But despite time pressure, congestion and traffic controls would the "asphalt cowboys" not swap her job. Each working day is an adventure, with friendships for life for Andrew, Piet and Marten. DMAX goes with the kings of the highway on a long trip across Europe, from Rostock to Milan. Spokesman of the new documentary series is a singer and Trucker Idol Gunter Gabriel - the German "Johnny Cash".

name: Love Bill
summary: A romance that arises after a collection of a financial debt.

name: Оторвы
summary: Reality about mothers and daughters. Daughter out of hand? Does your mother disapprove and criticize your lifestyle? Girls, don't fight! In the new project, mothers and daughters will take a step towards each other in order to sort out mutual claims and improve relations.

name: FBoy Island NZ
summary: In Aotearoa's hot new dating series three stunning Kiwi women are searching for the guy of their dreams. But can they tell the difference between the genuine 'nice guys' and the 'Fboys' who are there to compete for cold, hard cash?

name: Sventoonie
summary: It's Sventoonie , the official Svengoolie after-party! Join host Sventoonie every Saturday night at 10PM | 9C for a celebration of all things scary, silly… and Svengoolie! Every week, "The Red Tuna of Terror" recaps classic horror films, along with supernaturally fun sketches and video shorts. Of course, what's a party without guests like Svengoolie, Kerwyn, and other surprise pop-ins?

name: Ainsley's World Cup Flavours
summary: Cookery show in which chef Ainsley Harriott combines food and football, making dishes from around the world for celebrity guests.

name: Bollywed
summary: Bollywed is a heartwarming docu-series centred around the Singh family, who have been operating the iconic bridal shop, Chandan Fashion, in Toronto's Little India for the last 37 years. The series shines a fascinating light on the booming and glamorous world of Bollywood culture and fashion, and offers an authentic glimpse into an intergenerationally run business lead by patriarch Kuki Singh, his wife Sarab, their two children Chandan and Chandni, and daughter-in-law Roop.

name: Stay Tooned
summary: Eric Bauza – the Canadian who voices legendary characters from Bugs Bunny to Luke Skywalker – takes us on a deep dive through our favourite cartoons to see how they shaped us into who we are today. Each episode he meets with friends and experts to explore villains, race, sexuality, and so much more. Featuring Ben Schwartz, Lake Bell, Ken Jeong, Bobby Moynihan, Tara Strong, Lamorne Morris, Cree Summer, and James Adomian, among others.

name: Canada's Ultimate Challenge
summary: Each episode will take place at an iconic Canadian location where the teams will compete in spectacular Solo, Tandem or Team challenges that test them physically and mentally. Throughout the series, the superstar Canadian coaches will make strategic decisions and motivate their players to victory. In the end, only one team will win Canada's Ultimate Challenge !

name: The Home Team with Britt & Annie

name: The Sandie Shaw Supplement
summary: 1960s series in which Sandie Shaw performs songs on a specific theme.

name: Southern Hospitality
summary: The series follows "Southern Charm" resident boss-lady Leva Bonaparte as she manages Charleston's very own "it" crowd, otherwise known as her larger-than-life staff at Republic Garden & Lounge. Leva and husband Lamar own four restaurants along the city's famous King Street, but Republic is the crown jewel of their kingdom. The hottest nightclub and backdrop for Charleston's lively party scene, Republic is the place to go for pleasure, business or both.

name: Cuomo
summary: Chris Cuomo hosts CUOMO , a no-nonsense show featuring the day's most important news from all perspectives. CUOMO airs weeknights at 8 p.m./7C on NewsNation.

name: Life After

name: Killer Sally

name: America's Test Kitchen: The Next Generation
summary: Home cooks from across the country will compete to see who has what it takes to join the coveted America's Test Kitchen team. Each of the 11 contestants competing will present their dishes throughout a series of challenges that test their culinary abilities and on-camera personality. Each week, the contestants will stand in front of the judges' panel. The last cook standing will get the job of a lifetime—becoming the newest face of America's Test Kitchen, the opportunity to write their own cookbook, and a $100,000 prize to fund the culinary business of their dreams.

name: FIFA World Cup Preview Show
summary: A look ahead to the World Cup in Qatar.

name: My Friend, The Enemy

However, all four sides are relentless, reveling in the pain and pleasure of hatred and competition... and perhaps, even love.

name: Arknights
summary: In the wake of unknown Catastrophes in the heart of Terra, a mineral of unimaginable power has been discovered. With it, society's technology has made huge leaps and bounds, but the substance causes a deadly incurable disease, leading to a worldwide enslavement of the infected. As a rebellion is now on the rise, a pharmaceutical company races for a cure to save humanity.

name: Drag Race España: All Stars

In each episode, the contestants will have to pass different dance, sewing or acting challenges to avoid being eliminated and thus be crowned the winner and earn their place in the Drag Race España Hall of Fame. The ferocious duo is now back, but how much have they changed over the years? Do they still put each other in an uncomfortable situation in front of the couples therapist? How do they get along with the mother-in-law? In the episodes of the situational comedy, fans of the couple in love can also meet brand new and reimagining of familiar stories, directed by Gábor Herendi and Gergely Ipacs.

name: The Music Scene
summary: The Music Scene is a musical-variety show with rotating hosts, comedy sketches and contemporary rock and pop artists.

Amazingly spectacular courses, never-before-seen challenges, and the goal is the same for everyone: staying in the game!

The Queen has fled in protest, while the defence of the state is in the hands of the Guardians, a paramilitary force with absolute power and a ruthless determination to stamp out resistance.

From food competition rivalries and business partner squabbles to mentor vs. protégé grudges, sparks fly in and out of the kitchen.

Diving deep into the country's delicious food culture, they visit incredible locations to discover the culinary secrets and traditions of José's homeland.

Is Rome's Pantheon really an ancient sun dial? Why do Viking ships look different than Venetian gondolas? And why is there a floating church off the coast of Montenegro?

In it, players travel to various locations to complete challenges, helping them towards a larger goal - either by claiming territory or replenishing their travel budget. This character-driven documentary series follows multicultural athletes in pursuit of their dreams, paints a captivating picture of Japanese life and showcases what it takes to succeed in the international surf industry.

But the discovery of another life-sustaining planet light-years away gives hope to those who remain alive. Only a few will be able to make the generations-long journey, and those who don't make the cut face a watery death.

The docu-series takes fans behind the scenes with exclusive never-before-seen interviews, rehearsals, tour footage and performances across the U.S. from one of the biggest Reunion Tours.

These "kids" are now grown and ready to shake up all the norms of their Gospel roots. Each Gospel star has made their unique mark on the music scene, but they also each have very dark secrets and personal conflicts that may undermine their efforts to revolutionize the Gospel music industry.

The goal: to determine who is the funniest by making fun of his opponent. In front of an audience, comedians must demonstrate their ability to break their competitor.

Tense, emotional and anchored in personality conflicts, the series takes a critical look at society and the church in Portugal, in the 19th century.

His funny adventures and cunning tricks will surprise and amuse not only the owner, but also the audience!

The focus is on the struggle of the great powers over who gets control of the region and its natural resources. New information and perspectives on the events are offered by numerous international experts, ongoing field research, as well as newly opened archives and some never-before-seen footage.

Family life seems perfect, but on Anna's 44th birthday the world suddenly collapses: In a fit of anger, Peter kills his wife.

From an early age Zhaonan was always disguised as a boy, until one day when Ye Zhaonan fell off the cliff and met Liu Xuanming, the lord of Xuanyue City, and started a wonderful destiny.

Fresh off a terrible breakup, Sasha flees her life in New York to start over in London, where she meets and quickly falls in love with a recently divorced father named Jacob. When they impulsively decide to get married, they will soon learn that there's a lot they don't know about each other – and they can't outrun their pasts forever. Darkly comedic in tone, Second Wife is an exploration of intimacy, failure, and second chances.

name: Brave Police J-Decker

Over the past six months, Yuuta has taught Deckerd concepts which he was never meant to understand; things like joy, anger, sadness, and having a "heart". But now Deckerd is ready for Police service and his reprogramming will in all likelihood obliterate this knowledge...

Faced with the crisis of such a long, albeit happy relationship, they come to an agreement - to live in the format of an open marriage. Now they meet with other people, trying to figure out whether it is possible to become happy and not lose a loved one.

Bai Zhi, his seventh wife, married into the Marquis of Jingbei with trepidation, and thought she would not live more than a day, but found that the traitorous minister seemed to be different from the rumors...

name: Drinks, Crime and Prohibition
summary: The legacy of Prohibition is one of failure. Instead of making a more sober America, it weakened the nation's respect for the rule of law, enabled the expansion of organized crime, and turned city streets into battlefields. But it was also an era of great consequence, prompting federal criminal law enforcement and the expansion of the U.S. prison system. Revisit this defining moment in American history to see how it shaped the course of the 20th century and how its impact still reverberates to this day.

name: Jesse James Presents: Austin Speed Shop
summary: Jesse James, master fabricator and founder of West Coast Choppers goes back to his metal shaping roots in this entertaining series.

name: Stage 2
summary: Series of plays aired in 1971-72.

name: The Heir: The Freestyle Dynasty
summary: Five world champions of Spanish-speaking improvisation from Mexico, Argentina, Peru, Spain and Chile become mentors for the first time to recruit new talents from the Freestyle scene, and thus find a successor together.

name: Mr. Cat in the Villa
summary: Adapted from the novel 'Yang Fang Li De Mao Xian Sheng' (洋房里的猫先生) by Ying Yang . The tale of a gifted cartoonist, Qi Cheng, who suffers from social phobia. He is like a cat living alone in a bungalow. He is sensitive, vigilant, and stays away from crowds. He wishes to make friends with people, but he is afraid of approaching people. Chi Zhi Han, a popular food blogger, has become Qi Cheng's private chef because of a bowl of Yang Chun Noodle. With a contract and two people in a house, Chi Zhi Han uses her true love to take Qi Cheng out of the door that he hadn't dared to step out of for ten yea

name: The Romantics
summary: Featuring archival footage and in-depth celebrity interviews, this docuseries celebrates the life and legacy of Bollywood filmmaking titan Yash Chopra.

name: My Divine Emissary
summary: No one ever pays attention to Li Mengmeng, an insecure girl who does badly at school. One day, she strays into the unfamiliar world of Qi Kingdom to be hailed as their godly envoy. Depending on her modern day skillset, she becomes the mentor to the young black-bellied king.

name: Grenfell
summary: Told from multiple perspectives, Grenfell will shine a light on the human stories of those caught up in the tragedy, exploring the profound impact of Grenfell on survivors, the families and loved ones of those whose lives were lost, the firefighters on duty that night, and the wider community. The shockwaves of Grenfell were felt all over the country. This drama will ask not only how this terrible tragedy was able to occur, but also what we can learn to ensure that the events at Grenfell can never happen again elsewhere.

name: Fairyland Romance
summary: A prince strays into the peach blossom village, a place that is said to contain the fountain of youth, and begins an angsty romance with its leader Liu Qing Qing. Among the clouds and mists in the mountains, there is a village full of peach blossoms that is isolated from everything. Zuo Jing Lun, the heir to the imperial dynasty, strays into this place while on his way to take office in the southwest. Here, he regains his inner peace and falls in love with Liu Qing Qing , a strong leader who dares to love and hate.

name: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
summary: For more than five decades the US government has refused to discuss UFOs, but now, Navy pilots tell of seeing mysterious objects tracking their fighter jets – vehicles unlike anything they've ever seen before; top-secret Naval videos are leaked that captivate the world. Government officials, led by former U.S. Senator Harry Reid, demand an investigation. At long last, it looks like the truth about UFOs may finally be revealed.
previous_episode: Citizen Scientists Tackle the UFO Phenomenon

name: Джуна
summary: This series tells the story of Juna Davitashvili—an extraordinary healer and clairvoyant with a complex personality. The plot centers on a screenplay about Juna's life that Andrei, a mystery writer, has been commissioned by a film studio to write. Juna agrees to cooperate with Andrei and share her life story. The writer frequently visits Juna, observes her working with patients, and records fascinating, previously unknown details of her biography. Gradually, he comes to believe in her magical abilities and begins to dream of the impossible: a conversation with his deceased son. Then, one day,

summary: An extreme show in which participants test their endurance by passing an obstacle course. To win the show, participants must complete the qualifying stage, semi-finals, finals and superfinals. For a successful performance in a project, the speed and number of illuminated rings that need to be removed at each stage are important. If the ring does not break, the participant cannot continue the test. In the semifinals, seventy athletes compete not only with the track, but also with each other, passing tests in a pair race on a unique double lane. Thirty-five heroes make it to the finals, and only

name: Queens Court
summary: Queens Court is back with new celebrity queens – LisaRaye, K. Michelle and London Charles - as they embark on a journey to find their forever partners. Even with success, fame and fortune, the one area they have not ruled is matters of the heart. In this era of self-discovery, these Queens are opening their hearts to find their Kings amongst 22 confident, successful men. Hollywood power couple Holly Robinson Peete and Rodney Peete return to guide the new Queens as they let go of the past, embrace new connections, and look for their happily ever after.

name: Operasjon Lost Boy
summary: 15-year-old Martin calls the police in Bergen. This leads to an international hunt for a network of abusers. This series shows the inside of the police chase.

name: Маршруты любви
summary: Нелли уже тридцать лет, она не замужем, у неё скучная работа и никаких перспектив на горизонте. Чего она только не перепробовала, чтобы наладить личную жизнь! Но счастье не спешит к ней. Когда её бросает очередной парень, Нелли от отчаяния едва не сводит счёты со своей непутёвой жизнью. Подруги Аня и Жанна пытаются ей помочь, но вскоре все трое понимают, что нуждаются в кардинальных переменах. И начать девушки решают с перезагрузки – они решают пройти тренинг на выживание в диких условиях вдали от цивилизации. Две недели по одному из самых экстремальных маршрутов – готовы ли к таким испытаниям

name: My Man Is Cupid
summary: Fairy Cheon Sang Hyuk is the long-standing owner of Sarangbang, a high-end Korean chain restaurant in Jongno, Seoul. He went missing after working as a detective at Jongno Police Station. He is a man who has built an impregnable wall between him and women and a fairy who has burned his wings for 500 years.

name: Anti-Corruption Storm
summary: During the self-defense counterattack against Vietnam, Zhao Da Sheng, the commander of the reconnaissance company, lost his memory due to injuries and was saved by fraternal troops. Zhao Da Sheng's comrade-in-arms Yu Zhong Jun, thought that he had died, and according to their previous promise, he took good care of Zhao Da Sheng's wife Wang Yu Lan and son Zhao Xiao Jun, and the three formed a new family. A few years later, Zhao Da Sheng, who recovered his memory, returned to his hometown, only to find that his wife had remarried a friend. But he doesn't have much time , to deal with his persona

name: Go Hard or Go Home
summary: Brutal workouts… terrifying challenges… how far will eight Brits go to change their life? Adrenalin-fuelled fitness challenge series, hosted by Jordan North.

name: SPCA Rescue
summary: Follow the inspiring mahi of dedicated SPCA staff and volunteers as they give everything they have to protect neglected, injured or abandoned animals.

name: Dark Land: Hunting the Killers
summary: Reinvestigating some of Wales's most shocking unsolved murders.

name: World Cross Country Championships Highlights
summary: Highlights from the World Cross Country Championships.

name: Secrets of the Jurassic Dinosaurs
summary: Liz Bonnin joins an international team of palaeontologists in the remote badlands of Wyoming as they investigate a mysterious dinosaur graveyard.

name: Parole
summary: A look into the high stakes world of parole hearings, where the futures of prisoners, victims and their families hang in the balance.

name: Séamus Mac Murchaidh
summary: The story of notorious south Armagh outlaw Séamus Mac Murphy, an epic tale of repression and rebellion, love and betrayal.

name: The Women Who Changed Modern Scotland
summary: Kirsty Wark uncovers the stories of some of Scotland's most important female pioneers.

name: Secret France with Dick and Angel
summary: During their time at the Chateau, Dick and Angel have come to discover a side of France that few tourists ever see, and in Secret France with Dick and Angel they want to share some of the secrets they've learnt by heading off the beaten track to explore the areas of France few of us spot.

name: La chica invisible
summary: A father and daughter involved in the investigation of a murdered teenage girl in the picturesque fictional town of Cárdena, set in Andalusia. The two are forced to put their differences aside and to succumb their tense relationship in order to solve the murder case rocking a supposedly peaceful town, where all inhabitants are suspects.

name: The Billionaires Who Made Our World
summary: Landmark series lifting the lid on the tech titans of Silicon Valley - Gates, Bezos, Zuckerberg and Musk - who changed our world forever, how we communicate, how we shop, and the information we get.

name: Jamie Johnson FC
summary: Enter the world of elite academy football with Jamie Johnson FC . Join Jamie and a whole new squad of stars - who has what it takes to be the best? Get ready for a new era of Jamie Johnson football magic.

name: Duplas à Portuguesa
previous_episode: Joshua Benoliel e Aurélio Paz dos Reis

name: Sur Ta Rue
summary: Sur Ta Rue is an investigative documentary series in which private detective Annie Richard leads celebrities into the troubling past of their neighborhood. In each episode, she reveals to her guest the story of a place that is unique to her: her residence, her childhood home, or even her secondary school. She then takes to the road with the guest artist to reveal to him what his street has known in terms of crimes, accidents, legends, paranormal activities and heroic gestures. Together, they meet the witnesses of these events, bringing to light forgotten parts of our collective history.

name: Horario Estelar
summary: The story of a famous journalist and television host who covers an impact police case in which he is involved, although nobody knows it. As the investigation begins to advance, the journalist makes use of his abilities to avoid questions and information that implicate him, to get away with public opinion.

name: Still Missing Morgan
summary: On a humid evening in 1995, Colleen Nick's life would be forever changed when her daughter, Morgan Nick, was kidnapped while playing with friends nearby. Her friend, Patty Wetterling, is one of few people who can relate to life with a child missing for 27 years. Patty's son, Jacob, was kidnapped six years before Morgan. When the Morgan Nick case is reexamined in 2020, a documentary crew was there with the new investigators - leading to the first dramatic shift in the investigation in 25 years.

name: Battle of the Alphas
summary: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head with their own kind, in Battle of the Alphas .

name: Waco Untold: The British Stories
summary: Waco Untold: The British Stories will explore the untold story of the sizeable British contingent of David Koresh's Branch Davidian cult, and their experiences during the 51 day ordeal at Waco and its storming by the FBI in 1993.

name: Mean Girl Murders
summary: Mean Girl Murders explores the inner workings of cutthroat cliques, vicious backbiting and cruel intentions.

name: Killer Cheer
summary: Killer Cheer explores horrific events surrounding young girls.

name: Player 54: Chasing the XFL Dream
summary: With eight teams, 400 players, 40 coaches, and a new ownership group, Player 54: Chasing the XFL Dream is a visual manifestation of the League's motto: where dreams meet opportunity. The original series takes fans behind the scenes of what it takes to build a League and its eight teams from the ground-up, showcasing the human stories that exist within the XFL on and off the field. It is a character-driven look at the inspiring, unconventional, and even heartbreaking journeys of the players and head coaches whose professional aspirations are just beginning – or getting a second chance.

name: The Ancient Splendors of Rome
summary: When it comes to the mighty Empire of Rome, surely its greatest gift to posterity is the Colosseum that still commands the awe and admiration of people all over the world to this day. Built with 1 million bricks laid by the hands of 30,000 slaves, the Colosseum forced the Roman Genius to develop all-new building techniques which continue to benefit architects today. But it was also a tool used by clever emperors to manipulate public opinion in their favor. However, not every aspect of Roman history is quite so triumphant: The eruption of Mt. summary: Talented neurosurgeon Inna Loseva, having lost her husband on her own operating table, is forced to return to her hometown to help her mother after a stroke. Due to psychological trauma, she can no longer operate, so she gets a job as a therapist in a district clinic. Loseva is trusted with the 8th precinct, which is considered by therapists to be "damned". Soon, Inna faces intrigues and deceit not only from her colleagues, but even from patients and influential officials. name: Mission: Job Unknown
summary: Die ProSieben-Doku-Soap schickt Promis auf eine Reise, auf der sie in Zweierteams neuen Jobs nachgehen sollen. Dabei wissen sie im Vorfeld nicht, worauf sie sich einlassen. So müssen z.B. Autorin und Moderatorin Laura Karasek und Comedian Oliver Pocher auf einer Käse-Alm in Rumänien ihre landwirtschaftlichen Fähigkeiten beweisen, während Ex-Skispringer Sven Hannawald und Ex-Fußball-Nationalspieler Mario Basler in Mexiko als Rettungsschwimmer einspringen. Welches Team löst seine Job-Challenges am besten und sammelt die meisten Punkte? (Text: GR)

name: My Pacific Quest
summary: Kiwi adventurer Ellis Emmett embarks on an incredible journey across the waves of the South Pacific. He must harness the power of the wind to explore some of the most remote islands and atolls on the planet; places only accessible by sailboat. Greeted by the isolated people who call these shores home, Ellis immerses himself in the fascinating, yet threatened cultures of Tonga, Fiji, Wallis and Futuna, the Marshall Islands, and Kiribati.

name: Coastal Defenders
summary: Following the work of a team of dive engineers based on the southern coast of England as they battle time and tide to keep Britain's coastlines and waterways moving.

name: The Mormons Are Coming
summary: Three newly trained Mormon missionaries in Lancashire search for new converts. But in an increasingly secular Britain, how do you convince people that the Book of Mormon is true?

name: Alan Carr's Picture Slam
summary: Alan Carr's Picture Slam will see three teams face a series of pictures and each picture is worth cash. The more they can name the more they win, but for the big money they need to name them ALL, and if they do that, they've got a Picture Slam! This is the fast paced game that asks do you know your Eiffel Tower from your Blackpool Tower? Your Victoria Beckham from your Victoria Sponge and your Buckingham Palace from your Crystal Palace? Across four thrilling rounds, contestants will need to know something about everything to try and win up to £10,000!

name: Live with Kelly & Mark
summary: Kelly Ripa, host of the long-running, highly rated talk show since 2001, is joined by husband Mark Consuelos.

name: Stone Cold Takes on America
summary: For over two decades, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin gave everything to wrestling, becoming one of the all-time greats. However, his dedication to his career meant sacrificing many of the other experiences life has to offer. Stone Cold Takes on America , Austin will hit the road in his RV, accepting challenges from fans that push him out of his comfort zone, and make up for lost time. Through archival footage from classic WWE moments and his own stories, the series weaves together Austin's old and new life - both filled with incredible feats and his unique point of view - as he celebrates and learn

name: Truckers: Life on the Road
summary: Truckers are the life blood of Britain. Without them our shops, shelves, construction sites, fuel tanks and kitchen cupboards would be empty. In this story of real-life kings and queens of the road, we're riding shotgun with the team at Owens - one of the oldest and biggest haulage companies in Wales.

name: Live with Regis and Kathie Lee
Royal Crackers
summary: A Bakersfield family's once-successful cracker company dynasty is up for grabs. Royal Crackers was once the king of snacks, but the empire is crumbling. When the family patriarch, tyrannical company founder Theodore Hornsby Sr. ends up in a "super coma", the rest of the Hornsbys will take their lack of talent and business acumen and try to make Royal Crackers the success it once was.

name: Angelique: When Hearts Awaken
summary: A young girl named Ange is summoned to another world where she has been chosen to become the legendary Etoile whose mission is to save the newly-born cosmos named the Cosmos of the Holy Beast which has recently befallen a crisis. With the support of nine guardians she embarks on a journey to save the the land of the Holy Beast.

name: Great Miss D
summary: In Shanghai in the early 1930s, various forces were surging and the society was in turmoil. Ding Yiqing, the daughter of a wealthy Ningbo businessman, went to Shanghai alone to find her missing brother, but unexpectedly used her business skills to embark on the road of revolution. On this road, she has seen hope, that promising young man named Lin Mosheng, who is willing to fight with her hand in hand. name: Remembrance of Things Past
summary: The story shows the realistic life of young people in a foreign land in the metropolis. The experiences of each character give a sense of social topicality and currentness. Whether it is anxiety or calmness, whether it is staying and struggling or returning home. Through the various experiences of loss and gain, staying and leaving, they have gained the spiritual belonging and urban homeland to settle down in life.

name: Archie & Pete
summary: Archie & Pete follows an explosive, rule-breaking, fearless female detective with no filter enlists the help of a polite and gentle brainiac who studies the biology of evil to solve cases for the Los Angeles Violent Crimes Unit.

name: Next Stop Your World
summary: Wu Yan Zhu, a trainee doctor in the real world, who accidentally broke into the world of the comic "W", drawn by her father Wu Cheng Wu, met the comic actor Jiang Zhe, and a series of thrilling events and sweet love story begins.

name: A League of Their Own Road Trip: Southeast Asia
summary: After two years grounded to the British Isles, Jamie, Micah and Romesh are back for an epic sporting odyssey across Southeast Asia. Along the way they'll be joined by an array of star guests: Mo Gilligan heads into the Vietnamese jungle; Alan Carr and Big Zuu take on a synchronised swimming challenge; Patrice Evra and Maisie Adam race in Ha Long Bay; while Joel Dommett and Emily Atack attempt May Thai.

name: Thunder Bay
summary: Thunder Bay is a four-part Crave Original documentary series based on the groundbreaking podcast from Canadaland, Thunder Bay . The gripping investigative series is produced and also hosted by Anishinaabe journalist and award-winning writer, Ryan McMahon, who is on a quest to uncover the truth in the recent deaths of multiple Indigenous people in Thunder Bay, Ontario – a city known as the homicide and hate crime capital of Canada. McMahon's investigation sheds light on the history of racism in Thunder Bay, and examines the failings and the injustices of its social systems and institutions. The

In the winter of 1979, Yang Shumao returns home after graduating. He hopes to climb the social ladder and become a business to be at the level of his first love, Shi Xiaona, a rich heiress. Take a culinary adventure across Aotearoa New Zealand, uncovering hilarious and hearty stories of modern Kiwi-Chinese life through our universal love for food. Made with the support of NZ On Air. Featuring Masterchef 2022 and barista champ Sam Low, Olympic Gold medallist Tyla-Nathan Wong, and many more from the Kiwi-Chinese community - this series will give you plenty to munch on.

name: Девичник
summary: What could be more important than a wedding? Only a bachelorette party! After all, as you take it off, so you will live in marriage. And then they come to the rescue - bridesmaids. In each issue, the brides go to each other's bachelorette parties and evaluate the holiday. Unbridled fun and real female competition are guaranteed!

name: Top Chef
summary: Twelve young hopeful French chefs compete to win the title of "Top Chef," 100,000 euros. and be judged by the best in the business.

name: CMT Storytellers
summary: Get an in-depth look at the country music industry and what goes into becoming the best of the best in a behind-the-scenes look at the genre's greatest artists.

name: Nine Songs of the Moving Heavens
summary: The stories stars Han Fei, a student of the Confucius school and a prince of the Han Kingdom, traveling back to his homeland. During his stay, he meets up with Zhang Liang, Wei Zhuang, and Zinu. Together, they create Quicksand, a group dedicated to wrestling back control of the Han Kingdom from its top general, Ji Wuye. However, many other forces are conspiring over control of the Han, and the situation becomes more and more complex.

name: Nenek Bongkok Tiga
summary: Eight strangers held hostage in a mysterious dimension must complete a series of games in order to escape from a sinister being.

name: A Lot
summary: A Lot is a multi-cam improv comedy about a couple in their late 30s who pour their life savings into their biggest business endeavor yet: building a housing development on a defunct studio lot. But these house flippers get more than they bargained for when their new project becomes a nightmare.

name: The Shrouded College
summary: Based on Charles Soule and Will Sliney's series of graphic novels, The Shrouded College tells the stories of various characters enlisted to become secret agents fighting a supernatural cold war on the side of the Shrouded College, a down-and-out organization on the edge of destruction.

name: Моя мама — шпион
summary: The modest housewife Dasha forgot that she was once the star of Sobolev's special department. After activating a memory that lasted twenty years ago, not only fighting skills return, but also a daring character and a love of spectacular outfits. In the company of a colleague and brutal ex-fiance Makarov, you have to find a traitor and choose one of the lives: a homemaker and a dentist's wife or a spy and a superhero girl.

summary: Floortje Dessing travels with award-winning photographer Jasper Doest from the Netherlands to Nepal, along the way recording how people and animals live together. They meet people who dedicate their lives to animals, and marvel at the often complicated relationship between humans and animals.

name: Inside Monster Jam
summary: This official Monster Jam podcast offers exclusive inside access to Monster Jam Operations, including drivers, safety, track design and the Monster Jam Garage.

name: Слишком много любовников
summary: A man approached a famous private detective with a request to find his missing lover Alena and immediately gave him an extremely generous advance. At the first glance of the detective, Alena's life was unremarkable - there seemed to be nothing to catch on to. But as the investigation progressed, new victims began to appear and now this case has taken a completely different turn. What was modest Alena hiding if her disappearance led to such strange and terrible events?

name: History: The Interesting Bits
summary: Travel back in time with us as we reveal the funny, disturbing, tragic, ridiculous, fascinating and, just occasionally, preposterous stories that are all too often hidden under piles of dry facts, dates, monarchs, politicians, wars and treaties. Such as the spy tried for witchcraft, the president with radioactive urine and the man that sold the Eiffel Tower... twice!

name: Family Restaurant
summary: Andrew Zimmern visits iconic family restaurants across America. Multi-generational families share the stories and incredible food that make them so special.

name: Russebussen
summary: Finally russetid! Now Eigil and Vip are going to be cool! But their habit wears off, and the first bus is out of reach...or is it? They start an arduous journey towards the top of the school's social hierarchy.

name: What a Country
summary: "What a Country!" revolves around a ''citizenship class'' with a neat little cross section of foreign students: imperious Robert the African; grumpy Laszlo the Hungarian; fiery Maria and Victor the Hispanics; sweet little Yung Hi the Asian; trusting Ali the Pakistani, and shrewd Nikolai the Russian. Overseeing this determined brood is a nice-guy teacher Taylor Brown and an at-wits'-end school principal Joan Courtney, who is not quite sure what to do with ''these wonderful people from God knows where.''

name: Nudes
summary: Three stories of "revenge porn" seen through the eyes of three teenagers: Vittorio, Sofia and Ada.

name: Hengaillaan
summary: Hengaillaan is a Saturday night entertainment programme that combines quizzes, live music and taste tourism. Hosted by Jenni Poikelus and judged by Riku Rantala. Celebrity contestants will be taken on a journey to destinations in Finland, Europe and the world to test their knowledge in a series of changing questions. The topics include everything from contemporary entertainment to history, music, sport and geography. name: Sicília sense morts
summary: The president of the Balearic Islands receives the corpse of a rat at home. This unusual event triggers a journalistic investigation that will uncover the hidden mechanisms of power. The revenge, the desires, the virtues and miseries of a whole series of characters, could suggest that Mallorca is like Sicily without deaths. But until when?

name: Jinny's Kitchen
summary: In a small beautiful town in Mexico, Bacalar, Jinny's Kitchen opens, introducing Korean street food to their passionate customers! Meet Seo Jin, the boss who is serious about the business, Yu Mi, the new executive, Seo Jun, the new head of kitchen, Woo Shik, our good old intern, and Tae Hyung, the ambitious new intern! Come and enjoy their specialties made with love.

name: Indianapolis 500
summary: The Indianapolis 500 , formally known as the Indianapolis 500-Mile Race , and commonly called the Indy 500, is an annual automobile race held at Indianapolis Motor Speedway (IMS) in Speedway, Indiana, United States, an enclave suburb of Indianapolis. The event is traditionally held over Memorial Day weekend, usually the last weekend of May. It is contested as part of the IndyCar Series, the top level of American open-wheel car racing, a formula colloquially known as "Indy car racing". The track itself is nicknamed the "Brickyard", as the racing surface was paved in brick in the fall of 1909. O

name: Limitless with Nadia
summary: Join Nadia Khaled in this new weekly podcast where she teaches you how to reconnect with your inner badass and align with your highest timeline, unlocking your infinite potential to create a reality that defies all odds.

name: The Justice in the Dark
summary: Adapted from the novel "Silent Reading" (默读) by Priest. The story is now set in a sci-fi-esque Xinyuan Civilization Year 253 where rising crime rate and its relation to "zero-degre empathy" have become a topic of interest. The murder of a deliveryman leads to a criminal organization and the culprit turns out to be someone with "zero-degre empathy". Police officer Luo Weizhao who is in charge of the case finds that things are not as simple as they seem. In subsequent cases, the wealthy Pei Su also seems to be caught in the middle.

name: Police Strike Force
summary: The inside story of the most gripping, heart-stopping, tense and nerve-racking police investigations, stings and taskforce operations in recent memory, told by the men and women who broke the case and were there when it all came crashing down. Using video and sound captured by the New South Wales Police Media Unit, combined with surveillance, search and interview footage taken by the investigating units, Police Strike Force is a compelling insight into dramatic law enforcement takedowns.

name: Lhong Ngao Jun
summary: Pim's half-sister Khem goes out with guys pretending to be Pim. After getting dumped by Khem, one of the guys dies in a car crash. His friend Ae accuses 'Pim' of being the cause and vows to get revenge on her and gets engaged to Khem so he can get closer to Pim in order to make her life miserable. Pim on the other hand has no clue why she's being stalked/bullied by this psychopath.

name: Sortez Moi D'Ici

This thought takes root in the minds of two friends Bhargav and Siddhant after they read countless news stories of bank scams that have happened in the country and that a total of seventy-one thousand five hundred crores has been scammed. With each discovery, Ariel is filled with joy, and her mermaid tail, which changes colors depending on her emotions, lights up and shimmers.

Performed by popular musical artists Rob Cantor and Genevieve Goings ("Disney Junior Nursery Rhymes"), the shorts feature reimagined versions of classic songs, including "Circle of Life" from "The Lion King," "You Can Fly!" from "Peter Pan," "How Far I'll Go" from "Moana" and "It's A Small World."

He enters Wei's residence intending to steal the precious cure, Flame Jade. However, to his surprise, Jiang Juan unknowingly falls for Wei Lin in the process.

name: Un Cuento Perfecto
summary: Margot is a wealthy hotel heiress. David juggles three jobs. Their plan to recoup their exes proves that hearts heal in unexpected ways — and places.

name: Ramyun Brothers in Japan

Kang Ho-dong, Lee Seung-gi, and Bae In-hyuk who are serious about ramyeon gather as a team. They study the famous recipes and cook ramyeons with fresh and trendy ingredients. Every day, they must come up with a new recipe. What will happen at their ramyeon restaurant?

But the joy turns into concern when they realize that their daughter is speaking and acting strangely as if she were controlled by someone else. But why? Food critic and food lover Grace Dent traces the history of the company to figure out the secrets of their extraordinary success.

name: Lost Dogs Live with Clare Balding

name: Adam & Poh's Great Australian Bites

name: Never Let Him Go

name: Moordzaken: Eeuwige Twijfel

He will make his parents suffer the way he himself suffers, having lost his only loved one. They will never know who punished them. If each episode goes well in a stadium, the camera here is never turned towards the lawn: the stories take place exclusively in the stands while the match is played off-screen. name: Milo

Alongside his good friend Li Yunfei, they cross paths with Su Nan, a forward-thinking student, and Zhou Yingqun, an upright and principled BIS agent. As the enigma surrounding the key gradually unravels, it sets off clashes among gangs and sparks nationwide turmoil. name: Anhe Zhuan
summary: An He, the world's most mysterious assassin organization, consists of the 3 names of the Su, Xie, and Mu Families. Everyone was poisoned, and their lives were at stake. After learning the news, the 3 powers of the An He family took the opportunity to launch a rebellion. Su Muyu, as the leader of the Shadow Spider Guardian group, brought Bai Hehuai, the genius doctor of the Medicine King Valley, to heal the elders, while repelling the assassins and protecting the elder Zhouquan. At this time, his friend Su Changhe in An He, but on behalf of the Su Family joined the operation to kill the patriar

name: Gaishi Dizun
summary: In an ancient time when powerful Cultivators constantly battle for supremacy, a young man nicknamed Sleepyhead acquires a matchlessly powerful Cultivation method which has come as a blessing in disguise. That day marks the start of an epic journey of a prodigy endowed with unequaled physical constitution, who later achieves a meteoric rise in the world of Cultivators by defeating countless talented fellow practitioners. In a realm where numerous forces are thriving, he alone stands invincible.

name: Hudutsuz Sevda
summary: When he was a little child, Halil İbrahim lost his father due to a blood feud and was exiled to Istanbul. Twenty years later, he returns to his homeland in the Karadeniz region as a handsome, powerful young man. He plans to marry the girl he loves, Yasemin, and start a new life. However, events do not allow this. Halil İbrahim embarks on a journey of revenge, and his life will change completely when he encounters Zeynep from the Leto family.

name: Welcome to the Pub
summary: The story shows the various life styles of urban diners through the perspective of a tavern owner full of life wisdom. Whenever they encounter stumbling blocks in their struggle and life, they will come to the tavern to sit in the tavern, and under the hospitality of the boss's food and wine, they will be relieved and regain their confidence in life. The tavern hidden in the depths of the alley is like a shelter for people. The stories that happen in it are exactly the life we are experiencing now.

name: Megan Thee Stallion vs Tory Lanez: Five Shots
summary: Megan Thee Stallion vs Tory Lanez: Five Shots will explore the incident which saw Tory convicted of shooting Megan in the summer of 2020.

name: Drive with Swizz Beatz
summary: In Drive with Swizz Beatz , hip-hop legend and car collector Swizz Beatz and son Nasir Dean (also known as Note Mercato) visit car-loving destinations, where they'll examine the area's distinctive car culture and bring together two otherwise disparate car clubs over a shared love of all things automotive and an appreciation for what it's like to beat the odds through sheer drive alone.

name: Förrädarna
summary: Actor Dragomir Mrsic leads the program where board games meet reality. Get ready for a nerve-wracking murder mystery game where we, the viewers, become witnesses behind the scenes. 18 participants, completely unaware of each other, arrive at Häringe Castle and are put to tough tests in the psychological game. Who in the group can be trusted, which blacksmiths cheat and above all who are the Traitors?

name: The Tranz Form
summary: Brielle, Xaria and Elle are three Black Trans womxn in South Florida navigating love, family, community, health and politics.

name: Oktopus
summary: OKTOPUS is an abbreviation of "department for the control of deferred cases of department S". It was invented by the aging Captain Dítě mainly so that he could focus on the thirty-year-old Jordán case. He finds understanding in Lieutenant Colonel Schwarz, his superior, but when he assigns the young, ambitious Captain Fáberová to his hand, it soon becomes clear that he will not stick to just one case. The cases that OKTOPUS solves took place in the past, and it is up to the detectives to find new circumstances and clues that will help them finally solve the old cases. Their search will take us

name: A Clean Sweep
summary: Amateur baseball players go up against legendary pros in a championship to determine the ultimate winning team.

name: The Villbergs Chronicles
summary: Swedish internationally recognized power couple The Villbergs consisting of a talkative glittery goblin and a beautiful self-centred lady-woman welcomes you to see the world through their eyes.

name: Back to Seventeen
summary: 27-year-old Zhong Xiaoxiao's life changes when a DV recording sends her back to age 17. Her high school crush, Xu Yang, was a distant academic genius, but she soon discovers that time only flows normally when she's near him. As Xu Yang moves into her home, their growing connection leads to a series of unexpected and ironic events.

name: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
summary: Prue Leith opens the doors to her Cotswold Kitchen, sharing cherished recipes, tips, and handy culinary hacks. Joined by her husband John and a cast of special friends, including Sandi Toksvig, Alison Hammond and chef Tommy Banks, each episode is a unique culinary adventure. Beyond the kitchen, Prue celebrates her personal food heroes both locally and beyond. And husband John gets to grips with a varied mix of country activities on offer in the Cotswolds. The series is a celebration of food, friendship and fun – with easy-to-cook recipes for every occasion.

name: Politics Hub with Sophy Ridge
summary: Join Sophy Ridge for a fast-paced daily dissection of what's happening in Westminster, with a brand-new show launching Monday 4 September on Sky News at 7pm. Politics Hub with Sophy Ridge brings together Sky News' innovative and energetic coverage with their expert political team, including Beth Rigby and Sam Coates, for a one-hour show, weeknights at 7pm. Heading into a critical election year, Sophy and the team will offer an unparalleled mix of interviews, insights and analysis, getting stuck into the hard news but also the quirkier things going on in the country's corridors of power. On thi

name: The Search for Instagram's Worst Con Artist
summary: The Search for Instagram's Worst Con Artist tells the inside story of Belle Gibson, the 21-year-old social influencer who claimed she cured her terminal cancer through wellness and healthy eating. Her miraculous story brought her fame and money, with a successful app, a book deal and countless television appearances. But when journalists investigated, they discovered something shocking: none of her story was true – she never had cancer. She had misled her millions of followers – and for some there were devastating consequences. With access to friends and family who speak on the record for the

name: The Bride of Naga
summary: An epidemic of an unknown disease that gives children in Phanom Nakha strange snake-like scales leads Dr. Benedict to research the phenomenon. Asia, a medical illustrator, is chosen to help him with this. Along the way, the two meet Phumkhaobin, a lively but mysterious man and younger brother to Asia's friend Pheka. When joining the research, Asia couldn't have imagined that she would not only meet mysterious Phumkhaobin but also become involved in the mysterious legend of a village where people worship serpents.

name: Across the Sky
summary: A young man moves to Thailand to attend a prestigious academy and realise his dreams of becoming a famous musical artist just like his late father.

name: Rebel with a Cause
summary: This four-part documentary series hones in on the political dimension of the personal, showcasing the unparalleled efforts of four First Nations trailblazers who altered the course of Australian history. Interweaving never-before-seen archival material with interviews with loved ones and peers, Rebel with a Cause dives into the philosophies that guided Senator Neville Bonner, magistrate Pat O'Shane, poet Oodgeroo Noonuccal and media icon Tiga Bayles to present an inspirational, vital account of First Nations-led change-making.

name: The Legacy Awards
summary: Join host Keshia Chanté in celebrating Black Canadian talent at The 2023 Legacy Awards . The show will feature exciting performances, award presentations, and special tributes honouring both established and emerging Black Canadian talent.

name: The Brightest of Us
summary: Story of two people who helped reinvent traditional media and restore its glory. Zhou Ran is a woman interested in fashion who meets Ye Rongxuan, an unbending chief editor.

name: Laura Kuenssberg: State of Chaos
summary: BBC Two and BBC Current Affairs announce Laura Kuenssberg: State of Chaos which explores the reasons behind some of the most dramatic and chaotic political events seen in a generation. Laura asks if our politics has been stretched to breaking point and if it can ever be normal again, in a series of three one hour episodes produced by October Films. From the Brexit referendum, resignations, elections, prorogation and the pandemic, Laura was the BBC's political editor and held a ringside seat as these events unfolded. She'll investigate why this period became so toxic, both in public and behind

name: Zhen Yang Wushen
summary: The Daqian Dynasty is flourishing and is subservient to the whole world. However, beneath the surface of its prosperity, dark currents are already swirling. The eight demon immortals are eager to move, Wuwen Duke Hong Xuanji is ever-more powerful, and Meng Shenji, the Lord of Taishang Fraction, is monitoring the world. In such a world of great strife, the young scholar Hong Yi sent his first question to the world. Hong Yi is the son of Hong Xuanji, the most powerful minister of the dynasty, and Meng Bingyun, the previous Saintess of Taishang Fraction. Hong Yi lost his mother when he was young,

name: The Giza Killer
summary: Inspired by horrific true events. As a serial killer claims victim after victim, Officer Hazem will stop at nothing to catch him before the body count goes up...

name: Колапс. Як українці зруйнували імперію зла
summary: The series tells about the exit of Ukraine from the USSR and the role of Ukrainians in the collapse of the Empire of Evil.
previous_episode: On the Verge of a Nuclear Disaster

name: Barrumbi Kids
summary: A story of two best friends, Tomias and Dahlia, who are growing up together on Country in a remote Northern Territory community, and face various adversities and have many exciting adventures.

name: Building the Snowy
summary: The story of the Snowy Mountains Hydro-Electric Scheme and its modern expansion, Snowy 2.0, a project that saw Australia meet the challenge of the new world.

name: NCT 127: The Lost Boys
summary: Ever since their debut in 2016, NCT 127 continues to captivate audiences with fresh concepts and performances. They speak of their childhoods for the first time ever, through various forms of art, including plays, animations, dancing, singing, and performance art.

name: Killerspiele!
summary: Killer games - hardly a word in the German gaming landscape is so charged, hardly a debate was so emotional. Anyone who hears the word killer games today thinks of "Counter Strike", of "Doom", but most likely also of: Erfurt, Winnenden - the scenes of school shootings that shook Germany in the early 2000s. The culprits were quickly found: so-called first-person shooters, in the tabloid style they were called killer games from then on. But there is so much more behind the story of these computer games - ZDFinfo tells it in a three-part documentary series.

name: ТОП
summary: TOP is a show that is completely dedicated to the star guest. In every issue of Karina Kross is calling a star, and asks 3x co-hosts to prepare unique headings. All headings either otherwise associated with the guest and held in separate mini-studios. In breaks between visits to rooms, there is communication and interactives With Karina Kross At the end of the show, the guest chooses whose room he liked more.

name: Ts Madison Ate That
summary: Ts Madison tries the weirdest snacks from all over the internet, opening special mystery boxes filled to the brim with viral funky food. She must sample them and decide if she likes it - she ATE - or if it's disgusting - she HATE. From cloyingly-sweet breakfast-flavored cup noodles to mouth-puckering sour pickle ball candy, Maddie holds nothing back, giving us her TRUE reaction. Take a bite 'cause Ts Madison Ate That !

name: The Code of Siam
summary: A man walking the thin line between good and evil is an ingenious criminal. Yet he abides by the law and serves time in prison. One day before release, his ex-girlfriend who also happens to be his biggest rival runs into serious trouble, leaving him no choice but to escape in order to save her. The story originates in the Golden Triangle where drug trade is proliferate. Xia Tian gambles with his life against a notorious drug lord and wins big. News of Xia Tian's misdeeds reach Zhang Li who works for the Interpol. As it turns out, she is Xia Tian's ex-girlfriend and the apple of his eye. Despit

name: Мендельсон
summary: Fate played a strange joke with the Airborne Forces officer Vladimir Mendin (call sign "Mendel"): his whole life is spent among women. At home, his three daughters seized power long ago, and there was almost no room for vests on the hanger between the dresses. One day, Mendel's life becomes even more "pink" when, according to the will of the deceased general, he gets a successful wedding salon, which is run by Lena Zhukova, a confirmed bachelor. And everything would be fine, except that the general's widow and her new boyfriend seriously decided to take away the salon.

name: Kirli Sepeti
summary: Events will begin when the women work as maids in a luxury place and the cleaner Meryem jumps from the window of the villa where she works and commits suicide. Meryem's secret suicide will affect her daughter Elkgül, who is studying at the university, and Songül, who works at the same place, the most.

name: Forever Love
summary: Lin Zi Tong is the rich young heiress of the Li group: she is beautiful, cheerful, smart and straightforward. She has everything for her, including a devoted boyfriend, Chi Shan. But when she goes through family changes, this innocent young miss has to become stronger to not only face adversity but also the betrayal of her boyfriend, Chi Shan, and her so-called best friend, Xia Yu Wei, a deceitful hypocrite who on the surface treats Lin Zi Tong like a sister but is actually very jealous and wants to steal everything from her. Sheng Mo Yao is a brilliant medical student who succeeds in everythi

name: Egg and Stone
summary: Huo Xingchen, the daughter of the chief of the renowned Wuyue Sect, takes a decisive step into the martial world to defy the fate imposed upon her and to resist an unwanted arranged marriage. Along her journey, she crosses paths with Jiang Buting, an investigator delving into the case of a missing martial artist. Through a series of fateful encounters, they join forces and embark on a shared adventure. Along the way, they befriend numerous martial artists, uncover the truth behind the appearances of enigmatic figures in the martial world, and ultimately expose the schemes of two formidable vil

name: Comedy Island Thailand
summary: It's SHOWTIME! 6 celebrities find themselves stranded on a mysterious island and are made to perform. Not for fame or glory, but for their freedom. Placed in unscripted improvisational scenarios, our 6 celebrities will have to be quick on their feet to garner the most laughs from the island's villagers, while they try to outwit each other for a chance to go home.

name: Design Down Under
summary: Husband and wife design build team, Richie Morris and Georgia Ezra, create one-of-a-kind, modern designs and bespoke spaces for their clients in Melbourne, Australia while juggling their thriving businesses and family of four.

name: Incognito
summary: It follows an undercover cop as he infiltrates the life of an ordinary woman to discover whether she is a dangerous top criminal.

name: Voyages En Terres Du Nord
summary: From the glaciers of Norway to the cliffs of Iceland, passing through Lapland, vast Swedish forests and peaceful Swedish lakes, the Scandinavian lands are indomitable but men live in harmony with nature: yoga in the snow or slacklining at heights.

name: I Shall Survive Using Potions!
summary: One day, the supervisor in charge of watching over Earth was taking care of a distortion, when they made a mistake that caused Kaoru Nagase to lose her physical body. Not only that, but reincarnating her into a different, less culturally advanced world is the only thing they can offer to do for her. Not one to take this turn of events sitting down, Kaoru makes a demand: the power to create potions at any time she pleases, with whatever effect she wants it to have—and it doesn't stop there either. She asks for a magical Item Box, the ability to understand and speak every language, and the same

name: WTFAQ
summary: You ask. We answer. WTFAQs crack team of presenters hit the sweet spot where comedy meets inquisition to answer the questions that have sparked curiosity in the minds of our audience for far too long.

name: RoboDoc: The Creation of RoboCop
summary: RoboDoc: The Creation of RoboCop takes an in-depth look into the ground breaking franchise and features new interviews with cast and crew, including Hollywood icons such as Peter Weller, Diane Robin, Ronny Cox, Nancy Allen, Ray Wise, director Paul Verhoeven & more.

name: Desperately Seeking Soulmate: Escaping Twin Flames Universe
summary: Desperately Seeking Soulmate: Escaping Twin Flames Universe delves into the world of Twin Flames Universe, an online group run out of suburban Michigan by the captivating YouTube influencers Jeff and Shaleia Divine. The couple's promise is to match members with their perfect partner, but former participants describe the extreme lengths they have taken in order to claim their "twin flame." Journalist Alice Hines soon discovers that the promise of true love may come at a price. With real life testimony from former members, exclusive video footage with the group's leaders Jeff and Shaleia, as wel
previous_episode: Two Halves of the Same Soul

name: Vida the Vet
summary: Ten-year-old Vida, an animal doctor who nurtures the charming and silly woodland creatures who live outside her home. Is there a fox with a sprained paw? A turtle with an itchy toe? A tiger with an aching tooth? Then Vida is the vet for the job. With quick thinking, a doctor's intuition and the help of her closest friends, Vida helps adorable animals and makes sure they get the care they need.

name: True Story
summary: This fall, The HISTORY® Channel's groundbreaking Canadian original documentary event, True Story , returns for Part Two, offering a further look at the real and often misrepresented history of Indigenous peoples on the land that is now called Canada.

name: Dr Cassidy's Casebook
summary: As State Pathologist, Dr Marie Cassidy's name became inextricably linked with murder and tragedy. During her time in Ireland, Dr Cassidy's cases included the violent deaths of many women who she now wants to remember, not simply as victims or statistics but as real lives. With the cooperation of families and the help of peers and experts, she tries to understand why women continue to be abused and killed, mostly by men they know. What has changed since Dr Cassidy arrived in Ireland in 1997 and are women safer today?

name: You'll Never Believe What Happened to Lacey
summary: In You'll Never Believe What Happened to Lacey Amber Ruffin lives in New York where she is no one's first Black friend and everyone is, as she puts it, "stark raving normal." But Amber's sister, Lacey? She's still living in their home state of Nebraska, and trust us, you'll never believe what happened to Lacey.

name: The Fearless
summary: Luo Yingwei used to be a staff member of the government, and passed the judicial examination by self-studying the law. However, she suffered a blow: her husband Liu Ming broke up with her, and Liu Ming owed a huge amount of usury in China, which made Luo Yingwei deeply involved in a debt crisis. But Luo Yingwei did not give up, she chose to fight back with legal means. As a newcomer to the law firm, Luo Yingwei is burdened with huge debts on one hand and faces pressure in the workplace on the other. Fortunately, she met like-minded partners - Qiu Hua and Xia Shu. They always adhere to their fa

name: The Romance of the Condor Heroes
summary: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, this is the story of protagonist Yang Guo and his lover XiaoLongNü in their adventures in the jianghu (or wulin, the community of martial artists), which disapproves of the taboo love between master and apprentice.

name: Onmyoji
summary: In the gilded enclave of the imperial court, Minamoto Hiromasa befriends the mystic Abe Seimei, solving tricky cases rising from the demonic realm.

name: Fake не Fake
summary: A game show in which ordinary people compete for a real diamond worth 500,000 rubles, guessing which stone is fake and which is real. Hosted by Ida Galich.

name: As Luck Would Have It
summary: Recently retired criminology professor turned amateur sleuth Gabbi Luck uses her classroom smarts, charm and tenacity to get to the bottom of every crime she encounters.

name: Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions
summary: Ron Kamonohashi was once regarded as a genius at the top detective training academy. But after a fatal mistake, he was expelled and forbidden to become a detective. Years later, police officer Totomaru Isshiki knocks on Ron's door seeking help on a serial murder case. He finds Ron, now a messy-haired recluse, who agrees. Together, this mismatched detective team begins solving their first mystery!
previous_episode: The Case of the Highland Auberge Serial Murders (Part 4)

name: Design Defined
summary: Designers and historians share the origins and hallmarks of some of the most beloved design styles, including midcentury modern, farmhouse, art deco and more. You'll learn the secrets behind each unique approach to design.

name: Firefighter Daigo: Rescuer in Orange
summary: Toake Daigo burns with remarkable talent and unparalleled determination. Onoda Shun struggles against the walls blocking his own path. Nakamura Yuki hopes to become one of the few female members of the special rescue corps known as "Orange." When these three young firefighters who share the goal of becoming members of Orange come together, the story of how Japan will one day be saved begins... and what looms before them is a crisis that endangers the entire country!

name: Is She the Wolf?
summary: They're all here to look for true romance — but hidden among the women is at least one "wolf" who's prohibited from falling in love.

name: Migi to Dali
summary: The stork brought an angel into the lives of a childless middle-aged couple. His parents are kind, their house is luxurious and the meals are delicious, but to continue to revel in this happiness Hitori must conceal a certain fact from his family...

name: Не дождётесь
summary: Vitalik settles into a nursing home to hide from his pursuers. After a while, he gets to know the guests better and realizes that there are many people with difficult and interesting destinies among them. The hero gets closer to pensioners and begins to look at life differently. Will he be able to change before his enemies find him?

name: Captain Han
summary: This is a story of love and redemption between the journalist Xu Nannan and the forest ranger captain Han Xizhou. As they joined hands to fight against poachers, they uncovered the truth about Xu Nannan's amnesia from ten years ago. Through relentless efforts, Xu Nannan eventually overcame her fear and protected the forest. Both of them matured and found love.

name: Roman Kemp Documentaries
summary: A series of documentaries presented by Roman Kemp.
previous_episode: Roman Kemp: The Fight for Young Lives

name: Deadly Mission Shark
summary: Deadly Mission Shark is the toughest challenge yet, to protect the future of sharks who are facing extinction. This is where Steve Backshall and a team of kids from the UK and Bahamas step in to inspire and change the world. But will the kids complete their mission and learn to dive with sharks?

name: Wes Anderson Roald Dahl films
summary: Get ready for a very Wes Anderson autumn. This September, four new short films from the celebrated filmmaker are hitting Netflix. Fourteen years after he brought Fantastic Mr. Fox to life, Anderson is back with another Roald Dahl adaptation — or rather, four of them.

name: Musical Masterpieces
summary: Teaming up with leading orchestras from around the UK, Myleene Klass and Errollyn Wallen present brand new performances of Vivaldi's Four Seasons performed by Sinfonia Cymru, Bizet's Carmen performed by Opera North and Mendelssohn's Hebrides Overture performed by the Philharmonia Orchestra. They'll also reveal the iconic composers' secrets and techniques as they delve into the stories behind the scores. Along the way they'll be joined by some famous faces including Alan Titchmarsh, Simon Callow and Nicky Spence who share their own passion and insights on each of these masterpieces.

name: Huset
summary: Sammi, Henrik, Miriam, and Gert are prison officers and colleagues in an old, worn-down Danish prison. Their work environment is raw and hostile, and their respective lives outside the prison walls are filled with conflict, secrets, and loneliness for very different reasons. Secrets, that will soon resurface and have great consequences not only for the four prison officers, but for everyone inside and outside the walls.

name: Rachotilkovia
summary: A television series about personified sounds that are visible in the form of small characters to children and, thanks to their invisibility to adults, cause many unprecedented and comical situations for the children's heroes.

name: Pinches Momias
summary: A group of troubled teens become their town's only hope for survival when their notorious mummies rise from the dead during the busiest week of the year.

name: Отставник. Защита Дедова
summary: During surgery for a combat wound, Dedov's heart stops, but doctors manage to literally bring him back from the brink. Doctors soon discharge the retired soldier, who plans to recuperate and spend time with his recently born great-grandson. Dedov's friends, General Rastorguev and Colonel Nakhabtsev, are searching for the dangerous terrorist Burkhan. According to intelligence, he is plotting a terrorist attack in St. Petersburg. To prevent tragedy, Nakhabtsev suggests Rastorguev conduct an operation codenamed "Old Friend"—inserting a former comrade of Burkhan's into his group. The agent is Niki

name: The Whole Package
summary: Amateur male underwear models compete in stripped-down photoshoot challenges for the chance to become Dirt Squirrel Company's newest brand ambassador, $5000 cash and to be crowned " The Whole Package ".

name: Kobushi
summary: Every night, after closing hours, a very strange phenomenon occurs in a Japanese restaurant. All the sushis, makis, temakis, come to life: they are the Kobushis.
previous_episode: Without Tako All Hell Breaks Loose

name: Alien: Isolation - The Digital Series
summary: It's been fifteen years since Amanda Ripley's mother disappeared aboard the deep space towing ship Nostromo. And for fifteen years, Amanda has suspected there was more to her mother's story than meets the eye.

name: Adom a napom
summary: What a Hungarian celebrity does at an average weekday? Watch it on live stream all day long. What that day tells about her/him? Watch it in the live show on Viasat3 at 8 p.m.
previous_episode: " Adom a szülinapom" - Geszti Péter - Maga a házigazda kerül reflektorfénybe egy rendhagyó adás keretében

name: Sveriges Största Konstkupper
summary: Documentary series where we follow some of the most sensational Swedish art coups in modern times. How was it possible to steal art worth hundreds of millions of kroner? How did the police manage to solve the crimes? Why were secret agents involved in the cases? Hear the stories from the criminals, witnesses who were there and the police who investigated the art coups.

name: Kungen och jag
summary: A personal portrait of Carl XVI Gustaf. For two years, filmmaker Karin af Klintberg has had the unique opportunity to closely follow the king in his life and work. It will be an unexpected meeting between two worlds and two generations.

name: The Freelancer
summary: Based on the book 'A Ticket To Syria', Avinash Kamath, an ex-cop turned mercenary, takes up the daunting task of rescuing Aliya, a newly married girl trapped in war-torn Syria against the backdrop of growing ISIS terrorism.

name: Первый класс
summary: Three friends dream of sending their children to the most prestigious school in the city. But there's only one place left. An intelligent single mother, a desperate careerist and a beautiful businessman's wife jeopardize their friendship and not only to place a child in a super school. Parental ambitions and thirst for prestige push rival moms to do things that they did not expect from themselves.

name: Boomer
summary: Boomer is a comedy series about the ordinary things in life, through the eyes of presenter and actor, Jan Van Looveren.

name: De Sneeuwman: De Geheimen van een Kindermoordenaar
summary: Behind the friendly face of a truck driver hides the most horrific child killer in Dutch history. The chilling case of Michel Stokx is examined in the true crime documentary series The Snowman: Secrets of a Child Killer.

name: Sovietska
summary: The life of a family who left the former USSR and moved to the outskirts of Israel. 30 years later, the family experiences an identity crisis when the daughter becomes a social media star and the voice of the young generation.

name: 171: Negócio de Família
summary: The crook Moreira, missing for ten years, returns home for his wife's funeral. His return is not well accepted by his son, Diógenes, who fears that his grandfather's influence on his grandson, Chicão, could be negative.

name: Toopy & Binoo
summary: Toopy loves life. Every little thing...talking socks, giant footprints, meatballs, stars, butterflies, cookies, jumping noses, magic carpets, and dreamlands! But most of all Toopy loves his best friend Binoo, who's not just sweet and adorable but smart too. For Toopy and Binoo, life is delightful and simple. Everything swings between surprises, pleasures and zany situations. Binoo loves to follow Toopy on incredible imaginary adventures. For them, the sky has no limit.

name: Ottilie von Faber-Castell
summary: The story of Ottilie Faber, the sole heir to the successful Faber-Castell company. It will not be easy for her to assume the leadership of the company at a time when men were in charge.

name: Scam 2003: The Telgi Story
summary: 'Scam 2003' is based on true events and traces Abdul Karim Telgi's rise from fruit seller to the kingpin of the stamp paper scam. Fueled by greed, Telgi dominates the stamp paper market through corruption, while carefully maintaining a low profile. But for how long can he evade the clutches of the law? The biographical financial thriller is helmed by Hansal Mehta and stars Gagan Dev Riar in the titular role.

name: Las viudas de los jueves
summary: Teresa finds her husband and his two best friends dead in the lavish community where they live. As the truth comes to light, so will dark secrets.

name: Hard Broken
summary: Keep your friends close, and your frenemies closer. In this chaotic clique, the line between supporter and saboteur is awfully blurry.

Now, she is 30 years old and works in a field far away from her ideal job. One day, she happens to meet mysterious university student Ogasawara Taku. Kashiwagi Kokoro doesn't tell his new girlfriend Kamijo Sayo about Omori Ringo moving in with him.

You don't want to miss this!

Marcelino, who is able to talk with animals, lives very closed to the animals, the trees and plants. He delights in discovering new things, and often asks unusual questions. The friars educate and love the boy.

That is when he comes up with the idea to use it as a place for troubled teens. The teens would live on the ranch, do all sorts of chores, and learn the value of honesty and friendship.

The question is who will survive in the streets of McGraw Ave?

name: 18 Minutes with Jesus - Dr. Robert Jeffress
summary: Did you know you can read Jesus's Sermon on the Mount in about 18 minutes? Yet packed into this short talk are more life-changing and startlingly original teachings than anywhere else in Scripture. It's the spiritual straight talk we need about the things that matter most in life.

summary: The Story Keepers is an animated Christian video series that tells the story of a Christian leader and his family's adventures living in Ancient Rome, Italy whose mission is to keep Jesus's stories alive during the 1st century. Introduction: Rome, 64 AD. The Emperor Nero has unleashed his fury against the Christians. Their crime: Proclaiming a King higher than Caesar. Setting fire to the city, Nero places the blame on the Christians, and launches a new campaign to wipe them out. Families are separated, children left homeless, as thousands are sold into slavery or thrown to the lions. Escaping

name: Døm vores forhold
summary: Are we better at guiding other pairs of relationsship, than our own? In this serie unknown couples moves into where other couples lives, and guides on their relationship, with the help of the host 'Anna Lin'.

summary: Four single South African ladies are on a quest to find love in Nigeria. During the first round of dating, Southie babes jump on online dates with 12 Nigerian bachelors.
