name: Kontant
summary: This recurring documentary that touches on current subjects thats on mind on the Danish population. Program works on the premise that population/consumers, sends in subjects to dwell into, that they mean is of public interest. The staff of the show, then chooses the subjects that is most relevant for a investigation.

name: Playing Go
summary: "Playing Go" is set in a southern Chinese city during the early 21st century. It follows Cui Ye, an ordinary Go teacher whose life spirals into chaos after an accidental entanglement in a crime. As he gradually descends into a life of illegality, he becomes relentlessly pursued by his police officer brother, Cui Wei. The story paints a gripping tale of two brothers on opposite sides of the law.

name: How to Fail as a Popstar
summary: In order to become a popstar, a queer brown boy with a huge voice is doing everything he can. Told by the queer trans femme that boy becomes, looking back on how and why that dream was never realized.

name: Let Us Prey: A Ministry of Scandals
summary: Let Us Prey: A Ministry of Scandals a new four-part docuseries exposing the predatory and insidious behavior within Independent Fundamental Baptist (IFB) Churches, and the struggles of survivors to find justice. Featuring first-hand accounts from survivors, church defectors and activists, Let Us Prey offers crucial insight into the troubling culture within the IFB and the stronghold the churches have on its members. Since its inception in the 1950s, the IFB has evolved into one of the dominant religious forces in the United States today with an estimated 8 million believers spread out over 6,0

name: The Embers
summary: A tragic massacre in their childhood completely changed the fate of the Liao brothers. Will they break through the darkness for self-redemption, or will they descend into the abyss of vengeance? Once inseparable and solving countless mysterious cases together, the two brothers now stand on opposite sides.

name: Drömträdgården
summary: We follow Swedes all over the country who make their wildest garden dreams come true.

name: Kriminalarkivet Ståplats I Nybroviken
summary: The expression "Ståplats i Nybroviken" has its origins in a well-known triple murder from the 1960s, the so-called "Träskmorden". At that time, a lot is changing in Sweden, drugs are taking hold and crime is becoming increasingly brutal. The perpetrator Hans "Tuppen" Marmbo's name sells loose numbers and scares readers. If you want to look for the roots of what is happening today, then you can go to this era when organized crime began to establish itself in the Swedish public housing.

name: I brottets spår Fallet Tove
summary: For almost a year, SVT's crime reporters Karin Fagerlund and Lasse Lampers have followed the investigation into 20-year-old Tove's death in Vetlanda - from Tove's disappearance to the verdict against two young women in the Court of Appeal. In their search for answers, Karin and Lasse meet investigators, prosecutors and lawyers and review the details of the investigation. They also meet neighbors, acquaintances and others involved to get to the bottom of what really happened and how it affected Vetlanda as a community.

name: En våldsam heder
summary: We follow three authentic cases where people have been severely affected by honor-related violence and oppression, and we gain insight into the mechanisms in an honor context. The series depicts the devastating consequences the standards of honor cause, and the human destinies they leave behind. Experts on issues of honor give us an in-depth picture of honor-related violence and hatred.

name: Min ångest och jag
summary: Anxiety, loneliness, depression and suicidal thoughts are something that many struggle with. Here, four famous Swedes - artist Viktor Frisk, actor Marianne Mörck, former track and field athlete Linus Thörnblad and former handball player Loui Sand - talk openly about their lives. Psychiatrist Anders Hansen deepens the understanding around the protagonists' diagnoses and life situation.

name: Rostmacka
summary: Some of the country's funniest stand-up comedians square off in roast duels, with the goal of destroying their opponent with jokes as their only weapon. A unanimous jury consisting of, among others, Ina Lundström, Jesper Rönndahl and Thanos Fotas chooses the winner of the fight completely arbitrarily. A filter-free program with a sky-high ceiling.

name: Kod Adı Kırlangıç
summary: The common curiosity of children living in the same neighborhood is technology. There are both those who help the children who come together to design drones and the bad guys who try to prevent them... The series will bring the exciting stories of technology-savvy children to the screen

name: Арбатские тайны
summary: April 1959. Tanya Meshcherskaya, who grew up in an orphanage, goes to Moscow to visit her father, academician Vikenty Ryabinsky. She has with her a letter to her father and an old brooch inherited from her mother, which is stolen. Vincent is happy to have a daughter, as he loved her mother, Lilya Meshcherskaya. However, his wife, Maria Pavlovna, takes Tanya with hostility. She is trying to find out details from Vincent's sister, Kisa. Kisa doubts that Vikenty is Tanya's father, and she turns out to be right. But everything turns out too late...

name: Deca zla
summary: A masked perpetrator murders a prominent politician and leaves an old, golden coin in his hand. Nikola Bobic, a defence attorney, reluctantly takes a case and plunges into a dangerous game that will change his life forever.

name: Супергерои.ру
summary: The children of a special agent protect a valuable discovery from villains. Futuristic animation about inventive teenagers.

name: Hey Dad
summary: Architect Martin Kelly singlehandedly raises his children: Simon, Debbie, and Jenny. His wife, Margaret, had died three years before the series' start. Martin runs his own architectural business from the family home in the Sydney suburb of Chatswood. He employs his wife's cousin[2] Betty Wilson, a good-natured ditz from the New South Wales country town of Walgett, as his secretary. Many episodes deal with the daily stresses Martin faces as the family patriarch, such as settling arguments amongst his children. He frequently endures Betty's elaborate excuses for tardiness and is constantly frust

name: Secrets of the Aquarium
summary: Transporting turtles, hugging fish and swimming with sharks - all in a day's work. Head under the water as the dedicated team reveal the secrets of Britain's biggest aquarium.

name: Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live
summary: Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live will once again be the only place to watch the famous evictees first live interview alongside an array of unmissable exclusive features including access to the camera runs, special guest commentary and debate.

name: Celebrity Big Brother: Live Stream
summary: The Celebrity Big Brother: Live Stream will also return to screens, airing seven nights a week on ITVX and STV Player, giving fans the opportunity to watch live footage into the small hours after Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live.

name: Battle Pope
summary: Battle Pope is an independent superhero comedy comic book series created by Robert Kirkman and Tony Moore, which was published by their own small press company under the moniker of Funk-O-Tron originally in 2000. The series was reprinted in color by Image Comics in 2005, with plans to possibly continue it with new stories after collecting the original material. The comic was adapted into a season of eight animated webisodes that appeared on Spike TV's website in 2008.[1]

name: Davos 1917
summary: The First World War is ravaging Europe. By contrast, Davos, the noble spa town in the Swiss Alps, seems like an oasis of peace. But behind the scenes, neutral Switzerland takes centre stage in a relentless battle between the secret agents of the world powers. The young nurse Johanna Gabathuler unexpectedly gets caught between the fronts of the spies: to win back her daughter, she gets involved in a deadly game with the German Secret Service – and suddenly becomes the tip of the scales in a risky plan that decides between war and peace.

name: Big Brother Uncut
summary: One of the raunchiest shows in Australian television history in making return, some 17 years after it was yanked from the airwaves. Big Brother Uncut is the adults-only companion show of the reality show Big Brother Australia .

name: Virgin
summary: When 22-year-old virgin Ellie falls in love with Olivier, her roommates Kira and Veronique convince her to gain some sexual experience before sleeping with him for the first time. Under their guidance, Ellie soon masters the art of seduction in the age of Tinder, free porn and sexual fluidity. But will it all backfire?

name: The Garden Hustle
summary: The Garden Hustle will be hosted by Australian actress Lisa McCune and garden landscaper, The Block's Dave Franklin (along with resident pooch Robin). This series will follow everyday homeowners and renters on their journey to create their very own garden oasis. Always aspirational and achievable, every makeover featured will be carried out by the occupants themselves as they hustle to turn their tired spaces into a green oasis. This homegrown production full of heart and humour will become a feel-good gardening fix with plenty of genius garden timesavers for viewers to try.

name: The Great Art Fraud
summary: Inigo Philbrick is an art-world sensation, a wunderkind who makes millions selling to the world's richest collectors. But he is also harbouring a dark secret - one that will lead him to the South Pacific in a global game of cat-and-mouse with the FBI.

name: My Dead Mom
summary: Emmy's mother died and she hates what she's wearing. Emmy knows she could live her best life, if her dead mother would JUST. STOP. TALKING. Fern pops into Emmy's life to question her lipstick and life choices, as only a mother can. Even death can't stop Fern from being fabulous… and disappointed. Sure, Emmy would've liked to hike the Appalachian Trail after her mom died, but work's been really busy. She wants to make peace with her mother, move to the other side of grief, but how do you get over someone who is so present?

name: Celebrity Escape to the Country
summary: Celebrity Escape to the Country welcomes an exciting host of well-known faces hoping to make a countryside relocation including the nation's favourite panto dame and King of the Jungle, Christopher Biggins; Bucks Fizz popstar, Cheryl Baker; TV health professional, Doctor Ranj Singh; Strictly Come Dancing's Janette Manrara and Aljaž Škorjanec; and TV quiz sensation, Jenny Ryan AKA ‘The Vixen' from The Chase. First launching in 2002, the BBC's longest running property show Escape to the Country has showcased an idyllic look into rural Britain's property market, giving urban homeowners an insight

name: The Crime I Can't Forget
summary: New true crime series features top detectives who recall the stand-out case that shaped their career. With access to crime scene evidence, compelling archival footage, interviews with victims' families and original investigators, this series unveils both the human impact and intricate process of solving the most complex crimes.

name: Vem dödade Agneta? - Mysteriet i Mistekärr
summary: One autumn day in 2008, 63-year-old Agneta is found beaten to death by a lake in Småland. Suspicion quickly falls on Agneta's husband Ingemar, but is he really guilty? The locals hover in uncertainty until the case takes an unexpected turn, just over a year later. Who killed Agneta?

name: Sveriges musikhistoria
summary: Sweden's history is full of music - it starts with bone flutes, trance dance and mysterious bronze slurs. In the series, we get to know harp-playing Viking chieftains, gold-plated medieval sheet music and begging student singers. But also music spies and forbidden instruments, as well as rhythmic work songs and the origin of the Swedish snap song.

name: Capitalisme américain, le culte de la richesse
summary: Over the course of a gripping story that goes from 1870 to today, "American Capitalism – The Cult of Wealth" tells how a small elite has always justified its hyper-wealth in America. From the powerful philanthropic alibi to the constantly renewed promise of trickle-down, from the myth of the self-made man to the heroic figure of the visionary genius of Silicon Valley, this documentary reveals a grand capitalist narrative that is both immutable and unalterable, and at the same time the shadow of which 722 billionaires and 22 million American millionaires continue to enrich themselves without li

name: Живите лучшую жизнь
summary: Imagine a life where we are never distracted and have time for everything. Where we work as we always dreamed of, and if we get tired of it, we go back to school. Where we don't just eat to satisfy our hunger, but experience vivid impressions from food. Where casual acquaintances and deep relationships on social networks harmoniously form a diverse social circle. Where the center is not the main place in the city, but the entire city becomes the center of life. In fact, this life is already around us. Which means we can stop imagining it and just start living.

name: A Football Life Origins
summary: The Story of how today's top players made it to the league.

name: Wanneng Lian Ai Zahuo Dian
summary: Shi Ye is a police inspector who has no such interests in things like love and romance. One day, Ye finds himself up against a crafty witch who offers peculiar solutions to love problems. Follow Shi Ye as he tries to solve the mystery of the Love Magic Grocery and its peculiar owner.

name: The Pike County Murders: A Family Massacre
summary: How did it come to pass that eight members of the same family could be brutally murdered execution-style in four different locations in one night by members of another family they called friends? One of largest murder investigations in Ohio's history rips off the veneer of small-town America, exposing an underbelly of violence, pitting family against family, mother against son, and brother against brother in a haunting story of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

name: MotorTrend Working From Home
summary: All your favorite MotorTrend hosts are also stuck at home and finally have time to catch up on some personal projects of their own, so we asked them to film what they are doing! Whether its learning new skills, building a new rig to help around the shop, or finally catching up on a project car they have been neglecting for years, they are rolling up their sleeves and taking you into their home workshops for a little slice of their life.

name: Our Interpreter
summary: Lin Xi who's known as the "witch" in the translation industry reunites with ex-boyfriend Xia Yicheng. Eight years ago, she broke up with him for the sake of fulfilling her mother's wish for her to become a professional interpreter for the United Nations. Eight years later, Lin Xi has become the youngest chief interpreter at Huasheng while her ex Xiao Yicheng has become the chief technology officer of a communications company, which also makes him her potential client. name: Abyss Dweller
summary: January 1940. Liang Shuo, a Communist underground operative with a head wound, awakened in a snowbound mountain and his memory was gone. Drawn to Shanghai by fragmented clues to reclaim his identity, he'd hunted by Japanese forces. Then the Wang Jingwei regime's 76th Agency identified him as their Operations Director. As Japan and Wang Jingwei's government prepared their "Peace & Prosperity Conference," a group of imprisoned laborers would be sent to the frontlines. name: Загадай любовь
summary: Eleventh-grader Natasha Zueva is in love with geography teacher Anton Vladimirovich, whom high school students affectionately call "Goldie" among themselves. A few weeks before the New Year, Anton Vladimirovich calls Natasha, as the head of the class, and offers everyone to go on vacation to a snow-covered ski resort. Natasha is in a pleasant anticipation. She doesn't know yet that her life will change a lot in the coming weeks. name: Affaires sensibles
summary: For the first time, France Inter, France Télévisions and INA are teaming up to co-produce and bring to France 2 a new magazine: Affaires sensibles .

name: Anh Does Scandinavia
summary: Anh Do, Australia's favourite comedian, travels to Scandinavia and Iceland to find out what makes them officially the happiest people on earth.

name: Anh Does Vietnam
summary: Anh Do's travels through his homeland are a warm and wacky cultural mix from a tour guide with an infectious smile.

name: Anh Does Brazil
summary: See Brazil through the eyes of Australian comedian and best-selling author Anh Do. From Rio to the Amazon and Salvador to São Paulo, Anh brings us his unique take on the people, cuisine, customs and culture of modern-day Brazil. As always, Anh throws himself into the action and this adventure could be his craziest yet.

name: Anh Does Italy
summary: From gondoliers of Venice to pasta nonnas of Bari, comedian Anh Do is on a special quest to experience the best of Italy in this two part series.

name: Replacing Chef Chico
summary: When a head chef falls into a coma, it's up to his devoted sous-chef to keep their Filipino fine dining restaurant from closing down.

summary: The adventure story follows five youths unravelling the mystery of their missing friend in the mountains of central France, still covered with vast, deep forests to this day.

summary: In conversations with the children and grandchildren of the victims and perpetrators of forced labour, the series tells a story of reconciliation in modern Europe.

name: Зв'язок
summary: A long-distance comedy that strengthens hearts in times of war.

summary: The characters of the series are couples, colleagues and old friends who have united for a common cause - volunteering. They manage to hold meetings, provide for civil and military needs, and resolve relationships, while dealing with any life situations with dignity.

name: Закохай мене, якщо зможеш
summary: The protagonist of the series decides to make some extra money and sets up a profitable, but not entirely legal business. The guy pretends to be a medium and promises people to solve all their problems: to find a missing person, to catch an unfaithful spouse cheating, and even to "bring back luck" to some clients. The business is in great demand, but everything can be ruined when the protagonist's success is noticed by journalist Elia, who specializes in exposing pseudo-magicians. To divert the girl's attention, he will have to develop a rather unusual plan.

name: Hit Parader's No Cover
summary: No Cover is the only true original music competition show focused on changing the lives of unsigned artists. This series is about discovery, mentorship, hard reality and launching careers. No Cover is created and produced by the music business, not traditional Hollywood studios. We believe this is the show fans and musicians around the world have been waiting around for years to see and it's finally here! NO COVER, NO MERCY! No Cover was filmed on location at the legendary Troubadour and Sunset Marquis in West Hollywood, CA. 25 of these original artists will be competing for the top prize, whi

name: Supervolcano
summary: Molten lava bulging against the Earth's crust beneath America's Yellowstone Park will explode through with devastating effect - it's just a question of when, say scientists. This factual drama set in the near future depicts such an outcome based on evacuation procedures and predictions by volcanologists and futurologists. The year is 2020 and the world faces the ultimate threat. Not nuclear war or a terrorist attack, but the eruption of a gigantic 'supervolcano' simmering beneath Yellowstone Park. The last eruption of this kind plunged the world into darkness for six years, triggered the last

name: Interrogation Cam
summary: Interrogation Cam takes you inside the interrogation rooms of law enforcement agencies around the country. Each episode features incredible, real crime stories and spotlights the techniques used by investigators to uncover the unbelievable truth and bring criminals to justice.

name: HACK Crimes Online
summary: The season initially focuses on Shakti's induction in the cybercrime unit alongside Jigar and Girish, and how they transform into an indomitable force solving extreme cybercrime cases under the tutelage of ACP Ashutosh.

name: Murdoch Mysteries: Nightmare on Queen Street
summary: YOU play the role of a visiting detective assisting Murdoch in a troublesome -- and bloody -- murder investigation. Piece together the clues and crack the case before the killer strikes again.

name: Spaceflight
summary: This 4-part documentary miniseries covers the history of manned and unmanned space-flight, from the late 1800s through the mid-1980s.

name: BravoCon Live with Andy Cohen!
summary: Andy Cohen hosts five special episodes of "BravoCon Live with Andy Cohen!" at The Paris Theater.

name: Murdoch Mysteries: Beyond Time
summary: Constables Henry Higgins and Slugger Jackson are watching over the Station House when Jackson brings in a man who had been caught breaking into a factory on Power Street, claiming he needs to stop an assassination by time travelling. But when these claims turn out to be true, and Rebecca James gets transported into the future, they have to race against time to save Rebecca, with the help of a certain government agent.

name: Boom Boom Bruno
summary: Bruno is not just any cop. He is Boom Boom Bruno, the district's cowboy. Everything here is under his control. His criminals, his hookers, his boss. He is thrilled with his new partner Mark - it's up to him to teach this insecure boy to be a real man with balls. When a drag queen is found dead on his turf, however, both Bruno and Mark must fight their own prejudices and meet resistance coming from all sides to solve the case.

name: Сама виновата?
summary: In 2017, the quiet city of Serpukhov near Moscow finds itself in the center of public attention due to the bloody massacre of Dmitry Grachev over his young wife Margarita, who will be remembered for many years as "the girl whose husband cut off her hands with an axe." Grachev's carefully designed revenge plan does not include murder — he calculates the time he will devote to torture and bullying, takes into account the minutes needed to get to the hospital. After all, if Rita dies, he will be waiting for a long time, and if he follows the plan, he will be convicted only for causing grievous bo

name: Million Dollar Family
summary: Ng Chiu Ming is a carefree and unambitious guy who loves money but doesn't have goals or a direction in life. One day, a famous businesswoman, Ms. Fok, invites him to move into her luxurious house with a few other contestants. Those that survive the six-month period will each receive one million dollars. However, more and more problems surface as time goes by.

name: Les nouvelles aventures de Lucky Luke
summary: Every hero must have a villain, and Lucky Luke has four: the Dalton brothers. Fortunately, he's faster to draw his revolver than his own shadow and he has a loyal friend in his horse.

name: Hoob Phaya Suer
summary: A story about Paen, a handicapped man who has a miraculous life. Sua Prai, a revered good thief helps healing Paen's physical diability and turns him into a strong man. Paen then disguises as a minion of a local mafia to track down the lost land title deed. He also hunts for Praedaeng thief who killed his mother and tries to save Pailin, his loved one, from the son of the mafia. Despite the grave dangers, he never fears. But it hurts him when he learns that Sua Prai and Praedaeng thief are the same person. He then has to choose between repaying his gratitude or seek retribution.

name: Innermost
summary: Three stories intertwine. Innermost immerses us in a complex reality of violence and grace, which rages in today's Tel Aviv under the apparent calm of modernity, and shows us how life makes different destinies intertwine.

name: Hazalemet
summary: The series follows in the footsteps of Anna, a photographer, a few weeks before her death. The women who show up at his studio confront the camera, testifying to their complicated relationship with their own bodies and their deep secrets. Anna pushes them to make changes in their lives. But can she do the same?

name: Kald mig far
summary: Non-confrontational Emil and self-assured Viktor are life-long friends. Having always done everything together, they become business partners when launching a sustainable catering company.

name: Détective Surprenant : la fille aux yeux de pierre
summary: Detective Sergeant Surprenant, a veteran of major crimes in Montreal who took refuge in the Islands, investigates with the help of his colleague Geneviève Savoie and inexperienced police officers, even giving up his vacation to solve this sad story. However, he must deal with the arrogant chief inspector Sébastien Gingras, dispatched from Quebec and with whom he has disagreements.

name: La Fièvre
summary: Soccer star Fodé Thiam goes off the rails in front of the cameras, calling his coach a "dirty toubab" (white in Wolof). Caught up in the media storm, the club calls on Sam Berger, a talented communicator, to manage the crisis. But her rival, Marie Kinsky, was not to be counted out, as she instrumentalized the event by fanning the flames of the identity and social rifts dividing the country. The fever never stops rising.

name: Amar é Para os Fortes
summary: Amar é Para os Fortes tells the story of two mothers in search for justice after a police invasion in their community led to a tragedy that changed the lives of these two families forever. On one hand, Rita deals with the death of her youngest son, Sushi. On the other, Edna, the mother of police officer Digão, faces the consequences of her son's actions during the operation.

name: Murdoch Mysteries: The Murdoch Effect
summary: Detective Murdoch wakes in modern-day Toronto after being accidentally knocked unconscious. Murdoch must try to keep his wits about him as he races against and through time to solve a parallel case in both the 19th and 21st centuries.

name: The King's Guard: Serving the Crown
summary: This series goes behind the scenes for the first time to the elite regiments of the British Army's Household Division, in one of the busiest years in its 350-year history. Known as the King‘s Guard' the soldiers serve a dual role. Their sworn duty is to protect the Monarch and the State - as masters of state ceremony and tradition as well as being a modern fighting force. This series enters both worlds with privileged access as the Household Division prepares to serve the Crown in both its "red" (ceremonial) and "green" (combat) roles.

name: Scotland's Weather – Our Changing Seasons
summary: Judith Ralston explores Scotland's changing seasons.

name: JFK: The Final Evidence
summary: The mystery behind the assassination of US President John F Kennedy in November 1963. His family, his foes, and who may have had motive to conspire to kill.

name: Soy tu fan. La fiesta continua
summary: How can one be an adult and not lose the magic? How can one live with love when the best of youth is left behind? This story proposes a reunion with the characters that marked a generation of Mexicans, who are now facing adult life. Together again, Charly and Nicolás embark on the difficult journey of trying to have a baby. Fernanda and Iñaki face the dilemma of getting back together. Meanwhile, Rocío feels that motherhood is crushing her and tries to rediscover her sex life, while Diego obsessively pursues professional success.

name: Hitler's Engineers: Building the Third Reich
summary: After Germany's defeat in 1945, Hitler's most trusted henchmen tried to downplay their role in the Holocaust and distance themselves from the brutal Nazi regime. But they couldn't hide their misdeeds forever. Charting the lives and careers of the Führer's most prominent planners, designers, architects, and builders, Hitler's Engineers: Building the Third Reich exposes the truth—revealing the active role these men played in shaping the war, fueling anti-Semitism, and convincing everyday Germans to join their sinister cause. Featuring leading journalists, historians, and academics—and combining

name: Next Top Model Hungary
summary: A talent-search reality show in which 16 girls compete for the title of Hungary's Next Top Model. The winner receives a two-year modeling contract, becomes the Hungarian brand ambassador for Schwarzkopf Gliss, and gets to appear on the cover of Joy magazine.

name: Comedy Royale
summary: A battle royale of comedy in which twenty representatives of Korean comedy put aside age, experience, and titles in competition for an opportunity to host their own Netflix show.

name: Famous Toastery Bowl
summary: The Famous Toastery Bowl is a postseason NCAA Division I FBS college football bowl game to be played in December 2023. Played at the Jerry Richardson Stadium in Charlotte, North Carolina, the bowl is owned and operated by ESPN Events.
previous_episode: The 1st Annual Famous Toastery Bowl: Western Kentucky vs. Old Dominion

name: A Vida Pela Frente
summary: They are young and still have a lot to live for, but we never know what tomorrow will bring... When they lose a classmate, new perspectives touch their hearts.

name: Label
summary: Revolves around the protagonist struggle to reach his desired identity, overcoming the identity society has labelled him with.

name: Your Christmas or Mine
summary: Young student couple James and Hayley both decide to surprise the other at Christmas only to have to accidentally experience Christmas with each other's families. Hayley ends up with James‘s military father, Lord Humphrey The Earl of Gloucester, at his country house. James, on the other hand, ends up with Hayley‘s working class family, in Macclesfield.

name: Boetie Boer: Inside the Mind of a Killer
summary: As Nelson Mandela is released from 27 years in prison (1990), Stewart 'Boetie Boer' Wilken starts his killing spree. Unlike most serial killers, he had more than one type of victim. He also claimed to engage in necrophilia and cannibalism.

name: Lusitânia
summary: A cursed wolf-child, two sisters battling each other to win a castle, a cocky Friar betting against the Devil; these are a few of Lusitania's stories. Lusitania is an anthology of six different tales that recount Iberian legends taken from a vast and rich folklore. This epic series deals in fantasy, horror, comedy and drama, weaving a tapestry of myths and legends.

name: Spinners
summary: Ethan is a good kid born on the wrong side of town. In Cape Town's slums where local gangs make the law, he is soon left with no choice but to work for one of them to support himself and his younger brother. Caught in a web of crime, he discovers he has an incredible talent for spinning, an exciting and extreme motorsport. Could this be his way out from the violent criminal life that seems to be the only option to survive in his neighbourhood?

name: Nada más que la verdad
summary: Nada más que la verdad (Nothing But the Truth) is a game show created by Howard Schultz, an American television producer and owner of Lighthearted Entertainment. It was first aired in Colombia. The hosts asks the contestants a series of 21 increasingly personal and embarrassing questions for a huge jackpot. The format has been exported to 47 countries, and appears in most countries as The Moment of Truth .

name: When a Snail Falls in Love
summary: Vita is a rookie genius in psychological research. Her brain works as if there were a rapid generator in it. In fact, it is a gifted talent as a snail. Upon joining the police force, she is facing the fate of getting removed due to her weak physique. previous_episode: Виноробство Галичини: дикі дріжджі, плодово-ягідне вино й виноград української селекції

Dozens of shell casings litter the ground. This tragedy marks the beginning of one of the most sprawling and mysterious criminal cases of recent decades in Europe, which has still not been elucidated despite extensive investigations and modern means put in place.

However, in their search for the perfect life-partner, they end up getting exploited financially and emotionally by conmen with fake identities, posing as suitable grooms on popular online platforms.

name: The Voice of Finland: All Stars
Secrets of the Enchanted Forests
summary: Traverse the planet's richest, most diverse woodlands, from the tropics to the poles and everywhere in between. Get to know the wild residents of these magical ecosystems and learn how forests connect and nurture the lives of countless species.

name: Musti

name: Кинопоиск: Топ-250 фильмов

Almost.

All she knows is that with life, other things can be discussed. If even life is gone, what else is there to talk about? name: LOL: Den der ler sidst

name: The Sunday Show with Jonathan Capehart

Drawing upon his years of experience covering Washington politics through four presidents, Capehart cuts through the political noise to bring you compelling, in-depth interviews and unique perspectives.

name: Brits Down Under

name: Michael Mosley: Secrets of Your Big Shop

Jock (the immature leader), Kaitlin (smart, cynical, chain-smoker), Boab (charming loud mouth) and Crawford (mild mannered, eccentric optimist) as they continuously find themselves in sticky situations that will take much more than a mop to clean up.

name: Scotland: Ocean Nation

Through stories of our human connection to the ocean, we meet the people whose lives are intertwined with the sea, and investigate the vitally important wildlife and ecosystems in Scottish waters.

summary: Following a strange solar eclipse, Félix heads off to work as usual. Slowly, he realizes he is the only person left on Earth. Confused and scared, he soon learns how to adapt to a world with no electricity, and even begins to enjoy himself. At first, the two clash over their different lifestyles, but learn how to set aside their differences to uncover the truth about the disappearance of humanity.

name: At Home With Katherine Ryan

In series one, Katherine set out to explore the world of parenthood, and this time she'll continue discovering what it takes to be a parent to her three children while also examining her family life and marriage. Needing to change something in her life, she decides to install Appy and embark on the various experiences that the application has to offer. However, Rita does not realize that the errors in the application, still in the experimental phase, will cause irreparable consequences in her life.

Their sons, Roderick and Mark Newall, were in their early 20s and inherited £900,000 after their parents' deaths. They were later convicted for their involvement in the murders and cover-up. Roderick, a former British Army officer, received a life sentence for double murder, while Mark, an international banker, was convicted of assisting an offender and concealing the bodies. Cherkwan's princess-like beauty reignites the flames of love and resentment between the two eternal ene

name: Hanasaki Mai ga Damattenai
summary: Hanasaki Mai works as a teller for a branch of Tokyo Daiichi Bank. Suddenly, she gets transferred to the Tokyo Daiichi Bank's headquarters office. Her job is to fix problems that arise at its various local branch offices. Hanasaki Mai has the type of personality where if she believes she is right, she cannot keep quiet about it or give up. At her new department, she sees many mistakes that take place inside the bank, which she never noticed before.

name: Songkhram Somrot
summary: Buabongkot thought that after fifteen years of marriage and stability with Poramet, nothing would change. That is, until the day she learned of her husband's affair. Instead of accepting she's lost, Buabongkot decides to stand up for justice in her marriage.

name: Laorchan
summary: La-ojan has just graduated from France and applies to be a secretary for Mom Luang Phuthanet Juthathep. Her intention is to steal the "Ajna Chakra" necklace, a precious piece of jewellery from Wiang Phu Kham which was sent to be displayed at the JT Center Mall owned by Phuthanet. During this time, their relationship slowly builds. He has fallen in love with her at first sight, and La-ojan grows gradually more attracted to him too.

summary: Tien has been raised as a boy all her life because Kamontat, her ill-willed father, swapped her with the family's gardener/caretaker's son in his estate in Hua hin, leaving behind a ring strung in a necklace as key to her true identity. Before Grandpa Thaksasoot died, he declared that he wanted a boy to carry the family name since Thorn, her father's brother, who also later died, can't have children. Jaiphisut is unhappy to meet him because she can remember how he teased her. She needs to make up the relationship between Sunida and Pemnuch, unaware that they become friends and try to bring Ronnachak and Jaiphisut back together.

name: Praai Pikart

name: Key to a Fortune
summary: What would you do if you inherited a home that you didn't know existed? Jean Johansson follows the hunt for the rightful heirs to properties, but will they keep or sell their key to a fortune?

name: Rising Tides - Ireland's Future in a Warmer World
summary: Philip Boucher-Hayes goes on an extraordinary journey across the planet to see how climate change is already affecting the world and to find out what it means for us in Ireland.

name: Gray Shelter
summary: Cha SooHyuk is focused only on his survival, without any grand goal. He reunites with Lee YoonDae, who he was very close with. YoonDae was living with his girlfriend but now has nowhere to go. They end up living together.

Their ambition is to reach the front page by finding the local news that engages the most. They soon discover that the task is much more difficult than they had expected.

name: Eccentric Romance
summary: Jay, an international student from Thailand, comes to Korea to see his friend Sung Hoon. The two enrolled in the same college "Health and Happiness" class, and need to submit a physical body assessment for their final project. While Sung Hoon already works out regularly, Jay isn't in the greatest shape, and he struggles in the gym. Enter Jin Wook, a personal trainer who takes a special interest in Jay, much to Sung Hoon's displeasure. summary: Women's bicycle racing was born during the post-war period of turmoil. It has been several decades since its short competitive history came to an end after only 15 years. Women's bicycle racing has been revived as the Rinkai League. With the birth of a major star who is active all over the world, many feel unprecedented excitement. Invincible Queen, Ibushi Silver Veteran, an athlete who has reached the pinnacle in other sports. The challengers came with only big dreams in their hearts even though they had no experience in sports.

name: Whisper Me a Love Song
summary: Yori Asanagi is a mature girl in many ways but is still pure when it comes to romance. That sentiment is proven when an underclassman, Himari Kino, suddenly confesses love to her after her band performance at the freshman opening ceremony. Confused and surprised, Yori asks her friends for consultation, but they tease her by saying that she is experiencing love. Yori soon makes up her mind and tries to return Himari's feelings, but in a twist of events, she realizes that what Himari loved was not her, but her music! name: Connection
summary: The crumbling friendship of friends is revealed as they uncover the death of a high school friend who left behind a five billion won insurance money.

summary: Universo Z is a children's series that mixes live action and animation to present the adventures of Z (a girl) and two of her friends Taby (a tablet) and Sir PC (a computer). Together they address various issues and challenges in a fun and playful way.

name: Sat Suea
summary: The story of a young policeman who was falsely accused of a crime he didn't commit by a more senior corrupted policeman. During his time in prison, he comes to meet a few people with similar stories as him. Together, they break out of jail with a mission to fight against injustice and take down the corrupted.

name: Futekisetsu ni mo Hodo ga Aru!
summary: Ichiro is a PE teacher in 1986 feared by his students for a "tough love" approach, harsh tongue and frequently "inappropriate" behavior. He's also a dad trying to raise a rebellious daughter after having lost his wife to illness. When he gets transported in time to 2024, he encounters modern sensibilities that teach him about empathy, but also gives people of today reason to rethink their own political correctness in this time traversing comedy about change.

name: A Wonderful Journey
summary: During the fast-changing 1990s, the family who held "Wonderful Taxi" and their drivers in Chiayi, even when they encountered various difficulties and problems, they still kept going with their own way.

name: Discrètes
summary: Macha and Gaby are housekeepers of an office tower. The night Macha saves Gaby from the hands of her aggressor, the girls start a quest to do justice for themselves.

name: HeeSu in Class 2
summary: The drama is based on a popular webtoon of the same name. The story is about the youthful romance of HeeSu, an ordinary 18-year old boy, and his neighbor who has a secret.

name: Talking Friends
summary: Talking Tom stars in Disney's newest show, Talking Friends , along with Talking Ben, Talking Ginger, Talking Gina and Talking Pierre.

name: Hear Your Heart
summary: The flower shop owner and love consultant, Su Yi, has heterochromatic pupils. She can hear others' thoughts. By a twist of fate, she meets Lin Xufeng, who has returned to start a business in his homeland. After coincidentally encountering each other several times, they gradually develop feelings for each other. Unexpectedly, their true love's kiss unlocks memories sealed for a thousand years. As their memories of past life grudges and affections awaken, what should they do in this present life?

name: Love at Second Glance
summary: It tells the story of the female protagonist Zhong Qing, who, in order to stand out in the "workplace survival battle", spares no effort or cost to "only talk about money". But one day, there was a sudden incident, and Zhong Qing's position as director disappeared instantly, only adding a special skill that could see everyone's balance. The new director, Bu Yi, saw the new official take office, and this pair of happy enemies went from their strained relationship to the sparks of love sparked by friction, and finally felt the true meaning of life.

name: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
summary: George Poveromo targets the most popular saltwater game fish.

name: Jens i Mongolia
summary: A newly in love Jens is torn between a desire for adventure and missing his girlfriend when he sets out on a crazy journey on horseback in Mongolia.

name: Хлеб
summary: Four episodes of the documentary project will tell about the role of bread in world and Russian history, science and economics, geopolitics, as well as how it affects our health.

name: Nong Mia
summary: Many women find the protagonist, Ekkapop very attractive, yet is already engaged to Ngamnek, who he is about to marry. On the eve of the wedding, in a nightclub, by chance, Ekkapop ends up in an affair with Fuengfah, Ngamnek's half sister.

name: Air Fryers Made Easy
summary: In this cooking series, Alexis Conran aims to prove how easy it can be to prepare decent meals in an air fryer, even for the most amateur of chefs.

name: Predator vs Prey
summary: Wildlife series offering new perspectives on how predators such as lions, crocodiles and cheetahs stalk, chase and bring down their prey.

name: Spinal Destination
summary: Tessa Rivers' busy life is turned upside down when a mysterious illness leaves her paralysed from the waist down. Tessa is sent to Goldfield's Spinal Unit, where she becomes determined to walk again - by any means necessary.

name: Emergency Couple
summary: The tumultuous feelings of a divorced couple are rekindled when they become reunited years later as interns at the same hospital.

name: Chatham Islanders
summary: Experience the community, the history, the isolation, and the connection of life on the remote Chatham Islands, where the land and sea govern the day to lives of the inhabitants.

name: Strait to the Plate
summary: Aaron Fa'aoso sets out on a journey to discover signature Torres Strait Islander cuisine, providing a snapshot of the food, people, and life of the tropical region.

name: WWII: Women on the Frontline
summary: Defying expectations, overcoming prejudices, and often outperforming their counterparts, these are the courageous, and unwritten stories of the women who fought the Nazis. This remarkable documentary explores the daring and unknown histories of the remarkable pilots, journalists, guerrillas and spies who fought, flew, and died across Britain, Germany, France and beyond during World War II.

name: The Defenders
summary: Adapted from the novel "Sheng Shi Shou Hu" (生死守护) by Zhang Ping (张平).

name: Blemish Flaw
summary: Mystery video blogger Yang Zhenghui uncovers a disturbing connection between the long-term disappearance of his ex-girlfriend, Liu Wei, and a ceramist named Zeng Jie. A fire that broke out at Zeng Jie's studio a year ago appears to have concealed crucial secrets about Liu Wei's fate. Now, Zeng Jie is scheming to murder his wife and take over her fortune. As Yang Zhenghui digs deeper, the logic behind the truth slowly surfaces...

name: Runaway Princess
summary: One missing girl. Three very different lives. As the search pulls them together, each girl faces a choice that could break her—or save her. Above ground, the city gleams; below, a maze of dark tunnels hides its secrets. One girl walks that line alone, through pain and buried truths, until she uncovers what really happened. But finding the answer is only half the fight. The other half? Finding herself, and a way back to the light.

name: Twelve Letters
summary: Twelve mysterious letters, thirty-five years of unending anticipation. This drama focuses on the fate and romance of a small-town youth wrapped in a fantasy shell with suspense as bait and emotions at its core. It breaks traditional narrative patterns by introducing a unique dual-time-space interaction mechanism. The unpredictable weather and the blackboard in an abandoned classroom open a channel connecting two-time spaces, creating an enthralling and suspenseful experience.

name: Wonder Wall
summary: A terribly unlucky young couple stumbles into a massive villa by chance and accidentally discovers a huge sum of hidden fortune. But when trouble hits, they can no longer tell — is this a dream come true or a nightmare unfolding？

name: Be Passionately in Love
summary: In the cicada-filled summer in the rainy southern city of Qingyi, Xu Zhi, the "Ruijun Dark Horse," meets Chen Luzhou, the "Naked Score Topper." A misunderstanding kicks off the fiery romance between "Zhi" and "Poet Chen."

name: Coming to Myself

Along the way, she encounters Yin Feng, a criminal psychology professor who is injured and suffering from amnesia. The two form a detective duo. With his mind reverted to a youthful state, Yin Feng, innocent and passionate, gradually opens up You Mingxu's heart, which had been closed off due to losing her mother at a young age. During their investigation, Yin Feng displays exceptional skills in criminal psychological analysis, while You Mingxu relies on her extensive experience

name: Si Jin

Determined to rewrite her fate, she breaks off her engagement, outsmarts her cruel aunt, opens a perfumery, and investigates a series of mysterious crimes. She reunites with Yu Jin, and despite their unresolved past, they join forces to change tragic destinies—saving her siblings and clearing her father's name. As they overcome hardships together, Jiang Si's feelings for Yu Jin rekindle, and they work hand in hand to protect the peace of the Zhou dynasty, embracing a lifetime of prosperit

name: Chun Ri Yan
summary: Adapted from the web novel "Spring Banquet" (春日宴) by Bai Lu Cheng Shuang (白鹭成双).

name: Serendipity
summary: Jian Mingshu, the daughter of the Jian family, survives a family massacre after accidentally falling off a cliff and losing her memory. Rescued by her love, Lu Chang, they journey together to the capital for exams. As Mingshu investigates her mysterious origins, she faces challenges but is secretly protected by Lu Chang. Through shared trials, their bond deepens, and they ultimately confirm their love, deciding to spend their lives together. Adapted from the novel "Bang Xia Gui Xu (榜下贵婿)" by Luo Ri Qiang Wei (落日薔薇).

name: Donkey Kong
summary: Donkey Kong has escaped from the circus. He is on the lam, and Mario and Pauline are chasing the ape. As with the original game, Donkey Kong will often grab Pauline and Mario has to save her. Plots typically centered on them encountering crime with the villains conning the slow-witted Donkey Kong into doing their work and Mario and Pauline exposing the truth. After Mario and Pauline reveal the truth to Donkey Kong, the three of them team up to stop the antagonists' plans followed by Donkey Kong evading Mario and Pauline again.

name: Bury the Hatchet
summary: This light-hearted court-style show will bring two warring parties together to help them "bury the hatchet". Hosted by a notable Atlanta legal figure serving as the "judge" and a group of comedians and influencers as the "jury," the two groups will present their cases and the judge and jury will help them settle the beef.

name: Axel Wagner und die Klimakrise
summary: Species extinction, heavy rain, scorching heat, ... - science journalist and biologist Axel Wagner uses impressive film footage to show how our environment is changing and explains what we can do to avert the dramatic consequences of the climate crisis.

name: Demon Lord 2099
summary: The cyberpunk metropolis Shinjuku—a massive city-state bedecked with neon signs, towering skyscrapers, and the latest cutting-edge technology. It is here, in year 2099 of the Fused Era, where the legendary Demon Lord Veltol has his second coming five centuries in the making. But this landscape is nothing like the one he conquered all those years ago, for the fusion of magic and engineering has elevated civilization to dazzling, unprecedented heights. Veltol may have been reduced to a historical footnote, but make no mistake...this brave new world will be his for the taking!

summary: Jean Calvet, a doctor practicing at the Saint-Charles clinic, married Isabelle, a former patient whom he saved from Hodgkin's disease. Seductions, threats and blackmail are part of his daily life.

name: Chou Nogizaka Star Tanjou!

name: Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
summary: A young train engine and his friends work hard on the railways.

name: Johnson & Knopfler's Music Legends
summary: Musicians don't come much bigger or more successful than Brian Johnson and Mark Knopfler - lead singers of AC/DC and Dire Straits respectively. These two legends of rock have sold a staggering 300 million records between them, toured for more than 40 years and have each left their own indelible mark on our cultural history. Now, after a lifetime in music, Brian and Mark are taking a moment to reflect by sharing their incredible knowledge, experience and insights with each other - and the world.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress: Pathway to Victory
summary: The teaching ministry of American Southern Baptist pastor and television host Dr Robert Jeffress. He is a Senior Minister of the First Baptist Church in Dallas as well as a Fox News contributor.

name: D. James Kennedy Ministries Presents: Truths That Transform
summary: Topical discussions, feature stories, incisive commentary, and timely excerpts from the powerful messages of D. James Kennedy.

name: Coral Ridge Ministries Presents: Truths That Transform
summary: Topical discussions, feature stories, incisive commentary, and timely excerpts from the powerful messages of D. James Kennedy.

The next challenge for these girls is... Showa era songs! They will sing covers of hit songs from the past! They'll also perform serious duets with big-name male singers!

name: Adresse Malmø

summary: Produced by John Cena, this series chronicles athletes vying to become the next WWE Superstars. The process will challenge them, but the biggest tests they face will be ones they create on their own.

name: Together: Tr3ble Winners
summary: In this sports documentary, Manchester City FC offers a behind-the-scenes look into their 2022-23 season.

name: The Faulkner Focus
summary: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.

name: Beat the Bridge
summary: Featuring an enormous interactive bridge that dares players to cross by stepping on the right answers to challenging trivia questions. Each step forward puts money in the team's bank, with bonus money for each successful crossing. However, the team gets to keep the money only if it can "beat the bridge" by returning one of its players back across before time expires in an exciting end game.

name: Tic Tac Dough
summary: Tic Tac Dough is an update of NBCUniversal's classic format originally created by Robert Noah. The show is hosted by the incomparable Brooke Burns ("Master Minds", "The Chase"), who guides two contestants as they compete to place three of their marks in a row on the giant trivia board. After three rounds, the winning player moves on to face the dragon in the grand prize round, where the dragon moves strategically on the board to block the player's ability to make three-in-a-row and take home $10,000.

summary: Cuaderno de Campo is a documentary series that shows the best kept secrets of the Iberian fauna. On this journey, Juan Antonio Rodríguez Llano, naturalist and director of numerous nature documentaries, together with his expert film crew, will reveal the untold stories of Spain's wildlife. With a surprising and fun approach, each episode will show the life of a different wild protagonist, a star who will share his most intimate life and behaviors.

name: Zhu Tian Ji
summary: Teenage boy Lin Fei was unable to practice martial arts due to a defect in his meridians. After witnessing his master and his best friend die in the battle in the Black Abyss, he began to practice an ancient art of artifact refinement. He vowed to avenge them and hunt down the leader of the Black Abyss, even if it cost him his own life. A mysterious power revived him in a new era, and Lin Fei was determined to rebuild his sect and make it flourish.

name: Family Reservations
summary: Family Reservations follows culinary pioneer and world-renowned restaurateur Maren Winter, who is nearing retirement. Each of her three daughters is eager to take the reins of running her restaurant empire, the Winter Group. Ruled by her deep insecurities about becoming irrelevant, Maren pits her three daughters against each other, beginning her own dangerous descent into madness and starting the Winter sisters on their journey to freedom.

name: The Power of Film
summary: THE POWER OF FILM is a 6-part television event from legendary UCLA film Professor Emeritus Howard Suber, analyzing why certain films have remained both popular and memorable for generations. He uncovers mysteries, dispels myths, and explains with clarity and humor the defining principles and inner workings of some of the most powerful and beloved films of all time. Scenes from hundreds of these much-loved movies are featured throughout.

name: High Hopes
summary: High Hopes follows Slava, Mishka, and their hilarious employees at their Hollywood-based cannabis dispensary - MMD - as they navigate the pitfalls, pleasures, and potpourri of potheads that come with running one of the fastest-growing cannabis companies in California.

name: America Reports
summary: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts

name: Ожоги любви
summary: The Savelyev family lives and knows no troubles until an unexpected turn occurs in their fate. Vsevolod and his wife Galina learn that their son Ignat is falling in love with his mother's former friend Larisa. Meanwhile, a mysterious man in a leather cap named Alexander is trying to get home, and no one even suspects what will happen when he finally reaches his destination.

name: Fabricante de ovnis
summary: Fernando, a native of Argentina, arrives in Salgueiro, an almost abandoned town in the heart of Galicia, looking for his grandfather's birth certificate which he needs to apply for Spanish citizenship. While there, the locals try to convince him to stay in the town and assume the role of its leader, a role that Fernando's grandfather successfully occupied until he fled to Argentina for no apparent reason. Fernando believes the town could tap into UFO tourism to revive its fortunes. The entire community is at the command of its new leader, awaiting the arrival of aliens...

name: I Can Cook - On the Go

Katy travels around the country in Horace, her kitchen campervan, helping children create and prepare healthy food. With songs to sing, actions to join in with and mouth-watering recipes to try at home, I Can Cook - On the Go will make healthy eating and outdoor activities fun and accessible for families to enjoy together.
previous_episode: A Special Surprise: Funky Beet Muffin and Surprise Party

name: Highspeed Etoile
summary: In the near future, a next-generation racing event called NEX Race is announced, changing the world of racing. New technology has made racing at over 500 km/h safe, changing racing on the world stage completely. Rin Rindou, who once dreamed of being a ballet dancer, had given up her dream due to an injury, became a NEET and lives with her grandmother. However, one day she is suddenly thrown into the world of next-generation racing.

name: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain
summary: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain is the story of two strangers getting married and falling in love. Priya is a happy-go-lucky woman in her early 30s, not married so far, and quite sure that she wouldn't be able to get married ever. She takes tuition for college students and is happy with the world. Ram Kapoor, a wealthy man in his early 40s, is a ruthless entrepreneur who also believes that he has missed the bus of marriage. But as fate would have it, they bump into each other through a minor car accident which hurts their egos more than their vehicles and then after a series of miscommunications and mis

And how a person himself changes over time: remains true to his values, makes compromises, becomes disillusioned with ideals, but at the same time continues to search for answers to eternal questions.

The Galgo Group, the family business that has seen three generations grow, is going through its worst moment and everyone around it is looking to take advantage. The crisis in the sector, the imminent arrival of the sugar law and the lack of leadership of Emilio, president of Galgo since his father died, are shaking the company's future. So Gonzalo Díaz, after years of working alongside Emilio, sets out to implement his own plans for the company. The one neither of them counted on was Carmina, Gonzalo's wife

name: Destiny

After her father's death, she and her mother moved to her mother's hometown in Nagano Prefecture. Nishimura Kanade wanted to become a prosecutor like her father, and she entered law school at a national university in Nagano Prefecture. There, she had 4 friends, including Nogi Masaki. They became really close friends and shared memorable experiences together. Due to a case involving a death, their relationship ended. 12 years later, Nishimura Kanade is now 35 years old and

name: Bleep
summary: Victor Sotberg, Robin "Rob the Sir" Hofset and Christopher "Chris" Robin Omdahl give us fun and exciting content from their crazy world.

name: A Brief History of the Future
summary: A Brief History of the Future is a unique six-part documentary series about our futures and how we can reimagine them. Hosted by renowned futurist Ari Wallach, the show invites viewers on a journey around the world that is filled with discovery, hope, and possibility about where we find ourselves today and what could come next.

name: False Face and True Feelings
summary: Ye Yifan, once an innocent youth, swears revenge after his family is slaughtered, transforming into the ruthless and enigmatic crime boss known as "Mr. Mo." It is in this guise that he encounters Xia Zhiqiu, a dancer. Thus begins a love game between hunter and prey. Ye Yifan gradually falls in love with Xia Zhiqiu due to her seduction, but he discovers that her true identity is Gu Qingyan, the daughter of his enemy. Meanwhile, to avenge her father, Gu Qingyan lays traps that Ye Yifan willingly falls into for the sake of love. As the two adversaries are entangled in a web of love and hate, genu

Along with comedy champion Huma Qureshi and hosted by Harsh Gujral, Madness Machayenge features Snehil, Ankita Shrivastav, Paritosh Tripathi, Kushal Badrike, Inder Sahni, Gaurav Dubey and Kettan Singh.

name: Thapki Pyar Ki
summary: The bright and beautiful Thapki is pretty much perfect... except for one minor flaw - she stammers. But that doesn't hold her back. All she needs is an encouraging pat on the back, a 'thapki', which soon becomes her name. Over the course of the show, Thapki falls in love with Dhruv, but is duped into getting married to his brother, Bihaan. In spite of this cruel twist of fate, Thapki doesn't let her spirit fade and does all she can to be the ideal bahu. What does destiny hold for this charming girl with an unbeatable spirit?

name: Inside The Hilton: Park Lane

Pawat, a piano teacher nursing his own heartache, finds refuge in the same town. They both check into a homestay called "Lom Nao Dao Oun" and, despite initial conflicts, gradually develop feelings for each other. However, Lew's forgotten boyfriend and her mysterious nightmares complicate their journey to uncover the truth.

Dan Niralai was pulled in to aid in unmasking an evil organization and taking down Prab Punyobat; a famous politician who had wrongly used his powers and is the person behind an international drug trafficking ring.

The wife was so disgusted that she destroyed them all. This enraged the ancient spirits and they placed a curse on her. At that time, she was pregnant with her twin daughters. So the curse was transferred to one of them, leading her to be the next Gorgon's descendant.

To understand this paradox: our country, where the law is the most repressive, is the one in Europe with the largest number of consumers, a third of whom are under twenty-five years old.

name: Time Team

Over the years, the team excavated over 220 sites, from back gardens to Buckingham Palace. Fate brings them to Chufeng Academy, where loyal friends give Xiaobangchui warmth and love between Lei and her begins to bloom. Millions of people will be watching, millions of pounds will be bet and millions more will be up for grabs in prize money.

name: Pim Mala
summary: Priew is a playboy that captures the heart of Namnuan, the niece of his boss. She is a sweet and innocent lady. When she discovers how much of a playboy he is, she is saddened and leaves the country to study abroad. When she returns to work for her aunt's company, Priew is attracted to her new looks and attitude. However, Namnuan is already engaged to Waen. One day, an angel transforms Priew into a woman named Pim Mala. The angel wants to teach him a lesson about the feelings of women. She promises to return him to his male body when he ends his playboy behavior.

Filled with optimism and fun, kids and families are taught life lessons through song and dance that allow them to learn, laugh and grow together.

He steers his way through the underbelly of the Punjab music industry, politics and business feuds with a fierce determination to unmask his parents' killer.

name: Dr. Arora

His profession, seemingly unique to the locals, results in serendipitous encounters that lead to unexpected enmities and unlikely friendships.

name: Potluck

The riveting courtroom drama explores moral dilemmas and the choice of the right over easy.

Coincidentally, they overhear her brother Petch talking on the phone with his friend Ran—Bua's childhood crush—who is in need of a woman to masquerade as his girlfriend! When you're in the middle of a war, being neutral is not an option.

While she's being a fake mother for Pathiharn's son, they develop romantic feelings for each other. However, his wife who was missing, finally returns.

Professor Henning Franzmeier and his team have recently discovered a splendid palace and treasure room inside the city walls. This documentary follows this unprecedented mission for eight weeks and reveals for the first time the true history of the lost city of Ramses the Great.

The Agyekum sisters live a lavish life as the daughters of royal descendants of two of the most wealthy and powerful Ghanaian kingdoms. However, with that privilege comes great responsibility. Behind closed doors, viewers are given a glimpse into the double lives the sisters are living that could tarnish their family's noble reputation.

She pulls a list of names from her archives and begins to eliminate, one by one, the people mentioned on it, transforming into an enigmatic and clumsy vigilante.

name: In the Eye of the Storm: The Political Odyssey of Yanis Varoufakis
summary: In the Eye of the Storm is a six-part documentary series about one of the foremost intellectuals and political figures of our age, Yanis Varoufakis. Pär has a unique way of interviewing which encourages his guests to open up and share tales never told before.

Mafia is a six-episode crime series, drawing inspiration from actual events. A dramedy that makes fun of the Polish artistic elite, for whom Warsaw is "the only real Polish city", cannot be compared to other shows. It is the authorial work of playwright and screenwriter Pawel Demirski. He wrote it from the beginning with the intention of presenting a hero contrasting with the burnout syndrome often felt today – a vital madman who believes the best is yet to come.

This new three-part documentary series recounts the story behind the ten days leading to Edward VIII abdicating his throne to marry American divorcee Wallis Simpson. It would change the royals, the press and British history forever.
