Six months later, seven members of the University Mystery Research Club visit Tsunojima, which has become a deserted island, for a training camp. Meanwhile, on the mainland across the sea, Kawaminami Takaaki, a former member of the Mystery Research Club, receives a letter from Nakamura Seiji, who was supposed to be dead. As he continues his investigation, Konan meets a

name: Богиня сыска
summary: Goddess of Detection is a romantic experiment about searching and dating. Will the bachelor be able to choose a girl by the appearance of her apartment? He will study everything - clothes, books, the contents of closets and shelves. But will the girl agree to a date after a return search at the guy's home? Bloggers Ilya Kuruch, Vika Chuma, and fashion expert Daniil Grachev will comment on what is happening.

name: Погружение
summary: How could an innocent and slightly illegal trip to a classified career end up? Igor, a black digger, diver and just an adventure lover, comes here with his brother and a group of friends in search of an ancient settlement. Diving into a quarry turns into a surprise... Divers find themselves prisoners of the anomalous zone. The zone was classified due to secret experiments, and... people were left to live in their cocoons. Will they be able to get out of a parallel world that exists according to their own laws? ..

name: Broken Trust
summary: Businessman Chin Tai-hoi calls the shots in the office and at home. Tai-hoi is certain his son Chin Kai-loy is incompetent, so he forces him to make progress by continually putting pressure on him. Although Tai-hoi's lover Hung Mui-kwai has been hinting all kinds of ideas to him, but Tai-hoi still has not promised to honor her. Tai-hoi's daughter Chin Yau-fong goes into business while keeping her father in the dark. Tai-hoi slyly undermines her efforts as he feels betrayed. Tai-hoi is kidnapped. And staff member Chiu Yat-ming comes to his rescue. Tai-hoi becomes suspicious of people around him

name: Arnacœur ou prince charmant
summary: A single woman will meet 14 men who have everything to please her. She is unaware that, as in everyday life, some men she is going to meet are not there for sincere reasons... They are seducers! And if one of them succeeds in being the chosen one of his heart, he will win 20,000 euros. Will our single person succeed in detecting true love and avoiding the trap of seducers?

name: Yakuzas : Les mafieux légendaires au Japon
summary: Based on the exclusive testimonies of several of them, as well as insights and archive footage, this is a fascinating immersion into the ritualized world of the yakuza, legendary mobsters now in decline.

name: The Power : Qui a le pouvoir ?
summary: Each week, chance will designate a participant as the Power Player, who will have all the powers in the house and will decide who sleeps where, who eats what, who has this privilege or that handicap. But he will have to keep his identity secret at all costs. At the end of the week, the Power Player will designate the player who will be eliminated. Unless he unmasks the Power Player, in which case it is the latter who will be eliminated! Between strategies, alliances and low blows, who will be able to tame power?

name: Un chef au bout du monde avec Philippe Etchebest
summary: After 30 years travelling through the kitchens of France, chef Philippe Etchebest sets out to discover other flavors, other products and other cultures.

name: Terminal
summary: Jack, a captain who manages his personal life as poorly as his plane, and Charlie his co-pilot, relegated from a prestigious company to Flywingz, are forced to collaborate. To do this, they will be supported by an astonishing team of cabin crew: the naive Nelly, Nabil, the most unpredictable steward the sky has ever known, Tristan the arriviste, and Armelle, an activist in all battles. An inspection visit that turns into a fiasco, a child who takes the controls of the plane or a safety training session that goes awry: our (almost) always united team of broken arms will try as best they can to

name: GIGN, unité d'élite
summary: The GIGN, an intervention group of the national gendarmerie, is celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2024. Each episode of the series deciphers a daring mission.

name: Les Secrets des fratés
summary: For more than 10 years now, the people of Marseillais have been living their adventures in the four corners of the world! For Paga and Julien, it's time to delve back into memories... The two friends will review the highlights of all the seasons of the show that changed their lives, and comment on them by giving their version of things and revealing to you unpublished anecdotes… Discover the first reaction of the Marseillais… by the Marseillais!

name: Une amitié dangereuse
summary: Two women, young and beautiful, form a strong friendship. Marie de Rohan, Duchess of Chevreuse, lively and cheerful, free in body and mind, who collects adventures, and Anne of Austria, Queen of France, prudish and shy who, married too young and abandoned by her husband the king Louis XIII suffers from neurasthenia.

name: Las Largas Sombras
summary: The lives of a group of women are suddenly turned upside down by the discovery of the human remains of one of their classmates, who disappeared during a school trip to Majorca twenty-five years earlier.

name: Au micro
summary: In 2024/2025, the new UEFA Champions League format, with even more matches, will be broadcast in full on CANAL+ channels. With this in mind, to strengthen its team of commentators, CANAL+ has launched a search for a new voice to commentate on football on its channels. An exceptional recruitment process, in several stages, open for the first time to all football fans. Competitors aged 18 to 64, from all professional and social categories.

name: Sip & Gossip
summary: Welcome to Sip & Gossip, the podcast presented by Maghla where we read all your little unspoken secrets.

name: Au cœur du collège, un an à Jean Vilar
summary: This documentary series aims to reveal and understand education, its challenges, its hopes, its successes, and sometimes its limits. At an age when everything is possible - at this turning point in life - this unique program offers an uncompromising, but empathetic, look at life in a REP (Priority Education Network) middle school. Students and teachers alike will talk about the difficulties as well as the successes encountered throughout this school year.

name: Songs of Ireland
summary: Entertainer and musician Pat Shortt and Stockton's Wing frontman Mike Hanrahan, take a musical road trip around Ireland to discover the history behind some of our greatest songs.

name: Haantjes
summary: Mike, Daan, Ivo and Greg are facing a world that has evolved without them. Some are ready to rethink their ways; others try to reaffirm their manhood.

name: Экстрасенсы против ученых
summary: Two clans take part in the show - a team of psychics and a team of scientists. They have to fight each other. In these tests they must use only their own methods: scientists - the method of scientific analysis, psychics - superpowers and secret forces of nature! Who will win?

name: Исповедь экстрасенса
summary: A true and complete life story of the country's most famous psychics. Never before have they been so candid in front of the camera. What is it like to have the gift of foresight and know everything in advance? Why can't they protect their loved ones from misfortune, and which of these superhumans is capable of ordinary tears?

name: The Village Green
summary: The town of St. Maurice is in an economic crisis until an unlikely cash crop saves the day.

name: My Marvellous Dream Is You
summary: I'm Dawan. Since I can remember, I have always had strange dreams about a quiet girl who often played with me in my dreams. One day, a new neighbor moved in, and that led to my family falling apart. My father ran away with the man next door, who turned out to be the father of Khimhan the quiet and small girl from next door. Initially, we were not close at all, but circumstances brought us closer and made us understand each other. However, Khimhan was unaware that while in the real world we were just friends, in my dreams, she and I did things that went far beyond that. So, I kept my feelings c

name: Boonie Bears
summary: In a lovely wooded wonderland in rural Northeast China. Though the surroundings might seem idyllic, the peace has been disrupted by the dastardly Logger Vick, who schemes to transform the majestic forest into his own personal lumberyard! Too bad for Vick-two strapping brown-bear brothers are determined to thwart his plans and send him packing.

name: Dariba Diaries
summary: Set in 19th century Delhi, our story takes place at a time when technology and science are still in their infancy and modern tools of investigation haven't yet been invented. While Bahadur Shah Zafar II reigns ostensibly, the British might and influence increase each day, and with it, a spate of crimes. As crime multiplies, the police grapple to keep up with the mounting unsolved cases. Under these circumstances, when the Kotwal finds himself in the midst of a felonious mystery, he seeks the help of the only man who can come to his aid, Mirza Jaan Nawaz. Though eccentric in his methods of inve

name: Klimawechsel
summary: Four women, all teachers at Munich's Novalis high school, feel the sword of Damocles of the menopause threateningly hover above them - Angelika has hot flashes, Beate uncontrolled emotional outbursts, Cornelia gets panic attacks and Desiree is suffering from nervous exhaustion. However, all four realize that life also continues in this stage of life - albeit on winding paths.

name: Food Rescue Kitchen
summary: Join foodie influencer and home baker Naomi Toilalo as she challenges Top Chefs around Aotearoa to create a three course meal out of food she's rescued.

name: The Great War
summary: The Great War is a four-hour cinematic documentary covering U.S. involvement in World War I in the critical year of 1918. After three years of horrific battle in the trenches of France and Belgium, the Allies are on the verge of collapse—and Germany the cusp of victory. The United States is forced to rapidly train, arm, and ship millions of young soldiers overseas to Europe for the first time. Our story follows General John J. Pershing, leader of the American Expeditionary Force, who is charged with training and deploying an army almost from scratch; Michael B. Ellis, a young man fighting with

name: Jue Shi Zhan Hun
summary: On the Canglan Continent, warriors cultivate their power by communicating with heaven and earth through their martial spirits. Our protagonist, Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, accidentally obtains a fragment of the soul of the God of War, a mysterious being from the ancient era. From that moment on, Qin Nan defies his destiny and begins an upward journey. Along his way, he meets beautiful immortal women, defeats celestial geniuses, and becomes invincible in all battles, eventually becoming a supreme and revered Celestial God.

name: Alumni Lovers
summary: We invite you to a date-matching show with eight singles who share their memories of their school days and a panels who are all prepared to make over 100 funny and frank comments to encourage a couple to be matched.

name: Raja, Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan
summary: They say that variety is the spice of life. Well, Indian cuisine is abundant with both spice and variety! But how did the Indian palate come to be this colorful? The answer lies in the royal kitchens of India. Indian Royalty are the custodians of the ancient culinary traditions. Raja, Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan takes us through the history of food prepared in the royal kitchens of India, whose blending of foreign imports, rare fowls, elaborate preparation methods and local herbs, created some of the best and most flavorful food in the country. We get to experience the tales of extravagance and

name: Bret Baier's 'The Campaign'
summary: Bret Baier's 'The Campaign' focuses on the most important topics to American voters and the effectiveness of how the candidates are campaigning on these issues.

name: India's Best Dancer
summary: India's Best Dancer showcases the journey of some of the best talent who, with their solo performances, will compete to win the title. The show promises to be the toughest dance reality show on Indian television and the makers have ensured to make it challenging at every step.

name: Costa!! de serie
summary: On the Spanish Costa Brava, the legendary club Costa is running at full speed again. However, success also means hard work and club owner Thomas is on the verge of burnout. When the doctor warns that he really needs to take it easy, permanent employees Esmee, Kay and Mike have to take over the management of the Costa. But then a neighbor and the municipality turn against the club and the team is once again faced with the big challenge of saving club Costa.
previous_episode: Zon, zee, sex en gevonden voorwerpen

name: Dungeon People
summary: Clay has trained all her life to become the elite of the Thieves Guild. But since her father disappeared three years ago, she has put all her skills into searching for him in a dungeon filled with monsters and dangers. As she finally reaches depths never before equaled, she meets the manager of the dungeon... who invites her to join the staff! Arming traps, filling chests... through this new job, Clay will learn everything behind the scenes of a dungeon!

name: Ancient Powers
summary: Ancient Powers will bring together the history of early Eastern and Western civilisations; using stunning documentary visuals and stylish CGI to tell the extraordinary story of the world's greatest ancient cultures on one epic timeline, stretching back 5,000 years. Presented by world-leading historical specialists, each episode will use the very latest scientific and archaeological discoveries to reveal the tools, technologies, strategies and systems that decided the fate of Ancient Chinese, Egyptians, Indians, Greeks and Romans as they fought wars, battled the climate and established the rich

name: The Imposter
summary: Ghostwriter Tu Chacha finds herself reluctantly penning love letters for Miss Wen to hide her romantic escapades. Unintentionally, Tu Chacha develops feelings for the letters' recipient, Shen Buyan. In a bid to protect Shen Buyan from Miss Wen's father's schemes, Tu Chacha forms a makeshift family to dissuade him from pursuing Miss Wen. However, they soon fall into a trap laid by Miss Wen's father, resulting in severe repercussions for their masquerade. Together, Tu Chacha, Shen Buyan, and their makeshift family navigate a web of deceit, uncovering a shocking conspiracy along the way.

name: Taylor Swift vs. Scooter Braun: Bad Blood
summary: The $300M feud between Taylor Swift and Scooter Braun made headlines. But is Taylor bravely standing up for artistry and fighting the misogyny of the music industry, or has Scooter Braun been unfairly framed for what was just a business deal?

name: Toughest Forces on Earth
summary: Pirate ships. Desert warfare. Detonating underwater bombs. Go behind the scenes of secretive military units with a trio of veterans as your guides.

name: Dancing for the Devil: The 7M TikTok Cult
summary: After TikTok dancers join a management company and its associated church, unsettling details about the founder and their dark realities come to light.
previous_episode: Part III: Reap What You Sow

name: The Real CSI: Miami
summary: Jerry Bruckheimer, Anthony Zuiker and the minds behind the CSI scripted television franchise bring viewers a new true-crime series in The Real CSI: Miami . Each episode features gripping real-life crime cases and the cutting-edge forensic science used to solve them. The Real CSI: Miami highlights that at the heart of every story there's a victim and a family seeking justice.

name: Dreaming of a Freaking Fairytale
summary: In this 21st century hybrid fairy tale, a woman is determined to become a Cinderella, so she gets a job at an exclusive club and sets her sights on her future Prince Charming. He might be handsome and wealthy, but he's also an arrogant jerk with trust issues, and no interest in wom

name: Gummibär and Friends: The Gummy Bear Show
summary: Gummibär and Friends: The Gummy Bear Show is a brand new animated web series that follows the silly adventures of everyone's favorite gummy bear character and his friends Kala the cat and Harry the chameleon.

name: Living Stone
summary: Five couples engage in a life changing hike through Africa's most pristine wilderness in this game of survival and elimination to reach civilisation.

name: The Claman Countdown
summary: The close of the trading day is covered.

name: Kudlow
summary: Host Larry Kudlow leads roundtable discussions on the policies impacting the domestic and global economies and interviews with business influencers across the world.

name: Barron's Roundtable
summary: A weekly primetime series that features interviews with investors and major industry leaders about what to expect in the week ahead on Wall Street.

name: The Clues That Caught the Killer
summary: The Clues That Caught the Killer is a captivating three-part documentary series that dissects Britain's most shocking murders. And, in the face of gang violence, a lack of forensic evidence, and witnesses too terrified to speak, reveals how a team of hardworking investigators ultimately delivered justice for the victims and their devastated families.

name: The Evening Edit
summary: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

name: FBN's Wall Street
summary: FBN's Wall Street discusses emerging economic trends. Joined by veterans of Wall Street to talk about financial topics, with an emphasis on educating and empowering long-term investors. The show promises it's not just about investments, though, and includes all kinds of topics that affect people and their money.

name: WSJ at Large with Gerry Baker
summary: Wall Street Journal's editor at large Gerry Baker interviews industry leaders who impact Wall Street, Washington, D.C., and U.S. businesses.

name: The Bottom Line
summary: Dagen McDowell and Sean Duffy take on the hotly debated issues in the business and political world, plus the kitchen table topics that matter most to Americans.

name: The Big Money Show
summary: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

name: Ekstrem gjemsel
summary: In " Ekstrem gjemsel ", 15 celebrities will compete in an extreme game of hide and seek. Presenter Victor Sotberg has his fellow presenters Christopher Omdahl and Robin Hofset with him, and together they will hunt down the participants who will be tasked with hiding as best as possible so as not to be found.
previous_episode: Jeg risikerer livet for Ekstrem Gjemsel!

name: Celebrity Hunted – Jede Spur kann dich verraten
summary: 10 celebrities face the impossible task: submerging for 10 days. Chased by professional investigators with only little money to live on. Dr. Wladimir Klitschko, Axel Stein, Tom Beck, Stefanie Giesinger, Vanessa Mai, Andreas Ferber, Kida Khodr Ramadan, Summer Cem, Diana Bill & Melisa Kocak are on their run through Germany. Who will remain undetected in this game?

name: Samuel og Bestefar
summary: Presenter and adventurer Samuel Massie has the world's best friend in his own grandfather. Now that his grandfather is approaching 82, Samuel wants to challenge his comfort zone, and take him out on one last great adventure.

name: Sandra usensurert
summary: Sandra usensurert is a series about one of Norway's most talked about girls, Sandra Lyng (27). After seven years of silence, she is now back on her own two feet - and with a new voice.

name: Se hva jeg kan
summary: Join us when 10 tough and brave children show what they can do! There will be speed, wild tricks, glittering dresses, back protectors and water splashes.

name: Singel
summary: We follow eight single Norwegians through ups and downs. In this unique documentary series, we get an honest insight into the many different sides of being young and single in Norway today.
previous_episode: «Du veit det kleine øyeblikket mellom fødselen og døden...?»

name: SNAKK med Linn Wiik
summary: Linn Wiik invites guests from Norwegian social and cultural life and addresses current topics.

name: Betty La Fea, La Historia Continúa
summary: Betty has not lived with Armando for two years after having found him in a compromising situation with Marcela. Excited about her daughter's return to Colombia, she tries to strengthen her bond with her, but pressure on Ecomoda and enemies from the past will do everything possible to keep her from both Mila and Armando.

name: Shrimad Ramayan
summary: Shrimad Ramayan brings to life the timeless Hindu epic, the Ramayana, with a deep commitment to authenticity, cultural reverence and contemporary sensibility. The epic narrative of the Ramayana is rooted in the two words, 'Ram' and 'Ayana.' 'Ram' represents the human incarnation of Lord Vishnu, while 'Ayana' signifies a journey. Thus, the Ramayana unfolds through the voyage of Ram, a mortal who ascended to become Purushottam, the paragon among men, transcending his own inherent limitations.

name: Pushpa Impossible
summary: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until class 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The sho

name: Wagle Ki Duniya
summary: Three generations of the family live together, who share all their happiness and sorrows. Follow the story of this family as they bring laughter to each other's lives and will make your heart melt. A new generation of the old critically acclaimed show is here to take you on a roller coaster ride of emotions.

name: Kavya - Ek Jazbaa, Ek Junoon
summary: An ambitious young woman strives for the perfect balance between her dream career and a loving relationship. However, when these worlds collide, she grapples with the conflict between her roles as a daughter, a wife and an IAS officer. How will she tackle this challenging dilemma?

name: Barsatein - Mausam Pyar Ka
summary: A sensible and ambitious journalist joins a media company run by a suave maverick man. While united in their passion for honest and ground-breaking journalism, their contrasting characters immediately puts them at loggerheads. What will happen when she starts falling in love with him despite the red flags?

name: Wilde Ride
summary: A young girl's dreams of being a show jumping champion are dashed when her parents are killed. She goes to live with her dirt-bike-riding extended family in West Auckland. Made with the support of NZ on Air.

name: Dabangii: Mulgii aayi re aayi
summary: In a riveting tale of power, violence and family, a spirited young girl grapples with the contrast between who she believes her father is and who he actually turns out to be.

name: Kuch Reet Jagat Ki Aisi Hai
summary: Nandini is an independent and free-spirited young woman who, while honouring social customs, vehemently opposes societal malpractices camouflaged as traditions. Defying norms, she stands tall and bravely demands her dowry back from her in-laws.

name: Dhruv Tara - Samay Sadi Se Pare
summary: Love transcends time when a princess with a secret passion for healing people journeys 400 years in the future in search of a someone who can save her terminal brother. Amidst the wonderous modern world, the princess finds a talented neurosurgeon and, in the process discovers an unlikely bond of love. But will love be enough to compel him to travel to the past and help her and her brother?

name: Pashminna - Dhaage Mohabbat Ke
summary: A starry-eyed romantic falls in love at first sight with a hard-nosed businessman in a story of love, hope and heartbreak unfolding against the backdrop of soothing white snow-capped peaks, clear waters of the Dal Lake and golden chinar leaves in Kashmir. Will he be the answer to all her dreams, or will he become the gateway to the shattering truth of her past?

name: Aangan Aapno Kaa
summary: After raising three children alone, doting father Jaidev Sharma weathers the storms of seeing his adult daughters marry. Though Pallavi defies society's conventions and norms, she still seeks to be a dutiful daughter.

name: Mehndi Wala Ghar
summary: Mauli, an optimistic and determined woman who has never truly had a family of her own, sets out to mend the broken bonds of a family in Ujjain and reunite them in their ancestral home, the Mehndi Wala Ghar .

name: Vanshaj
summary: In a breathtaking whirlwind, a small-town girl unravels her hidden identity, thrusting her into a war with her own family members. Navigating fears and self-doubt, she must prove her mettle to inherit a real estate empire and forge a legacy that defies all expectations.

name: Mind Your Business
summary: Mind Your Business tells the story of the Williams family, which is in the business of celebrating some of life's biggest events with its music services. However, when it comes to the Williams' family affairs, there's a need for referees instead of DJs.

name: Promiseland
summary: Take an intimate journey with NBA rookie Ja Morant as he navigates the perils of his first season. The challenges of 2019-2020 turn out to be more than the point guard could ever have imagined.

name: Thru
summary: THRU is an exciting reality knock out game. In each episode the teams follow a precise straight line from A to B and overcome the obstacles.

name: Takeshi's Castle
summary: Welcome to Takeshi's Castle , a Japanese game show involving 100 to 140 contestants who try to go through a series of silly physical challenges designed to eliminate them. Designed like a live-action Mario game, thousands of people have come to take on Takeshi's Castle to try and win the ¥1,000,000 prize but hardly anyone does!

name: Fiennes: Return to the Wild
summary: Sir Ranulph Fiennes, 'the greatest living explorer,' and his cousin, actor Joseph Fiennes, embark on a journey through Canada's British Columbia, traversing challenging landscapes, amid stunning scenery. On route they discuss Ran's historic triumphs, perilous expeditions, and recent Parkinson's diagnosis - using this shared experience to strengthen their familial bond and create lasting memories.

name: Murder in Mahim
summary: Police officer Shivajirao Jende and his friend, Retired journalist Peter Fernandes plunge into a murder investigation in Mumbai's underbelly. In a thrilling tale adapted from Jerry Pinto's critically acclaimed book, they uncover secrets of desire, greed, despair and also confront the shadows of their long lost friendship.

name: Μαύρα Μεσάνυχτα
summary: Thrasos' family becames inheritor of his dead brother, Apostolis, house and nightclub. But also he takes over the mafia of his brother. Everyday new troubles appear with police. Silvi the ex girlfriend of Apostolis, trying to take control more than the 5% of the club. Murders, fights and forbiden loves take place everyday. Last his wife, gothic daughter and teenage son keep making the things worse.

name: Ainsley's National Trust Cook Off
summary: Ainsley and his chef friends cook al fresco in the walled kitchen gardens of the UK's finest National Trust stately homes. In each episode, Ainsley Harriott is joined by two guest chefs in the kitchen gardens of the historic estates who he will challenge to create and cook recipes using the bounty of the garden in an attempt to win the accolade of ‘Dish of the Day' whilst celebrating the abundance and beauty of fresh British produce grown by the Trust's team of staff and volunteers. Alongside the fun of outdoor cooking and friendly competition, Ainsley meets the staff and volunteers of the Tru

name: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentoushou
summary: In the Edo era, young Jinta and his sister must flee their home, finding refuge in a mountain village. Years later, Jinta has grown into a skilled swordsman, sworn to protect the priestess of the village shrine. Charged with slaying a demon that threatens the shrine, Jinta confronts the malevolent creature in the forest, only to learn a shocking truth. The demon speaks of events one hundred and seventy years hence, when Jinta must confront the demon in the future. Thus begins an epic fantasy journey that spans multiple eras as Jinta hunts a demon through time and must come to terms with his ow

name: Where in the Eff is Sarah Cincinnati?
summary: In this Carmen Sandiego send-up, everyone's flakiest friend, Sarah Cincinnati, asks for geography trivia help as she travels the world, getting lost and buzzed.

name: Shark
summary: Shark offers viewers a surprising, insightful, and shocking look into the planet's most feared predator – the shark. Each episode of Shark takes a look at different aspects of the shark, from vicious attacks, conservation, survivor stories to examining a shark's anatomy. The series will also feature specially made crafted content that explores everything you ever wanted to know about shark attacks but were afraid to ask, reminding us why we need to value and look after these extraordinary beasts. The shark's anatomy, including their jaws, skin, eyes and teeth will be examined and the question

name: Modern Day Gladiators
summary: Take an unprecedented look inside the vibrant world of esports. With the fanbase growing every year the competitions just keep getting bigger…and so do the cash prizes.

name: Spesialprestene
summary: We get to know priests in Norway who have an everyday life out of the ordinary. The special priests work in hospitals, in the police, in Norwegian prisons, on oil platforms, in the defense and at Gardermoen airport.

name: Suksesskolen
summary: Suksesskolen is a comedy drama series about a college that likes young people to succeed. The series is packed with music videos and questions what success really is.

name: All Rise
summary: A group of legal interns enter a high-stakes battle for the ultimate job offer. In this fierce jungle of competition, they must discover the truly fulfilling opportunities that resonate with their lives.

name: Jade's Fateful Love
summary: To protect her eldest sister, Yueling, the Youngest Princess of Dongyu, was married to Beishuo. By accident, she married Zhou Shiyu, the North Prince of Beishuo. The trip to the Capital City of Beishuo was full of assassinations. A jade pendant activated the Time Gate. Yueling and Zhou Shiyu had repeated reincarnations and improved themselves together, from striving to change their destiny to shouldering the national cause. As they grew together, they fell in love with each other.

name: Suverene Helter
summary: Suverene helter is a documentary series about some very special, but hitherto unknown, Norwegian athletes and their path towards the big event, the Special Olympics in Los Angeles 2015.

name: Sykkelreparatørene
summary: Spring is here and the time has come to get the bike out of the garage or shed. Through five episodes of Cykkelreparatørene, we will try to help you get your bike in working order. TV 2 Sport's Christian Paasche and the mechanics from The Service Course Oslo give you tips for simple repairs, settings, maintenance, clothing and training.
previous_episode: Ruller i mål med Edvald Boasson Hagen

name: Søsken
summary: In this completely unique Norwegian documentary series, we follow six families where one of the siblings is "wrapped up" in a slightly different way.

name: Tigerstaden
summary: The girls from the TV2 Bliss series Tigerstaden are back with the second season of the popular reality show. Linni Meister, Carina Dahl and Mari Haugersveen are joined in the new episodes of the series by their friend Anette-Marie Antonsen. "Tigerstaden" is a reality show about extremely ambitious girls in Oslo's best west. We follow them in their pursuit of success and love - while they both work and party hard.

name: Tutta – Veien til Rio
summary: For two years, TV 2 has followed golf ace Suzann "Tutta" Pettersen, both privately and on the golf course. With the whole world as her workplace, we join Suzann on the road to the next big goal: Olympic gold in Rio.

name: Unge foreldre
summary: A portrait series about young parents of young children who film themselves and their family in a hectic everyday life. We get to be part of the ups and downs when these families with children open their doors to give an insight into how they cope with the role of parents.

name: Ut av stillheten

Tina's friend since their student years Maryana has always been in love with Stas and tries not to lose sight of the couple. Maryana is married to Alexei, but her heart still belongs to the former fellow student. Gradually, envy of the personal and professional success of Tina and Stas gets stronger and stronger, and now the ill-wisher is ready to step over a lot in order to steal the husband from her ""sworn"" girlfriend.

name: Индус
summary: Anton Ponomaryov (Marat Basharov) devotes all his time and efforts to developing a conceptually new implant with the ability to speed up bone healing and help even in hopeless cases. However, scientific community does not appreciate Anton's piece of work which causes Vedernikov (Alexander Samoilenko), head of Scientific Research Institute, to put Ponomarev's laboratory under threat of being shut down. Fortunately, the situation is being resolved thanks to Anton's old friend Leonid Lazarev (Egor Beroev), a successful businessman, who possesses broad connections in political and business circles

name: Спецкор отдела расследований
summary: Dmitry is a young journalist. Near him always is a girl Nadya who's in love with Dmitry for many years.

name: Super Mutant Magic Academy
summary: Super Mutant Magic Academy is set at a high school where the student body is a mix of mutants and "regular" kids. Through eyes of Marsha, a sardonic new transfer student with a mysterious past, the series follows the awkward high school struggles and occasional triumphs of a diverse cast of teens as they stumble through romance, friendships and growing mutant powers.

name: Beat the Clock
summary: Syndicated five-day-a-week revival of the durable game show, where couples chosen from the audience attempted to complete stunts within a time limit.

name: Beat the Clock
summary: Classic game show where couples (and sometimes families) competed to win prizes by completing stunts within a time limit.

name: Beat the Clock
summary: Unlike previous versions, this version had kids playing the game along with adults.

name: Trooping the Colour
summary: Join Andrew Pearce and Ellie Costello, with Cameron Walker at Buckingham Palace for full coverage of the parade to mark the King's official birthday.

name: The Einstein Challenge
summary: The world is complicated, and sometimes we need things explained to us like we're kids. Today's greatest minds will do just that! In each episode of The Einstein Challenge , two world-class experts in science, history and engineering will see who can best explain complicated concepts to kids.

name: Anupama: Namaste America
summary: Seventeen years ago, Anupama gets an opportunity of a lifetime to live her dreams. Now she has to make a tough choice between her career and her family.

name: Pseudo Harem
summary: Eiji Kitahama joins the drama club with dreams of having a harem like the ones from his favorite manga. Rin Nanakura, an underclassman, finds herself crushing hard on Eiji, and tries on different personas in his presence to win him over. No matter how she acts, one thing is certain—her feelings for Eiji continue to grow stronger. Will she ever be able to tell him the truth and be herself?

name: Tasuuketsu
summary: The WEB Comic "Tasuketsu" by Miyakawa Taiga serialized in manga app "GANMA!" is finally becoming an anime! The game began suddenly. It was "Tasuketsu," a brutal survival game in which the majority is eliminated. In order to fight back against the immensely powerful emperor masterminding the game, young men and women create their own futures using the mysterious special ability known as "Special Right."

name: Super Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
summary: Dogs – they love us, protect us, and would do anything for us. But some clever canines are taking that dedication to extremes, doing everything from sniffing out crimes to saving lives and helping humans heal from PTSD. Welcome to the world of Super Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs ! Over two episodes, we meet a range of incredible hero hounds, seeing them in action as they use their training and talents to make the world a better place for humans and other animals. And we explore the ground-breaking techniques that have turned these super pups from loving pets into something even more special.

name: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
summary: Tom Kerridge hits the road in his 1950s food truck to discover wonderful produce, cooking with the ingredients he finds along the way.

name: Chock
summary: Chock is a Swedish horror TV series from 1997. Each episode was presented by the Swedish cult actor and horror host, Ernst-Hugo Järegård. Episodes were directed by Mikael Håfström, Daniel Bergman and Ulf Malmros among others.

name: The Loyal Pin
summary: Her Serene Highness Aninlaphat, or Princess Anil, and Mom Rajawongse Pilanthita, or Khunying Pin, have been close since they were young. When Princess Anil is fifteen, she must travel to England for her studies, separating the princess from her close friend Khunying Pin by a great distance. The distance, however, allows Anil to come to know herself, to know deep down how she's felt about Khunying Pin without question. Once she returns to Thailand, Princess Anil tries everything to get near to Khunying Pin where she can find the opportunity to confess her love. However, it seems to be an imposs

name: Accidental Farmer & Co.
summary: Inheriting a debt-ridden farming estate is hardly a dream come true, especially for a man with no direction in life. Just about having given up on the barren land, the man stumbles upon a mysterious medicinal herb. He decides to cultivate it so he can pay off the debt but ends up attracting wanted as well as some unwanted attention.

name: Salt City
summary: The show explores the journey of the Bajpai family through the complexities of the lives of each crisscrossing the other while exposing the past, coming to grips with the present, and unfolding a promising future.

name: Moving In with Malaika
summary: All set to showcase her true self, Malaika will shut down trolls in her quintessential Arora style as she opens up about her life.
previous_episode: What's Next for Malaika and Amrita?

name: Red Swan
summary: Oh Wan Soo, a former world-class golfer married into the powerful Hwain Group, finds herself targeted by death threats. She crosses paths with Seo Do Yoon, a bodyguard investigation a friend's death that is tied to the Hwain Group. Together, they unravel Hwain Group's secrets tainted with desire.

name: Черный список. На кухне
summary: Ilya Zakharov and Alexander Rambo Pushkov will check the aptitude of chefs all over Russia to get them into the best restaurants in the country. Unscrupulous chefs will be permanently blacklisted, and for providing high-quality services, the masters will receive double wages and, possibly, a dream job.

name: A Chan
summary: Connected by a mysterious antique pocket watch, Zhang Jing Chan and Li Wei Yi are suddenly transported back in time, where they discover their souls have been swapped. Forced to live each other's lives, they become determined to protect their families and rewrite the painful fates that bind them. As the two navigate tangled timelines, hidden truths, and growing emotional burdens, they realize that changing destiny may be far more complicated—and dangerous—than they ever imagined

name: Jing Hong Yi Xiao Re Tian Jiao
Summit of Our Youth
summary: Summit of Our Youth is a youth fantasy drama packed with inspiration and feel-good moments. It follows Gu Xuejiao, a love-obsessed office worker, who unexpectedly travels back to her high school days after getting laid off. Determined to fix past regrets, she shifts her focus from romance to ambition. With the help of the brilliant top student Lin Zhihua, she reinvents her life. And they fall into a sweet, mutual love as they grow together.

name: Born with Luck
summary: Zhang Yi'ang, a police officer who has been away from frontline criminal investigation for years, is dispatched to Sanjiangkou after receiving an anonymous tip from the provincial department. Shortly after arrival, he witnesses the murder of his criminal investigation captain. While clearing himself of suspicion, he unexpectedly arrests a serial killer, quickly gaining prestige. As he focuses his investigation on the gang of Zhou Rong, a wealthy local businessman, the numerous bumbling thieves and their infighting create a butterfly effect that ironically help him and his team. Supposed fate b

name: The Secret Path
summary: Yang Guang, Deputy Director of the Third Division of National Security, is caught up in a conspiracy involving an international spy organization during a mission. As a series of unexpected incidents unfold, Yang Guang and his team realize they are facing a crisis that threatens the leakage of national secrets. Sensing an earth-shattering conspiracy lurking behind these events, Yang Guang leads his division to investigate. Amid the escalating crisis, a woman named Zhao Yani becomes the focal point of the investigation. Her identity and actions are shrouded in mystery. At times, she appears to o

name: Dead End
summary: Two generations of policemen stumbled forward with unwavering determination, searching for the murderer in the maze-like alleys and finally breaking out of the dead ends in their lives.

name: Соло для пистолета с оркестром
summary: Lonely widow Yulia Shumova accidentally sees an American film on TV, the plot of which completely repeats the life story of her late husband Peter and his companion and childhood friend Mikhail Gvozditsky. It follows from the film that the car accident in which Peter died was set up by an unknown avenger in black. In a panic, she rushes to the police, where Gena Mylnikov, recently appointed to a leadership position, does not take her words seriously. But in vain...

name: Эра стрельца
summary: In the center of the plot is a triple murder. A successful businessman Alexander Serebryakov and two pensioners, the Zavyalov family, were shot dead in an elevator. The operatives are not happy with another cold case and are not going to deal with the motives...

name: Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin
summary: Spoiled harvest goddess Sakuna finds herself banished from her opulent celestial home to an island overrun with demons. In the untamed wilderness, she must rediscover her birthright as the daughter of a warrior god and harvest goddess by weathering the elements, fighting monsters, and cultivating rice, the source of her power. By her side in this forbidding place is her guardian Tama and a group of outcast humans. Together, these unlikely companions must join hands to tame both the soil and the demons of Hinoe Island.

name: Mayonaka Punch
summary: Meet Masaki, the now former member of the popular NewTuber group, Harikiri Sisters. After a career setback, aka getting fired unexpectedly via a live stream, she joins forces with Live, a partner with superhuman abilities. Together, they aim to create sensational content and reach 1 million subscribers. Will they reach their content dreams or be hit with the block button?

name: Opri Paraai
summary: After a boy was killed by someone, the spirit of the boy possessed a married girl. In his desire for revenge, the boy seeks to punish his killer.

name: The Bahatis Empire
summary: Hitmaker Bahati and his singer wife, Diana, navigate infidelity rumors, parenthood and the weight of fame while living the high life in Nairobi.

name: The Elusive Samurai
summary: In the year 1333, the Kamakura shogunate government comes crumbling down. A trusted vassal, Ashikaga Takauji, betrays the shogunate and organizes a rebellion. Hojo Tokiyuki, the rightful heir, escapes the massacre with a Shinto priest named Suwa Yorishige to Kamakura. On the run and fighting to stay alive, Tokiyuki sets in motion his plan to reclaim his birthright.

name: SHOSHIMIN: How to become Ordinary
summary: Kobato, who once had a bitter experience through deduction activities known as "wisdom work," was determined to become an honest and humble citizen. He secretly formed a reciprocal relationship with his classmate, Osanai, who shared the same aspiration, planning to make their high school debut as ordinary citizens and lead peaceful days. However, for some reason, mysterious incidents and misfortunes keep coming one after another into their school lives. Will Kobato and Osanai be able to achieve peaceful days as ordinary citizens?

name: Gimai Seikatsu
summary: An unlikely love story begins when Yuuta's dad remarries, and his new stepsister is the cutest girl in school.

name: Elf-san wa Yaserarenai
summary: Naoe-kun, a massage therapist, is about to head home for the day when he's saddled with a rather strange patient. This lovely lady has emerald eyes, pointy ears, and grew up in the forest—everything about her screams "elf," except for one thing: her bodacious body. It turns out she left her world but loves junk food in this one, and now her obsession has caught up with her. Can Naoe-kun help this loveable elf girl lose the weight—and keep it off?
previous_episode: The Beefy Soldier and Remnants of a Dream

name: Sky News at 3pm
summary: A summary of the latest news headlines.

name: Milkshake! Craft Party
summary: Showing how to make a range of fun artistic creations from common household items.

name: Rumors
summary: A young woman recounts the devastating experience of relationships destroyed, reputations tainted, and a career halted- all due to rumors spread by a "friend".

name: MBTI Love
summary: It is adapted from "Mr. Huo Dotes on Me". It tells the story of the piano teacher Wen Man, and the lawyer Huo Shaoting. They are not good at expressing love. From the test to doubt, and they can finally trust each other.

name: Apocalypse: Les débarquements
summary: June 6, 1944. A titanic fleet launches an attack on the beaches of Normandy. Objective: to free Europe from Hitler's yoke. The mission was a spectacular success: the Allies of the Second World War managed to overcome their political differences, overcome logistical difficulties and carry out an operation with unprecedented military challenges. How, before and after D-Day, did authorities, soldiers and civilians experience this turning point in History?

name: First Note of Love
summary: Neil is a singer-songwriter who has recently returned to Taiwan. Both talented and charming, he has everything he needs to become a professional singer, except one thing––the nerves to step onto a big stage. In an effort to get over his stage fright, Neil decides to start as a street performer to eventually work his way up. Hai is a loyal but timid fan of Neil's. One late night, after seeing Neil's performance, Hai gets on the last bus of the day and is surprised to see Neil get on, too. The bus brakes suddenly, and Hai finds himself in Neil's arms. When Neil gets off the bus, Hai sees his gui

name: Sugar Dog Life
summary: Sakuraba is a college student, though you'd never know it, with his short height and baby face. Certainly, police officer Amazawa thought Sakuraba was a minor, and nearly booked him for being out too late after he was returning from a drinking party. But there's something oddly familiar about him, and the two strike up an odd relationship…

name: Profe Infiltrado
summary: The "sports teacher" Julián seeks to obtain as much evidence as possible to arrest the father of a student, who is a criminal. However, the story will take an important turn when Julián falls in love with Miss Sofia.

name: Sai Sueb Sai Sadeu
summary: Chachai Fuangfoo and Chachai Phudeung are police officers w/ similar names. As they chase down drug traffickers, they find other similarities that lead them to hilarious adventures together.

name: Prajun San Gon
summary: Yodkwan and Tak just got married and got the free honeymoon tour package to Kraiwan Island. However, they couldn't go, so Yodkwan gave that ticket to her sister, Pluemjai who was going to work on that island and Tak gave that ticket to his brother, Tiw who was going to see his girlfriend on that island. Pluemjai and Tiw had to travel together as a couple in the honeymoon tour group, though they hate each other. They thought they would separate from this tour group to do their own business when they reached there. However, there was some reason that made them unable to separate and had to stay

name: The Magical Girl and the Evil Lieutenant Used to Be Archenemies
summary: The story centers on Mira, the clever brains behind an evil organization that invades and destroys everything in its path. One day, a magical girl named Byakuya Mimori decides to stand up to the organization, and Mira falls in love with her at first sight.

name: Catch 21
summary: Catch 21 hosted by Alfonso Ribeiro and Witney Carson. You might recognize the duo from Dancing with the Stars. Catch 21 is a Vegas style Game Show where three contestants are each given a card to start a blackjack hand from a standard 52-card deck and must answer trivia questions. Can they catch three blackjack 21s?

name: Last Call
summary: Fresh takes on business topics that explore the intersection of money, culture, and policy.

name: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!
summary: Meet the girls on the losing side of romance! First is Anna Yanami, the girl-next-door type who can't say no to delicious food. Then there's Lemon Yakishio, a beautiful and spirited athlete. Last but not least is Chika Komari, the cute yet shy heroine with gentle charm. Together, they navigate awkward setbacks hoping to finally find love!
previous_episode: Am I Actually Just Some Unseasoned Rando Who Drops In for the Last Episode with the Losing Heroine?

name: Koi wa Futago de Warikirenai
summary: Jun Shirosaki's love life takes a wild turn when he finds himself caught between the Jinguji twins—his childhood friends who are as different as night and day. Rumi, the older sister, pairs a boyish charm with a maiden's heart, while Naori combines girlish looks with her deep love for otaku culture. As feelings grow and confusion mounts, Jun must navigate this unexpected love triangle next door.

name: Delico's Nursery
summary: Hailing from a prestigious noble house, Dali Delico is an elite member of the Blood Pact Council, the highest governing body of the Vamps. Yet, Dali flatly refuses a mission the Vamps assign him. As Dali's motives and possible connection to mysterious murders begin to mount, council members Gerhard, Dino, and Henrique visit him in hopes he'll reconsider, but find him soothing an infant child!

name: VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream
summary: Yuki Tanaka is a VTuber at Live-On, one of Japan's largest VTuber companies, as the polite and ladylike Awayuki Kokorone. One day, she forgets to end the stream, and viewers see her real personality—irreverent, improper, and prone to imbibing after a long day. Yuki is surprised to find that her accident caused her rankings to multiply, so she doubles down and gets to work. She'll be a star yet!

name: Take Me Out Feet First
summary: Take Me Out Feet First is a documentary series profiling 25 extraordinary terminally ill people, in unimaginable circumstances, who have take control of how they will die.

name: Unidade Básica
summary: Inspired by real cases, the series takes place in a Basic Health Unit, and brings stories of overcoming and challenges faced by two physicians who have different views on the performance in the UBS.

name: Mr & Mrs Chinnathirai
summary: Your favourite celebrity couples put their relationship to test through a series of fun, challenging and hilarious tasks! Whom will you root for this season?...

name: Confessions of a Teenage Fraudster
summary: From a Glasgow call centre, 16-year-old Elliot Castro began scamming innocent people. But the luxury lifestyle it funded spiralled into darkness, danger - and eventually prison.

name: Scandinavia with Simon Reeve
summary: A new travelogue will see Simon journey to Scandinavia, travelling from the Arctic to the Baltic to uncover the secrets of this beautiful and extreme region. Nordic societies are known for their wealth and happiness, but the Russian invasion of Ukraine and the impact of mass immigration have put them under new pressure. As well as showcasing some of the most spectacular scenery on earth, Scandinavia with Simon Reeve will reveal a hidden side to what has become one of the most important frontiers of Europe.

name: Outrageous Homes
summary: From the unusual and unconventional to the eccentric and eclectic, Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen visits some of the UK's most outrageous homes and celebrates their proud-to-be-different owners and designers

name: The Nightbeast
summary: A young mother unsatisfied with her seemingly perfect suburban life begins an affair with the boogeyman in her son's closet — a surprisingly sexy man called the Nightbeast. But this harmless affair she thought to be a figment of her imagination begins to have unexpected consequences, as her two worlds increasingly begin to collide in this seductive, darkly comedic tale.

name: New Zealand's Best Homes with Phil Spencer
summary: Join property expert Phil Spencer (Location, Location, Location) as he takes viewers on a tour of some of Aotearoa's most stunning homes and gives a glimpse into the lifestyles they have to offer.

name: Happy Jävla Pride
summary: Dilan comes from a small Swedish town and goes up to Stockholm to experience his first Pride Week. He moves in with his cousin Ari. When Ari's best friend Nina becomes homeless, she also moves in with her cousins. The trio gets to experience a fast-paced week together.

name: Mina og meg med hele sirkuset
summary: Mina, Lilje and Alexander go on another expedition, and this time mum Kristin and Rose (9 months) join them. The trip starts from Maridalen to Finnmark.

name: Wonderoos
summary: Join animal pals Kiki, Dewey, Hazzy, Luly and Teshi as they learn how to make friends, try new foods and face other big firsts in colorful Roo City!

name: Le siècle des icônes
summary: The Century of Icons recounts, in three episodes, the 20th century through its greatest icons. From Charlie Chaplin to Charles de Gaulle, from Marlene Dietrich to Lady Diana, via Gandhi, JFK or even Nelson Mandela, director Bertrand Delais has selected characters who have left their mark on the most incredible century in the history of humanity, that of emancipation and individual freedom.

name: The Mystery House
summary: Bai Xiao Jun suddenly loses contact with his fiancée. His last clue is a building in the shape of a dilapidated tube, where the woman was last seen. Wanting to find her, Xiao Jun takes the risk and decides to move there. On his journey, he meets a woman named Suo La, who decides to help him with his mission. But after entering the building, they both discover that this place hides many secrets, that its inhabitants have a lot to hide, and that they are not happy at all with the appearance of the two snooping intruders. But what are they really hiding, and how does it connect to missing women?

name: My lovely wife, don't mess with me
Qing Qi Tai You Ren, Jin Yu Shou Fu Liao Feng Le
Ni Shi Wo De Xiao Huanxi
Re La Guntang Zhi Huali Bian Shen
La pasión turca
summary: Olivia, a Spanish Fine Arts professor with a brilliant professional career, wakes up from a coma in an Istanbul hospital after having attempted suicide. There she answers the questions of an inspector who investigates Olivia's collaboration in an art smuggling network with Yaman, her Turkish lover. The protagonist's story reconstructs in two stages the overwhelming passion that she experienced with Yaman and that made him abandon her life project in Spain. A story full of lights and shadows about which Olivia does not always tell the truth, which fuels the mystery that surrounds her stay in Tu

name: Le siècle des lumières
summary: From the 18th century onwards, many thinkers, scientists and philosophers, questioned the dogmas of the Church, the arrangement of nature and even absolute monarchy. The work on universal gravitation by Isaac Newton, or Diderot's Encyclopedia for example, have largely contributed to this evolution of thought. In doing so, they spread the spirit of the Enlightenment and laid the foundations of democracy and the modern State.

name: Blade's Dance with You
summary: Assassin Zhao Xiaoren from the Flash Sect was assigned to assassinate Junmo of Jasmine Manor. Disguising herself as a bride, she married Junmo, both concealing secrets. Through daily deceit, they developed feelings, only discovering Junmo was the exiled seventh prince. This revelation embroiled them in a murky struggle for succession, where love blossomed amid deadly confrontations. Together, they united to quell conspiracies.

name: Sea of No Return
summary: An imperial princess and a border prince, born on opposing sides of a century-old feud, enter a marriage of schemes and grudges that spirals into a doomed yet unforgettable love.

name: Ashes to Crown
summary: The general's daughter, Chu Zhao, refuses to accept her fate as nothing more than a pawn to be sacrificed in Xiao Xun's rise to power. Taking matters into her own hands, she fights her way out with the help of Xie Yanlai, protecting the emperor's grandson as he makes his way to the emperor's presence. Through a tense standoff in the imperial court, she helps the young prince secure the throne, cutting off Xiao Xun's path to power. But with a new emperor comes new crises. The realm is torn by internal strife and foreign threats. Working alongside Xie Yanlai, Chu Zhao navigates the treacherous c

name: Òlòtūré: The Journey
summary: Working undercover as a sex worker in Nigeria, a young journalist out to expose corruption fights for her life as she forges a path to Europe.

name: What a Wonderful World
summary: This is a healing journey of self-reconciliation. In the world of adults, the monotony of everyday life silently erodes the soul, between breaking down and recovering, wounds are stitched up and torn open repeatedly. Loneliness drifts through the bustling city, caught in the endless cycle of day and night, swallowed by a dense forest of steel and concrete, where neither light nor a sky of one's own can be found. Two souls, reflected in a rearview mirror, gradually shed their disguises and defenses, finding redemption and embracing each other in love. Reality and illusion intertwine, suspense a

name: Issues and Answers
summary: Issues and Answers was a weekly TV news program that was telecast by the American Broadcasting Company network from November 1960 to November 1981. The series was distributed to the ABC affiliate stations on Sunday afternoons for either live broadcast or video taped for later broadcast.

name: Bloomberg Wall Street Week
summary: David Westin speaks with influential personalities in finance about the week's biggest issues on Wall Street.

name: Love's Ambition
summary: Xu Yan, a popular broadcaster, and Shen Haoming, an urban elite, are an enviable couple. Yet, due to their different backgrounds, they struggle to fit into each other's social circles. Xu Yan, with her glamorous hosting career and a "polished" personal history, marries Shen Haoming, who is well aware of and in control of the situation. When conflicts arise, Xu Yan breaks free from Shen Haoming's control and leaves without looking back. Shen Haoming, however, realizes he has fallen deeply in love and is determined to win Xu Yan back. Through various trials, the two eventually shed their pretens

name: I sindet på en forbryder
summary: For years, Kevin Adrian Werner abused children and young people in the hooligan environment and became known as Denmark's biggest serial offender. Former investigator Sebastian Richelsen investigates how it could go so wrong.

name: Crush
summary: Fu Yunyue, the second-in-command of Long City's Chiyan Gang, disregarded her brother Fu Yunzheng's objection and disguised herself to get close to Shen family's young master, Shen Xize. While seeking revenge for her mother by assassinating the family head, Shen Wende, she discovered an even deeper secret.

name: Another Soul In Me
summary: An extroverted grandmother and her introverted granddaughter have been lived together for many years but have underlying tensions. After a soul-switching accident, they swap lives. The grandmother tackles the work issues for her granddaughter, while the granddaughter enjoys retirement. Through this journey, they find mutual understanding and healing, discovering the power of love and companionship.

name: Her Disguise
summary: A promising female doctor embarks on a journey of vengeance for her sister, infiltrating a wealthy family to confront the Lu brothers and risking her own future. Living a double life, she uses herself as bait and her heart as a pawn. A tale of strategic love between a cunning female doctor and a scheming young master is about to unfold.

name: Storage Wars: Barry's Best Buys
summary: It wasn't long after the 2010 "Storage Wars" premiere that series star Barry Weiss emerged as a fan favorite. The longtime antiques collector viewed buying the contents of abandoned storage lockers as a hobby, and an auction became the perfect place to display his omnipresent fun-loving, devil-may-care attitude. Whether he wore night vision goggles or employed psychics to help him decipher a locker's worth, Barry was always seeking outlandish ways to gain an edge on the competition. "Best Buys" compiles the most memorable purchases -- and antics -- of the treasure hunter during his four season

name: American Wreckers
summary: Follow the rivalry between the Belle Boys and the Outsiders, as they battle each week in the demolition derby arena in Belle, Missouri.

name: Uninterrupted's Top Class Tennis
summary: Uninterrupted's Top Class Tennis follows the hard work and sacrifice of four junior tennis players as they make their way to the Orange Bowl, a competition that could make or break their careers as tennis pros.

name: Christine's Garden
summary: Horticulturalist Christine Walkden opens the door on her charming garden.

name: Getting Lost with Erin French
summary: Chef Erin French heads out on a cross-country road trip to find new ingredients and inspiration for another season of cooking at The Lost Kitchen.

name: Catch 21
summary: Based on one of GSN.com's popular online casual games, Catch 21 is a fast-action series blending pop trivia with the tension-filled excitement of the classic card game, 21.

name: Suranne Jones: Investigating Witch Trials
summary: The actor investigates the most infamous witch trials in history and explores their legacy today.

name: Surreal Life: Villa of Secrets
summary: Eight unexpected, hand-selected stars are given a non-transferable golden ticket to a once-in-a-lifetime adventure that money can't buy. In the Surreal Life celebrities will embark on a Surreal Journey that pushes them to leave their personas aside and reveal their true nature in unexpected ways.

name: Construction Fails
summary: Construction Fails happen every day, but sometimes the damage is catastrophic. This factual, fast-paced show investigates the most spectacular mishaps, what went wrong, and how the disaster could have been averted. Combining live footage with CGI animation, this show examines well-known disasters, such as the Notre Dame fire, and the collapse of the Georgia Dome, but also more minor incidents. Presented in a light-hearted and accessible manner, Construction Fails shows what happens when things go drastically wrong.

name: Resurrected Rides
summary: A charming host works with skilled car experts to transform beat-up vehicles into outlandish rides that exceed their unsuspecting owners' wildest dreams.

name: Tomorrow's Pioneers
summary: Tomorrow's Pioneers (Arabic: رواد الغد Ruwād al-Ghad), also known as The Pioneers of Tomorrow, is a Palestinian children's television show that was broadcast by the Hamas-affiliated television station Al-Aqsa TV from April 13, 2007 to October 16, 2009, and featured young host Saraa Barhoum and her co-host Farfour, a large Mickey Mouse-like costumed character, performing skits (or "scenes") and discussing life in Palestine in a talk show fashion with call-ins from children (typically of age 9–13 with some as young as 3).

name: Battle of the Writers
summary: Writer Aob-On faces accusations of plagiarism from top online novelist Shan and his attempts to clear his name are thwarted when evidence vanishes and Shan refuses to engage. This deepens Aob-On's resentment towards Shan. However, they unexpectedly collaborate on a project.

name: My Glastonbury
summary: iPlayer and BBC TV bring you exclusive coverage of the world's most famous music festival.

name: Match Game
summary: Contestants try to match celebrity answers.

name: Щасливі за сім днів
summary: Do not miss the project of radical transformations - watch online Happy in seven days on the STB YouTube channel! In just one week, the heroes of the program will be able to face their fear, believe in their own strength and become happier. And professional experts of the program, Maryna Borzhemska, Nadiya Matveeva and Andriy Zhelvitro, will help them in this.

name: Yttersia
summary: Norwegian documentary series about life on Sommarøy and Brensholmen.

name: Happy Tree Friends: Ka-Pow!
summary: Happy Tree Friends that focus on ACTION and ADVENTURE!

name: Badanamu Cadets
summary: Follow Bada and his fellow cadets as they battle against the forces of darkness and keep the world of Badanamu safe. After a serious accident during a storm, the musician begins to experience some terrifying visions about his neighbors.

The series features touching and funny moments and depicts a father's struggle to save his children from addiction. And now both Adamyan's promotion and his personal life are under threat.

Stories investigated this season include a disappearance involving a young film director, two prosecutors killed in a small Texas town and a serial killer who must be stopped before the next victim is murdered.

This series gives Elizabeth Taylor the significance she richly deserves, in all her incarnations: as an actor, rebel, business mogul, and activist – to reveal how Taylor created the blueprint for modern celebrity. The ship's captain is due to retire soon and the head diver refuses to offer Daisuke any guidance. To add to his woes, his girlfriend doesn't seem to be too happy to see him, despite their maintaining a long-distance relationship via the phone. The manga adaptation consists of this TV series and four films. This is continuation on the movie with the same name released a year earlier, and is followed by more movies afterwards.

name: Super Shark Highway

Away from prying eyes, the Nazis also established a concentration camp, the only one on British soil, amid the idyllic scenery of woodlands and silver sand beaches. Watching on, the celebrity panel's job is simple; they must decide if each challenger will succeed - Yes or No. If they guess correctly, they'll be awarded points. The Celebrity with the most points at the end of the show will receive £5,000 for their chosen charity.

Now, alongside his editor and a mushroom researcher, Hotaru shares heartwarming and hilarious moments with his new capricious companion.

While they kept quiet out of fear, prudence or forgetting, their children, during the dictatorship, learned not to ask. Stealing her father's ring, which can protect her family, fails, and Nadia disappears. And now her husband Roman, a surgeon from the human world, has to raise three children himself. Years later, teenagers suddenly discover superpowers in themselves, which magicians, including Vera, a tough operative in the Magical Security Department, find out about. The life of the family ceases to be the same, because the grandchildren of the legendary magician have been seriously hunted.

In the 90s, his gang stole the cup of the Russian tsar of the Time of Troubles Vasily Shuisky from the museum of the city of Electrospas, where his fake was later "triumphantly returned". Bringing men to clean water, manipulating and seducing is their profession. Another order comes in: the oligarch's wife asks to find evidence of her husband Dmitry's infidelity, and in return promises to give half of his company after the divorce. The seduction mission is successful, but unexpectedly the woman forgives her husband and tells him everything. The oligarch is furious. His goal is to destroy the impudent avengers, because of whom he almost lost his fortune.

name: Нам кранты

Deciding to earn some extra money, the boys take the car of a police officer neighbor and go to an abandoned construction site to cut up and sell an old tower crane for scrap metal. But here's the problem: the crane falls on the car of the leader of a criminal group. And now what seemed like a profitable business becomes the beginning of a whole series of problems.

name: The Godfather of Fentanyl
summary: 'The Godfather of Fentanyl' tells the story of the first widespread fentanyl overdose epidemic in US history, featuring exclusive interviews with George Erik Marquardt. A self-taught savant, Marquardt teams up with the Boston mob to introduce fentanyl in the early 90's. His product quickly finds its way to cities all over the Northeast and results in a national priority investigation by the DEA. Told by Marquardt and law enforcement officials who chased him, this is a never-before-heard story.

name: Feebs
summary: Feebs is an ensemble character-driven comedy following two sisters who love and hate each other and are thrown together as agents for the FBI. With their sibling rivalry on display in front of their teammates, the two must use their lifelong contention to fight for justice and not just with each other.

name: The Long Chase
summary: Tom Corby and his son John are bird watching, by the cliffs, when he spots a number of strangers. John goes to help a girl cut off from land. When he returns his dad has vanished.

name: Last Lands

name: Murder in the Village: Who Killed the Doctor's Wife?
summary: An award-winning team of documentary makers revisit one of Britain's most baffling cold cases - the murder forty years ago of Diane Jones, the 35 year old wife of the doctor serving the picturesque Essex town of Coggeshall.

name: Весна моего сердца
summary: Olga Lemesheva, a sweet, kind girl, lives in a small apartment with her mother. The family runs a small business, a cozy café. But the profits from the business are mere pennies, and the family is constantly short of money. Recently, her mother has become increasingly alcoholic, and her daughter's health has deteriorated significantly. The problem is that Olga has a congenital heart defect. Her condition is currently dire, and doctors offer no guarantee. She needs a donor heart transplant, but she has neither a donor nor the money for the operation.

name: Tiny Toot
summary: Tiny Toot is about 3 years old. She lives with her cat Gato, her brother, and her mum and dad ... and then there's Pixie, her magic making the elf who lives in a mouse hole in the wall. Every morning Pixie invites Tiny Toot and Gato on a new adventure. They eagerly join him in his nut-chopper and together they make friends with everyone they meet and learn new things about daily day life.

This is a unique opportunity to see these world class performers together in one room and captured as live for Sky Arts.

name: Kabát FC

Each with children of their own, they not only face outside challenges in their career but also have to handle family members with very different personalities. They return to the city after ten years of separation. Liu Bi Yun's stepdaughter Jiang Mei and grandma are the instigators of many conflicts within the family but Liu Bi Yun never takes it to heart as she tries to be a good mother and a good influence.

name: Gizli Bahçe
summary: Nazlı is a young, poor, single mother living with her son, Memo. When Demir Akçınar, Memo's wealthy uncle, finds out about his nephew after his brother's death, he is determined to take Memo under his care. However, once he learns about Nazlı's profession, Demir refuses to let someone like her raise his nephew and begins a fierce custody battle. Nazlı, however, is not the woman Demir thinks she is. As Nazlı and Demir fight for Memo's future, long-buried secrets, family schemes, and shadows from the past complicate the struggle even further.

name: Grab Your Love
summary: It tells the story of Min Jiangxi, who aspires to become "the Number One Female tutor in Shencheng", and Qin Zhan, known as "the Villain in Shencheng". The two start off being wary of each other, but gradually develop deep affection and mutual understanding. In the end, they join forces as powerful partners to eliminate the great villains in the business world. While growing together and healing each other, they stage a passionate love affair in the upper-class world.

name: Sisters in Arms
summary: It tells the story of the "Hummer Commandos" from the Binjiang City SWAT team as they fight crime and protect the people. The "Hummer Commandos" are elite police officers with modern law enforcement skills and a strong sense of duty. They are compassionate and committed. Whether in the community, on the streets, during arrests, or on the front lines, their heroic and tireless efforts are everywhere. They are the embodiment of the "visible sense of security" that people can rely on.

name: Profilerka

The investigation is led by commissioner Karol Nadzieja, transferred from the capital to Augustów. When the crime at the forester's lodge is finally solved and everyone breathes a sigh of relief, new victims appear. No one yet suspects that in this previously quiet neighborhood, where life was "like God's home," a sophisticated and cunning serial killer has just begun his "hunt." Fear falls on the city and its surroundings.

name: Wichita Town
summary: The exploits of Mike Dunbar, the marshal, and his attempts to maintain law and order in the growing town of Wichita, Kansas during the 1870's.

name: Pobail na Páirce
summary: Pobail na Páirce , a four-part series for TG4, tells the stories of Ireland's most iconic and revered provincial GAA grounds. While Bela Lugosi filmed by day, a separate cast and crew arrived at night to shoot the same movie in Spanish, using the same sets, costumes, and a translated script. Working from dusk till dawn, they defied the odds and created a superior version to the original.

We learn about her attempts to find true love, which man or woman she was involved with, how she tried to bribe Circe to break the curse, if only for 24 hours, and everything she did to undo the spell.

summary: A series of conversations between Jorge Ramos and some of the most recognized Spanish-speaking celebrities. Fascinating characters share their most intimate and personal side; their successes and sorrows, their fears and desires, and their best kept secrets.

Each nominee will interact with undecided Hispanic voters and answer their questions. The special "Latinos Ask ... Donald Trump Responds" will air on Tuesday, October 8 at 10 p.m. ET from Miami, Fla. "Latinos Ask ... Kamala Harris Responds" will air Thursday, Oct. 10 at 10 p.m. ET from Las Vegas, Nev. Both events will be broadcast coast-to-coast with Spanish translation.

Minori, who has vowed to take revenge on Yudai, who has another family, and on his lover, Riko Miyake, plots her revenge using Riko's son, Wataru.

Rigo is an optimist by conviction, a comedian and a talker by nature, and that is the spirit of the story based on him and his three great loves: the father who takes violence away from him; Michelle, the woman he has longed for since he was a child; and the bicycle that accompanies him to sell lottery tickets in his town and then takes him to the top of the world.

To protect his daughter, Jang Tae Su struggles to reveal the truth.
