summary: In this comedy-drama series, we are introduced to Braon Poitín. A curious but talented man, struggling to make his own way in the world, decides to bring his poitín business to the international market - whichever way he can. Braon believes he will be able to save the world with this miracle liquid and pushes the patience of his family and community to the end of their tether as he embarks on his questionable business through dubious marketing ideas.

name: Anti-Fraud
summary: Reckless thrill-seeker Qin Lang has only one dream, become a narcotics officer, yet on graduation he's dumped into the Anti-Fraud Center. To transfer out faster, he's forced to partner with the icy, razor-sharp Gao Man, and the two become instant frenemies. Case by case, their crackdowns shatter fraud rings, and Qin starts to feel the pull of this new battlefield, until the day he discovers that the fraud syndicate's kingpin is inextricably linked to the drug lord he's sworn to take down.

name: The Fevengers
summary: After a kidnapping, jewelry heiress Wen Ruojun discovers that her husband, Gu Yancheng, not only cheated with her best friend but that their entire marriage was a carefully crafted scheme to seize her wealth. Awakening to the truth, Wen Ruojun finds Lin Jiayi, another of his victims, and the two women join forces with others to launch their revenge against Gu Yancheng!

name: ShenDu Fox Detective
summary: A series of gruesome murders targeting young women sends Luoyang City into panic. Hu Zhengyi, a Dali Temple, is tasked with uncovering the truth. Meanwhile, rogue swordsman Li Jianxing deliberately approaches Hu to investigate his own family's massacre. From "Phoenix Murders" to "Puppet Brides," the duo navigates surreal cases, transforming from mutual suspicion to life-and-death allies in their pursuit of justice.

name: I Am Not Your Enemy
summary: Mi Youchu, a general's daughter, marries the heir Su Buxiao out of love, but suffer from betrayal and the destruction of her family. Reborn with revenge in her heart, she hones her skills to take down Su Buxiao—unaware that his body now hosts a game player trying to win her love. What begins as a deadly chase turns into a reluctant partnership when a mysterious figure threatens her family again. Forced to work together, they share laughs, survive danger, and slowly fall for each other, uncovering the truth—and love—along the way.

name: Agarwood Like a Dream
summary: To clear her late mother's name, the genius perfumer Ying Hemeng marries into her enemy's house, and becomes the concubine of the heir, Ye Buhuan. The two of them, each with their own agenda, have several confrontations and gradually develop feelings in the midst of their probing and scheming. Together, amidst a mixture of love and hatred, they unravel the truth of the past together.

name: Call Me Ted
summary: The life and legacy of Ted Turner is told in his own words in this six-part documentary series.

name: Love Island VIP
summary: A group of adventurous VIP singles experience a summer full of exciting encounters and tingling flirts in a luxurious villa. Presenter Sylvie Meis leads the first VIP version of the successful dating show.

name: The Empress of Ayodhaya
summary: Jinda, daughter of the lord of Lopburi, and excellent in appearance and intellect, was born to the highest of destinies. It is her great duty to seize the throne from Phra Chairacha, the warrior king of Ayodhaya, and return it to her own Lavo dynasty line. Jinda must therefore offer herself as one of four royal concubines, inevitably separating her from her lover Wamon. Her journey has her face the other three royal concubines of foreign origin, Jittrawadi, La-ongkham, and Tanyong, each vying for the position of queen consort.

name: 13 Клиническая. Начало
summary: USSR, 1970s. The world's first mystical hospital opens its doors to the demonically possessed. Doctor Yana heads the clinic to return her son, who was kidnapped by otherworldly forces.

name: It's in the Game: Madden NFL
summary: It's in the Game: Madden NFL reveals the never-been-told story of Madden NFL, from its archaic 8-bit origins to its success as an annual must have—against all odds. For the first time ever, EA SPORTS is opening their vault of rare and never-been-seen footage, while also allowing cameras to follow along as the team finishes the next generation of the game. What started as an unlikely pairing between a computer whiz and a football legend, ignited a revolution and triggered a seismic collision between the worlds of jocks and geeks. They should have failed. Instead, their game changed the game—and

summary: Adventures of the greatest heroes, facing the problems you probably didn't even know they had... and maybe would rather not know.

name: PwC All Stars Awards

name: US Presidential Election Special
summary: Live results coverage of the US presidential election, presented by Miriam O'Callaghan in Washington and David McCullagh in Dublin.

summary: Investigating the lives and characters of the US presidential and vice presidential candidates as they seek office. In an historic election, those who know the candidates best reveal key moments that shape how they would lead America.

name: The Groomsmen
summary: The Groomsmen follows Danny, Jackson, and Pete as they stand by each other through the biggest days of their lives. The narrative explores their complex relationships with friends, love interests, and family members, all while celebrating the bond of their enduring friendship. The Groomsmen trilogy offers a unique perspective on these significant life events, making it a must-watch for fans.

name: Beyond: UFOs and the Unknown
summary: Following revelations of a secret government program studying UFOs, many experts have stopped asking whether UFOs are real and have started wondering: "what are they?" The answer could change everything we thought we knew about human consciousness.

name: Cinema Therapy
summary: Do movies help you to heal? To grow? To connect? Licensed therapist Jonathan Decker and professional filmmaker Alan Seawright draw from their experiences on the job to explore the psychology of your favorite films! Your "Internet Dads" combine humor, heart, and vulnerability to share healthy relationship skills, mental health awareness, and movie-making magic.

But the three heroes find a secret passage that leads to the forest, and discover that the Majesties have a secret base there! What are they looking for? And who is this strange creature in the forest?

summary: Despite initial misunderstandings and reservations from their families, Wichai and Anong find comfort in each other's company. Anong is a high-society lady whom many men compete for, given her status, it's important that her family finds her a good match. Passionate lawyer Wichai finds himself randomly tasked with screening potential husbands for her. His duty is to eliminate unsuitable candidates and pave the way for his younger brother. Although the concept rests on the cooking arrangement, it is a program that is at least as much about Taylor as the viewers getting to know the celebrities in a new way.

name: Cromañón: La noche del incendio
summary: The drama series follows a group of teenage friends whose lives are impacted by the real-life fire that erupted at the República Cromañón club in Buenos Aires in 2004. The story is told from the perspective of Malena, a 19-year-old aspiring musician. On the night of the fire, Malena attends her favorite rock band's concert with her friends, unaware she will lose many of her loved ones at that event. Four years later, she returns to her childhood neighborhood to reconcile with her past and overcome the guilt she feels about surviving the tragic fire.

name: Bureau Maastricht
summary: Ewout spent six months working with the police in the Limburg capital. The presenter once again follows six couples who provide emergency services, day and night. Various cases are discussed, from a runaway dog to domestic violence and from exciting chases in collaboration with the Belgian police, to people with suicidal thoughts and confused people walking around with dangerous weapons.

Blackmailing Masha by breaking up, Vadim draws her into crime - they kidnap Varya in the hope of a ransom from the rich Lida. Varya's younger brother, Nikita, works in the local department of the Investigative Committee. His boss, Pyotr Kravtsov, entrusts him with a delicate matter - to find Yulia Filippova, the runaway fiancée of the son of a famous businessman. Nikita goes looking for Yulia and disappears. Varya rushes to find him. Using the laws of dramaturgy, she manages not only to find her brother, but also to solve the murder of the fiancée.

One day, Anna gets a call from her ex-mother-in-law: her son suddenly left without explaining anything. And she is sure that her apartment is being watched. She is afraid to go out even for groceries...

summary: Life in the small provincial town of Vesterløv goes well for Charlotte and her family, but when 19-year-old Liam from the local wrestling team is found dead, and Charlotte's husband, the town's wrestling coach, Lars, is arrested for the murder, everything changes for Charlotte and their already shaky marriage is put to the test.

name: Found & Lost
summary: In the early years of the Republic of China, Su Manli, a stand-in dancer at the XianYuess Club, crosses paths with Chen Bi, a noblewoman whose family has been tragically wiped out, while searching for her father's killer. Borrowing Chen Bi's identity, Su Manli approaches Yang Ziqin, a council member of the Haitang Society, to uncover the truth behind the Chen family massacre. Upon learning Yang Ziqin's true identity, the three join forces to confront the mastermind behind it all.

name: Wen Chu Na Lai Qing Ruxu
Parole Examiner Lee

Lee Han Shin is determined to prevent inmates who show little remorse for their crimes from obtaining paroles through money, connections, or deceitful tactics.

name: Итоги с Малькевичем
summary: Everything that happened in Russia and in the world will be told in the final weekly analytical program by the famous Russian journalist Alexander Malkevich.

name: Desde la Raíz
summary: Desde la Raíz is a captivating four-part series that dives deep into the essence of Mexican culture by exploring four iconic products. From the ancient origins of corn to the fiery allure of chili, from the aromatic richness of coffee to the mystique of mezcal, this series celebrates the flavors, aromas, and stories that shape Mexico's cultural identity. Each episode offers an immersive journey through the rich history, cherished traditions, and bright future of these quintessential elements.

Each of them has accumulated many complaints over the years of their family life, which, having reached a critical mass, threaten to destroy the once happy marriage. Across four episodes, watch as bakers return to craft tasty replicas of ice skates, wreaths, nutcrackers and more in this holiday spin on the mind-bending baking competition. Bakers will baffle the celebrity judges with their festive and delicious deceptions and fight their way to the ultimate grand prize.

On the last and sixth day, a winner will be chosen, and it is based on stars that the celebrities themselves have awarded.

Soon unexplainable phenomena begins to happen, so the Director sets out to document them and compile them into the most authentic horror film ever.

summary: Five couples will live together for 24 hours, be social detectives and try to guess who is together, without being revealed themselves. Be prepared for a day full of strategy, lies and memorable participants.

Blunt and always complaining, Dr. Makino is a scary school physician who glares at everyone, be it the teachers or the children. Between the events of funerals and weddings, these four characters confront past wounds and misunderstandings, redefining love and life in the process.

Flash forward a few years later and Aqua and Ruby are high school students determined to make it on their own in the cutthroat world of entertainment for personal reasons. The ending of this drama is told in "Oshi no Ko: The Final Act" (2024) theatrical movie.

summary: The cold-hearted Tang Weiwei falls in love with intern Li Shu under a misunderstanding and a series of unfortunate events. Just as Tang Weiwei is basking in happiness, she learns that Li Shu is the younger brother of her deceased first love, and his appearance was part of a plan for revenge. After clearing up the misunderstanding, the two choose to break up. Years later, they meet again on the street...

The stakes are high for six real estate professionals who handle multi-million-dollar properties in some of India's most exclusive neighbourhoods. Juggling market fluctuations, intense negotiations and high-pressure deadlines, can these realtors bag the next big deal?

summary: Follow Made in Chelsea OGs Binky Felstead, Lucy Watson and Rosie Fortescue in a reality spin-off, as they navigate new challenges and major milestones, from starting families to building businesses.

Used, abused, and eventually abandoned by his fellow adventurers, Ein decides it just isn't worth going on... Lucky for Ein, though, the end may just be the beginning...and a new lease on life. Turns out, his "worthless" job may just be the key to becoming a hero after all...

name: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
summary: "I've come to eat you." So softly utters the mermaid Shiori as she emerges from the sea and takes high school girl Hinako by the hand. Hinako lives alone in a town by the sea and possesses an unusually delicious body that is irresistible to nearby monsters. To ensure that she matures to the best condition, Shiori seeks to protect Hinako—all so that someday, she can devour every piece of her. What will become of Hinako's feelings as this looming unjust death closes in on her...?

summary: Any proper noble lady must cultivate refined tastes, and Lady Melphiera's delicacy of choice is…monsters! Unfortunately, society frowns upon such unladylike cravings and brands her the "Voracious Villainess." At a banquet, she's attacked by a monster, only to be saved by the feared "Blood-Mad Duke." He's brutal, mysterious, and charming. Could he be the one to appreciate her monstrous appetite?

Meanwhile, his childhood friend Rena quickly rises to S Rank. Their cherished dream is to meet live and perform on the stage of a big rock festival in Moscow. But in order for it to come true, they will have to face the misunderstanding of their parents, the betrayal of loved ones, rethink life values and overcome inner fears. Especially their soloist, Vasilisa, a Moscow schoolgirl, who dreams of a musical career, but has suffered from a pathological fear of public speaking since childhood - peyraphobia.

Presented by John Creedon and Aoibhinn Ní Shúilleabháin, Fleadh Cheoil captures the fun, excitement and good music from one of the biggest and longest running free music festivals in the world.

Together, they embark on a journey of revenge, domestic intrigue, and business warfare, rising from humble beginnings in a modest courtyard to the pinnacle of success in a department store. Hand in hand, they overcome countless obstacles, battling enemies and fate alike.

When they realise they're being targeted by a powerful organisation known as the Bodkin, they must join forces to protect themselves and those they love. With the guidance of their enigmatic teacher, Madame, the teens embark on a thrilling journey as they learn to control their powers and believe in themselves.

summary: John Green will explore the history and culture of religions and how they offer frameworks for making sense of our lives, while being incredibly slippery things to pin down. We'll discover how we define, debate, and contest what religion means, whether we're personally religious or not.

name: Mechanical Marie
summary: Former martial arts legend Marie has accepted a new job as a "mechanical maid"… except she's 100% human, and Arthur, her new boss, despises humans. Luckily, Marie's naturally expressionless face helps her keep up the robot act while secretly protecting Arthur from constant assassination attempts. But when Arthur falls in love with his "perfect" maid, things quickly spiral out of control!

name: Crime Scene Investigators
summary: Crime Scene Investigators offers a fresh take on the true-crime docudrama, weaving forensic evidence into a single visual frame—a puzzle detectives must piece together to catch the killer. From blood spatter and shell casings to bio-markers and digital fingerprints, every fragment adds to the intricate array of evidence that ultimately exposes a murderer at large.

name: The Briefing with Jen Psaki
summary: Based in Washington, D.C., The Briefing with Jen Psaki will pull from Psaki's decades-long experiences on campaign buses, in the Oval Office, at the State Department, and in the briefing room to dissect the most important stories of the day. Every day the show will aim to help viewers better understand the happenings in Washington and around the country, how it impacts their communities, and what leaders are doing to stand up for the people they represent.

name: The Age of Innocence
summary: Based on Wharton's novel of forbidden love in 19th-century New York, The Age of Innocence follows a passionate and heartrending will they, won't they love triangle while exploring themes of freedom, duty, identity, and love in all its forms. The new take promises to be true to Wharton's novel but will speak to a new generation as it traverses the ballrooms and bedrooms of its young characters, asking what is love — and what is lust. And should we ultimately be driven by our heads, or by our hearts?

name: All Rise for Julian Clary
summary: All Rise for Julian Clary as he holds court, presiding over the grievances of the public and acting as judge and jury.

name: Unaccustomed Earth
summary: Inspired by the internationally beloved bestseller of the same name, Unaccustomed Earth is an epic, soapy drama about a tight-knit immigrant community navigating love, desire, and belonging. When a star-crossed romance between a devoted wife and her long-lost love comes to light, a scandalous affair is born and new battle lines are drawn in the elite, insular Indian American community of Cambridge, Massachusetts. Rich with passion and unforgettable characters, Unaccustomed Earth is an intimate, nuanced look inside a tight-knit community.

name: Sneaky Links: Dating After Dark
summary: Six sexy singles check into a motel in pursuit of true love, only to discover their longtime booty calls, or "sneaky links," are there as well. Facing desires old and new, and many hard truths, guests must decide whether to strengthen their sneaky link or explore new connections. Will they stay sneaky, or is love worth "checking out"?

name: Murderous Encounter
summary: The story centers around two journalists who meet at the scene of a brutal serial murder case in Tokyo. The man is a famous freelance writer for a weekly magazine, while the woman is a director for a television information program. As they pursue the same case, the two become attracted to each other, but suspicions about the man begin to emerge one after another.

name: Generationer
summary: A mummified infant's body is discovered during a renovation in a Frederiksberg apartment. Martha, an 87-year-old resident, unexpectedly confesses to the crime, triggering a journey into family secrets long buried. Crime and mystery intertwines as the complex tale of a family across multiple generations is unfolded. Told through the lens of a crime plot infused with subtle mysterious elements, exploring themes of guilt, shame, and transformation.

name: Shark: The Storm
summary: The story of Cha Woo Sol, a victim of school violence for three years, who stabbed the perpetrator in the eye, becoming a criminal from a bullying victim and a world mixed martial arts champion.

name: May All Your Wishes Come True
The Long Way Home
summary: Through a raid on a human trafficking ring, Detective Gu Xinhe and Forensic Artist Qi Chu join Zhao Shi's anti-trafficking task force. As they untangle a web of cold cases, the team zeroes in on the notorious "Auntie Gui" syndicate. Qi Chu goes undercover at great personal risk, leading to the takedown of the long-operating criminal network and exposing Auntie Gui's horrifying scheme of "using trafficking to fund more trafficking.

name: The Corner of the World is Dinner
summary: Three female roommates with entirely different careers, personalities, and schedules share a home. Despite their differences, they share one ritual. No matter what conflicts or problems they face in life, love, or work, they always come together as night falls to cook and share a proper meal. For them, the day's troubles always seem to resolve themselves after dinner.

name: A Promise to You
summary: The demon princess Zhao Yue, who had originally only set revenge as her goal, found herself entangled in an unexpected scandal on her wedding day. The river god Ruo Xiao crashed the ceremony, bringing along a child. Before anyone could react, Zhao Yue's fiancé, the demon lord, flew into a rage over being "cuckolded," unleashing a thunderstorm and throwing knives at his bride. Zhao Yue was utterly baffled, unable to understand why the ancient god would barge into her wedding with a child, and she firmly denied any connection to either Ruo Xiao or the child. However, wary of the complications in

name: 90 Day: Hunt for Love
summary: Step into a world where sparks fly and hearts race as everyone is introduced at a masquerade ball to connect, flirt, and find romance. But it's not just about finding someone new—some of these singles have a history! Will old flames reignite? As jealousy bubbles up faster than the hot tub jets during a hot-tub-speed-dating session, tensions rise, and feelings get messy. From flirty first impressions to late-night confessions, expect shocking hook-ups and unexpected pairings. The journey transforms into a thrilling adventure in chemistry and connection, filled with romantic curveballs and twist
previous_episode: The Boy Who Left His Mark

name: Off the Grid with Colin and Manu
summary: MKR favourites Manu Feildel and Colin Fassnidge are going Off The Grid on a road trip around Aotearoa to discover local places, local faces, and local produce - with a generous dose of banter for good measure!

name: Deep Look
summary: Deep Look explores the unseen at the very edge of our visible world. Get a new perspective on our place in the universe and meet extraordinary new friends. Explore big scientific mysteries by going incredibly small.

name: Hunt for Love: Between the Sheets
summary: This unfiltered, one-hour after-show dives deeper into each week's episodes. Cast members from this season will provide behind-the-scenes commentary and personal reflections on their heated romances in Tulum. Through never-before-seen footage, viewers will get an exclusive insider look at what really went down, both on and off camera, in paradise.
previous_episode: The Boy Who Left His Mark

name: Battle of the Irish Dancers
summary: Hot on the heels of the Irish Dancing World Championships in Dublin this month, Sky is today announcing a brand-new series charting the drama and devotion of Ireland's most loved artform. New Sky Original, Battle of the Irish Dancers , coming later this year, follows a cast of dedicated dancers and their teachers on the road to the Championships, spotlighting a dance form which requires the strength, endurance and agility of an Olympian.

name: Yukon Rescue
summary: From Whitehorse to the remote towns at the edge of the Arctic, the Yukon is one of the most challenging places on Earth to live... let alone be a first responder. But someone has to do the job. Yukon Rescue is a heart-pounding doc series about the Yukoners who answer the call to keep people safe in the rugged Canadian North. Featuring breaking cases from wildfire to search and rescue, animal services to highways, these front line workers go toe-to-toe with Mother Nature - battling lethal temperatures, vast distances, scarce supplies, and an unforgiving landscape to get the job done.

name: De la cabeza
summary: An absurdist comedy show. Oiginal for its time, it represented a renewal of comedy on Argentine television.

name: The Innes Book of Records
summary: No facts, no figures, no records broken. In this new musical diversion, the sounds of today echo back nostalgically from a loophole in time. The programme features the words, music and performance of Neil Innes with special contributions from guest stars.

name: Detectives These Days Are Crazy!
summary: Once a legendary detective, Nagumo Keiichiro now stumbles through middle age baffled by smartphones and modern life. His quiet decline gets disrupted when Mashiro, a bold high school girl, bursts into his office demanding to become his apprentice. Though he's rusty and set in his ways, her relentless enthusiasm drags him back into detective work. Now the gap-bridging detective duo is on the case!
previous_episode: Nagumo Dons the Haori / Producing Nagumo Detective Agency / Nagumo Detective Agency Shuts Down

name: Loving the Lie
summary: Genius traditional Chinese painter Xin Yi returns to her picturesque hometown with a hidden agenda. She carefully lays out a plan to become the hired artist of renowned collector Guan Shanhai. But her true motive is to uncover the truth behind a horrific incident from over a decade ago - her father was lured into a counterfeit art factory and died tragically, while her younger sister Nong was brutally abused and left mentally shattered. Using herself as bait, Xin Yi is determined to expose the mastermind behind the tragedy. At a critical moment, Guan Shanhai's son, Guan Huai, unexpectedly offe

name: Yuezhou Phantom Tales
summary: In the first year of the Zaichu era, Tang Dynasty, a bizarre suicide resembling a ghost-summoning ritual shocks Yuezhou's West District. Investigating the case, Si Wen, the young magistrate of Yue Prefecture, discovers the victim is none other than Liu Zhaodi, a once-renowned courtesan he once loved deeply. But as the seventh day of her death arrives, abandoned infants rise as vengeful mountain spirits, unraveling a meticulously planned retribution...

name: The Art Assignment
summary: The Art Assignment is an educational video series hosted by curator Sarah Urist Green. We explore art and art history through the lens of things happening today.
previous_episode: Make a Book with Meat (or other atypical materials) ft. Ben Denzer

name: Two Cents
summary: Two Cents is an educational show about personal finance.
previous_episode: Are You Ready for a Recession?

name: Mickey
summary: The Gradys, a Midwestern family, inherit a bayfront California hotel. Mickey Rooney stars as Mickey Grady, a lifelong landlocked Nebraskan who sees the Pacific Ocean for the first time when he and his family drive out to look over the bay-front hotel he inherited. Sammee Tong plays the hotel manager who was included in the inheritance. Emmaline Henry plays Mickey's wife; real-life son Tim Rooney and Brian Nash, the sons.

name: Origin of Everything
summary: Every aspect of our daily reality, whether its the words we use, the pop culture we love, the technology that get us through the day, or even the identities we give ourselves, emerge from thousands of intersecting histories. And on this show, we're going to explore them ALL! . . . Okay, maybe not ALL, but you get the idea.

name: Dead and Buried
summary: What is our society's relationship to death? Many are disconnected from its reality and afraid to even think of it or discuss it. How did we get here, and are there different ways to connect to this part of life that we all must face for ourselves and our loved ones? How do we reclaim death from the industries and processes that have distanced us from it?

name: Why Am I Like This?
summary: Being a human can be weird. Even when everything is "normal" (whatever that means), you might not always get what your body is doing…or why. Dr. Tina Lasisi, full-time biological anthropologist and part-time human, is here to help you make sense of how and why our bodies do what they do.
previous_episode: Why Does My Voice Sound Like This?

name: BrainCraft
summary: Vanessa Hill talks about psychology, neuroscience, and why we act the way we do. Neuroscience has never been so animated.

name: Roots of Resistance
summary: Have you ever looked around and wondered how society transformed into what it is today? Felecia For the Win is here to shed some light on it all. On Roots of Resistance we'll take a deep dive into various social movements, and into the individuals who helped create them, that have shaped how we exist today.
previous_episode: The Disturbing History of America's Highways

name: Climbing in Heels
summary: A fictional tale following the rise of five ambitious secretaries navigating the glitzy world of 1980s Hollywood while offering a glimpse into the boys-will-be-boys club and the women who wanted a seat at a table where they were expected to serve. It's a juicy story of friendship, betrayal, survival and ambition. It's also a cautionary tale about how some of those women became very much like the monsters they worked for.

name: Кредит доверия
summary: After the tragic death of her parents, Mila inherits a huge debt. A chance to save herself is a dance competition with a million-dollar prize. But there is little time to prepare: collectors demand immediate payment. Will Mila manage to win and avoid the debt hole?

name: Yabusaka de wa Gozaimasen
summary: The protagonist, Fushigi Mai, who works at the silent cafe "Morning Glory," and her colleague at the cafe, Kamishita Ryo, a younger man who has a close relationship with people, one day enter into a relationship where they "observe" each other. While working together, Mai becomes interested in Ryo, but it's not easy because she has a trauma from her first love and is in a complicated relationship... Meanwhile, Ryo is also interested in Mai, and behind his cool appearance, his feelings for Mai overflow... Will the two be able to open the door to each other's hearts?

name: Under His Command
summary: John Campbell has spent months investigating Destiny Church, encountering fear from insiders like he's never seen before—what is Brian Tamaki doing, and why does it terrify them?

name: La Gata
summary: Esmeralda, whom everybody calls "The Stray Cat", grew up in a suburban slum under miserable conditions; ever since she was a little girl she has lived with Doña Rita, who exploits her by sending her out on the streets to beg or sell candies in order to "earn her food and bed". As a child, she became friends with Pablo, a wealthy child who cares for her and tries to help her behind his mother´s back, Lorenza, who looks down on "The Stray Cat" due to her social prejudices which make her reject poor, uneducated people. Esmeralda has turned into a beautiful woman over time and although she is stil

name: Fugitivos
summary: Julian is an engineer who overnight destroys his life, his marriage, and his work, as he is blamed for a murder he did not commit. After being sentenced to 26 years in prison, he decides to run away to find the only witness who knows the real culprit.

name: Solo per passione - Letizia Battaglia fotografa
summary: In the bigoted and retrograde Palermo of the immediate post-war period, Letizia is a curious and rebellious girl who at sixteen decides to get married hoping to have more freedom but instead finds herself trapped in a marriage strictly disciplined by patriarchal rules. Following a nervous breakdown, she will be admitted to a Swiss clinic and undergo psychiatric treatment. Back in Palermo, with her marriage in full crisis and in a state of perennial emotional fragility, Letizia decides to face her malaise with psychoanalysis, continuing to feel trapped in a reality that she cannot accept.

name: Hotellet
summary: 11 celebrity couples are each given a suitcase. One contains half a million, another sends you home. Welcome to Hotellet !

name: Oljefondet - på innsiden
summary: Nicolai Tangen and his team's job is to make our savings grow. How do they work to succeed in that?

name: Любовь – не шоу-бизнес
summary: This is the story of Zhenya, a young woman who, having come to Moscow from the provinces and begun working with Russian stars, becomes familiar with the customs and traditions of show business. Despite all her adventures, she remains true to herself, and that's precisely why she achieves recognition and finds love.

name: Drømmen om Alaska
summary: Sisters Ylva-li and Ronja grew up in the dog farm and train dog sleds together. The goal is to become the first Norwegian juniors to participate in the Iditarod.

name: Ключі від правди
summary: "Keys to the Truth" is a gripping detective series where every secret hides a deep personal drama. Valeria, a seasoned investigator, is forced to leave the service after the tragic death of her brother, who was wrongly accused of a crime. Losing faith in the system, she launches her own investigation, which leads her to a luxurious hotel hiding dark intrigues, lies, and crimes behind its elegant walls. The path to truth proves to be more dangerous than she ever expected. She's not just searching for the culprit — she's fighting for the truth that could change everything.

name: It's Lit!
summary: It's Lit! is a series of smart, funny video essays about our favorite books and why we love to read. Hosted by Lindsay Ellis and Princess Weekes, the series delves into topics like the evolution of YA, how science fiction mirrors our own anxieties, and why the book is sometimes just a _bit_ better than the movie.
previous_episode: Toni Morrison's Opus About Confronting a Terrible Past

name: Insectarium
summary: Entomologist and museum curator Jessica Ware will introduce us to insects that upend our expectations and a diverse group of scientists who are passionate about the six-legged critters all around us. Forget about pandas–we're here to make you fall in love with mandibles! The series is produced for PBS by the American Museum of Natural History.
previous_episode: How Mantises Became Nature's Strangest Assassins

name: Infinite Series
summary: Mathematician Kelsey Houston-Edwards offers ambitious content for viewers that are eager to attain a greater understanding of the world around them. Math is pervasive - a robust yet precise language - and with each episode you'll begin to see the math that underpins everything in this puzzling, yet fascinating, universe.

name: Код кохання
summary: Investigator Veronika Levchenko is forced to cooperate with the talented cybercriminal Andriy Miroshnyk in order to save her younger brother. Veronika and Andrii fall in love with each other, but realize that they cannot be together. Can their love overcome the boundaries of duty and danger?

name: Sovereign Innovations
summary: Discover how Indigenous innovation and technology allows Indigenous communities to survive and thrive now and across the centuries. Our host, Cheyenne Bearfoot, will explore various native and Indigenous identities across the globe in order to unravel stereotypes that have diminished innovations made by Indigenous peoples.
previous_episode: How Indigenous Knowledge Connects to Science

name: The Crusaders
summary: Discovering the real stories of the medieval knights who dedicated their entire lives to God, the Crusaders, to delve deeper into the history behind the popular image of heroic, chivalrous knights.

name: Wild Crusades
summary: Sri Lanka is one of the most bio-diverse places on the planet but it's also home to one of the world's fastest-growing human populations. Animals and humans come into increasing contact and the results can be catastrophic. In this three part series we meet the scientists and researchers who are dedicating their lives to ensuring that Sri Lanka's most extraordinary wildlife – elephants, monkeys and sloth bears – can share this tiny island with people in peace.

name: Serving Up Science
summary: Serving Up Science is hosted by history buff, science writer and foodie Sheril Kirshenbaum, who will give you science-backed tips to make your favorite foods even better. Farmed or Wild? Why does cheese stink? Why should meat rest? Explore these questions and more.
previous_episode: Why Cast Iron Skillets Last Forever (And How to Use Them Right!)

name: Liao Zhai
summary: In the bustling streets and among the common folk, strange and eerie phenomena arise. Humans, demons, deities, and spirits all understand the ways of the world, while flowers, trees, birds, and beasts are all imbued with a certain spirit. Humans have a touch of the demonic, and demons possess a human heart. This revival of classic Eastern supernatural tales, with a volume of "Liao Zhai," discerns the good and evil between yin and yang, and paints a vivid picture of the myriad aspects of life.

name: Tycoons - Die Macht der Milliardäre
summary: The series shows the richest people in the world who have great influence in their countries: In China and Russia they live dangerously, in the USA they are changing the modern world with innovations.

name: The Sixty Million Dollar Conman
summary: Hamish McLaren scammed friends, lovers and acquaintances out of over $60 million. This is the shocking story of Australia's most successful con artist. Part of True Crime on Channel 4.

name: Welt der Ritter
summary: A fierce warrior-class emerges in medieval Europe around 1000 years ago: the knights. They live brutal lives, glorified by tales of chivalry and courtly love that have left us with a skewed idea of knighthood. In reality, it's a world of freezing castles and violent battles, where joust competitions, fair maidens and the crusades are the latest fads. Manners and gallantry are everything and their abuse can end in deadly duels. This elegant and exciting 3-part series evokes the time of the knights in a unique and intimate rollercoaster ride of individual lives set in the wider context of mediev

name: Secrets of the Royal Traditions
summary: Revealing how the monarchy uses traditions to maintain a place in our nation's identity.

name: Bob Vila's Home Again
summary: Building contractor and all-around handyman Bob Vila visits the sites of various home and commercial building construction and restorations, and gives viewers tips on the best way to finish such projects.

name: Снежный папа
summary: An ordinary hairdresser Irina, having separated from her husband, is raising her daughter Masha alone. Unexpectedly, fate gives Irina a gift: meeting a successful businessman Oleg Tsarev. Trying to please him, Irina comes up with a new successful life for herself, in which she is the owner of an elite beauty salon, and her daughter is a student at a private school. Irina and Oleg's relationship is moving towards the registry office, but suddenly her husband Kolya, whom she has not officially divorced, appears on the threshold of Irina's apartment. Kolya is determined to get his family and Irin

name: A Celebration of Sean O'Casey
summary: A series dedicated to the centenary of Irish writer Sean O'Casey consisting of a documentary on his life followed by three dramatisations of his plays.

name: La Promesa
summary: Lured by promises of a better life, three young women are sold into prostitution and must risk their lives and their families to escape.

name: La Bruja
summary: This is the story of two characters, a witch and a known mafia boss, who strongly influence Colombia's political destiny at the end of the 1970s, changing the entire future of the country.

name: Çift Kişilik Oda
summary: Having lost her parents at a young age, Nilüfer's dream is to work at the Lutesya Hotel, which her parents built. Kaan, one of the heirs of the hotel, returns to the hotel, which has been ruled by his step-sister Sevil for years, to take revenge. Nothing will ever be the same for Nilüfer and Kaan, whose paths cross here.

name: Lian Dan Wo Bu Hui, Zuo Cai Suan Bu Suan
The Channel Islands At War
summary: Written, produced and presented by John Nettles, this 3 part documentary coinciding with the 70th anniversary of the German invasion and occupation of the Channel Islands, the only part of the UK conquered by the Germans in the Second World War.

name: When The Hawthorn Blooms
summary: In the early 1970s, Jing Qiu, a girl from a "politically problematic" family, is sent to the countryside for re-education. While documenting village history in Xicunping, she meets the talented and handsome Lao San. Their budding affection faces harsh trials: class stigma, family opposition, and the rigid social hierarchy. Can their promise to reunite under the hawthorn tree ever bloom true?

name: De glemte piger
summary: In 1979, four-year-old Heidi disappears without a trace in Kolding. Heidi has never been found and police are still at large in the case. The year before, 13-year-old Line was abducted in Lyngby. Police find her killed after three weeks. Both the abduction of Heidi and the murder of Line are unsolved, but the cases must never be forgotten. In both cases, we are pursuing the search to find important witnesses who can bring new information about both cases. We have gained access to the Travel Team's confidential journal of Heidi's case, and former Travel Team Manager Hans Jørgen Bonnichsen and s

name: Franklin
summary: A counterfeit artist, also a single father, is forced to work with his ex-lover to craft the perfect $100 bill — all to save his dying daughter.

name: The Killer Within
summary: Delve into what turns someone into a killer. Whether it was premeditated or spontaneous, a revenge plot or the killer simply snapped, experts uncover the true story behind each killer from the very beginning.

name: The ChuckleHounds
summary: The Chuckle Brothers dressed as giant hounds get into all sorts of adventures and scrapes in this programme aimed at pre-school children.

name: Тюремный дневник
summary: Russian student Maria Butina unwittingly gets caught in a dangerous political game during her U.S. studies. Arrested, she faces isolation, pressure and interrogation, forcing her to choose between self-interest and loyalty to her homeland.

name: Stillwater
summary: Stillwater follows ex-convict Daniel West, who receives a mysterious letter promising answers about his past and a substantial inheritance in the small town of Stillwater. There he discovers a community where nothing ever ages, no one dies and nobody ever gets out.

name: Встать на ноги
summary: A former prisoner named Stary returns to his hometown after 20 years in prison and finds out that he has a daughter, Olya, with limited mobility. In addition, the Old One still has one important unfinished business from 20 years ago. His former accomplice Rakhimov is at large, for whom the Old One just sat down, taking all the blame on himself. Meanwhile, Rakhimov rose decently with the help of the looted money and completely forgot about the existence of his former friend. The district police officer prescribes that the Old man, who is under the supervision of the authorities, must live toget

name: Речная сказка
summary: Cosmetologist Alina Svetlova comes to a sanatorium outside the city to recover from a prolonged bout of bronchitis. And immediately finds herself a suspect in the murder of her ex, Dmitry. Trying to hide the evidence, she crosses paths with former detective Mikhail. Alina must solve the murder case and decide whether to trust Mikhail. He helps her, but he seems to have his own interests…

name: Mission to the Moon
summary: A person dies twice in life. The first is when their body perishes, and the second is when they fade from the memory of others.

name: Suspicious Partner
summary: Tateishi Haruto, a skilled prosecutor, is mistaken for a molester by Miyashita Sakura on the bus and has a terrible experience. After that, he happens to encounter Sakura, who is fighting after her boyfriend cheated on her, and ends up helping her without thinking... This leads to Haruto having to join Sakura in her drowning binge, and she pushes him down when he's completely drunk! A few days later, Haruto is reunited with Sakura, who has come to take her prosecutor training. Haruto is strict with Sakura, but for some reason he can't leave her alone.

name: Virgins
summary: Virgins a wild, warm, and wonderfully awkward ride with four adults who have yet to experience sexual intercourse, as they navigate love, intimacy, and self-discovery in their 30s and 40s.After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.

name: Kill Lover
summary: Youyou was born into a wealthy and loving family, but at the age of ten, tragedy struck—her mother fell to her death, and her father was imprisoned. Ten years later, Youyou discovered that it was An Guoxuan who had orchestrated it all. In a moment of rage, she sought revenge but failed, and accidentally blinded An Guoxuan's son, Qi Dong. In retaliation, Qi Dong heartlessly threw her into the sea. Miraculously, Youyou was rescued by Madam Yu from the Yuan Bi Orphanage and sent abroad. Qi Dong, as An Guoxuan's illegitimate child, was never truly favored. After losing his sight, he was completely

name: Relative Secrets
summary: Relative Secrets investigate an everyday American family's darkest mystery, aiming both to solve the mystery and explore how it shapes that family today. Colorful characters, rich cultural context and dramatic twists and turns abound in every tale, each of which connects the American family to their UK heritage. Along the way, we'll meet charismatic heroes and terrifying villains, ranging from a 99-year-old World War II veteran who worries his absence led to the murder of his grandmother, to the daughter of a serial killer desperate to carve out her own identity from her father's sordid past t

name: Murder Has Two Faces
summary: In the shadow of a highly publicized tragedy, an eerily similar crime is overlooked. GMA's Robin Roberts shines new light on the victims largely ignored.

name: Call Her Alex
summary: What does it take to become the most influential female podcaster of a generation? Following Alex Cooper as she prepares for her first tour, this compelling two-part documentary series traces Cooper's evolution—from a self-conscious kid growing up in Pennsylvania to the voice behind "Call Her Daddy," a podcast that redefined the conversation for women everywhere. The series offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at the life-defining events that shaped Cooper's journey as she grew from a 24-year-old woman with a sex and dating podcast to the CEO of a media empire in just six years. More tha

name: Cheat: Unfinished Business
summary: Sun, scandal and second chances collide in this reality show in which former cheaters reconnect with their exes. With Amanda Holden and Paul C. Brunson.

name: Round and Round
summary: High-concept relationship sitcom with each episode charting a different key year in the life of Maureen Stevens, over a 14-year time span.

name: BLK: An Origin Story
summary: BLK: An Origin Story acts as an immersive and informative chapter of Black Canadian history, elevating remarkable Black Canadians previously unacknowledged in mainstream social, academic, and cultural circles, normalizing their unique stories as a matter of general record.

name: Dun Huang, antigua fortaleza de la frontera
summary: This series reveals how the Chinese fortress city of Dun Huang moved from an oasis in the desert to a vital commercial bastion.

name: Mad Unicorn
summary: Santi has struggled to survive since childhood. Now, he risks everything to take his startup business to the big leagues. Inspired by true events.

name: Natalie Cassidy: Caring Together
summary: Best known for playing Sonia Fowler on EastEnders, Natalie Cassidy will be taking on a new role – but off-screen, fulfilling her genuine ambition of a lifetime to train as a carer. She will study, work and care alongside the next generation of young carers. Natalie will be enrolling at one of the UK's top Health & Social Care colleges where she'll train, study, and work alongside real professionals - facing the realities, the heartbreak, and the joy of caring. Together, her and her fellow students will push open the door to the UK's healthcare providers and put the spotlight on something we al

name: Earnhardt
summary: Earnhardt will dive into the rich history of Dale Earnhardt, one of the sport's most influential figures to ever compete at NASCAR's highest level. Through rare archival footage, thrilling races and emotional interviews from his children, colleagues and closest friends, the docuseries will depict Dale Earnhardt's rise to NASCAR stardom and nationwide fame. Earnhardt's navigation of family dynamics — including that of his son, Dale Earnhardt. Jr. — will also be explored.

name: Perdiendo el juicio
summary: Prestigious lawyer Amanda suffers a severe OCD breakdown during a high-stakes trial.

name: The Way Out

name: Our Guy in Vietnam

name: Matt Baker's British Isles

In addition, competition, love affairs and intrigues arise among colleagues. Medical disputes are the order of the day for the doctors at the Stadtklinik, and social controversies are also reflected here, for example in questions of euthanasia.

How did the Soviet criminal investigation department fight crime after the war, during the thaw, during the period of "developed socialism" and during the years of "stagnation"?

She falls into a coma. At the hospital, Sergey is given her things. In her purse is someone else's phone. Accidentally turning it on, Sergey sees an intimate video. Who was his wife posing for? Rage, confusion, jealousy, and guilt, because Sergey himself is not without sin—he's having an affair with a girl from a tattoo parlor. What went wrong in their marriage? Why did this perfect marriage end in disaster?

name: Rapport

In an attempt to understand, he takes his daughter back to the year 2000, where a life-changing childhood love changed his life forever.

name: Kiwi & Cat: Mānawatia a Matariki

From the lowlands to the peaks, this lush world remains elusive, with creatures avoiding human presence. Patience and careful investigation are the keys to uncovering the secrets of nature in this majestic, compact group of mountains: the Pyrenees.

name: Modern Kadın

summary: Prince, a superstar in the entertainment industry, proudly comes out as LGBTQ and finds great success in her career. But everything changes when he suddenly wakes up in a past life—as Khun Worradej, a young man forced to hide his true identity in a time when same-sex love is forbidden. Prince must navigate palace intrigue, political betrayal, and uncover the mystery behind Worradej's past and his secret lover. On the journey, he encounters King Chaiyachet, a young monarch facing an assassination plot, and Mom Kosol, the king's older brother who holds a hidden truth tied to Worradej's heart. Pr

name: Let's Go Karaoke!
summary: The president of the chorus club, Satomi Oka, is approached by a yakuza named Kyoji Narita. Kyoji's yakuza group holds a customary karaoke competition, and whoever earns the title of worst singer must get a tattoo. Since he was asked to be Kyoji's singing teacher, Satomi has no choice but to go along with these practice sessions. Brought together by karaoke, where will Satomi and Kyoji end up?

name: Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter
summary: After failing the royal court sorcerer exam, Allen finds himself stuck with no job, no money, and no way home. Just as all hope seems lost, he's offered an unexpected position: private tutor to the daughter of one of the kingdom's most influential nobles, Duke Howard. His student, Tina, is a prodigy in every academic field, except magic. With the Royal Academy's entrance exams looming and magical ability a strict requirement, Allen must uncover the mystery behind Tina's magical block. Using his unorthodox teaching methods and a deep understanding of sorcery, Allen may be her last chance… but i

name: Ruri Rocks
summary: High schooler Ruri Tanigawa loves shiny things. She loves them so much that she heads into the mountains to search for crystals herself—where she unexpectedly meets Nagi Arato, a graduate student studying mineralogy. As the pair start collecting minerals together, Ruri begins developing a genuine appreciation for science and the beauty of the natural world.

Though the two girls attend separate high schools, they meet up at a shopping center's food court almost every day. Take a little peek at the laid-back afternoons Wada and Yamamoto share as they reflect on the ups and downs of high school life together.
previous_episode: Randy / Gorilla Tape / Toxic Fan / See You Tomorrow at the Food Court

summary: Seven years after humanity was devastated by a major disaster, a beacon of science and prosperity rises in Kamitsubaki City. But lurking in its shadows are Tesseractor monsters born from human darkness. Only the Witchling, five girls with Song of Purification, stand against them. With every note, they fight, not just to protect the peace of the city, but to heal a broken world.

name: Roasted: Verdens Sjoveste Ferie

During the daytime, they soak up the sun and enjoy the pool, but in the evening, things heat up as the guests, one after another, must take their place in the hot seat and get roasted by their friends. The last of them is the host, only to decide then who has become the best roaster of the season.

name: Roast On the Coast - Norge
summary: Six Norwegian comedians have packed their bags and traveled to Cyprus for a week of sun, swimming - and roasting! Each night, a new comedian will take the hot seat to have their life torn apart by the other comedians before the best roaster of the night is crowned. On the final day of the stay, the week's best roaster and the winner of Roast on the Coast -Norway will be announced.

name: 50 оттенков брака
summary: A comedy series about saving family relationships. The lives of Andrei and Kristina Konovalov have long been mired in the mundane, losing their vibrant colors, and the family hearth has completely extinguished. At the suggestion of friends, the couple turns to sex coach Boris and enrols in the course 'Sexual Resurrection'. During the training, Andrei and Kristina immerse themselves in experiments that seem strange, amusing, and some even frightening, pushing them out of their comfort zone. During the 'resurrection' process, the couple realises that their intimate life is just a small part of t

summary: Top End Bub revisits Lauren, a dynamic Indigenous lawyer ticking off life goals in Adelaide. She's married to Ned, a handsome husband who makes fresh croissants. What else could a person need? After Lauren's eight-year-old niece is orphaned, the show follows the couple reluctantly abandoning their big-city goals and moving to the Top End (where the outback meets the tropics) to raise the child. While Lauren and Ned juggle the responsibility of becoming unexpected parents and try to keep their marriage together, Lauren must come to terms with her responsibilities within her culture as she trans

name: ClaireBell

That was until Claire, a mysterious female inmate with a rumored brutal murder charge, appeared to help her. And from that moment on, ... the encounter between these two souls began to fill this dark and desolate place with a small glimmer of light - one that gradually grew into love.

name: Future Fantastic
summary: A series of documentaries looking at the connection between science fiction and science fact.

name: Naturen vender tilbake - rewilding
summary: For a long time, many species have been so scarce that they are hardly ever seen. Humanity has wiped out over fifty percent of all mammals, birds and fish in as many years. Across Europe, efforts to restore the balance of ecosystems damaged by the human footprint are now seeing returns of many wild animals close to extinction. But not everyone is happy with their return.

name: Das NRW-Duell
summary: Game show with Bernd Stelter, in which celebrities from North Rhine-Westphalia are tested on their knowledge of their own federal state.

name: Kill Lupercal
summary: Kill Lupercal is the first animated series set in the Horus Heresy on Warhammer TV. It takes place in the dying days of the Siege of Terra – the most brutal and iconic battle in all of Warhammer.

name: Dating Game
summary: Hill, a former bullied boy with a geeky personality, finds love and confidence from "Yuka" in the female character romance simulation game "Yuka! Love Me Please" and grows into a handsome programmer beyond recognition. Hill achieves his dream of getting a job at the company that developed "Yuka! Love Me Please", where he meets Junji, the perfect, cold-hearted CEO from Japan. Soon after getting the job, the company announces that it will be ending service for the game, leaving Hill dejected. Seeing his passion to move forward despite his heartache, Junji approaches Hill with a proposition.

name: Три сигмы

If you don't remember, we're envious that this is the first time you'll hear science journalist Ivan Shunin and N+1 editor—in-chief Alexander Dubov discuss science fiction in every sense with a specially invited guest and find out how science fiction is scientific.

summary: DC Metal Force is a miniseries about Justice League. A mysterious entity has brought the powers of good and evil together to participate in the ultimate super-powered showdown!

name: Batman Exordium
summary: After his parents are murdered, young Bruce Wayne vows to find their killer, but his quest leads him into conflict with Gotham City. Alfred Pennyworth tries to protect Bruce from criminals, corrupt police, social climbers, relatives.

name: A Journey to Glow
summary: In a war-torn world divided by rival states, rumors of a hidden royal treasure in the southern town of Yongxing draw together five unlikely strangers: a thief, a disgraced official, a loyal general, a tomb-guarding lady, and a struggling heir. As they search for the treasure to revive the local economy, they discover healing, purpose, and the true value of human connection.

name: Piao Yang Guo Hai Lai Song Ni
Big Backyard Quiz
summary: A series of games and quiz rounds explore the people and history of Australia, exactly the way people weren't taught in school.

name: Living Black
summary: Australia's premier Indigenous current affairs program, Living Black provides timely, intelligent and comprehensive coverage of the issues affecting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians.
previous_episode: Nornie Bero: Torres Strait On A Plate

name: Eternal Joy With You
summary: In her past life, Xu Wanning was betrayed by her husband. The child she raised was his mistress's, while her own son died tragically. Now reborn, she's determined to protect her son and take revenge. Amid her mission, she repeatedly crosses paths with Pei Heng, who is investigating the "Red Zhen" perfume. Soon, she realizes their connection began long before this life.

name: Heavenly Secrets Bureau
summary: The son of a convicted astronomer from the Imperial Observatory follows the clues left in his father's secret notes. Teaming up with the Ninth Princess, a skilled healer, they unravel a series of bizarre cases involving witchcraft, divine lightning, and earth-shattering sorcery. But as they peel back the layers of mystery, all signs point to a prophecy in the mysterious tome —the prophecy that says, "Two Fish Doom the Nation."

name: Sweet Secrets
summary: Lu Huayan, the star performer of the Paramount, comes to seek revenge for her sister. She encounters Li Motong from another world called "Wujian." In his quest to find a treasure that can make "Wujian" eternal, he must kill the mortal songstress Lu Huayan. Unexpectedly, he discovers she is his lover from a past life. Thus begins a tale of intertwined love and hatred, where passion and vengeance collide.

name: Starlit Bloom
summary: Gu Liusu, the founder of a jewelry brand, is decisive and efficient at work, and just as strict and meticulous in her personal life. Yet, one unexpected night, she ends up in a mix-up after a one-night stand with "Young Master" Lu Xingchen, a man she had only met once before. To make matters worse, Lu Xingchen soon joins her company as her personal assistant. Neither of these bickering rivals could have imagined that, with time, their relationship would undergo a profound change. Lu Xingchen develops an unspoken affection for the sharp-tongued yet soft-hearted Gu Liusu, while his design talent

name: Returned Master
summary: On Chinese New Year's Eve, the entire household of the retired General Li is brutally slaughtered by a mysterious assailant. The youngest son, Li Jianwei, survives by a stroke of luck. Assuming a new identity, he infiltrates Ghost Valley, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed his family. The valley's young heir, Chen Xiaoxi, is mischievous and unpredictable, yet gradually grows close to Li Jianwei, who tries every trick in the book to win his trust. Just when everything appears to be going according to plan, Li Jianwei begins to uncover disturbing secrets lurking behind the massac

name: The Crush
summary: Modern CEO Lin Yuhao suddenly finds his consciousness transported into the tea merchant game he developed, now inhabiting the body of Wei Xiaotang, a new bride of the Li family. The only way back to his world is to complete the game's mission and win the title of "World's Best Tea." Thus, Wei Xiaotang joins forces with her husband Li Zixuan, embarking on a journey filled with witty schemes and steadfast kindness to claim the ultimate prize.

name: Vengeance of the Mountain God
summary: Jin Shisan, adopted son of the famed ginseng hunter Jin Buhuan, masters the art of harvesting the prized root. When his entire clan is slaughtered during a mountain expedition, he alone escapes, only to be captured and forced into a life of brutal servitude as a "blood slave." After enduring years of torment, he breaks free. Now, he returns to the Mount Guan Dong, setting a deadly trap to hunt down those who destroyed his family...

name: Her Feast
summary: After being framed and tortured to death, Zhang Wange miraculously wakes up three years in the past. Armed with memories of her past life, she gets close to police captain Lu Ye, whose prophetic dreams offer eerie guidance, to uncover the truth. As the mist of illusions clears, Lu Ye surrenders to the devastating truth. When a bullet pierces two hearts in a dream, one remains trapped in the past while the other leaps toward the future...

name: The Crime Unit of Tang Dynasty
Lust and Lies
summary: By a fateful coincidence, the waif Ruan Feifei enters the Huo family in place of a famed courtesan, assuming the identity of the wealthy heiress Huo Qingwan. For revenge, she navigates between rival factions, while becoming entangled in a love-hate relationship with the domineering marshal Huo Xiu, amidst the bitter feuds of the wealthy.

name: Half-awake
summary: Known for his ruthless demeanor, business tycoon Gu Yixiao has only one forbidden weakness—his secretary, Ye Xingwan. Due to a misunderstanding 15 years ago, he set up schemes to control and torment her. No longer willing to endure, the seemingly gentle Ye Xingwan turns the tables, using herself as bait to engage Gu Yixiao in a love-hate entanglement. In the end, she witnesses Gu Yixiao's repentance and the dawn of redemption, but whether her heart can truly find peace and happiness remains uncertain.

name: Böhmi brutzelt
summary: Based loosely on Biolek's "Alfredissimo", Jan Böhmermann invites one celebrity guest each to his studio to cook, eat and chat together. Each guest chooses their own dish and Böhmermann adds a second one.

name: A Farmer's Fortune
summary: After a sudden fall, food blogger He Qingqing finds herself transported to a pastoral ancient world. She embarks on an inspiring journey—paying off debts through entrepreneurship, finding true love by a marriage and raising an adorable child—as she forges her own path to success. Along the way, she builds a thriving career and develops a deep, mutual affection with Fu Qinghuai. Just as her life seems complete with professional fulfillment, love, and family, she faces an impossible choice: to stay or return to her own time.

name: Beyond Immortals
summary: Ancient myths descend upon the world. High above, the ruined celestial court hangs suspended in the sky, where gods shuffle forward like the walking dead, numb, hollow, and lifeless. As humanity receives the "blessing" of these immortals and stands on the brink of assimilation, a defiant few always rise. They stand their ground and hold fast to the truth of who they are.

name: alfredissimo! Kochen mit Bio
summary: Cooking program with Alfred Biolek, who invites a celebrity guest to each show, talks to them and cooks.

name: The Empress Dowager On A Second Spring
summary: After a traumatic birth leaves her in a coma, Jiang Rong wakes up as the Empress Dowager, with a newborn son. Amidst the scandal of a widow giving birth, she must conceal a deadly secret: the father's identity. To survive and uncover the truth, she navigates a dangerous game with three potential fathers, sparking a mix of romance, comedy, and unexpected revelations.

name: Dragon King's Decree

Meanwhile, Crown Prince Chu Moshang of the Dragon Clan is destined to marry the Holy Maiden in order to unite forces against the demon race. name: Die Hausmeisterin

As a janitor she wears smock aprons and likes to wear blue when she goes out. She has the typical perm, and a beer doesn't leave her cold either. Martha Haslbeck has never left her Munich neighborhood of Haidhausen. But she is a heroine in her apartment building. She simply copes with everything. Whether it's a clogged toilet, an escaped cat or her flatmates' tarnished married life - Martha has a solution for everything.

summary: Happy Endings with Bruno , an all-new original series starring RuPaul's Drag Race Pit Crew member and long-time masseur Bruno Alcantara. Special guests lay down on his table for a full body massage interwoven with intimate and emotional conversations which answer the question: "What does my Happy Ending look like?" Combining the soothing elements of massage ASMR with thoughtful and often vulnerable interviews, Happy Endings with Bruno offers viewers a rare glimpse into the personal journeys of its guests.

name: Long Planned Love
summary: When spoiled heiress Jian Cheng discovers her fiancé's betrayal, she breaks off the engagement in fury and enter a flash marriage with his younger uncle, Zhou Tingyan. What begins as a contract marriage born of a "life-saving debt" slowly transforms into a journey of redemption and true love, set against tangled family ties and ruthless business rivalries. Under Zhou Tingyan's protection, Jian Cheng uncovers the truth behind her high school kidnapping and grows from a reckless, headstrong girl into a composed and independent woman. For Zhou Tingyan, however, this marriage was never just about

name: Lock Her
summary: On the massacre night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Qin Shiyue, the sole survivor of Qin family, is taken in by Marshal Dai Shiyao. To uncover the truth behind her father's wrongful accusation, she navigates a dangerous game between two brothers—Sheng, who shifts from ruthless possession to deep love, and Dai Shiyao, whose suspicion turns to passion. As war reignites, the trio defies fate: Sheng abandons violence for love, Dai Shiyao sacrifices love for duty, and Qin Shiyue finally finds both truth and rebirth amidst the bloodshed.

name: The Mission Is To Return The Pearls
summary: During the Eastern Han, Hepu's Southern Pearls were valuable, and a gambling culture around them flourished. Li Ling, known as the "Pearl Prince," is ruined by a Magistrate who rigs one of these pearl gambles. Forced to become a pawn in manipulating pearl prices, Li Ling meets a tragic end as the scapegoat. After death, he is reborn moments before his downfall, awakening the supernatural ability to see through and sense oysters. Armed with the memories of his past life, Li Ling gambles without fail, embarking on a path of revenge and a legendary quest to return the pearls as decreed by fate.

name: Dr Ann's Secret Lives
summary: From dense rainforests to remote coastal regions, each episode offers a rare and intimate look at one animal. On the Great Barrier Reef, QLD, Dr Ann comes face-to face with a heavily pregnant bull shark, and in the Pilbara, WA, she goes fishing for deadly, mysterious sea snakes. In the steamy heart of Borneo's jungle Dr Ann looks for wild orangutans; and in the Dampier Archipelago, WA, she meets three species of turtle. In Moreton Bay, QLD, Dr Ann helps catch a dugong for an onboard health check, and along the edge of the Kinabatangan River in Borneo, she hunts for one of the weirdest mammals

name: The Time of Rebirth
summary: Trapped in a time loop for 100,000 years, Lin Yue relived the same day endlessly, until an accidental act of saving the young saintess of the Forgetful Immortal Sect finally shattered the cycle. Now free, Lin Yue embarks on an adventure across the Hongmeng Continent, armed with eons of accumulated wisdom. But the foes he could never defeat in 100,000 years are also stirring in the shadows of this world...

name: 3000 Whys of Blue Cat
summary: The protagonist of the show is Blue Cat, a curious and optimistic cat who is always eager to explore different parts of the world. His friends include a smart and cunning fox named Feifei, a naughty and adventurous mouse named Taoqi and many other animals. As Blue Cat and his friends go on an adventure and encounter problems, the series provides answers to science-related questions posed by Blue Cat.

name: Nela mała reporterka
summary: Follow the inspiring travels of Nela, a young adventurer who explores diverse locations around the globe, sharing her discoveries and experiences in engaging and educational reports for young viewers.

name: The Best People with Nicolle Wallace
summary: Who are The Best People? They're the most magnetic and engaging people in the room; the ones who know how to get that extra something out of every collaboration, connection, and endeavor. These are people who are the best at what they do and know how to bring out the best in others. Now, in an era of social and political upheaval, The Best People share lessons that we can all use. Listen as Nicolle Wallace seeks varied perspectives on how to keep reaching for truth, decency, and connection.

name: Okami no Heya
summary: The spin-off on Watashitachi wa Douka Shiteiru . The story will shed some light on the inner workings of Kyoko, the Landlady of Kougetsuan, and mother to Tsubaki, as she tries to take down Nao. Kyoko is a woman of the high society and the worst kind of enemy one could ever wish upon their foes. She has spent her life raising her only son, Tsubaki, to be the successor of Kougetsuan. We learn more about her dark schemes as we enter The Landlady's Room. It may even be possible to make sense of the disturbing hymns she sings and unravel the mystery behind the murder of the Landlord 15 years ago.

name: First Copy
summary: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.

name: Till Tonight
summary: Till Reiners invites you to his first late-night show, which combines political satire and modern stand-up comedy.

name: falsch, aber anders lustig
summary: Laugh until the tears come: In this unique comedy show, it's not who's right that counts, but who has the best sense of humor. Two teams of two comedians compete in a witty battle for the most absurd answers to crazy questions. The comedy highlight is hosted by Moritz Neumeier - known for his biting humor and spot-on punchlines. "Wrong, but funny in a different way" guarantees entertainment at the highest level.

name: Comedy Clash
summary: The Comedy Clash describes itself as "Germany's toughest stand-up competition in the world". The series shows the performances of hopeful comedy talents and follows their progress. Only the best make it to the annual final. In 2024, SWR will turn the "Comedy Clash" into an interactive live stand-up comedy event on the Twitch streaming platform. Viewers will be able to vote for their favorite comedians in seven monthly livestreams. The Twitch livestream is hosted by sports reporter and soccer commentator Robby Hunke. He is alternately supported by the streaming stars Starlet Nova, Donnie O'Sull

name: A Caverna Encantada
summary: The plot tells the story of Anna, daughter of Paulo, a missionary doctor. The two live together in the north of Minas Gerais. Paulo receives a call to a dangerous mission and, unfortunately, Anna will not be able to accompany him. The father leaves his daughter at a boarding school in the interior of São Paulo, where the girl will live with very different children. Paulo promises to return on his daughter's birthday, but mysteriously, he doesn't return.

name: Colosseum: Rise and Fall
summary: New discoveries and cutting-edge research reveal the history of Rome's Colosseum and its intricate relationship with the empire that created it. Combining the latest archaeological evidence from the Colosseum itself, with clues from ancient sites in Europe and North Africa, we explore the building's extraordinary archaeological and cultural history, and its role in Rome's rise and fall.

name: Merci professeur !
summary: A chronicle of the French language, its curiosities, current events and accents.

name: Destination francophonie
summary: A journey to francophone countries around the world! In each country, we meet francophones who tell us about their culture, their way of life and what concerns them in French. The program also highlights projects that contribute to the survival of French, a living, dynamic and constantly evolving language, at the local level.

name: Aligned Reverence
summary: Orphaned girl Su Jinyuan trusted the wrong person and fled her marriage, only to bring disaster upon herself. When she returned, she was horrified to find the entire Xiao family, her benefactors wiped out. To atone for her sins, her fate becomes entwined with Xie Yunyan, the Xiao family's adopted son who had taken his brother's place at the wedding. Together, they struggle to survive in desperate circumstances, break free from the shackles of the world, tear their enemies apart, and carve out a blazing, blood-stained love that defies destiny itself.

name: Dragon Flyz
summary: In a future decimated by war, only a small band of humans survive. The radiation from the war has created many new species, including huge, semi-intelligent dragons and evil mutants. The only source of power is the volcanic stone amber, but locating it is a constant problem, with the mutants and other species laying claim to their finds. Without the amber, their floating city cannot stay afloat. Protecting the city is an elite group using the dragons as transport, the Dragon Flyz.

name: Aşk ve Gurur
summary: The Köksoylars live in an ancestral mansion as a wealthy and rooted family. With three daughters, the family is sinking and on the verge of losing everything. In a state of great panic, they contemplate how to escape the impending disaster when Tolga enters their lives like a savior. He is the heir to a wealthy and established family. If one of the daughters marries him, life will continue as it used to, affluent and secure. The idea is considered for the eldest daughter, Mercan, to marry him. However, Mercan rebels against this imposition, finding Tolga excessively arrogant and frivolous. Des

name: Mary Kills People
