previous_episode: There are definitely patients who need euthanasia.

name: Tian Yu
summary: A millennium ago, the Five Monarchs guarded the land of the Xia Dynasty with magical artifacts. Later, the leader of the Dragon Clan, Zu Long, assisted humanity by establishing the Yun Chui Empire. The Empire faces the Tranquil Ocean where the Xi and Black Water Clans have defended it throughout a peaceful millennium. Now, the waves are surging from below and chaos will rise once again.

name: S Line
summary: Suddenly red lines appear above people's head. These red lines connect people who have had sex relations. Due to this, embarrassing or secret sides of people are revealed. People call these red lines "S Line." Han Ji-Wook (Lee Soo-Hyuk) is a detective with an attractive appearance and free spirit. He chases after the truth of the S Line. Kyu-Jin (Lee Da-Hee) is a high school teacher with unique charm. Hyun-Hob (Arin) is a high school student. She has been able to see the red lines since she was born.

name: Veliaht
summary: Due to his worsening health, Zülfikar Karslı begins to lose his former influence at the bus terminal. Meanwhile, all eyes are on his son Zafer, who is rumored to be returning soon from abroad. At the same time, Timur, a roaming repairman struggling under the weight of debts left by his father, crosses paths with this secret-laden family. Unknowingly, he steps into a fate he never imagined—as the successor to Zülfikar: Zafer Karslı. From that moment on, nothing will ever be the same for Zülfikar's children: Kudret, Derya, Cennet, Zafer, and Zafer's wife Reyhan.

name: Bears' Lair
summary: Bears' Lair is an exciting new series that offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to aspiring Indigenous entrepreneurs. Follow their journeys as they pitch their best ideas to four business experts and face off in a collaborative competition!

name: Luc le milliardaire?
summary: Starting from nothing, raised in a public housing project by a mother on social assistance, Luc Poirier built an empire valued at nearly 1 billion dollars from a few bags of candy. An extraordinary life story... Imagine this rapid social ascent seen through the eyes of the person who best knows how to put words to money stories: Pierre-Yves McSween.

name: Busu ni Hanataba wo.
summary: Hana Tabata is used to being invisible. With a plain appearance and a pessimistic view of romance, she's convinced that love and cute things are out of her reach. But everything changes when Yousuke Ueno, the handsome and kind boy from her class, suddenly takes an interest in her. As Hana navigates awkward moments and unexpected attention, she begins to question her own worth and what it truly means to be seen. A heartfelt, offbeat high school romcom that proves love isn't just for the beautiful.

name: Las Muertas
summary: Based on Jorge Ibargüengoitia's novel, the series tells how the Baladro sisters built a brothel empire and became merciless killers in 1960s Mexico.

name: TechTalk
summary: Discover flying taxis, robots for the elderly, firefighting drones, 3D holographic surgery & much more! Explore a world of technology & innovation that you never dreamed existed! Multiple Award-Winning Series TechTalk , takes you to see the hottest start-ups & upcoming entrepreneurs from across the globe. Checkout 50+ wow-factor new technologies that are transforming our planet for the better.

name: Murder on the Doorstep: The Killer Clown
summary: Murder on the Doorstep: The Killer Clown tells the story of Marlene Warren, a young wife and mother who was shot in the face on the doorstep of her Florida home by a clown bearing balloons and flowers. Behind her brutal murder, which was witnessed by her 21-year-old son and his friends, lay a web of love, betrayal and deceit. Amid rumours of infidelity, her husband emerged as the prime suspect, but Michael Warren had a cast-iron alibi and was never charged. The crime remained unsolved for nearly three decades until, in a surprise twist, Michael's alleged mistress and subsequent second wife, Sh

After a mutual murder, both sisters rebirth, but when Lu Qinning steals Kuang Yue this time, she doesn't realize Lu Zhaoyan also remembers everything and is still destined to outshine her...

From their high-tech hunting bus, Giel, Thomas, and Stefan get help from the public, who pass on information live. A nerve-racking game of cat and mouse ensues.

name: Queering

The teams will compete against each other in ambitious brick-building challenges to be crowned the country's most talented amateur LEGO builder. But everything shifts when her grown daughter, now a med student, stages a late rebellion-and Ji Ahn nexpectedly reconnects with her first love, Ryu Jung Suk. Fortunately, Rose's childhood friend and owner of an organic vegetable farm Din Kasama Wathinwanit comes to protect her. To secure her safety, she and Din will have to marry. Even if it's only a sham marriage, their reestablished closeness gradually brings about real feelings.

This underwater arena could be anywhere in the world, but this stunning series takes place near Roscoff in Brittany, France, with breathtaking windswept coasts that experience a daily tidal shift of 10 meters or more.

summary: Julia Zemiro will host Crime Night! a comedy true-crime panel show where real-life cases are examined through the lens of criminology and comedy. summary: Sport vs Money tells the inside story of the collision between football and business. Across four episodes, Jordan - the Premier League's youngest-ever owner - travels the globe to explore how decisions made by football's top executives in the early 1990s set in motion a transformation that has turned the world's most beloved sport into a vast entertainment industry.

One day, Lua's crush, Commander Garrett, was on the brink of death from a beast attack. Lua healed him, which left her on the verge of death. Even a small stage reflects the turbulent times. No matter the difficulties, they vow to love fiercely amidst the turmoil.

Yoshikawa Keiko is a veteran manager at the bottom of despair when she happens to pass Moriyama Takuto on the street. Feeling a connection with him, Keiko invites him in the world of entertainment and does everything to make him debut as an actor. Given a second chance, Fang joins forces with the resurrected Song Cheng to expose the conspiracy and cheat fate. As vengeance binds them, love blooms; together they unravel the villains' scheme, rewrite destiny, and step into a future forged by their own hands.

Detective Hours: In Our Prime

An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. Valt's close friend Shu Kurenai, who is regarded as a Beyblade genius, is a participant in the National Tournament and is called one of the "Supreme Four" due to his high influence within the tournament. Teamed with assistant Zhan Na to decrypt data and with Shang Wei for lightning raids, he unravels the conspiracy and foils a coup. With the covert backing of heiress Zhao Qingyun, the truth is dragged into daylight.

Some of the questions are general knowledge-based, but there are also treasure hunts, charades and against-the-clock challenges.

name: B-Friend

The icon used to belong to the boyar Morozov and came into their hands after his arrest. Rumors of the numerous miracles performed by this icon spread further and further. The memory of the icon did not die down even after centuries.

name: Zoo nursery

Scientists around the world are working to foster the birth of endangered species and reintroduce them into the wild. summary: The heroes of the program "Leave Your Parents" are adult children who, for various reasons, have not yet acquired their own housing and are forced to share their life with their parents. Some of them returned to their parents' home after a divorce or due to financial constraints, while others simply delayed "flying out" of the nest. Professional realtors, psychologists, designers and even astrologers communicate with the show's heroes and help them find suitable housing and finally start an independent life.

name: Platonik: Mavi Dolunay Otel
summary: When a suave guest with a hidden agenda checks into the Blue Moon Hotel, he forms a bizarre and messy love triangle with the two sisters who work there.

name: La Preuve : L'opération SharQc
summary: On April 15, 2009, several police forces joined forces to conduct the largest raid against a criminal biker group. The result of Operation SharQc was the arrest of 156 Hells supporters, including 111 members in good standing, almost all of the Quebec members. THE EVIDENCE: Operation SharQc is a documentary series that recounts the construction and collapse of the largest evidence ever amassed against criminal bikers in the world. A criminal and legal saga told to us by those who lived it, on both sides of the story: police officers, prosecutors, and the accused.

name: Снимите это немедленно!
summary: The main characters of the program get into "Take it off immediately!" thanks to letters from relatives or friends who ask to help their loved ones find joy in life again. The goal of the project is to change the heroines not only externally, but also internally. The hosts of the program will have to find out the reasons why women fall into depression, stop paying attention to themselves, and eliminate this by outlining new prospects for the heroines. According to the change, in order for a woman to change and take a new look at herself, she must act decisively and radically. Therefore, no reg

name: Съешьте это немедленно!
summary: Is your husband complaining about a dry piece of steak or unchewable beef stroganoff? In that case, the "Eat It Now!" program is especially for you!

name: Las maldiciones
summary: In northern Argentina, the governor's daughter is kidnapped by his trusted man while a crucial lithium exploitation law is being voted on. As the kidnapper's motivations are revealed, a secret plot that began to develop 13 years ago comes to light, challenging the girl's identity. The race-against-time negotiation exposes the true nature of power, the limits of love, and the curses of kinship.

name: Camp Rock
summary: Mitchie Torres (Demi Lovato) gets the chance of a lifetime—attending Camp Rock , the prestigous musical camp.

name: Dish It Out
summary: Tilly Ramsey will take Dish It Out viewers on a journey celebrating online trends and family favorite recipes. In each episode, she'll unbox surprise ingredients and tools, revealing recipes sent by celebrity chefs, social media influencers, and loved ones. From secret family recipes to the latest viral food trends, Tilly tackles each dish with her signature flair, creating mouthwatering masterpieces.

name: Ji Huang Nian, Wo Jian La Ji Dai Quan Jia Chi Rou
Dexter Procter: The 10-Year-Old Doctor
summary: Dexter Procter: The 10-Year-Old Doctor tells the story of Dexter Procter, a 10-year-old paediatrician trying to solve – frequently disgusting – medical mysteries, save his job, and find his place in the world.
previous_episode: Dexter Procter and the Case of the Disappearing Doctor

name: Paris & Pups
summary: Inspired by Paris Hilton and her real-life pets, Paris & Pups follows five fabulous pups who live in the penthouse of The Fabuluxe Hotel with 12-year-old Paris Star. The animated series celebrates the bond between Paris Star (called "Star") and her pups, living their best lives, going on creative adventures, and bringing kindness and happiness to others.
previous_episode: Mugsy is Stuck in the Elevator?! Crafting an Escape

name: Ta Cong Ye Se Shen Chu Lai
Chong Fan Jiu Ling Yang Zai fa Jia
Long Xian Sheng, Bie Na Me Jiao Ao
Bu Guo Shi Chuan Yue Nu Er Yi
summary: When a modern woman from another world steals her first love, noblewoman Xue Wanning takes control of her fate by marrying the emperor and claiming the throne. With power in her grasp, she's determined to show the so-called champion of equality that in this world, status isn't given—it's enforced.

name: NFL Classics: After Further Review
summary: NFL stars and celeb fans rewatch iconic football games, sharing new context, rare insights, and untold stories.
previous_episode: Super Bowl XXI: Giants vs. Broncos

name: Shen Suan Jiao Qi: Bing Ruo Shi Zi You Dian Tian
How To Kill Your Sister
summary: After 8 years of silence, Anna finds herself on the doorstep of her older sister Kat in a car with a coffin mounted on the roof. Anna announces she is terminally ill and wants Kat to accompany her on her last trip to Spain. Along the way Anna finally wants to find out why Kat abandoned her after the death of their parents. The two estranged sisters set off on a hilariously dark road trip, doomed to derail. The closer they get to their destination, the harder it becomes to hide the secrets they both harbour.

name: Royal Betrothal
summary: Adapted from the novel of the same name, Royal Betrothal follows top scholar Meng Tinghui and young emperor Ying Gua as they uncover a conspiracy amid court turmoil. From rivalry to trust, they join forces to rule together and write a passionate legend of love and power.

name: Caught in Providence
summary: Real people with real cases enter Providence Municipal Court to stand before Chief Municipal Court Judge Frank Caprio. Caprio hears cases involving traffic, parking, and arraignments for criminal offenses. There's always a bit of fun when the cameras are rolling, but Caprio makes it clear that he is there to do his job.

name: Next Gen Chef
summary: From fast casual to fine dining, rising chefs dish out bold flavors for a panel of VIP judges and culinary greats in this one-of-a-kind competition.

name: Вернись ко мне
summary: For Victoria Medvedeva, a successful Moscow TV presenter, other people's feelings are a hollow sound. She's unreflective and easily manipulates people and destinies. Her behavior unexpectedly leads to tragic consequences: both Vika's career and reputation are at risk. On the advice of her boss, Krupsky, Vika decides to temporarily leave Moscow to wait out the conflict. She travels to her hometown of Yalta, at the invitation of her first love, Roman Kuznetsov. But instead of the expected warm welcome and an affair with her ex-boyfriend, Vika faces a series of strange adventures that threaten to

name: TerrorBytes: The Evolution of Horror Gaming
summary: From the creators of the critically-acclaimed In Search of Darkness trilogy, Aliens Expanded , and First Person Shooter , it's time to enter a whole new world of horror... TerrorBytes ! In this new five-part episodic documentary, we explore and celebrate the rich history of horror gaming, taking you behind-the-scenes with the developers, artists and composers of the scariest games of all time.

name: Смехолэнд
summary: Tired of boring everyday life and monotonous entertainment? Do you want something fresh, witty, and a little bit daring? Then get ready to dive into "Funnyland," a cartoon series that will revolutionize your perception of humor. Each episode is a burst of laughter, fueled by subtle observations of our lives. We're not afraid to talk about what's going on around us, and we do it with our signature style: hilarious jokes, sharp remarks, and a touch of dark humor that adds an extra kick.

name: Mythos Borussia - Eine Legende wird 125
summary: A declaration of love for a traditional club: to mark its 125th anniversary, this two-part documentary celebrates the legendary club from the Lower Rhine region. Featuring Günter Netzer, Lothar Matthäus and Christoph Kramer.

name: Sin City Rehab
summary: Sin City Rehab will document Alison, best known for her Emmy®-nominated series Windy City Rehab , taking the biggest gamble of her career as she expands her successful design business out West. Alison will bet on herself for lofty rewards, diving headfirst into multi-million-dollar client projects and risky flips all while building a team and reputation from the ground up in a flashy new market.

name: Bian Qi Wei Qie, Yi Nu Jong Shi Zhang Gong Zhu
Qu Fu Liu Zi Hou, Huang Shang Yao Fu Ping Zi Gui
Eränkävijät: Äijän retket
summary: Wilderness Explorers: Äijä's Trips returns with new adventures! In the series, well-known Finns and their dogs experience unforgettable adventures with Wilderness Explorers' Aki Huhtanen and Äijä's dog. The guests face the challenges of the wilderness in Käsivarre Lapland and get to test their skills. In the second season, Aki and Äijä will be visited by Jukka Hildén, Pippa Laukka, Emma Kimiläinen, Sari Helin, Shirly Karvinen and Tommi Manninen.

name: Qi Shi Lao Tai Bu Hao Re
Marcial Maciel: El Lobo de Dios
summary: A four-part docuseries chronicling the decades of abuse and deceit by Father Marcial Maciel, the infamous leader of the Legionaries of Christ.

name: Дрон
summary: At the center of the plot of the series is a service dog working alongside the police. A determined and intelligent dog named Drone helps detectives solve criminal cases and unravel intrigues.

name: Бісова пательня
summary: A four-part adventure film with an intricate plot, unexpected twists and turns, humour and New Year's magic.

name: Щоденники Темного
summary: Events take place in the fantastic city of Dark. Vampires, werewolves, and other creatures live in it. Everything lives and breathes here, even the walls of houses. To get into this mysterious city is not at all difficult, but to leave is incredibly difficult. Once a journalist arrives in the city. His task is to cover the events taking place in the Dark. However, everything is complicated by the fact that to distinguish where the truth is, and where only hallucinations, in the city is incredibly difficult. In each issue, he investigates new mystical affairs.

name: Містер і місіс Малишки
summary: "Mr and Mrs Malyshko is a 16-episode ironic detective story about a married couple, Oleksandr and Maria, who are gentle, attentive and loving parents at home. However, as soon as they step outside their apartment, investigator Oleksandr and lawyer Maria immediately turn into irreconcilable rivals. An uncompromising professional confrontation

name: Ліки від минулого
summary: Alina's civilian husband, with whom she has not been together for several years, returns from the war. After being wounded, Serhiy is unrecognizable, his face is disfigured and he has partial memory loss. Alina helps Serhiy recover physically and get back on his feet. And falls in love with him for the second time. But where there should be a happy ending, the trials of fate are just beginning.

name: ЖК «Сімейки»
summary: ЖК «Сімейки» is a comedy premiere about our lives. The plot is centred on a chat between a house and the families who live there. Every day, they discuss topics that are important to them and resolve issues that every Ukrainian faces: everyday problems, family relationships, children's education, work and daily news. But despite all the heated debates and difficulties of today, the characters resolve situations with humour and positivity. That is why ЖК «Сімейки» is a light story that viewers love so much and which is so lacking in these difficult times. A special feature of the new STB series

name: Дві сестри
summary: Two Sisters is a story of love, betrayal, and life's tough challenges. Vera and Alexandra have always been inseparable, but one tragic event turns them into rivals. Love and pain, loyalty and revenge—each chooses her own path, unaware of where it will lead. Difficult trials await them, forever changing their lives.

name: Кришталеві джерела
summary: Lisa Kokhach, a 32-year-old children's dance instructor, finds her life turned upside down when she discovers she must become the guardian of a 10-year-old niece she never knew existed. In search of answers, Lisa arrives at an old yet picturesque house on the shore of Crystal Springs Lake. This house is more than just an inheritance — it's the crossroads of two people's fates united by a common goal. Her new acquaintance, the charismatic and stubborn Mykhailo Stolyar, is also vying for guardianship. Under one roof, they face not only the challenge of becoming a family for the girl but also a d

name: Тут і тепер
summary: On the roof of a high-rise building, four Kyivites Lara, Elka, Yulia and Susanna meet the dawn after graduation and decide to live "Here and Now", without waiting for better times. Each of the girls dreams of her happy future, investing in these dreams various things - death, glory, freedom, justice. Over time, they will realize that saving others from death is where they find the most meaning in life, true love trumps fame, and absolute freedom can collide with selfishness.

name: Скажені сусіди
summary: It's not just the wedding. Wild weddings are over, but frenzied adventures in Yablunivka continue! Two families – Serediuks and Kryzhanivskis – are engaged in an eternal Ukrainian competition: who has the taller house, the greener grass, and the cleverer children. Day or night, summer or winter – they always have time, inspiration, and imagination to play dirty tricks on their neighbours.

name: Сталеві нерви
summary: The plot of «Nerves of Steel» introduces us to Max, a young and talented manager. His strong, but surprisingly nasty character helps him reach the top of his career but scares away others. Max's grandfather believes that life has no meaning without friends and love, so he finds his own way to influence his grandson. Now Max has a choice: get engaged to the girl his grandfather has chosen for him, or lose his leadership position in the family business and be excluded from the will. The elderly man's chosen one is a plain and not very attractive nurse who works in a nursing home. How will the ac

name: Якщо кохаєш — скажи
summary: Anna is a young woman with great prospects. She's finishing her studies and has been offered a place at Stanford University. Ahead lies a bright future and the chance to start a new life in the United States with her beloved, who also happens to be her academic advisor. But everything changes when her mother dies unexpectedly. Anna soon discovers that Stanford will only accept one of them. Her beloved hides this from her and leaves for the U.S. alone, shattering her dreams and leaving her to face her grief alone. Years pass. Anna builds a new life, happily married to her high school friend Ill

name: Тілоохоронець
summary: She is looking for the truth about the past, and he follows her as an invisible shadow, protecting her from the machinations of her enemies.

name: Гарячий
summary: Operative Max Goryachev and police officer Ihor Bezhatchenko are another duet of cop-partners who prove that heroes do not have to look alike in order to successfully investigate cases. However, due to radically different characters and approaches to investigation, the heroes often have quarrels with each other, and because of this, unpleasant incidents at work. Max is used to acting sharply and without hesitation, but independently. After the sudden death of his wife, psychologists forbade him to go out on business alone. Max gets Ihor Bezhatchenko, a balanced provincial family man, as his pa

name: The Journey to Killing You
summary: Yakuza members Odajima and Kataoka are sent away on a trip after Kataoka, the young wakagashira, screws up. However, this trip hides the true mission: Odajima has been ordered to kill Kataoka.

name: Примарна спадщина
summary: An amazing journey of personal growth, in which sincere humor is intertwined with a realistic depiction of the afterlife. This is the transformation of the main character Viktor, a cynical and selfish person who, after the death of his grandmother, finds himself thrown into the spirit world. Through humorous situations, the audience will witness the transformation of a "sloppy scoundrel" into a kind-hearted and selfless person.

name: Переслідуючи вогонь
summary: Dramatic mini-series, the events of which unfold around the burning of the forest in the Chernobyl zone. A series of fires near the nuclear plant threatens to become a terrible disaster for the country and destroy the lives of thousands of people. The head of the emergency department, an experienced and determined firefighter, Andrii Troyan, must catch a dangerous firecracker and prevent a tragedy. But the investigation of the crime becomes a real test for the main character - he will have to survive the loss of a loved one, imprisonment and reveal many secrets, of which he himself is a part.

name: Холод
summary: A 16-episode detective story about the impulsive, sometimes tough, but experienced investigator Maxim Kholod, whose daughter disappeared under mysterious circumstances four years ago. Having never solved the case, Kholod despairs, he drowns his grief in a glass every day, and only work saves him from a fatal step. Everything will change when the principled, fair and dedicated linguo-criminalist Alexandra Kosovich joins the investigation, masterfully identifying criminals by pronunciation, handwriting and correspondence style. With only one clue - the last note from his daughter, Kosovich will

name: Табун
summary: Ukrainian and now British spy Hryhoriy Didenko returns to his native town of Novohrad-Volynsky after 15 years with a top-secret mission – to obtain a sample of Tabun's newest chemical weapon for the development of an antidote. The obstacles for Grigory will be not only the Nazi regime and deadly gas, but also the distrust of the local residents, whom he is trying to save from the ever-increasing threat.

name: Материнський інстинкт
summary: A new head of the obstetrics and gynecology department arrives – the charming and petite Natalia. However, behind her fragility and defenseless appearance lies a tremendous inner strength.

name: Злі духи
summary: A fascinating mystical four-part detective story.

name: Хазяїн
summary: The classic history of the relationship between parents and children in a modern way, because many problems are as relevant today as in the nineteenth century. According to the plot of the miniseries, after returning home from Harvard, the girl Sonya tries to understand the methods of work of a famous and influential father and discovers many unpleasant things. Raised in love and respect for her parents, she does not immediately dare to go against the interests of her father. However, in the end he comes into open confrontation with him and will fight for justice. Her conflict with Terentiy Pu

name: #ЯЖЕБАТЬ
summary: A young and not very serious father is forced to take responsibility for the life of his two-year-old son. The baby's mother was tired of maternity leave and decided to test her husband's ability to take seriously anything in life. So now our hero has to grow up.

name: Вітя
summary: Viktor Viktorovich Vasilenko works as a mechanic at his father's service station, but his real passion is psychology. Thanks to his earnings at the workshop, he was able to enroll in the correspondence department of the Poltava Forestry Institute, where he received a degree in psychology. Vitya dreams of gaining a deeper understanding of himself and helping others find inner harmony. Without hesitation, he begins counseling people right on the job. Every day, residents come to him with their anxieties, complexes, and prejudices, and Vitya tries to help everyone.

name: Справа НБР
summary: The plot of the series revolves around the NBR, an elite special unit created to hunt down the most dangerous predators in human form. It is headed by a hardened operative Koval (Sergei Strelnikov), whose team works as a single mechanism: ruthlessly, quickly, on the verge of a foul. But where is the fine line beyond which the thirst for justice turns into blind rage? What awaits the team when they are ruled by emotions? Each of them has their own secret - and it's a mystery that keeps you in suspense to the very end. And crime is getting stronger and stronger...

name: Takumi-kun Series -Drama-
summary: Shido Academy is a secluded all-boys boarding school built on a remote mountainside. Second-year student Hayama Takumi is assigned to share a room with Saki Giichi (nicknamed "Gii") Their unexpected pairing draws jealous and hostile stares from the other students. In truth, Takumi and Gii are secretly in a romantic relationship. While Takumi feels happiness in their bond, deep down he is haunted by the fear that "if I reveal everything about myself, he might come to hate me." Gii, on the other hand, struggles with the pain of being physically close yet unable to truly connect, gradually losing

name: Бойові родини
summary: The last years for our country are tragic. We have lost control of a certain territory, there is a war in the country and people are being killed, but we are not giving up. It's time to listen to the stories of real heroes.

name: Ворон та Воробйов
summary: The plot centers on the story of Voron, an experienced detective who has gone through many trials, and Vorobyov, a younger, naive, and romantic hero. The men have completely different characters and methods of work. While investigating a complicated case, they learn about a gangster's safe with 50 million dollars. To get to the money, the rivals are forced to join forces and become a team.

name: Рятівники
summary: What to do when you get stuck on a catamaran with a wife and a hated mother-in-law in a middle of a sea? No water, no food, and nobody hurries to save you... Well, then, it's high time to find out the relationships!

name: Таємниці архівів
summary: When modern crimes have their roots in the past, Special Branch investigators use unique techniques, artificial intelligence and digitised archives to prove that justice has no statute of limitations.

name: Митець
summary: This is a story about a former prisoner of war, a legendary police major in the past, Skoruk, who unexpectedly returns home two years after his mysterious disappearance. He begins to envision and investigate future crimes that will soon take place. For two years, he was presumed dead, but his miraculous return, strange drawings and the chemistry in his blood suggest one thing: Skoruk cannot be trusted. Who is he? Why did he come back and remember nothing? And the main question: who will win the battle of the demons in Skoruk's head?

name: Хід коня
summary: Maksym Nikonenko has everything: a favorite job, a lover, money. He is considered lucky and many envy him. But suddenly Nikonenko's life is destroyed - he finds himself in a colony for a murder he did not commit. While in the cell, Max scrolls through every second of his past to find the answer to the main question - who framed him and why. However, fate prepares a new twist for him and a new mystery - the "unknown savior" made a lot of efforts to free Max. Nikonenko is trying to understand who the savior is and most importantly - what is his motive.

name: Королі палат
summary: Taras and Yehor are brothers and doctors in the city polyclinic. Yehor is a macho, and a successful surgeon. His wallet attracts all the girls, but the man wants to find true love. Taras is his exact opposite; he does not have enough money, neither he faces a promotion. Moreover, he should care for his wife and children. Every time the guys make fun of each other and conduct genuine laughter sessions! Throw away your daily routine and enjoy humor from the doctors.

name: Підміна
summary: The story focuses on Kateryna, a successful architect and head of a design bureau. She is a self-confident woman who has spent her life building a career, family and future. Her life seems stable, though not without internal conflicts. But an unexpected call from the past forces her to travel abroad to visit her sister Irina, whom she hasn't seen in years.

name: Майор Сковорода
summary: "Major Skovoroda" is a police comedy with detective elements, centered around the charismatic and unconventional head of the criminal investigation department, Andrii Skovoroda. Assigned to a precinct on the outskirts of Kyiv, he's put in charge of a group of rookie officers who lack field experience. Teaching them how to catch criminals is one thing — but showing them how to deal with people is a whole different challenge, especially for someone like him. Known for his sarcastic humor, philosophical quips, and unpredictable tactics, Skovoroda seems more like a mentor — or even a babysitter —

name: Ловець снів
summary: When life crumbles in front of our eyes, dreams of personal happiness collapse, and the accumulated problems lead to a dead end, he comes to the rescue. Dream catcher. A person who is able to solve the most hopeless life situations. A genius specialist whose main tool in his work is our dreams. He will destroy the stereotypical interpretation of dreams and prove that sleep is the key to solving our problems. You just need to read it correctly.

name: Колишня
summary: The nationally known coach Regina Lavrentyeva returns with her wards from the junior championship. Two thoughts do not give her peace - at the championship, one of her two daughters (Lana) got a leg injury, and her beloved husband and father, the famous businessman Yurii Lavrentiev, do not meet them yet. However, Regina leaves the airport with her husband's brother, Vlad, who has long been involved in all the finances of Regina's gymnastics school. On the way, they discuss the upcoming celebration of Regina and Yuri's silver wedding and the school's financial situation. Regina calls her stepso

name: Птаха в клітці
summary: Alena thought her life would be like a fairy tale. But her husband turned out to be a cruel tyrant and a possessive manipulator. Desperate to change her fate, she decides to escape—taking her young son and sick mother with her. Under a new identity, she tries to start over. But her powerful husband has no intention of letting her go…

name: Мольфар
summary: Since ancient times, people with supernatural abilities have been called molfar. At the same time, their main tools are various spells and potions. Not everyone can visit such unusual people: only those who have only pure and good thoughts. "Molfar" tells the viewer a story about a magician. He lives in a remote house near a lake.

name: Зворотний напрямок
summary: Fate brings Roman and Daryna together in circumstances they would never have chosen themselves. The forced marriage becomes a test for them, because instead of love, they feel only mutual hatred. Living under the same roof and expecting a child turns into a constant struggle of characters, where every day is a new confrontation. But will they be able to resist the circumstances? And will it turn out that this "game of war" is actually the beginning of great feelings?

name: Виговський
summary: The eight-episode film tells the story of a spy who, after being exposed, is forced to accept a failed mission to avoid execution.

name: Служба 112
summary: "Service 112" tells the story of a new unit that is being created for rapid joint response of emergency services. A team of specialists from different disciplines - rescuers, police officers and paramedics - now work side by side to respond to calls received by the 112 Service. In a time of war, when there are more threats and fewer experienced people, they overcome not only external circumstances but also their own disputes for the sake of a common goal - saving people.

name: Обмежено придатні
summary: It is a profound yet light-hearted story about how war changes the lives of ordinary Ukrainian families, their relationships, inner world and views on the future. It's about people who, despite all the trials and difficult decisions, find the strength to laugh, love and move on.

name: Chabos
summary: When Peppi (36) finds out he wasn't invited to the class reunion, his self-image starts to crack. Fuck! Forgotten? Uninvited? – This must be a mistake! Searching for answers, we follow Peppi to his old hometown and back to the past of his 16-year-old self: Skateboarding with bleached tips through the monsoon of the 2000s. The era of flip phones, lan parties, and Top of the Pops. But alongside the wild, nostalgic memories lurk some dark teenage sins. Maybe there are reasons why Peppi shouldn't have been invited after all. CHABOS is like an old Facebook profile you've scrolled too far down — ful

name: Scheda
summary: In the seaside town of Hel, the death of a prominent local naval captain threatens to expose the web of lies tying his family together.

name: 4 Destiny Project
summary: A collection of four BL series, directed by four visionary directors— get ready for an emotional rollercoaster.

name: Matchroom: The Greatest Showmen
summary: Meet Barry and Eddie Hearn. These Essex entrepreneurs run a billion-quid sports promotion company in Brentwood — and they're aiming for world domination.
previous_episode: Chapter Six: Show Me The Money

name: Следопыт
summary: Huntsman Maxim Okhlopkov is forced to leave his native Pskov forests due to a conflict with the local mayor. His new home is cold St. Petersburg, big, uncomfortable and unusual. The ability to see the trail and feel the animal logic helps Okhlopkov at his new duty station – he gets a job as an operative in the Yekaterininsky district of St. Petersburg. His partner is a Welsh Corgi dog named Tubik. Will the provincial and the truth-teller Okhlopkov be able to get along in a big city? His integrity often creates difficult "situations."

name: The Circle Of Life
summary: In her past life, Jiang Sui was pushed off the rooftop to her death by Song Yan. After being reborn ten years later, she became Xu Jin Xia, Song Yan's six-year-old daughter. Enduring in silence, she bides her time, tearing away the hypocritical facade of the wealthy family, searching for her birth mother's whereabouts, and making her enemies pay their blood debts in blood. Witness how the reborn heiress overturns her doomed fate!

name: Back for You
summary: In the weary city night, Yu Xingchen is stunned to learn of the death of Su Ruo, his white moonlight. When a mysterious figure pulls him into a temporal vortex, he finds himself back in high school, face to face with the 18-year-old girl he mourned. With their timelines merged across fifteen years, he navigates familiar halls for answers. Can his youthful feelings unravel the mystery of her death? And is this second chance a gift from fate, or the first clue in a dangerous truth?

name: Bróker Marcsi
summary: Marika, a mother in her fifties, is not promoted at the Karcag bank branch where she has worked for decades. In her anger, she quits and decides to put her financial expertise to use in the civilian sphere. She starts her own business, where she handles sums amounting to billions, but after fifteen years her pyramid seems to be wobbling. Based on a true story. © RTL Hungary

name: Тоннель
summary: The incorruptible customs officer Sveta Suvorova has always been too principled for a small town where everything is decided "by friendship." At least until the mafia kidnapped her husband. There is a chance to get him back, but for that, Sveta will have to forget about principles and make a deal with her conscience. Is she ready to cross the invisible line she drew herself?

name: Wukong
summary: An independent story of Sun Wukong. It tells the adventure of the great demon Wukong, who dominated the demon road in his previous life, and formed a direct bond with the human girl Guozi.

name: My Sassy Wedding
summary: Khamduang, delivery buffalo for her ill father, meets Khun Ek, an officer avoiding monkhood. To escape political schemes, he offers her a rare golden ginseng to pose as his wife. As they navigate her transformation into a refined lady, they face a cunning thief, political intrigue, and a love triangle. Amid challenges, their unexpected bond deepens, blending danger, romance and self-discovery.

name: Foursome
summary: Who doesn't love the single life? Being able to hook up with whomever you please and making no apologies for it. And if you're looking to celebrate the joys of being "unattached", there's no better series than Foursome! You know the formula, right? Two guys, two girls, and a sprawling mansion "slumber party".

name: Capoeiras
summary: Veneno and Noivo are capoeiristas who grew up as brothers, but a brutal crime separated them. Before revealing the truth, the informant falls to her death. Woo-seok's investigation leads him to Royal Auction and its chief auctioneer, Han Seol-ah, whose three fiancés have all died under suspicious circumstances. To expose the truth, or perhaps to test her, Woo-seok proposes they fake a relationship. After resolving a series of misunderstandings, the two joined forces to subdue the true culprit—the Young Marshal.

Every year, Russian scientists introduce cutting-edge methods that extend the lives of patients who previously would not have survived. By a twist of fate, the two find themselves taking charge of the town's "life's major events." As they face one heartbreaking yet heartwarming story after another, Li Yiran begins to see life and regret in a new light. And quietly, her relationship with her mom starts to shift...

From there, he sets off around the world to check if any of those theories were correct. In his most personal and revealing travel series to date, can Romesh find the answers to modern life... and was any of his stand-up material that he performed to over a quarter of million people actually true?

He'll then be offering nutritious alternatives and take us back to basics, showing us what to shop, cook and eat in a bid to transform the nation's health.

Torn between escaping a foretold death and fighting to reclaim her career, Lin Zhiyu is forced to confront a fate where danger and destiny may be one and the same.

name: Bao Qing Hou Ye Chi Qing Qie
He Ping Jing Ying: Jia You Te Zhong Bing!
Killer Investigations
summary: Detectives chase down leads, prosecutors go head-to-head with defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with life-or-death decisions.

name: Star Trek: Scouts
summary: Star Trek: Scouts follows three 8-year-old friends, JR, Sprocket and Roo, as they train to become future Starfleet Explorers by going on epic, out-of-this-world missions that push them to "discover, grow and boldly go!"

name: Ceol ón gCré
summary: In this brand-new series for TG4, renowned singer and musician Nell Ní Chróinín takes viewers on a heartfelt musical journey through rural Ireland. Ceol ón gCré (Music from the Earth) is a 4-part traditional music and documentary hybrid series exploring the deep well of tradition, memory, and community across the country. Each episode focuses on a core theme of rural life – the land, the sea, the heart, and the soul – with Nell meeting musicians, singers, and dancers who embody these connections through powerful performances and personal stories. Filmed in a warm, informal style, this is a ser

name: The Records Show
summary: Katie Hannon delves into the secrets held in Ireland's National Archives in a new series of The Records Show starting this Sunday on RTÉ One and RTÉ Player. Over three episodes, Katie digs out previously undisturbed documents from the hundreds of thousands of records held at the National Archives before heading across the country to follow the trail of the stories behind them. The Records Show takes Katie from the surface of the moon to Steven Spielberg's County Wicklow bunker and then to the epicenter of Ireland's international sports car industry – Castleblaney, County Monaghan. She hears of

name: Свободный код
summary: Opensource came to change the world, but he changed himself. Russian journalist and science popularizer Andreyka Konev is next to him-expert Vladimir understands how to live further today. The leading program, the author and the head of IT, she also answers the main question: what is expertise, what is progress or what does a tough corporate player need for this? The principles of a free community are being tested: a developer is suing a company that is trying to steal his work, Russia is being pushed out of international open-source projects, and new ecosystems are being born out of the wreck

name: Тысяча «нет» и одно «да»
summary: One chance encounter forever changes the lives of Oksana, a young girl from a simple family, and Sergey, a young oligarch. It all starts with the wedding. Oksana's sister Tanya is getting married. The wedding day turns into a series of disasters - literally everything is not going according to plan. Tanya's ex-lover even appears at the wedding. And the self-confident rich man Sergey makes an offer to Oksana in front of everyone. Oksana's refusal really hurts Sergey: "And even if you say no a thousand times, sooner or later you'll say yes anyway!"

name: Tower of Babel
summary: A midnight massacre at the Babel Villa in Mystic City. The homeowner is found decapitated, and his wife dies by self-immolation. Two deaths in one night ignite an urban legend. Months later, six individuals gather at Towel of Babel, seeking the truth behind the will, unaware that they have already walked into the snare of fate. As secrets surface and dangers lurk in every shadow, no one will emerge unscathed. Beneath the web of deceit, what is the real truth?

name: The Dreamwalker
summary: After her escort agency family is destroyed, He Fuyi plunges over a cliff with the ancient artifact, the Seven-Star Lamp. Her blood awakens the lamp's spirit, A Qi, binding them together in a symbiotic fate. To avenge her family and sustain her own life, she embarks on a perilous quest with A Qi to "dissolve dreams and shatter obsessions." Thrust into the turmoil of the late Qing Dynasty, they join forces with the nobleman Little Fifth Master. Witnessing countless human sorrows and enduring attachments, they finally unravel a truth that will shake the very foundations of their world.

name: Det danske madmirakel
summary: From brown gravy to world-class! This is the miraculous story of how Denmark became a gastronomic powerhouse - and what it cost along the way

name: Zambia Untamed
summary: In a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to life.

name: The NeNe Leakes Show
summary: Nene Leakes opens up her life and invites celebrity guests to engage in candid, unfiltered conversations about relationships, careers, and the latest gossip

name: Sex Pistols
summary: An average boy named Norio is suddenly getting a lot of unwanted romantic attention. A fall down the stairs into the arms of a handsome stranger sets off the beginnings of an explanation, and it is one Norio never could have possibly imagined. Soon a whole new world opens up for Norio revealing a secret society of special people evolved from animals other than monkeys. Norio turns out to be a particularly rare breed and his DNA is in high demand. Now that he's suddenly the prey, it'll take much effort to survive in this modern jungle.

name: 6 Lovers
summary: This mini-series includes short stories adapted from 6 different manga series, all centered around the theme of gay love.

name: Chandamama
summary: Chandamama was an old Doordarshan (DD) television serial for children, produced by Kamini Kaushal and Rahul Sood, which aired on a Doordarshan channel i.e. DD National or another regional DD channel such as Doordarshan Sahyadri. The show was designed for children's entertainment, information, and education, combining old stories with new content to align with changing trends.

name: SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes
summary: SI-VIS is a co-ed music group, led by Yosuke, shaking up the global music scene with their unmatched vocals and performances. However, they are actually heroes in disguise, battling against mysterious forces threatening the world. They convert audience energy at live performances into combat power. Luckily, the battles appear to be ordinary concerts to the public, keeping their identity a secret.

name: Plus-sized Misadventures in Love!
summary: "This is my punishment - someone as hideous as me falling for someone as good-looking as you..." Yumeko had a mountain of complexes about herself. Then, a terrible accident befalls her. Though somehow saved from the brink of death, Yumeko wakes up a completely different person. "Is this...me...?! I'm SUPER cute!!" Those around her can't hide their surprise and wonderment at this 180-degree change... But, Yumeko's new hyper-positive attitude starts to change her surroundings, too. Worries and complexes can affect anyone, and Yumeko will chop right through those of her various supporting charact

name: Alma-chan Wants to Be a Family!
summary: She's small. She's sweet. She's…capable of obliterating a tank in under three seconds?! Built by Enji and Suzume, two underappreciated genius scientists, Alma is the ultimate self-learning AI. There's just one thing: She thinks they're her mom and dad! Now as unexpected co-parents, the duo must hide their budding romantic feelings while taking on the messiest experiment of all: family life!
previous_episode: I Want to Be a Family

name: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
summary: Even turning after 40 years old, Tojima Tanzaburo still seriously wants to be a Kamen Rider. Just when it seems like his dream may never come true, he gets caught up in a series of infamous Shocker-inspired robberies... Shibata Yokusaru, the author of Air Master and 81 Diver, presents a story about adults who love Kamen Rider a little too much, and start playing pretend... for real!

name: Mar afuera
summary: Álvaro and Carlos are two inmates recently arrived at a juvenile correctional facility located by the sea. While serving their sentences, they must face threats from the Los Pajaritos gang without losing hope in an increasingly dark future. But there, they also find support from inmates like Saray, a young woman who prefers to live in the facility rather than return to her troubled life on the outside, and from staff like Mario, a man who will risk his own life to help these children.

name: Above Average Presents
summary: Above Average Presents is a Peacock series featuring a collection of comedic sketches and skits performed by a diverse range of comedians and talented individuals, including figures like Tina Fey, Jason Sudeikis, and Reggie Watts, with each episode presenting humorous and creative scenarios that showcase the show's high-quality and hilarious content.

name: New Power Generation: Black Music Legends of the 1980s
summary: Series of documentaries looking at the careers of four titans of African-American music: Janet Jackson, Prince, Lionel Richie and Public Enemy.

name: Even Better Than the Real Thing
summary: Some of the world's greatest tribute acts go head to head, performing songs made famous by music legends.

name: Britain's Christmas Story
summary: Gareth Malone and Karen Gibson reveal the stories and legends behind some of Britain's Christmas traditions.

name: Death Row Confidential: Secrets of a Serial Killer
summary: The story of convicted killer Joseph Naso, and how a fellow inmate came to connect him to many additional cold cases, with the help of Investigators.

name: The Ba***ds of Bollywood
summary: In this high-stakes drama, an ambitious outsider and his friends navigate the chaotic, larger-than-life, yet uncertain world of Bollywood.

name: She Woke up from the Coffin
The Night Conveys Love to Lovers
Cuibhlichean an Fhortain
summary: Car makeover competition. Two teams battle it out for the spoils of a car auction.

name: Traffic Cops: Elite Squad One
summary: When it comes to chasing criminals, two wheels are better than four. In this brand new high-octane series, nowhere is off limits for the country's highly trained police bikers. They are the UK's fastest responders, at the ready to race at top speed to save lives and catch suspects on the run.

name: Shao Nian Ge Xing Zh Feng Hua Xue Yue
Spring Night
summary: Mai Tian, the sole survivor of the fallen Shen family, saves the life of Crown Prince Jinchuan, who is gravely wounded and has lost his memory. To evade an imperial marriage decree, she seizes the chance to enter into a marriage of convenience with him. What begins as a contractual union unexpectedly blossoms into genuine love and deep attachment. Ultimately, joining forces, they unravel a colossal imperial examination fraud and succeed in clearing the Shen family's name.

name: Slaget om Tisvilde
summary: In the attractive seaside resort of Tisvilde on the North Zealand coast, a music festival has divided the residents into two camps. The annual festival has grown so large that it has transformed the otherwise idyllic and peaceful summer oasis into a town of conflict and irreconcilability. The question is what kind of town should Tisvilde be, and who actually has the right to decide that?

name: Look What You Made Me Do
summary: Look What You Made Me Do explores cases of revenge and betrayal. The series features real courtroom footage and first-hand accounts to detail shocking acts of vengeance.

name: Largados e Pelados Brasil: A Tribo
Néara-Éagsúlacht: Dearcadh Difriúil
summary: TG4 has announced the launch of a powerful new documentary series, Néara-Éagsúlacht: Dearcadh Difriúil produced by Tyrone Productions, which will air as part of TG4's Autumn schedule. The two-part series offers a moving and honest insight into the lives of neurodivergent people across Ireland, filmed over the course of a year. The series shines a light on the challenges and triumphs faced by neurodivergent individuals and their families, while highlighting the importance of understanding, inclusion, and support in education, employment, and wider society.

name: Canada AM
summary: Canada AM was a Canadian morning television news show that aired on CTV from 1972 to 2016. Its final hosts were Beverly Thomson and Marci Ien, with Jeff Hutcheson presenting the weather forecast and sports. The program aired on weekdays, and was produced from CTV's facilities at 9 Channel Nine Court in Scarborough, Toronto.

name: Love Hina Again
summary: Keitaro has finally passed the entrance exams, and is officially a Toudai student. But after breaking his leg in an accident in the entrance ceremony, he thought and re-evaluated himself. Having new goals, Keitaro follows Seta on an overseas archeology trip. During his absence, however, all was not well in Hinata Lodge. Urashima Kanako, Keitaro's sister, arrives on the scene. She claims to be the new manager of Hinata Lodge starts to go against all the tenants. Things become even more complicated when they recieve a letter from Keitaro. The tenants and Kanako made a big mess trying to get the

name: ДомоЧАТцы
summary: The residents of the multi-storey building decided to create a shared chat in order to solve possible problems in relations with the organization serving the house and communicate with neighbors.

name: Güller ve Günahlar
summary: When Serhat was a boy, life struck him twice — his father abandoned the family, and their fortune vanished. He rebuilt his life through sheer will, becoming a successful businessman devoted to two values: family and integrity. But everything shattered when he learned his wife Berrak had been hiding a devastating secret. Before he could confront her, a tragic accident left her in a coma — taking the truth with her. Then came Zeynep. A fiery, outspoken young woman from a working-class neighborhood, she was nothing like anyone Serhat had known. Drawn together by the mystery surrounding Berrak, Se

name: Разворот
summary: A gang of skaters operates in Moscow, fighting for justice with bizarre methods. The helmeted criminals attack bribe-takers and brand them with the word "karma." A young, fresh graduate of the police academy, Alexey Yudin, is tasked with infiltrating the gang disguised as a skateboarder. Accompanied by his new friend, Max, he masters the board and becomes part of the skater community. But the further the mission progresses, the more difficult it becomes for Alexey to maintain impartiality. Yudin himself seems to be imbued with the noble gangsters' ideals and increasingly uncertain whose side h

name: Balene - Amiche per Sempre
summary: After the sudden death of their lifelong friend Adriana, Evelina and Milla reunite in their seaside hometown. Once inseparable, the two women had drifted apart, but grief brings them back together. As they confront old wounds and rediscover the strength of their bond, they begin to suspect that Adriana's death may not have been accidental. Between family tensions, hidden secrets, and the challenges of middle age, their renewed friendship becomes both a refuge and a driving force in uncovering the truth.

name: The Little Reunion
summary: The Little Reunion follows the lives of a dynamic group of outspoken and unstoppable women with dwarfism navigating new opportunities in the sun-soaked streets of Los Angeles. The new chapter starts now, reuniting cast members from the Little Women franchise, starring Tonya Renee Banks and Christy McGinity from Little Women: LA , along with Amanda Salinas and Andrea Salinas (known as "Tiny Twinz") and Tiffany Becton (known as "Monie") from Little Women: Atlanta , as well as Briana Barlup (known as "Left Cheek") from Little Women: Atlanta and Little Women: Dallas.

name: Little Hollywood
summary: Following "The Little Reunion" and its shocking revelations, ladies living with dwarfism start a new chapter with old friends, new faces and big opportunities.

name: Champions for Change
summary: Champions for Change spotlights extraordinary innovators and everyday people using grit, creativity, and compassion to drive positive change and tackle some of the world's most pressing issues

name: A Question of Genius
summary: High pressure quiz show where contestants battle it out over increasingly difficult rounds for a chance to answer A Question of Genius and win a cash prize.

name: Fu Xing Wang Fei Zai Xian Da Lian
Ji Zhang Xian Sheng, Ni De Wei Hun Qi Jia Ren Le
Jiu Zhong Chun Se Suo Qian Sui
Affinity
summary: Five years ago, Wu Nongyu followed her brother Wu Siyuan to the scene of a murder, where her life became entwined with Xie Xinxu, who was then suspected to be the killer. Her very presence seemed to exert a strange, instinctive pull on him. A single glance was enough to awaken an uncontrollable desire to possess her.Five years later, determined to have Wu Nongyu, Xie Xinxu disguises himself as a cold, ascetic medical professor and deliberately draws close to her. Step by step, he lays his traps, guiding her into falling in love with him, and the two embark on a perilous journey together. A man

name: Tracks in the Snow
summary: A fraudulent influencer's occult divinations lead to a bizarre kidnapping. Within twenty-four hours, layer upon layer of conspiracy reveals unspeakable secrets. Three intricately connected groups of characters expose a hidden plot beneath a seemingly calm surface. A glamorous influencer, a black-market kidnapper, and a shady banker take the stage, each scrambling to survive or save the day, and each making a disgraceful spectacle of themselves.

name: Extraordinary
summary: History enthusiast Shi Feifan wakes up in the fictional "Great Southern Dynasty" as his dissolute namesake. To protect his family, he appears to squander wealth, while secretly using modern knowledge to amass a fortune through silk trading, outwit the Qiang envoy, rescue the Grand Princess, and eliminate the malevolent Prince. All with the Emperor's tacit approval. Subsequently, he is sent to reorganize the Western Army, transforming from a good-for-nothing into the dynasty's unseen pillar, who secretly holds military power.

name: Search For Soul Stone
summary: A half-century ago, the sudden emergence of spiritual energy within jadeite gave rise to espers and powerful clans. The Meng family, gifted with the ability to sense this energy, was brutally wiped out overnight. The sole survivor, a youth named Meng Yan, forged a life with a mysterious girl named Xiaoduo. Six years later, having mastered his powers, Meng Yan embarks on a path of vengeance, igniting a metropolitan superpower war that spans two generations.

name: The Brownlow Medal
summary: The Brownlow Medal awards show is an annual event, traditionally held at Crown Melbourne on the Monday before the AFL Grand Final, to present the Charles Brownlow Medal, awarded to the AFL's fairest and best player of the season. The event features a "red carpet" (often humorously called the "Gownlow"), where players and their partners arrive, followed by a live count of the votes. The count, hosted by the AFL, involves the AFL CEO reading the votes for each match, interspersed with highlights and commentary, leading to the announcement of the winner.

name: Тримайся, братику
summary: Тримайся, братику is a war drama. The plot follows two best friends, Alex and Nikolai, medical students at the start of a full-scale Russian invasion, as they try to find work at a military hospital. Along with a casual acquaintance, Sasha, they find themselves at a stabilization point in the east, near the front lines. Every day, the film's characters face death, undergo their own personal transformations, endure personal dramas, and expose traitors. This is a story about friendship, extreme adolescence, and true values.

name: Neon Flower Waiting for Love
summary: What will happen when "Khao Jee," an Isan boy who comes to the city to work in a factory, gets the chance to live in the same condominium as "Fah Kram," the factory owner's son and his cold, distant boss? Follow their special story—will love bloom between them? Or will it turn into a heart-shaking drama as always?

name: Antigang
summary: Antigang will follow the adventures of detective sergeants Jean-François, Mathilde, Philippe, Carolanne, and Tommy, led by Lieutenant Christian. The squad finds itself at the heart of the conflicts between the country's criminal organizations. Each character experiences personal, familial, and romantic challenges. Antigang will also reveal the repercussions and consequences suffered by the families of the leaders of the underworld, not to mention the anxieties that haunt the daily lives of source agents and informants, torn between the mask of their loyalty and their true betrayals. The series

name: Кузя. Путь к успеху
summary: The story takes viewers back to Kuzi's past and shows how, after leaving university, he ended up in his native Agapovka and unexpectedly became the head of a local collective farm. This is where his path to big business begins — with all the difficulties, adventures and his cousin's trademark spontaneity. Trying to save the farm from bankruptcy, Kuzya encounters the intrigues of a city businessman who wants to take over the land. In her personal life, too, everything is not easy: a practical neighbor, Verka, a divorced mother with a child, and a spoiled city girl, Dasha, the daughter of that b

name: Искусство падения
summary: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the charac

name: Малахит
summary: In the village of Krasny Kamen, three seventh graders — Roma, Asya and Gordey ― are spending their summer holidays carefree. On one of his trips to the quarry, Roma finds a malachite nugget, with which his drawings become reality. But along with the miraculous find, the ancient spirit Black Raven emerges from the depths of the quarry, which embodies any desire and in return demands to pay too high a price. Now the heroes have to prove that pure thoughts and true strong friendship are stronger than the ancient evil.

name: Участковый Саша
summary: Sasha, raised on Hollywood action movies, is trying to apply his professional skills in a new environment. But life in the countryside is completely different, and you can't understand it with your mind, as they say. The precinct officer will have to figure out the local rules, gain the respect of the residents, gain wit and even find his love in the face of a local milkmaid. And at the same time, he is faced with the case of the mysterious disappearance of a fellow villager, which may not be as simple as it seems at first glance.

name: Дидюшкино Live
summary: Pavel Valerievich works in the administration of a small village. He is in no hurry, does not dream of the capital and sincerely believes in the principle: "where he was born, he came in handy there." Everything changes when an order comes from Moscow to start a video blog about the activities of the administration. The first issue is so comical and strange that it collects thousands of likes and views. Now Pavel will have to continue filming, which will turn his life and the life of the entire village upside down.

name: Wife Swap: The Real Housewives Edition
summary: Based on the hit global format, each standalone episode follows a different Real Housewife and real wife as they navigate swapping their everyday comforts and luxuries to fully immerse themselves in a vastly different familial experience. Through unexpected conflicts, eye-opening moments and emotional breakthroughs, the journey challenges everything they thought they knew about themselves and the world around them. Through this process, the Real Housewives will question if they can appreciate the lives they left behind and conversely, the real wives will question whether the aspirational lives
previous_episode: All Is Ferret in Love and War

name: TV We Love
summary: The nostalgic series celebrates eight of America's most iconic television shows and the indelible mark they left on popular culture.

name: Bruce Forsyth's Hot Streak
summary: Bruce Forsyth's Hot Streak is a fast-paced word-association game show in which two teams compete to build a chain of connected clues. Players try to think on their feet and keep the momentum going as teammates race to guess the final word before the streak is broken. Hosted by Bruce Forsyth, the series blends lively gameplay with Forsyth's trademark humour and showmanship.

name: The Off Weeks
summary: The Off Weeks follows writing professor Gus Adler, whose divorce has thrown his life into chaos. He struggles to hold things together during "on weeks" when he has custody of his kids. But in his "off weeks," he's falling dangerously in love with Stella West, a mysterious woman whose arrival puts Gus' on-week duties and off-weeks ambitions on a fatal collision course.

name: Hebe: Um brinde à vida
summary: The series shows the Hebe we all know and reveals her personal story: loves, disappointments, aspirations, opinions and her enormous influence that remains on our TV to this day.
previous_episode: Eu Não Tenho Medo De Morrer, Tenho Peninha!

name: Стальные испытания
summary: «Stal'nyye ispytaniya» is a competition for blade enthusiasts and collectors. Participants bring their finest specimens to prove the quality of their creations and their mastery of them in a series of three rounds.
previous_episode: #4. Мага Исмаилов, Ярин, Сулима, Орлов, Корнев, Михеев, Гершвальд

name: Спроси моего папу
summary: Especially for Father's Day, the O! channel is launching a new educational online show for children and parents called "Ask My Dad"! Our main experts—children—will bring their dads with interesting professions to our studio, where they will answer viewers' most original, funny, and unusual questions live on air.

name: La Disparue de Compostelle
summary: Jeanne Nogarède is a police officer in her home village of Saint-Guilhem-le-Désert. The biggest regret of her life: the case of Emma Vivian, the daughter of one of her childhood friends, who disappeared on her way to school. Five years later, a new element shakes up her understanding of the case. Jeanne discovers online the video image reconstructed by an AI of the young Emma Vivian who explains what happened to her. However, her story contains an element that only her captor could know... or her mother.

name: Alone Suomi
summary: Eight Finns from different backgrounds try to survive in the Inari wilderness alone without amenities. The longest beneficiary of nature wins.

name: CBC Kids Reads
summary: Gary and the gang share their favourite books, meet the authors, and celebrate children's literature! From books to the alphabet to opposites, the CBC Kids Reads Collection has something for everyone!

name: A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace
summary: Futami, a novice shojo manga artist, is finally publishing her beloved shogi manga, Dear Subaru. But…the stress makes her stomach hurt, she's forced to push the deadline for her first chapter, and she isn't making any progress on the storyboards. To top it off, she's gaining weight from midnight snacking and starts having wild delusions! Will Futami be able to enjoy life as a manga artist?!

name: Our Dearest Sakura
summary: It's the spring of 2009, and Hanamura Construction, the largest general construction firm in Japan, is holding its annual welcome ceremony for its new grads. Sakura stands out from the rest of the talented bunch for clearly being a country bumpkin. Hailing from a small remote island up north, she came to Tokyo alone and has no qualms about sharing her dream of building a bridge to her home town.

name: GNOSIA
summary: When a shapeshifting enemy known as Gnosia infiltrates a lone spaceship, the crew has only one way to survive: identify the imposter each day and put them into cryo-sleep. But for Yuri, the day never ends. Trapped in a time loop, she relives the first day of the crisis over and over. To escape, Yuri must uncover the truth behind Gnosia and the time loop itself—before it's too late.

name: Inexpressive Kashiwada and Expressive Oota
summary: Kashiwada-san's face is a masterpiece of stoicism. Her classmate Oota-kun? A walking explosion of emotions determined to crack her calm with over-the-top antics. (Spoiler: It's not working.) But between his failed surprises and her secret smiles, these polar-opposite classmates might just be into each other! Witness a rom-com where love speaks louder than expressions.
previous_episode: Kashiwada-san and Oota-kun and the Summer Festival

name: Let's Play
summary: Samara "Sam" Young is a developer in Los Angeles who's about to achieve her dreams with her first video game, Ruminate. That is, until a popular streamer gives the game a scathing review. Even worse, Sam finds out the troublesome critic is now her new neighbor! Get lost in a comedic, romantic, and all-too-real story about gaming, memes, and social anxiety. Come for the plot, stay for the doggo.

name: My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me!
summary: For high schooler Akiteru Oboshi, the whole youthful experience thing—like fun, friendships, and even having a girlfriend—is a complete waste of time. So when his best friend's sister, Iroha Kohinata, keeps teasing him, Akiteru naturally finds it annoying. She practically lives in his room, she's always on his bed, she's just a raging storm of clinginess! Why is she only annoying around him?!
previous_episode: My Friend's Little Sister Really Does Have It In for Me

name: Shabake
summary: Ichitaro, the frail yet sharp-minded master of Nagasakiya, rarely leaves his estate—but he's far from alone. Gifted with the ability to see spirits, he's protected by ghostly companions like Hakutaku and Inugami. One night, he slips out and witnesses a brutal murder. Soon after, Edo is plagued by a series of eerie murders. As fear grips the city, Ichitaro and his spirits must uncover the culprit.

name: Um Beijo do Gordo
summary: With never-before-seen footage, never-before-told stories, and unique access to Jô's inner life, the series offers a thrilling and hilarious journey through his comedy shows, plays, and talk shows.

name: Touring After the Apocalypse
summary: Two young girls, Yoko and Airi, travel through the empty world of post-apocalyptic Japan. They photograph the scenery of famous places and camp out in towns overtaken by nature. Together, they ride on a Serow off-road motorbike and experience a new sense of freedom, unbothered by neither traffic nor traffic lights. The world is over now, so let's hop on a bike and go on a journey!

name: Yano-kun's Ordinary Days
summary: Kiyoko Yoshida is an overanxious class representative who can't help but worry about Tsuyoshi Yano, who sits beside her. Tsuyoshi comes to school covered in bruises, and as Kiyoko tends to him day after day, the two draw closer. Where will Kiyoko's feelings take her? Will Tsuyoshi's life ever be normal? A romantic comedy between an anxious girl and a boy who's always injured is about to begin!

name: WanDance
summary: Kaboku Kotani is starting high school, and he plans to do what he's always done: go along with his friends, keep quiet, and not draw too much attention to himself. After all, it's hard enough to get by with a stutter like his—why make things worse by standing out from the crowd? But then he sees another first-year, Hikari Wanda, dancing like no one is watching—or like she doesn't care who sees her. It makes Kaboku wonder: Could he reach that same freedom? To find his way to Wanda, he does something he never thought he could: He joins the dance club. After all, every routine begins with a singl

name: Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right
summary: With her cool, mysterious aura, transfer student Ishikawa Luna is already the most popular girl in class. Ohtori, on the other hand, is so average he's practically a background character. The thought of ever speaking with Luna never even crossed his mind—until he accidentally discovers her secret: She's a vampire…who's absolutely terrible at sucking blood!

She inherited all her grandfather's inheritance, but was locked up in a wooden building by the Song family, pretending to be crazy and living a miserable life, leaving her to rot on her own. In order to seek revenge, she left the old house and set her sights on He Lian, the prince of Jinzhou, and set up a trap for him.

During a meal delivery, she witnesses Yu Fan cheating on her with the Pei Group executive Jiang Xiao Yuan. Drowning her sorrows at night, she runs into Pei Yan, Pei Group's CEO, who is framed by his brother Pei Yu because of the fight for inheritance. However, Yan loses his memory after waking up, and his temperament changes drastically. Su Ke Ke names Yan "Lucky." Because Ke Ke's mother is seriously ill, she wants to find a husband for Ke Ke. So, Ke Ke and Yan have a sudden marriage.

After leaving Tian Dong in a cruel manner, Xing is always uneasy about whether he will take revenge, but he disappears for two years. Just when she thinks she has completely gotten rid of him, he reappears on her wedding day and kidnaps her husband, Su Mu, to threaten her into a divorce. The head of the family spent twenty years working in Italy and now returns home with a decision: Sunday dinners must become mandatory for all family members. He is confident that these gatherings will help revive family ties and restore lost warmth. However, in practice, these dinners turn into not peaceful conversations, but real comedic battles with many curious situations, misunderstandings, and unexpected confessions.

This alternative capital is governed by three Great Houses: Nav, Chud and After All. Artyom finds himself in the very center of their confrontation, as a result of which his life changes forever.
