summary: A romantic story about love between Varya, figure skating world champion, and Vladimir, ice hockey star.

name: Вижу-знаю
summary: The operatives of one of the police departments are on the trail of dangerous criminals every day. They face violent gangsters and uncover intricate combinations invented by criminals to cover up crimes. But each of the police officers of the department knows that there is always a reliable shoulder of a colleague nearby.

name: Не жалею, не зову, не плачу
Трое против всех
summary: After their father is lost at sea and their mother falls into a coma, three young siblings struggle against all to hold their family together.

name: Агент
summary: The secret agent of the special services, Andrei Kozyrev, nicknamed the American, unjustly convicted of murder, once has a chance to change his life. He makes a daring escape from the colony to find his enemy, prove his innocence and save the world from a deadly new virus that threatens the death of millions of people.

name: Банды
summary: Based on the real story. After collapse of USSR former army officer don't know what to do with his life in new Russia. After some collisions with criminals he decided to join a gang by his own will.

name: Toronto Airport Uncovered
summary: For the first time, cameras go behind the scenes at Toronto Pearson International, Canada's biggest and busiest airport. They reveal how the airport keeps millions of passengers and thousands of planes moving, even when facing record-breaking snowstorms and extreme winter weather. Technical issues, emergencies, security breaches and passenger demands pile even more pressure on the flight schedule.

name: Дорогая передача
summary: A Russian sketch comedy show. The predecessor of "6 kadrov".

name: Анна Каренина
summary: Anna is torn between her love to Count Vronsky, and her loveless marriage to Mr. Karenin. Based on the book by Leo Tolstoy.

name: Анна Павлова
summary: The film is based on the biography of the legendary Russian ballerina Anna Pavlova. She became an internationally regarded ballerina after her performances in 1909 with the Dyaghilev's Ballet in Paris and in London. Anna Pavlova eventually formed her own troupe. She made a successful world tour together with Viktor d'Andre, who was her husband and manager.

name: Настоящие Детективы
summary: Zhenya Utopia and a unique experiment in which celebrity guests investigate murders, interrogate suspects, and sift through evidence. They are detectives whose job it is to find the culprits and uncover their motives. And it's not easy, as criminals are adept at covering their tracks.

name: Treacherous Cases in Shendu
summary: Li Ya'er acts as his father's proxy to receive the bride who dies in a mysterious fire that very night. He is then attacked, loses his memory, and is enslaved. When a bloody conspiracy collides with the secrets of his identity, master and servant are forced into a tragic confrontation. Behind the masks lie true hearts, and beneath the strange case, deep feelings surge. Witness how a dual-faced princess and a cold-eyed killer join forces to unravel a conspiracy and protect the Tang Dynasty under the cover of darkness!

name: Lost in Moldova
summary: Diego joins the Peace Corps to win back his ex-girlfriend. He imagines exotic locales, instead he finds himself "Lost in Moldova." Follow his adventures as he navigates the cultural differences that divide us and the shared humor and humanity that unites us.

name: Black Death Patient Zero
summary: Black Death Patient Zero explores the origins of the 14th-century Black Death pandemic, using new DNA analysis to investigate its earliest victims. The show investigates the plague's spread from Central Asia, with filming locations in the UK, Italy, and Germany, and highlights scientific efforts to trace the pandemic's roots, such as the study of plague victims found in Kyrgyzstan in 1338 or 1339.

name: Most Wanted - A hajsza
summary: Most Wanted - A hajsza is RTL's new interactive escape reality show. 24 well-known Hungarian celebrities try to escape from Balázs Sebestyén and his team of professional pursuers - without a phone or money, dressed in orange prison uniforms. The goal: to evade the hunters. Viewers could also join the action - reporting if they spotted any of the fugitives, or even helping them escape through online platforms and social media. The format engaged the entire country, with thousands of reports submitted and hundreds of people offering assistance to the celebrities.

name: Exek csatája
summary: The past haunts, the grand prize tempts! Which couple will be able to move beyond past grievances and work together for victory and a prize of up to 40 million forints? In the special game Exek csatája , participants reunite solely for the sake of the reality show. Their goal is to complete challenging tasks while skillfully navigating the emotional tensions between them. The competition isn't just about the potential 40 million forint prize - it's also about proving that the past doesn't have to hold them back from overcoming the challenges of the present.

name: The Alibi
summary: Vincent, an heir to a news empire, gets accused of killing his rival, Walter. To protect his reputation, he hires Stella, an escort with her own haunted past, to pose as his alibi. What begins as a transactional arrangement soon becomes dangerously real as their shared wounds and ambitions draw them together. But when they uncover the truth, the two are compelled to confront their true feelings.

name: Dogfood Dan and the Carmarthen Cowboy
summary: Aubrey drives a load of 'Doggy Dins' dog food from Carmarthen to Hull, and Dan drives a load of 'Bona Fido' dog food from Hull to Carmarthen. They soon find - or rather don't find - that they have more in common than they think.

name: ПАПАШИ
summary: A show in which comedians don't discuss cars, politics or sports, but... fatherhood!

name: НОСТАЛЬЖИ
summary: This is a nostalgic show from Otar Kushanashvili and Roman Kositsyn. If you remember how you brought one roll to a tea party and ate two, then this show is just for you. Our guests are nostalgic for the nineties and two thousandths, answer questions and participate in activities related to that time.

name: ПОСЛУШАЙ, ЧТО СЛУЧИЛОСЬ
summary: "Listen to what Happened" is a new true edge show from the DELA community. This is a homely, cozy podcast in which guests come to the hosts Masha and Dasha to discuss stories about serial killers, cults, robberies, mysterious cases, unsolved stories. These are our interests. Make yourself comfortable, turn off the light and pour the tea. It's going to be creepy and interesting.

name: Son Kare
summary: After being suspended from duty and only able to work under the supervision of a psychotherapist, Homicide Squad Commissioner Sare Baykal faces the most complicated murder of her career, while her path crosses with fashion photographer Atlas Demiroğlu, who came to the police station because of a film full of mysterious images. The investigation, which begins with a woman's body found in an amusement park, soon opens the doors to a multi-layered puzzle that extends to both Sare and Atlas' pasts. As each new clue draws Sare and Atlas into a dark labyrinth, the boundaries between reality, fantasy

name: Победители
summary: Their breathing is ragged, their strength is at its limit, and each new stage is harder than the last. No staged scenes – only real emotions. Pushing a 150-kilogram log, then climbing without safety equipment, and after that, without a break, heading to the firing range. It's not just difficult – the obstacle course exhausts even seasoned athletes, and special forces veterans drop out of the race. Steep climbs, sharp descents, challenges at high altitudes. summary: Heather Gay, star of "The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City" and New York Times bestselling author of "Bad Mormon," uncovers the dark history of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in "Surviving Mormonism with Heather Gay." All three parts will drop exclusively on Peacock on Nov. 12. summary: It follows Tom and Petra, a successful couple who built up a large Ica Maxi store in Linköping and sold it for a record sum to live a life of luxury in Mallorca with their sons. Ready to enjoy an eternal vacation, their lives suddenly take an unexpected turn during Tom's 50th birthday party, leading his brother Timmy and his wife Maja to move their family to the sunny Spanish island, where chaos ensues.

summary: The Gudov family lives in a small village near Moscow. Sergei is the head of a close—knit family, he has everything in order: a faithful wife, a marriageable daughter, a farm, a house. He considers his brother Semyon to be a rotten branch on the family tree. After all, Semyon is a disgrace to the Goodovs' honest name, instead of a normal business, he commands a cemetery, sauna and microloans. Sergei only lacks an heir, but suddenly Matvey appears in his house — a charming orphan boy who claims that he is his illegitimate son. From this moment on, the family idyll turns into a test for everyone

summary: A brave team of toy spies embarks on epic missions to save their beloved human family from the mischievous pet guinea pig Silver Paw.

summary: Real celebrities. Really saucy stories. Mel Giedroyc hosts the erotic showbiz book club where famous guests narrate racy fanfiction while naughty puppets bring their words vividly to life!

name: Belphégor
summary: Hafsa, a talented art restorer freshly hired at the Louvre, plunges into chaos when she comes face to face with a millennial mask of the storm god "Belphegor". Suddenly involved in a series of inexplicable disappearances, a race against time begins for her. To bring out the truth, Hafsa will have to fight against those who stake her... and against her ghosts.

name: Extra-Lucide
summary: Denise is an ordinary woman. Or almost. From a very young age, she has heard people's thoughts. No spirit resists him. How, under these conditions, to play the game of life in society? How to maintain a relationship of couple, friendship, family? How to love, how to be loved? Can we reasonably be lucid and happy at the same time?

name: Hype
summary: Milan, QT8 neighborhood. Anna, Luca, and Marco are three young people with a passion for rap music. When a prestigious record label takes notice of them, the three believe their breakthrough is near, but in the neighborhood nothing is ever guaranteed, and the group must contend with a drug dealer who doesn't want their success. With music by Ernia.

name: Les Mascots
summary: Dustin, a half-baked film major from LA, is sent to NYC to stay with- and make a documentary about- his uncle Henry, a supposedly ultra-successful Broadway actor. However, upon arrival, Dustin discovers a hidden truth: Henry shares a cramped apartment with an eccentric roommate Marlon. Worse, they scrape by performing as Elmo and Cookie Monster in Times Square. This is their story.

In this fantasy investigation series, investigators from two eras must hunt for the truth in old unsolved cases, communicating only through an old radio. The signal between the past and the present only opens at 23:23.

name: Аптекарь
summary: Five friends, acquaintances of the beer machine, from different professions, ages, and fate, threw off the bottle. And out of the bottle came a fairy named Bereginya, obliged to fulfill all the bottle owners' wishes.

name: Алые погоны
summary: A television series based on the novel of the same name by B. Izyumsky. It follows the fates of the students of the Suvorov Military School who honorably took up the baton from their commanders during the Great Patriotic War, and explores the present-day Soviet Army, shaping character, and cultivating courage in young soldiers.

name: Битва за небо. История военной авиации России
summary: "Battle for the Sky: The History of Russian Military Aviation" is a comprehensive 8-part documentary series produced by the Zvezda TV channel. The project covers more than a century of the evolution of the Russian air force—from the first wooden "shelves" of the early 20th century to today's fifth-generation supersonic fighters.

name: Без права на ошибку. История и вооружение инженерных войск
Желанная
summary: Our time. On her sixtieth birthday, Maria Grigorieva receives an envelope from a stranger. Inside, she finds a ring and an open letter signed with the pseudonym "Sweet Hedgehog." Maria recalls that this was what she used to call her numerous lovers. She mentally travels back in time to figure out who could have sent such a touching letter.

name: 13 знаков зодиака
summary: Each of us wants to know where happiness awaits. We'll look into the future and reveal all the secrets of the zodiac signs, including the power of the 13th sign.

name: Бешенл Джеографик

name: James May's Shed Load of Ideas
summary: James May returns with a brand-new series, taking on the everyday frustrations that unite a nation in grumbles. From his Wiltshire home, his pub, and most importantly his shed, James sets out to dream up imaginative fixes for the problems blighting Britain and stirring up public annoyance. Armed with his trademark wit and curiosity – and joined once again by his engineer sidekick Sim and series favourite Tony "The Tool" – James dives into a fresh set of challenges. Whether it's tackling practical irritations or exploring the country's bigger gripes, this inventive trio use humour, creativity,

name: Бес в ребро, или Великолепная четверка
summary: Four cheerful and close friends constantly get involved in different adventures. Each of them turned fifty, but they fill their lives with a bright, interesting meaning. Every day one of them gets into some kind of frivolous story. This is a series about love relationships, about the fate of four bosom friends and their true male friendship.

name: Невозможные зеленые глаза
summary: Alexander Litvinov belongs to the generation of Russian clerks. Glossy magazines impose on him a lifestyle he cannot afford; his environment demands success and professional ambition from him. Alexander's real estate career is not going particularly well; his last chance to turn things around is to get hold of a plot of land that once belonged to a pioneer camp. However, the land is occupied. Strange research is being conducted there. The aliens want to find out how humane humanity is and whether it's time to shut down the test site called Earth. To save civilization, Alexander must learn to l

name: Автономка
summary: About the lives of the crew members of the submarine "Varshavyanka". The crew members of B‑556 serve with dignity. The closed world of the submarine imposes its own conditions: there is no distinction between day and night here; you need to be on guard both day and night. But the sea prepares many unforeseen circumstances for the heroes. They will have to participate in rescuing a Russian tanker, help drowning fishermen, and assist oceanologists. Before that, the submariners will take on board the mysterious female pilot Galina, who was involved in a plane crash and ended up on the open sea. H

name: Бальзаковский возраст, или Все мужики сво...
summary: Already from the title of the film it is obvious that we are talking about residents of a big city, charming young ladies of "Balzac age" - "a little over thirty". This age formula of "maturity and flowering" was brought out by the great French theorist (and, of course, practitioner) of love Honore de Balzac in his novel "The Thirty-Year-Old Woman". The second part of the name is a direct consequence of the first. What else to do for beautiful and unmarried girls, if not the search for love? Well, where is the search - there are mistakes, and disappointments, and those same "muzhiks" who somet

name: The Haoge of Erlonghu: No Rogues Under Heaven
Hearts in Play
summary: Sunny and warm-hearted high schooler Xia Fanxing is known as the campus "hidden gem"—someone whose presence can soothe any wounded soul. Sheng Yang, a transfer student and former champion of the National Youth Table Tennis Championships, was forced to give up the sport for reasons he can't talk about. His world stays dim—until he meets her. Determined to help Sheng Yang step out of his shadows, Xia Fanxing tries every method imaginable, from gentle persuasion to hilarious tough love, leading to a series of funny and heartfelt mishaps. But as they grow closer, Sheng Yang gradually realizes that

summary: Get a stunning view of the soul, strength and spirit of this historic land on Aerial Mexico

name: The One
summary: Adapted from a novel by Feng Huo Xi Zhu Hou, the story follows a small town that looks ordinary but is secretly on the verge of collapse. As powerful forces scheme using the town as their battleground, a humble young man, Chen Ping'an, dares to challenge fate with courage and determination. Armed with only a sword, he fights to survive and protect his path forward.

name: Feng He Jin Qi Zhang Ju Zheng
Алмазная тропа
summary: Repeated attempts to locate Siberian diamonds proved fruitless. The latest expedition began with a dramatic event: the sudden death of its leader. But the geologists decided to continue their journey. Thus began a difficult, perilous trek for a handful of people along the taiga's "diamond trail."

name: Блондинка и брюнетка
summary: Olga Zhuravleva is a successful dentist and the owner of her own small clinic located in a country hotel. But Olya is unlucky in love... She has been dating a married man for four years. One morning, she learns that he has finally divorced. However, her joy is short-lived, as he divorced not for her, a stern, serious brunette, but for a young and frivolous blonde.

name: Бобры
summary: Vladimir Suvorov, a retired military man who spent 25 years in the Air Force, comes to visit Tamara, a saleswoman in the small village of Olkhovka. They met in the south, struck up a brief holiday romance, and Tamara couldn't imagine their story could continue. She invites Vladimir to live together for a while, get to know each other, and then decide what to do next. Writer Kruglikov lives next door to Tamara. With his royalties, he could have lived in Europe, but he chose Olkhovka. According to him, this is the real Russia, which the city's intellectuals don't know and fear. At first glance,

name: Богини правосудия
summary: The plot centers on four wronged women and four vibrant and complex destinies. Valentina, a former police major unjustly dismissed from the force; Zoya, a self-defense instructor who was raped in her youth; Zhenya, cruelly abandoned by her husband; and Tatyana, who served several years in prison for slander… What connects these two so dissimilar women, and is their meeting a coincidence? Is revenge their sole motivation, and why are they called "goddesses of justice"?

name: История отечественного военного альпинизма
summary: Are you convinced that mountains are an impenetrable border? That ridges and sheer cliffs will stop any enemy? Such a belief can prove costly if relied upon in national defense. As past events have repeatedly proven, an experienced enemy can use the heights as a springboard for a surprise attack at any moment. This film explores the most heroic chapters in the history of Russian military mountaineering. It explores the complex art required to defeat the enemy even when the front recedes into the clouds. We'll explain when and why mountain rifle units were created, and why they are as indispens

name: Анечка
summary: Alexey is madly in love with Anechka. She is the woman of his life. For her, he is willing to make any sacrifice, even take her blame and go to prison. Time passes, and Alexey discovers a talent for healing, learning from the herbalist Olga Afanasyevna. Believing himself to be responsible for the deaths of his loved ones, he readily gives up material possessions and embraces a reclusive lifestyle. Helping people becomes the meaning of his life.

name: Непокоренная красота
summary: The most amazing city on the planet! Emerging as if by magic, celebrated by poets, and surviving incredible trials. Petrograd. Leningrad. Petersburg. Its strength and magic remain in its beauty. The beauty that was sheltered, saved, and preserved during the war and the siege. Evacuating valuables, camouflaging domes and spires, preserving architectural monuments, hiding sculptures. What efforts did it take? And how was Leningrad reborn from the ashes of the siege?

name: Come Dine With Me: Teens
summary: Come Dine With Me: Teens will, for the first time in CDWM history, see five teenagers try their hand at cooking up a menu and hosting their own dinner parties over five nights. The 16–19-year-old competitors will score each of their competing hosts with a mark out of 10 and the overall winner will scoop a £1,000 prize.

name: V for Vendetta
summary: Based on a comic serial written by Alan Moore and illustrated by David Lloyd. The story is set in Britain in a dystopian, not-too-distant future in which the country is controlled by the fascistic Norsefire party. An anarchist named V, known for his distinctive Guy Fawkes mask, seeks to topple the government with the help of Evey Hammond, a young woman V rescued from the country's secret police.

name: Money Honey Brainy
summary: The freelance queen Xin Tong, who never turns down a gig, takes on a task from her best friend: to sabotage a blind date. Unexpectedly, her target is Wen Pei'an, heir to the Sihai Group. Facing intense pressure from his parents to marry, Wen Pei'an seizes the opportunity and hires Xin Tong to be his contract girlfriend. Together, they must outsmart the relationship inspector sent by his father, launching them into a hilarious journey of cohabitation and pretend romance.

name: Surely Tomorrow
summary: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyungdo now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.

name: Love is Always Online
summary: Entrepreneur Jiang Anlan enters a virtual game in search of his first love, Yao Yuan, launching a heartfelt pursuit that eventually brings them back together in the real world. As they prepare for their wedding, an old family feud resurfaces, putting their relationship to the test. Through misunderstandings, heartbreak, and even illness, the couple endures every trial and finally reconciling and achieving their destined happy ending.

name: Petter og familien – dit ingen drar
summary: Petter Nyquist is taking his family out into the world! Now they will live with people who know war, poverty and climate change firsthand.

name: Shutline
summary: Moon Shingun, who makes a living by repairing cars on the street, is having a disappointing day until Jake Gillan appears with a broken car. Jake eyes Shingun up while asking irritating questions. However, Shingun can't afford to lose a customer offering a large wad of cash, so he gives Jake his contact information. Shingun's goal is to avoid danger and survive each day. Soon, he learns that Jake is a high-ranking gang member, and despite his efforts to stay away, Jake seems unwilling to let him go.

name: The Chase New Zealand
summary: The Chase is on Aotearoa! Four Kiwi contestants must pit their wits against the Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius determined to stop them winning the cash prize. Hosted by Paul Henry,

name: Scout Elf Squad

name: Treasure War
summary: After the death of her husband, the leader of Loetwara business ring, Erin is being prevented by his cousin from inheriting his assets. At the same time, she needs to not only fight to survive but also preserve everything that rightfully belongs to her son. Everything she is confronted with, work, money and even love, comes seeking something from her. Erin calls all of this the war of money".

name: The Only Light
summary: Xu Xiao Yang grew up under the high pressure of her mother. She had to accept everything arranged by her mother. She always felt that she was ordinary. Even when she was in school, she had a crush on the school idol Fu Yan Li, but she didn't dare to approach him and could only escape. Ten years later, she was 29 years old and worked as a small employee in a bank. The long-term work pressure caused her ill health. name: Kampen om Pusher Street
summary: This docuseries details how one street became the epicenter of Danish drug crime -- as told by those living in and around the community.

name: My Nightmare Stalker: The Eva LaRue Story
summary: My Nightmare Stalker tells the harrowing true story of how Emmy® Award-winning actress Eva LaRue and her daughter Kaya endured 12 years of terror at the hands of a relentless stalker. Operating from the shadows, he taunted and terrorized their lives while his identity remained a mystery, even to the FBI. In this gripping account, Eva reveals the constant fear, emotional toll, and the resolve, courage and resilience it took to protect her family.

name: Younger Husband Is Deeply In Love With Me
summary: To take back her mother's company, Ye Qing Huan, the eldest daughter of the Ye family, planned to kill her father and keep her son. She chose Bo Yu Chuan in the club, but unexpectedly, Bo Yu Chuan was the richest man in Yancheng, with a net worth of hundreds of millions. He was in a car accident and lost his memory, and ended up getting together with Ye Qing Huan by accident. In fact, Bo Yu Chuan fell deeply in love with Ye Qing Huan many years ago. After regaining his memory, he hid his identity and helped Ye Qing Huan recover his mother's company.

name: Haunted Desires
summary: The story of a man trapped in an emotional and physical tug-of-war. Though he's been with his loyal and loving partner for years, the memories of his ex - who ignited a passion like no other - continue to haunt him. As her struggles with lingering desires and the comfort of his current relationship, he must decide whether to embrace the love he has or chase the fire he lost. Will he learn to let go, or will temptation pull him back into the arms of his past?

name: Sicilia Express
summary: With Christmas around the corner, two blundering Sicilian friends working in Milan discover a dumpster that transports them to their families in seconds.

name: Stygt?
summary: Are we building disturbingly ugly buildings in the world's most beautiful country? Hans Olav Brenner travels around to find out what the state of Norwegian architecture is like.

name: Nomad
summary: In the violent underworld of New Zealand's outlaw bikers, a warrior torn between two lives, two callings and two families must decide which path defines his true destiny.

This hotly contested bequeathment pushed Faith Temple into a controversial, new era. summary: Based on a web novel, this courtroom time-slip drama tells the story of an upright judge named Lee Han Yeong, who dies after being falsely accused, and ends up 20 years in the past.

name: Dérive
summary: Daniel Major, a prodigious pianist, finds himself unable to play. To heal, he must uncover the latent trauma causing his blockage. His quest for the truth, fraught with danger and pitfalls, leads him to a most disturbing revelation, leaving Daniel to face an agonizing moral dilemma.

name: 50 segundos: El caso de Fernando Báez Sosa
summary: This documentary series explores the case of Fernando Báez Sosa, whose fatal beating by a group of young men was caught on video, shocking Argentina.

name: Portraits of Delusion
summary: Set in Gyeongseong in 1935, the series follows painter Yun Il Ho, who is tasked with creating a portrait of Song Jeong Hwa—a mysterious woman who has remained out of public view for more than half a century and is the subject of countless rumors. As he steps into her world, a web of secrets begins to unravel, pulling him deeper into a suspense-laced narrative.

Emboldened by her blindness, he brazenly betrays her with his secretary right before her. However, when extreme abuse from Ye Dong's mother triggers a miraculous recovery of Lin Xia's sight, her world shatters and reforms. A phoenix rising from the ashes, she sets out on a path of vengeance to make her tormentor pay and cleanse her world of his corruption.

summary: Two of India's sharpest women, Kajol and Twinkle, host a talk show that's fun, unhinged and sneakily insightful - featuring celebrity guests, wild takes, and total chaos. Like the fun table at the party - everyone's invited.

Li Huang, now a powerful figure, purchases Lu Niansheng as her "gilded canary," only to find herself ensnared in his meticulously laid trap. A dangerous game of cat and mouse unfolds between captor and captive. From a crucible of torment and buried truths, they must unite to confront a greater enemy lurking in the shadows, forging their legend from a complex web of love and vengeance.

name: Yong Zhe Da Maoxian
summary: Scattered throughout the world is proof of an advanced prehistoric civilization. There exist those who desperately want to learn more about these ancient people. The series follows people who set out on an adventure to uncover the truth.

name: Glina. Nowy rozdział

Joining the seasoned detectives Banaś and Jóźwiak is a young, ambitious police officer - Tamara Rudnik. summary: Bill Nylander and Marie Olsson Nylander are facing their biggest renovation challenge ever - an unlikely renovation project in Sicily. They will buy, renovate and transform a 1-euro house into their dream home.

summary: Source Code is a documentary series about how the past few years have changed the games industry and the people working in it. The pandemic, the protests, the war — all of it has impacted game development. Some people lost their jobs, some had to leave their homes, others found in games a way to speak about reality. At the center of the story are developers from Ukraine, Belarus, and Russia, as well as their colleagues from other countries — speaking about work, burnout, relocation, and about how to keep living when the familiar world begins to fall apart.

name: Doden Liegen Niet
summary: Forensic pathologist Frank van de Goot takes you on a journey through his daily life with death. Driven by curiosity and a passion for his profession, he is always searching for the true cause of death. Through unconventional experiments, he gathers evidence that sheds new light on the cause of death.

name: Shakedown
summary: Shakedown is the gripping true story of how a group of ordinary Australians risked it all to expose an unlawful automated debt-recovery system that falsely accused half a million people of welfare fraud. This searing drama is set to reveal how a courageous coalition of victims, activists, journalists, and lawyers fought back against a government and bureaucracy that refused to listen - uncovering what's been described as Australia's greatest miscarriage of justice.

name: Shaun Micallef's Going For Broke
summary: In Shaun Micallef's Going For Broke , the famous writer, actor and comedian taps back into his curious side and sets out to understand a national obsession he's never quite grasped. Shaun has never understood gambling. He uses cold, hard logic when making decisions and always plays for certainty. But as viewers saw in On The Sauce , even a teetotaller can be swayed - Shaun spent one episode getting drunk to better understand Australia's relationship with alcohol. Now, he turns a sober eye to our love affair with gambling. Travelling across the country, Shaun meets punters, experts, and those a

name: The Moon Rises Above the Sea
Born To Be The Villain
summary: Lu Chengwen unexpectedly finds himself trapped inside a novel, cast as the villain destined for a brutal death. His only strategy is to lie low and survive at all costs. But when the heroines begin awakening to a power that lets them hear his thoughts, the story spirals out of control. In the end, he must join forces with the novel's awakened hero, Gu Zhantian, to challenge the very forces manipulating their fate, and in doing so, discover a path to both redemption and a way home.

name: Phoenix's Homecoming
summary: Once the most powerful princess in the realm, she was betrayed by her beloved tutor and her own imperial brother, and perished in flames. Reborn from the ashes, she now sees her former white moonlight, the revered tutor, bowing at her feet, while the prince of a rival nation serves as her hidden blade. Though the Empress sees her as a destined rival, what she intends to reclaim is far more than the throne! If love was once her chessboard, now power is her game. In the raging tide of love and vengeance, a crown awaits its true sovereign.

name: Bloom in Turmoil
summary: Betrayed by those she trusted most, Lu Xinnian transforms from a fragile heiress into a formidable warrior goddess. Tearing through labels in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles with her lover, she joins forces with the "Sisters of Bloom" to embark on an epic, passion-fueled legend in ancient times!

name: Marry Him in Her Place
summary: On her wedding night, wealthy heiress Liang Yi is disfigured and thrown into the river by her husband Song Zhichu. Unexpectedly rescued, she is forced to take on a new face and live as Xu Yin, a courtesan. "The best mask in this world is another living face." Thus reborn, she uses Xu Yin's identity to get close to gang leader Lin Yun, setting off on her path of revenge.

name: The Big Pet Project
summary: Ireland's most extraordinary pets will be showcased in The Big Pet Project - Saturdays on RTÉ One at 5.15pm and streaming now on RTÉ Player. From surfing dogs to painting ponies and goal-scoring turtles, The Big Pet Project is crammed full of the weirdest, wackiest and most talented pets and animals. Pet lovers Demi Oviawe and Adam Beales jump in their Pet Mobile and travel across Ireland to meet the nation's most pet-obsessed people and learn all about their pets. We meet more than 70 animals including axolotls in Belfast, turtles in Tipperary, hawks in Wicklow, pygmy goats in Donegal, a gian

name: DJ Carey - The Dodger
summary: Charting a Shakespearean fall from grace of epic proportions that left a generation of hurling fans, and an unknown number of victims, reeling.

name: Neven's Christmas in Limerick
summary: Neven explores the food and culture of this historic city and prepares some of his own favourite recipes for Christmas.

name: I am Boxer
summary: From 30-year boxing veteran Don Lee comes the ultimate survival competition. Ninety boxers, regardless of age, weight, or profession, gather to prove they're the best. They'll face off in explosive matches and missions on an epic scale. Who will survive to the end and be crowned the champion?

name: Baddies USA
summary: OG's hit the road across the USA with packed concerts, camaraderie and chaos.

name: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win
summary: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win , the latest installment in ESPN's 30 for 30 series, unravels how Berlusconi transformed A.C. Milan into a global powerhouse and used the club's success as a springboard to political dominance. Told over three parts, the film traces his rise from real estate and television to football glory and ultimately to the highest office in Italy. Directed by Sam Blair and produced by Box to Box Films, the documentary captures the interplay of sport, culture and politics at a defining moment in history.

name: Porta premium
summary: The consultants at the country's largest real estate agency reveal the secrets of their success, convinced that a documentary is being made about their incredible work. But the filmmaker has other intentions.

name: Kiss Kiss Sxx
summary: Each work differs in tone, style and relationships, but the eight stories, each with a completely different worldview, will be completed as a single omnibus drama.

name: The Man in the Mask: An Orkney Murder
summary: Full of jaw-dropping twists, this is the extraordinary story of the first murder in Orkney for 25 years as the police suspect a schoolboy of shooting dead a waiter in a restaurant.

name: Legally Ladies
summary: Directed by Yang Long and written by Zou Yue and Tang Xiaoning, this original drama explores the lives of female legal scribes in ancient China. Wielding their pens as blades, they unravel lies and fight for justice, breaking free from domestic confines to forge their own paths.

name: The Noble
summary: The Noble tells the story of Chen Que'er, a maid born into servitude, who uses a magnificent gown to defy fate and change her destiny.With her intelligence and courage, she breaks through every obstacle and stirs up a storm that shakes the world.

name: Angry Wind
summary: Betrayed and cast back in time to 1990, young CEO Zheng Nanfeng finds himself stripped of his title, now managing a dance hall and serving as an aide to his own wife, Zhou Zhiyi. In this era of both innocence and upheaval, he must use his foresight to turn foes into allies and thwart a smuggling ring. More profoundly, through this second chance at life and love beside his formidable wife, he discovers what truly matters. Together, they forge a legendary partnership, standing side-by-side in a tale of strength and redemption.

name: The Ultimate Vow, Unknown to You
summary: Shen Qingru's entire family is massacred. Believing Yuwen Que to be responsible, she sets out on a path of revenge. She marries into the General's household, is later confined within the palace, and becomes entangled with Yuwen Que in a tormenting cycle of love and hatred. When the truth finally comes to light, Yuwen Que is willing to sacrifice everything to protect her. The two reconcile, and Shen Qingru is restored to her true identity as the Princess of Cangzhou. Amid fierce power struggles, both ultimately find redemption.

name: The Inescapable
summary: Hidden deep within a forest of toxic miasma, Baixiao Manor has remained an enigmatic forbidden zone for decades. On the eve of the manor's legendary nocturnal feast, the lord vanishes without a trace. Enter Ye Li, a condemned prisoner who volunteers to investigate, joining forces with Hua Qiankun, a catcher from the Supreme Court. As they step into the heart of the mystery, they unwittingly unravel a conspiracy that threatens to eclipse the very heavens...

name: United FC
summary: It's time to cheer on your new favourite team - United FC . Get to know the squad in the feel-good teen docuseries that will have you kicking every ball and kick-starting crucial conversations across Ireland. The new series is presented by Jordan Conroy, two-time Olympian and Irish Rugby Sevens legend along with footballer, presenter and content creator Vanessa Ogbonna - did we mention she won The Traitors Ireland too?! United FC brings together 15 teenagers from diverse Irish backgrounds for the ultimate team challenge. Part coming-of-age story, part football camp, this thought-provoking seri

name: Highclere: Behind Closed Doors
summary: Highclere: Behind Closed Doors provides viewers with a unique insight into the lives of Lord and Lady Carnarvon, who manage the estate, and their dedicated staff. The series captures the challenges and triumphs they face in maintaining the historic castle while also preparing for various events and attracting visitors.

name: Gimme Sugar
summary: Gimme Sugar is a reality show that follows Charlene Borja as she attempts to launch LGBT ladies club nights, showing the entire process as she mixes business with pleasure. In the first season, Charlene and four of her friends -- frequent party girls but newbie promoters -- start the Truck Stop in Los Angeles. In season 2, Charlene and Davonee relocate to Miami to start a new event in South Beach, which proves more challenging since the scene caters to a tourist crowd.

name: Cabo
previous_episode: Capítulo Final: El amor verdadero es eterno

name: Jiu Yang Wushen
summary: Once betrayed and killed at the peak of his power, Ye Yunfei is reborn into his younger self—the moment his martial veins were first destroyed. With all the memories of his past life, he seizes this second chance to protect his loved ones, outmaneuver rival clans and sects, and rebuild his strength.

name: The Golden Egg
summary: After a sudden transfer to the department she dreaded most, Hinako hunts for tabloid scoops at a weekly magazine and searches for meaning in her work.

name: Les saisons
summary: 30 years of a love chase between Camille, Alexandre and Martin, teenage friends, becoming over the decades husband, wife and lover, with, as the center of gravity of these sentimental tears, an old family home in Les Sables d'Olonne, motionless witness of the joys and sorrows of these restless hearts.

name: Kasaba
summary: Selim is strapped for cash. Efe would do anything to help him. When they find a trunkful of stolen money, it becomes a moral dilemma neither want to face.

name: He Qing Hai Yan
summary: Tang He Qing, a young woman from a seaside town, crosses paths with Zhou Hai Yan, who abandoned police academy after his father died in the line of duty. Her arrival rekindles his dream of becoming a criminal police officer. Together, they take on a campus drug-trafficking network and gradually fall in love. But when the truth behind his father's death comes to light, Zhou Hai Yan conceals his identity and goes undercover to uncover the truth and bring the criminals to justice.

name: Far Cry
summary: The limited series from Executive Producers Noah Hawley and Rob Mac, with Mac set in the starring role, is based on Ubisoft's global hit video game franchise of the same title and the series will retain Far Cry's signature standalone storytelling format, with each season set in a new setting following a new cast of characters.

name: The Unseen
summary: While investigating her sister's alleged suicide, blogger Shen Man plunges into a bizarre case involving obstetrician Ai Xia's hysterectomy and becomes the prime suspect. Female police officer Jiang Li helps clear her name. A single postcard, linking the two cases, forces these two opposing women to join forces. However, a second murder swiftly follows, thickening the fog of mystery...

name: Echoes of Love
summary: Modern beauty blogger Song Zhiyun unexpectedly crosses over and becomes Liu Ruyan, a Song Dynasty courtesan. She finds herself caught up in a shocking conspiracy. To uncover the truth, she goes undercover at Huanyue Pavilion and joins forces with a calculating young lord, uncovering a shocking secret along the way!

name: High & Low Born to be High
Executor Across Worlds
summary: Travel through different worlds, crush the villains and rewrite fate! Ace executor Su Luxia is here ,her comeback starts now!

name: The Spooky Love Tale
summary: Ghosts aren't real... right? Chan has a wild imagination as a horror-novel author with a knack for turning his mundane life into a harrowing ghost story. These spooks live only in his head... that is until he meets Min, a man haunted by the supernatural specters in Chan's novel! With everything around him suddenly turning into an eerie mess, is Chan's growing love for Min the reason why his heart is racing? Or is it the bloody ghost behind him?

name: You Maniac
summary: Handsome, tasteful Dean likes to party and seduce, never wanting to be tied down. However, after accepting a request from his good friend Ten, Dean finds himself doing whatever it takes to win over contradictory artist Moth. You see, Ten wants to pursue Pun, but Pun has feelings for Moth. At first, Dean doesn't give much thought to flirting, but Moth's indifference to him triggers his competitive instinct to win.

name: Winner
summary: Lu Yunxiang, who takes over his late brother's courier business and transforms it into a modern logistics empire. From a small time entrepreneur to a listed company leader, his journey reflects the rise of China's private delivery industry and a generation that dared to dream big.

name: Match Point
summary: Perfect school tennis player Sun and indie, arts-track boy Bay have feuding fathers. Their families own competing dim sum restaurants on Krong Thong Road: Sun's family's old, traditional shop Saming Phon Fai, and Bay's family's Merlion, a new spot famous for its shumai. When Bay enters a tennis tryout to annoy Sun and Sun loses due to an injury, the principal orders a rematch. In turn, their fathers Chun and Bee strike a deal: whichever family loses must close their dim sum business for good. When the day of the match arrives and circumstances push them to take up representing the school as a

name: Weirdo-101
summary: Without realising it, Niran starts getting closer to Cheewa, the school's nerdy student. When he tries to distance himself, he discovers their paths are already completely intertwined.

name: Write You Again
summary: After an accident 10 years ago, Nine lost all his memories. He decides to return to the house where he lived as a child and, once there, he reunites with someone important from his past.

name: Billionaire Biker
summary: O makes a huge mistake when he confuses his future boss for a motorbike taxi driver. He thinks he's in trouble — but ends up becoming his boss's favourite person.

name: Kiss Me, Remember?
summary: Pas, who has lost his memory is saved from drowning through mouth-to-mouth. When he realises that every time he kisses Kit, the guy who saved him, a piece of his memory returns, he suddenly wants to kiss him all the time.

name: My Professional Boyfriend
summary: When the son of a mafia boss needs to find a boyfriend to escape his father's control, he decides to hire someone who will pretend they are in a relationship.

name: Twenty One
summary: When Aii and Koon are heartbroken by the same person, the two take comfort in each other and find they have a lot in common. Given all the time they're spending together, to make things easier, they agree to live together. As their closeness grows, Koon's bandmates attempt to persuade Koon to act on what they sense goes beyond friendship. Afraid of losing what they have but also of losing Aii if he can't return his feelings, Koon proposes a twenty-one day experiment to see if Aii can make him fall for him.

name: Lovers & Gangsters
summary: In 1956, "Hong Sen", known as Hong Sen Kai Yod, the leader of the Nine Yod gang in Thonburi, and "Seng", aka Seng Kluang, the leader of the gang in the dusty district of Phra Nakhon, started a battle from the unsolved rage of the past. But in the midst of the two gangs that are ready to fight every time, love is formed in unexpected ways.

name: Good Boy
summary: Thirty-year-old Jiraphat passes away with regrets and is given the chance to start his life over at age seventeen. Determined to make the most of this second chance, he sets out to change the mistakes of his past and live a better life than before. His return brings him closer to Ruth Atiwitch, the student president and a childhood friend he had once forgotten. As their relationship gradually grows closer, Jiraphat's second life becomes about more than correcting the past. It also becomes a journey of getting to know someone again who may become an important part of his life.

name: When Oranges Fall
summary: A school-age love story that begins with an orange—when an orange from the yard of Ko Song falls into the yard of his neighbor and classmate Ko Neung. Despite sharing the same nickname, the two couldn't be more different. An unlikely friendship slowly blossoms into a close bond, with the "oranges" bringing them together. The story also follows the friendship of their group of friends—Augar, Achi, August, and their classmate, Tle—all set against the backdrop of school life in the 90s. How will the oranges lead them to love?

name: Gunshot
summary: A mysterious murder case brings police officer Kongphon to Mini, a glass artist with hidden wounds and secrets. As he gets closer to uncovering the truth, suspicious turn to love. The person he wants most to protect may be the very person he must capture, heart and duty pulling him in opposite directions.

name: Greatest Basslines
summary: Series celebrating music's killer basslines and the glory of the bottom end. Following the same format as Greatest Guitar Riffs and with A-List musical talent at its heart, each episode is authored by a different bass expert, offering three unique perspectives of experience and expertise and allowing the series to traverse through multiple genres: rock, funk, disco & hip hop and reggae & club culture. Each episode combines newly-shot interviews, immersive experiences and masterclasses from each author alongside exciting archive and new contributions from a range of musicians that speak to the

name: Roommate Chaos
summary: Three couples who share dorm rooms find themselves beginning to develop unexpected feelings - A prodigy student who loves to party and the strict dorm supervisor. Two actors who are cast to lead a BL stage play together, and two complete opposites; one is a morning person, the other is a night owl.

name: Plan B to U
summary: With his life savings, Nile purchases a house owned by Art, the CEO of record company Rabbit Hole, for a bargain price. However, it turns out the house is haunted. Nile tries to return the sale, but Art refuses, so Nile comes up with a plan B: land an internship at Rabbit Hole and exact his revenge.

name: 17th Spring
summary: Marn, who was born with HIV, transfers to a new school, where he meets Than, a rebellious student. As they grow closer, they begin to bring out the best in each other.

name: Simon Cowell: The Next Act
summary: Simon Cowell wants to discover the next great boy band. Can he balance the dreams of young hopefuls with the harsh realities of the music industry?

name: How to Survive My CEO
summary: One evening, completely drunk, Pafon kisses a stranger. When he starts his new internship, that stranger turns out to be his boss Phatlom, who, hooked on Pafon's kiss, appoints him as his personal photographer.

name: The Sweet Journey
summary: After her marriage to a cheating CEO falls apart, a determined single mother overcomes poverty by building a successful dessert business with the support of a kind deliveryman, ultimately choosing her hard-won independence and new love over her ex-husband's belated remorse.

name: Cupid's Ghost
summary: Florist Phut is afraid of ghosts and, therefore, funerals. When Phut startles at a ghost in Jett's funeral home, Jett offers him a job communicating with the recently deceased he provides services for.

name: Unlucky Bae
summary: In trying to curse the guy who just dumped him, Rin, a fine arts student and heir to a family of sorcerers, accidentally hits the wrong person. Khobfah, a third-year business administration student, with his spell. While he can't undo the bad luck he's brought about, he'll try to use his own good luck to balance out Khobfah's misfortune.

name: The Invisible Dragon
summary: Khun is a passionate young man eager to become the Lion's Head for the Dragon Festival. But he's also interested in Earn. Earn, on the other hand, is more concerned with summoning the dragon. Being an adopted child, he doesn't have dragon blood flowing in his veins. As they train, Earn and Khun grow closer, but an obstacle stands in their way: Leng.

name: I Will Always Save You
summary: When musician Pepper is forced to enter the witness protection program after witnessing a murder committed by the son of an influential politician, Lieutenant Pongpuen is assigned to protect him. The two have a complicated history involving Pongpuen's ex. Despite clashing, Pongpuen has sworn to protect Pepper from any danger that might threaten him.

name: Arrest and Action
summary: Two argumentative lieutenants are assigned to go undercover in the entertainment industry to investigate a case. But their dynamic causes problems — and now the two of them are forced to film a BL series together so as not to blow their cover.

name: Mr. Kill
summary: Kaye, a famous manga artist, finds himself under the watchful eye of Phat, the inspector overseeing a serial murder case, after the victims' profiles, killing methods, and crime scenes are found to bear a suspicious resemblance to scenes from Kaye's old work. Thrown together by circumstances, the two must join forces to uncover the truth, solve the case, and track down the killer. Along the way, two strangers slowly find themselves bound by something that feels a lot like trust. But the deeper they dig, the more the past resurfaces, and what it reveals beginning to shake their relationship. As

name: Her
summary: On their wedding night, groom Apo catches the bride with her stepfather, Chawin, who attacks Apo to protect their secret. Apo is mutilated and believed to be dead. In order to seek vegeance, Apo becomes a woman and installs herself as Chawin's secretary. In this position, Apo gets to know a member of the family, Porpan, and identifies her as their weakness...or her own.

name: Oxytoxin
summary: At St. Cecilia, there's an influential and feared high school friend group known as Toxxxxin led by Aidao, Gale, Chelsea, and Meimei. When bullied scholarship student Junjai comes into their orbit, Aidao finds her to bear a striking resemblance to the girl haunting her dreams. The girls take her in and elevate her social status as they pursue dreams of modelling and designing. The real world, however, is no dream, and the girls are plunged into trials they've never had to face before.

name: The Cross-Dressed Union
summary: Plagued by a realm left defenseless after his predecessor's purges, the new emperor Yan Lin faces crises at home and abroad. To shield the general's son, Nan Chenxiao, who hides in female disguise, and Rui Yu, who serves in court as a man, Yan Lin ordains a marriage between them, seeking a new variable in the desperate situation. Through shared trials and life-and-death journeys, the two uncover each other's secrets, kindle a hidden love, and ultimately help Yan Lin usher in a prosperous age.

name: Love's Echoes
summary: Clara and New shared the same dream: to become idols. Today, one of them shines bright under the spotlight, while the other stays in the shadows, having turned to writing. Their paths cross again when a novel of New's is getting a screen adaptation and Clara discovers the truth behind their estrangement: New gave up because of a tumor deteriorating her hearing. Once very close, will this reunion allow them to revive their bond... or perhaps build something altogether stronger?

name: Enemies with Benefits
summary: Head of Sales Lal is determined to triumph over Head of Accounting Wine. Wine is her polar opposite and known for her mercilessness. When a night of spontaneity leads them to a friends with benefits relationship, they'll do anything to keep it a secret, pretending to be enemies so that absolutely no one at work finds out. Without realising it, however, their newfound closeness begins to give way to love.

name: Moonshadow
summary: After a painful breakup, Jan, the owner of a cozy bar, shuts her heart off from love and focuses solely on surviving in the shadows of her past. Everything changes when Key, a bold young singer, steps into her world after a one-night encounter openly declaring she wants to be Jan's sugar baby. What begins as a purely physical arrangement morphs into something deeper as Key's warmth begins to melt Jan's icy walls. Just as their feelings become undeniable, Jan's ex unexpectedly returns, testing the fragile bond forming between them.

name: Wish Upon a Star
summary: A story of two young women who share the name. After the Dao who shines so bright tragically loses her life, forgotten and lonely Dao travels back in time to high school to save her life. In order to do succeed, she'll have to find the courage to do what she never dared to and stand by her side.

name: Bake Love Feeling
summary: Though we got off to a bad start, I hope that we'll get close and that I'll be able to work smoothly with you. I don't know if it's from proximity or what that's making my heart race. I have to keep telling myself that the kindness you've been showing me is only out of obligation, don't take it so seriously!

name: Ditto
summary: This is the story of two very different women. One is a promising ballerina, rich and arrogant. The other is a well-mannered flight attendant, always ready with a smile. The two share nothing in common...except for a name. Rafah. Somehow, fate joins them together in a fall from heaven—a flight attendant with a fractured wing and a dancer with a broken leg.

name: Обыкновенный фашизм
summary: Mikhail Romm creates an original montage film using newsreel footage from another country. The director drew on German archives, collections of photographs confiscated from German soldiers, and the archives of postwar anti-fascist organizations to recount the origins and characteristics of the movement that led to the outbreak of World War II. The film opens with footage shot by Romm's team specifically for the project in the 1960s. These scenes depict everyday life in Prague, Moscow, and Berlin. This peaceful exposition leads into the main narrative. The film presents documentary evidence of

name: Casa-Abrigo
summary: Inspired by true stories, we follow Vera, Madalena, Conceição and Gabriela, victims of domestic violence in a shelter. Together, they rediscover their place, while trying to gain independence and security to start a new life. Each episode is dedicated to one of the women and also to Joana, the psychologist who accompanies them. A personal sharing and a unique testimony from women who are not defined by the dramatic situation they find themselves in, without ever being able to forget it.

name: Past, Present, Perfect?
summary: In high school, Shantal (2003) experienced the pangs of first love after she met Sir Daniel, her Filipino teacher. Fast forward to the present, Shantal (2018) now pursuing a career in writing, gets the biggest surprise of her life as she crosses paths with Sir Daniel once again in their high school reunion. Has the time already come for Shantal's unrequited love to be reciprocated by the man she admires the most? Will the perfect love she dreamt of ever come true?

name: Sins of the Father
summary: A self-made man has spent his life building an honest name, desperate to escape his estranged father's criminal legacy. Now, falsely implicated in his father's sins, he must fight to prove his innocence before they destroy everything he holds dear.

name: Love at First Spike
summary: A former basketball team captain finds himself in a tough situation as he is forced to join the school's boys' volleyball varsity team composed of queer members.

name: Let Me Into Your Heart
summary: Two performers from different fields have to come together to collaborate on a new series, "A Playful Kiss in Likay Style," with likay hero Ja helping lead man Jack prepare for his role. On the outside, everything appears to flow seamlessly, but behind the scenes, the two are clashing like mad.

name: Вечерняя школа
summary: Dimon, an officer of the patrol and guard service, is forced to sit down at his desk again in order to receive a secondary education certificate and retain his position. People of all ages and backgrounds come to night school with him for various reasons. Here they relive familiar school situations: the first two, the first fight and, of course, the first kiss. They will hear the phrase "didn't you forget your head at home?" again, they will find themselves in the Kamchatka classroom, close their mouths and open their notebooks.

name: The Sparrow's Gambit
summary: After being betrayed by her adoptive father, the formidable and beautiful assassin Qingmao is left for dead. In her final moments, she uncovers the truth that the mastermind behind her family's annihilation has been lurking nearby. Burning with vengeance, she bides her time for five years, reinventing herself as the enchanting songstress Liu Rumeng. Now, under this new identity, she sets her revenge plan in motion...

name: One Night In Lincoln
summary: The multi-talented Mike Harding entertains an audience at the Theatre Royal, Lincoln, with his one-man show.
previous_episode: It's Hard to be an Angel When You're 65

name: Shall We Dance
summary: As children, Crown Prince Chu Ying forms an unexpected friendship with the young eunuch Xiao Man, and the two grow up inseparable. When the late emperor passes away, Chu Ying ascends the throne, while Xiao Man is driven out of the palace. Ten years later, Xiao Man returns in disguise, posing as a man. Though they appear close on the surface, both keep their guard up, quietly testing one another. After enduring court intrigue side by side, their relationship begins to shift, and feelings long buried slowly come to light...

name: The Princess Decree
summary: A revenge born of a political marriage reunites the Grand Princess with her former lover at court. Love and rivalry entwine, yet in the end, they discover that only each other can save them. Hand in hand, they play the empire like a chessboard, crafting an age of splendor together.

name: Glory in Shadows
summary: Forced to marry the "deceased" General Li Jingchuan, Shen Yaochu discovers he faked his death. After her mother died under suspicious circumstances, she vows to uncover the truth. Starting as mutual users, they gradually become inseparable allies. In the Li Mansion, they battle the hostess, solve mysteries and investigate murders. Finally, they expose long-hidden conspiracies and find true love.

name: Holy Light
summary: This series follows the journey of intellectual Yi Gaoyuan and the innocent Xizang girl Gesang Meiduo, who meet and connect in Xizang. Their bond deepens into love at Xizang Public School. Centering on their story, the drama portrays the founding and development of Xizang Public School, the first institution of higher learning established by the Communist Party of China in inland China for Xizang. It highlights the tremendous changes brought by the peaceful liberation to Xizang and its people, and depicts the challenging yet steadfast path of New Xizang's progress.

name: Hunting for Crime · Red Deep Grudge
summary: A string of bizarre deaths rocks the Lin Mansion. Madam Lin, a maid, and others are found dead. Each scene is marked by a mysterious scarlet opera robe. Rumors of a "curse from the costume" spread like wildfire. Detective Huang Jinrong, joined by forensic experts Li Chuncheng and Duan Qingqing, digs into the case. They unravel not only the injustice suffered by Bai Mei, the woman behind the robe, but also the Lin family's hidden affairs, corruption, and a long-buried truth of revenge.

name: Shen Xian Dao Zhi Yuan Jian Qing Shan
Secret By My Name
summary: Tan Jianfei, the newly appointed CEO of the Tan Group, is drawn into a dangerous crisis. His former lover Li Shujing suddenly enters the company and challenges him in a ruthless struggle for power. As they clash again and again, old feelings quietly reignite. Unbeknownst to him, Li Shujing has returned as a seeker of truth, determined to uncover the cause of her father's death. When the truth finally emerges, what remains between them is a legacy of family feuds and a carefully laid trap disguised as love.

name: The Architect

summary: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a football player -- altering both of their fates.

One evening Naomi, her aging mother, declares that she has lost the purpose of life and asks Vered to kill her. Vered does not agree and goes on a wild journey in order to find meaning in both of their lives.

A suburban couple's act of kindness towards a storm-soaked stranger leads to a costly scam. A single mother's trust in a supposed delivery person turns into a hostage situation. A woman's door-to-door evangelism covers up a sinister cult recruitment scheme.

In 1874 Heinrich Schliemann announced he had found the legendary city of Troy and caused a sensation. His discoveries have been challenged, and yet ushered in a golden age of archaeology. name: Dad tries his best

summary: Deep in the Black Forest, a witch named Luna lived quietly in a house of poisonous mushrooms. Poisonous mushrooms often grew wherever she touched or walked, and her breath and skin were laced with poison. The townspeople called her the "Champignon Witch." Feared as a black witch, no one approached her. Luna continued to travel to town today to sell her medicines. summary: Explores how young NBA stars and marketing execs drove an explosion in global popularity in sneakers in the 1990s.

summary: Fred Marsac built his life around jazz. He was happy with his family, alongside his wife and two children, Estelle and Sam. When his wife died in a car accident, he disappeared. He entrusted Sam and Estelle to his in-laws, only to reappear four years later. The welcome is frosty. Estelle rejects him, and his in-laws resent him. To redeem himself, Fred accepts a position as a music teacher at a middle school. The principal, Isabelle Martinet, reluctant to integrate him into the teaching staff, assigns him the most difficult class.

In the smoke-filled clubs of Hamburg's St. Pauli's red-light district, an inexperienced young rock ‘n' roll band from Liverpool collide with two young artists, Klaus Voormann and Astrid Kirchherr. Together they help spark a transformation that turns a scrappy group of teenagers into the greatest music phenomenon the world has ever known: The Beatles.

Yaki, a self-absorbed aspiring author, scrambles to protect his secret while Shay revels in his newfound power. Their escalating feud takes a dark turn when Shay enlists the help of a sinister neighbor who happens to also be the local pedophile, and Yaki involves an ex-detective to unmask the blackmailer. As their schemes spiral out of control, the fractured family faces trying consequences, culminating in a desperate fath

It seems obvious that Lebedev is the culprit. But it soon emerges that his son disappeared on the evening of the murder. As Kira unravels the case, she realizes it is directly related to her own personal tragedy...

The city's power is divided between the local crime boss, Uma, and the corrupt head of the criminal investigation department, Mamonov. As the city undergoes significant changes, they engage in a criminal war, each seeking to gain full control over the construction and its billions of dollars in funding.

name: Я отменяю смерть
summary: Rita inherited an old bracelet from her mother, which simply fell from the hand of a dead woman, but during her lifetime she never took it off. The girl put on the bracelet and realized that now she can hear the voices of the dead, or rather, their cries for help, and also move in time, just for a day, but this is enough for her to have time to prevent someone's death. Rita quickly realizes that the bracelet cannot be removed and there is no escape from the strange gift. Then she gets a job at the morgue to be closer to those who need her help.

name: Does It Count If You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?

Beautiful, brainy, and an indispensable office worker for a robotics manufacturer, Akane's admired at work...because her colleagues can't see her at home. Privately, Akane's a hot mess with an apartment that looks more like a landfill than a living space. Good thing she drunkenly ordered a new android named Nadeshiko to help her clean up! Well, maybe not good, because the beautiful lady android that arrives is a horny hottie. Akane's about to get more service than she expected!

This event forces Melchor Marín, one of the agents in charge of the investigation, to relive his dark, complex, and forgotten past. Politics, ambition, family, money, sex, religion, history…and revenge. A crime that will change the lives of everyone in Terra Alta.

Her love life is always precarious, torn between her affection for Claudio, her ex-husband, and her passion for Domenico, a charming gynecologist. Her family is also in tatters, between a cynical and spiteful mother and a recently deceased father who kept a painful truth from her. But despite it all, Mina never loses her smile or the strength to help everyone.

Later, on her wedding night, she walked into the bridal chamber only to find her husband in an illicit affair with another woman. When she confronted him, instead of receiving an explanation, she was brutally murdered and thrown off a cliff. Miraculously, Wen Yueqian survived the fall, and alongside her, Xiao Jin, unwilling to meet his end, was also resurrected. From that moment on, their fates became intertwined.

name: Fuochi d'artificio
summary: Four teenagers decide to secretly help the Italian Resistance in the fight against the Nazi invaders. A great partisan adventure and a story of love and friendship, told from the point of view of thirteen-year-old Marta.

name: Le onde del passato
summary: Elba Island, summer 2004. Anna and Tamara are two young friends attending a summer music event. After the concert, invited to a party on a yacht, they are raped. Twenty years later, Tamara calls Anna and tells her she's caught one of the molesters, but when Anna arrives on the island, the man is dead. Who was it? The case is assigned to possibly an old acquaintance of Anna's, c ommissario Luca Bonnard, who focuses his suspicions on Tamara. But Anna fights to prove her friend's innocence, find the real killer, and find the other rapists.

name: Chris Ramsey's Alternative Christmas Guide
summary: Hosted by British comedian Chris Ramsey, the show is all about embracing the joy of throwing a Christmas party, with minimal effort, whoever the guests happen to be… Across three episodes, Chris takes on the ultimate festive challenge hosting three big Christmas get-togethers. From prepping canapés to decking the halls and keeping guests entertained, he's on a mission to prove that anyone can throw a proper Christmas bash without the stress. Expect laughter, a few mishaps, and plenty of festive spirit along the way!

name: Primeri inspektorja Vrenka
summary: In an elite Maribor neighborhood, a cleaning lady finds the bloodied body of a prominent doctor. Although traces point to a suicide, a handful of illogical details become reason enough for Inspector Vrenko to open an investigation. It turns out that not only the neighborhood is cold and sterile, also its residents are cold and inaccessible. After the first conversations, Vrenko can't shake the feeling that all the interlocutors are hiding something and at the same time everyone is watching out for everyone.

Fraud victim Andrei Beburishvili, professional psychotherapist Vasily Beinarovich and two anti-fraud bloggers Alexander Kharchevnikov and Ilya Blanco analyze real cases of deceived victims right in the studio, and also give viewers tips for countering scams.

name: КИБЕР ВЕЧЕР
summary: Andrey Beburishvili, German Gromov, Sergey Gorokh and Dmitry Liks communicate with esports players and just popular people who like to play games on the most interesting topics. Counter-Strike, Dota2, Valorant, LoL, The Legend of Zelda, Dark Souls, Super Mario, Resident Evil, Halo, Doom, Minecraft, The Last of Us, GTA, Twitch, Elo, MM: if you buy the meaning of these words or have ever heard them, go watch, we created it.

name: Second Chance Love
summary: In Second Chance Love , five pairs of first loves reunite for a two-week journey filled with nostalgia, emotional reflection, and intimate dates. Led by our hosts, they revisit their pasts, confront unfinished business, and rediscover what once brought them together. As they build new memories and lean on each other for support, one big question remains: will they rekindle the spark they once had or discover that love belongs in the past? summary: Domenico "Mimmo" Dodaro, a labor inspector known for his integrity, moves to Lucca with his daughter Mimì after the death of his wife. Hosted by Alessandro, a family friend who was paralyzed in the same accident that killed Domenico's father, they find support from their relatives. While Mimì and Alessandro try to help him rebuild his life, Domenico tackles new cases and uncovers a shocking truth about his father's death that puts him in danger.

name: Быть Джиганом и Оксаной
summary: Parents with many children, rapper Dzhigan and influencer Oksana Samoilova, will let viewers into the most intimate corners of their lives and honestly tell them about the events of the past few months.

summary: "Putting Things in Order" is a show in which Natalia Zubareva, a preventive medicine doctor, checks apartments using her unique technique to detect threats that you don't even know about. Human health directly depends on the space that surrounds it. A house is an organism that can fail even if everything around it is shining clean.

Not only in the Netherlands, but across Europe's largest cities, they try to remain elusive, while six fanatical duos, aided by viewers at home, open the hunt.

This new series follows the five fearless hosts as they dive headfirst into the world of marine leisure, tackle extreme challenges and wild stunts, and encounter hilarious mishaps along the way.

name: Hammam
summary: A team of fighters is sent to "Hammam," a God-fearing outpost in the Jordan Valley, where a series of mysterious events shakes everyone's routine and psyche. Power relations are tested, loyalties are shattered, and above all, an ancient curse hangs over them: a forgotten biblical story that is reawakened through the soldiers.

After Liang Qing Yan loses his memory, he secretly unravels a conspiracy, making the two become closer again in the midst of crises, with a mutual emotional tension that is irresistible.

In each episode, the hosts, along with sports stars, conduct spectacular experiments and test unusual hypotheses to answer the most interesting questions. How to lose weight with the help of the brain? Who is stronger left-handed or right-handed? What is the most dangerous shot in sports? You will see all this in the Science Sports show!

name: Darna

Indeed, she's had the nickname "Prince" as long as she can remember. That is, until she met Ichimura-senpai…the only person who's really seemed to see her for herself. To her surprise, she's not sure how to handle this new relationship, especially when her newfound friend is a prince himself (and a guy prince, at that). The story of the two high school princes starts here!

After suffering a serious injury, professional soldier Oleksandr Krechet can no longer return to the front lines and is forced to find his place in civilian life. After regaining consciousness following an amputation, Oleksandr faces not only physical pain, but also inner demons — the image of his fallen comrade Serhiy Verba appears in his mind. name: First Dates Beach Club

This isn't just dinner, drinks and done; it's cocktails by the pool and sangria on the sand, with sparks flying in all directions. Anything is possible when romance meets holiday bliss and endless sunshine.

name: The Year From Space

Drugs van de Duivel

summary: This absorbing true-crime series takes a fresh look at shocking and well-publicized mysteries -- with exclusive interviews, recent developments, and critical updates coming together to produce inspired new theories in the search for truth and justice.

name: Zero Star: The Cam Ward Story

summary: Xu Jingxi quits her city job and sets out to Dali, Yunnan, to live her final days without regret. Losing her wallet upon arrival, she turns to Wen Shan, a quiet employee at the guesthouse, and works there to repay her debt. As the carefree Jingxi and reserved Wen Shan share daily life under the Dali sky, they gradually open up, finding warmth, healing, and love in each other's company - a tender story of courage and connection between two women.

name: Broken (of) Love
summary: A woman betrayed by her fiancée and returning not for healing but to "finish what was started"

name: Похищенная
summary: Kristina Malakhova, an environmental expert, is in the process of divorcing her husband, Yakov, whom she suspects of infidelity. One day, Kristina arrives in the town of Drevlyansk to conduct an environmental assessment and gets into a conflict with a local developer. This story is captured on local television, and soon a stranger, Svetlana Kalinina, approaches Kristina. She claims that Kristina is her daughter, kidnapped thirty years ago! The heroine begins her own investigation. Her attempts to uncover her true past lead to a series of deaths.

summary: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

name: Only You

Before anyone can stop her, she is already on her way to South Korea with her long-time best friend, Jonathan. But it soon becomes clear to her that skill alone is not enough to make her pass such a difficult course. So in her desperate attempt to succeed and create a good life for her family, she goes in search for a woman who can teach her a winning recipe.

name: Teach Me
summary: Teach Me centers on a teacher wielding power over an impressionable but unreliable student, chronicling what happens when that student becomes the teacher as an exploration of the blurred lines between sex, power and addiction.

name: La linea della Palma
summary: The troubled journalist Anna Romano investigates the theft of a famous Caravaggio painting trying to uncover the truth about her father's mysterious disappearance. Drawn into the world of art trading, amidst financial intrigue and shady dealings with the mafia, she soon realizes that her family is hiding dangerous secrets.

summary: Set 30 years in the future, San Country has fallen under the control of AI. A group of young people determined to take charge of their own destinies forms the Random Alliance and launches a real-time confrontation against the AI, Zero.Eventually, by integrating the ancient wisdom of the I Ching, the Random Alliance defeats Zero with a universal random formula. They rectify Zero's upgrade trajectory, ushering in an era of harmonious coexistence between humanity and artificial intelligence.

name: Under the Surface

At the instigation of a down-and-out heiress, an innocent girl disguises herself as the idealized first love of a social-climbing man to uncover the truth behind her lover's death. This time, they are determined to reclaim everything that is rightfully theirs！

name: The Royal Highness of the Princess
summary: When C-list actor An Ran accidentally transmigrates into a script, she plays the fool to find her way back to the modern world. Her attempt to save a minor character, however, pulls her into the revenge plot of Yu Wenrui, a scheming chief minister. Now posing as the minister's loyal lackey, An Ran must navigate a partnership built on mutual deception, all while a conspiracy to overthrow the Yunmi Empire unfolds around them...

name: Incas: The Rise and Fall
summary: The rise and fall of the Inca is a story of a civilization marked by gold, power and ingenuity. From monumental cities and vast empires stretching across the Andes to dazzling treasures that inspired legends, the Incas conquered millions and reshaped South America. But their golden age ended suddenly, leaving behind mysteries, monumental ruins, and a legacy that still captivates the world.
