Arno Kantelberg, Défano Holwijn, Dionne Slagter, Juultje Tieleman, Marouane Meftah, Maxim Hartman, Margriet van der Linden, Teun Kapitein, Victoria Koblenko, and Vonneke Bonneke take on the most strategic challenge of their lives.

name: Pojken i Grannhuset
summary: Journalist Linnéa Krook recognizes her childhood crush Anton on TV and decides to find out why he disappeared 20 years ago. As Linnéa starts digging into the past, more and more questions arise. Why did he prefer playing horse with 12-year-old Linnéa rather than spending time with Linnéa's 17-year old older sister, his girlfriend of the same age? And why did he write passionate love poems in Linnéa's friendship book? The series follows both Linnéa's search for the truth and Anton's own struggle as being attracted to minors.

name: Opgelicht In De Liefde?
summary: Ellie Lust and her team confront fraudsters who have not only broken the hearts of their loved ones, but also left them penniless. The police and judicial authorities can do little or nothing about this devious behavior, because in most cases no criminal offense has been committed.

name: Scam Alert: Trap Er Niet In!
summary: Ellie Lust and cyberjournalist Daniël Verlaan delve into the dark world of online scams. How are people hacked, scammed, and even exposed online when their most personal information is made public? Ellie highlights urgent issues and the stories of victims, while Daniël and his team of ethical hackers thoroughly investigate the scams.

summary: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones host an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.

name: Maxxed Out

name: Matt Allwright

summary: Photsawat is a former famous boxing champion who was forced to leave the sport after being accused of throwing a match and, to make matters worse, his ex-wife ran off with all his hard-earned savings. Now living hand to mouth, he works as a motorcycle taxi driver to support his daughter. By chance, he meets Homerun, a young man who once suffered from depression because of his difficult past. Inspired by Photsawat, Homerun manages to turn his life around and make a fresh start. He asks Photsawat to become his boxing coach so that he can pursue his dream of becoming a champion. name: Nordin

But between rebellious students, a corrupt principal, and his own ego, he soon learns that real life isn't about fast cars, but about making an impact. Can he turn himself and his class into a success story, or will he fail spectacularly?

name: Sunshine Through The Rain
summary: This is the story of the headstrong girl Zheng Yu and the lonely boy Chen Yan Zhou. Burdened by her family's poverty, Zheng Yu must take on heavy responsibilities, while Chen Yan Zhou withdraws into himself after the death of his older brother. From school rivals, they gradually become a light in each other's lives, facing life's storms together.

As middle sister, seventeen-year-old Adriana trains for the World Championships with new partner Brayden, while still harbouring feelings for her first love and former partner, Freddie. Her life becomes complicated when she and Brayden pretend to be a couple off the ice so they can land a sponsorship to keep the financially struggling Russo rink afloat.

Successfully infiltrating the household by posing as Yuankai's maid, Yan Ran continues her investigation and ultimately discovers her sister's body buried in the abandoned courtyard of the Zeng estate. When she finds out he is her childhood sweetheart, the line between truth and falsehood is blurred. Their relationship arouses suspicion within Aurel's family, setting the stage for a family feud...

Suddenly, a mysterious talking black cat that can use magic appears before her!! Spica wants to learn magic, and the black cat wants his curse broken—goals on the same path. Therefore, a secret master-apprentice relationship was born! But the key to breaking the curse is kissing his…?!

Seeking a profound change from their present way of modern life, each participant contemplates the possibility of converting into Amish society, as they navigate drastically different routines and a culture defined by faith, discipline, simplicity and community.

name: Buongiorno, Mamma!
summary: A wonderful family tale that encompasses both joyous and sorrowful moments, intertwining the past and present, while also delving into the realms of mystery and truth.

Everything changes when her teacher, Chie, discovers her secret. Kaya-chan's fists will go flying at any sinister spirits that show up!

name: Home Reimagined
summary: Home Reimagined travels across the country to mentor brave renovators who have taken on the task of converting unusual commercial and industrial spaces into one-of-a-kind family homes.

name: Dream to You
summary: A romantic comedy exploring the lives of two individuals at different crossroads in life. Reporter Lee Jae has transitioned from a fearless teen driven by dreams to a disillusioned 20-something facing the harsh realities of life, and finally becoming an adult in her 30s who feels like she has settled into mediocrity. On the other hand, film director Su Bin has lived a life designed by his parents during his teenage years but eventually broke free and charged through his 20s and ultimately achieved the dream he had longed for by his 30s.
previous_episode: The End of a Love Like War

name: Wildfire
summary: Filmed during BC's worst fire season on record, this series parachutes you onto the frontlines of recent wildfires. With unprecedented access, it follows the brave firefighters dedicated to protecting communities and shares the latest understanding about wildfire prevention.

name: Ριφιφί
summary: Rififi is inspired by the notorious bank robbery that took place in Athens in 1992. Who carried it out and why? The authorities spoke of organized crime, terrorist groups, and highly educated, ruthless perpetrators. But was it really like that? Through the power of fiction, the new production by COSMOTE TV combines the biggest heist ever committed in Greece with a true story of human tragedy, creating a character-driven series full of emotion and strong elements of humor.

name: The Magnificent Seven
summary: Set in the tumultuous 1880s American frontier, The Magnificent Seven is a reimagining of the classic Western tale. After a peaceful Quaker village is massacred by mercenaries working for a greedy and ruthless land baron trying to force them off the land he covets, seven gifted but flawed mercenaries are hired by the community to protect them from the land baron's hired guns. But as the team embeds itself in the community, preparing to defend them against overwhelming odds, they are all forced to grapple with an essential question: is the use of violence acceptable to defend a people whose fait

name: Amanda & Alan's Greek Job
summary: Besties Amanda Holden and Alan Carr take on a big fat Greek renovation on the idyllic Ionian island of Corfu. It's tearing down walls by day and smashing plates by night.

name: Adventure in Wonder
summary: This docu-series follows a Texas family who abandons their comfort zone for the Croatian seas, they discover that the most profound adventures and deepest connections happen when you're brave enough to navigate the unknown together.

name: Murder at the Post Office
summary: In 2010, the Yorkshire village of Melsonby was left in disbelief when postmistress Diana Garbutt was found murdered in the post office she ran with her husband, Robin. Robin claimed she'd been the victim of a violent intruder, but as detectives probed further, suspicion began to fall on him. Prosecutors claimed that behind the façade of a happy marriage lay deep marital and financial turmoil and £16,000 missing from the safe. They argued that when Diana confronted Robin over the missing money, he killed her. In 2011, Robin Garbutt was sentenced to life in prison. Robin has always maintained hi

name: Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job
summary: Amanda Holden and Alan Carr will be moving countries for their biggest project yet – they're heading to the sunny south of Spain where they'll take on a rambling, run down property in the province of Andalusia for the third series of their hugely popular series where they renovate ageing properties. With many rural areas suffering from de-population, they're hoping to remedy this and bring the tourists back by highlighting some unloved and forgotten areas around the Costa del Sol, in Amanda & Alan's Spanish Job .

name: Ronan Keating and Friends: A New Year's Eve Party
summary: See in the new year with a rollercoaster of feel-good hits, incredible performances and big surprises. Join pop icon Ronan Keating for an unforgettable party!

name: Тайный миллионер
summary: Under the watchful eye of Sergei Burunov, the star-studded cast uncovers the intrigues of an Indian palace to secure 10 million rubles.

name: The other gAIrl
summary: Frank's and Lisa's love and family life is put to the test when he downloads the AI app 'Maia' who turns out to be his able and willing dream partner. Alarmed, Lisa asks him, what's so bad about our real life? And he searches for answers.

name: Horizons from PBS News
summary: Horizons will explore a single science, health, technology or environmental topic each week.

name: Compass Points from PBS News
summary: Compass Points will address one international topic per episode, featuring analysis from a panel of experts that may include journalists and former government officials.

name: Inside the College Football Playoff
summary: An all-access series gives viewers a glimpse into each of the top four teams' preparation leading up to and through the semifinals and national championship.

name: Out of Bounds
summary: Out of Bounds explores the latest stories and biggest scandals shaking up the sports world.

name: Don't Call It a Comeback
summary: From last-second heroics to gut-wrenching collapses, the most legendary comebacks in sports.

name: National Parks from Above: Ireland with Dara O Briain
summary: In this three-part series narrated by Dara Ó Briain, we'll take to the skies over six of Ireland's national parks to witness the wonder of this land from above, before swooping down to the ground to meet the people living and working in these spectacular locations.

name: Scanning History
summary: An archaeological revolution has been taking place over the last 15 years and technology is at its beating heart. Archaeologists once excavated ancient ruins with little more than oral texts, haphazard plans, and aerial photographs to guide them. This series explores the massive changes technological innovation has brought to the discipline. It is now pushing the boundaries of archaeological discovery and our understanding of what once was. Thanks to the development of drones, lidar, radar, 3D technology and more, each episode brings a variety of archaeological finds to life and explores how g

name: БДЫЩ!
summary: "WATCH Out!" is the first big series about the comic book industry in Russia.

name: ЭТО ЛЮБОВЬ
summary: "THIS IS LOVE" is a new romantic detective show from Medium Quality, where Roman Kagramanov tests the love intuition of the star guests.

name: Point Break
summary: The series is set 35 years after the events of the original film and is focused on a dangerous heist crew with ties to the Ex-Presidents gang.

name: Pagans
summary: Pagans follows a man who becomes the sole caretaker of his two children after the tragic loss of his wife. While his son is typical, his daughter, Alice, is anything but. What starts as a strained father-daughter relationship soon evolves into something far more sinister. Equal parts emotional, horrifying and humorous, Pagans is a show that unearths all our darkest thoughts about family.

name: Amor de oficina
summary: Graciela, an ambitious and empowered professional, has a wonderful, passionate night. The problem is that the man she spent it with, Mateo, turns out to be her main rival for the CEO position at the company to which she has dedicated the last several years of her life. What begins as a fierce professional battle soon becomes a personal challenge. As they fight for the job of their dreams, both will discover that the person they see as their greatest obstacle might be the answer to everything they've been searching for.

name: The Most Embarrassing TV Moments
summary: Excruciating, hilarious and plain embarrassing TV clips.
previous_episode: The Most Embarrassing TV Guest Moments

name: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas
summary: This Christmas on RTÉ One, join Eva Pau for Christmas with an Asian twist! Across two episodes filled with festive sparkle, Eva will serve up a delicious Christmas feast and an array of irresistible party food to keep your family and guests coming back for more!

name: Urbi Et Orbi: Pope Leo's Christmas Message
summary: Pope Leo XIV delivers his Christmas Message and Blessing to the Vatican City and to the World, with commentary and translation by Lydia O'Kane.

name: The Archbishops' Christmas Message
summary: The Catholic and Church of Ireland Primates of All Ireland, Archbishop Eamon Martin and Archbishop John McDowell, offer a seasonal message and blessing.

name: A Misanthrope Teaches a Class for Demi-Humans
summary: After a traumatic incident ends his teaching career, Rei Hitoma is certain he hates humans. Yet when he sees a job for "a teacher who truly cares for their students," he's compelled to apply. Before he knows it, he's hired—only to find out his students are demi-humans. What begins as a job becomes a journey for healing for both a teacher who's lost faith in humanity and students who dream of it.
previous_episode: The Misanthrope and the Nigh Future

name: An Adventurer's Daily Grind at Age 29
summary: Born and raised in the slums, 29-year-old adventurer Hajime Shinonome now lives a quiet life in Komai Village. But his peaceful days take a turn when he discovers Lirui, an abandoned young girl, being attacked by a slime. Moved by her desperation and reminded of his own past, he takes her back to the village. Hajime and Lirui begin a new chapter filled with unexpected challenges and gentle days!

name: The Daily Life of a Part-time Torturer
summary: In a society where torture is legal—and big business—Spirytus dominates the industry with skill, style, and surprisingly cheerful teamwork. Part-timers Cero, Shiu, Mikke, and Hugh tackle "client sessions," office shenanigans, and even the occasional in-house assassin…all with a smile! Life at Spirytus proves that even in a world of pain, work can still be surprisingly fun!

name: Bajo la misma piel
summary: Bajo la misma piel is a story of love and heartbreak, friendship and betrayal, freedom and emotional ties, rivalries, hatred, and intrigue. But above all, it is the story of women who fight for their ideals, to be authentic, and to feel satisfied with themselves, without being in any man's shadow. Miranda, Regina, Sara, and Esther are very different and belong to different generations, but they still have something in common: none of them is willing to sacrifice true love.

name: Fate/strange Fake
summary: The Holy Grail War: a competition in which Mages summon Heroic Spirits and vie against each other in pursuit of the Holy Grail, a wish-granting machine that can grant any and all wishes. Several years after the conclusion of the Fifth Holy Grail War in Japan, the next war is about to manifest in a place called Snowfield in the western United States. It is a Holy Grail War that is full of false things. Mages and Heroic Spirits have gathered together on a false pedestal. Even though they know that this is a false Holy Grail War, they continue to dance on the pedestal. What is true and what is fa

name: Isekai Office Worker: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
summary: Seiichirou Kondou, a salaryman approaching his 30s, gets caught up in a holy maiden summoning ritual and is transported to a parallel world called Romany Kingdom. Having worked day and night, he developed the mindset of a corporate slave and even demanded work in this new world, which landed him an accounting job at the Royal Accounting Department. During his hectic days rebuilding the accounting department, Seiichirou came across a nutritional tonic that wiped away any fatigue. Thanks to the tonic, Seiichirou's chronic ailments and exhaustion completely disappeared, leaving him overjoyed. But

name: Journal With Witch
summary: Reclusive novelist Makio Koudai has always preferred the company of books—but when her sister and brother-in-law pass away, Makio unexpectedly becomes the guardian of her 15-year-old niece, Asa Takumi. As they navigate grief, clashing personalities, and the challenges of living together, the two slowly open their hearts to each other, discovering warmth, understanding, and the meaning of family.

name: Roll Over and Die
summary: Flum Apricot was never meant to be a hero. Despite zero stats across the board and a power she can't even use, she somehow finds herself included in a party of heroes. But Flum's life hits rock bottom when the party's renowned sage, Jean Inteige, decides that the useless girl is dead weight, and arranges to have her sold into slavery. Tossed to monsters to be feasted upon for her master's entertainment, Flum makes the desperate choice to reach for a cursed weapon... and something new awakens within her. A grimdark tale about one woman's blood-soaked quest to reclaim her life!

name: The Demon King's Daughter Is Too Kind!!
summary: Once feared as the ruler of all demons, Demon King Ahriman seeks to conquer the world…until he's stopped by an unexpected force: his daughter, Doux! Too kind for chaos and too gentle for war, Doux melts the hearts of demons, humans, and even angels. Desperate to restore demon pride, Ahriman's aide Jahi vows to train Doux to become a proper demon. But is Jahi any match for Doux's compassion?!
previous_episode: The Face Reveal Ceremony Is Too Lively!! / The Future Demon King Is Too Kind!!

name: Juegos de Amor y Poder
summary: Luciana, a psychologist, is torn between love and loyalty. After being rescued from a robbery by prosecutor Roberto Roldán, they feel a strong connection. However, Roberto is investigating a hit-and-run involving Adrián Ferrer, whose father, Enrique Ferrer, is the presidential candidate and Luciana's godfather. As Roberto gets closer to the truth, Enrique's future is at risk. Luciana must choose between supporting Roberto in his quest for justice or protecting her family.

name: The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife
summary: Akira Tounome is an invisible gentleman who runs a detective agency, and Shizuka Yakou is a mild-mannered blind woman who works there. Shizuka can always find Akira, even when he turns completely invisible. Love begins to blossom between them as they grow closer to each other day by day. A touching and adorably frustrating romantic comedy is about to begin!

name: The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom
summary: A woman will have to chart a new path when she's reincarnated into her favorite otome game, but not as a heroine. As her love story with the price shatters, another price comes to her rescue... the one who is part of main love story in a sequel game which she didn't play and doesn't know how it will end, even more so since she is not playing a heroine.

name: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
summary: The anonymous streamer "Apollo" starts one man's journey to find the performer behind the dynamic voice!
previous_episode: In Rikka's Front Row / Symbol for Defiance

name: Wash It All Away
summary: In the seaside town of Atami, one girl's cleaning service provides comfort to the busy locals.

name: The Dylan Ratigan Show
summary: The Dylan Ratigan Show was an opinion and analysis-fueled daily broadcast program airing weekdays.

name: You and I Are Polar Opposites
summary: She's outgoing, he's shy. High school love gets awkward when opposites collide… and courage is the real test!

name: You Can't Be in a Rom-Com With Your Childhood Friends!
summary: High school freshman Sakai Yonosuke, aka Eiyu, is obsessed with rom-coms, especially ones about childhood friends. But even though he has two childhood friends of his own—Shio and Akari—he's sadly given up on romance becoming a reality. Little does he know, both girls have the hots for him! A humorous will-they-or-won't-they rom-com about friendship, love, and first crushes!
previous_episode: Did the Three-Legged Race and Feel a Little Naughty? Then Doing the Scavenger Hunt Still Won't Start a Rom-Com

name: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
summary: "Level up even while offline?! That's not a game on 'easy mode'—that's just an AFK game!" The online game Kenichi Yamada had been playing religiously is shutting down its servers, leaving him with a void in his heart. He looks for a new game to fill it, but everything he finds is way too easy. The kind of game he likes—the kind punishing enough to make players want to spend thousands of hours on it—just isn't around anymore. "What's this? 'You are invited to a game that will never end.'" Kenichi stumbles upon an untitled game, one promising incomparable challenge with unprecedented potential.

name: Hana-Kimi
summary: Mizuki Ashiya is on a mission: disguise herself as a boy and enroll in a male boarding school to meet her idol, high jump star Izumi Sano. But after successfully infiltrating the school, she discovers he's suddenly quit the sport! Now Mizuki must dodge suspicion, protect her cover, and somehow reach the boy she came all this way for—all while surviving the chaos of an all-boys dorm!

name: Inagaw na Bituin
summary: Inagaw na Bituin is about how the brightness of stolen dreams can be restored through the struggle of life. The marriage of Eduard and Belinda will be tested after their only child, Anna, is kidnapped. With their real child gone, they will focus their attention and love on their niece, Lucy's daughter, Ariela. Meanwhile, Anna will grow up as Elsa with Aurora. Because of music, the paths of their families will cross. Whose star between Anna and Ariela will shine brighter? Will they be able to regain the memories and stolen dreams they have lost? Watch out for all of that in Inagaw na Bituin .

name: The God of the Woods
summary: The God of the Woods is a multigenerational drama series set in the Adirondacks. It explores the Van Laar family's dark secrets, class tensions, and the mysterious disappearance of 13-year-old Barbara Van Laar from her family's summer camp — in the wake of an earlier family tragedy that may be related. As the past and present collide, the Van Laars' wealth and influence unravel, revealing the damaging consequences of privilege and the abuse of power.

name: Tamon's B-side
summary: Utage Kinoshita is a high school girl who works part-time as a housekeeper. She has devoted her life to her favorite idol, Tamon Fukuhara, from the group F/ACE. Then one day, Utage ends up being assigned to Tamon's house! There she discovers that off-stage, he is nothing like his wild idol persona. A gloomy, introverted boy with no self-confidence, Utage still finds herself falling for him anyway.

name: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
summary: What does Christmas mean to some of our best-loved personalities? Anita Rani meets famous faces to hear how their festive memories reflect their lives, careers and faith.

name: Walang Hanggang Paalam
summary: Estranged couple, Emman and Celine, is brought together by the disappearance of their son, Robbie, only to find the love that they have lost in the past.

name: Helvetesuka
summary: Hell Week is a raw, emotional and uncompromising reality series where 13 of Norway's most high-profile athletes voluntarily throw themselves into an extreme military simulation - inspired by the special forces entrance exams and the Norwegian Armed Forces' most demanding course.

name: Bedre sex
summary: Janne Formoe and Triana Iglesias embark on a thrilling journey of discovery into the world of sex. Here they meet people who openly share their sexual experiences, and colorful experts who give them deeper knowledge about sex, sexuality, and sensuality.

name: Doucheaholics
summary: Doucheaholics Anonymous is an international fellowship of men and women who exhibit poor behavior and want to better themselves in a supportive, healing, and nurturing environment. Unfortunately, with this group the environment is often not supporting, healing, nor nurturing. This series explores and satirizes the different personality archetypes that make us human.

name: Norges smarteste idrettsstjerne
summary: Host Bernt Hulsker invites 14 sports stars to a prestigious quiz show. There will be questions from the world of sports, general knowledge, clever fun facts and lots of competitive instinct.

name: Inspektørene
summary: In Inspektørene (en.: The Inspectors) , we get to follow the inspectors of the Mattilsynet (Norwegian Food Safety Authority) up close for the first time, in a dramatic and unvarnished encounter with a reality that most of us never get to know. The Norwegian Food Safety Authority is one of Norway's most important, and least known, emergency response agencies. They are responsible for everything that goes in and on our bodies, such as food, drinks, cosmetics and creams – in addition to animal welfare in Norway. They close restaurants, inspect food factories and stop dangerous imports at the bord

name: Skjærgårdsfeber
summary: Skjærgårdsfeber follows boating enthusiasts in, on, and around the Oslofjord. The archipelago is where summer dreams meet reality, the sea spray is fresh, and the boaters' maneuvering skills vary dramatically. In Archipelago Fever, every bay, every cape, every headland and every harbor is explored – from idyllic gems to places where you should rather not dock. There is sun, rocky shores, swimming, screaming seagulls and just the right amount of drama.

name: Spenningens helter
summary: In the new workplace reality series, Spenningens Helter (en.: Heroes of Excitement) , we get a rare insight into the tasks that fitters face, and the effort that makes Norway work – even when everything else comes to a standstill.

name: Verdens verste publikum
summary: Who emerges victorious when five of Norway's best comedians face the world's worst audience?

name: Tabu
summary: Can you joke about everything? Comedian Lars Berrum tests where the line is after getting to know people who are not allowed to laugh at.

name: Heajastallan
summary: Everything goes to hell when a group of siblings have to work together to organize a wedding with 3,000 guests.

name: Pappatreneren
summary: How hard should parent coaches push their children? This series explores the boundaries between support and unhealthy pressure – with insights from profiles such as Ståle Solbakken, Team Northug, Jæger, Kristoff and Mol.

name: Jakten på Norges farligste kvinne
summary: For three years, the police infiltrated the life of mother of seven Elisabeth Aaslie and eventually had her convicted of two murders.

name: Mord i Sogn
summary: In a fjord community facing the closure of its only police station, detective Ole Vik gets an oddly timed new trainee whose arrival coincides with something far darker than small-town life should ever see.

name: Petters kommandosentral
summary: Petter Nyquist wants to start a command center for good deeds in the middle of the municipal housing in Torshov. But will he get the residents on board with the idea?

name: Love Me Tender
summary: Ke Yuruo gave up her dream of dancing for her parents and entered a seven-year loveless business marriage with the Xu family, only to discover her husband Xu Zichen's affair. She decided to end the marriage. Her mother-in-law, Xu Lan, plotted to seize the Ke family fortune and enlisted Li Haoqing, a former member of Ke's dance troupe who had long loved her. Though appearing to work for Xu Lan, he secretly helped Ke. Ke's best friend Shen Yan, who was in love with Xu Zichen, was manipulated by Xu Lan. But Shen eventually chose to help Ke under repeated pressure. Moved by Shen Yan's suffering, X

name: The Glory of Queen
summary: In Yuezun Kingdom, women held power and inheritance followed the strict rule of "to daughters, never to sons." Pei family, a century-old master of incense-making, owned a priceless ancestral incense manual that countless people had sought in vain. Forced to steal it, the "female thief" Song Zhiyao was caught on the spot by Pei Jingheng, the Pei family's second young master. To keep the manual from leaking, he kept her by his side. As they spent time together, affection quietly grew. Later, Song Zhiyao recovered the brutal memories of her clan's massacre and uncovered many hidden truths about t

name: This County Lord is About to Get Promoted
De kerststal van Nederland
summary: The Christmas story for everyone, live from Maastricht. The biblical Christmas story comes to life in a heartwarming way in the nativity scene on Onze Lieve Vrouweplein.

name: Uit De Schulden
summary: We follow five households with financial problems. Stress about money dominates their lives. And the more their debts mount up, the less control they have. John Williams and his team of experts work with the participants to get their lives back on track.

name: Moedermaffia!
summary: In the eyes of others, Daan is a ‘depraved' mother who muddles through and has no idea what good parenting is. After her divorce, Daan ends up on her mother's couch. In order not to lose her children for good, she has to take a parenting course.

name: Mo' Waffles
summary: When a hip hop legend vanishes before his waffle joint's opening, his oddball crew must crack the case, wondering if one of them could be the culprit.

name: The Main and Favourite Duties of Ms. Kurishita
summary: In the student council room, you'll never find more than two people: the president, Haiya Gin (that's me), and the vice president, Kurishita Namida. We used to have a bunch of other officers too, but since the vice president took care of everything so easily, everyone stopped coming. She's incredibly beautiful, and an honor student with no flaws to speak of, but... For some reason, she's always messing with me, and only me?! A comedy featuring the antics of a strangely doting, tall vice president and an adorably tiny president begins!!!

name: Dr. Nancy
summary: Dr . Nancy Snyderman shares her unique journey as a practicing surgeon and broadcast journalist, emphasizing the passion for medicine and the opportunities it offers.

name: Beat the Reaper
summary: Dr. Peter Brown, an intern at Boston's worst hospital who has a talent for medicine, works a shift from hell and has a past he'd prefer to keep hidden. But when a patient recognizes him from his dangerous past, Brown has eight hours to elude the government, mob hitmen, quack surgeons and a trail of dead gangers to beat the reaper somehow.

name: So Far Gone
summary: So Far Gone follows Rhys Kinnick, a reclusive journalist whose self-imposed exile in the woods is upended when his long-estranged grandchildren arrive on his doorstep after their mother disappears. When the children are kidnapped by a cult connected to their father, Rhys must re-enter the fractured world he abandoned. Joined by a bipolar retired detective and a sharp-tongued ex-girlfriend, he embarks on a wild and suspenseful quest to save them and track down his missing daughter, rediscovering his own capacity for connection along the way.

name: Is It Cake? Valentines
summary: Bakers team up with their sweetie pies to create ultrarealistic cakes and hoodwink celebrity judges in this special Valentine's Day edition.

name: The Right to Judge
summary: Are you a good person or a bad person? Elementary schoolmates gather for a reunion. A graduation yearbook with six faces blacked out is unearthed from a time capsule. Suddenly, the suspicious deaths of classmates begin. Who is responsible, and for what purpose? Two of them start to investigate in an attempt to stop the incidents, but they also have secrets of their own… Classmates who are now suspects—will the real culprit be revealed? An unpredictable, thought-provoking mystery begins.

name: Scandal Eve
summary: The head of a talent agency races to stop an exposé that could end her client's career — pitting her against the reporter determined to break the story.

name: The Ed Show
summary: The Ed Show was a political talk show hosted by the nationally syndicated talk-radio personality Ed Schultz on the MSNBC news channel.

name: Dinastía Casillas
summary: The Casillas Dynasty saga continues as the family faces a ruthless game of power and betrayal following patriarch Aurelio's disappearance.

name: Tom Read Wilson's Magnificent Journey
summary: Tom Read Wilson's Magnificent Journey reimagines the rite of passage once undertaken by 17th, 18th and 19th-century aristocrats on their Grand Tours of Europe. Now, nearly 40 and craving a touch of cultural enlightenment, Tom Read Wilson sets out to follow in their footsteps. With a heart full of wanderlust and a taste for timeless beauty, Tom embarks on his own Grand Tour, armed with his Super 8 camera and travelling from Paris to Rome to become schooled in art & architecture and enriched in history and culture. It's a series brimming with beauty, wit, and the enduring joy of lifelong learnin

name: Jane McDonald: From Pole to Pole
summary: Jane says she's "a woman of a certain age" but in this series she's determined not to let that define her. And she's proving it by throwing herself into her Pole to Pole adventure and grabbing every opportunity with both hands.

name: The Most with Alison Stewart
summary: The Most with Alison Stewart focused on the top news stories of the day people are looking at on MSNBC.com. In addition, the program also aired "the most watched or sought after" material on the Internet, including the most watched viral videos of the day.

name: Things That Matter
summary: We live in a divided country. A country where many cannot talk to those with whom they disagree. Where people can't speak across the political divide – or even sometimes across the kitchen table. Things That Matter aims to change that. Sponsored by Bank of America, Things That Matter is a series of town halls and debates that will feature the people in politics and culture who are shaping American life. The events will be held across the country, in front of audiences who have a stake in the topics under discussion. The events take Americans into the most important issues that directly affect
previous_episode: A Town Hall with Vice President JD Vance I

name: Sin pecado concebido
summary: After several years, Adrián and Mariana meet again at La Encantada, and just when they think their lives are settled, they realise they've never stopped loving each other. They must fight against those who seek to separate them.

name: Corriedale
summary: Two worlds are about to collide. Brace yourself for an incredible hour of drama, as the nation's best-loved characters crossover in an explosive soap special.

name: The Casebook of Arne
summary: Louis Hartmann loses his father, a private detective investigating a string of murders, leaving him all alone. Rumor has it that the murders are the work of a Grave-Digger Vampire. Louis isn't keen on superstitions and vows to catch the culprit himself. That is, until a self-proclaimed detective, Arne Neuntöte, and his assistant, Lynn Reinweiß, appear. A new door is about to open for Louis…

name: Innato
summary: Innato tells the story of Sara, a psychologist who has left behind a traumatic past as the daughter of Félix Garay, a serial killer once dubbed by the press as "the diesel killer." Now, the idyllic life Sara has built with her husband Aitor and their teenage son Sebas begins to crumble when Félix is released from prison — just as a new wave of crimes appears to replicate the murders committed 25 years earlier. After hiding her past from her family for years, Sara must now work with the police to solve the new cases.

name: Scum of the Brave
summary: By the mid-21st century, Tokyo's criminal underworld is ruled by Demon Lords—crime bosses who have undergone ether enhancement surgery, granting them terrifying superpowers. The only ones who can take them down are Heroes, bounty hunters who boost their own ether powers using the drug E3 (E-Three). With legalized killing as part of the job, being a Hero is less about justice and more about survival. Yashiro, known as the Reaper, is one such Hero—an independent enforcer who works alone. That is, until Jougamine, a high school girl and self-proclaimed "apprentice," forces her way into his life.

name: Stolen Life
summary: When a criminal performs astral projection to switch physical body with her cousin, a life will be stolen and forced to be imprisoned. The cousin will plan to regain her family and life.

name: My Faithful Husband
summary: A happily married mother faces an emotional crisis when her ex-boyfriend unexpectedly returns to her life, forcing her to confront past feelings and question her commitment to her family.

name: A Love to Last
summary: Sometimes we find love in the most unexpected places, and it comes in the most unexpected moment. Can two broken hearts make their love last?

name: Under her rules
summary: Alice, a fresh graduate, meets her intense and alluring boss Nannalin. As boundaries blur between work, desire, and power, Alice must decide—escape her demanding boss or surrender under her rules?

name: The Hidden ID

summary: Following staff shifts and patient journeys across the hospital. Together, they tell a bigger story of Cork University Hospital on 'any given day'.

name: Positively Yours
summary: The story of Jang Hui Won, a successful woman who prioritizes her career over marriage. She works late-night shifts and weekends, but one night, her life takes an unexpected turn when she impulsively becomes pregnant with the company's president and insists on marriage.
previous_episode: The Greatest Variable of My Life

name: Club Friday Theory of Love: A Mother's Mirror
summary: Love, though arising between two people, can only last if both families accept it, particularly the mother. There's a young woman so perfect, almost celestial, that no one dares reach for her. She has a close friend, a handsome young man who's always been by her side. He acts as her personal bodyguard, warding off ill-intentioned men. She can come and go from his home as if she were another of his mother's children. Everything takes a turn, however, when she transitions from friend to girlfriend. In his mother's eyes, she's stealing her son's love away.

name: Prijzenjacht
summary: In Prijzenjacht, two teams led by Rob Janssen compete for great prizes. It all revolves around one question: what is something worth? Who is price-conscious enough to win?

name: Niebo. Rok w piekle
summary: A psychological drama transformed into a thriller inspired by true events. Set in the early 1990s, the story follows a young, idealistic boy who abandons his studies and joins a religious sect.

name: Mr & Mrs with Julian Clary
summary: Mr & Mrs with Julian Clary is a revival of the classic couples quiz show, produced for ITV by Carlton Television. The series keeps the familiar format of testing how well partners know one another, but introduces a more mature, tongue-in-cheek tone. Fronted by Julian Clary, the show features playful innuendo and mischievous humour, offering a late-night, adult-leaning twist on the traditionally family-friendly original.

name: Kantan na Oshigoto desu. Ni obo shite Mita
Undercover Us
summary: Xie Cizhou, Lord of Yunzhou City, once rose to power with the support of Huanhua Valley, but his growing suspicion drove him into enmity with its master, Siyu, forcing the valley into seclusion from the martial world. Years later, Xie Cizhou's tyrannical rule sparks widespread resentment. In secret, his younger brother, Prince Xuanping Xie Ciyuan, counters him under the hidden identity of the head of Wufeng Pavilion. Fang Muwan, a successor of Huanhua Valley, was once trapped in a case of mistaken identity and married Xie Ciyuan for three years. She ultimately escaped by faking her own death t

name: Physical: Welcome to Mongolia
summary: After completing the grueling "Physical: Asia" finale, Team Mongolia leads their Korean teammates on a Mongolian trip of outdoor challenges and culture.

name: Clash of the Comics
summary: A wild and unpredictable event that sees some of the biggest names in comedy wrestling against each other and some of the UK's top professional wrestlers.

name: Spillet
summary: Spillet is an intense, social and psychological game about money, power and relationships.

name: И так далее с Михаилом Фишманом
summary: Every Friday, Mikhail Fishman presents his take on the past week. Together with key figures and analysts, Fishman attempts to understand the meaning and future direction of the key events and decisions of the previous seven days. And so it goes with Mikhail Fishman—debates and investigations, opinion pieces and dry analysis.

name: No, Your Majesty
summary: "No, Your Majesty" follows James Taylor , a poor but brilliant scholarship student who enters an elite university hoping to escape poverty and build a future. Instead, he becomes the target of Prince William Davies , a spoiled, powerful heir raised under pressure and emotional neglect. Their first meeting is explosive, humiliating, and deeply charged. But as they clash, fight, and test each other's limits, their hostility slowly turns into a dangerous, magnetic attraction. Around them, the elite students scheme and manipulate — especially Linda , William's self-declared fiancée — pushing the t

name: Wicked Game
summary: Matt, a young grifter in the corrupt Vitarelli mafia clan, is deep in debt to his ruthless cousin Sebastian. His only way out? Spy on Marcus Gravano — a rival mafia boss known for his brutal methods and zero tolerance for betrayal. What starts as a desperate mission quickly spirals into a high-stakes seduction of power, survival, and identity. The story begins with Matt crashing into Marcus's life in a chaotic, cross-dressing escape gone wrong — and from that moment, their connection is electric. Marcus, intrigued by Matt's audacity, makes him his personal servant instead of killing him. But M

name: Obsessed With You
summary: Obsessed With You follows Tino , a talented nightclub dancer trapped in a toxic world controlled by a powerful club owner. His life is ruled by fear, debt, and the desperate need to save his sick sister. Everything changes when Brendon , a police officer, crosses his path during a raid. What starts as a moment of silent help turns into a dangerous emotional bond. Love, guilt, obsession, and violence collide as Tino is forced to choose between survival and truth.

name: Waterwold of Komodo
summary: The Waterworld of Komodo takes the you on an extraordinary voyage to one of the most beautiful places on earth. Over the course of millions of years, the archipelago around the island of Komodo, has been shaped by the forces of nature and the mechanisms of evolution. Thanks to its isolation we are still able to stand face to face with works of nature which do not exist anywhere else on earth. On land, the legendary dragons reign undisputed, whilst under the water, strong currents surge through the coral reefs which are teeming with life. The underwater world is ruled by sharks and the majestic

name: Big Russian Boss SHOW
summary: The BRB Show is back!
previous_episode: Сабина Хайрова и Александр Волков. Новогодний выпуск

name: Lucy Worsley: Victorian Murder Club
summary: The Thames Torso Murderer terrorised 19th-century London but escaped justice. Lucy Worsley unearths this dark and dangerous story - can she unmask a forgotten serial killer?

name: Sweethearts
summary: Sweethearts is a light-hearted British panel game hosted by Larry Grayson, where a celebrity panel tries to spot the real couple hidden among a trio of hopeful storytellers. Each set of contestants shares the same "how we met" tale but only one is genuine, and the panel must quiz them to uncover the true sweethearts. Warm, playful and gently mischievous, the ITV series mixes bluffing, romance and Grayson's trademark charm.

name: How to Train Your Killer
summary: On the wedding night of Crown Princess Gu Qingyao, a cold-blooded assassin known as Shiyi suddenly attempts to assassinate the Crown Prince. By accident, their souls are swapped. To protect her husband, Gu Qingyao engages in a battle of wits and courage with Shiyi, as a deadly game of assassination officially begins, uncovering a thrilling power struggle between the martial world and the imperial court behind the scenes...

name: Zabić Miss
summary: This three-part docuseries chronicles the tragic story of Polish model Agnieszka Kotlarska, whose life was cut short by an obsessive fan.

name: Turbulent Love
summary: Hao Yu, the police superintendent's adopted daughter, goes deep undercover as an informant within the underworld and becomes the girlfriend of mob prince, Ji Jiejie. The ruthless and decisive Ji Jiejie, fully aware she is an informant, yet willingly succumbs and even gambles his life to protect her. When her former lover, police superintendent Zhou Ziheng, returns, where will they go as they navigate their path between justice, truth, and passion?

name: Shrimp Encounter
summary: All because of a "magic crock"! Three bumbling companions embark on a journey to repair a broken jar in an attempt to cover up their blunder. Along the way, they stumble into a spy conspiracy, accidentally discover a hidden paradise, and launch an ancient startup using their trusty drain-clearing gadget. When conspiracy collides with cuisine, and romance meets ridiculousness, this lovable trio cooks up a crayfish craze that writes a hilariously unconventional legend!

name: Falling Under the Stars
summary: To save her seriously ill mother, Lin Qingzhu strikes a deal with Chu Nanhe. Little does she know that he is actually Chu Guanxing, who has been reborn. In his previous life, his obsessiveness drove Lin Qingzhu to commit suicide. Now, filled with remorse, he returns with a new identity, helping her clear away obstacles while restraining his surging love. Lin Qingzhu feels the warmth amidst his protection. When family conspiracies and the truth are unveiled, what kind of ending will the three of them ultimately face?

name: Watch Your Back
summary: In Watch Your Back, host Soy Kroon welcomes 12 familiar faces to his country house. In the real world, they have made a name for themselves. Here, they are nothing more than a number. That number is on their back — visible to everyone except themselves. Those who know remain in the game. What do you do when everyone knows except you?

name: The Winner Takes It All
summary: The ultimate musical game show where tactics and talent come together. Fifty singers try to sing better and impress more than the rest, until only one remains.

name: Postcode Loterij In de Ring
summary: One duo in the middle, 12 rings with 100 opponents slowly closing in, and a jackpot of €50,000. A thrilling battle of wits.

name: Oh Oh Den Haag
summary: Residents of The Hague show what connects their city. Genuine locals with big hearts and sharp tongues, and respectable citizens with a sense of style and tradition. Two worlds, but one city.

name: Carrie op Vrijdag
summary: Kick off the weekend with Carrie ten Napel. Carrie welcomes a variety of guests to her clubhouse. In her upbeat Friday show, she chats with them about topics that touch, inspire, and connect us all.

name: Arts in Motion
summary: Arts in Motion is a thrilling series, showcasing renowned cultural figures sharing their insights with the next generation. This series will encompass multiple disciplines, including dance, music, visual art and performance-based work. Each episode centres around a masterclass led by a major cultural figure working with aspiring artists at the beginning of their careers. This unique opportunity allows young creatives to learn from a world leading artist and refine their craft.

name: Волшебные холмы
summary: The Magic Hills are a fairyland. It so happened that one day it was divided into four parts. Winter has remained forever on one Hill, spring on another, summer on the third, and autumn on the fourth. Funny little animals live on every Hill. But they don't know anything about each other.

name: Blind Sherlock
summary: Blessed with exceptional hearing, blind Roman Mertens lands his dream job in the local police wiretapping unit -- a job more dangerous than he expected.

name: Pro Deo
summary: Alex and her team also have to fight to stay afloat because the office is consistently underfunded. Moreover, the cases that arise are deeply affecting Alex and her colleagues. Pro Deo chronicles the lives of Alex and her team, the challenges they face in their personal lives, and how, as an "office family," they not only support each other but also sometimes get in each other's way.

name: Rust en Vreugd
summary: After her husband Thomas's death, Emma discovers that he had registered himself for the allotment garden complex Rust en Vreugd. To cope with her grief, she decided to get a garden after all. It soon became clear that the complex was anything but peaceful and joyful. Before she knew it, Emma was welcomed into the diverse community of gardeners and drawn into a full-blown power struggle over hedge heights, garden bingo, and snail control.

name: Alpha 00
summary: Alpha 00 follows a special team of police specialists who, during the most intense operations, lead a mobile command center at a violent crime scene.

name: Grand Hotel aan Zee
summary: In and around the Noordwijk seaside hotel, the lives of staff, hotel guests, and villagers intertwine – resulting in intrigue, blossoming romance, and unexpected twists. Grand Hotel aan Zee combines beautiful costumes, impressive sets, and delightful characters with timeless themes like love, motherhood, and ambition in the first ever Dutch produced costume drama.

name: Pandora
summary: Under the guidance of Ruben Nicolai, twelve participants embark on an adventure full of temptation, strategy, and dilemmas at a mythical location on the Mediterranean Sea. They place their fate in the hands of Pandora's Box. Will the participants manage to curb their curiosity and keep the famous box closed? Or will the temptation prove too strong, with all the consequences that entails?

name: Выходи за меня замуж!
summary: Nina is released after three years in prison. An unknown man is waiting for her at the gates of the colony and offers to enter into a fictitious marriage.

name: Handyman Hal
summary: Join Handyman Hal for a ride on a garbage truck, behind the scenes of a fire station and on a host of fun learning adventures about how things work.
previous_episode: Handyman Hal and Benji Explore the Hardware Store

name: Los Querendones
summary: Dr. Gloria Miralles is a beautiful and successful doctor who seems to have it all. But she has always resented her best friend, Fe Quintero Ruiz, a sweet, sociable literature teacher and an obedient daughter. Two events deepen Gloria's jealousy even more: Fe falls in love with the handsome Sergio Grimán, to whom Gloria is also attracted; and Gloria's mother Alicia drops the bombshell that Fe is actually Gloria's half-sister from past infidelity and is entitled to half her fortune.

name: Пороки и их поклонники
summary: Bachelor Vladimir Arkhipov lived peacefully with his faithful mastiff and had no intention of changing anything in his life. Everything happened against his will. His eccentric neighbor, Lizaveta, died, leaving him an apartment and her adopted "orphan girl" as an inheritance. The orphan turned out to be a grown woman named Masha, who stunned the lonely Arkhipov. But why didn't the neighbor leave the apartment to her? Was it because the "Path to Joy" cult was laying claim to it? Then Masha's half-brother from the provinces fell into her care, and then they both disappeared. Concerned about thei

name: Братья Карамазовы
summary: Three brothers, one spiritual and living at a monastery, the other - a gambler, and the third - an intellectual, work out their problems in 19th century Russia.

name: Le tre rose di Eva
summary: Aurora is a modern-day heroine who fights for her freedom and her independence against all those who have plotted against her and imprisoned her. In the background lies a ruthless fight for the homeland, an old feud between rival families, conspiracies, secrets and unspeakable sins, brothers competing for the love of one woman.

name: Пелагия и белый бульдог
summary: In a remote Russian province in the late nineteenth century, Bishop Mitrofanii must deal with a family crisis. After learning that one of his great aunt's beloved and rare white bulldogs has been poisoned, the Orthodox bishop knows there is only one detective clever enough to investigate the murder: Sister Pelagia. Like a Russian Miss Marple, Sister Pelagia uses her extraordinary intuition to investigate terrible crimes. Based on the best-selling book by Boris Akunin.

name: Кордон следователя Савельева
summary: Savelyev decides to retire. The boss artificially drags out the process of signing the report, because Savelyev is not only his friend and cool detective, but also a real professional.

name: Odds
summary: Tom lives in a world of statistics and figures, while Neil is a true bon vivant and womanizer. These two completely different men turn out to be the perfect team for solving unsolvable crimes. Their qualities are quickly noticed by the ambitious detective Kim, who decides to hire them as consultants.

name: Scarecrow
summary: Criminal profiler Kang Tae Joo is pulled out of retirement by a chilling summons: an imprisoned serial killer has been linked to additional unsolved deaths through DNA evidence, but he insists that Tae Joo joins the investigation, believing that Tae Joo can prove his innocence. Tae Joo is brought back into a world he thought he'd left behind 33 years earlier, forcing him to face ambitious prosecutor Cha Si Young, with whom he shares a difficult past, in pursuit of the truth. But as with many cold cases, the truth isn't as straightforward as it seems – and Tae Joo might be more involved than ev

name: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers
summary: The Demon World once plunged the Human World into terror. With the seal broken and hordes of Demon Soldiers launching an invasion, five young warriors rushed to humanity's rescue. They were called the Samurai Troopers, and now their battle begins anew!

name: Oedo Fire Slayer -The Legend of Phoenix-
summary: Gengo Matsunaga, once known as Phoenix, was the greatest samurai fire-slayer in all of Edo. After leaving fire-slaying, Gengo is approached with an offer from the Shinjo Domain. Encouraged by his wife, Miyuki, he sets out to rebuild a fallen firefighting brigade. Gengo gathers a group of misfits, the Ragged Fire-Slayers, as they investigate mysterious fires started by the arsonist Kitsunebi.

name: Bag enhver mand
summary: Head chef Michael is challenged when the female sous chef Naja is hired at his restaurant. A comedy-drama series about gender, power, and change.

name: The National Lottery: We've Got Your Number
summary: Brian Conley hosts The National Lottery: We've Got Your Number in which members of the public participate in events that revolve round the lottery draw, which takes place during the show.

name: Gold Wars Downunder
summary: Gold Wars Downunder follows three hardcore mining teams as they battle it out on the one patch of gold-rich-land to see who can unearth the biggest nuggets and the most gold in an epic made-for-television gold hunting season. The sale of gold is an important source of income for hundreds of thousands of Australians, including the men and women willing to risk it all, as they venture into some of the most dangerous and inhospitable territory on the planet - hoping to strike it rich. The miners are our narrators and through them, and their specialist mining skills, we're drawn into the wider wor

name: Millionaire Hot Seat
summary: Millionaire Hot Seat is a fast-paced, tactical twist on the classic format. Hosted by Jeremy Clarkson, the show places six contestants in a rotating "hot seat", demanding quick thinking, strategy and composure under pressure. Six contestants compete in a queue around the Hot Seat. Only the contestant currently in the Hot Seat can answer questions on the money ladder. Answer correctly → climb the ladder Answer incorrectly → you're out, and the top prize drops. Pass → you stay in the game, but return to the back of the queue. Passed questions must be answered by the next player correctly to stay

name: Rick Stein's Australia
summary: Rick revisits his Aussie home from home. Catching up with old friends and foodie favourites, he explores exciting new dishes, from the arid Outback to the dazzling Sapphire Coast.

name: Ростов-Папа
summary: A stylish arrangement in a modern way of a number of classic love stories - "Carmen", "Orpheus and Eurydice", "Don Quixote", "Cyrano de Bergerac", "Hamlet". Each episode is a complete story with its own characters, they are united only by the place of action - the city of Rostov-on-Don. It is always summer here, women are beautiful and men are courageous, there is a high sky and a blue river, everyone is happy here or could be happy.

name: Toussaint Louverture
summary: The historical drama "Toussaint Louverture" is dedicated to the fate of Toussaint Louverture, the leader of the Haitian Revolution, as a result of which Haiti became the first independent state in Latin America.

name: Назначена награда
summary: Pasha Gaitan and Oleg Lyalakin, ordinary employees of the teaching staff, dream of becoming real "bounty hunters" and independently fight criminals, especially for a decent remuneration. The day comes when fate itself forces them to take up this trade: would-be friends are thrown out of the police with a bang.

name: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
summary: Adventurous naturalist and all round snake lover Nigel Marven takes a look at some of the world's most lethal snakes.

name: The 1970s Diet: Could It Work for You?
summary: This entertaining two-part social experiment sees presenter Josie Gibson immerse herself in the food, drink and health culture of the 1970s, to discover if the average diet from what is often seen as one of the "unhealthiest" decades in British history, could have something to teach modern eaters. For two weeks, Josie follows a bespoke 1970s diet, carefully designed by a nutritional expert, to reflect what the average person would have eaten in that decade. She'll take a series of physiological tests before and after to see if the 70s diet and lifestyle can make her slimmer, fitter and healthi

name: Fatal Fall: Murder or Accident
summary: Fatal Fall: Murder or Accident is a shocking series built on a chilling premise: each episode examines a case where a victim was seemingly pushed to their death — from balconies and rooftops to cliffs, staircases, and bridges. Beyond the act itself, the series explores the interpersonal tensions and psychological buildup that led to these sudden and violent outcomes, often at the hands of someone they knew and loved, and the investigations that followed. Through expert analysis and testimony from those closest to the victims, the series reveals how ordinary moments can turn deadly in an instan

name: Spelet
summary: Twelve famous Swedes are isolated in a luxury suite at the top of a skyscraper. Monitored 24/7, they navigate a brutal power game where cunning, pacts and betrayal are necessary to avoid being voted out. The rules of the game are simple – but unfair. Both power and money influence the participants in the mini-society created in the suite. One by one, they are ruthlessly voted out by the group until only one winner remains.

name: Robinson - Exit
summary: We follow the Robinson participants as they leave the great adventure, from the moment they board the boat to the first bite of real food.

name: Lueat Kakee
summary: Talap, a beautiful slave girl was raped by her master Manas. As a result, his first wife Thanthip hates her. Pregnant from the assault, Talap's child ends up dying after delivery as the result of Thanthip's vengeance. In retaliation, Talap decides to take away Thanthip's own daughter. As time passes, the abducted young girl grows into a beautiful young woman. Now Talap plans on bringing the father and daughter into a forbidden relationship for the ulitmate revenge.

name: Hua Jai Patapee
summary: The story is about Forest Conservation. The main lead are special agents from the National Forest Ranger Department.

name: Roi Arkart
summary: The murder mystery of the business tycoon Paisarn leads his children to come face to face again. Including Ansaya who is about to become the newest member of the family. But… the first case hasn't been solved, a new case arises that made her and Paam, Jao Sua's younger brother and also her first love become suspects. Their love then rekindles in the midst of danger and the real murderer that no one suspected.

name: LMN's: Adventures in the Microworld
summary: After a failed experiment, Dr. No, an evil scientist obsessed with world domination, and Chip, a cute and clever 9-year-old boy, are sent by the beam of a particle accelerator to the atomic world of Microworld.

name: STUCK: The Chronicles of David Rea
summary: David Rea works as Emotional Trainer dealing with all kinds of people in existential block.

name: Unseen Islands
summary: Islands born of fire run from the equatorial Atlantic down to Antarctica. Many are now home to unique species and all have intriguing stories to tell.

name: O Sorriso do Lagarto
summary: Life and love of ladies man Joao, while lab outside of town does experiments on lizards and people.

name: Ozie Boo!
summary: Ozie Boo! tells the story of five baby penguins, four boys and a girl, who learn to cohabit in a joyous and friendly way and have many adventures in their home, located in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean.

name: Oretachi Bad Barbers
summary: On the surface, they're barbers, but behind the scenes, they're... Ryoshi! A retro-style barbershop tucked away in a rural town. The two men who work there have hidden lives. "For 3 million yen, we'll straighten up your life." The Ryoshi take on any problem that can't be solved in the real world, straightening out their clients' messy lives and cutting their hair. This mysterious barbershop, run by two clumsy men, will once again see someone off to a fresh start.

name: Gu Xiong
summary: The show centers on a lone wolf, a tough guy among tough guys, grappling with his identity and purpose. As the curtains draw on his solitary existence, a question lingers: Where does a lost soul, a true lone wolf, seek his rightful place in the world?

name: K-foodie meets J-foodie
summary: Korea's top foodie Sung Si-kyung joins Japan's beloved Yutaka Matsushige on a tasty adventure as they explore culinary gems across Korea and Japan.
previous_episode: An Irresistible Taste That Keeps You Coming Back

name: Kántor
summary: The unique career of Kántor, the most successful tracker dog in the history of Hungarian law enforcement.

name: La Otra Cara del Alma
summary: After her parents die, a vengeful Alma fights to reclaim her stolen inheritance but her self-destructive desires prevent true happiness until she must choose between love or revenge.

name: Solamente vos
summary: The story of a group of friends: those who love themselves, those who hate themselves, and those who are a real family.

name: L'ombra del destino
summary: An unsettling and inexplicable series of crimes, apparently connected to the old nonsense rhyme, upsets the peaceful lives of the inhabitants of San Giorgio, a splendid island in the middle of the Mediterranean. An investigation is undertaken by the hard-hitting and rational Inspector Pietro Montero and his female partner Deputy Inspector Lara De Falco, of more sensitive and instinctive disposition. Their mission is to put an end to a gruesome chain of murders, by finding a middle ground in the infinite expanse between the rational and the mystical...

name: Dora, la celadora
summary: Dora Lara is a woman of strong character who works as a caretaker of an important building in the city, there she will live incredible stories that could lead her to know her true love.

name: El Ángel Caído
summary: María de los Ángeles is known by all her neighbors as a good, honest and very educated woman; however, she is actually a bitter person and capable of anything in order to get enough money to support herself financially

name: Sei donne - Il mistero di Leila
summary: The disappearance of a little girl, Leila, and her stepfather Gregorio, is the mystery around which the story of the series develops. A psychological thriller in which the search for truth intersects with the stories of six women of today - Anna, Michela, Alessia, Viola, Aysha, Leila - each with her own experience, each with her own secrets, representative of a contemporary female universe , between determination and fragility, love and hate, constraints and freedom

name: Nikolaj og Julie
summary: Copenhagen thirtysomethings Nikolaj and Julie struggle with marriage, baby and work, plus friends of varying maturity.

name: Spain with Michael Portillo
summary: Michael Portillo takes us on a journey deep into his Secret Spain.

name: Вдовий пароход
summary: Anfisa's happy married life ends with the news of the outbreak of war. Four other women live with her in a communal apartment, each of whom was crippled by fate.

name: Ainsley's Taste of The Bahamas
summary: Ainsley Harriott travels to The Bahamas to meet the people behind its vibrant island cuisine, from local producers to beachside chefs.

name: The Salvage Squad
summary: Creating Show-stopping Homes...That don't cost the Earth! Can we achieve the home renovation of our dreams without it literally costing the earth? A makeover show with a new sustainable twist, Our host and the teams will be challenged to transform our bland old rooms, furniture and fittings into unique and stunning show stoppers, using only up-cycling and sustainable methods. This is the home makeover format for the world we live in today, as 2 households per week, each with a team consisting of an interior designer and an up-cycling wiz, have just 3 days and €1,000 to renovate and rejuvenate

name: Valley of the Kings: Secret Tomb Revealed
summary: With over 60 tombs, the Valley of the Kings is the most-famous burial ground on Earth. In the biggest Egyptian excavation ever, a team of archaeologists led by Zahi Hawass heads into the Western Valley to hunt for evidence of an undiscovered tomb.

name: Kings and Queens of England
summary: Kings and Queens of England is a six-part docuseries from UKTV History. Presented by historian Alan Ereira, this docuseries chronicles nearly 1,000 years of England's monarchy. From the Norman Conquest in 1066 to the Windsors, each episode delves into a specific period, highlighting how monarchs influenced the nation's history and how their personal lives and decisions shaped the Great Britain we know today.

name: Ruben langs de Zuid-Chinese Zee
summary: Ruben Terlou returns to China and the countries surrounding the South China Sea, scene of rapidly escalating tensions. As China tightens its grip on the sea and islands, neighboring countries like Japan, the Philippines and Vietnam feel threatened. In eight episodes, Ruben investigates what this power struggle means for the people who live there.

name: Great Military Blunders
summary: We have long saluted military genius and bravery. But the other side of the coin is military incompetence – a largely preventable, tragically expensive, yet totally absorbing aspect of human behaviour. From the Crusades to Vietnam, history is littered with examples of stupidity, obduracy, brutality and sheer breath-taking incompetence. Lack of communication, technological failure and a misplaced sense of superiority have led to the deaths of thousands of ordinary soldiers, let down by their masters and betrayed by arrogance. Using a combination of history, human interest and archive footage un

name: 6th Sense Agency
summary: A cash-strapped young man, a gifted realtor and a pair of fake exorcists form an unlikely squad to sell houses haunted by spirits.

name: Ryojin no Ono
summary: The eldest daughter of Detective Shibasaki Sachio from the First Investigation Division is found stabbed to death. He goes after the truth with Kawasumi Shigekatsu, a junior detective who respects Shibasaki as his mentor in life and is a close family friend. However, the hard work of the police is in vain. There are no developments due to the numerous questionable points at the crime scene and case goes unsolved. 15 years later, Shibasaki is retired and quietly spending the rest of his life looking after his wife Miwako who is seriously ill. However, the situation suddenly changes with the est

name: Looking After Jo Jo
summary: A four-part drama of love and betrayal set among the housing estates of eighties Edinburgh.

name: Time Traveler's Disease
summary: Mirai, a 25-year-old man who keeps to himself, is hiding a certain secret from his beloved wife, Meguru... The truth is that he's suffering from an unexplained disease that causes him to travel back in time whenever he experiences sudden, intense emotions. It was Meguru who brought him solace from his suffering. But then, on the day of their wedding anniversary, Meguru falls to her death down the emergency stairs at her workplace. Why did a cheerful and simple-hearted person like her have to die? What if she was actually murdered by someone? Mirai falls into deep despair and travels back in ti

name: Fire of Desire
summary: Kenneth decided to go to Thailand with his best friend Yuth. Yuth was asked to come home urgently because his family was bankrupt. Ken wanted to help by lending the money from his inheritance but he must be married before he could get any money. To Ken that's not a problem because he fell in love with Yuth's sister PeangUma and is willing to marry her. Unfortunately, PeangUma did not even give him a chance to love but married Ken anyway to help her family. PeangUma hated all caucasians because her dearest aunt died from a broken heart caused by her aunt's caucasian husband. While Ken was tryin

name: I Wanna Be Sup'tar
summary: A story that explores the relationship between two women from opposing parts of the realm of stardom. One has never tasted success, and another who, having experienced incredible success, was left disillusioned by the entertainment industry's cruelty and now wishes to run far away from it all. Unintentionally, the two end up living together when one has just moved into this house and the other refuses to move out.

name: #Cold Game
summary: Earth plunges into a -45°C ice age, where survival eclipses money and status, and resources are scarce. Kimura Shoko, a genius con artist with a criminal past, joins a shelter valuing family above all. Posing as the "mother" of a fake family, she struggles to endure the harsh conditions while fueled by her longing to reunite with her son.

There, under the disguise of being a mere manager named Nantrai, he falls in love at first sight with Nuea Nang, the very beautiful granddaughter of the village elder who is called in to perform a folk dance at his welcoming party in the last minute after the main dancer injures herself. Fallen completely in love, Nantrai or Natrai does everything he can in order to win the beautiful girl's heart. In the meantime, his tyrant mother is all set to marry him to Kair

summary: Harit Rangsiman, a pearl farm owner in the south of Thailand is very angry and vengeful after Harin, his only younger brother, commits suicide because of a woman name Sansanee breaks up with him. Harit wants to take vengeance on the girl who caused his brother's death. He kidnaps who he thinks is Sansanee to torture her, but he doesn't know that the girl that he kidnaps is Soraya, Sansanee's cousin. name: Anguished Love
summary: Pikul and Luang Yot's love began when he saved her from drowning in Suphan. As a talented flutist in her father's orchestra, Pikul's family moved in with Luang Yot's family, supported by his father. Class differences led them to elope, but their love is cursed by a "rattlesnake" flute Pikul inherited. Sarapee, in love with Luang Yot, kills Pikul's family and his mother. In the end, Pikul dies thinking Luang Yot betrayed her, while he is killed by Sarapee. In their second life, Pikul's vengeful spirit seeks to make those responsible pay for their karma.

She decides to take revenge by marrying her abuser in order to ruin him later, and goes to study winemaking in Okanagan, Canada. But Bussababan still doesn't know that she chose the wrong object of revenge, and falls in love with the master of the vineyard, taking him for a simple manager.

name: Ultimate Tag
summary: Ultimate Tag is an Australian sports entertainment competition adapted from the American show of the same name. The show centers on an extreme, high-energy version of the classic playground game, with contestants racing through a series of indoor obstacle courses while elite professional taggers pursue them.

Denis's father dies by accident, and a year later, Lisa, Denis's mother, comes to the Rozhkovs and demands that the child be returned. The grandson is the last joy in the Rozhkovs' lives; they throw out their hated daughter‑in‑law. However, Lisa is determined to fight for the child. The Rozhkovs understand that sooner or later they will lose the battle for their grandson: the court will take the mother's side. The only way not to lose Denis is to marry Lisa off to a local man who will never leave

The film's action begins with a piece of news that shakes the stunt world. The film company Columbia Pictures is going to shoot a film about British intelligence services here. The budget is beyond all bounds. In connection with this, a competition is to be held among Russian stuntmen. Xiao Wei is the vice president of Yuanhang Media. In order to pursue her goddess Mei Xin, she will not hesitate to take care of her younger brother Mei Ruobin who returned to study when she was on a business trip.

He lives alone, unburdened by either a family or bad habits; in the evenings he plays in the local orchestra, and sometimes, in his endless quest for freedom and new experiences, he disappears to who knows where for a week or two. Vera is a pretty woman who isn't yet old; she lives in the hope of meeting her "one and only". Two lonely people, longing for unattainable happiness, met and started living together. And so everything was fine, but one day, after

name: Взять живым
summary: About the fate of soldier Vasily Romashkin, a tenth-grader who survived all the trials of the Great Patriotic War and ended his military career as an intelligence officer.

name: A Touch Away
summary: Impossible love story between Zorik - new immigrant from Russia and Roha'Le - a daughter of Hassidic family.

name: Guardians of Nature
summary: This series of documentaries is dedicated to discovering the magnificent scenery of mainland France and its territories throughout the world. These regions are remarkable for their natural wealth and beauty, and for the man made structures that have been established to protect them. Reserves, national parks, mangroves, islands, marshlands and coral reefs are all examples of how man and nature have carved out and shaped these jewels of nature. In the company of scientists, nature lovers and « guardians » of these sites, all of whom are involved in the study and the protection of an enchanting y

name: Myth of Sword
summary: A cat and mouse chase between Shen Shi Wu, the number one constable in the area and Liu Xing Yu who is a a troublemaking delinquent. Repeated encounters pave the way for a growing camaraderie as the two enter into several crime solving antics throughout the course of the story.

name: Тайна Эдвина Друда
summary: Edwin Drood is engaged to marry Rosa when he comes of age, but when the day comes, they agree to break off the engagement. Shortly afterwards, Edwin vanishes leaving his uncle Jasper and a mysterious detective named Dick to investigate.

name: Bekännelsen
summary: Nina and Thomas, a young couple in their thirties, are expecting a baby. They live in a small community and are in the process of renovating their house which is situated on a lake outside the village. Thomas works at a gas station and gets help with the renovation from Nina's brother, Sigge, who works at the town bakery. One day an Estonian couple come to the gas station. Their meeting with Thomas and Sigge starts off well but ends badly, changing and ruining lives in the process.

name: Florentina
summary: Flo is a spontaneous, charming chatterbox who can hold her own in the tough health and fitness business of her mother. Just before her wedding, she is dumped and inherits a secret nightclub from her mysterious uncle.

name: Tiere bis unters Dach
summary: The Hansen family runs a veterinary practice in the Black Forest. For Greta, her sister Lilie, father Philipp and mother Annette, everything revolves around the four-legged friends who live with them.

name: Ты не один
summary: Stories about the everyday life of lawyers whose specialization is operational work on call. Three employees - a lawyer Vladimir Kuzmin, a former police officer Maksim Zagorskiy and a graduate of a prestigious law school Natalya Shatova, using their abilities, opportunities, useful connections and contacts, urgently come to the rescue on the first call.

name: מילואים
summary: "Milluim" describes the experiences of reserve soldiers called up for service, and takes the viewers through the training, strategy, team work, and different missions.

name: Off The Grid Living
summary: It's time to take house-hunting to the extreme as we search for the best properties way off the beaten track. Find out what happens when prospective buyers seek out isolated locations for the perfect quirky home. This brand-new series includes Matt and Kelly, who want to swap their humdrum existence for a new pad in the jungle of Costa Rica, complete with solar energy and a 3G connection; Stefani and Jason, who plan to move to Haida Gwai in British Columbia, where the total population numbers 4,000 hardy souls; and Ollie, who is relocating from Australia to Svalbard in Norway, just 700 miles f

name: Третье измерение
summary: An action‑packed film story about the crew of a nuclear submarine of the Red Banner Northern Fleet.

name: Вторая мировая. Великая Отечественная
summary: Many people believe that after so many years, there are simply no more gaps in the history of the greatest and most tragic war. But is that really the case? The more historians study the events of World War II, the clearer it becomes: we know very little not only about yesterday's enemies, but also about former allies. Who planned to deliver a crushing blow to the Soviet Union's rear, defeating Red Army units in Europe immediately after Germany signed the surrender?
