name: Scroll Patrol
summary: Scroll Patrol is an inside look into the life of RuPaul's Drag Race Season 2 and All Stars 10 icon, Nicole Paige Brooks. Nicole is scrolling through her camera roll, sharing never-before-seen photos and stories from her 30-year drag career, her personal life, and her RuPaul's Drag Race journey.

name: Под небом Вероны
summary: 1984. Andrei Mazurov, a reliable worker in the Committee of Youth Organizations who had served in Afghanistan and believed in the party's ideals, is sent to a seminar in Italy. In Verona, he meets his true and only love. His Juliet turns out to be a Jewish girl, Leah, who has come with her father to a congress of rabbis. Fate gives them a few fleeting encounters in the most romantic city in the world, and then each must return home — Leah to Israel, Andrei to the USSR. name: The Wildlife Man featuring David Ireland
summary: Encounters with dangerous creatures are part of David Ireland's day job - he is the Wildlife Man. David Ireland is one of the world's most experienced wildlife television presenters. An expert diver, cameraman and bushman, he has also spent years in the Australian outback learning the Aboriginal way of life. In this series he encounters some of the world's wildest and most fascinating creatures.From tropical jungles to rugged mountains, deep sea shipwrecks to harsh deserts, the Wildlife Man captures never-before-seen animal behaviour and takes you on a thrilling ride into the wilderness.

name: Верю я в любовь
summary: On the eve of her daughter's wedding, seamstress Nadezhda Matveeva catches her husband Gennadiy with his young lover Marina.

summary: How can plastic surgery disfigure? At what point does the desire to look better turn into a dangerous experiment? Are you willing to pay with your health for a "perfect" appearance? "What have I done?!" is a documentary project in which victims of plastic surgery will honestly tell where the enhancement has led them. And experienced doctors will try to fix what unscrupulous specialists have done.

name: I Kill U
summary: The story unfolds as a part-timer who was once a promising Taekwondo player, but now has a resemblance to the biological granddaughter of Beomhan Construction, who was accused of being the main culprit in a hit-and-run while drunk, and takes on the role of appearing in the media on her behalf.

name: 19 Keys
summary: 19 Keys is a British game show that aired on Five in late 2003. Across 20 episodes broadcast on weeknights from 10 November to 5 December, contestants competed in a quiz format where correct answers unlocked numbered keys leading to prizes. The show combined general knowledge questions with a strategic element of choosing which key might open the next reward.

name: Ayrılık Sevdaya Dahil
summary: Kemal, the collector and overall stronghold of a loan shark family, confronts scriptwriter and obligatory restaurant owner Afife for a debt. This confrontation plunges them into emotions they never anticipated; they soon realize that love and honor are nothing like what they once believed.

name: The Red Cradle
summary: In the autumn and winter of 1946, amid shifting tides of war, the Yan'an Second Nursery is ordered to evacuate 136 children to safety. Thus begins a perilous journey known as "The Long March of the Little Ones." Through gunfire, harsh terrain, and relentless danger, the caretakers and soldiers shield the children with their lives until the final child reaches safety in an epic tale of sacrifice and survival.

summary: The story unfolds in a small town in Venezuela. Miriam contracts leukaemia and dies giving birth to a baby girl. Her husband, Dr. Mirabal, dies in an accident. The child, Gisela, is taken in by her maternal grandfather, Mr. Mendoza. His wife, who is also Miriam's stepmother, wants the Mendoza fortune to go to her twin sons from her first marriage, Juan Carlos and Rolando. For this reason, she gives the girl to some gypsy circus owners who are passing through town. Twenty years later, the circus returns. Mr. Mendoza and his sister, Yolanda, see Gisela and notice that the little gypsy girl has t

name: Banjo and Ro's Grand Island Hotel
summary: Situated 150 metres off the west coast of the Isle of Mull in Scotland, Ulva used to have a population of 800 but now just 14 call it home. At the centre of the island stands Ulva House, a once enchanting Regency home, the former residence of the first Governor of Australia, Lachlan MacQuarrie. In recent years, Ulva House has stood abandoned and fallen into disrepair. Banjo and Ro's Grand Island Hotel will follow the trials, tribulations, design dilemmas and community spirit it takes to bring Ulva House back to life and, hopefully, turn it into a must-visit getaway. Along the way, the couple -

name: No Way Back VIPS
summary: Fourteen famous Dutch people are trekking through the Albanian wilderness with ex-commando John Sohilait. In the untouched nature, where wild bears and wolves roam, they have to make a choice: stay behind in a survival camp or continue to the finish line. With a prize pool of 100,000 euros, there is a lot at stake.

name: Style of Hiroshi Nohara's Lunch
summary: The story focuses on Hiroshi Nohara, Shin-chan's father and the head of the Nohara family. As a 35-year-old salaryman, he has limited time and money to spend on food, which shapes his choice of lunchtime. Throughout the manga, Hiroshi describes the food, delivers food trivia, and gripes about workplace woes, such as having to treat his seniors to food, sudden workloads shortening his lunch break, and hated bosses.

name: Masumiyet Müzesi
summary: Selahattin Paşalı stars as a man undone by obsession, desperately clinging to memories of a love that slips further away with every attempt to hold on.

name: I'll Live a Long Life to Dote on My Favorite Stepbrother!
summary: Alba was reincarnated as the son of a poor noble family. In his new life, he is introduced to his new step-brother Orsis, through his mother's second marriage. Orsis happens to be Alba's favorite character from an otome game he played in his previous life. Alba is ecstatic until he realizes his own character's death is the reason his step-brother loses his smile. Alba is determined to find a way to live longer.

name: Muscle Farmers
summary: Five physical strength entertainers help with farming work by harvesting various crops.

name: A.B.İ.

name: A Question of Entertainment
summary: A Question of Entertainment is a light-hearted BBC quiz show where host Tom O'Connor asks two teams of celebrities amusing and varied questions on film, TV, music and other showbiz topics, with team captains Ken Dodd and Larry Grayson leading the fun. Lively banter and pop-culture trivia make for entertaining viewing.

name: Lies for Love
summary: After awakening in a hospital bed with complete amnesia, Chen Jinxue stumbles upon a terrifying secret hidden in a locked room... Playing the part of the forgetful patient, she forms an unlikely alliance. Her husband Jiang Chen's ex-wife turned private eye, his current mistress, and a fellow victim. Bound by vengeance, these four women conspire to deliver the devil himself into damnation. But as roles reverse and the hunter becomes the hunted, a high-stakes game of identity, memory, and retribution unfolds.

name: Leaders Playbook
summary: Leaders Playbook, an in-depth series offering candid conversations with visionary leaders about their strategies and philosophies.

name: Saving Country Houses with Penelope Keith
summary: From cafes to craft fairs, glamping to ghosts, Penelope meets the owners of Britain's country houses trying to keep their historic homes intact.

name: A Hundred Percent
summary: A Hundred Percent is about a group of friends working inside the Thought Leader industrial complex. Their books, podcasts and morning routines might help us live our lives more perfectly, but away from the screens and mics, they are most definitely far from perfect.

name: Something in the Wind
summary: Daracha is a 35-year-old woman who is well educated and has a simple life with a set routine. After the failure of her first love, she has never opened up her heart to anyone. That is, until one day Wayu arrives into her world. The younger man is in his late twenties but loves to live his life freely, without the restrictions of a nine to five job and other societal expectations. Despite being so different from each other, the two fall in love and are happy. However, everyone around Daracha considers this relationship to be unacceptable as Wayu does not have a stable job like her and spends hi

name: Più forti del destino
summary: Palermo, 1897. At the inauguration of the exhibition of new technologies, an unstoppable fire causes many victims and forever upsets the destinies of three women: Arianna, Costanza and Rosalia. A costume drama, which still represents current issues. The protagonists fight for their own salvation from a destiny that seems already sealed, stubbornly striving for their own emancipation and achievement of happiness.

name: La Sposa
summary: Italy, late 60s. In order to save her family from poverty, Maria, a Calabrian woman, accepts to marry Italo, nephew of a rough farmer living in Vicenza.

name: Prithvi Vallabh: Itihaas Bhi, Rahasya Bhi
summary: Prithvi Vallabh is a tale of two powerful states constantly at war. Mrinal of Manyakheta dynasty nursed an enmity against Malwa since childhood as they were responsible for her parents' death. The battle brings two warring souls; Mrinal and Prithvi face to face. The animosity leads to deception, and rejection that gradually transcends into a heart rending passionate love story- a love story that perhaps was never meant to be. Here is a unique story that starts with hatred in a battlefield and ends up becoming the biggest love story, one that has never been told before.

name: Bekenntnisse des Hochstaplers Felix Krull
summary: Based on unfinished 1954 novel by the German author Thomas Mann. It is a parody of Goethe's autobiography Poetry and Truth, particularly in its pompous tone. A young man gains social and amorous advantages through deception and his good looks.

name: Schlafende Riesen - Die Macht der Vulkane
summary: In the 6th century AD, large parts of the world were affected by mysterious weather events causing temperature drop, crop failures and famines. All this might be the result of a large volcanic eruption in the tropics. But can a local natural disaster impact the global weather, thus influencing the course of history? Using stunning re-enactments and unique animation techniques, "The Power of Volcanoes" makes it clear: Volcanoes might be sleeping giants. But they can wake up quicker than you think and in the worst case trigger a fatal chain of events.

name: Insectia
summary: A high definition look at some of the world's most interesting insects.

summary: Robbe and his dog Kosmoo are best friends. When Kosmoo is involved in an accident, he can only be saved by giving him bionic elements. Because of these elements, Kosmoo now has phenomenal powers. A new hero is born.

The brave fighter against the "criminal element," Veronika Grekova, having become disillusioned with her profession, is seriously considering resigning and settling down for a quiet family life with a balanced, reliable partner. name: Tous sur orbite

name: Aillte

name: 74.5 Uma Onda no Ar
summary: In Pedra da Lua, a paradisaical city by the sea, the old journalist Álvaro keeps radio 74.5 Uma Onda on the air, radiating hope, humour and high spirits. The starting point is the arrival of Luiza, the radio host's granddaughter, who returns after suffering a severe disappointment in her marriage to Caíque. Starting a new life again, the young woman falls in love with Miguel, an ex-boyfriend who lives on a boat and lives taking tourists out. Miguel is the son of a fisherman and has been passionate about the sea since he was a boy. As a child, he and Luiza dated. They both believe that, in past

name: Duda & Dada
summary: This is a story of how a little happy-go-lucky mole, 'Duda' befriends a cheerful explorer 'Dada' and has exciting adventures together.

name: Fosca Innocenti
summary: We are in Arezzo, in Tuscany, where Fosca Innocenti lives, an assistant superintendent with a casual beauty and an extraordinary gift. His sense of smell transforms every perceived fragrance into a decisive clue. Around her, we find an almost all female police squad. Provincial stories and related crimes. No mafia, no Camorra. A microworld immersed in nature that in four episodes tells about universal themes through the investigations of our protagonist.

name: Das Haus der Krokodile
summary: While his parents are on vacation, twelve-year-old Victor Laroche wants to uncover the mystery surrounding the death of a girl who fell over a banister in the same house 20 years earlier. His sisters Cora and Louise help him. Through stories told by an elderly uncle, the father of the girl named Cäcilie, they come across a former friend of Cäcilie's, Friedrich Mörlin. The series title refers to a small leather crocodile that Victor finds in the house during his investigations.

name: Caterina e le sue figlie
summary: A single mother, Caterina, is abandoned by her husband and has to raise her three daughters alone, reorganizing her life by working as a postwoman and starting a new relationship, while her daughters grow up facing their own loves and problems, in an alternation of comedy, drama, and family misunderstandings.

name: Trainer Games
summary: Trainer Games chronicles ten elite competitors as they fight their way through treacherous challenges set against stunning backdrops of Mauritius, an island in the Indian Ocean known for its adventure landscapes.

name: Mocosos Latosos
summary: After the internal and violent conflict that comes with the transition from childhood to adolescence, seven intrepid, troubled, and scheming children join their lives when they meet at a mysterious and extraordinary school in Mexico City, commanded by the rigid Director Héctor Manríquez (Rubén Cerda), who suffers from his difficult past and is obsessed with education and discipline to become better.

name: Zhua Zhu Cai Hong De Nan Ren
summary: Around the beginning of 1900's, Jiang Yu met Wu Cai Hong and was attracted by her kindness and beauty. He unwittingly discovered she was the daughter of his enemy, and her father sudden death made him the primary suspect. Their path crossed in an effort to find the truth. The closer they worked together, the deeper their mutual attraction, and the harder they hid their feelings. Will the truth give them the permission to love, or will it be their end?

name: Ultraman Jîdo
summary: After escaping from the raid of giant monster Skull Gomora, Riku Asakura and his partner Pega stumbled upon a secret base lay 500m underground. Given the Geed Riser and Ultra Capsules by operating system Rem, he transforms into Ultraman Geed and becomes a hero that his childhood inspired.

name: Kuhlab satan
summary: Rose seeks revenge on Choke, who killed her family when she was a child. Unbeknownst to him, she survived. Now, living under a new identity and gifted with visions of the future, she uses her abilities to get close to Choke's brother, Chat.

name: Padiwaradda
summary: To show gratitude to her adoptive father, Rin Rapee accepts to disguise herself as his real daughter and marry Saran, to keep the promise their fathers had made in the past. Saran is a cold-hearted guy who suffers from his previous love. Although he knows that Rin's adoptive family has deceived him, he does not wish to return his bride, since he gets to know her beauty and kindness. Love slowly grows. But soon their love is tested, when Duangsawad, his ex-lover, returns to him, while Rin also feels guilty with the secret she is hiding from him.

name: Jiajia's Lovely Journey
summary: After being unemployed and abandoned by her boyfriend, He Jia Jia left the urban life for the countryside. He Jia Jia meets Fang Wen Yu, a writer who is the complete opposite of her and learns to find her confidence in happiness and life again

name: Poser
summary: Exploring toxic female friendship through the lens of a sexy, emotional thriller, Poser centers around two estranged, former best friends. When one of them is given a chance to live the life she's long coveted, and maybe get answers as to why they fell out years ago, she finds herself in a psychological game of revenge, betrayal, and heartbreak — ultimately altering their lives, and those around them, forever.

name: Fino all'ultimo battito

name: Wakakusa Monogatari: Koisuru Shimai to Koisenu Watashi
summary: Work, love, marriage, dreams...Four sisters face the inevitable challenges of life and go through trial and error while searching for their own happiness. What will be the four different happy endings they each reach...

name: Bloody Flower
summary: A serial killer who has the ability to cure all incurable diseases, posing a shocking question that overturns law and common sense and building viewers' anticipation.

name: «СССР. Знак качества» с Иваном Охлобыстиным
summary: The Soviet Union was not just about the hammer and sickle, the first space flights, "PEACE!LABOR!MAY!", or the arms race. For many, it was a time of youth. The best period in every person's life, when we learned to love, to be friends, to cope with defeats, not to lose our heads from victories, and — not to worry about tomorrow… Host of the program "USSR. The "Quality Mark," the artifacts he found, as well as the witnesses of the Soviet era, will allow us to take a time travel journey and remember how the citizens of the largest country on the planet lived. name: Dastaan-E-Mohabbat: Salim Anarkali
summary: Salim, a young Mughal prince falls for a courtesan named Anarkali but things become complicated after he faces opposition from Emperor Akbar, his father.

name: Лошадиная энциклопедия
summary: Thousands of years ago, a person, upon seeing a horse, was struck by its beauty, intelligence, and the structure of its back. People fell in love with it and wanted to tame it... Man achieved his goal, but only partially. The horse never loved people, and it still doesn't. This film is a look at the history of the relationship between humans and horses. It's about the main secrets of this noble animal and its greatest misfortune — its closeness to humans...

name: Laid Bare
summary: Ten men staying at a gay nude resort are slowly picked off one by one, leading to paranoia, violence, and a whole lot of bitchiness as the dwindling number of survivors turn on each other.

name: Я дождусь
summary: In the after war years from France to motherland returns a soldier with a name Sergei. Giselle his french love is moving with him too. For Giselle it is hard to get used to the lifestyle of a soviet village but she is trying as hard as she can because of her feelings for him. But on the other hand Sergei is a popular man in the village. His neighbour Klavdia is also in love with him and she is trying to destroy the marriage in any possible way. She makes Sergei fall in love with her sister Olga. Unspeakable passion is happening in the village. Which choice will Sergei make?

name: Heavy Lift
summary: The story of the engineers and mechanics behind some of the largest lifting and moving equipment in the world.

name: Дело было в Гавриловке
summary: Somewhere in the Urals, the small town of gavrilovka was lost. The old house, khrushchovkas, a squatter... Around the river and lake, wonderful places-hunting, fishing, mushrooms and berries. Here people live slowly, everyone knows each other, but even here serious passions are boiling, and why is something out of the ordinary always happening? Each episode begins with an emergency that hits residents from the TV show "Echo of Gavrilovka". name: Blueprint for Disaster

Rani's a Walmart version of a young Woody Allen, insecure and with a fear of alpha males, who now finds himself serving under a detestable sergeant (his estranged father), facing surprise drills, misguided mentorship and the most passive-aggressive toastie orders known to man! While trying to survive, Rani looks to win the heart of Naama – a sharp-tongued counter-terrorism clerk wit

name: Mama's Maken Porno
summary: After browsing through several porn websites, the four celebrity mothers become concerned about the content young people encounter online and what the consequences are. They decide to make an ethical porn film themselves, but first they have to investigate the intriguing world of porn.

name: Still Shining
summary: After falling in love as teens, two young adults drift apart — only to reunite 10 years later and confront their heartbreak, growth and new challenges.

name: Les Morin-Perras sous le même toit
summary: Maripier Morin and Jean-Philippe Perras embark on a bold adventure: transforming their house into an intergenerational home.

name: Les Guignols de l'info
summary: Les Guignols de l'info (literally "The News Puppets"), sometimes simply called Les Guignols (Puppets), is a satirical French television show of puppets, broadcasted since August 29, 1988 on the channel Canal+. A parody of a newscast, the show is a caricature of the political world, the media, personalities or more generally of French society and the current world. Originally created to compensate for the shutdown of the "JTN des Nuls", the show was part of an idea by Alain De Greef who wanted a French equivalent of "Spitting Image". Les Guignols de l'info have an important place in French popu

name: Plastic Beauty
summary: Welcome to Tohyama Cosmetic Surgery Clinic: Botox parties, secret VIP floors and shadow doctors. Now along comes a new surgeon who won't stay silent.

name: The Big Country Quest
summary: Fancy chancing an arm at bodging? Or at duck herding, goat milking or flax spinning? These are some of the rural crafts that contestants have to tackle in The Big Country Quest presented by Nick Owen.

name: Don't Blow the Inheritance
summary: Tim Vine hosts this ITV game show, where teams made up of two generations of the same family answer general knowledge questions to build up their inheritance prize fund. Parents complete against each other in the early rounds to build up the money and then the winning team play in the final, where their son or daughter have to try and hold onto the inheritance.

name: Die Adria
summary: Explores the Adriatic coastline, highlighting its vibrant local cultures, historic towns and breathtaking landscapes from Italy to Croatia.

name: Refúgio do Medo
summary: Maria is a Portuguese woman who emigrates to Vestmannaeyjar, a small and remote island in Iceland, in search of a better life for herself and her teenage daughter, Bela. Away from a past marked by domestic violence and deep secrets, she looks for freedom and a place to be herself. Six months after her arrival, Maria is found lifeless. Her violent death shocks the isolated community and exposes the secrets everyone is keeping. The investigation is placed in the hands of Soffía an Icelandic detective who, as she immerses in the investigation, faces her own crossroads, trying to balance professio

name: Age of Attraction
summary: When age is just a number, is it easier to find the one? Singles aged 22 to 60 date without revealing how old they are in this fascinating reality series.

name: Maiagare!
summary: Iwakura Mai lives with her parents Kota and Megumi and older brother Haruto. Her father Kota runs a small factory in Higashi Osaka, a district that is known for its craftsmen. Mai is shy and withdrawn. But when she visits her grandmother Shoko who lives on Nagasaki's Goto Islands which has a rich natural environment, she is entranced by the Baramon kites that catch the wind and soar high in the sky. Wanting to fly high in the sky like these kites, Mai's longing swells into a dream to become a pilot. Even though she works hard, the path to getting there is tougher than she had imagined. As Mai

name: Bargain Holiday Secrets
summary: Insiders from some of the world's biggest travel companies lift the lid on the tactics that shape our choices, from pricing strategies to marketing tricks. The series uncovers the truth behind all-you-can-eat buffets, cruise drinks packages, airline dynamic pricing and the FOMO marketing tactics designed to push us into booking in haste. Their behind-the-scenes insights will empower holidaymakers to book better, travel smarter and spend less.

name: Sin City: The Real Las Vegas
summary: Tir Dhondy finds out how Las Vegas has reinvented itself to pull in a new generation of visitors - recasting the city away from gambling to the world's go-to destination for live entertainment.

name: Missing
summary: The story revolves around spirits who are unable to move on as they carry unresolved attachments from their lost lives. In order to truly depart from the world of the living, the truth behind their deaths must first be uncovered.

name: The Eternal White
summary: The silence between Ela and Jim is a memory of Kin's failed operation, his daughter, now unable to feel emotions. On his trip to the white planet, the ship suffers an accident. To survive, the group must cross the eternal and white desert of the planet to get to Atis, avoiding being captured by their wild creatures that react to their fears, pain and joys.

name: The Tank: Ultimate Weapon of World War II
summary: From the early concepts to the first tank prototype, we examine how the battlefields of WWI set the scene for the mechanised warfare of WWII.

name: Will You Be My Manager
summary: Japanese high schooler Hirose Hana dreams of becoming a manager for top pop groups. She transfers to Segi Art High School, a South Korean school that has produced some of the Korean entertainment industry's brightest stars. Her first few days are a success, and she soon strikes up a friendship with the handsome and popular aspiring singer Koo Eun Ho. But she soon discovers that egos at the school are fragile, and that her own success may be stoking resentment in others. Worse still, someone at the school has learned that she is harboring a secret – and threatens to make it public. Is disaster

name: Dino Aventuras
summary: On board of Atlas, a flying ship, Dino, Kika, Lip and Cacau travel above the clouds in a magical universe, where imagination is the limit. The gang is always willing to get in an adventure to help their friends of this fantastic world. During each episode, Dino's crew will find some floating islands where they'll discover adventures that reflex situations on a child's daily basis. On a ludic and energetic way, they'll handle their fears, learn how to share, see the power of friendship and much more!

name: Aynı Yağmur Altında
summary: Rosa, a young woman who has devoted her life to the struggle for human rights, whose world is turned upside down during a Gaza protest she attends in London. As she grapples with a serious illness and an unexpected personal quest, Rosa finds herself in Istanbul. There, her path crosses once again with Ali, a man she met for the first time at the same protest. The two quickly fall in love, but their relationship will become the catalyst for a devastating chain of events that neither of them could foresee.

name: Kagi no nai Yume wo miru
Lost Grail with Alice Roberts
summary: Join Professor Alice Roberts on an adventure across Britain as she decodes the truth behind its Holy Grail legends, linking Arthurian lore, sacred relics and the Knights Templar. From the Isle of Wight to Glastonbury, Oxford, London and Scotland, she'll meet passionate locals, unearth legends of sacred vessels and ancient cauldrons and investigate Arthur's grave where the trail takes an interesting turn. Her quest culminates at the mysterious Rosslyn Chapel and with a controversial archaeological find.

name: Michael Jackson: The Trial
summary: With exclusive new footage, unheard audio tapes and insiders from Jackson's entourage and the police, this beautifully composed and gripping series narrates a tragic story of the decline of a genius and steps beyond the media circus of "the trial of the century" to ask profound questions about fame, race, and the American justice system.

name: Our Yorkshire Pub Rescue with Jon Richardson
summary: What do you do if you love pubs and Yorkshire…? Bring an old boozer back to life! Jon Richardson becomes a shareholder in Fadmoor Community Pub Limited to breathe life back into their historic local.

name: Eliminator
summary: Eliminator is a British children's game show where teams of three answer questions to advance through levels while avoiding a pursuing character called the Eliminator. Strategy and quick thinking determine how far teams progress and what prizes they win.

name: Domesday Detectives
summary: Paul Coia presents the programme and asks teams from all over the country 'Where is the smallest home in Britain?' and 'In which town would you be most likely to see people playing uppies and downies?' The answers to these questions and many more can be found on the amazing Domesday discs. All you wanted to know about Britain in the 80s is contained on two laser discs and teams compete to win this treasure trove of information.

name: The Ultimate Baking Championship
summary: The Ultimate Baking Championship tests the competitors on the core techniques that outstanding pastry chefs must master, from laminated dough and pâte à choux to chocolate work and sugar artistry. Duff Goldman is joined every week on the judging panel by a baking legend to determine who has the skill, vision and endurance to rise above the rest and who will leave the competition. In the end, only one pastry chef will be named the Ultimate Baking Champion and win the $50,000 grand prize.

name: Halloween Bakeshop
summary: Hosted by Canadian actress and comedian Lauren Ash, this frightfully fun baking showdown will see eight talented competitors face off in a high-stakes competition for a chance to taste sweet victory, taking home the title of Halloween Bakeshop champion and a $25,000 prize.

name: Long Story Short
summary: Long Story Short is the result of a brand-new talent initiative from BBC Writers, created to shine a light on the next generation of UK screen talent. Spanning all four nations of the UK, Long Story Short pairs fresh writing and directing voices with local production companies to develop authored, ambitious short films. The result is a slate of seven remarkable short films, each one a testament to the energy, imagination and craft of the teams behind them. Long Story Short champions homegrown storytelling, amplifying voices from every corner of the country, and providing a platform for fresh p

name: Built in Love
summary: Soul is a skilled architect. Xinxin is a successful Feng Shui master. When these two women with polar opposite personalities are hired to build a house together for its homeowners, a battle between them ensues. But will there be space for love to bloom?

name: Fulfill
summary: From college sweethearts to lifelong partners, Pafun and Aioon build a loving, devoted life together—dreaming of a family that seems just out of reach. When Pafun's longing for motherhood deepens, their hope grows around the promise of adopting a child someday. Everything changes when their best friend, Nubnueng, returns unexpectedly and brings a life-altering opportunity. As love, loss, and responsibility collide, the couple must navigate heartbreak, resilience, and the challenges of becoming new parents. Fulfill is a tender, emotional journey that celebrates chosen family and the power of lo

name: AI Girl
summary: One day, a package arrives at quirky introvert Gen's doorstop. When she opens the package, she discovers a truly human-like robot, beautiful like the girl of Gen's dreams. While trying to find a way to send the robot back, Gen accidentally hits a button that has the robot opening her eyes and coming to life. With the beautiful, flirtatious, playful and sexy robot by her side, Gen is completely swayed and decides to keep her, giving her the name Ai.

name: The Last Case
summary: Could this be an accident, or perhaps it's a murder?

name: Between Sighs
summary: The plot centers on Laura, a Brazilian woman in search of herself, and Carisa, a Thai woman who finds refuge, in a romantic adventure that unfolds across different cultures and oceans. Marina, a Brazilian woman seeking to rediscover herself, and Nam, a Thai woman wanting to escape the pressures of her life, meet at a sanctuary in Thailand.

name: Love After Addiction
summary: Once an award-winning actor, Yoki sees his career collapse after being entangled in scandals—and is plagued by severe insomnia. While filming a reality show on a remote island, he unexpectedly reunites with his high school classmate Yang Meng, now a rescue team leader. To his surprise, the moment he sleeps beside Yang Meng, his long-suffering insomnia disappears. Using "sleep aid" as an excuse, Yoki launches a series of calculated pursuits, trying to get closer to the emotionally guarded Yang Meng. Yet through encounters that are planned, accidental, and uncontrollable, his feelings shift—from

name: Katie Pavlich Tonight
summary: Katie Pavlich Tonight offers a conservative take on the day's events while welcoming all viewpoints. The goal: cutting through left-right bias in pursuit of plain facts and honest analysis.

name: Jesse Weber Live
summary: A fresh, fast-paced, and often unexpected take on the day's headlines, diving into the biggest stories through the lens of an expert in legal affairs.

name: Frontline: Our Soldiers Facing Putin
summary: Europe's on a knife edge. The battle to deter Putin has begun. Behind the scenes with NATO's troops, support teams and commanders through 2025, as they prepare for a war that seems closer by the day.

name: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
Maryoku Yummy
summary: Maryoku Yummy invites you to Nozomu, the magical land where Wishes become real.

name: The Interrogator
summary: The Interrogator centers on Conrad Henry, former MI6 agent, and his elite team. When conventional methods have failed, Henry's quirky charm, superior intellect, and mind-bending behavioral maneuvers make him the only man able to lockpick the minds of the world's most dangerous criminals.

name: The Morning Show with Sanam Baloch
Algojo
summary: Zar, an ANJELO, finds his father attacked by a mysterious man. Clues point to a group of executioners. To uncover the truth and exact revenge, Zar goes undercover and infiltrates a secret organization fraught with danger and betrayal.

name: E4 Mafia
summary: Four Specialists sham their way through life in the 82nd Airborne through back door favors, tactical acquisition, and CQ racketeering.

name: Phoebe & Jay
summary: Follow the adventures of 6-year-old fraternal twins Phoebe and Jay Yarber, who live with their family in the fantastical Tobsy Towers.

name: Careless
summary: When Scottish backpacker Robbie finds himself in Sydney, he is determined to become a live-in carer for a notorious rock'n'roll legend, Mike, who has been diagnosed with multiple sclerosis. To his delight, he nails the interview and gets the gig. But, as he grows closer to Mike, he also grows closer to Mike's wife Angela, and becomes a confidante to both Mike and Angela. As Robbie integrates himself further in their relationship, it becomes clear there's something in Robbie's past which may put Mike and Angela in serious danger.

name: Mysterious and Absurd Cases of the Tang Dynasty
summary: In the glorious Kaiyuan era of the Tang Dynasty, beneath the prosperity of Chang'an lies a series of mysterious cases. Folk investigator Shentu Baiqi joins forces with Yao Yuan, the Deputy Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, and Mu Guiyi. Together, they unravel multiple bizarre incidents, from ghost infant rituals and coffin pressings to haunted towns, murderous puppets, and wife-pawning contracts. Peeling away layers of power, desire, and obsession, they seek truth before the dead and pursue justice in the silent shadows...

name: Agent P Under C
summary: Perry the Platypus, returns as his alter ego Agent P; he takes on a new undercover mission to stop animal enemies from rival spy organization A.N.A.T.H.E.M.A.: the Alliance of Nefarious Animals That Has an Exceptionally Memorable Acronym.

name: The Haunting Maid
summary: An, a scheming maid, plots revenge for her sister. She fabricates haunting incidents within the wealthy Chen family, and with the help of a Feng Shui Master, infiltrates their home to settle scores with her enemies. Yuan Youzhen, the Chens' brother-in-law, teams up with An to reclaim his lost family fortune. But An seduces Chen Zhengbang to reach her goal. Arrogant and self-righteous, Yuan tries to win her over with his morals—only to fall deeply in love with her instead.

name: Fall in Love Again
summary: Star actress Chu Jingxi quits for love, only to be betrayed by her fiancé, Qi Siqin. She exposes him at their wedding and walks away, but her career soon hits rock bottom. With her agent and bestie Yangyang pushing her forward, Jingxi starts her own production company. Superfan He Zheng stays by her side, while business tycoon Fu Sinian steps in with major backing and open affection. Yet as Jingxi fights her way back with He Zheng, sparks quietly grow between them. Just as her new project launches, Qi Siqin leaks her private photos, whipping the public into a frenzy. After a short reset, Jingx

name: Field Generals: History of the Black Quarterback
summary: Field Generals: History of the Black Quarterback documents the stories of the trailblazing and pioneering quarterbacks who transformed the game—from the AFL-NFL merger through the turn of the century. By placing their journeys in full historical and social context, the series reveals how politics, culture, and race shaped both their struggles and their triumphs.

name: Großstadtrevier
summary: Großstadtrevier depicts everyday police work in the Hamburg district of St. Pauli and the neighborhood, focusing on the officers of the fictional 14th Police Station/PK14 (until season 23, the 14th Police Precinct). The plot essentially consists of three sub-areas.

name: How NOT To Hire A Hitman
summary: How Not To Hire A Hitman is a true crime series that looks at people who make the ill-advised decision to hire out a murder, and the even more ill-advised decisions they make to get themselves caught.

name: The Practical Guide to Love
summary: Blind dates seem like the most efficient way to meet someone. So Ui-yeong, still single despite yearning for love, decides to seek romance through blind dates. After a few attempts, two very different men step into her life—Tae-seop, quietly attentive, and Ji-su, playful and refreshing—leading her on an unexpected journey toward understanding what love truly means.

name: Duet of Shadows
summary: Qin Xin and Lin Lan, two very different girls, repeatedly solved strange cases and became detectives. They also gradually broke the knot and became best friends.

name: Catching Up With the Royals
summary: Catching Up With the Royals is a brand-new weekly visualised podcast for 5, offering audiences a smart, entertaining and always-curious look at the royal family. Every week Reverend Richard Coles and royal journalist Emily Andrews deep dive on the latest royal news, inside whispers and intel from their royal sources to lift the lid on what life is really like behind palace walls. They'll also look back on key moments from history that informed the way the monarchy is today and answer viewer/listener questions about the royal topics they've always wanted to know more about. The show delivers fr

name: Black and Jewish America: An Interwoven History
summary: Black and Jewish America: An Interwoven History is a four-part series tracing the rich, complex relationship between Black and Jewish Americans — defined by solidarity and strained by division. Drawn together by racism and antisemitism, they forged civic and cultural bonds, especially during the civil rights era. The series explores both the challenges and enduring promise of that alliance.

name: DIY Dungeon
summary: A DIY show, but make it spicy. Joey Mills and Fantasia Royale Gaga are serving camp, construction, and kink in their new OUTtv series 'DIY Dungeon' — from basement redo to sex-positive lessons and all the chaos in between. Watch the trailer!

name: Infinite Cycle of Love
summary: Xiao Ling, the Empress of Li Kingdom, was born into a distinguished military family. For love, she laid down her armor and married Emperor Li Yunxi. Yet after their marriage, she is met only with coldness and suspicion from him. Deeply wounded, Xiao Ling ultimately cuts her hair to repudiate her husband, but is murdered while fleeing the imperial palace. At the moment of her death, she discovers that she has been reborn—returning to one month earlier. Determined to sever all ties with Li Yunxi and change her fate, Xiao Ling struggles to escape their entanglement, only to die again and again du

name: All In
summary: All In follows a Flemish and a Dutch family who spend their vacation at a Spanish all-inclusive resort. What starts as a dream vacation quickly turns into a battle for the perfect vacation experience. As if that wasn't enough, their carefree stay is turned upside down by a gang of criminals and the hotel staff clearly needs a leave of absence themselves.

name: Eragon
summary: In Eragon , when destiny selects an ordinary teenager to become the first Dragon Rider in over a hundred years, he must forge an unbreakable bond with his dragon, master ancient magic, and challenge the mad king who destroyed the Riders.

name: Agios Paisios, Apo ta Farasa ston Ourano
summary: The story begins with the birth of Saint Paisios, born Arsenios Eznepidis, in Farasa, Cappadocia. A few days before the people of Farasa abandoned their village, he was baptized by Saint Arsenios the Cappadocian, where he took his name "to leave a monk at his feet". After the Treaty of Lausanne, the family of little Arsenios was uprooted and took the path of refuge to Greece. Together with his family, they temporarily settled in Corfu, but soon they would depart for Konitsa, Epirus. His grandmother and mother transmitted their faith and love for the Lord. He grew up with stories about Saint Ar

name: ІстФак
summary: History is not only facts, but also questions that generations seek answers to. In the new podcast IstFak (Ukrainain: ІстФак; Faculty of History), Volodymyr Viatrovych, PhD in History and director of the Ukrainian Institute of National Remembrance, and Yaryna Sizyk, folklorist and member of the band ShchukaRyba , explore the most pressing historical topics, debunk myths, and uncover connections you never knew existed. History is more important than ever.

name: Особенности национальной кухни
summary: Mikhail Stognienko and his viewers will explore Russia as it exists far beyond the Moscow Ring Road. Each episode will be an expedition to a different city, where Mikhail will join foreign haute cuisine chef Pierre Carbonara. Together, they will bring back the crown jewel of Pierre's restaurant—a spectacular and expensive dish that costs thousands of rubles in the capital. Will residents of the regions, accustomed to hearty cuisine, be able to appreciate this culinary delight? Their initial reaction, honest and uncompromising, will put many things into perspective.

name: Murder in Glitterball City
summary: The city of Louisville, Kentucky is known for the beauty of its historic Victorian architecture and birthplace of the mirrored glitterball. It also has a reputation for being one of America's most haunted neighborhoods and is the backdrop for a dark tale of murder, lies, and deceit. With a uniquely colorful cast of local residents as tour guides, the two-part documentary explores the shifting landscape of a grisly murder, the toxic relationship of two ex-lovers, a vulnerable victim, and the unreliable accounts of flawed individuals on trial for their lives. Inspired by the non-fiction book "A

name: Escape to Homestay
summary: Top, the owner of a bankrupt pub in the heart of Bangkok. decides to say goodbye to the city and take comfort in his grandmother Thap, the owner of a homestay in the nearby province of Nakhon Nayok. With him, Top drags his close friends Kan, a flight attendant recently put on leave, and Film, a photographer who's lost his passion to help with the homestay. When the gang arrives, Grandma Thap introduces them to P'Ter, a government officer favoured by the locals. The three begin working at the homestay and get to know more of the locals: Tao, Ter's younger sister who's fled home and her parents'

name: The Great Icelandic Swim with Ross Edgley
summary: Sixty-foot waves, nosy killer whales, hypothermia, tongue rot. Ultra-athlete Ross Edgley attempts to swim all the way around Iceland - 1000 miles of icy water.

name: Roman Empire by Train with Alice Roberts
summary: Alice embarks on her most ambitious journey to date, in search of the Roman Empire, travelling 1300 miles through Italy, France and Spain to discover the origins and secrets of Rome's success.

name: Let's FoQ: El reencuentro
summary: Special interview program to reminisce with the stars of the series about great anecdotes, the most iconic scenes, and how they experienced the success of 'FoQ' firsthand.

name: Morbo K - Chi salva una vita salva il mondo intero
summary: On the eve of the roundup of the Rome ghetto in 1943, the director of the Fatebenefratelli hospital, Professor Prati, saves several Jewish families by pretending that a contagious virus, known as Morbo K, exists in order to keep the Nazis away. Among the refugees is Silvia Calò, a young artist who falls in love with the doctor Pietro Prestifilippo. While Kappler betrays his promise of salvation and begins the deportations, the destinies of the protagonists intertwine in the most dramatic hours before the departure of the trains.

name: Morfonication
summary: Morfonication is a two-episode anime special focusing on the band "Morfonica". Set after BanG Dream! Season 3 , it depicts the members reflecting on their identities, insecurities, and growth as a band. The story is self-contained, character-driven, and takes place within the main BanG Dream! continuity, but it does not advance the broader franchise plot.

name: Takeover Bid
summary: Bruce Forsyth presents Takeover Bid , a game show where the contestants are given prizes and then bid to take over those prizes from each other.

name: Too Young To Love
summary: Influenced by her mother from a young age, Yi Lan studied the cello and displayed remarkable talent. In her very first week of high school, encouraged by her childhood friend Tong Xiaole, she resolved to form her own musical trio. Driven by the goals of "defeating the school orchestra" and "performing at the annual campus festival," Yi Lan worked tirelessly, burning with the energy of a little sun. Her passion was infectious, inspiring Tong Xiaole to rekindle his own musical dreams. Amidst the melodious strains of the cello, the laughter of friends, and the tears of a young girl's secret heart

name: How To Survive Without Me
summary: In the wake of matriarch Beverly's passing, the De Angelis family has begun to drift, unsure how to manage their complicated, evolving lives without her guidance. But in true Beverly fashion, she found a way to keep running the show from the beyond. Should they wish to experience Beverly's final work, the family must find the time — and make the effort — to remain connected, and be there for each other through all of life's challenges yet to come.

name: Yesterday Wife
summary: Phum is fed up with his wife and gets magical coins that bring him back to the past. He then marries his first love, but his old wife appears to be his lovely colleague.

name: Adam Richman Eats Italy
summary: Globally famous superfoodie Adam Richman is back with his next delicious adventure and this time he's in Italy.

name: Fleet of Time
summary: Five friends recount their good, bad and educational experiences of growing up in Bangkok in the 1980s. Win, Fang, Cheaw, King and Yae become best friends in high school. Win and Fang have feelings for each other. Cheaw has secretly liked Fang ever since he fell in love with her at first sight. At the end of high school, Cheaw goes to UK and Win and Fang goes to the same university. Win becomes very popular in campus and starts dating a beautiful girl, Alyn. Out of jealousy, Fang hangs out with a playboy. After Fang going through a hardship, Cheaw comes to take care of her but she refuses. How

name: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: New Story, Old Love
summary: Something peculiar begins to unfold; the ex-lover appears to be afraid of something in her own room and requests to sleep in our room. To make things worse, my boyfriend's mother still holds strong affection for her son's ex-lover and welcomes her into their home.

name: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: One Night Stand
summary: Khwanphon, a modern high school teacher, doesn't believe in long-term relationships or even love. She leads a secret lifestyle, enjoying one-night stands without any commitments. However, she finds herself involved with three different men: Kornkit, a gentlemanly figure who is the son of the school owner where Khwanphon works; Time, a colleague who has been pursuing her for a long time but has never been reciprocated; and Mac, a playboy who desires more than just one-night stands with Khwanphon. The story becomes complicated when Khwanphon decides to marry one of the three men. However, her tu

name: Club Friday Theory of Love: No Such Thing as Coincidence
summary: A shy, soft-spoken single woman who struggles with socializing has never had a boyfriend. One day, a seemingly chance encounter brings her face-to-face with a charming, good-looking man. From this initial meeting, the man begins pursuing her in earnest, sweeping her off her feet. He seems to know everything about her, constantly surprising her with thoughtful gestures. She starts to believe that this man is not just a coincidence, but the soulmate she's been waiting her entire life for. What starts as a romantic tale soon turns into heartbreaking drama. Another woman appears, weirdly similar i

name: The Sandy Effect
summary: Volunteer teacher Sandy believes in the message "no child left behind." She makes it her mission to help her underprivileged young students discover their potential and make sure they don't fall out of the system.

name: The Lady and Her Lovers
summary: Thongprakai or "Thongdee" is a girl who goes to live in Bangkok in search for a better life. Despite getting involved with several doting men, sustained happiness alludes her. Their interest seems shallow, and she must ponder whether her beauty is more of a curse than a blessing.

name: The Thirsty Thirty
summary: Welcome to your thirties. Are you ready to step into the dreams you've envisioned?

name: L/over – ikuisesti minun
summary: When Roosa meets Juha, a charismatic author, they fall head over heels in love and seem to have found everything they ever wanted in each other—until the love story takes a dark turn.

name: The Shadow Sovereign
summary: Princess Zhao Yang, Li Shu, is born to a low-ranking concubine and grows up in the Cold Palace, where she endures years of neglect because of her mother's humble status. Through her intelligence and political acumen, she earns a place in the Crown Prince's faction. Yet after leaving the Cold Palace, she becomes nothing more than a pawn in his political game. Three years later, Emperor Bing Qian reforms the imperial examination system by reviving the Xiao Lian recommendation system to curb the influence of the powerful noble clans. At the banquet honoring the newly crowned scholars, Li Shu is p

name: Talking Royals
summary: Charlene White hosts a round-up of royal news with expert analysis from ITV News Royal Editor Chris Ship, ITV News royal expert Lizzie Robinson and a host of guests.

name: Money Honey
summary: Stories from a market community of Jae Nam. Wit opens an organic vegetables stand in front of the pork butchery of Hia Tang. Wit meets Money, Hia Tang's daughter. Money dislikes Wit from some trouble pasts in the university. But as she is a vegetarian, Wit's vegetable stand becomes her favorite.

name: Sweet Secret
summary: Get ready to practice your investigative skills because of three high school spy girls, Sherbet, Chocco, and Yogurt, who have to disguise themselves to investigate drug cases at St. Butus School. In addition to the case, the agents also have to deal with the club's seniors who are constantly disturbing.

name: The Surgeon
summary: For the first time, this series reveals exactly what life is really like as a surgeon: from the high-pressure world of the operating theatre, where someone's life is literally in your hands, to the consulting room where news must be broken, both good and bad, to the everyday ups and downs of life at home. Each episode follows a different surgeon as they juggle these very different worlds making life changing decisions on a daily basis. It's a dramatic and deeply personal series that gets under the skin of surgeons like never before.

name: Love Through Time
summary: In the Emerald City, a land steeped in civilization, yet still harboring secrets, Princess Kannika mysteriously disappears. Before the Prince of Bagan arrives to inquire, a photograph surfaces showing a young woman in traditional Thai costume on a stage in Bangkok. The woman's face is has an undeniable resemblance to Princess Kannika, causing panic and fear as people suddenly see her appear. Unprepared for country life, Cho Mi Ryeo struggles as farming and housework prove harder than expected. Meanwhile, their eldest son, Seong Ji Cheon, once bound for medical school, begins to discover himself. However, village chief Im Ju Hyeong grows wary of the family, who arrived with a major corporation. As they endure rural life while longing to return, can they find their way back?

name: Bedaine
summary: A broken former superhero, Bedaine tries to find meaning in his life in his hometown. Between wacky enemies, deep wounds, and lost wings, he will discover that there are other ways to be a hero.

name: Bole UP
summary: Bole UP is a flagship infotainment program produced by Doordarshan Kendra Lucknow for the DD Uttar Pradesh network. The show blends interviews with audience participation and cultural showcases, featuring spotlights from regional talents.

name: Blue Therapy
summary: Seven couples move out of their comfort zones and onto the therapist's couch to try and work through their relationship issues in this reality series.

name: En ven, en morder
summary: In this documentary, three friends recount their memories of a series of crimes that changed their lives and rocked their quiet corner of rural Denmark.

name: Piekło Kobiet
summary: Set in pre-WWII Poland, this drama series follows a woman's fight for justice for victims of sexual assault – and her own autonomy.

name: Hello Bachhon
summary: A physics teacher sets out to make quality education accessible to all students through online learning. Based on a true story.

name: El Asesino de TikTok
summary: A missing woman's family discovers that one of the last people to see her was a peculiar content creator — who was convicted of homicide years ago.

name: Pardon the Intrusion, I'm Home!
summary: Rinko, a quiet office worker and secret otaku, just wants to enjoy her anime in peace. But when a neighbor keeps banging on the wall, she asks her other neighbor, Satsuki, for help. Their attempt to resolve the issue goes wrong, leaving a hole in the wall that reveals…Usaharu-sensei, the creator of Rinko's favorite manga?! Now with nowhere to hide, their lives begin to overlap in surprising ways!

name: Vanvidsbilisterne
summary: Crazy drivers kill innocent people on Danish roads every year. To combat life-threatening behavior in traffic, the police have been given a new tool: the insanity clause. With it in hand, the police now have the opportunity to punish Denmark's most dangerous drivers much more severely than before. Unconditional revocation of the driver's license, confiscation of the vehicle and imprisonment await road users who commit the worst offences.

name: Vejens Helte
summary: We follow the professional rescuers from Viking roadside assistance – the previously overlooked heroes who head out when accidents and mishaps occur in traffic.

name: Mord auf dem Inka-Pfad
summary: The mysterious murder of a German tourist in the Peruvian Andes in 1997 sparks one of the most difficult and extensive investigations in German criminal history. As a tenacious seeker of the truth, Munich detective Nina Gummich embarks on a grueling mission that takes her across three continents and to her personal limits over the course of years. Based on a story by Rolf Basedow, the screenplay for this four-part crime series was written by Mika Kallwass and Nina Wolfrum.

name: Britain's Almost Perfect Murders
summary: Britain's Almost Perfect Murders follows expert-led, forensic investigations of cases where meticulous, near-flawless crimes were ultimately uncovered due to tiny, overlooked fatal mistakes by the perpetrators.

name: Snowball Earth
summary: Yukio was destroyed in battle and Tetsuo survived in an escape pod. After eight years in cold sleep, the escape pod finally lands back on Earth. But when Tetsuo emerges he finds a world in ruins, entirely frozen beneath a blanket of ice and snow—snowball Earth! What happened to humanity, how did the planet freeze over, and will Tetsuo be able to keep his last promise to Yukio?

name: Killed Again, Mr. Detective
summary: Sakuya Otsuki is the son of a legendary detective, working to follow in his father's footsteps with his assistant, Lilithea. However, something's different about this high-school sleuth. Wherever he goes, he always manages to get himself entangled in his cases—as a murder victim! When Sakuya is tasked to infiltrate a luxury cruise ship, he finds himself killed once again. But every time he reopens his eyes, Lilithea is there by his side, ready to help him get to the bottom of the mystery...

name: The Regression of Great Sage Riddle
summary: A young man named Riddle had lost all of his friends—and the entire world—at the hands of a mysterious organization known as the "Box of Malice." Having lost all hope to live, he dwelled in a pit of despair until he has one final revelation. What if... he could return to a time before everything ended? And so, after a thousand years, a deformed Riddle finally manages to reverse time. "I'm going to stop them this time...!" Equipped with a thousand years of knowledge and experience in his young body, the Great Sage Riddle's journey to the past now unfolds!

name: Beyond the Brush
summary: Beyond the Brush takes viewers on a journey through the ages of art, exploring the evolution of creativity across centuries. Each episode uncovers hidden secrets, personal struggles, and the cultural shifts that shaped history's greatest masterpieces. From the brushstrokes of genius to the untold stories behind the canvas, this series will reveal how every work of art holds far more than meets the eye.

name: Juliet & Juliet
summary: When heirs of two feuding families become one another's first love, will it end in love or tragedy?

name: You're Only Young Twice
summary: You're Only Young Twice centers on Emily and Alex, who got pregnant and married in high school but now they're 35 and their kid is starting college. That means they can get divorced and start life all over again while they're still young enough to enjoy it. Newly divorced empty-nesters, they stumble through dating, co-parenting, and maybe a second chance at love.

name: Rivals
summary: In Rivals , a series exclusive to Kayo Sports, some of the best rugby league players in the world will go head-to-head with their counterparts from Aussie Rules and Rugby Union to decide which code deserves bragging rights.

name: Хоспис
summary: It seems that there is no place for failures in the life of cardiac surgeon Viktor Sturm, but the ideal facade is cracking due to problems in his personal life: Victoria's 14-year-old daughter loses trust in her father when he refuses to take on a hopeless patient. Trying to return his daughter's love, Sturm loses control, disrupts the operation and finds himself outside the profession. Trying to cope with a turning point in his career, a world-class doctor unexpectedly finds himself in a hospice, where his first wife and former classmate are dying. Trying to help her, Sturm gets a job at an i

name: Слепой
summary: Having received a tip on a rich house, Senya, who trades in small-scale criminal earnings, goes on a robbery. But he is caught by the owner, a very influential and eccentric businessman, Orlov, who also turns out to be blind. Suddenly, he doesn't turn him in to the police, but makes him his personal assistant. But the seemingly carefree life of a billionaire turns into a tough business struggle for Senya with a high-ranking official, where not only their own destinies, but also the lives of their loved ones are at stake.

name: Bize Bi'şey Olmaz
summary: Aktan and Lal, at an unexpected point in their lives, encounter a love they cannot control, and despite all their differences, they cannot resist each other.
previous_episode: Aşk Dediğin İman Etmektir Bir İmkansıza

name: Goat Girl
summary: Tarzan was raised by apes. Mowgli was raised by wolves. Gigi was raised by… goats. This is the story of Gigi, a 13–year-old girl who just happens to have been raised by mountain goats. But now that she's a teenager, her Nanny and Billy think it's time that she spread her wings (er… horns?), so this year she will attend a boarding school and, for the first time in her life, spend time around actual people. Goat Girl is about being comfortable in your own skin, about being happy being you, about embracing your differences and your quirks – and even your weirdness!

name: Magic Move
summary: When an architecture student in his final year accidentally becomes a famous university fortune teller, he pretend-reveals that he was the childhood ship partner of the young heir to a real estate fortune. Although their relationship begins with a lie, it develops into a genuine love. At the same time, a young man fresh off a failed attempt to become a star in Korea comes back in search of his once-ship partner—who happens to be a particular real estate heir.

name: The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King
summary: Serafina, the West's fiercest knight, expected torture when captured by barbarians. Instead, she got a marriage proposal! Marrying her sworn enemy is a hard no! But after seeing her wedding captor's culture and very pretty face, she may be tempted to swap her sword for a wedding veil. Get ready for the ultimate enemies-to-maybe-lovers arc.

name: 2 for 2000
summary: On the run-up to the new millennium, CBBC launches its biggest ever game show. Hosted by heptathlete Denise Lewis, with Steve Wilson and Rachael Hopper.

name: Tigre-kun to Vanadi-chu
summary: Short chibi specials streamed alongside with the Madan no Ou to Vanadis anime TV series. Each episode was available on the official web site, and were later included on DVD/Blu-ray release.

name: Born to Bowl
summary: Born to Bowl takes viewers inside the colorful world of professional bowling, chronicling five stars of the sport – Kyle Troup, Anthony Simonsen, EJ Tackett, Cameron Crowe, and Jason Belmonte – as they chase glory, respect, and much-needed prize money on the Professional Bowlers Association (PBA) Tour. Set within bowling's blue‑collar culture, the series examines a familiar American family pastime that evokes myriad pop cultural references and reveals a quirky sport with ancient roots shaped as much by personality and persistence as by skill and precision. Every season, members of the PBA Tour

name: Kusunoki's Garden of Gods
summary: Minato Kusunoki is assigned to manage his family's haunted, abandoned countryside estate. However, thanks to his overwhelming spiritual power, Minato accidentally purifies the entire place, turning the once-cursed property into a peaceful haven for wandering gods and deities! As Minato settles in, he finds himself surrounded by quirky divine neighbors and the lively chaos of life among the gods.

name: Release that Witch
summary: Roland, a modern man reborn as a prince in the dangerous Border Town, rescues the witches Anna and Nana Pine from the Church. Harnessing their extraordinary powers, he fuses magic and technology to craft weapons, armies, and steam engines to defend his people. As the Demon Moon rises and conspiracies close in on his family, Roland must lead a revolution to protect his allies and reshape the world.

name: Life Is Strange
summary: Life is Strange follows Max, a photography student, who discovers she can rewind time while saving the life of her childhood best friend, Chloe. As she struggles to understand this new skill, the pair investigate the mysterious disappearance of a fellow student, uncovering a dark side to their town that will ultimately force them to make an impossible life or death choice that will impact them forever.

name: Risk Lust Love
summary: A story of greed, lust and capriciousness, of people who don't consider the consequences of their actions until it's too late. Priao is young and spoiled with role-model parents. She's an unrepentant partier but she's faithful. Aon has grown up with the weight of her parent's hopes on her shoulders. They want to see her elevated in society with a wealthy, appropriate partner. One looks wicked, another looks put-together and sweet, just as she would have it.

name: Ru Guo Qin Jian Hui Shuo Hua
Where There's Smoke
summary: In Where There's Smoke , a group of firefighters will navigate the intense challenges of their profession while grappling with personal struggles, fractured relationships, and the emotional toll of saving lives in a world filled with danger, drama, and heartbreak.

name: Leon – Glaub nicht alles, was du siehst
LAUGH
summary: Bigg Jah's dark comedy anthology explores the dangerous, absurd moments of Los Angeles hood life where survival often depends on bad decisions.

name: Yi Wan Quan Zhou Zhi Jiang Mu Ya
Bling Bling
summary: A small likay troupe is facing a major crisis. Following the sudden passing of the troupe's founder, his eldest son Petch-thae, unprepared, must step up as troupe leader and guide the family's likay troupe through all the troubles rushing in, all while endeavouring to preserve the vanishing traditional artform.

name: The Mask of Love
summary: Boon is an elder craftsman of ghost masks, which are said to be vessels for the dead. After dreaming of his missing daughter, Lalita, calling for help in the forest, he's unaware when her spirit enters his latest piece. When travel content creator Thianphisut visits the Phi Ta Khon ghost festival in Loei with her boyfriend Rachen, she purchases Uncle Boon's blue mask and is possessed by Lalita's spirit. In this new form, Lalita meets her former lover Chatban, and he feels an uncanny familiarity.

name: Saneha Stories 4: Saiyai Saneha
summary: Tako has a son with Bell, and he's discovering he may be gay.

name: Jenny A.M./P.M.
summary: Jenkhwan, an architecture freshman who loves competition, loses a bet with his good friend Pod. Consequently, Jenkhwan has to dress as a woman for their high school farewell party. By chance, Jenkhwan comes to save drunk comm arts freshy Pin. Jenkhwan likes her immediately but the two part ways before they can get to know one another. Fate, however, brings them together again under confusing circumstances: Jenkhwan's name ends up on the girls' dorm list and his roommate is none other than Pin. At first, Jenkhwan intends to clear things up and have his name moved to the men's dorm list. Then Po

name: Kirio Fan Club
summary: Aimi and Nami, two best friends who are rivals in their intense, sometimes delusional obsession with their quiet, average classmate, Ken Kirio. The story focuses on their over-the-top fantasies and attempts to grab his attention while they navigate high school life.

name: Sôgen no shôjô Laura
summary: Laura, the Prairie Girl is a Japanese anime television series based on the novels Little House in the Big Woods and Little House on the Prairie by Laura Ingalls Wilder. Twenty-six half-hour episodes were released between 1975 and 1976.

name: Dao Yao Xing
summary: Forced into a marriage of convenience based on mutual benefit, Jiang Yuan, an assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower, and Shao Yue, the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect, are ordered to marry. On their wedding night, they attempt an assassination, only to discover they are both immortal. To obtain the Demon-Suppressing Bell and the Demon-Controlling Bell, secret treasures of each other's sects, they transform from mortal enemies into a facade of marriage, engaging in a charade of mutual deception.

name: Hunt for the Missing: Chicago
summary: Retired Chicago Detective Pamela Childs revisits unsolved missing persons cases as she hopes to uncover new leads and find potential answers for the victims' families.

name: Naked City: Hitmen
summary: Carl Williams' thirst for revenge ignites Australia's bloodiest underworld war. To dominate the drug trade, he enlists a team of misfits to eliminate all rivals. Enter, the hitmen.

name: Maison de retraite, la série
summary: Christophe Beaugrand is now part of the tour of the new series "Maison de Retraite". The actress Chantal Ladesou was part of the casting. Six episodes on each other in box and diffusion are scheduled to debut in 2026 on TF1.
previous_episode: La crise de la double quarantaine

name: NÜKTE
summary: The story revolves around 35-year-old gambler Daniyar. Having escaped the trap of gambling addiction and returned home from a rehabilitation center, he carries the heavy burden of the past: lost joy, inexhaustible debts, years that have wounded his soul. Now he is faced with the task of rekindling his son's faith, starting a new life, and finding himself again. On this journey, he meets a love that warms his heart and restores his faith in miracles. This series is a story about second chances and self-acceptance, reminding us that everyone deserves a new beginning.

name: Drapet på LastebilJonas
summary: The family and friends of Jonas Aarseth Henriksen are left in despair after the murder that shook Norway. New details and the full story provide more answers to what happened.

name: Reclaiming My Lost Love
summary: Xu Chuyuan had secretly loved Bo Yanzhou for years. Their marriage was arranged, but all she received from him was cold indifference. When her identity as the "fake heiress" is exposed, she believes she has become nothing more than an unwanted daughter in a wealthy family and leaves in heartbreak, unaware that she is carrying twins. Unbeknownst to her, Bo Yanzhou's mother secretly takes away their baby boy, deepening the misunderstanding between them. Six years later, fate brings them together again. This time, Bo Yanzhou returns with their son, determined to win Xu Chuyuan back. When the trut

name: Twisted Yoga
summary: Twisted Yoga follows a group of young yoga students from around the world drawn to the ancient practice in search of inner peace and purpose, only to fall under the influence of reclusive Romanian "guru" Gregorian Bivolaru, the spiritual leader of an international network of yoga studios specializing in tantric rituals. As they begin to fear they've joined a cult, they discover that Bivolaru, who often summoned select female students to his Paris apartment for private initiations, has a dark past. Bivolaru now faces charges in France, including human trafficking, kidnapping and rape — allegati

name: Mao Shan Zai Zai Kai Ju Shou Fu Lao Zu Zong
Filing for Love
summary: Ki-jun, once the ace of the internal audit team, is now stuck handling petty office scandals—all thanks to his manager, In-ah. One day, he receives an anonymous tip: In-ah is involved in an inappropriate relationship at work. Digging into her secret for revenge, Ki-jun instead finds himself drawn to her.

name: The New Gothic
summary: The New Gothic redefines the legendary storytelling of the American South as it follows the collision of the enterprising Bloom family with the resurrected Mississippi Mafia. Set in a landscape stained by red clay and bad blood, villainy is commonplace. But power is singular.

name: 12 негритят
summary: 12 негритят is a show about people, a project that the characters themselves make. 12 people learn to live together, make friends, fall in love, quarrel and make up, build relationships.

name: Pen Tor 2017
summary: Yom and Wok compete for a girl's attention but she is more interested in Pentor. They become angry and plot a vengeful plan to get even.

name: Pen Tor 2018
summary: Pen Tor is about modern working singles who are looking for partners. It is centered around Mr. Pentor, a businessman in the BKL company. He wants to have an easy life and just wants to be a normal businessman like other people in Bangkok.

name: Remember
summary: A young lawyer with an extraordinary memory confronts the hurdles of proving his father's innocence in the face of serious criminal accusations.

name: The Messenger
summary: Q, the god of love who lost confidence in love, asked to leave heaven and go to the human world to find the "answer to love". In such an era where it is easy to love and break up, when he met Design, Q finally changed his opinion about love, which he had firmly believed in for 200 years.

name: The Cat and the Dragon
summary: An orphan since hatched, a lone dragon named "Uncle Wings" is taken in by a family of magic-wielding cats and raised as one of their own. As Uncle Wings grows, he becomes the cats' protector, determined to keep them safe from humans. But as he watches the cats connect with humans using their magic, Uncle Wings slowly starts to warm up to humans in this heartfelt, bittersweet tale.
previous_episode: The Cat and the Royal Capital Festival

name: Ingoku Danchi: Deviant's Apartment Complex
summary: Rookie building manager Yoshida must protect the peace of the apartment complex from the threat of a perverted housewife ! Yoshida, who took over as the caretaker of a certain housing complex in place of his father, is met with attacks from married women who have descended into madness while wearing lewd outfits called "Libido Cross." While being tossed about by the rampage of residents such as Watanabe and Ichinose, the threat of A-list married woman Kanzaki and the shadow of the police interfering with the incidents further deepen the darkness of the housing complex. Yoshida confronts them w
previous_episode: The Superhero of Justice in Battle!

name: Fake Fact Lips
summary: Ryou and Zen are two men who hate to lose—especially to each other. From high school rivals to rival co-workers, these two men have always been locked in fierce competition. They've competed over grades, sports, and even the number of Valentine's chocolates received! And now that they're salesmen at the same company, their rivalry has reignited. One night, while out for drinks, the two begin arguing about who's more experienced in love. Suddenly, their newest competition is set: the winner is whoever makes the other fall in love with them first! But will this competition of hearts really lead

name: Alexander
summary: In Alexander , as the Athenian empire crumbles, the world's greatest mind, Aristotle, arrives in Macedonia to tutor a volatile young prince Alexander. Amid palace intrigue, forbidden love, brutal war and ruthless ambitions, their unlikely friendship shapes an empire and alters the course of history.

name: Avvocato Ligas
summary: Lawyer Lorenzo Ligas is the man everyone would like to be. He is fired from his prestigious law firm because he is unable to distinguish between duty and pleasure, and to get back to the top he will face a challenge that he cannot tackle alone.

name: Do You Like Big Girls?
summary: Sota is suddenly made the dorm manager and coach of the Kitaei University women's volleyball team by a single word from his older sister, Kaoru . There, he finds his first love, Ayano, and experiences a fateful reunion... but in the girls' dorm! In the gym! In the hotel!? What awaits him are days of being tossed around by girls who are bigger than him! A hilarious harem romantic comedy with a huge size difference is born in the northern lands!!

name: The Galloping Heart
summary: With a vivid and lively gallery of characters, this drama unfolds four warm and healing stories set in xizang. There is a vibrant xizang's grandma, a xizang's cuisine team stepping onto the global stage, an indomitable young plateau marathon runner, and a brave and pure blind girl. They meet and illuminate each other atop the plateau, just as a line from the drama goes: "In the scenery we pass by, lie the lives of others; encounters from afar are also a reunion after a long separation."

name: Reincarnated Love
summary: Jiang Ruoli, the legitimate daughter of the Prime Minister's mansion, has the gift of precognition. When she dreams that her parents will be killed on the Lantern Festival, she tries to change their fate, only to be drawn into a dark conspiracy. She then meets Huo Linchuan, the heir to the Duke's mansion, who hides the mystery of ten lifetimes of reincarnation. Using his memories from past lives, Huo Linchuan saves Jiang Ruoli many times.
