name: Great British Castle Rescue
summary: Great British Castle Rescue follows Rick Edwards as he ventures inside some of the UK's most spectacular and endangered castles. From crumbling medieval towers to collapsing royal chambers, engineers and historians battle to stabilise these epic structures with help from National Lottery funding. Each rescue unlocks extraordinary stories of warrior kings, civil wars, brutal betrayals and forgotten lives. Across each episode, Rick meets heritage experts, engineers and stonemasons racing to save these buildings. Blending cutting-edge engineering, adventure and vivid historical reconstruction, th

name: Corazón de Oro
summary: Luz lives a modest life with her daughter Catalina, who is ashamed of her humble origins and pretends to be wealthy while dreaming of a life of luxury. Miguel Ángel, a successful blind lawyer, struggles to earn the approval of his powerful father, the owner of the prestigious Arango-Nova vineyards. Years ago, a scandal at the estate tore Luz and Miguel Ángel apart, cutting short a love that never truly faded. An unexpected reunion forces Luz to return to the vineyards with Catalina, reopening old wounds and bringing long-buried secrets to light. As Luz confronts lingering feelings, Catalina, b

name: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man Podcast
summary: Creators, special guests and stars — including Cillian Murphy — unpack the "Peaky Blinders" saga in this official companion podcast for the new film.

name: The Strongest Job is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (provisional)!
summary: Hibiki Manabe is transported to a world where monsters roam freely. There, he's granted a skill, "Appraisal," and given the job title, "Appraiser (Provisional)." With the help of Emalia, an elf from the grassland plains, he becomes an adventurer and teams up with Claude, Lilian, and Vene. Will he ever make it home? And will he become the strongest?!

name: Monster Aliens
summary: In Monster Aliens , chilling encounters blur the line between UFO sightings and legendary beasts. From Bigfoot to owl-men, witnesses and experts uncover a global pattern that suggests monsters and extra-terrestrials may be one terrifying mystery.

name: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
summary: Nao is a replica created to be Sunao Aikawa's perfect double, stepping in whenever Sunao skips school. She studies, plays sports, and lives each day for the original—until one day, Nao falls in love. Suddenly, her quiet, borrowed life blooms with secret dates and shy promises. But the more she cherishes them, the more she must hide from Sunao, who's starting to notice the changes in her replica.

name: Haibara's Teenage New Game+
summary: Natsuki Haibara thought his high school years were a complete failure—until he suddenly wakes up as a freshman again, armed with all he learned in college. Determined to rewrite his school days, he joins the popular crowd, makes friends he never had, and grows closer to his crush. But second chances aren't as easy as hitting "Restart." Can Natsuki turn his regrets into a rainbow-colored youth?!

name: Мёртвая точка
summary: Rita Galich, a housing lawyer, works at a social center. One day, she receives the news that her father, a respected lawyer and university lecturer Evgeny Vladimirovich, is accused of murdering his graduate student. Evgeny Vladimirovich's guilt is obvious to everyone — he was detained at the scene of the crime, his fingerprints were found on the murder weapon and on the victim's body. But Rita does not believe that her father was involved in what happened, and wants to find out the truth on her own.

name: Yétili
summary: Join Nina and Leon, two little mice, at story time with Yetili. Every day Yetili reads them an amazing new story. Yetili is a giant plush toy and mascot of the local bookstore. When the store is closed, he comes to life to join his friends for story time. And where can you find this magical shop? Why, it's right next door. Come in and have a look.
previous_episode: Attention, il y a un loup dans ce livre !

name: Ernest et Rebecca
summary: Ernest et Rebecca follows the adventures of a six-and-a-half-year-old girl named Rebecca and her best friend, a microbe named Ernest, whom she catches on a rainy day. Together, they navigate daily life, school, and crazy adventures while Ernest serves as the ultimate remedy for bad moods.

name: h&p@bbc.
summary: New variety show presented by comedy duo Hale and Pace. Weekly items include well-known names battling it out in Celebrity Quiz, unlikely impersonations of famous musical acts in Stars with Smoke in Their Eyes, and a search for Britain's most generous towns.

name: Skate Tales
summary: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.

name: Kenny's World
summary: Follow Australia's favourite portaloo plumber and part-time philosopher on a sight seeing tour you won't find in any travel guide

name: The Bob Morrison Show
summary: The Bob Morrison Show is the story of an ordinary family from through the eyes of their pet dog, Bob Morrison. Bob is an adorable stray that is welcomed by the youngest member of the Morrison clan, Ben, but he has a tough time winning over the rest of the family.

name: House Gang
summary: When Mike, a bankrupt landlord, and his adolescent daughter Chloe suddenly find themselves homeless, they decide the only solution is to move in with their three tenants. But father and daughter are shocked to learn that they now share a house with three people with an intellectual disability, and a motorbike-mad social educator. And if Chloe has something to say about the situation, so do Robert, Trev, Belinda and Jack. A warring comedy of foiled expectations follows.

name: Shinda Ani no Shinyuu wo Hiroimashita
summary: Taku Chiga (An Togashi), a first-year high school student living in Nasu Town, Tochigi Prefecture, one day happens to witness a young man, Mitsuru Morimoto (Mirai Fukahori), about to jump off a bridge and instinctively stops him. When Taku talks to Mitsuru after he regains his senses, it seems Mitsuru has nowhere to go and no money. Though suspicious, Taku couldn't bring himself to think Mitsuru was a bad person and reluctantly allowed him to stay for just one night. However, it later transpires that Mitsuru was the best friend of Suga's late elder brother, Harumi (Yoshida Haruto). Why has his

name: Wishing Upon the Shooting Stars
summary: A legend spreads on Xingpu Islet: toss a stone into the sea, and your wish may come true. He Xiangyong, a young man beaten down by life, makes a desperate wish to disappear. The next day, he wakes as Zhong Xiaoyou. No one knows him except his best friend Wanzhe, who stays by his side. Little by little, his new life brings warmth. He reconnects with his father, with everyone. Then Haowei returns, haunted by his own wounds. He's an old friend, a secret crush, and he can't explain why Xiaoyou feels so familiar. Meanwhile, Wanzhe wishes for epic love under shooting stars, sparking a chase by fishe

name: Predator Files
summary: Predator Files takes viewers onto the front lines of the fight to apprehend the world's most dangerous online child predators. Led by Roo Powell, law-enforcement consultant, survivor advocate, and founder of SOSA (Safe From Online Sexual Abuse), the series documents high-stakes undercover operations conducted in direct partnership with ICAC task forces, vice units, and district attorneys across the United States.

name: Stripped Down
summary: When six gay strippers at a Florida gay strip club are asked to live together, tensions boil as they navigate interpersonal conflicts and struggles in the industry.

name: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand.
summary: With no other options, Luck makes the choice to hold the line against the unending demonic hordes alone, to make sure his comrades can escape with their lives. However, through a combination of fortune, skill, and ingenuity, he holds that line for ten straight years, eventually coming out on top singlehandedly. Now he has to tackle the dilemma of how to occupy himself in a world where he holds a myriad of roles: that of a legend, that of a veteran, and that of a brand new face.

name: Space Warrior Baldios
summary: After polluting their own planet beyond repair, a race of evil aliens target earth as their next home. Now it is up to a lone outcast and his robotic spacecraft, Baldios, to defend earth. But, first he must convince the distrusting human population of the impending danger.

name: The Jack Dee Show
summary: Mean, moody, miserable and magnificently funny, Jack Dee takes to the stage at the Bohemia Club with an assortment of music guests.

name: Planes That Changed History
summary: Dive into the 125 years of aviation to uncover how aircraft have reshaped our world. The series explores the engineering secrets behind its success, its humble origins, and what made these aircraft icons years after their initial success.

name: La Oficina
summary: Jerónimo Ponce III, regional manager of Olimpo Soaps, is a nightmare for his employees, who must endure his politically incorrect outbursts just to survive the workday.

name: Power Couple România – La bine şi la greu

name: Без кутюр
summary: A project about fashion, style, and beauty with Alexey Sukharev! Using Russian and Western showbiz stars as examples, we highlight five fashion trends of the season. We'll show you all the successful and unsuccessful examples of how celebrities have embraced these trends, with a fashion expert commenting on them. We'll also tell you what to bring back from your mom's or grandma's closet to stay on trend. And in our columns, you'll learn how much Russian stars' looks cost and how their style has evolved over the years.

name: Mini-Jean et Mini-Bulle
summary: Mini-Jon and Mini-Maple are undergoing their training in the most secretive and technologically advanced Agency in the world! It's like school, but with less boredom and more explosions

name: The Genie From Down Under
summary: When upper class English girl Penelope Townes finds a magic opal that contains two Australian genies, Bruce and his son Baz, she thinks all her problems are over. Bruce, however, has other ideas.

name: BOHO
summary: Kima loses her job and pursues a crazy idea. Nawal struggles with her desire to have children. Alex thinks the Flemish have it too easy. Three friends from Borgerhout search for happiness and stumble through life happily.

name: Garfield
summary: Garfield , the series, is inspired by Jim Davis' original comic strip and features the chonky feline at his finest, most sarcastic and lackadaisical.

name: The Race for Ancient Egypt in Colour
summary: The Race for Ancient Egypt in Colour reveals the extraordinary story of Egypt in the years between the World Wars – a time when archaeology became entangled in the politics of a nation striving for sovereignty. In 1922, Egyptology burst onto the world stage with Howard Carter's discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb sparking global Egyptomania. But the discovery came amid a period of rapid political change, with Egypt having won partial independence from Britain. As its leaders sought greater control over foreign excavations, many Western archaeologists resisted, unwilling to relinquish access to a p

name: Vincenzo Malinconico, avvocato d'insuccesso
summary: Semi-unemployed, semi-divorced, semi-happy, but above all an unsuccessful lawyer. More psychologist than lawyer, Vincenzo Malinconico always has an off-topic thought in his head. He mostly defends friends and relatives in not particularly demanding disputes that he doesn't always win. Separated, with two children, women like him due to his insecurity, but he is unable to fulfill himself on a sentimental level. Vincenzo Malinconico makes us passionate about his ramshackle events and shows the world through his ironic and authentic gaze.

name: Rex - Vienna Calling
summary: The crime-fighting canine joins his partner, Detective Max Steiner, to solve even the hardest cases in the Austrian capital.

name: Le Rêve français
summary: In the 60s, the Government encourages Islanders to leave the French West Indies to escape poverty that results from the closure of sugar mills. Lured by the idea of a "dream country", they find life in Europe is not what they had imagined.

name: This Tastes Funny
summary: Iliza Shlesinger and her chef husband Noah Galuten travel the length of New Zealand discovering all of the sights, tastes and smells the country has to offer in preparation for Iliza's first New Zealand comedy show.

name: Ready Vet Go: The Vet Paramedics
summary: Vet paramedics race to save critically ill pets at home and on the road. Join Melbourne's vet paramedics for real pet emergencies.

name: Ed Gamble's Unacceptable!
summary: Two teams of comedians battle to convince the studio audience of their most outrageous opinions that they're forced to defend.

name: Hva gjorde denne russeren i Norge?
summary: In a sounding Trøndelag, the businessman has been hunting down Norwegian waterworks, ports and properties. We uncover Norwegian security holes and seek him out with a hidden camera.

name: Wild & Fiery
summary: Twenty years ago, a child was secretly switched. The Mu family's true young master, Shen Jibai, was cast out and grew up among ordinary people, living a poor and dangerous life. The false heiress, Mu Zhiyu, returns to the country as a top auctioneer, determined to take back the auction house from her stepmother, Xu Mingzhu. Xu Mingzhu uses Shen Jibai to approach Mu Zhiyu, drawing the two of them into a vortex of power struggles. As they pull against each other within the schemes of the powerful family, they eventually join forces to seek revenge.

name: Полицейский по обмену
summary: Chinese policeman Desheng is a hereditary officer of the law and a member of the Communist Party, who grew up respecting rules and protocols. They taught him everything: to fight, shoot, negotiate, but he never had a chance to apply the skills: there is perfect order in his neighborhood. But he has learned Russian well and understands our culture. So the hero gets to partner up with the metropolitan Coast. name: Secret Sex Lives of Tyrants
summary: Secret Sex Lives of Tyrants uncovers the private worlds of some of history's most notorious dictators. The series examines the sexual power plays, obsessions and abuses that influenced rulers' reigns - and sometimes the fate of nations. From Muammar Gaddafi's secret sex chambers, Fidel Castro's insatiable womanising, Joseph Goebbels' politically charged affairs, Saddam Hussein's sexual brutality, Mao Zedong's concubine network and Idi Amin's murderous polygamy, the series reveals how intimate appetites became deliberate instruments of control.

name: Adolf Hitler: Decoding a Dictator
summary: Explores six different aspects of Adolf Hitler's life and reign, revealing how an uneducated, ordinary man left a legacy of unprecedented evil.

name: Lex
summary: In Lex , when a disgraced former reality star accidentally films a murder in the background of a $20 Cameo video, he finds himself at the center of a global conspiracy — and on the run from powerful forces who want him dead. Using the skills he acquired navigating reality TV's toxic social dynamics, Lex must fight to not get killed, to expose the truth, and most importantly… to get back on TV.

name: Durango
summary: Durango follows Mikey, a ski bum townie chasing a buzz, and Bunny, a homeschooled runaway working as a greasy-spoon waitress. Together they're riding an avalanche of bad decisions and falling in love while running from cops, criminals, and Mikey's wife in pursuit of their own American dream.

name: First Timers on the Frontline
summary: First Timers on the Frontline follows student, intern and newly qualified paramedics as they face real emergencies. The series offers a close look at a new generation of paramedics learning on the job with support from advanced paramedics and senior members of the National Ambulance Service.

name: Hold the Dream
summary: Emma Harte has trained her grand-daughter, Paula, to 'hold the dream' and retain intact the vast business empire that is her legacy from Emma. But will the burden prove too heavy?

name: To Be the Best
summary: Paula feuds with her cousins as she fights to save her grandmother Emma's business.

name: Hard Spell
summary: Britain's best young spellers battle it out in five regional heats, but only one person can go through each day to the final where they will compete for the title of Hard Spell champion.

name: Le Libere Donne
summary: Lucca, 1942. After an act of desperate defiance, Margherita is committed to Maggiano by her husband. Here she meets Mario Tobino, a doctor returning from the front who opposes the coercive methods of the institution. While he rediscovers his old love Paola, now a partisan and persecuted, Mario seeks the truth about Margherita: is she really ill or just a victim of violence?

name: Drift This
summary: All the smoke, all the speed, and all the style!! Drift This is comin' in sideways as Chris Forsberg and Ryan Tuerck take five from their pro cars to bring some variety to the drift game. These two legends of drift pull out all the stops to go full drift in big ol' trucks, teeny li'l cars, things that should never drift, and everything that should have been drifting all along!

name: Hokuto no Ken: Fist of the North Star
summary: In the year 199X, the world was engulfed in nuclear fire!! Yet...humanity somehow survived!! A lone man with seven scars on his chest emerges. His name is Kenshiro, heir to Hokuto Shinken. In a world where only the strong survive, Kenshiro forges a path with his iron fists!

name: The Sisaundra Show
summary: The Sisaundra Show is a live daily talk show blending celebrity interviews, musical performances, faith-driven and inspirational conversations designed to uplift, inform and entertain while celebrating Black culture.

name: Point of View (POV)
summary: Point of View (POV) is a live panel talk show centered on the perspectives and lived experiences of diverse Black women, delivering timely discussions on current events, relationships, career, wellness and issues shaping Black communities nationwide.

name: EVO
summary: From the hottest supercars to everyday rides, this series covers everything from track tests to epic road trips to car-of-the-year showdowns.

name: Brasil 70: A Saga do Tri
summary: When legends take the field and a nation dares to dream, history is made. Lace up your soccer shoes: Pelé and his all-star team are coming for the cup.

name: The Master Cutter
summary: A former scout ranger–turned–tailor and secret man-hunter takes in a street-smart girl and her guardian, then is hired to hunt the girl down. Defying the contract, he uncovers that she is his biological daughter and tied to a powerful crime syndicate, forcing him into a brutal war to save his newfound family and confront the ghosts of his past.

name: Fatal Fraud
summary: Fatal Fraud delves into cases where financial schemes spiral into betrayal, violence and murder, exposing the deadly cost of lies fueled by greed.

name: On Pace with Pastrana
summary: The 29-year-old has broken nearly every bone in his body on his death-defying path to motorcross glory. Now, Travis is up against the biggest challenge of his professional career: to become a top competitor in NASCAR racing.

name: Sammy's Children's Day
summary: Set in 1980s Kowloon Walled City, where triads run rampant and corruption infects the police force, He Chusan dreams of studying hard and escaping the chaos. His plans collapse when Xia Liuyi, a triad deputy leader, forcibly pulls him into a criminal scheme. As conspiracies unfold and power struggles intensify, the two men move from reluctant allies to partners in revenge. He Chusan, a calculating yet deeply devoted financial strategist, and Xia Liuyi, a fierce but unexpectedly tender enforcer, find themselves fighting side by side. In a lawless city balanced between black and white, love beco

name: Asia Express
summary: Diverse couples of both famous and unknown personalities set off on a journey across Asia. They have one euro per day and a big task - to be the first to reach the finish line! The contestants are given challenging tasks along the way, and while their relationships are put to the test, it is mainly their willpower that keeps them afloat. Only those who can handle the pressure, inclement weather and unexpected situations have a chance to win an attractive financial prize.

name: Rafaela y su loco mundo
summary: A surreal comedy where Rafaela and her friends navigate an adolescence full of absurd and wacky situations while trying to save the world before they become adults

name: Bad Choice Good Love
summary: Once known as the "Love Master" for her proactive approach towards romance, Kamoi Hiyori becomes timid after a traumatic breakup with her university boyfriend, Sudo Kei. However, her life faces a drastic turn when she suddenly timeslips back to four years ago, when she was still a university student. Reunited with Kei, Hiyori vows to not date Kei again but her heart begins to waver after experiencing Kei's kindness and thoughtfulness she did not noticed before.

name: Life in Smokey Blue
summary: Sakutaro's former colleague and No. 1 sales rival, Shizuka Kuji, saved him from danger when he was out having a good time one night. When Kuji left the company a step earlier than Sakutaro, he looked at him with envy, thinking that he must have a brilliant second career now. But when Kuji reunites with Sakutaro for the first time in eight years, his sarcastic personality is still the same, but for some reason, he is now working as a translator, looking languid and with long hair...

name: Wild Weather
summary: Donal MacIntyre is blasted, roasted, frozen and soaked on an epic journey to experience the wildest weather the planet can throw at him. In Wild Weather , the tough man of journalism meets his match in a new series exploring how the world's weather works. From a gruelling marathon in the heat of the Sahara to paragliding through the fury of the monsoon, MacIntyre is tested to the limit. Wild Weather explores the elements and hears from scientists investigating how the weather works, and those who are trying to tame it. Using state-of-the-art 3D graphics, this wild ride through the weather is b

name: OG Stories
summary: The unfiltered docuseries gives voice to the OGs, the cultural architects, street legends, and self-made bosses who built empires from nothing. Through cinematic visuals and candid, character-driven conversations, Dash builds with those who've walked the walk, creating a space where game is given, not sold. From surviving the trenches to breaking generational curses, OG Stories captures the mindset, moments, and blueprint of those who've shaped culture and the communities connected to it.

name: Riding on the Wind
summary: The project tells the story of the young prodigy painter Xi Meng of the Song Dynasty and his journey of growth as he eventually collaborates with Emperor Huizong to create the legendary masterpiece A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains. Within the imperial painting academy, Xi Meng fights side by side with the guard Aji through life-and-death trials; in a hidden chamber, he humbly studies under an unseen mentor he has never met; and in the imperial court, he boldly questions Emperor Huizong's mistakes in governing the realm. As these three figures—mentor, friend, and adversary—gradually conver

name: Everlasting Moonlight
summary: Wealthy heiress Yu Ming and impoverished student Yang Jingzhi once loved each other deeply, but were forced to part when her family fell from grace. Five years later, Yang Jingzhi rises to become a rising tech tycoon, while Yu Ming struggles to make ends meet and repay debts. Everyone expects him to seek revenge, yet unbeknownst to them, he has never let go. Breaking through the barriers of status and time, the two find their way back to each other with renewed determination.

name: The Secret of the Lost Pearl
summary: A pair of embroidered shoes kicks off the adventure of cultural relics expert Chen Youxi. A four-person team clashes repeatedly with tomb raiders while searching for the Lingxiao Pearl. Yet after securing the first Lingxiao Pearl, they realize they've stumble into an even greater conspiracy...

name: Escravos da Fé - Os Arautos do Evangelho
summary: The series investigates allegations of abuse and psychological manipulation by former members of the Catholic group Heralds of the Gospel.

name: Nua na Rede: A Verdade Sobre Rose Leonel
summary: This documentary series follows the story of Brazilian journalist Rose Leonel, who in 2006 became the victim of a massive leak of intimate photos and transformed her pain into activism, leading the fight against digital crimes in Brazil.

name: I Survive In The Villain's Arms Through Psychotherapy
summary: Qi Jiujiu transmigrates into a novel as an heiress engaged to Huo Xize, fated to die. She breaks the engagement and meets Huo Shenye, his younger brother—a villain who craves physical contact and vows to take everything from Huo Xize.

name: Жребий судьбы
summary: Restaurant singer Ksenia marries a military psychologist, who is soon sent to a hot spot. Pregnant Ksenia is thrown out onto the street by her husband's brother, without any documents. An underground doctor delivers the babies prematurely. Three girls are born. Ksenia cannot be saved. Twenty years later, under strange circumstances, the father will have to meet his daughters, the existence of whom he had no idea about.

name: Kill Blue
summary: Legendary hitman Juzo Ogami has never failed an assignment. But after a mission, he's stung by a mysterious wasp and wakes up in the body of a 13-year-old boy! And to make things even weirder, he receives a bizarre new order: infiltrate a middle school. Now the once-feared assassin must balance the chaos of school life with his deadly work, all while searching for a way to regain his adult body!

name: Çirkin
summary: The series follows Meryem, who holds onto life with nothing but good intentions, as she reunites with her one true love, Kadir—now a man whose world has been shaped by power, wealth, and ambition.

name: Los Asesinos de Colosio
summary: This three-part docuseries chronicles the search for answers in the 1994 assassination of Mexican political candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio.

name: Fakhr El Dilta
summary: Mohamed Salah Fakhr, an ambitious young man from a Delta village, strives to break into advertising, determined to prove that success depends on belief in a dream, not living in Cairo.

name: Las Autenticas Aventuras del Profesor Thompson
I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
summary: At a secret academy where orphaned children are raised as weapons, death is routine and grief is forbidden. Sheena, a 14-year-old who questions this brutal life, meets Mimi, a mysterious, blood-soaked girl who refuses to break. In a world built on violence, the two cling to fragile hope and fight to hold on to their humanity.

name: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
summary: New university life, new dormmates…and a whole new world of drinks! Botan Kamiina takes her first sip of alcohol after spotting the quiet dorm leader, Ibuki Tonami, enjoying a highball alone. From shochu to whisky, Botan shares the joy of drinking with friends, while Ibuki slowly learns that some pleasures are better when shared.

name: Tystnaden
summary: When Linus suddenly disappears without a trace one day, his closest friends gather to search. Why is Linus missing? And what has happened?

name: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
summary: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.

name: Amor Animal
summary: Amor Animal is an Argentinian Original, fictional drama series following Kaia, a trap artist from the outskirts of the city, who meets Nico, an upper-class young man with existential angst. Despite their different realities and the outside forces pushing them apart, they try to make space for their love to grow, and in doing so, unleash a gang war.

name: Monsieur Molina
summary: As a retired schoolteacher, Mr. Molina decides to become a judge in his local jurisdiction, a job he takes to relieve the court of minor cases, and in which he will have to deal with people from his neighborhood involved in petty crimes.

name: David: King of Israel
summary: The four-part docudrama series David: King of Israel , hosted by Zachary Levi, premieres on Fox Nation on February 26, 2026. The series explores the life of the biblical King David, with new 45-minute episodes airing weekly. The dynamic life of King David: giant killer, renegade warrior, and unifier of Israel under his crown.

name: Beneath the Brilliance
summary: Orphaned Shen Moran learned from a young age to hide her true self in order to survive. After being adopted, she was mistreated and exploited by her adoptive mother, but eventually broke free from her control and made her way to the entertainment industry. To climb higher, she strategically leveraged Lin Qian, who once bullied her, and allied with Su Nian, the biological heiress of a prominent family. Her boyfriend, Gu Yechen, saw the tenderness and sincerity beneath her fierce exterior and silently protected her all along. Just as Shen was on the verge of winning Best Actress, Gu Yechen was a

name: Back to Your Heart
summary: A misunderstanding brings software engineer Min Hui and CEO Xin Qi together, leading them into an unexpected love, until another misunderstanding tears them apart. Years later, fate brings them face-to-face again at work. As workplace tensions, regret, and lingering feelings collide, they are drawn into a bittersweet romance that leads them back to the love they never truly left behind.

name: Help! I Bought It at Auction with Sarah Beeny
summary: Help! I Bought It at Auction with Sarah Beeny explores the drama, risk, and reward of buying property at auction. From bargain terraces to sprawling mansions—and even the occasional castle—each episode follows gripping real-life stories of buyers seeking a bargain and gambling their life savings in pursuit of their dream home. But with many properties in dire need of renovation, the journey is rarely straightforward. Behind every wall and beneath every floorboard could lie a costly surprise.

name: How to Suffer 101
summary: When former psychotherapist Fai is hired to teach Happiness, a newly offered course aimed at helping students to get to know and understand themselves, she finds that nothing is as easy as she'd thought. A troubled student in her class, Kla, insists that happiness does not exist. Fai often finds herself helping him, despite what he wants. In her class, she also meets Miu, a depressed medical student; Win, Miu's perfectionist and controlling boyfriend; Good, a cheery freshie with no friends; and Chai, an electrical engineering student who identifies as a woman. Fai also reconnects with Itt, a p

name: The Idol Game
summary: The story of a renowned family of surgeons who hold significant power in Thailand's cosmetic surgery industry. Their enormous profits from the business become a source of internal conflict within the family. Especially between Dr. Thicha, the ambitious oldest sister, and Dr. Tan, the youngest brother struggling to find his place in the family. Meanwhile, the dangers of cyberspace are shown with Itthichai or "It," an expert programmer from a government agency, who must solve an mystery that links cybercrime to the dark side of the cosmetic surgery industry.

name: Win the Mall
summary: Living inside a mall is a dream — until $1 million is on the line. In this reality competition series, 10 teams vie for wealth and stores to win it all.

name: Dujupsorn
summary: "Fah" Dujupsorn's mother M.L. Wilairampha remains resentful of M.R. Ronnaphi Juthathep for breaking a promise to marry her. Fah loves her mother so much that she is ready to take revenge on the Juthatheps; she is to apply for a job at a Juthathep-owned company and seduce M.L. Ronnaphum Juthathep to fall for her, only to hurt him. Ironically, it is Fah who falls in love; she is stunned when she meets the president of the company, Major M.L. Asira Juthathep, the eldest son of M.R. Tharathorn, as he is the charming and handsome soldier from her past who had once saved her life. She now faces the

name: Poncheewan
summary: The bright and beautiful cousins of Dhevaprom—Cheewan and Poncheewa—are close like sisters and do everything together, including studying in Switzerland. Meanwhile, M.L. Saruj Juthathep, son of M.R. Pavornruj and Princess Wanrasa, is the First Secretary of the Thai Embassy in Bern, whose job is to support Thai students. This is a perfect setting for romance, but not a love triangle. Things get complicated when Cheewan falls for Saruj while she is supposed to play Cupid for her Poncheewa and Saruj. They become entangled in a web of lies and jealousy that threatens to tear apart the cousins' onc

name: Jeff Dunham's The Cars That Drove Us
summary: Cars began rolling off the assembly line over 100 years ago. Two billion vehicles later, we still can't get enough. The Cars That Drove Us takes viewers into Jeff Dunham's garage - home to 130 legendary cars. Joined by his cast of characters, Dunham reveals the storied history of era-defining rides, from the Corvette Stingray to the ill-fated Vector W8, as told by the engineers, artists, and socket slingers who built them.

name: Glory Back
summary: Empress Gu Qing, betrayed and perished in flames, is reborn as Feng Qing, a lowly seamstress in the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau. To protect her sister Gu Wan and uncover the truth behind her death, she navigates the treacherous harem, joining forces with her younger brother, Imperial Physician Gu Xuan. As she schemes amidst the palace's shadowy powers, her fate becomes inextricably tangled with Emperor Xiao Luo. Their bond rekindled with every confrontation.

name: Wo Xi Huan De Ren Bian Cheng Mao Shi Zen Yang De Ti Yan
The 50
summary: 50 players navigate a chaotic Mahal where rules don't exist. In this lawless game, alliances form and break, betrayals matter, and each turn affects all contestants.

name: Koi ni Ochita Ohitori Sama: Stendhal no Renairon
Ein Sehreya
summary: Adel, a young surveillance installer, secretly plants cameras for money and accidentally witnesses a murder, drawing him into a dangerous network of corruption that forces him to fight to protect his family.

name: Agents of the Four Seasons: Dance of Spring
summary: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

name: Time Rescue
summary: An unexpected accident shatters a once-happy family, leaving Wen Xin as the sole survivor. By chance, she obtains a magical lantern that allows communication across time. Joining forces with Sun Wen from twelve days in the past, the two embark on a desperate race against time to save the family. As they attempt to change fate, the rescue becomes increasingly perilous, revealing that the accident was not a simple tragedy but the beginning of a web of hidden conspiracies and looming dangers.

name: Runaway Healer
summary: Ji Bai, a gifted young physician, flees an arranged marriage only to run into a group of bandits—led by none other than her never-before-met runaway fiancé, Xiao Heyan. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the mismatched pair become entangled in mysterious illnesses and the hidden intrigues of a medicinal hall. As they navigate life-and-death trials together, unexpected feelings begin to grow. Yet just as the truth comes to light, Xiao Heyan falls into an eternal slumber, poisoned by a deadly gu toxin…

name: The Dark Gold
summary: Amid sweeping reforms in the mining industry, the quiet village of Dayang is thrust into turmoil. An ordinary villager, Yang Gang, is forced into the dangerous undercurrents of the mines in order to protect his family. Together with his brothers, he takes a desperate risk by venturing into a forbidden mine shaft, only to uncover a hidden secret tied to a gold deposit. From that moment on, he becomes entangled in a web of corruption and crime. As pressure mounts from the mine's authorities, rival factions clash both openly and in the shadows, and a series of misfortunes befall those around him.

name: Dongbei's Back
summary: When Zhou Dongbei returns to his hometown in Northeast China, he unexpectedly digs up a bucket of gold in his own backyard. With his buddies and his longtime crush by his side, he sets out on an ambitious entrepreneurial journey, launching one outrageous business venture after another—from "KenDeQi" and "Hali Baba" to "Penguin QQ." But his longtime rival, Wang Jinsheng, is always close behind, pulling every trick in the book to bring him down. Just as Zhou Dongbei seems poised to finally defeat his rival, a long-buried secret at the hospital suddenly comes to light—revealing that the people he

name: Chong Sheng Huang Nian Di Ping Jie Gui
The Verdict
summary: Broadcast Legend Christopher "Mad Dog" Russo gives the definitive take on the greatest debates in sports.

name: Finlay Donovan Is Killing It
summary: Finlay Donovan Is Killing It follows a struggling novelist and single mom on the verge of losing custody of her kids, who is mistaken for an assassin and offered life-changing money for one kill.

name: O11CE: Nueva generación
summary: After six years of success in European soccer, Gabo, Dedé, and Ricky decide to visit IAD, the Academic Sports Institute, which saw them grow up, and surprise them. But they are the ones who get the surprise: the IAD is not as it used to be and the Golden Hawks, the soccer team they were part of, is aimless, unmotivated, and on the verge of being relegates. Now they must restore the IAD's glory and the pride of being an Hawk: a new chapter begins, full of passion and plenty of soccer!

name: Le Morning Night
summary: After skyrocketing to fame as the host of *Morning Live* for just 18 months, Michaël Youn is finally back on M6, 20 years later. And since the network has given him free rein, you'll see that he hasn't lost any of his wildness or his irreverence.

name: L'humour à la plage
summary: Kev Adams hosts a stand-up comedy show on the beach with various French comedians.

name: Les 100 plus grands...
summary: Ranking of 100 clips (bloopers, stunts, magic, or surprises) from 100th to 1st.

name: Les Nuls, L'émission
summary: Les Nuls The show is a comedy show modeled on Saturday Night Live with Les Nuls broadcast on Canal+ from October 13, 1990 to March 28, 1992. Les Nuls were accompanied by a guest actor who played their sketches with them and a musical guest who performed two songs live. The show was also full of fake ads and fake trailers, not to mention L'édition, a fake newscast presented by Maurice Chevalier (Alain Chabat) and Pénélope Solète (Chantal Lauby).

name: Les mots d'Eric et Ramzy
summary: Les mots d'Eric et Ramzy is a French comedy show featuring the iconic duo Eric Judor and Ramzy Bedia. It is a series of short, absurdist sketches where the duo plays with language and situations, typical of their surreal humor style.

name: Vikram On Duty
summary: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him

name: The Legend of Lu Xiaofeng
summary: As mysterious cases shake the martial arts world, Wuwang Pavilion offers Lu Xiaofeng a miracle cure for blindness if he can solve a series of impossible crimes. Determined to restore his best friend Hua Manlou's sight, Lu Xiaofeng takes on the challenge. From deadly flower curses and mysterious gambling houses to haunted islands and sinister desert inns, each case grows stranger and more dangerous. With his sharp mind, signature skills, and trusted allies including Hua Manlou, Ximen Chuixue and Sikong Zhaixing, Lu Xiaofeng uncovers the truth behind every mystery and ultimately stops a conspira

name: Hirayasumi
summary: At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people around him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

name: Mao
summary: Nanoka survived a car accident that killed her parents when she was young. Her only memory was a mysterious burning shopping street that didn't match any official reports. Years later, rumors of ghosts, she returns to the site and is transported back to early 20th-century Japan. Where she encounters a mysterious man named Mao, claiming that Nanoka isn't human, but an ayakashi (demon).

name: Meantime
summary: Meantime follows Felix McAveety, a full-time addict whose best friend is found murdered in a Glasgow park, leaving him as the police's most convenient suspect. In a fog of intoxication and paranoia, Felix sets out to clear his name, enlisting the help of an ageing former Detective Inspector turned crime novelist and a chaotic friend. Their search for the truth becomes an exhilarating and frequently laugh-out-loud race through the murkier edges of contemporary Scotland, as events rapidly spiral out of control around him.

name: This Is a Gardening Show
summary: Zach Galifianakis digs into the world of gardening, interviewing curious kids and eccentric experts in a funny, oddball celebration of the food we eat.

name: Единственный мужчина
summary: The jewels of a great emperor, kidnappings, explosions and chases, acts of sabotage, a love that has endured through the years, separation and the discovery of happiness... name: Ultras

name: American Gladiators
summary: The iconic competition returns with each episode featuring weekend warriors from across the nation stepping into the Arena to face 16 powerful new Gladiators. From classic events like Joust, Powerball, Hang Tough, and The Wall, to high-impact new challenges including The Ring and Collision, every showdown demands pure grit, strategy, and heart. Only one man and one woman will conquer the Arena, claim $100,000, and earn the title of American Gladiator Champion.

summary: Erik Follestad takes Josefine Engmann and Jonas Bariås on a trip to show you why he loves Norwegian ice hockey.

name: Conspiracies & Coverups
summary: Driven by a relentless hunt for the truth, Bustamante pulls back the curtain on modern-day mysteries that blur the line between fact and fiction. Using his unique perspective and insider techniques, he investigates, pressure-tests, and challenges prevailing narratives to reveal the hidden forces behind these events and the motives used to manipulate the truth.

name: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed
summary: Follow Sophia and her friends as they embark on a glimmering quest to unlock Unicorn Island's mysteries and banish Grimoria — and Ravenzella — for good!

name: Hypnotic
summary: After mysteriously losing her parents as a child, a young woman infiltrates the family responsible, seeking revenge by tearing them apart.

summary: Dokkaew lives with her father and stepmother. Afraid that her husband's money will go to her stepdaughter, Dokkaew's stepmother tried to kill them in an accident. While struggling to get up from the accident, which hurt her father, Dokkaew is again hit by a car driven by Chit's mother who takes her to the hospital where she is diagnosed with amnesia. Chit's mother takes Dokkaew to her own house and names her Kahlong. Chit believes that Kahlong is faking her amnesia to take advantage of his naive mother and is suspicious of her while being attracted to her as well. Dokkaew's friend who is tryin

name: Ultra Q
summary: As supernatural events and monster attacks rock Japan, the military and government look to be overwhelmed. Three intrepid young investigators—two pilots and a reporter—take it upon themselves to study these unexplained phenomena in order to inform and protect the public. With allies and science aiding them on their journey, the trio must separate myth from history as they explore the greater mysteries of these occurrences: are these unrelated, or is this barrage somehow a portent of things even worse to come?

name: A Kiképzés
summary: A military sports reality show commissioned by the Ministry of Defense. The best 24 players (men and women), selected in advance, form four teams and compete against each other in a team competition based on military training, pushing their own physical and mental limits.

name: Exploring Quantum History with Brian Greene
summary: Quantum physics? Theoretical physicist Brian Greene helps you understand its origins and its impact on today's world.

name: Határtalan szerelem
summary: We can follow the matchmaking efforts of six single Hungarian entrepreneurs living abroad. The show gives an insight into the lives of Hungarians living and working in beautiful foreign landscapes. Those applying to them have to travel far and wide to get to know them, which, in addition to the matchmaking, provides even more excitement and experience for matchmakers and candidates. The host of Határtalan szerelem is Babett Köllő, who keeps in touch with matchmakers from Hungary and asks them about their feelings.

name: Curious Minds: Quantum Computing
summary: What's a qubit? How do you visualize an atom? Welcome to the new world of quantum computing!

name: Uncorked
summary: Uncorked delves into the life of a talented but self-destructive winemaker who returns to Napa for her second chance at love, legacy and that elusive 100-point wine. Not that she's constantly refreshing WineSpectator.com or anything. This is a woman whose greatest passion is also her fatal flaw — a failing that usually begins before lunch on Tuesday.

name: Το Τρίτο Σταφάνι
summary: Based on the classic Greek novel of the same name by Kostas Tachtsis. Nina is a middle aged woman living in Athens in the late 1930s, while Hecuba is an older woman who moves from Thessaloniki to Athens with her adult children. From their first meeting at Nina's home, the two women form a close friendship. As they share memories and stories from their lives, their personal experiences bring to life the struggles, passions and hardships of ordinary people in modern Greece, against the backdrop of a country undergoing profound social and historical change.

name: The Moment I Met You
summary: Detective Mao Buyu is determined to marry Chu Yunchang, unaware that she is secretly the leader of a powerful thieves' guild. To earn the promotion he needs for their future, Mao Buyu vows to capture the notorious "Jade Squirrel." Torn between her family's legacy and the man she loves, Yunchang must navigate a double life as a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game begins.

name: Soft-Hearted God
summary: Ye Zhao, a lofty and ruthless god, falls into the mortal world for love. Princess Chu Xihe of the royal family carries the secret of a dual identity, and the two become powerful rivals entangled in a sea of love and hatred. Across a hundred years, their relationship shifts from love at first sight to bone-deep resentment, as a pure yet fateful romance transcends reincarnation—unraveling hidden truths amid their obsessive bond and the greater duty to family and nation.

name: Fireworks
summary: Qiao Nian, the obedient daughter of a powerful conglomerate family, falls to her death under mysterious circumstances, but her story doesn't end there. Unable to move on, her spirit possesses the body of Jiang Zecheng, a man entangled in the dangerous world surrounding her family. With only 7 days to reclaim her original body before both souls are destroyed forever, the unlikely duo race against time, digging through dark secrets, exposing hidden enemies, and outsmarting the villains who orchestrated her fall. name: Braving the Famine with My Wife
summary: Zhao Dong, an immortal sovereign obsessed with enlightenment and blind to earthly attachments, is backstabbed by his immortal beloved and enters a calamity with nothing but regret. After rebirth, he inhabits the body of a country thug also named Zhao Dong. Through his dual existence as immortal and mortal, he comes to understand that everything has its limits. Determined to stay in the mortal realm, he vows to right his past wrongs and reawaken the Dao.

name: The Matter of Facts
summary: In an era defined by trolls, Chatbots, misinformation and disinformation, truth and lies can be indistinguishable. The Matter of Facts takes audiences to the frontline of the global information wars, where information is manipulated to influence what we believe, how we behave and who we vote for.

name: Pécheresses

Her mother enrolls her in a Catholic boarding school to punish her but above all to get rid of her. Cassidy must buy back a conduct by integrating into this boarding school with strict rules.

name: Bandi

For some, drug trafficking seems to be the only way out. This choice, far from being unanimous, puts a strain on the strength of family ties.

name: Lakásvadászok
summary: Hungarian real estate agents fight for the favor of couples and families who are about to buy a home, while also competing with each other. A lot depends on who offers the most attractive, best-value home, and who manages to best understand the tastes and needs of buyers.

name: Tizenkét okos ember

The answers are not evaluated immediately, the player has to mark how many of his answers he thinks are correct – this is the winning zone. If he gets it right, he can win up to twelve million HUFs, if not, he leaves empty-handed. Meanwhile, the host makes the game even more tense with offers and bluffs.

name: K9 PD with Jim Belushi
summary: K9 PD with Jim Belushi showcases intense moments caught on camera of officers and their K9 partners facing high-stakes calls, told through gripping footage from surveillance cameras, body and dash cams, drones and more. Actor and lifelong K9 advocate Jim Belushi returns to the world of heroic K9s—only this time, it's for real—serving as host of the series, which captures the courage, precision, and raw instinct behind one of law enforcement's most formidable partnerships.

name: Secrets of the Bees
summary: Explorer Bertie Gregory uncovers the hidden world of bees, revealing their vital role in pollinating the world's food and their astonishing intelligence.

name: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

He's convinced she's out of his league, but as their unlikely friendship grows, Maki starts to wonder…could there be more than just friendship between them?

By the time she uncovers the truth, unexpected things take place, and their lives becomes threatened and turns upside down.

name: Feel what you feel
summary: Ming De University law students Yu Lei and Chen Ke have no idea that they'll change each other's lives when they first meet. Initially, they seem like complete opposites: Yu Lei is bold and confident, while Chen Ke leans quieter, preferring to distance himself from others in a group. But instead, Yu Lei is caught off-guard by Chen Ke, leaving him without his usual bravado. Throughout their years of school, Yu Lei and Chen Ke gradually develop feelings for each other, but keep it hidden – until an impromptu game of football with the men's dormitory brings unspoken emotions out into the open.

name: Cat for honeymoon
summary: Tiger and Lynx's honeymoon trip goes off-plan and they wind up sleeping in a tent outside their homestay after Tiger says there's something mysterious inside. So, Lynx takes Tiger back inside the house to prove exactly what the source of that sound is.

name: Murder on the Fringe
summary: Takes viewers on a journey into some of the most riveting homicide stories of the 21st century committed in society's most marginalized communities.

name: Pls.Love
summary: Based on a novel by Reverse, the story promises rivalry, emotional tension, and an unexpected connection between two women from very different worlds. The narrative follows two women whose lives exist in very different worlds. Fah is recognized as the top employee of a lounge club. Used to navigating complicated situations, she receives a task involving a wealthy businesswoman who openly despises her. That woman is Phakinee. Circumstances unexpectedly place them in the same bed, creating the starting point for a relationship built on confrontation, curiosity and growing emotional tension. As t

name: Amar Vishwas
summary: Brilliant, eccentric Mumbai lawyer Amar Vishwas defends the underprivileged while seeking hidden truths. When a powerful businessman is murdered, he navigates a deadly web of lies, suspects, and shocking twists to deliver justice.

name: Русские цари
summary: A documentary about the Romanov dynasty. "Tsar" was the primary title of the monarchs of the Russian Empire beginning in 1547. Officially, Ivan IV the Terrible was the first tsar, and Peter I was the last. After Peter I, the title of Russian monarchs became "emperor." However, as a semi-official title, it remained with Russian monarchs until the 1917 Revolution.
previous_episode: Последний на престоле. Николай II Александрович

name: Lenny und Twiek
summary: Lenny is looking for a friend. To this end, he puts up a "wanted" ad on a big tree, but no one responds. Instead, Lenny stumbles upon Twiek, who's dragging his birdhouse behind him. Well, until a friend comes along, Lenny can at least pass the time with Twiek…

name: Rasmus Klump
summary: The whole world is their playground, but they are always back home in time for pancakes.

name: Mamonogurai no Boukensha: Ore dake Mamono wo Kuratte Tsuyoku Naru
summary: Rudd's a nobody-- just an E-Rank adventurer with a seemingly useless talent of status immunity. An outcast in a city obsessed with labyrinth crawling, he's stuck scraping by as a "grubby forager," navigating guild politics and backstabbing adventurers just to survive. But when a betrayal leaves him for dead without any supplies or help, he does the unthinkable and consumes the flesh of fallen monsters...

name: Kujima: Why Sing, When You Can Warble?
summary: In the fall of his first year of middle school, Arata Kouda meets Kujima, a strange, talkative creature that's neither bird nor human. What begins as a small act of kindness turns into an unexpected stay at the Kouda household. Meant to be only until spring, Kujima's clumsy warmth, soft cries, and gentle mystery quietly become part of the family's days, weaving tender, fleeting bonds.
previous_episode: Out of Sight, Closer to the Heart

name: Clash of the Superpowers: America vs China
summary: Clash of the Superpowers: America vs China delivers the inside story of how, since Donald Trump's first term as President, America and China have become locked in a battle for global power and influence. Drawing on candid first-hand accounts from key insiders, the documentary looks at the policies, personalities, power plays, and pivotal moments that have shaped one of the most consequential geopolitical rivalries of our time.

name: Surviving the Cold General
summary: Transmigrated into a novel as a princess, Li Xunzhi knows her fate. One month from now, her husband Xiao Xing will execute her. Determined to survive, she takes the initiative to win his heart, navigating the schemes of a scheming cousin and the suspicions of those around them. Along the way, she outsmarts the crises plaguing the marquis's household and untangles the corruption in the estate's ledgers, earning Xiao Xing's respect with each triumph. Just as they finally find their way to each other, Xiao Xing is ensnared in a conspiracy woven by foreign spies.

name: A Mountain in My Sight
summary: At fourteen, Wei Lingyi cut ties with her father after watching his mistress kill her mother. Taking her younger brother Wei Shao with her, she sought refuge with her maternal grandparents. To survive and secure a future, she entered the palace as the princess's study companion. Biding her time while quietly plotting her rise, she earned the princess's trust and came to know the crown prince, Ning Yu. She made the prince fall for her, helped him claim the throne, and leveraged his favor to climb higher step by step...

name: In Love with Loving You
summary: At his darkest hour, Song Zhaoli crosses paths with Ji Xuan, a young woman shattered by family tragedy. In secret, he sponsors her education. Years later, a twist of fate brings Ji Xuan back into his life. Against all odds, Song Zhaoli rises from the ashes, breaking through every barrier in his path. Through continuous interaction and communication, the two gradually understand and respect each other, and their love heal each other.

name: Zero Stars
summary: Best friends and comedians Roisin Conaty and Sara Pascoe are visiting locations with the most hilarious, baffling and terribly bad reviews.

name: Decoding History's Prophecies
summary: Revelations, fortunes and harbingers of doom … human history is scattered with mysterious people rumored to have supernatural insight into the future. Have forces beyond our understanding endowed these extraordinary individuals with the gift of prophecy, or is there a rational explanation for these visions? This riveting documentary series blends dramatic reenactments, sweeping footage, and interviews with a panel of experts to present three captivating stories per episode. name: Yorkshire's Poshest Hotel: Grantley Hall

name: The Wire: Forensics Murder
summary: Following the work of detectives in their relentless pursuit of killers.

name: Disaster Strike Force
summary: Leading geoscientist Dr. Molly Martin sees Earth at a tipping point as climate change fuels natural disasters. Rather than wait for bureaucracy, she and her family join international disaster response unit R.E.A.C.T.

name: Ready or Not: Texas
summary: No plans, just vibes. When two best friends and their crew set off for Texas on an entirely unscripted adventure, there's no telling what's coming next.

name: Антикиллер 2: Антитеррор
summary: Colonel Fox is in charge of a counter terrorism group that will now have the complicated mission to help the police to prevent a dangerous Chechen terrorist organization that wants to free its leader at any cost, even if it has to destroy the whole place.

name: Tom Scott: England
summary: Tom Scott takes a road trip to every county of England, travelling by car, train, boat, plane, tram, monorail and hovercraft, visiting hidden infrastructure, ancient traditions, and more bells than you might expect.

name: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
summary: Welcome to CrunchLabs, a science playground where former NASA engineer turned creator Mark Rober tackles challenges that push creativity to the limit.

name: Capsized
summary: Set in the elite world of girl's high school rowing, Capsized follows Jo Bryant, a spitfire novice, and Margaret Douglas, the polished varsity captain, as they and their teammates unravel a dark secret behind their coach's legacy and train for the annual Head of the Charles Regatta.

name: Elegy for the Henchmen: Fist of the North Star
summary: 199X. The world is engulfed in nuclear flames, making mere survival a struggle. In this chaotic world, the protagonist Nobu finds a job none other than with the "King of Fists Army"! How long can Nobu survive in this dangerous workplace where more people die than apply ...? A cast of unique thugs appear one after another , including a thug disguised as an old woman, Cassandra's Uighur prison warden, and the Holy Emperor Army's "filth disinfection guy" !!

name: Bill's included
summary: Bill's included follows Bill Beam, a well meaning but over enthusiastic divorcee who rents his spare rooms to students to stay afloat. As Bill tries - and often fails to be both responsible landlord and honorary housemate, he and his mismatched lodgers muddle through chaos, growing pains and unexpected friendships.

name: Monstress
summary: Set in an Asian-inspired fantasy world, Monstress tells the story of a young woman with a literal monster living inside of her. On a quest to understand her past and avenge her mother's murder, she's joined by a colorful ensemble including a talking cat and a hybrid fox/human girl as they're thrown in the middle of a war between human and otherworldly forces. When the world turns us into monsters, Monstress asks how can we overcome our monstrosities?

name: FPJ's Batang Quiapo
summary: A young man rises to be one of the biggest outlaws in the neighborhood while he navigates his way in life to survive in Quiapo. Hoping to earn the affection of his parents, his feat draws him closer to the truth about his identity.

name: FPJ's Batang Quiapo: Unang Yugto
summary: FPJ's Batang Quiapo: Unang Yugto is a fast-paced, limited series that follows Tanggol, a young man raised in the dangerous streets of Quiapo, as he navigates the challenges of love, family, and survival.

name: Inside Britain's National Parks
summary: A look at four of Britain's 15 national parks, capturing these unique places and meeting the people who live and work in the New Forest, Pembrokeshire Coast, Dartmoor and Northumberland.

name: Golden City
summary: It tells how the three best friends (brothers) beat the world with their bare hands in the early 1960s to 1970s. The love stories of their generation connects to the next generation. The common emotions and memories between the two generations also highlights and explores the differences in their life values.

name: Dickens
summary: The bold new series will explore how Dickens, a restless insomniac and obsessive night walker, drew inspiration from the people and stories he encountered in Victorian London after dark. It shows how the characters he encountered on the streets, as well as in London's busy courts and jails, both shaped his stories and sharpened his keen sense of social injustice. Running alongside the story of his exploration of London is the story of Dickens' creative evolution, revealing how real-life events informed some of literature's most enduring works, from Oliver Twist and David Copperfield to A Chris

name: The Koreans
summary: Set during the wave of democratization and cultural modernization that swept across South Korea in the early 1990s, The Koreans will follow a middle-class family hiding a treasonous secret. While seemingly ordinary citizens in the eyes of their friends, neighbors and even their children, both parents actually are elite North Korean spies working to bring down the South from within. Highlighting the stark difference between these two formerly united countries, the series will follow the spies as they wrestle with conflicting feelings of patriotism, loyalty, identity and love, while a ruthless K

name: App me als je thuis bent
summary: In this painfully timely documentary series, women break the silence regarding the impact of sexual violence on the streets. Sexual assault cases from the past and present reveal how deeply women's lives have been affected. With unprecedented candor, women speak about the trauma, the road to healing, and justice.

name: The Scandal
summary: In Joseon's world of rank and reputation, an aristocratic wife and an infamous libertine pull a reserved lady into a scheme where love turns dangerous.

name: El depredador de Sevilla
summary: A sexual assault by a Spanish tour guide sparks a surge of similar claims from multiple US students. This documentary follows their fight for justice.

name: La acusación
summary: The limited series centres on the Sellés family, who belong to the well-off bourgeoisie, are well integrated into their city, and enjoy the esteem and respect of high society. Their perfect façade crumbles when Jaime, the model son, is accused of a terrible crime. While public opinion condemns him and the family falls apart under media pressure and social isolation, Mina, his cousin and a criminal lawyer, decides to defend him, convinced of his innocence. Over the course of the trial, the Sellés will be forced to unearth their past to find out whether Jaime is truly guilty.

name: Two Birds
summary: Set against the rarely-seen-on-screen landscape of Kalgoorlie, a remote Australian mining town carved from red earth, where rusted shafts and weatherboard pubs fade into endless bush, this harsh, beautiful, and isolating world clings tightly to its secrets. The series centres on British Police Constable Izzie Cornwell, who arrives in the small fictional town of Dugdale having been recently widowed and intent on a fresh start and a new life in Australia. name: La fiscal
summary: This documentary series goes deep into the new office created to combat femicide and exposes the harsh reality of violence against women in Mexico City.

name: Die SS - Zwischen Macht und Mythos
summary: The SS was the Nazi state's instrument of domination and oppression, responsible for the intelligence services and the police. The SS committed a horrific range of atrocities, including the Holocaust, the persecution of political opponents, and brutal war crimes. Millions of people were victims of the Schutzstaffel, and many of the perpetrators were unrepentant to the end. This six-part documentary provides a comprehensive overview of the SS, describing how a small group of thugs rose to become the most feared organ in the Nazi state. name: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
summary: Bertia is reincarnated into her favorite otome game—not as the heroine, but as the villainess engaged to the perfect Crown Prince Cecil! Fully aware that her role is to sabotage his future romance, she's determined to bloom as a wicked flower and wither away according to the story. But no matter how hard she tries to scheme, her "evil" plans only make her more endearing!
previous_episode: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess as a Wife.

name: Eren the Southpaw
summary: As high school reaches its midpoint, Koichi Asakura—who dreams of studying design at art school—has his plans shaken by explosive graffiti on a museum wall. The artist is Eren Yamagishi, a left-handed girl who buried her talent after a past incident. Drawn together by art, Koichi pursues design as Eren returns to painting, but fear, ambition, and old scars threaten their paths.
previous_episode: To All the People Who Couldn't Become Geniuses

name: I Want to End this Love Game
summary: Childhood friends Yukiya and Miku share everything…except their feelings. Ever since sixth grade, they've played a "love game": they take turns saying "I love you" and whoever gets flustered first loses. Now in high school, their hearts are closer than ever—but will they finally find the courage to confess?

name: The Drops of God
summary: When world-renowned wine critic Toyotaka Kanzaki passes away, he leaves behind an enviable collection. The will promises his estate to whoever correctly guesses the brand and year of the 12 greatest wines he selected, and the legendary wine that stands atop them all, "Drops of God." The challengers are Toyotaka's son, Shizuku Kanzaki, and a young critic, Issei Tomine, who was adopted by Toyotaka.
previous_episode: A Light on a Long Road

name: A Hundred Scenes of AWAJIMA
summary: At Awajima Opera School, girls from across Japan strive to earn a place on stage. Wakana is driven by her love of musical theater, while Kinue studies with quiet discipline. Scholarship student Emi draws attention from all—but especially from Keiko, who struggles with admiration and comparison. Through shifting perspectives, their intertwined days explore ambition, friendship, and self-discovery.

name: Bayn Al Qosour
summary: Sakina is a girl from a poor family who lives in a popular neighborhood. Sakina is exposed to a strong shock in her adolescent, which radically changes the course of her life. Years later, life circumstances force her to return to her hometown, "Bayn Al Qosour" Sakina confronts her painful past and seeks to know the truth about what happened to her in her childhood.

name: GHOST CONCERT: Missing Songs
summary: The year is 2045. Singing is forbidden, and an AI system called MiucS creates music in place of people. Seria Aiba, a high school girl who can see spirits, lives quietly under these rules—until one day, she hears a real human voice singing. Following the song, Seria discovers the source: a ghost. Now Seria must decide whether to stay silent or risk everything to bring music back to the world.
previous_episode: Each Blossoms in Their Own Way

name: The Food Diary of Miss Maid
summary: After a mysterious incident drives her from her job at a British mansion, Suzume moves into a small apartment and begins a new life in Japan. Curious about her new surroundings, she dives into the country's vibrant food culture. From local diners to street stalls, Suzume discovers new flavors, meets colorful people, and finds joy in life one meal at a time.
previous_episode: Gyoza, Dried Daikon, Instant Noodles, and Year-End Soba

name: Кулинарная битва
summary: "Cooking Battle" is a cooking show in which Konstantin Ivlev will test the recipes of food bloggers live. In each episode, he will choose three video recipes from the internet and, together with a team of professional chefs, prepare them exactly as they are. During the cooking process, Ivlev will monitor the execution, and at the end of the episode, he will taste each dish and choose the winner of the episode, the best recipe in its culinary category. The author of the winning video will receive a prize from Konstantin Ivlev.

name: ПОПРОБУЙ РАССМЕШИ
summary: Stand-up comedian Timur Dzhankyozov is traveling to cities, villages, and towns in various parts of our country, where people have never seen stand-up comedy live and may not be ready for this type of humor or be skeptical. Timur will explore the culture, daily life, problems, and gossip of the locals, immersing himself in their lives to create a stand-up performance and try to make them laugh! This is the "Try to Make Me Laugh" show. Enjoy your viewing!

name: Needy Girl Overdose
summary: In a world where likes are currency and every viewer is a judge, OMGkawaiiAngel—also known as KAngel—is determined to become the ultimate "Internet Angel." Yet beneath her pastel smile and lively streams, there's more than meets the eye.

name: Pearl in Red
summary: Pearl in Red tells the story of Kim Dan-hee and Baek Jin-ju, who both seek revenge against the Adel Group by infiltrating the company under false identities after losing a beloved family member.

name: Secret Garden
summary: To experience epic animal adventures, there's no need to travel the globe. Some of the greatest natural dramas are happening much closer to home. Britain's 30 million gardens have a combined area greater than all of our national nature reserves combined. And it turns out that our flowerbeds, vegetable patches, lawns and ponds are home to thousands of animal and plant species - many rarely seen, most barely understood. Secret Garden tells the surprising stories of the wild characters that live right on our doorsteps, revealing what they get up to when our backs are turned.

name: Anime Pilgrims
summary: Join our Anime Pilgrims on a journey to where fiction meets reality. The real-life settings of iconic anime productions offer a glimpse into Japan's deep culture, history, and hidden charms.

name: A Mile in Your Shoes
summary: This program focuses on foreign residents in Japan who tackle the issues the country faces, driven by their love for their community of adoption and their ability to put themselves in Japanese shoes.
previous_episode: A Store Stocked with Flavors and Hope

name: Love Scandal
summary: When the fine line between "work" and "feelings" begins to blur, a secret relationship between a model and his manager begins.

name: Tenball
summary: Tenball was an ITV game show combining snooker and pool, where eight professional players competed in a knockout tournament.

name: Building Back America's Trades
summary: Building Back America's Trades chronicles the stories of students, mentors, and teachers as they remake the trades industry and themselves. In the premiere, veterans, women and working professionals stand shoulder to shoulder as they rebuild their lives and industries through overlooked opportunities in the skilled trades.

name: First Letter First
summary: Comedian Don Maclean presents a new style of word game which demands speed of mind and hand. Contestants must not only know the answer, but also be first to press the initial letter on a computer keyboard.

name: You Don't Know Where I'm From, Dawg
summary: You Don't Know Where I'm From, Dawg , a comprehensive look at the life and career of American soccer legend Clint Dempsey. The five-episode series traces Dempsey's dramatic and improbable journey from a trailer park in Nacogdoches, Texas to starring for the U.S. at the FIFA World Cup.

name: Le grand restaurant
previous_episode: Le Grand Restaurant : La guerre de l'étoile

name: The Black Tower
summary: Frustrated with his career, Commander Dalgliesh is invited to Toynton Grange, a home for the disabled, by his old teacher, Father Baddeley, who is resident there. But unbeknown to Dalgliesh, something happening at the Grange is making the Father uneasy, and Dalgliesh quickly finds himself investigating a series of mysterious deaths.

name: A Taste for Death
summary: Sir Paul Berowne - a prominent Government Minister - turns to his old friend Adam Dalgleish following a series of threatening letters delivered to his London home. The minister's wife is in an adulterous affair with a prominent surgeon and she makes no secret of it. Berowne's only daughter is involved in left-wing politics and rejects her conservative father. As the list of suspects quickly grows to include several key members of Aldridge's firm, each with an excellent motive for murder, suspicion also falls on Gary Ashe, a murder suspect Venetia recently defended - successfully - and who has since taken up with her daughter Octavia. name: Delikanlı

While he dreams of a modest life with his childhood sweetheart Hazan, fate drags him into the middle of the underworld, power games and class conflict. When he reappears years later with a completely different identity, nothing is the same anymore; The wounds of the past and the hidden secrets will force him to follow both his heart and his revenge.

name: Shadow of Love
summary: Their relationship began with a lack of affection, but living in the same family and bonding with each other led to feelings that transcended the usual sibling dynamic. Despite their attempts to restrain their feelings, they were unable to resist their feelings for each other.

Standing before the legendary "curtain," the participant must face the truth in front of the guest of their choice, with Pascal Bataille and Laurent Fontaine serving as arbiters.

summary: Drama serial about a middle-aged housewife who has to cope alone when her husband disappears.

name: Creature Kid

name: Iggy and Mr. Kirk
summary: Laugh, learn, sing, and play along with Iggy the Iguana in Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Watch as Iggy discovers the importance of honesty, forgiveness, bravery, and more! Iggy may not have it all figured out, but thanks to Mr. Kirk, Iggy's friends, and some great Freedom Island stories, he'll grow a little more each day.

name: Onze Man bij de Vijand
summary: Russia is at war. Western journalists are barely left. Thomas Erdbrink was allowed to travel freely through Russia for a year without visible interference from the authorities. Together with director Roel van Broekhoven, he investigates what it is like to live in a country where war dictates everything and silence is safer than speaking.

name: The End
summary: The End is Ari Shaffir's live storytelling show featuring some of comedy's biggest names sharing the wildest true stories you've ever heard. Raw, hilarious, and completely unfiltered, the series spans seven hour-long episodes plus a bonus prologue, with comedians including Shane Gillis, Nate Bargatze, Tom Segura, Tony Hinchcliffe, and many more.

name: The Dark Wizard
summary: The Dark Wizard is an up-close and unflinching portrait of Dean Potter, one of the world's most influential and controversial climbers, BASE jumpers, and highline walkers. The series traces the jaw‑dropping feats that made him a legend, as well as the personal turmoil that defined his life. From an early age, Dean grappled with inner demons that led him to seek the limits of human possibility. Climbing became his outlet and Yosemite National Park became the canvas for his unique talent and artistic expression. As his accomplishments on El Capitan and Half Dome elevated him to hero status in th

name: Should I Marry a Murderer?
summary: A fiancée turned key witness reveals how she stayed engaged to a man accused of murder while gathering evidence against him in this documentary series.

name: The Heat Is On
summary: The Heat Is On is a six-part reality series in which 14 strangers aim to prove themselves by completing a punishing SAS-style training regime.

name: The Lord's Day
summary: On the State Opening of Parliament, British spy Harry Jones finds himself inside the iconic building amidst a lockdown. As the siege escalates, loyalties are tested and selfless sacrifices are made, leading to a desperate fight for survival where not everyone will emerge alive. Can Harry use his skills and training to be the country's saviour?

name: Miles That Matter
summary: Hit the road with three of basketball's brightest stars at different stages of their careers: Azzi Fudd, Trey McKenney, and Napheesa Collier. Each episode offers an intimate look at the athlete's life beyond the arena as they navigate their hometowns alongside the family and coaches who helped pave their way. From the school gyms of Flint and Arlington to the farm roads of Missouri, we explore the legacy, the community, and the miles that made them into champions.

name: Firefly Wedding
summary: Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want—except time. With her life running out, she's determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: "Marry me, and we'll have it all." Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.

name: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
summary: Just as His Highness's favored butterfly Reirin is beloved by the prince, jealous "court sewer rat" Keigetsu uses magic to swap their bodies—and their destinies. With a looming execution, Reirin embraces her new, healthy body, while Keigetsu learns Reirin's life isn't what it seems as she's pulled into an inner-court conspiracy.

name: Ronan Keating's Wild Atlantic
summary: Ronan Keating's Wild Atlantic takes audiences on an epic journey around the west coast of Ireland. This surprising, fun and at times emotional series offers an insight into Ronan's childhood and family life as he visits Cork, Kerry, Mayo, Sligo, Donegal and Londonderry.

name: I Flower You
