Phak, a young man who decides to move back to his hometown to start a funeral organizing business, meets Nich, a gentle and detail-oriented florist who teaches him the meaning of "love at first sight." name: Transfer Student Nanno

name: Tabi to Boku to Neko
summary: After wishing upon a star to be able to talk to his childhood cat, he learns to speak with cats. He becomes a travel writer introducing places the cats told him about.

name: Call the Midwife: Sisters in Arms
summary: In September 1939, Sister Monica Joan is in her prime, Sister Julienne and Sister Evangelina are young and zealous, and Nonnatus House is the beating heart of Poplar. Together with Sister Alice, and local GP Dr Kit, the nuns dedicate their lives to mothers, babies and the poor. But there is no gas and air, no penicillin, no cure for TB, and no welfare state. Then war is declared - and life gets even harder. name: L'Été 36
summary: Summer 1936, Nice. The vacationing bourgeoisie, accustomed to the French Riviera and its refined privileges, is bewildered by the influx of new holidaymakers taking advantage of the first paid vacations. In this hustle and bustle, where two worlds coexist without attempting to understand one another, four women from different backgrounds become embroiled in a murder at the very chic Hotel Riviera. A crime that will completely turn their family life, romantic relationships, and professional lives upside down.

name: Call of Destiny
summary: Crime profiler Fong Yat-chun receives a bizarre distress call, and the caller is astonishingly from the future. They predict brutal murders are going to take place! Yat-chun teams up with female detective Ying Ho-lam and forensics assistant Chong Ding-kan to prevent the deadly incidents from happening. But the perpetrator gets a head start and commits crime. Yat-chun eventually ascertains the caller's true identity. He also finds out Ho-lam is going to get into trouble. And Yat-chun knows his destiny as well. However, Yat-chun loses contact with the caller from the future. The perpetrator is g

summary: The Last Hunt for Nazi Gold follows historian Guy Walters and Justine Ostrowska on a 4,000-kilometre journey across Europe, chasing legends of hidden Nazi treasure. From the mines of Germany and the Amber Room mysteries of Czechia, to stolen art in Austria, the Gold Train myths of Poland, bunker hunts in Italy, and the infamous waters of Lake Toplitz, their search combines discovery and eccentric encounters. Though every site yields more myth than treasure, the series reveals how obsession, paranoia, and history intertwine.

name: Vicky Pattison: Maybe, Baby?
summary: Vicky Pattison and her husband Ercan Ramadan face a big decision; should they start a family? As they explore the routes to parenthood and the realities of having kids, will they decide it's for them?

summary: Spymasters: The Great Spy Writers explores the lives, works, and secrets of some of the most brilliant spy authors in literature. They have shaped what has become a hugely popular genre, weaving intricate plots, clandestine operations, and intense suspense into their novels, and sometimes exploring political issues and international relations with unsettling and often cynical insight. Successful film and television franchises have been built around spies, while spy novels sell in great numbers. Lying behind recurring plots based on the successful negotiation of risk and betrayal safely exposed

name: Our Sticky Love
summary: Amnesia, small-town hijinks and a shadowy past — classic tropes collide in this rom-com about a star prosecutor and the boxing coach who upends her life.

name: Britain's Murder Map
summary: In a unique historical crime series, Vicky McClure and her historian husband, Jonny Owen, travel the UK exploring historic, culturally significant crimes that have changed the face of modern Britain. The married couple investigate unsolved murders, miscarriages of justice and milestone cases that have changed the law. Speaking to experts, historians, police officers and victims' families, they examine the lasting impact each murder has left on the community and why these cases still resonate today. name: Relatively Speaking
summary: Gordon Burns hosts Relatively Speaking , in which two family teams have their powers of observation, communication, and logic put to the test as they compete for the chance to win a holiday.

Flags of Glory
summary: In 1950, Wei Zhenghua took on the identity of Zheng Xiongcai to join the Korean War. On the battlefield, he earned glory through countless acts of bravery, yet endured the agony of loss: brothers in arms scattered, comrades and loved ones sacrificed. Alongside his fellow soldiers, he fought through blood and fire, thwarting enemy conspiracies and a biological warfare campaign, culminating in a decisive victory. In 1953, the war ended. Seven decades later, a white-haired Wei Zhenghua unfurls his battle flag, honoring the fallen and paying tribute to a hard-won peace.

name: The Dark Romance
summary: In the process of investigating the truth about the suicide of her best friend and the arson by her student, single mother Yan Ling falls into the trap of emotional manipulation by a pick-up artist. In the entanglement of love and hate, she gradually awakens and regains her life.

name: It's Adam and Shelley
summary: Character-based sketch show created and performed by the brother-and-sister double-act, Adam and Shelley Longworth.

name: A konyha ördöge
summary: In the internationally renowned television format, Tamás Bereznay Hungarian star chef's task is to help struggling or only seemingly well-functioning restaurants, even to save them from bankruptcy by taking on all conflicts and awkward situations.

name: Love Destiny

After an accident befalls him, he winds up in the body of Phor Kaew, a man living in the past, despised by all of Ayutthaya. Unsuccessful in finding a way to return to the present, to survive in Kaew's life and by being himself, he gradually comes to win over the people around him.

name: Bless
summary: They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

name: Southern Law
summary: Southern Law follows law enforcement officers across the South as they respond to calls, protect their communities, and face the realities of policing in one of the country's most dynamic regions.

name: Akane-banashi
summary: Akane Osaki, captivated since childhood by the magical performances of her father, Shinta Arakawa, witnesses a shocking incident during his decisive performance for promotion to shin'uchi (master rank). Six years later, now a high school student, she sets her sights on becoming a shin'uchi herself—pushing forward in the highly competitive world of rakugo.

name: Love In Bloom
summary: On a rainy day, two strangers meet. As blossoms begin to bloom, love quietly takes root between them. But when a long-buried truth comes to light, they must decide what comes next, for their love, and for themselves.

name: Donna Hay Coastal Celebrations
summary: Best-selling Australian cookbook author, Donna Hay hosts a series of sunny celebrations by the sea, where she styles and cooks delicious food in beautiful locations. With Sydney's harbour as the backdrop, Donna uses fresh produce to create simple and stunning food.

name: Dear Killer Nannies: Criado por sicarios
summary: A gripping coming-of-age series told through Juampi's perspective as a child, the son of Colombia's most notorious drug lord, Pablo Escobar Gaviria. As he grows up, Juampi's world begins to fracture, shaped by his father's expanding criminal empire and the constant presence of danger - embodied by the hitmen who serve as his "nannies." Featuring a stellar cast including John Leguizamo as Pablo Escobar Gaviria, the series explores loyalty, fear, and the loss of innocence, revealing the human cost of a childhood spent inside one of history's most infamous criminal legacies.

name: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer

name: Raising Chelsea

name: Sins of Kujo

name: Dream Stage

In an era where diversity in entertainment is a necessity, Comedy InvAsian is the brainchild effort of producers Koji Steven Sakai and Quentin Lee to showcase and celebrate the diversity of Asian American comedy in both genre and representation to the world.

name: The Husband

name: A legjobb ajánlat

The designers have three days and a maximum budget of half a million HUFs to renovate a selected room in each property. Every week, we visit the homes of one celebrity family and one ordinary family.

Witnessing one of such "duels" is a former professional athlete Igor Strelnikov - a tired coach who has long dreamed of finding a truly gifted child. These men and women put their lives on the line every day of the week to keep us safe. With emotional testimony from survivors of major wars and terror attacks, coupled with dramatic footage of war zones and inner-city massacres, we also meet the military personnel who served across the world risking everything to keep others safe. summary: In the game of life, we all face countless quests of choice. Kang Sung-jae, who enlisted to escape a harsh reality, one day encounters a mysterious virtual "Quest" screen to become an army cook. With each quest he clears, hidden secrets of the base, even those tied to his father's death, begin to surface.

The program's participants embark on short trips or find options for staying in the city. Some of them dream of extreme activities, while others seek family adventures or want to explore or try new things.

Blending rising talent with established stars, the club serves as a creative home for a diverse group of artists navigating ambition, relationships, and chosen family in a fast-paced docuseries.

name: U.S. Against the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team

Filmed over the course of four years, the series follows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah, Weston McKennie, and an array of U.S. players on their personal and collective journeys toward their sport's signature global event.

Wild stories continue to swirl around the gifted young woman who called herself the Cryptoqueen and Bitcoin Killer. Under the guise of giving the unbanked access to financial markets and helping them get rich, she scammed the world, especially small investors, out of billions. She accepts his deal to protect her secret, but can she finish this novel unscathed?

It features family dynamics, fierce rivalries, and the untold stories behind one of America's most iconic sports.

name: Scandal love
summary: In the highly commercialized idol industry, emotions are often manufactured and sold as part of the brand. Scandal Love follows four women navigating different levels of power within a K-pop girl group system. As they struggle with strict contracts, overwhelming public scrutiny, and their own genuine feelings, each is forced to make impossible choices. The series explores one central question: can real love survive inside relationships that are carefully designed and controlled?

name: Finder Series
summary: Twenty-three-year old Takaba Akihito is a young freelance photographer who takes pride in his work and seeks to get a major "scoop." After he takes photographs of the business dealings of crime lord Asami Ryuichi, Asami kidnaps and rapes him, beginning a sadomasochistic relationship between them as they find themselves continually drawn to one another. Fei Long, a rival Chinese boss who blames Asami for his father's death, takes an interest in Takaba, as well, seeking a way to get revenge.

What happens between the beautiful father, the son, and his best friend is anyone's guess.

Before the killer... silences them as the next victims. The deeper they dig, the closer they get to death-and to each other. Until they can no longer tell which one is louder: the "voice of the dead" or the "sound of their racing hearts".

Equal parts suspense and self‑discovery, this "literary road trip" blends crime, comedy, and classic wisdom into a journey that heals old regrets.

The pressures of society come bearing down on them. Will their love ever survive these obstacles and their feelings of insecurity?

name: Earthian

Each team of plus and minus checkers keep track of Earth events and, if the score ever reaches minus 10,000, the Earth will be destroyed. The story follows Chihaya and Kagetsuya and the different people and events they observe on Earth.

summary: Mekhin was believed to be the next chairman of H Group, a powerful corporation. Devoting his life to the family, he risked everything—only to be denied the position upon discovering he was not a true heir by blood. When the tycoon was murdered, he planned to steal and alter the will, but a third party got there first. To recover it, he uses Monmeena, the thief's daughter, as leverage—unaware she will change his life and reveal a family secret he never imagined.

summary: Great Japanese Railway Journeys is a wide-ranging exploration of a country synonymous with rail innovation. The series starts with Michael in Osaka, he journeys from Kyoto's imperial heritage to Hiroshima's Peace Memorial Park, from the volcanic landscapes of Kyushu to the vast urban system of Tokyo, before continuing through the Seikan Tunnel to Hokkaido. Along the way, he explores a nation where technological innovation and long-held tradition sit side by side, using the railway to connect stories that have shaped modern Japan.

name: Shift the Thrift
summary: Couples scour the UK's charity shops to see if they can make even more money at auction for the items they purchase and raise money for their chosen causes.

name: The Corrections
summary: The Corrections is a sharply comic portrait of a Midwestern family whose three unmoored adult siblings desperately resist their mother's wish for one last Christmas together – each undone by the delusional ambitions that were supposed to save them from becoming their parents.

Her path crosses with Lin Shen, a cold and aloof female detective, and the two join forces to solve a series of bizarre homicides. As their bond deepens, Lu Yi begins to uncover unsettling clues. There are hints that Lin Shen may be inextricably linked to her father's long-buried case...

name: Great Korean Railway Journeys

From a peninsula defined by division and war to a capital transformed by rapid development, he examines South Korea's emergence as a global force in technology and culture. In the midst of their celebration in Sapiro, Mine-a suddenly arrives and warns the Sang'gres about an impending danger that only they can solve.

name: Великая и забытая
summary: It was not customary to recall the First World War in the Soviet Union. The situation hasn't changed much these days either. What our knowledge of the First World War consists of today is largely based on how this war was presented in Soviet history textbooks.

name: Inevitable Justice
summary: Desperate to fund his critically ill daughter's treatment, Luo Xiao is coerced by gang leader Chen Yongjiang into a gruesome dismemberment case. To save himself, Luo Xiao kills Chen Yongjiang in self-defense, and then seizes his position and takes over an underground money-laundering operation. As police officer Zhang Heng digs deeper into the investigation, he uncovers traces of Luo Xiao's crimes and the tangled web of illicit capital behind them. The harder the police push, the more a vast criminal network, spanning murder, money laundering, and medical corruption, rises to the surface throu

name: Капитан Кракен и его команда
summary: This is a story about three little kids who dream of becoming real pirates. The small fish Flip, the small jellyfish Sue and the sea duck Quack live with their grandfather - rather strange old retired pirate Captain Kraken. Together they learn the wisdom of pirate life that results in many comic and funny adventures.

name: Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre
summary: Terra grew up timid, feeling different due to her ability to talk to animals. Haunted by the mystery of her past—her father died when she was a baby, and her mother abandoned her soon after—she struggles with insecurity. On her 18th birthday, Terra discovers she has superpowers and learns she is the last princess of Encantadia, a hidden realm of enchanted beings. When an evil queen conquers Encantadia and threatens the mortal world, Terra must rise to protect both realms and embrace her true destiny.

name: Superrace Freestyle
summary: A showdown between 10 of Korea's top racing teams. With an operating budget of 100 million won, each team must purchase a vehicle and transform it into a freestyle racing car through custom tuning.

name: TechTown
summary: At TechTown , Alan, Adam, Ellie, Britt and their manager Rowan rarely get any real work done, often finding themselves bored to death.

name: LIS
summary: Petra and the other young LIS doctors have just started their rotation at the hospital. A dramatic six months will bind them closely together.

name: Asawa Ko, Karibal Ko
summary: Rachel meets Nathan, a gay man who later marries her when pressured by family. Unhappy and trapped, Nathan plans to fake his death, and later he undergoes a sexual reassignment and facial surgery in another country. Years later, Rachel meets and falls for Gavin, who has a wife named Venus--who is actually what her former husband Nathan has made of himself.

name: Pusong ligaw
summary: A tale about friendship, love, and dreams, featuring two women, Tessa and Marga, from poor families. Caloy, a friend, falls in love with Tessa's mentor, wealthy Jaime Laurel, while Marga uses Caloy's jealousy to undermine Tessa's faith.

name: History's Greatest Machines with Dolph Lundgren
summary: Machines can rewrite history – and no one knows that better than action legend and chemical engineer graduate Dolph Lundgren. Join him as he uncovers the stories behind history's most groundbreaking machines: witness secret stealth helicopters, spy planes outrunning missiles, espionage tech that won wars, to the rocket that took humanity to the moon. Guided by Dolph's keen insight and charisma, this is a thrilling ride through the gears, guts, and genius behind the machines that reshaped our world.

name: Wooju Bakery
summary: An alien prince crashes into a baker's grand opening, forcing the two into an unlikely partnership to rebuild the shop and find a home.

name: Les Justiciers
summary: Three experienced lawyers hear disputes between citizens and deliberate among themselves to determine the amount of damages to be awarded.

name: Salish & Jordan Matter
summary: One wildly creative dad who loves a challenge. One up-for-anything daughter who loves to win. Together, they put "family time" to the ultimate test.

name: Luka, Makan, Cinta
summary: To save her mother's restaurant, ambitious chef Luka has no choice but to work alongside talented newcomer Dennis. The only catch? She hates him.

name: Alguien Tiene Que Saber
summary: When a teen goes missing, a detective and his team launch a tireless investigation to solve the mystery in this drama series inspired by true events.

name: Ronaldinho Gaúcho
summary: With a laid-back style and masterful dribbling skills, Ronaldinho became a star on and off the soccer field. This is his story — as never seen before.

name: The Hidden Love
summary: On a snowy night in the Northern City, Zhong Xiran is abandoned by her first love, Huo Xin, and finds herself married to Qi Sinian, a man who has secretly loved her for eleven years. Four years of a cold, loveless marriage follow, plagued by her ex's return, family pressure, and scandal after scandal. Then she makes a shocking discovery. Their marriage was a long-planned act of devotion. When the truth finally comes to light, she turns and falls into his arms. "The rest of my life is yours."

name: Mga Batang Riles
summary: A group of young men gets wrongfully accused of a crime, sending them to a public juvenile center. Their goal is to clean their names and find the real perpetrator as they fend for themselves.

name: Dreams : 1 rêve, 2 vies
summary: The series follows Julia Delacourt, a young woman who dreams of becoming a singer despite her father's wishes for her to follow in his footsteps at his hotel group. To pursue her passion without her father knowing, Julia adopts a secret double life.

name: This Palace Maid Isn't Very Calm
summary: Shen Zhaodi, a modern doctor of traditional Chinese medicine, is suddenly transported into a palace intrigue novel and reborn as a cannon-fodder maid who meets a brutal death right at the beginning. With her superb medical skills and knowledge of the future plot, she turns her misfortune around completely. She cures the Empress Dowager, helps the original female lead rise to power, and also develops a bittersweet, time-defying romance with the icy Fourteenth Prince. name: Just to Meet You
summary: A three-time widow enters a marriage of convenience with Ye Lang, the secret son of the richest tycoon, thinking she's scored a harmless, lovestruck "puppy" of a husband. But she couldn't be more wrong. She walks straight into the trap of a powerful man reborn with memories of his past life. In his past life, Ye Lang died on their wedding day, his love unreturned and his heart shattered. Given a second chance, he vows revenge, yet once again finds himself falling for her gentle charm. As passion and vengeance collide, hidden truths begin to unravel. And just when they think they understand the

name: Spring Over Phoenix Pond
summary: Qi Yuan, the butcher's daughter, was the true heiress of the Marquis Residence who was switched at birth. The fake heiress framed and humiliated Qi Yuan to protect herself. Forced into becoming Prince Jing Xiao Yunting's hidden guard, Qi Yuan and Xiao Yunting gradually fell in love. On their wedding night, Prince Qi broke in recklessly. Qi Yuan died together with him, only to discover she had been reborn. In this life, she will let no one stand in her way...

name: The Double Game
summary: Wen Yan goes undercover as a wealthy family's daughter-in-law to gather evidence, while Lu Tingxiao schemes for power to avenge his mother. As it happens, she's the impostor who once spent a night with him. By day, she beats up her useless husband while he secretly plots murders; by night, they each harbor hidden agendas. From mutual suspicion to joining forces to bring down the family, their forbidden love spirals out of control amid the high-stakes game.

name: RaiRaiRaise Demo Chanto Shimasu
summary: Spin-off to Raise de wa Chanto Shimasu (season 2).

name: The Floor
summary: The Floor is an exciting quiz show where one hundred contestants compete to dominate a giant digital board divided into one hundred squares, each representing a different area of knowledge. The game is simple: challenge your opponents, win their squares, and conquer the entire board. In successive fast-paced and intense duels, contestants must identify images, sounds, or answer questions faster than their rivals. Each contestant will showcase their personality episode after episode. Diversity, excitement, and strategy combine in this race for total domination. Who will conquer The Floor ?

name: Dickie
summary: Dickie is the universal loser. Whether he is a farmer or a pirate, a knight or an astronaut, things always end badly for him. In a series of two-minute animated shorts, we follow the amusing exploits of this pitiful yet sympathetic antihero, who shares our own shortcomings and weaknesses. Based on a popular comic strip, Dickie holds up a mirror to our society.

name: I Bid You Peace: The Rise & Fall of the Frugal Gourmet
summary: TV chef Jeff Smith was beloved in the 80s-90s until multiple former teenage employees accused him of sexual abuse; exploring these allegations through interviews with survivors, colleagues and journalists.

name: Adepta Sororitas: Penitence
summary: A group of Adepta Sororitas must overcome a physical and spiritual ordeal as they seek to deliver a sacred relic to its ordained resting place.

name: Housoukyoku Senkyo Go: Sequel
summary: Ibuki Yuji becomes entangled in a new hostage crisis, where a deadly psychological battle unfolds. Moreover, Suruga Saki—one of the "Beasts", returns once again! What is the true meaning behind Suruga's reappearance?

name: Mavis Eccleston
summary: The tragic and extraordinary real-life story of a woman who survived a joint suicide pact with the love of her life and husband of nearly 60 years and was subsequently arrested and charged with his murder.

name: Thérèse Humbert
summary: A 19th-century French peasant woman orchestrates the "swindle of the century" by inventing a fictitious American millionaire heir, using the promise of a massive imaginary inheritance to swindle bankers and elites, living in lavish luxury until her spectacular exposure in 1902.

name: One Day In My Body
summary: This bold and intimate series hands the camera to those living with some of the world's rarest medical conditions. Meet an individual allergic to water, a woman who ages at an unusually rapid rate, a woman who has been unable to empty her bladder in years, and other complex disorders that leave the most skilled medical professionals searching for answers.

name: My Dream Is Fencing
summary: International fencer Sun doesn't quite live in the present; he's preoccupied with past and present, making him unfocused. As a kid, Sun trained in the Athamat Thai swordsmanship style of his grandfather. Later, when Sun took up the international sabre, his style as a fencer was outstanding, though he was held back by his lack of focus. Sun lives with his mother, Rungthiwa—who has stage four heart arrhythmia—and grandfather, Chamnan, in an antique shop on the verge of bankruptcy. His father left them before Sun was born, although Sun was told he'd died. Sun has a crush on a girl, Wela. Now stud

name: Call Me Mr. Chairman
summary: When three grandchildren of a renowned family have to fight to inherit the position of president after their grandfather, a chaotic, headache-inducing war commences! What tricks will the three grandchildren employ in this battle for the seat at the head of this multi-billion dollar business?

name: My Quarantine Days
summary: Amidst the COVID-19 pandemic and the escalating conflict between Prapop and Wichit's family, Pan, the only son of Prapop looks for new content for his YouTube channel. Pan is interested in a rumor that there is a ghost in Wichit's house. He then sneaks into the house but encounters only a mysterious girl no one has seen but no traces of ghost.

name: Haunted
summary: This is a compilation of horror stories including ghost stories.

name: Hulk Hogan: Real American
summary: Before he was Hulk Hogan, he was Terry Bollea. Uncover the man behind the legend in this unfiltered documentary featuring his very last interview.

name: Большая фарма
summary: Medical scientists Alexander Gireev and Vladimir Shulgin have invented a medicine that can cure any disease, even a cancerous tumor. But the drug that could save the world becomes a source of conflict for the entire family. Gireev's eldest son, Evgeny, decides to help his father with its promotion. His daughter, Polina, is convinced that her brother only wants fame and money, and he is ready to betray his father. And Gireev himself turns out to be unprepared for the compromises that the big‑pharma market demands of him. After all, producing medicines is a profitable business. And why produce s

name: 100 Days Until We Break Up
summary: Kasuga Yuma and Hasegawa Itsuki gained public attention after an interview about the partnership oath system for sexual minorities went viral on social media, with many users describing their dynamic as "moe." When they are offered the chance to film a documentary chronicling 100 days of their life together, Yuma eagerly accepts in hopes of helping "spread understanding of homosexuality." Despite having already broken up, Yuma convinces Itsuki to continue acting as a loving couple in front of the cameras. Unaware of the truth, director Kayano Shiho is determined to capture their relationship a

name: Boy Band Confidential
summary: Candid interviews with artists from Boyz II Men, Backstreet Boys, NSYNC, and others reveal the darker realities of power struggles and exploitation.

name: Retired, Not Expired
summary: Aggression and violence is explored through the story of a retired teacher whose heart hasn't expired. The teacher is ready to live a simple life in her later years, but her students unexpectedly bring her bitter problems to solve.

name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders
summary: When a woman vanishes, police find bodies along Long Island's shore. Years of dead ends and overlooked victims stall the case until a new task force spots a suspect hiding in plain sight. With trial looming, insiders and families speak.

name: Yue Ding Qi Jian Ai Shang Ni
Охота на маньяка
summary: A television program that is an author's series of feature documentaries about serial crimes committed in the modern history of Russia and the work of law enforcement agencies.

name: Soccer's American Dream
summary: How the gamble that brought professional soccer to America almost didn't pay off.

name: Horror Collector
summary: Not all urban legends are myths. Some are real, and they're coming to life. Fushigi roams Japan in a red hood, sealing them inside his magical notebook, with Jimmy, his human-faced dog, by his side. Each phenomenon brings him one step closer to capturing Himitsu, the girl responsible for manifesting the supernatural beings.

name: Our New World
summary: What world will we live in tomorrow as climate change reshapes the Earth? Our planet has many surprises in store. This film reveals Nature's astonishing adaptation abilities, and how we humans can become a supporting force.

name: Bu Rang Jiang Shan
summary: In a time of chaos, a young man looks at the world and no longer sees heroes, only disorder and weakness. Refusing to accept fate, he rises from humble beginnings and challenges the rules of his era. Determined and fearless, he steps into the turmoil with a plan to change the world around him. No matter the storms ahead, he vows that the realm will not fall.

name: Echoes of Gang City
summary: The Xu family of Gang City is struck by successive blows and teeters on the brink of collapse. Xu Wanxin turns to the family she's engaged to for help, only to be exploited in her time of crisis. Meanwhile, tech prodigy Shen Gu returns with significant shares in hand and proposes a contractual marriage. Together, they fend off a hostile foreign takeover and dismantle his father's schemes. As they stand side by side to protect the family legacy, genuine feelings begin to grow. Yet in the eyes of Wanxin's grandfather, Old Master Xu, their bond traces back to a legendary couple from the Republica

name: No Doubt in Us
summary: The civil-minded Emperor, a man of letters who despises martial arts, and his warrior Empress, a woman of the blade, have nothing but mutual disdain and deep distrust for each other until a freak accident swaps their bodies. Forced to accept their bizarre new reality, the two must walk in the other's skin. As they play each other's roles, misunderstandings unravel, and something unexpected takes root: love and trust. Trapped in the Empress's body, the Emperor endures the cold mockery of the concubines and the Empress Dowager, and suffers through the schemes and traps laid for an unloved queen.

name: The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole Aged 13¾
summary: The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole Aged 13¾ marks the return of an iconic British character to our screens. It's New Year's Day 1981 and Adrian starts his uniquely funny diary about family life and being a teenager before the advent of mobile phones and social media. With only a multi-coloured ballpoint pen as his guide, Adrian worries about his spots, his parents' divorce, the torment of first love and the fact he's never seen a female nipple. As Adrian's mother Pauline wrestles with her feminist awakening, his father George struggles with being made redundant in an unforgiving economy. Adrian's

name: I Know Who You Are
summary: I Know Who You Are centers on a brilliant forensic genealogist who gets pulled back into the police force she walked away from and the partner she left behind. Using DNA technology to follow genetic breadcrumbs, the pair unearth long-buried secrets to crack the most impossible of cases — all while quietly pursuing the one case that broke them apart.

name: Hilda! In Lights
summary: Hilda! In Lights is one of those classic shows about a spunky, small-town upstart who moves to the big city to make it on her own. There's just one teeny, tiny, totally inconsequential difference … our hero is a 70-year-old woman named Hilda

name: Flint
summary: Flint follows a burnt-out LAPD officer who, on the verge of retirement, is blindsided when the city extends his service by five years. Determined to get fired, he breaks rules and disobeys orders, which to his dismay, ends up making him a better cop.

name: Family Theatre
summary: Dramatic anthology series hosted by Father Peyton.

name: Pertaruhan: The Series
summary: Elzan struggles to make money through street fights and becomes a debt collector to redeem a family house that the bank wants to confiscate. However, what's the point of defending the family home when Elzan must be in direct conflict with his brother, Ical. Helped by Ara and Rio, Elzan fights for the integrity of his family by risking everything.

name: Ethernel
summary: By chance, during a scientific experiment, the dead can now communicate with the living via a device called Ethernel. David Novack, a former detective haunted by his wife's death, works in a new unit tasked with taking statements from victims after their deaths. A routine investigation will shatter his certainties, reawakening the ghosts of his own past.

name: Alter Ego
summary: Joseph Batista returns to Marseille after 30 years and discovers that he has an unknown judge daughter and grandson.

name: Lisbon Noir
summary: A Spanish diplomat falls from the top of the Aqueduct. The police investigate with the help of a Spanish inspector. It quickly becomes clear that there is a serial killer in Lisbon, inspired by the legendary "Aqueduct Killer" of the 19th century: Diego Alves. When the police seem close to solving the case, a twist reveals that the psychopath is still at large, this time driven by personal revenge.

name: Suez: 24 Hours That Ended the British Empire
summary: The dramatic inside story of 6 November 1956, the final day of the Suez Crisis. A day that changed Britain forever. Exactly as it happened - hour by hour, minute by minute.

name: Chernobyl: Days That Shocked the World
summary: Chernobyl was the world's worst nuclear accident. But at the time, 1986, the Soviets tried to cover it up. Now, witnesses and survivors tell the story of what they went through.

name: Egypt With Dan Snow
summary: Dan Snow is on an epic historical journey through one of his favourite countries - Egypt! He visits some of the most extraordinary places on earth, from Luxor to a luxury steamer on the Nile, and from the ancient pyramids to the packed streets of Cairo. Alongside the incredible history, Dan navigates boats on the Nile, balloons and even the odd camel! Along the way he'll be exploring the stories of people living along the Nile from past to present, from Agatha Christie and Tutankhamun to the ancient Pharaohs and the modern-day market traders.

name: Sutherland
summary: Sutherland , the far north of Scotland, the near future. Mirren works at Paravel Space Hub as flight director for the UK's first crewed mission to the stars. Everything is going to plan when, just hours after launch, a series of unexplained events engulf Sutherland in mystery and risks destroying everything Mirren's been striving for. As a decades-old conspiracy begins to resurface, local detective Logan is unexpectedly pulled back into Mirren's orbit. When Logan's investigation and Mirren's mission threaten to unravel, the pair join forces to make an extraordinary discovery that will change t

name: A szemfényvesztő - Hazudj, ha tudsz
summary: A tactical competition set in a castle library. In each episode, five players work together to answer questions to raise the most money while trying to find out who is the mole – the contestant who knows the answer to every question in advance and doesn't rely on their own knowledge. The game show is based on the format of "The Hustler".

name: Captain Zed and the Zee Zone
summary: Captain Zed and his Dream Patrol are on standby 24/7, ready to fly into a child's dream at a moment's notice! Along with his patrol partner, P.J. and his barking cat, Spring, Captain Zed saves the dreams of children worldwide from Snort and Mutter the evil Nightmares! Whether it's battling an invasion of killer bunnies or an irrational fear of vegetables, they will pit their wits against the Nightmares and bring the dream back on course for a happy ending!

name: Заложник
summary: Moscow, 2014. Successful financial analyst Maksim Pozharskiy helps already wealthy people get rich. Without asking unnecessary questions, he simply takes what's his. But everything in his world changes when the only person close to him, his sister Nina, disappears in the Middle East and is captured. This time, financial solutions are unavailable, and Maks is forced to travel to Syria, engulfed in internal conflict, torn apart by major powers for oil and other resources. Right at the border, he is kidnapped by rebels, and to escape, he makes a dangerous deal with a militant named Said. Using al

name: Rippers
summary: A quiet night at an underground opium plantation in Eindhoven ends in a brutal robbery. In the midst of the chaos are three young underdogs. They have one night to carry out the plan. Fast, hard, and without mercy. In a world where money and power reign, loyalty is worthless, and betrayal lurks around every corner, one wrong move can be fatal. The only way to survive: stay one step ahead of everyone to rip that shit.

name: Adventures of Akira and Mowgli
summary: The book has opened up yet again and only this time we read through those pages which were never narrated earlier. The pages which narrates the tales of "AKIRA", girl from the nearby village who accidently lands in the thickets of the mighty Seonee jungle and finds herself in the jaws of "Sherekhan", the tiger. Akira managed to escape but the sight of another man cub in jungle has just doubled up Shere khan's rage and anger. He will never stop picking up the scents of both the man cubs. Mowgli is pretty amused by the sight of Akira but Baloo and Bagheera already know that with Akira's footprin

name: Wo Ping Po An，Na Xia Jin Yu Da Li Si Shao Qing
Акулёнок Шарки
summary: A toy comes to life and goes to underwater school. Musical stories about growing up and independence. Growing up, baby shark Sharky goes to sea school to a wise octopus teacher, makes friends, and learns independence, kindness, and bold decisions.

name: Tou Ting Zhu Zi Xin Sheng
Qing Zai Hao Hao Huo Yi Ci
The Old Story of Yu Hong
summary: A series of absurd murders break out on a public square: a drunk frozen into an ice sculpture, a strong man with severed limbs, a local big shot who vanishes into thin air. Seemingly unrelated, their lives and hearts are deeply intertwined.

name: Saturday Matters with Sue Lawley
summary: A late night talk and entertainment series, in which Sue Lawley invites guests to talk not only about themselves but also about their ideas and opinions on a wide range of topics.

name: Koi Naam Na Do
summary: Two men forge a deep bond, shaped by their pasts, but unexpected feelings challenge the thin line between friendship and love.

name: Magical Sisters LuluttoLilly
summary: The story centers on sisters Fū and Rui, who used to be close, but have been a bit distant from each other recently. One day, Fū encounters a mysterious spaceship and gains magical powers. At that same time, Rui also gains magical powers, and both transform into the adults they dream to be. The sisters' powers come with two conditions: their magic powers can only be used in one year, and no one must know about it. Unaware of each other's secrets, Fū and Rui become active as idols.

name: Regai
summary: SI Vetri investigates a medical team that is trying to cover up deaths of clinical trial participants by staging them as accidents. Can Vetri put an end to this sinister plot before it's too late?

name: Azure Spring
summary: After years marked by injury and failure, former swimmer Anna returns to her quiet seaside hometown, leaving her dreams behind. There, she crosses paths with Yun Deok Hyun, a quiet sea diver who remains trapped in his past, enduring time in silence. Brought together under one roof, Anna begins to learn diving from him, slowly finding her way back to life. But as their distance closes, unspoken emotions rise, and a long buried secret surrounding Deok Hyun begins to fracture their fragile peace. As the past refuses to stay buried, both are pushed to confront what they have been running from and

name: Everflame
summary: Everflame is set in a world where mortals live in poverty, subjugated by an elite race known as the Descended. When her mother goes missing, Diem Bellator suspects that the most powerful and most feared Descended in the kingdom – Prince Luther Corbois – may be responsible. As she embarks on a search for answers, she becomes an unexpected force in the mortal rebellion against the Descended, and the center of an even more unexpected love triangle.

name: Fifties Professionals
summary: Three seemingly ordinary middle-aged men—behind their modest looks are the pro skills that made them legends in their fields. Now in their fifties, thinking their glory days are long gone, they are unexpectedly pulled back into action. Even if your life hasn't been perfect so far, it's about filling the rest of your 50%—no matter what age you are. Just like these pros in their fifties.

name: Mordu de la pêche avec Cyril Chauquet : Le retour
summary: Cyril Chauquet is back, searching for giant fish all over the planet; from the Mexican desert to the plains of Mongolia, via the turquoise waters of the Seychelles, he tracks the fiercest and most powerful species; from the legendary roosterfish to the mythical taimen, from the powerful barracuda to the voracious lingcod, each new species pushes Cyril further, into shark-infested waters, between sharp rocks, deadly currents, furious rapids and crushing heat.

name: Final Table
summary: Follows Choi Song I, the new manager of a family restaurant, who must step up to take charge after her father's sudden death. In a bid to save the restaurant, she becomes entangled in a fierce cooking competition alongside Kang Han, also known as "Chris K", a renowned overseas chef. Their journey brings them head-to-head with Cha U Jin, a perfectionist chef and Kang Han's fiercest rival, whose relentless ambition drives the intense rivalry. At the center of the competition is Seon Jeong Won, the executive producer of The Table: K Chef 2026, who orchestrates the high-stakes event to crown Korea

name: The Facade of Love
summary: Ji-hun and Hu-kyung, two strangers far from home, spend an unforgettable night together in an unfamiliar place. Both know that once they return to Korea, life is supposed to go back to normal. But the connection they share follows them home and small cracks begin to appear, slowly upending the lives of four people. As their relationships knot together, The Facade of Love peels back what lies beneath the polished surfaces of their lives: desire, guilt, hurt and the gap between the stories we tell ourselves and the truths we can't escape.

name: Human x Gumiho
summary: A top actress who is secretly a 2,000-year-old gumiho with the power to bewitch humans becomes romantically entangled with a man who is uniquely immune to her enchantments, forcing them to navigate a romance where their supernatural powers collide.

name: Sacred Jewel
summary: In 1258, amid thirty years of relentless Mongol invasions, the Emperor commands elite warriors to retrieve the Sacred Jewel, a divine relic protecting the kingdom. The warriors break through Mongolian lines and journey toward the eastern sea in search of the legendary relic.

name: Nine to Six
summary: Kang Yi Ji has long kept romance on the sidelines, pouring all her energy into her career. Her perspective shifts when she meets Han Seon Woo, whose warmth and thoughtfulness help her rediscover love. Together, they navigate both professional challenges and personal growth, finding balance in work and life.

name: Between Love and Sin
summary: At eight years old, Lin Qingmiao turned her father in to the police after he accidentally killed Zhou Jin's mother in a hit-and-run. Instead of receiving sympathy, she was labeled a traitor and forced to endure years of stigma and bullying. She was left with no choice but to assume the name Sun Tao and flee to Gangcheng. There, she met Zhou Yusheng, a disillusioned driver, and the two unexpectedly fell in love. Yet as their affection grew, Qingmiao found that Zhou Yusheng was none other than Zhou Jin. Their love story is only beginning to face its greatest trial.

name: Santita
summary: After a car accident that resulted in a disability, María José Cano, affectionately nicknamed " Santita "—although she is more of a sinner than a saint—left the love of her life at the altar. Two decades later, the unexpected return of the man she didn't marry forces her to face the consequences of her actions and make a decision that will push her ideas about love to the limit. This is an unconventional love story, filled with gambles, and led by a perversely irreverent woman.

name: The Qinling Bronze Occult Chronicles
summary: A bronze tomb anomaly, buried in the aftermath of a 1971 mine disaster deep in the Qinling Mountains, awakens years later. Retired reconnaissance scout Qin Yue leads a team into the heart of the mountain range, venturing into an underground forbidden zone where scientific exploration collides with ancient shamanic rites, to unearth the truth of a blood sacrifice that spans two generations.

name: La Ba Ku Yu Tie Fan Wan
Свора
summary: Kristina, a successful travel blogger, along with her boyfriend and cameraman Danya, go to film a crime scene in provincial Volchegorsk in order to find dirt on the current mayor. However, upon arrival, Danya disappears without a trace, and Kristina is attacked by a local "Pack" — aggressive dogs that keep the whole city at bay.

name: The Trials of Winnie Mandela
summary: Freedom fighter, mother, wife, enigma. South African icon Winnie Mandela's legacy is examined by her granddaughters in this incisive documentary series.

name: Can't Buy Me Love
summary: When a young man gets caught up in a deadly plot against a rich woman, he pays a devastating cost to free her — creating a debt that binds them together.

name: Fall in Love With My AI
Entwined Secrets
summary: Sent by the Crown Prince, Kou marries Chancellor Gu Huanzhi to steal secret letters. After the Crown Prince's death, she tries to flee, only to discover Gu has long known her identity and silently shielded her. Through suspicion, betrayal, and life-or-death trials, she also recovers a childhood memory that unexpectedly links to him.

name: Destined To Be Yours

But after the mines closed, many residents left to find work in the city. However, Sinag loves her hometown very much. In the confines of his clinic, he shows unwavering dedication to his profession and learns empathy while protecting patients' oral health.

This time, he bets it all, not for brotherhood, but for the people he truly cares about.

What happens when "Fresh Blood" enters the mix?

summary: In Columbus, Ohio, power flipper Tommy Harr and his family have built a business on seeing opportunity where others see disaster. Their edge comes from within the family — two generations of elite home inspectors, a fearless construction crew led by his middle brother, and a mom who doubles as both designer and real estate agent. Together, they take on the city's worst "zombie" houses, transforming rundown properties into stunning dream homes.

name: Designed To Last
summary: Sponsored content made in collaboration with American Family Insurance. Three teams of home design innovators face off against the worst Mother Nature has to offer to see whose build is truly designed to last. Part competition, part science experiment, each episode tests a different element—until one team reigns supreme and wins the $100,000 prize.

name: Weather Command Weekend
summary: Stay up to date inside the Weather Command center with a weekend forecast and real-time alerts.

name: The Vanishing of Debbie Griggs
summary: Chronicles the investigation into the 1999 disappearance of 34-year-old Debbie Griggs, a pregnant mother of three who vanished from her home in Deal, Kent - a case spanning more than two decades with incredible twists and turns.

name: Hong Le Ying Tao Lu Le Ba Jiao
33 días
summary: The escape of two dangerous criminals from the Lleida Penitentiary Center in 2001 triggered a 33-day police manhunt, marked by violence, sacrifices and loyalty.

name: Ni Shi Wo De Ren Jian Shen Qi
Jia Fang Dian Xia Qing Zi Zhong
Ni Hao, Wo De Su Liao Jie Mei Hua
Love as Bait
summary: After a sudden accident, Lu Zaozao finds herself transported into the Republican era as Su Muwan, the young mistress of a wealthy family. She awakens to a husband pointing a gun at her, her parents framed for a crime, and a series of poisonings. Fighting her way through one crisis after another, she goes from mortal enemies to falling deeply in love with the "jealous" Ling Shenxing. But just as their romance blossoms, she suddenly wakes up in the modern world—only to encounter a familiar face around the corner.

name: Ta Ruan Zai Wo Xin Shang
UFC Rivals
summary: UFC Rivals is an electrifying deep dive into the most iconic feuds in UFC history. Blending gripping archival footage, exclusive interviews, and a dynamic roundtable, the series revisits the unforgettable moments and high-stakes drama behind the fiercest battles inside the Octagon. UFC superfan, Mario Lopez brings together fan-favorite voices, including C.M. Punk and Ken Shamrock, to break down the rivalries that defined eras, shaped legacies, and helped propel the UFC into a global phenomenon.

name: Graf Yoster gibt sich die Ehre
Fly to Fin
summary: When all four young men of the band Jingle Bell entered university, they want to reunited the band after they parted ways. But still lacks the lead singer That's why the 5th member joined in; June, a dark-faced young man, very handsome and a voice crushing women. It was like a bolt of lightning struck their hearts one after another, and the Jingle Bells were born again. As well as being well known in their university.

name: Suea Chani Keng
summary: Three BFFs live in the same condominium building and face life and love together. Tum, a playboy photographer who doesn't believe in true love because his girlfriend left him with a luxury condominium to pay off alone. Oil, Tum's friend, offers to help him find a roommate to share the rent. Turns out the new roommate is Cheetah aka Chatree, Tum's gay friend who used to be secretly in love with him. Tum cut off his friendship with Cheetah a long time ago because Cheetah tricked him to believe that he was straight.

name: Во что верят люди
summary: The boldest hypotheses about our world, along with phenomena and places shrouded in mystery. The mysterious Library of Atlantis, the Yeti, Antarctica as humanity's last refuge, and oceans hidden beneath the Earth's crust—mainstream science dismisses these wonders, yet many people believe in them. We are giving them the chance to tell their stories in detail.

name: Big Girls Wanted: Escaping Pearadise
summary: Pearadise promised safety and a utopia for plus‑size women. The sisterhood turns dark as allegations of assault and coercion spread among the women.

name: Il peccato e la vergogna
summary: In the Rome of the '30s lives Nito Valdi, a difficult boy just out of the reformatory, who works for a boss in the area with his friend Tony.

name: Baciamo le Mani Palermo - New York 1958
Zabt
summary: Ayla, a beautiful young girl, is deeply in love with her cousin Ehtisham. But their love is caught in a long-standing family conflict, where their mothers' hatred keeps them apart at every step. Unseen and unheard, Aoun—a quiet young man living only with his grandmother—carries feelings for Ayla, though she has never noticed him. Sometimes, fate brings two hearts close only to pull them apart again. Their love is tested by family conflicts and hidden betrayals, breaking what once felt strong and real. In the middle of this pain, a broken heart finds comfort in the one who has always loved sile

name: Tapish
summary: Shahzer is a young heir to immense wealth, known for his strong, dominating personality and short temper. Despite his privileged background, his anger and behavior often create distance between him and others. Shifa is a strong, responsible young woman who quietly carries the burden of her family while holding onto her dreams through patience and sacrifice. Maaz, Shifa's cousin and fiancé, shares a close bond with her, and they are already engaged in a relationship built on family trust and mutual understanding. Fate takes an unexpected turn when Shahzer crosses paths with Shifa and feels an u

name: Hercule
summary: Hercule follows Hercule Poirot's first cases in London before he becomes the world's most famous sleuth. The series is an intimate study of Hercule the man and an epic portrait of Britain between the wars. The series takes a magnifying glass to three of Christie's most celebrated stories, while also charting Hercule's burgeoning friendship with Captain Arthur Hastings, his early encounters with Scotland Yard's James Japp, and introducing him to one particular nemesis...

name: Half as Interesting's Crime Spree
summary: Half as Interesting put the 34 weirdest laws in America on a map and gave Sam 72 hours and $5,000 to break eight of them. But the HAI writers got $3,000 and a live tracker on Sam—and if they tag him, he loses a point. None of the rules require anyone to go to sleep at any point. What could possibly go wrong?

name: YoKoSo Scooby-Doo!
summary: While visiting Japan on the ultimate foodie adventure, Scooby-Doo and Shaggy unwittingly unleash hundreds of mythical monsters that are causing trouble across the country. With the help of Scooby's uncle, Daisuke-Doo, along with new friends, a magical girl Yume, and gadget whiz Takumi, the group embarks on an all-new mystery filled with monster chasing and fun chaos.

name: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
summary: Join Ranger Hamza on an epic African adventure! Visiting animal sanctuaries and exploring the wild, he discovers incredible animals, each with their very own story to tell.

name: Tendres Agneaux
summary: A hungry wolf desperately tries the craziest tricks to get to his favourite prey, the sheep. But the predator, despite all the schemes he employs, never succeeds and never satisfies his hunger.

name: Alatava
summary: Friends who grew up in an orphanage and, after entering adult life, engage in petty fraud and face the problems of this easy way to make money.

name: A Hill to Die On
summary: Some things are just too important to let go.

name: Half as Interesting
summary: Half as Interesting is an entertaining, fact-based, educational series covering diverse topics of general interest presented in a somewhat humorous, quirky style. Topics range from curious to weird and are rarely important to know unless you're looking for some lunch room or coffee break conversation starters.
previous_episode: The Loophole That Makes Kalshi Legal

name: Aik Mohabbat Aur
summary: Khushbakht is a determined police officer who has already experienced the painful side of love. After a failed love marriage, she returns to her parents' home with her young son and the scars of a broken relationship. Instead of support, she faces constant judgment, slowly losing faith in love. Haroon, an honest journalist who values truth and meaningful connections, struggles to find someone who truly understands him. When an investigation brings them together, he is captivated by Khushbakht's courage, dignity, and quiet strength. For Haroon, it is the beginning of love. For Khushbakht, love

name: Andy's East Coast Kitchen Crawl
summary: Andy Hay explores East Coast food culture, one kitchen at a time.

name: Marg e Wafa
summary: Is love the name of a journey, or is it the destination? A story born from the pages of the bestselling novel Marg e Wafa is about to come alive.

name: Glee Vietnam
summary: A Vietnamese remake of the hit US show 'Glee'.

name: A Forgotten Kill
summary: A Forgotten Kill is centered on ex–Army Ranger Dani Vega, a Nuyorican from the Lower East Side and dauntless FBI agent whose specialty is breaking codes and detecting patterns. As part of a task force, Dani is partnered with NYPD Detective Mark Flint. Their clashing styles give them an edge in solving crimes and expose an undeniable chemistry, but Dani is haunted by a secret: a family tragedy in her past that comes back to put her career and life at risk.

name: Swamp Patrol
summary: SWAMP PATROL pulls viewers into the unpredictable world of law enforcement operating in America's most unforgiving swamps. From the tangled bayous of Louisiana to the coastal inlets of Florida, Swamp Patrol follows officers in real time through bodycam footage as they respond to a wide range of threats, including armed suspects, drug busts, missing persons, stolen boats, 11-foot gators, and deadly snakes. Every call comes with its own dangers, and in the depths of the swamp, there is no backup. The series offers a captivating look at the chaos and courage required to hold the line in places mo

name: Ghost
summary: When a famous actress is murdered, hacker Hades becomes the prime suspect. Captain Phakorn discovers Hades is his old friend, Phirawat. But shocking evidence points to Phakorn himself. As the real killer hunts them down, Phakorn is killed and Phirawat is left severely burned. Lieutenant Viulada helps Phirawat assume Phakorn's identity through surgery. Together, they must unravel the mystery and catch the real villain before it's too late.

name: Mercan Köşk
summary: After her husband disappears, Cemre finds herself in the mysterious Coral Mansion, where secrets from the past, family feuds, and forbidden love change her destiny.

name: Celebrity Escape
summary: Seven comedians attempt high-concept escape rooms under the watch of a mischievous Game Master. Solve the room, then survive elimination - with Panic Buttons, Gifts, Wrath, and only one winner.

name: To the Stars
summary: Inspired by the remarkable achievements of China's Lunar Exploration Program, this story follows Wu Wei, a young man who has dreamed of working in aerospace since childhood. Determined to join the Flight Control Center, he is devastated when he fails the interview and is instead assigned to work in the archives. Meanwhile, Ying Ziqi, a brilliant and aloof top student with whom Wu Wei shares a long-standing rivalry, successfully secures a position in the Flight Control Center. While working in the archives, Wu Wei gains valuable experience and matures into a dependable professional. Recognizing

name: Doctor Who: TARDIS Crew
summary: The series follows the Doctor, a young Time Lord, and his friends Hannah, Beastie and Toast-IE as they embark on extraordinary adventures through time and space. Travelling aboard the iconic TARDIS, they encounter incredible creatures, discover amazing new worlds and come face-to-face with legendary Doctor Who foes, including the Daleks.

name: Xing Xing Ran Shao De Sheng Xia
Worst Yard on the Block
summary: In Worst Yard on the Block , two teams of curb appeal aficionados will search out the most unsightly yards in the country, meet the overwhelmed homeowners and perform miraculous outdoor makeovers in just a matter of days.

name: Would You Rather: Decide to Survive
summary: Would You Rather be invisible or be able to fly? Fight one giant duck or 1000 tiny ducks? Eat a man-sized bean or a bean-sized man? This comedy game show will see two teams of some of Britain's funniest digital personalities compete in hilarious real-life challenges based on classic hypothetical Would You Rather decisions. These three simple words decide everything from what they eat to who they send home...

name: Darna
summary: The origin of Darna relates that she is a warrior magically manifesting herself through a human girl from Earth, named Narda. After Narda swallows a magic white stone, she transforms into the mighty warrior by shouting "DARNA!"

name: El Cor de la Ciutat
summary: El cor de la ciutat follows the lives of the people who live and work in the neighbourhood of Sants and Sant Andreu in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.

name: Deep End: The Scott Miller Story
summary: A compelling new two-part documentary charting the dramatic rise and fall of Olympic swimmer Scott Miller, and his ongoing fight to rebuild his life. Once a golden boy of Australian sport, Scott Miller had it all: medals, fame, and a nation's admiration. Then came personal tragedy and a fall into addiction, crime and eventually prison.

name: Above Myriads
summary: After transmigrating to the Xianjiang Continent, Yi Feng discovers that he was born without a spiritual root, making cultivation impossible. With no choice but to rely on the "essential life skills" granted by a mysterious system, he struggles to make a living in this world of cultivators. What Yi Feng doesn't realize, however, is that in the eyes of powerful cultivators, his abilities are nothing short of godlike. Every casual action he takes unknowingly influences the fate of the entire continent. As he effortlessly resolves one crisis after another without realizing his true impact, Yi Feng

name: The Prosecutor's Office's Proposal
summary: From the director of ‘Secret Relationships', follows the romance between an investigator burdened by the stigma of "being a murderer's son" and a prosecutor.

name: Your Sky Hare Nochi Koi
summary: After a misunderstanding, a kind-hearted college student ends up in a fake relationship with a popular senior feared by everyone.

name: Power: Legacy
summary: Power: Legacy sees the return of Tommy to New York, where he partners with Tariq to take the city by storm.

name: Mock the Week: Summer Specials
summary: Dara Ó Briain is back with a summer run of topical chat and hilarious games, featuring a host of top stand-up comedians.

name: Красота
summary: The end of the 80s, a time of change and high hopes. Vera, the director of the House of Culture, launches the country's first beauty contest, despite the displeasure of officials. But against the background of the collapse of the country, it is under threat of closure — the country has no money for beauty. In an attempt to find a solution, Vera makes a deal with criminals, falling into a dangerous trap.

name: Doppelt kocht besser
summary: Star chef Alexander Kumptner decides which of three couples cooks the best. However, the contestants are essentially amateurs in the kitchen and receive tips via headset.

name: Deep In
summary: Fresh off winning Best Actor, Chen Xin finds himself cast alongside ambitious newcomer Zhang Zhun in a daring LGBTQ+ film. On screen, they portray psychiatrist Fang Chi and his patient Gao Zhun, whose relationship spirals beyond therapy into a dangerous mix of desire, obsession, and love. Off camera, Chen Xin and Zhang Zhun begin to lose sight of where acting ends and real feelings begin.

name: Thunder 3
summary: Unremarkably ordinary middle schoolers, Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame, wander into an extraordinary adventure when Pyontaro's little sister goes missing.

name: Chéri(e), c'est moi le chef
summary: Every day, three couples compete to prepare a recipe. Only one partner knows the recipe and must guide their significant other remotely to execute it—a setup that reveals both tensions and the bond between them.

name: Chéri(e) c'est moi le chef
summary: Three couples compete to prepare a recipe. Only one partner knows the recipe and must guide their other half remotely—via an earpiece—to execute it. The guiding partners then taste the dishes blind and rate them on a scale of 1 to 10. The chef also tastes and rates the dishes. The highest-scoring couple wins a prize and secures a spot in the next episode to defend their title...

name: Knighted
summary: Knighted follows a missing person's case that spirals into an absurd documentary-style exploration of the sinister secrets lurking beneath the enchanting pageantry of a local medieval dinner theatre.

name: Free Nelson Mandela
summary: The story of Nelson Mandela's journey from activist to revolutionary prisoner, and the global movement and musical activism that helped bring his freedom.

name: Space Bug
summary: Insects are taken up into space for use in experiments by humans. The development plans and experiments are aborted by humans for no known reason, the organisms are left behind in the space station with limited resources. Going over hurdles and fighting through challenges, Mick and his friends travel across planets and gain new comrades, heading for Earth.

name: Qian Nu You Hun: Qian Chen
Jim Henson's Monster Dance
summary: Calling all Monsters! Do YOU love to DANCE? Come join the fuzzy, friendly, funky fun with Toots, Teeny and Razzle Dazzle, as they get down.

name: Egoli: Place of Gold
summary: Egoli: Place of Gold is a bilingual South African soap opera that follows the daily lives, romances, and corporate rivalries of a handful of intertwined families. Centered around a prominent Johannesburg family and the employees of their international automobile firm, the show explores the intense trials, triumphs, and tribulations of its characters.

name: Jian Dao Mei Nu Jian Xian Hou Wo Ni Xi Le
Число зверя
summary: The 1990s. Alexey Kirsanov, an investigator at the Smolensk Regional Prosecutor's Office, receives a "black mark" from the leader of a local organized crime group without a statute of limitations, and a hunt begins for him. Kirsanov's close friend and colleague, Igor Sazonov, is being promoted and transferred to the position of prosecutor of the Yaroslavl region. He offers Kirsanov to move to a new place with him, away from gang violence.

name: Santa Maria
summary: The series follows two families from very different sides of the tracks whose lives are slowly entangled by the actions of saintly but strung-out cleaner Maria.

name: Vandaag Inside Oranje
summary: Vandaag Inside Oranje is a special edition of Vandaag Inside dedicated entirely to the World Cup. The regular panelists discuss the matches, notable events, and the dutch national team's performance. The show also covers other topics that are making headlines at the time.

name: The Author I Admired was not Human
summary: A mysterious vampire novelist uses his supernatural powers to solve complex crimes alongside a rookie editor, slowly regaining his lost humanity through their bond.

name: Kalabsh
summary: Follows the journey of Selim Al-Ansary, a hardworking police officer, who was wrongly accused of murder.

name: Late Night Law
summary: Ride along as officers face the dangers and decisions that define the night shift.

name: Muhafiz
summary: What he sees as duty, she sees as control, and what begins as protection slowly turns into a silent war between a responsible man and an unwilling heart

name: Hit Man
summary: Hit Man , a series inspired by the 2024 AGC Studios feature that was co-written, produced and headlined by Glen Powell.

name: Yokya Shudan ni iru Serizawa wa, Ore no Mae da to Yosu ga Okashii
summary: Suzuki is a self-proclaimed loner secretly writing stories about the popular boy, Serizawa. But when their worlds collide, Serizawa finds himself unexpectedly drawn to Suzuki, turning fiction into reality.

name: Идеальное ограбление
summary: In a luxury house, everything is arranged for a comfortable life: spacious rooms, a warm pool, a well-groomed territory... And most importantly, there is money in the house! The bank is replenished every day thanks to the joint efforts of the participants. There is only one way to break this impressive jackpot — to successfully leave the house. Whichever player does it first, the entire budget will be transferred to that account. All entrances and exits, windows and any possible loopholes in the house are securely closed, which means that the participants will not just have to look for a way t

name: Леший
summary: Ten years ago, the life of operative Sergei Granin changed dramatically when he was seriously injured while rescuing his friend and partner Yuri Dymov. During the time the law enforcement officer was in the hospital, his wife Maria went to Dymov and took their eight-year-old daughter with her. Disappointed in his family and people in general, Granin leaves for a remote village, where he becomes an inspector of forest protection and receives the nickname Leshiy for his unsociability. In his new position, Granin does not sit idle and helps the local district police officer Karpen in solving case

name: Rosa Elettrica
summary: In Rosa Elettrica , Rosa Valera is a young agent recently transferred to the Witness Protection Unit. On her first assignment, she's assigned to Cocìss, an unpredictable Camorra baby-boss who recently repented. Having been targeted by the rival clan, the young man has agreed to cooperate with the police to save his own skin. Rosa wonders why she was chosen, but she doesn't have time to let her uncertainties hold her back. Determined to protect Cocìss at all costs, she doesn't stop even when she realizes there's a flaw in the system and that, not only is her career at risk, but her life as well

name: Black Torch
summary: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago's powers.

name: Dong Bei Ai Qing Wang Shi: Shan Hun Mei Gui
Pride
summary: A globe-trotting journey through international pride festivals reveals diverse LGBTQ+ communities and their historical legacies across cultures and continents.

name: Alex Goes Bananas
summary: Alex Nickel (Technicality) was born in 2001. Join him as he discovers, reacts to, and explains pop-culture from the late 1990s and early 2000s.

name: Not Just Bikes
summary: Stories of great urban planning and urban experiences from Amsterdam and the Netherlands. It's not just bikes.

name: Real Life Lore
summary: RealLifeLore explains the history, geography, undercurrents and geopolitics of international disputes both big and small around the globe with the occasional diversions off planet or into 'that seems weird" situations that are quite telling.
previous_episode: Why You Can't Drive Anywhere In This Part of Alaska

name: Adónis
summary: Without money, without a partner and over 40, Miguel finds himself at a crossroads. However, his charisma and success with older women leads his friends at the health club to convince him to make a living as an escort for older ladies. With them, Miguel learns and enjoys himself, offering attention, joy and plenty of fun in return.

name: Into the Blue: Las maravillas del Triángulo de Coral
summary: The Coral Triangle is a tropical area located in the Pacific Ocean, where Southeast Asia (China Sea) and Oceania meet. It is the place with the most marine biodiversity of the planet. For two years, the award-winning Spanish underwater cameraman, Álex del Olmo, has travelled around the Coral Triangle, filming the marine fauna and the vast array of coral that inhabits the spectacular reefs of this area, the true lung of our planet. With a neat 4K image, the 8 episodes of the series cover places such as the Forgotten Islands, Raja Ampat, Komodo, Bali, Triton Bay, Flores, among others, to show in

name: Mermaids to Lovers
summary: The young adult rom-com centers on 18-year-old competitive swimmer Trixie, whose home is her father's swimming pool. However, the pool is on the verge of bankruptcy and is therefore rented out to a group of wannabe mermaids, whom Trixie now has to tolerate in her waters. Sixteen-year-old Instagram star and crowd-pleaser Finn is part of this group, and he manages to make Trixie's steely heart beat faster. Will the athlete and the merman be able to admit that they're on the same wavelength?

name: Paper Man
summary: Cha Myung Jo works at a company producing imitation character stickers. Though he's technically the head of his household, at home he's constantly overshadowed by his highly competent wife, who's a judge. However, when Myung-jo comes to create a counterfeit bill so flawless it can't be distinguished from the real thing, he steps into an unexpected world he never imagined.

name: Maiden and Shadow
summary: A-Deng, a lantern bearer who has lost her memory, wanders the mortal world carrying a bronze soul lantern. There, she encounters Xie Jingchen, the General of Dingyuan, who is burdened by a long-standing injustice that has plagued his family. Together, they investigate a series of supernatural mysteries, including the vengeful spirits haunting the Liu Manor and eerie disturbances within frontier military camps. As they unravel these cases, they gradually uncover the long-buried truth behind a devastating war between humans and demons that took place three centuries ago. A-Deng and Ying, whose h

name: Ancient Greece: The Dark Chronicles
summary: Ancient Greece is known as the birthplace of democracy, science, and architecture, but a darker reality hides beyond the shiny marble façade. This five-part series shows another side of Greek history, including menacing gods, oppressive laws, and brutal wars.

name: Игра вслепую
summary: Vocal is a TNT game show in which the stars will have to test their hearing, intuition and ability to recognize the voices of colleagues. The participants are divided into two teams and try to figure out who is singing in front of them now — the real star or her vocal double. The main task of the players is to confuse their rivals and not fall for the tricks of impersonators who can perfectly copy famous voices. Alexey Vorobyov became the host of the project, and among the participants were Philip Kirkorov, Olga Buzova, Klava Coca, Valeria, Irina Dubtsova, Lucy Chebotina, Marina Kravets, Timur

name: Come Outside
summary: Come Outside is an educational series for children. Auntie Mabel and Pippin the dog explore the world around - on the ground, under the ground and sometimes up in the air, in Auntie's aeroplane.

name: Appleseed XIII
summary: Following World War V, a global-scale conflict fought with non-nuclear weapons that almost halved the earth's population, the city-nation of Olympus stands as a beacon of hope in a world of chaos. The utopian metropolis is governed by Gaia, a vast artificial intelligence, and administered by genetically engineered humanoids known as bioroids. Although Olympus seems like a peaceful city on the surface, racial (human vs. bioroids vs. cyborgs), religious, and political conflicts lurk underneath -threatening to overturn the delicately balanced peace of this so-called utopia.

name: Legacy of Heroes
summary: Armenian soldiers' heroics during Artsakh wars through personal stories, battlefield bravery, and human experiences, highlighting their sacrifices, love, struggles, and how their legacy lives on, underscoring the cost of freedom.

name: Knockers
summary: What happens when straight dudes get picked off the street and get boobed up for cash? Come hang with Jimbo on KNOCKERS!

name: Beautiful Rain
summary: A young daughter supports her father who is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.

name: Swaci
summary: The main characters of the series are two pairs of parents of spouses Ania and Mateusz. The young people go on holidays bought last minute and want to leave their 7-year-old daughter, Maja, in the care of their grandparents. As a result of a mistake, both Ania's parents from the countryside and Mateusz's parents, who live in the big city, come to look after their granddaughter.

name: No.99,Happiness Road
summary: Told through the eyes of Su Man, a young woman from Taipei, China, this warm, uplifting, and lightly comedic series follows her unexpected journey. Unemployed and broke after her ex-boyfriend empties their joint savings, Su Man travels to Lucheng to demand repayment. Instead, she ends up with a restaurant, all that's left of the debt. Selling it isn't easy, so her actuary logic kicks in: run the business, raise its value, then sell.
