name: Niko Tama
summary: The series focuses on Asao Atsuko, who works at a bento shop, and her partner, patent attorney Iwaki Kohei. Despite being university sweethearts who have comfortably lived together for 12 years, their routine is disrupted when Kohei has a one-time affair with his colleague Yuko. This explores their struggles with emotional drifting, hesitation, and the nature of "family".

name: Eleceed
summary: High school student Jiwoo Seo knows nothing of the hidden world around him. Terrified of his own mysterious powers, he lives quietly, concealing his abilities from everyone. But everything changes the day he rescues a battered stray cat who turns out to be none other than Kayden—the most powerful Awakened being alive.

name: Open House Chicago
summary: An Exclusive, insiders look at the hottest residential properties in the Chicagoland market.

name: Songs of U.S.
summary: Salt Lick Session presents: " Songs of U.S. ", a new performance and conversation series bringing together artists from across the American musical landscape to reinterpret songs that have shaped the country's cultural identity — and to ask what belongs in the American songbook today.

name: 404: The Camellia Will Bloom
summary: Zhao Yanqing, the heir to a wealthy family, falls in love at first sight with Jiang Li, the daughter of his family's driver, after she drives him home one evening. He's helping her family discreetly. She's a fighter who won't accept help easily. Between them: an eight year age gap, social gap - the daughter of the help? It's a huge class difference Aware of the gulf between their social standing, Jiang Li hesitates. For years. Fate brings them together once more at the 404 Pub.

name: Deep Revenge
summary: After waking from a four-year coma and learning that her ex-husband had plotted her murder, Nozomi takes on a new identity and seeks revenge.

name: Where Colors Dream
summary: Set against the backdrop of Republican-era Shanghai, Xu Yanzhen, an orphaned painter with extraordinary artistic talent, unexpectedly crosses paths with Jiang Xinyu, the chief accountant of Ronghui Bank, who has been framed and pushed into a desperate situation. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two soon uncover a scheme to sell a priceless national treasure painting to foreign buyers at a bargain price. Using her remarkable forgery skills, Xu Yanzhen creates a flawless replica, allowing them to secretly swap the original masterpiece. As powerful forces close in from every side, Xu Yanzhen a

name: Muthassi
summary: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.

name: Jumelles
summary: Emma and Florence, 14-year-old twins, one with black skin and the other white, must redefine their identity after the tragic death of a young black woman in their neighborhood.

name: The Dark Side of the Sun
summary: In a psychiatric hospital overseas in Country M, the most dangerous patient, Xiao Mu Chen, passes his 144th mental evaluation and is finally discharged. But no one knows that his condition has never truly improved-he still sees the phantom of his fiancée, Jin Zhao Xi, whispering in his ear, urging him to take bloody revenge. Four years ago, on the day he had planned to propose, Jin Zhao Xi was brutally murdered. He arrived too late, only to see the four culprits walking away, laughing. Now, at last free, he begins the revenge he has long prepared for...

name: Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights
summary: Live-action anthology TV drama series adapting stories from Junji Ito's "Masterpiece Collection."

name: GBRB: Farm Operation - Go Go Farm
summary: They're back, but this time, at a farm! The three men's chaotic journey to adjust to animal farm life begins! The Lee Kwang-soo, Kim Woo-bin, Doh Kyung-soo trio arrives In the peaceful farm that sits on the lush, green pastures of Jeju. This time, they're kicking off a brand-new life alongside dozens of cows. From feeding the cows at the crack of dawn, checking on the fences, and handling all sorts of tasks popping up endlessly, they are suddenly hit with an unexpected crisis. Will the trio manage to keep the peace and survive the farm? A farm-tastic farmstay of the three besties, where laught

name: Histoires extraordinaires
previous_episode: La chute de la maison Usher

name: The Night Mist Scorches
summary: From the age of five, Lu Ying clung to Jin Bei Zhou like a shadow, even until they married. Jin Bei Zhou would rather believe the world turned upside down than for Lu Ying to leave him. But a sudden kidnapping made Lu Ying realize that no one can live without the other. In their third year of marriage, Lu Ying filed for divorce. But Jin Bei Zhou refused to let go,crushing his pride and begging her with bloodshot eyes not to leave. It turned out that the person they couldn't live without was Jin Bei Zhou.

name: Hey Kay Navin?
summary: Rama and Umesh are a happy couple with a good home, a loving family and well-settled corporate jobs. They've passed all the big hurdles of a relationship - romantic 20s, long marriage, setting up a home and finally.

name: Sui Sui Huai An
summary: Song Huai Chuan, a member of the Nuwa clan, is tricked into forming a contract with Xu Sui An, who suffers from a terminal illness. He initially intends to use marriage as a cover to stabilize his company and uncover the truth behind his mother's death; Xu Sui An, in turn, can be cured of her illness using the bloodline of the Nuwa clan. Both get what they want, but in theprocess of investigating the truth, Song Huai Chuan discovers that Xu Sui An seems to have a complex relationship with his mother, and that she is not a simple human girl, but a shrouded-in-mystery figure.

name: A Filha
summary: The new series is a Maria & Mayer production, with project direction by António Borges Correia and support from ICA. The story features a cast composed of big names in Portuguese fiction, such as Dalila Carmo, Diogo Infante, Inês Castel-Branco, José Condessa, Sara Barradas, and São José Lapa.

name: Newlywed Addiction
summary: Qiao Yuan is forced into marriage with Fu Tingzhou after her older sister runs away from the wedding. To the outside world, this looks like a sudden replacement marriage, but for Qiao Yuan it is much more dangerous emotionally — because Fu Tingzhou is the man she has secretly loved for ten years. After marriage, she becomes his most familiar stranger at home and his most reliable partner at work. Their relationship starts with obligation, distance, and old feelings hidden under professionalism, but the longer they stay beside each other, the harder it becomes to pretend this marriage is only a

name: Пригоди козака Виговського
summary: Facing execution, a compromised capital-city spy named Ivan Vyhovsky is forced to accept a seemingly doomed assignment. Instead of the gallows, a perilous mission awaits him—one that transforms the former agent into a fearless Cossack leader.

name: My Lady's Bodyguard
summary: Disguise might be able to hide the truth, but it can never hide the feelings born within the heart. When a female bodyguard must protect a mischievous young lady who is the light of her life - how will this love story end?

name: Sisters' Heist
summary: Adapted from "Sister's Heist" in Yan Yan Story. Xia Yan and Fang Yun, two best friends, accidentally transmigrate into a novel. Xia Yan becomes the obsessed wife of the cunning second male lead, Gu Bochuan, while Fang Yun is forced into the role of stand-in lover for the dangerous yandere antagonist, Gu Wang. On the surface, they play their parts as lovelorn captives, but behind closed doors, they are secretly indulging in every luxury their lavish, high-society lives afford. When the "white moonlight" female lead, Shen Mianmian, returns, the two decide to "fake their deaths" and escape to avo

name: Did You Know
summary: The story follows a dedicated surgeon and a successful hotel entrepreneur who have known each other since their school days. Their relationship has always existed somewhere between attraction and rivalry. Everything changed after one particular night, leaving unanswered questions that one of them desperately tries to forget while the other refuses to let go. Now, fate continues bringing them together. Between hospital corridors and luxury hotel halls, both women struggle to navigate unresolved emotions, professional responsibilities, and feelings they have carried for years.

name: Addicted To Marriage
summary: Addicted To Marriage is centered around an arranged or contract-style marriage deal, and explores how the protagonists transition from a strict agreement to developing genuine affection.

name: Quiet in the Office!
summary: Nayul was at her breaking point. Between the crushing workload and her detestable boss, Kwon Sijin-a man who perfected the art of trampling on dignity-she'd had enough. At 11 PM on a Friday, driven by pure rage, she stormed into his office. There, time froze. Nayul stood paralyzed, having caught her "perfect" yet perverted boss in the middle of a private, lewd act during overtime.

name: Hide One's Love
summary: In this game of love, Nan Ye Jue is the conqueror, the brutal plunderer. He gives Rong En ten days to compromise, then gradually closes in, completely destroying Rong En's once-normal life. The superior bows to love, but Rong En always remembers the pain he inflicted. Her unwavering clarity drives Nan Ye Jue ever more mad, and he's determined to keep her by his side at all costs.

name: Mermaid Husband
summary: Amidst the mermaid civil war, the Empress Princess Yun Ling —the heir with a sacred mission—stripped of her powers and exiled her to the mortal realm. Four merfolk closely tied to Yun Ling transformed into a doctor, a celebrity, a CEO, and a mafia boss to infiltrate the human world. Their quest: Find Yun Ling, uncover why she vanished... and confront her mortal incarnation, Xia Shi Yue, in a story of fire and tides.

name: The Captive Rose
summary: After catching her fiancé cheating with her stepsister and being thrown out by her own father, Wen Qiansu's life falls apart. On a rainy night, she meets the mysterious Mr. Huo, a man rumored to be cold and unhinged—but who treats her with unexpected kindness. As their relationship grows, Qiansu remains unaware that Mr. Huo has loved her for years and has been given a second chance at life, hiding the dark obsession that once led him to imprison her as he tries to protect her and rewrite their fate.

name: Forever Love
summary: Meng Yu was fostered away from home from a young age. Her biological parents doted on their adopted daughter, Meng Huan, and only used her. After breaking up with her ex-boyfriend, she was forced to accept her family's arrangement to marry Fu Qingshao, the heir to the Fu Group. He needed a loveless, unconditional wife to avoid suspicion, while she needed the status of Mrs. Fu to live a stable life and earn money to treat her adoptive mother's illness. The two, each getting what they wanted, signed a contract and hastily got married.

name: Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer
summary: When Isogai realizes that Hinata has the ability to spot murderers, he asks her to help him find the serial killer who murdered his fiancée, Azusa Kawada.

name: Burning Beauty
summary: Jiang Jiao was sold by the Jiang family into a marriage alliance with Fu Ran. At their first meeting, Fu Ran tried to force her into a divorce and even resorted to violence. Though she appeared gentle and obedient, Jiang Jiao was in fact ruthless, pretending to be compliant while secretly plotting revenge against both the Jiang family and the Lu family, stirring up storms in the business world.

name: Fen Shou Hou, Cheng Yi Sheng Ku Chu Bi Ti Pao
summary: Luo Jia discovers that Cheng Jin, the new transfer from orthopedics, is the very man she had a one-night stand with the night before. Cheng Jin switches seamlessly between domineering and puppy-like, successfully winning Luo Jia's heart. Just as their romance grows sweet, Luo Jia learns that Cheng Jin only approached her to get revenge on his ex-girlfriend. Heartbroken, she returns to Yu City. Unexpectedly, Cheng Jin follows her there, beginning his desperate "wife-chasing crematorium" journey.

name: Die Realitystar Academy
summary: Die Realitystar Academy , the reality competition centers on a ruthless talent factory where 18 undiscovered hopefuls cram for fame. Guided by prominent reality figures, the candidates must survive grueling tasks and daily drama to prove they have what it takes to be the next big reality TV main character.

name: Idaten Jump
summary: Idaten Jump follows a young, passionate mountain biker named Sho Yamato who is mysteriously transported to the "X-Zone" alongside his friends and his custom bike, the Flame Kaiser. To return to their home world, the group must win high-stakes "Idaten Battles" against other riders across various treacherous environments.
previous_episode: A New Journey, Restoring the World!

name: Crossroad
summary: Crossroad follows a clash of personalities and ideals within the high-pressure environment of Yokohama Bay Hospital.

name: Here U Are
summary: Yang Yu is a university upperclassman who's loved by everyone, and Huan Li is a quiet, antisocial new student. The two of them get off on the wrong foot, but despite clashing and repelling one another at times, they are still drawn to each other.

name: The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All
summary: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya loves listening to rock, but no one else seems to share her interest…until she meets a cool, stylish employee at a CD shop. Dressed in black from head to toe, he has this air of mystery about him, and his taste in music is impeccable. Aya falls hard for him—not knowing her crush is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! For her part, Mitsuki generally keeps to herself and avoids standing out at school. But given that she sits right next to Aya, Mitsuki's all too aware of the other girl's feelings, and she's afraid to reveal the truth. So why does she fi

name: First Love Returns
summary: After serving a stint in prison, single mom Gu Xing Wan is released and struggles to find a job in the law field. She ends up as the legal assistant to her ex-boyfriend, Attorney Yan, who can't understand why she wouldn't let him wait for her 5 years ago.

name: Professor Zhou Was the First to Fall in Love
summary: In her previous life, Jiang Song Chu died in an earthquake. The husband she had never truly cared about, Zhou Qi An, instead chose to quietly watch over her until the end. Given a second chance at life, Jiang Song Chu returns to four years earlier, to the time when she and Zhou Qi An had been married for just one year through a whirlwind marriage. This time, she decisively cuts ties with the charming but shallow Lin Tian and reunites with Zhou Qi An. Jiang Song Chu soon confirms that Zhou Qi An has not been reborn like she has. Armed with the experiences of her previous life, she quickly reali

name: Nian Nian Ru Huai
summary: After successfully confessing her love, 18-year-old girl Xu Chu Nian traveled through time and space to become a 24-year-old abandoned wife of a wealthy family. Faced with her indifferent husband, Jiang Huai Xu, and her mute daughter, Zhu Zhu, she was determined to save everything. When strange memories and men in black appeared frequently, she discovered that the world was actually set in a novel! Xu Nian Chu broke free from control and fought against the plot. She could only write her own life!

name: Double Blade
summary: Three years ago, to save her critically ill grandmother, Gu Xingwan unilaterally blocked her boyfriend Ji Yan, who was studying abroad, and got together with Fu Sihan. Three years later, when she accompanied Fu Sihan to visit his parents, she unexpectedly encountered Ji Yan, who had been searching for her for three years. Ji Yan couldn't accept reality and began to relentlessly pursue Gu Xingwan. At the same time, Fu Sihan's favoritism completely broke Gu Xingwan's heart, and she resolutely broke up with Fu Sihan, bringing a new turning point to their relationship.

name: Turquoise Summer
summary: Follow three lifelong friends as they leave their pasts behind for the sun-drenched shores of Bodrum—a place of escape, reckoning, and unexpected rebirth.

name: Dia a Dia com Goldenboy
summary: Dia a Dia com Goldenboy , hosted by streamer and presenter Felipe Goldenboy, serves up behind-the-scenes moments and pop culture commentary directly from the network's studios.
previous_episode: A VERDADE da COPA na DiaTV: Beta Boechat, Diva Depressão e Cá Fremder desabafam

name: WM 1994 – Elf Helden, ein Albtraum
summary: For the 1994 World Cup, Germany entered as the favorite and defending champion, but was eliminated in the quarterfinals. Internal conflicts, media campaigns, and public criticism of coach Berti Vogts led the so-called "eleven friends" – players like Lothar Matthäus, Jürgen Klinsmann, Stefan Effenberg, Bodo Illgner, and Matthias Sammer – to maneuver themselves into a collective nightmare within just a few weeks. This documentary takes a behind-the-scenes look at Germany's memorable World Cup and shows how one of the strongest German teams of all time spectacularly failed.

name: Low Tide in Twilight
summary: Burdened by crushing debt, omega Kim Euihyun struggles to protect his younger brother while searching for a way out of despair. His life changes after meeting the wealthy alpha Yeo Taeju, leading to a complicated relationship shaped by survival, trust, and love.

name: BaseBoys
summary: Four boys enter a music contest, hoping to win money for gaming equipment. But they are surprised when they do so well that they become a popular boy band.

name: Два с половиной повара
summary: Kristina and Albina have a lot of secrets and tricks that turn things in the kitchen into a fun holiday. Together with them, viewers will learn how to create a real branch of a restaurant at home, where not only delicious, but also very beautiful food is served.

name: Romantic Island
summary: Ye Ji enters a 19+ dating show with a huge cash prize for her boyfriend, who lost everything. The only way to win the 1.9 billion prize is to spend the night with another man. There, she meets Jae Hyeon, her first love, and Do Hyeok, the ex-husband she broke up with after an affair. Between true love, the 1.9 billion prize, and her own desires—what will Ye Ji choose?

name: The Dean Martin Celebrity Roast
summary: For a series of 54 specials and shows, Martin would periodically "roast" a celebrity. These roasts were patterned after the roasts held at the New York Friars' Club in New York City. The format would have the celebrity guest seated at a banquet table, and one by one the guest of honor was affectionately chided or insulted about his career by his fellow celebrity friends.

name: Yankı Görünmez El
summary: Eray, a senior manager in a bank, does not get the promotion he looks up to. As his moral compass is put to test, he finds himself having to choose between integrity and ambition: Will he get the position he deserves by any means necessary?

name: Dynasty of the Undead: Mutate
summary: Set in a fictional ancient empire, the dark sorcery of the Mijiang people creates an undead monster army that invades the Dasheng realm, leading to the capital's fall and the emperor's capture. Fang Sun, a Mijiang orphan with eagle-like vision, and Princess Xiao Qing of Dasheng form an alliance. Trapped in a besieged city amid political intrigue and hordes of monsters, they lead soldiers and civilians in a desperate last stand with cold weapons and muskets, fighting both the undead horde and traitors to save their nation. Blending Eastern political intrigue, doomsday survival, and superhuman a

name: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
summary: Under the impression that they are entering a standard 35-day group challenge at dawn, the survivalists instead begin their insertion adrift at sea overnight. With emergency flares shooting overhead, the survivalists must grab whatever limited resources they can before making their way ashore. Divided into four groups of three, the survivalists are stranded on a mysterious and isolated island on the lost coast of the Philippines, often described as the "Bermuda Triangle of Southeast Asia," due to its history of past shipwrecks and unexplained disappearances. The terrain offers both opportuniti

name: Harlan Coben's Myron Bolitar
summary: After an injury ends his NBA dreams, Myron Bolitar reinvents himself as a sports agent - using charm, smarts, and a ruthless partner to navigate the high-stakes and dirty world of sports, where saving his clients often means risking himself.

name: Young Swordsman
summary: Born with sealed meridians and death written into his fate, Peng Dasheng was never meant to become a hero. Sent down the mountain to break off his engagement, the powerless disciple of the Wuhuduandao Sect discovers a destiny beyond imagination. With one miracle after another, he defeats six Demon Sect masters and rises to become the leader of the martial alliance. When his true identity is revealed, the hero once revered by all is cast out by the entire martial world. Only then does the soul jade awaken, unlocking the power hidden within him. Now, Peng Dasheng will defy the fate that cursed h

name: How Do We Relationship?
summary: Shy Miwa has always dreamed of finding love, but living in small-town Japan made finding the right match difficult—especially since she likes girls! Even going away to college didn't seem to help, until one day her outgoing classmate Saeko suggests they might as well start dating each other since it's not like either of them has other options. At first it seems like things won't work out as their personalities clash and misunderstandings abound. But when their casual friendship starts to become something more, Miwa begins to wonder—can a pragmatic proposal lead to true love?

name: Guilty Creatures
summary: Guilty Creatures delves into the psyche of a torrid romance and subsequent act of murder between two young, adulterous but God-fearing lovers, unraveling their complex lives and the emotional toll of living as killers for 18 years.

name: Exposed: The Ghost Train Fire
summary: This three-part documentary series explores the mysterious details surrounding the Sydney Luna Park tragedy that took seven lives in 1979.

name: Who Wants To Marry My Dad?
summary: The adult children of a single father choose among several suitors to decide which woman will marry their dad.

name: A Killer in the Family: The Murder of Becky Watts
summary: A teenage girl goes missing from her home in Bristol, prompting a huge search across the city and a social media campaign to find her. As days pass fears grow that she may have come to harm. As the police investigation progresses shocking evidence is discovered, pointing towards a family member for her murder but no one could have imagined what happened next.

name: Fred Has Problems
summary: Follows Fred, an optimistic everyman trying to do the right thing who somehow creates absolute chaos for himself.

name: Stand Up to Cancer
summary: Live broadcast television event. Some of the biggest names in entertainment are on hand to raise money for the fight against cancer.

name: Macha Dynasty: Zhong Kui
summary: Lin Xiaojia, a young amusement park mechanic, accidentally travels to a parallel universe: the Zhaoming Dynasty, an industrial superpower ruled by Mohist mechanical engineering. When Japanese onmyoji send mutated beasts to invade, the centuries-old giant Mohist mecha "Zhong Kui" is awakened by Lin. Using modern repair skills to pilot the ancient mecha, he joins the Mech Bureau to fight interdimensional beasts and conspiracies, igniting a thrilling clash between Eastern ancient machinery and modern mecha combat across time and space.

name: Please Don't Break Anything
summary: Four months after a night gone horribly wrong, Billie holds a gathering in honour of her dead best friend. But as the night unfolds, she realises her mates may be hiding more than they seem.

name: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
summary: Over 3,500 years, brave voyagers cross millions of miles of harsh Pacific Ocean in handmade canoes. They find and settle thousands of islands, reaching as far as Guam, Hawaii, Rapa Nui and Fiji. Becoming master navigators, they overcome deadly natural barriers, and build an ocean world like no other - one connected by canoes and legends of the sea.

name: Adam Liaw's North American Fan Feasts
summary: Adam Liaw embarks on an extraordinary culinary journey across North America, celebrating how food, sport, and culture unite communities and shape national identity.

name: L.O.L. Surprise! The Next Headliner
summary: Five aspiring performers compete for a coveted music industry opportunity, only to discover that their greatest strength lies in collaboration rather than rivalry. As they navigate friendship, self-doubt and the pressures of pursuing a music career, they form a band and chart their own path to stardom.

name: Celebrity Tipping Point NZ
summary: Daniel Faitaua takes the tried-and-true Tipping Point formula and infuses it with a distinctly Kiwi flavour, alongside some some of Aotearoa's favourite famous faces

name: Summer Unboxed with Maisie and Joel
summary: Maisie and Joel experience the unpredictability of a British summer through a series of light-hearted challenges. Mystery boxes filled with quirky postcards, seasonal items, and essentials from Boots guide them through each task. Their journey takes them from festivals to seaside trips and countryside wellness retreats, where they tackle activities like capturing the perfect beach photo and cycling a tandem route. Throughout, they stay prepared for changing conditions with a range of health and beauty products suited to every setting.

name: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab
summary: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab follows long-term couples whose relationships have been rocked by infidelity as they move into the Miami-based "Cheathab House" to confront the trust issues, jealousy, and unresolved wounds threatening their futures. An emotionally charged journey of accountability, difficult choices and redemption.

name: Saved by the Ice Cold Prince's Embrace
summary: As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in

name: Bulges
summary: Bulges follows the lovably eccentric staff at an iconic and once-thriving all-male, not-so-family friendly restaurant called Bulges in Niagara Falls, Ontario, as they embrace friendship, juggle complicated love lives, and fend off ruthless cross-town rivals... all while sporting booty shorts that are tight in all the right places.

name: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition
summary: The series takes audiences on a high-energy journey across America's most iconic highway, combining adventure, competition, entertainment, community celebration, and philanthropy.

name: Пять причин поехать в…
summary: "Five Reasons to Visit..." is a television program that introduces the unique nature, sights, culture, and traditions of the peoples of the Commonwealth countries. Traveling with us is always exciting, because we always have "five reasons" to do so.
previous_episode: Молодая столица. Какими достопримечательностями встречает Астана?

name: Baddies
summary: After a botched bank heist and a stolen cop car collide, four misfit kids sent to a dodgy youth camp find themselves standing between a crew of robbers and a million bucks.

name: Jagerpilotens sidste mission
summary: From Yugoslavia to Afghanistan, Iraq, Syria and Libya, Thomas 'MET' Kristensen has been involved when Denmark sent the Air Force into action. Now he is flying his last mission and looking back on a life over the world's hot spots.

name: The Best of Us
summary: The Best of Us dramatizes a landmark case that reshaped the fight for accountability: a relentless legal war that stretched nearly a decade to secure almost $1 billion in compensation for first responders who fell gravely ill in the wake of 9/11.

name: Más allá de la sociedad
summary: The story of Flight 571 did not end on the day the survivors were rescued from the Andes. For them, and for the families of those who did not return, the hardest part was about to begin. Whilst silence reigned amongst those directly involved, the rest of the world continued to try to understand what had happened through books, films and documentaries. But how does one rebuild a life after such a tragedy?

name: I Can Grow It
summary: I Can Grow It follows Aaron Roach Bridgeman and his young "Garden Buds" as they uncover the magic of nature in a colourful inner‑city garden, from tiny seeds to buzzing bees and harvest-time surprises. Packed with music, hands‑on fun and simple ideas to try at home, the series shows that anyone can grow something — anywhere.

name: Daggerheart: Azerim
summary: Baradun and the Dickheads return, and this time they have landed in Daggerheart! What begins as a light-hearted adventure in the Beast Feast campaign frame, filled with bizarre creatures & questionable cooking, soon reveals a much darker mystery.

name: Lavender
summary: A story about love, identity, and the relationships that have no name — and no less meaning for it. Appu and Mohak have built a life together in Mumbai. When circumstances force a lavender marriage into their home, all three lives change in ways none of them planned.

name: Jesser's Ultimate Kickoff
summary: Jesser and friends take on epic, high-energy soccer challenges like goal-scoring contests and mystery pool jumps for the entire family to enjoy!
previous_episode: Score The Goal, Win The Prize

name: Shergar: The Racehorse and the IRA
summary: Shergar: The Racehorse and the IRA is a gripping two-part docuseries telling the extraordinary story behind one of racing's most infamous mysteries. After a record-breaking Derby victory made Shergar a global sensation, armed men abducted him from a County Kildare stud farm in 1983, sparking ransom demands, political speculation, and a mystery that remains unsolved.

name: Goodman: Too Big To Fail
summary: The story of Larry Goodman's rise, fall, and resurgence, revealing how he survived crises and controversy to dominate Ireland's meat industry.

name: Let's Tug It!
summary: As an unpopular club, the Mingcheng tug of war team is led by an unreliable coach named Lei Ming, who gathers eight newcomers with various personal motives to form a team on a whim, preparing them to compete in professional competitions. They suffer a devastating defeat in their first match and are ridiculed. Thus, they start the "rise from the ashes" battle, stumbling yet growing. While gaining friendship, how will they continue to follow their original intentions and fulfill their promises to each other?

name: In the Dead of Winter
summary: In the dead of winter, a mentally ill woman stops a passing vehicle to report that her husband has committed murder. Her shocking accusation leads detectives Shen Dongliang and Wu Hongbing to uncover the truth behind a series of gruesome dismemberment murders. But before the dust can settle, a string of new crimes erupts—a deadly savings bank robbery, the disappearance of a teenage girl, and a violent carjacking spree. As Shen and Wu pursue the perpetrators, they are drawn into a devastating human tragedy that will forever alter both of their lives.

name: To Love & Cherish
summary: To help support her family, Daran gave up her dreams of higher education to start working immediately after high school. Unfortunately, she struggles to find work, eventually taking a job as a security guard at a broadcasting company. But unexpectedly, she runs into her ex-boyfriend Rangsiman, now a powerful television executive. Daran and Rangsiman were deeply in love in their teens but separated over painful misunderstandings and secrets kept from each other. Rangsiman himself is now engaged to another woman, but he finds himself drawn back to Daran, wanting to understand why she broke up wi

name: Aperture R&D
summary: After losing a fellow scientist, Nik and Charles must decide how much they're willing to risk for the Lab Team of the Month title.

name: Sayonara Noir
summary: A former organized crime detective and a brilliant but socially awkward psychologist team up at the newly established Crime Victim Support Office at Tokyo's Nishi-Ikebukuro Police Station. Together, they use contrasting approaches to support crime victims and bereaved families, helping them overcome their trauma and move forward in life.

name: Monkey Wrench
summary: The series follows the misadventures of cut-rate mercenary monkey duo Shrike and Beebs as they cruise the galaxy in search of decent-paying contracts.

name: Atlas and the Stars
summary: Atlas is determined to set off for the stars, but things take a wild turn when her attempt to steal a starship doesn't go as planned. After mysteriously getting tossed across universes, Atlas and Atmosphere have no choice but to team up together if they ever want to make it off of the strange dying planet, Quasonia.

name: Sugar and Spice
summary: Pixie and Molly are arch enemies, as different as sugar and spice. During the 1920s, they are forced to leave home to attend high school — together. They travel hundreds of miles from the tiny settlement of Coolwong, deep in the Australian outback, to a big country town — together. The girls begin a new life with a new family. Together they fight, laugh, join the Girl Guides, fly in a biplane, discover Rudolph Valentino — and together, they grow up to understand one another. A warm, humorous and exciting story of two very strong-willed girls and the development of a most unlikely friendship.

name: Rewriting the Fate of Jiang Hui
summary: Ye Shishi has just accepted Yu Chengli's confession when her best friend, Jian You, claims she's back from ten years in the future. Jian You warns Ye Shishi that Yu Chengli is a scumbag and tells her to stay away from him. She also reveals that her own future husband, Jiang Hui, will kill his father on the night the college entrance exam results come out. To save Jiang Hui, Ye Shishi teams up with Jian You and Chen An, who lives next door to Ye Shishi and has secretly loved her for years. Jiang Hui himself also joins them, and the four work together to rewrite his fate.

name: Код а‑ля Рус
summary: In the "Code à la Rus" project with Tatiana Morozova, our designers, together with the queen of economy renovations, Ksenia Shakhmatova, will rethink the code à la Rus in a modern style. All this is for business owners to breathe new life into their creations! 8 different establishments in the country will receive a new interior.

name: Rachael Ray's Tasty Travels
summary: Where can you get a burger for a buck in the Big Apple? How about fresh oysters on the half shell at 2 a.m. in Boston? Travel guru Rachael Ray is back with insider tips and travel secrets that will turn your next vacation into a delicious, affordable feast. From the sweetest ice cream shop to the perfect spot to stage a picnic, Rachael shares tips from around the country and the world. Hop on board for some tasty travels!

name: Suikoden: The Anime
summary: Two young boys… the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom – a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine br

name: That genius is obsessed with his fake girlfriend
As Scheduled
summary: Singer Jin Xi makes a disastrous crossover into acting, only to be ridiculed online for his poor performance. Refusing to give up, he decides to reinvent himself by stepping into the world of musical theatre, determined to prove his critics wrong. By chance, Jin Xi falls for the cold, perfectionist musical director Ning Jin, and an unexpected kiss sparks undeniable chemistry between them. Fate brings them together again at an audition, where Ning Jin—who has little respect for idols crossing into musicals—is far from impressed. Subjecting the newcomer to relentless training and impossible stan

name: Life In The W
summary: Through exclusive behind-the-scenes access, Life In The W captures the realities of life at the highest level of women's basketball, offering viewers a front-row seat to the sacrifices, pressures, leadership responsibilities and defining moments that come with being among the game's elite athletes. Across six episodes, audiences will experience the intensity of the WNBA season from multiple perspectives: a reigning superstar continuing to elevate the game, a leader helping shape the future of the league, and a veteran icon balancing championship aspirations with a legacy already cemented among

name: Your Time Starts Now
summary: Set in the Taskmaster universe, the new show builds on the at-home ingenuity of earlier incarnation The Button, which Horne devised and narrated in 2018, and HomeTasking that saw Horne on a mission to entertain a world stuck in 2020's lockdown. Your Time Starts Now will see UK households compete against one another while tackling a host of his typically devious tasks without ever leaving their homes. Five teams of friends and families across the UK will need to display creativity, lateral thinking, speed, knowledge and teamwork if they want to win.

name: An Impossible Way to Die
summary: DS Katie Salter is happily solving everyday crimes until fate drags her into an impossible murder mystery. Four people sat around a table seemingly set for a dinner party – except they are all dead. The only clue is a scorpion crawling out of one of the victim's mouths…

name: Kissed by the Rain
summary: Plaifon works as a social worker for children and women. She meets a boy named Mawin. Mawin and his mother are on the run from an abusive father and hope to find shelter at the foundation where Plaifon works. When his mother suddenly dies, Mawin's world comes apart at the seams, and Plaifon is the only support in his life. Plaifon knows that love can give and take everything from a person, leaving a long trail of regret. She decides to leave Mawin to avoid the unwanted mistake. Will their paths cross again? Can they ever let go of their past?

name: Homestead Family Survival
summary: Homestead: Family Survival explores the biblical art of homesteading, farming, and holistic living.
previous_episode: A Forest of Food Pt 2: Community

name: Икорный барон
summary: Sergey Bortnik arrives in the large provincial city under the guise of a new state fisheries inspector. In fact, he is an investigator for particularly important cases of the Investigative Committee. Here Bortnik meets his old love Liza, now the wife of the local oligarch Zbruev, a friend of his youth. But Bortnik did not come here to arrange his personal life. The Caviar Baron appeared in the city - powerful and elusive, cruel and resourceful. Together with district police officer Ivan Kashin, Bortnik is looking for the Baron - but he turns out to be too cunning.

name: Bluey Cake Off
summary: Join two famous friends as they go head to head in a playful baking adventure, each will have to follow instructions by baker Tigga Mac and try to recreate a delicious bake inspired by Bluey. From a longdog yule log to the recreation of the Heelers' House, watch as the duo mix, decorate and mould their creations while sharing plenty of laughs along the way. Once all finished, Tigga will choose an honorary winner… but the real winner is having fun in the kitchen.
previous_episode: Chattermax Cake with Myf vs Rove

name: Wir werden groß!
summary: Over the past two years, VOX has provided insights into the interaction and developmental stages of kindergarten children in the documentary format ‘The Mysterious World of Children'. Tom, Mert, Paulina, Abigail and the other children have now started school. They were once again accompanied by cameras for the two-part documentary ‘Wie werden groß!'. The first-graders are accompanied for one episode each in a primary school and in an adventure centre. Viewers can witness how the eleven girls and boys have developed since their kindergarten days. But not only the children, but also the parents

name: A Little Reunion
summary: This story focuses on China's notorious college entrance exam, the "gaokao." It follows three seniors in high school and their families as they navigate the ups and downs of their lives whilst preparing for this exam that they believe will determine the trajectory of the rest of their lives.

name: ESPN Jeopardy!
summary: ESPN Jeopardy! is the ultimate match-up between the worldwide leader in sports and the world's leading quiz show. Hosted by Emmy®-winning and Monday Night Football broadcaster Joe Buck, "ESPN Jeopardy!" features sports commentators and celebrity sports fans as they face off to experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat in a new arena: the Alex Trebek Stage. With material covering the full spectrum of ESPN content, this is "Jeopardy!" for sports fanatics. Contestants will represent charities of their choice as they compete in a tournament-style event for the $500,000 grand prize a

name: Jupiter Island
summary: The series is set on the ultra-exclusive Jupiter Island where the privileged world of professional golfers and their wives fractures when a mysterious outsider arrives — and a secret threatens golf's reigning power couple.

name: Spy School
summary: Spy School revolves around Ben Ripley, who may only be a teenager, but he's already pegged his dream job: CIA or bust. Ben is not surprised when he is recruited for a magnet school with a focus on science — but he's entirely shocked to discover that the school is a front for a CIA academy.

name: Тест на верность
summary: Anastasiya is a well-known family psychologist. Thanks to her work, many couples have overcome the crisis and found harmony in the family. Nastya herself has been happily married to Vladimir for fifteen years. They love each other and run a family business together.

name: Fatal Conflicts - The Rise and Fall of Civilisations
summary: Four ancient leaders. Two epic wars. Civilisations clash in a battle for supremacy – rewriting history forever. Fatal Conflicts: the Rise and Fall of Civilisations is a two-part documentary exploring two defining ancient rivalries: Xerxes vs Themistocles in the Second Greco-Persian War, and Hannibal vs Scipio in the Second Punic War. In each, a dominant empire, Persia or Carthage, faces a rising force, Greece or Rome.

name: The Happy Mess Method
summary: Experts Sabrina Soto and Jennifer McCartney help clients develop practical, sustainable home organization methods. Their "Happy Mess Method" offers achievable solutions instead of focusing on decluttering or perfectionism.

name: Always Remember
summary: Always Remember follows Pae and Liu, two successful professionals who have secretly been in a relationship for two years despite working as business rivals. Their carefully hidden romance is shattered after an accident causes Pae to lose every memory from the previous two years, including the time she fell in love with Liu. Suddenly, the woman she once loved becomes a complete stranger. To make matters even more complicated, people around Pae begin convincing her that Liu is actually her greatest enemy. Unable to reveal the truth, Liu decides to stay by her side and slowly help her rediscover

name: The Secret Creatures of Jao
summary: This magical series takes place deep in the heart of the Okavango Delta in Botswana. Isolated by the surrounding flood water, a collection of secretive and mysterious creatures are imprisoned on the paradise island of Jao.

name: Символы русского флота
summary: The documentary series *Symbols of the Russian Navy* (produced in Russia) explores the history and key attributes of the nation's Navy, tracing its evolution from the era of Peter the Great. The series covers pivotal stages in the fleet's development, highlighting traditions, shipbuilding, and the symbols of naval power.

name: На разломе эпох
summary: The film's authors will attempt to answer the question: what was the role of the intelligentsia as a kind of spiritual and moral barometer of Russian public life, and the extent of its participation in those turbulent and fateful events during the First World War.

name: The Adam Ray Show
summary: Same host. Different characters. All chaos. Each week, Adam Ray taps into his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests — and no one is safe.

name: Jackie, Ethel, Joan: The Women of Camelot
summary: They were more than Washington wives. They were part of an American dream known as Camelot. With strength and cunning they upheld their public image by concealing their private truths. Jackie, Ethel and Joan had little choice.

name: City '68
summary: City '68 was a anthology drama set in the fictional, bustling Lancashire city of Fylde. Supposedly located on the north bank of the River Ribble—geographically nestled between Preston and Blackpool—Fylde was imagined as a massive industrial hub home to over three-quarters of a million residents. The series used this fictional backdrop as a microcosm to explore the emerging social, economic, and personal conflicts of late-1960s urban British life.

name: Chotto Matou yo, Harutora-kun
summary: Iki Kishida is a high school senior who struggles to connect with others, choosing to hide his true expressions behind a mask. Enter Harutora Kurobe, a straightforward and fiercely devoted freshman who sees right through the barriers. Despite being complete opposites, their paths cross, sparking an unlikely bond filled with the warmth, awkwardness, and heart-aching tenderness unique to adolescence. As they navigate the bittersweet waters of first love, they must confront their own vulnerabilities in a deeply moving journey of youth and self-growth.

name: The Secret of Secrets
summary: In The Secret of Secrets , symbologist Robert Langdon races against ancient forces and time to rescue his girlfriend, missing scientist Katherine Solomon, and her groundbreaking manuscript whose discoveries have the power to forever change humanity's understanding of the mind.

name: Awakening of the Tomb Leader
summary: Chen Guzhou, the legendary Tomb Leader, falls off a cliff after a deadly battle with the Corpse King of Miao Territory. Saved by the heiress of the Mechanism Clan, he hides his true identity as a servant and keeps his true power concealed—until warlords and old enemies threaten the entire clan. Forced to reveal his lost arts, Chen fights to save his people and uncover the secrets of the thousand-year-old Gu Tomb.

name: Born Again
summary: Top influencer Gu Xiaotang's grand wedding turns into a murder scene, orchestrated by her husband, best friend, and agency. Trapped in an infinite time loop of that very day, she dies repeatedly. After several brutal cycles, she awakens and uses her curse of unlimited resets, teaming up with Dr. Ye Shen, the only one who follows her through the loops, to take revenge on her killers. Just as victory seems near, the loop resets earlier: one week before the tragedy. Gu Xiaotang realizes she must stop the source of pain before it begins and fight for a future worth living.

name: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Bones of the Past
summary: While the city is dredging a riverbed, human remains are unearthed. Medical examiner Qin Ming discovers that the victim is a woman from an old case years ago. On Qin Ming's birthday, sunspot activity causes his toy walkie-talkie to connect with his father, Qin Tian, 30 years in the past. Qin Ming warns Qin Tian about an explosion and saves him, but this triggers the Rainy Night Hammer Killer serial case. Two generations of police officers work together across time to solve the case and uncover the truth.

name: Jin Wan Yue Guang Hen Mei，Cha Xiang Si Yi
El Señor de la Querencia
summary: Set in 1920s rural Chile, the story follows José Luis Echenique, a deranged and abusive landowner who rules his estate, "La Querencia," with an iron fist. His empire of terror is threatened by the return of Manuel Pradenas, a revolutionary outsider who falls for Echenique's oppressed wife, Leonor.

name: El Señor de la Querencia
summary: The days in Querencia are about to end. The unexpected arrival of Manuel Pradenas, a revolutionary worker who returns from the north to say goodbye to his dying mother, will put in check the authoritarian hegemony of José Luis Echeñique in his traditional hacienda and in his marriage with Leonor Amenábar. Thus, the family life of the Echenique Amenábar family and his three children, Ignacio, Luis Emilio and Teresita, will change forever, collapsing the rigid values, abuses and impositions that reigned in Querencia for years.

name: Témpano
summary: The life of a police officer is not easy, or at least if you are Nicolás Duarte, a cunning young man who is assigned the mission of protecting Amparo Benavente, a mysterious girl who comes to visit and in passing to play revenge for the events that occurred. 8 years before the beginning of the story. But, what he doesn't know is that just 20 years before, Álvaro Grau had a relationship with his mother, but due to a dark secret they distanced themselves.

name: A névtelen vár
summary: In this story set during the French Revolution and the Napoleonic Wars, a mysterious Hungarian nobleman, Count Vavel, rescues Marie—the heir to the executed French royal couple—from the ruthless Republican agents hunting her, and hides her in the "Castle of the Nameless," a deserted fortress by Lake Fertő.

name: Within the Frame
summary: Within the Frame is a popular documentary series broadcast by Museum TV that allows viewers to explore the masterpieces and lives of history's greatest painters. It provides an inside look at renowned collections, focusing on legendary artists like Leonardo da Vinci, Rembrandt, and Claude Monet.

name: Sirotan
summary: Sirotan anime series follows the daily exploits of the titular fluffy, white harp seal and his animal friends as they lead cozy, laid-back lives. Based on the popular Japanese character brand by Creative Yoko, the show focuses on simple, everyday adventures designed to spread comfort and healing.
previous_episode: I want to eat pizza 10 times.

name: Icons Unearthed: Harrison Ford
summary: Icons Unearthed: Harrison Ford tells the tale of the everyman, who redefined the leading man, from a whip-cracking archaeologist to a President with a punch. This is the story of the carpenter turned actor who built an unprecedented Hollywood legacy.

name: Lunacy
summary: The series follows high school student Luna Goda, who is raised as the "child of the fire god" and forbidden to fall in love. She runs a "follower business" (cult-like enterprise) at her grandmother's acupuncture clinic. When a popular classmate named Kensho rejects Luna's romantic confession, a scorned Luna plots to exact revenge by pulling him into her follower business.

name: Rabbit Hole
summary: A 36-member cast of the world's most influential creators, including Topper Guild, Zhong, Mackenzie Turner, Matthew Beem and Jesser come together for the ultimate teen variety show.

name: Byzantium: The Lost Empire
summary: Four programmes taking an in-depth look at the rise and fall of the Byzantine empire.

name: Sword in Flames
summary: Sword in Flames begins 7,000 years ago, focusing on a woman discovered in an ancient tomb clutching precious metal. From this starting point, the series traces the revolutionaries who figured out how to melt copper and tin to forge the very first bronze sword, following its trail from West to East across the Eurasian plains.

name: Rediscovering the Arctic
summary: Rediscovering the Arctic is an acclaimed 8-part documentary produced by CCTV. It explores the history, environment, indigenous cultures, and modern scientific expeditions of the Arctic region, detailing China's historic and ongoing relationship with the extreme north.

name: Virgin Love Hell
summary: After joining a dating survival show, "Hot Dating Zone," at Su-a's request, Solji is assigned overwhelming physical-affection missions and gets entangled in relationships with three different guys, which turns out to be set up by Su-a to humiliate her. Now, Solji has to find a way to escape from this chaos full of betrayal and excitement.

name: Spread Like Wildfire
summary: Years after a painful mistake tears them apart, a ruthless but deeply loyal lawyer and a determined female reporter are forced to work together. Bound by shared secrets and regrets, they navigate a dangerous web of revenge and healing that reignites old feelings.

name: Outback Terror: The Falconio Murder
summary: Twenty-five years after the murder of Peter Falconio and Joanne Lees' escape from Bradley John Murdoch, experts uncover insights into Murdoch's motives and try to determine where Peter is buried.

name: Por el nombre de Dios
summary: A prophecy tells that the secret name of God will be revealed with the birth of a chosen child, in the last year of the millennium.

name: Paura di amare
summary: Paura di amare centers on bereavement and a romantic new beginning: after the tragic death of his wife, pharmaceutical entrepreneur Stefano Loi plunges into despair. His life changes radically when he meets Asia, a young and determined medical student; this unexpected encounter offers both of them a second chance to find love and happiness.

name: The Debut: Dream Academy
summary: The Debut: Dream Academy consists of 20 girls from all around the world on their journey to make their dream come true. As the girls go through multiple missions, they will grow and show different sides of themselves until they make it in the final debut line-up.

name: MechWest
summary: In a fantastical Wild West world, oddball Pearl West is the only one who thinks of mechs as anything more than tools and appliances. But one fateful day she stumbles upon an unlikely friend: a curious mech named Six who carries a tremendous secret. Now Pearl, aided by her stalwart brother and a quirky salesman named Casey, must brave the dangers of the untamed frontier to protect Six from dangerous bandits. The future of all the Western nations may very well rest in Pearl's hands!

name: It's Ok to Ask Questions
summary: In the GLAAD nominated series, It's OK to Ask Questions , NBC Chicago's Matthew Rodrigues showcases open and honest conversations with trailblazers in the queer community, offering a dialogue where no topic is off limits.

name: Gayle
summary: Gayle's a middle-aged woman, stay at home mom type who descends deeper into madness each week. She's frantic and desperate and will stop at nothing to maintain status in her community.

name: Bigtop Burger
summary: The surreal daily lives of the employees of the Bigtop Burger food truck.

name: kiDnap GAME
summary: Kidnappings erupt simultaneously across seven Asian cities. Families of the victims receive a chilling email: "How far will you go to save your loved one?" Each participant is given different instructions, forced to overcome trials to rescue those they love. Seven people from diverse nationalities, backgrounds, and religions are drawn into a brutal survival contest under extreme conditions—the deadly "kiDnap GAME."

name: The Drowning Pool: The Murder of Paula Leeson
summary: Gripping mystery unravelling the death of wealthy Paula Leeson.

name: Победители
summary: Famous actors, television presenters, bloggers and correspondents ask questions to veterans of the Great Patriotic War. Heroes will tell about the dramatic events of the past and an important contribution to the overall Victory. Veterans will also share the details, personal life and observations of their contemporaries. How did moral ideals help in shaping the generation of winners? And thanks to which the veterans managed to stay in active intellectual and physical form despite the turmoil experienced?

name: A Different Breed
summary: A Different Breed follows 18 very talented pooches and their handlers as they compete in three annual live events, including high-flying disc routines, head-to-head weave pole racing, intricate dog agility courses and diving dog competitions.

name: Murder in Suburbia
summary: In December 2007, a quiet Surrey town is shaken by a horrific murder. But who killed Sharon Birchwood? Detectives follow a trail to Thailand in one of the most bizarre murder cases in recent memory.

name: Surgery Secrets of the Super Rich
summary: With privileged access to elite clinics in London and Manchester, this series follows world-renowned doctors delivering bespoke, undetectable results for high-net-worth clients, revealing pioneering treatments and eye-watering price tags.

name: 9 месяцев
summary: 9 месяцев is a new pregnancy show that will be with you every step of the way: from the first two lines to the long-awaited meeting with your baby.

name: Лето Победы
summary: The spring of 1945 brought the Soviet people a great victory, but World War II was not yet over. Japan continued its fierce resistance, and soon a new war—the Cold War—began. In this film, you'll see how the USSR's former allies literally transformed before our eyes into what they have now become for Russia—geopolitical adversaries. We'll take a look behind the scenes of high-stakes diplomacy and recount the Red Army's brilliant operation to defeat Japan. And we'll celebrate the 80th anniversary of the Great Victory in World War II.

name: Heartbreak Island Australia
summary: Heartbreak Island's global cast jet into Fiji and sparks fly as sixteen singles pair up. Competing to be with the one they really want and $100,000 for the winning couple.

name: The 700 Club Israel
summary: Hosted by Gordon Robertson, brings you weekly news, devotionals, interviews, and inspiring stories from the Holy Land. Discover what God is doing through CBN Israel and hear powerful testimonies of hope, faith, and humanitarian impact.

name: 20.000 leguas de viaje submarino
summary: Diego, his friends and Admiral Nemo try to save the ocean while facing great dangers.

name: Transcendence
summary: Stress, overwhelm, depression, anxiety, autoimmune disease, obesity, suicide, cancer, a midlife crisis, wondering what direction to take in your life? These are some of the biggest challenges of our time. What if you could have everything you ever imagined? What if the life of your dreams was already available? Come on a journey to discover the secrets to living a happy and purposeful life. Learn from the world's best on how you can achieve everything you've ever wanted, using what you already have. In this 5-part docu-series you'll hear from some of the world's most recognized doctors, high-p

name: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God 10th Anniversary
Miracle Living Today
summary: The hosts shed light on the testimonials of various people on the experiences of supernatural help and divine interventions in their life.

name: Trafic
summary: An ordinary father in Bucharest is forced into a world he never wanted to be part of in order to save his son. But the deeper he gets, the more he realizes that the greatest danger comes from where he least expects it. A crime drama about family, sacrifice, and choices from which there is no turning back.

name: Jan Serce
summary: A sensitive idealist, a noble and righteous man, he dreams of a true, great love. Despite turning 40, he is still looking for 'the one'. Before fate unexpectedly turns out to be favourable, he experiences various emotional adversities. Reflective story of the unchanging human longing for goodness and honesty.

name: Doña Bella
summary: A poor woman falls for a rich man but faces obstacles due to class differences. She's abducted by a powerful businessman who desires her, leading to heartbreak and revenge against those who wronged her.

name: El elegido
summary: El elegido tells the story of Andrés Bilbao, an ambitious lawyer married to Verónica San Martín, with whom he has an autistic daughter named Alma Bilbao. Coming from a humble background, Andrés is a professional who aspires to become a partner alongside Oscar Nevares Sosa at the law firm where he works.

name: ZDFzeit
summary: From politics and the world of royalty to consumer protection: these high-end documentaries offer space for all the topics of our time. Sometimes insightful, sometimes feel-good, never boring.

name: Chaofan Jinhua
summary: The story follows young Ming He, whose "junk superpower" mutates into a special entity called the "Dependent Spirit" after colliding with the "Goddess" meteorite, triggering a series of adventures and crises.

name: Double Lives of Suburban Wives
summary: Double Lives of Suburban Wives follows six couples in the St. Louis area whose everyday routines from carpools and cul-de-sacs to church and community gatherings coexist with a second, more private side of their lives. Beneath the polished façade, they've built lucrative and unconventional second lives, forging an unexpected bond rooted in navigating lives that many people would never expect.

name: Cocktail Wars
summary: In a series of themed challenges, Cocktail Wars pits America's buzziest mixologists against each other in a lively, high-stakes competition with $10,000 on the line in every episode. Each installment showcases a fast, fiery battle of skill, creativity, humor, and flair. From playful flavor combinations to eye-catching technique, the focus is on having a good time, taking risks, and serving up drinks with personality. Each shake, stir, and splash could be the winning touch or the one that sends them home. It's a cocktail competition where the vibes are high, the drinks are strong, and the bragg

name: Shifter
summary: Shifter is set in the near-future, where a banned cosmetic procedure lets people change their faces on the fly, creating a new underground industry of Shifters, who can become anyone you want, for any purpose you can imagine, for a fee. Rose is making a name for herself as one of the best, but the more she gives to her gigs, the more she risks losing herself.

name: Connecting to You
summary: Chia-kai possesses the unique ability to see the ""connections"" between people: red for love, green for family, and blue for hostility. Yet, he himself is constantly threadless—until he meets Ta-wei, a skeptical detective. Between them, a mysterious silver thread appears, which makes Chia-kai determined to uncover the meaning of this unprecedented bond. As their lives intertwine, the silver thread begins to shift colors, forcing them to confront feelings they can no longer ignore. Adapted from a hit Taiwanese BL novel, Bruce Chiu and Liu Yu-ren form an irresistible paranormal crime-solving du

name: The Loyalty Game
summary: A group of women runs a unique business: luring men to expose their infidelity. Their newest client, Ana, lives a seemingly perfect life with her devoted husband-until doubt creeps in. As he starts to distort her reality, Ana teams up with a loyalty tester, and their search for truth spirals into a dangerous game of secrets, manipulation, and power-where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

name: Dessert Person with Claire Saffitz
summary: Claire Saffitz is a dessert person. She likes cakes and cookies and pies and believes that no meal is complete without something sweet at the end. In her recently published book, "Dessert Person," Claire celebrates and defends her love of desserts and empowers reluctant home bakers to work with new ingredients, attempt new techniques, and bake with more confidence. Join Claire in her home kitchen as she highlights recipes from the book in this new baking series to help you take your baking skills to the next level.

name: Виталя
summary: Vitalina has been a district police officer for many years and is accustomed to devoting far more energy and time to her job than to her own family. But the day after their thirtieth wedding anniversary, her husband, scientist and professor Anatoliy Rozanov, unexpectedly decides to leave her for his eighteen-year-old secretary, Sveta, who is also expecting his child. Anatoliy explains his unseemly act as revenge. He took paternity tests and discovered that only two of their three adult children are truly his. This means his wife was the one who started cheating on him first. Vitalina decides t

name: Время для двоих
summary: 1991. A group of tenth-graders goes to Moscow. There, one of the students, Alena, meets a boy, Mitya, who leaves her his address and phone number. But Alena loses the note. 2010. Dmitry Platonov, editor-in-chief and one of the co-founders of a large, successful Moscow publishing house, goes on a business trip to N-sk. There, many business events await him, including an interview for a local newspaper. The journalist turns out to be that very Alena. Dmitry doesn't recognize her: the 16-year-old girl has become a beautiful woman. She has loved him all these years and recognizes him immediately,

name: Samantha
summary: Samantha is a 1998 Venezuelan telenovela produced by Venevisión. The story follows Samantha, a free-spirited country girl who saves a wealthy playboy, Luis Alberto, from a plane crash. They fall in love, but their romance is threatened by dangerous family secrets, ruthless rivals, and Luis Alberto's memory loss.

name: Mi querida Isabel
summary: Mi querida Isabel is a Mexican telenovela that centers on Isabel Rivas, a simple, beautiful and happy young girl and a dedicated law student who supports her dysfunctional family following the presumed death of her mother two decades earlier. Her family is noble and affectionate but her father hides his addiction to the alcohol and the truth about the mother of Isabel and Marcos, who is alive and unjustly put in jail. Her younger brother Marcos pursues a rebellious lifestyle focused on music and easy money. While working as a waitress in the university, Isabel meets a nice guy, Juan Daniel. A

name: Araw Gabi
summary: It is a tale of how love can bring light and gloom in a person's life and how a deep, dark secret can make or break the blooming relationship between Michelle and Adrian. Michelle is a girl with a bright and sunny disposition. Despite the hardships in life, she managed to get by because her Mamay and Papay taught her always to see the good in every situation. She has her eyes set on bagging the Tranquila Resort account because it will boost her career. Adrian's life, on the other hand, is full of darkness. He is the CEO of the Olvidar Group of Companies, of which Tranquila Resort, a vacation s

name: Cuando hay pasión
summary: Inés and Luis Guillermo... Marisela and Diego Andrés... Two love stories unfolding against the backdrop of a fierce struggle between two prominent families: the Núñez and the Malavés.

name: I Left My Heart in Sorsogon
summary: I Left My Heart in Sorsogon is a romance-drama story about Celeste, a young woman from Sorsogon who has reinvented herself in Manila as a fashion designer and socialite. Celeste is successful on both the personal and professional front. Their only inheritance is a legacy of two-bit crime that inspires them to run increasingly audacious frauds. As their con grows, so does their odd-couple bond, as they each start to fill the father-shaped hole in the other's heart.

Behind Bars: Officer Cam

Through raw, first-hand footage, the series reveals what it takes to run a modern American jail. Once viewed primarily as tools of oversight, bodycams have become catalysts for change—driving smarter training, stronger decision-making, and safer outcomes for officers and inmates alike.

name: Super Market

Reborn on her wedding day, she pretends to be foolish to uncover the truth, joining forces with Prince Yu, Mu Yunzheng, to clear the injustice, defeat the Empress and the Fourth Prince, and eventually live in seclusion together.

Ágata possesses an exceptional memory and a unique talent for analyzing criminal files, while Lola brings intuition, field experience, and empathy for victims.
