Enjoy this slapstick comedy about a slightly strange parent-child pair!

name: The Lenticulars
summary: Here's my classmates Uta Aihara, Moripura-kun, and friends, who shared joys and sorrows with me during my trainee days, so please do check it out!! A natural, heart-fluttering youth story... but there are intriguing elements everywhere!

name: Ömür Usta
summary: Ömür is a strong woman who lost her youth when she was forced to marry at fifteen, only to be abandoned with three children. Determined to rebuild her life, she starts her own business and earns respect in her neighborhood as "Ömür the Mechanic." While raising her family with dignity, her children face their own secrets: her eldest son raises his child alone while battling a gambling addiction; her daughter hides an unplanned pregnancy after a painful betrayal; and her youngest, a promising medical student, hides his family's poverty to date a wealthy girl. When Ömür reconnects with a childhoo

name: Aşk ve Taht
summary: Set to create a brand-new and magnificent narrative universe through its set design, storyline, and rich cast of characters, the production will bring to the screen a grand love story that has never before been told in history.

name: Earle Meets World
summary: Candid, chaotic and still getting started, influencer Alix Earle navigates breakups, best friends and a unique blended family in this reality series.

name: On Campus: Game of the Week
summary: Every week at a different school, go inside campus life with real college students from the lead-up to the aftermath of college football's biggest games.

name: Charlie & Co.
summary: Follows the Richmond family, headed by dad Charlie, a blue-collar worker, and his wife Diana.

name: Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles
summary: Everyone's favorite ninja turtles, Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey, are back! Set in their childhood years, this original series explores the early days of the iconic ninja turtles on their first adventures as ninjas-in-training. They'll even be joined by their friend April O'Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai.

name: Wolven: een spel van list en bedrog
summary: Thirteen specialists play a psychological game in a remote village, centered on observation, intuition, and deception. Each player is assigned a role: ten of them become Citizen and three a Wolf. But no one knows the roles. Every glance, remark, and choice is a potential clue. As the first suspicions arise, everyone tries to discover who is telling the truth and who is playing a double game. As night falls, it becomes clear that the game has begun.

name: Семейный очаг
summary: The series is about the life of three generations of a modern Russian family. The events unfold against the background of the relationship of journalist Anastasia Davydova, who hosts the radio talk show "Family hearth", her husband-playwright Andrey, their daughter-a high school student Yulia and an elderly father, a former officer Pavel Ivanovich.

name: Dziewczyna i chłopak
summary: Adventures of two tweens - Tosia and Tomek.

name: Celebrity Cooking Showdown
summary: Hosted by Alan Thicke, Celebrity Cooking Showdown is a 2006 reality television mini-series where pop culture stars team up with world-class chefs for an adrenaline-fueled culinary boot camp and real-time cooking competition.

name: Celebrity Exposé
summary: Celebrity Exposé is a weekly news television series that delivers in-depth profiles, behind-the-headlines looks, and investigative stories on major celebrity newsmakers and Hollywood culture.

name: Sotto copertura
summary: Michele Romano is the head of the Mobile Squad of Naples, a ward of men in the service of the State in a world infested with crime. After capturing the boss of the Casalesi Antonio Iovine, called "'o Ninno", Romano and his Team return to work to cut the second head of the Casalesi, that of Michele Zagaria.

name: Children's Hospital
summary: Children's Hospital follows the dramatic, fast-paced, and emotional daily lives of the doctors, nurses, and young patients navigating a busy pediatric ward.

name: Le Mystère de la Chambre Jaune
summary: Jo, a young journalist, is shocked to learn that an attempted murder has taken place in her native village of L'Artuby, nestled in the Verdon Gorge. She is devastated to discover that the victim is none other than Mathilde—a close childhood friend—who has been in a coma since the attack. The circumstances of the incident are particularly intriguing: when villagers, alerted by screams, managed to enter the victim's room, she was alone inside.

name: The Silk Road
summary: The Silk Road is a documentary television series produced by NHK that was first broadcast during the 1980s. The travelogue traced the ancient Silk Road from Chang'an (modern day Xi'an) to Rome covering the history, archaeology, culture, religion, and art of countries along the route. It took a total of 17 years from conception to complete what many considered a landmark in Japan's broadcast television history.

name: The Charlie Farrell Show
summary: The Charlie Farrell Show follows a semi-fictionalized version of a retired film star who runs the prestigious Palm Springs Racquet Club in California

name: Бесы
summary: the series follows Pyotr Verkhovensky, the leader of a revolutionary cell who attempts to recruit Nikolai Stavrogin and other young people into the revolutionary movement. To bind the cell he has created together, he plots the murder of former student Ivan Shatov, who is about to break with the revolutionaries .

name: I Am The Only God
summary: In the vast land of China, the gods who were in charge of the laws of heaven and earth died and lost their legal boundaries. The forces of darkness will move, trying to overthrow the entire land. Ning Chen was an ordinary guard in the Canglan palace. He gained the power of swallowing spirits by accident and increased his cultivation level. Initially, he was able to compensate for this. However, the crisis began . First, the royal cronies betray each other. The imperial leaders turned to each other. In the face of many hardships, Ning Chen adhered to the principle of doing things as much as his

name: Pound Pups To Dog Stars
summary: Pound Pups To Dog Stars follows the rescue work of Auckland animal behaviour expert Mark Vette and his talented trainers at 'Animals on Q'. Dealing with dogs of all shapes, breeds, and sizes, Mark works with the SPCA, animal control officers and foster carers to learn the back stories of each rescue dog and how they came to be mistreated, abandoned or surrendered. Devising rehab and retraining plans for each pooch, Mark and his team embark on potentially life saving journies to try to turn the Pound Pups' lives around.

name: Gekkan! Nanmono Anime
summary: A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.

name: Відважна дівчина
summary: 25-year-old Yevheniia Marchuk is one of the best operatives of the Kyiv police, who is accustomed to confidently even for difficult cases. But after the unsuccessful detention of her career is under threat of reprimand. The only chance to rectify the situation is a new task - this time to work undercover. Stolen jewels from France, Italy and Germany unexpectedly appear on the territory of the former USSR, and their trace leads to Odessa. Here the investigation is attracted by the store of antiques and art objects of Andriy Nikolayenko, the godfather of the Deputy Minister of Internal Affairs.

name: Prissana
summary: Prissana takes place in 1938 in Phra Nakhon, Thailand, during a time when men and women were not equals. Marriage for women meant security, not love. Prissana is the youngest daughter of four girls and was the only one raised in America by their uncle. She is outgoing, cheerful, and pretty, but at the same time, she is also headstrong, intelligent, and opinionated. She returns to Thailand after living in Americafor 12 years and is once again reunited with her family. Prissana, whose name means "mystery, a puzzle/riddle," causes quite a stir in Thailand with her open, American behavior and refr

name: Две стороны одной страны
summary: Two hosts head to a new country: one enjoys a lavish, high-end vacation, while the other gets by on the bare minimum.

name: A Killer Story
summary: A Killer Story examines a polarizing murder case that spanned more than two decades and captured national attention. At the center of the case is Dana Chandler, who was accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend in 2002.

name: The Assignment with Antonia Hylton
summary: The Assignment with Antonia Hylton will bring Hylton's thoughtful, deeply reported journalism to MS NOW's audience every weekend. Based in New York, The Assignment with Antonia Hylton will serve as destination viewing for the latest political and cultural headlines, informative discussions and fresh insights from top lawmakers and changemakers. Centered around Hylton's award-winning field reporting and rooted in her signature curiosity and accountability, the program will aim to help audiences better understand not only the latest headlines, but also the broader context behind them, while invi

name: The Last Oath
summary: A zombie virus sweeps across the globe, and Lin Zai tragically discovers he carries an immunity, making him targeted by multiple factions. A-Leh, a cold-blooded assassin, is ordered to hunt him down, but when he is critically wounded, Lin Zai saves his life, and the two end up bound to each-other in a post-apocalyptic world.

name: Destino de Mujer
summary: Mariana Oropeza's life changes when she meets the young and arrogant Victor Manuel Santana, whose plans for revenge against Mariana's family lead him into unforeseen situations.

name: The Life and Crimes of William Palmer
summary: Keith Allen plays William Palmer in this true story of a Victorian-era English surgeon who uses poison to settle scores and ward off debt. William lacks a sense of regret, even after killing his wife, brother and three of his own children.

name: Komi Can't Communicate
summary: It's Komi Shouko's first day at the prestigious Itan Private High School, and she has already risen to the status of the school's Madonna. With long black hair and a tall, graceful appearance, she captures the attention of anyone who comes across her. There's just one problem though—despite her popularity, Shouko is terrible at communicating with others. Tadano Hitohito is your average high school boy. With his life motto of "read the situation and make sure to stay away from trouble," he quickly finds that sitting next to Shouko has made him the enemy of everyone in his class! One day, knocke

name: Wild Tales
summary: Wild Tales is a children's wildlife documentary series broadcast on CBBC that follows young animals as they grow up, learn vital survival skills, and navigate the challenges of the natural world.

name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
summary: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.
previous_episode: The Fall of the House of Adelson

name: Eigyou Desukara
summary: In order to be pampered by girls, Ren has been "Selling BL" (fanservice) by flirting with Issei, a handsome guy who attends the same college. But one day, Ren is suddenly kissed by Issei?! A fascinating love comedy that begins with a lie.

name: Başkalarının Hayatı
summary: With its story full of love, ambition, and intrigue, the series, which is set to break the mold in the new season, focuses on the dangerous test faced by a young woman who envies the lives of others.

name: Ой, мамочки
summary: The most anxiety‑relieving show about motherhood! Why it's important not to be an ideal mom, but a real one. Olya Parfenyuk, Karina Meikhanadzhyan and Maria Kravchenko will discuss the fears associated with motherhood. Together with celebrity guests — mothers themselves and those whose relatives still bombard them with questions like "so when?" — they will share their experiences, tell jokes, discuss the topic and answer the audience's questions. As usual, humour will save us, and the mums will support us!

name: Noos - L'avventura della conoscenza
summary: Noos takes the place historically occupied by Piero Angela's "Superquark". The main topic remains the same as its predecessor's, with services exploring the latest scientific discoveries in a wide array of topics: medicine, genetics, neuroscience, biology, archaeology, paleontology, and more. Moreover, it also highlights important innovations in both the energy and environment fields.

name: Superquark
summary: Superquark is a long-running Italian television program created by Piero Angela that brings science, history, nature, and technology to viewers through detailed documentaries and expert segments.

name: Head On Comedy with Jo Brand
summary: Comedy panel debate hosted by Jo Brand, in which teams captained by Bill Bailey and Ed Byrne put forward their views.

name: Phoenix Sleuth
summary: In the early years of the Republic of China, a bizarre police death case and a high-profile wealthy merchant murder case made headlines across all newspapers, with the perpetrator's identity shrouded in total mystery. No police officers could make any headway in the investigation. The victim's fiancée, Jiang Siyao, a once-famous teen detective who had retired for years, teamed up with her best friend Huo Yining, a policewoman, to track down the killers of her fiancé and father. With the help of Ye Shi'an, a wealthy young heir hiding his real identity, the three went through countless dangers a

name: The Long Race
summary: Tycoon Gao Sheng has long monopolized motorcycle racing events, reaping huge profits through rigged gambling rings and shady gray-area deals. Three years ago, he secretly tampered with Lin Ye's racing car. Chen Mo spotted the vehicle abnormality right before the race, but with no time for full troubleshooting, he insisted on swapping cars with Lin Ye to protect his partner, only to end up severely disabled and forced to retire from the racing circle. The two have since cooperated covertly, one operating in the open and the other in the shadows, biding their time and quietly collecting evidence

name: The Fixers
summary: Christopher Lee and Shou Lou star as a mismatched pair of fixers for the rich and powerful, but a mysterious rival throws their mission into disarray.

name: Minerva - La scuola
summary: Minerva - La scuola is a teen drama series set in a military high school in Naples. It is a world that seems to belong to another era, where students are woken up at dawn for the flag-raising ceremony, where mobile phones and civilian clothes are not allowed, and where subjects include military tactics and fencing lessons. It is a world where love stories are forbidden and every mistake comes at a very high price.

name: Married in a Flash
summary: Country girl Lin Kexin enters an arranged flash marriage with a stranger, Gu Juncen, believing him to be an ordinary worker. Unbeknownst to her, he is actually a billionaire CEO hiding his true identity. Throughout their marriage, she faces workplace challenges and schemes, with Gu Jun always stepping in to protect her fiercely. As the truth about her real identity as a wealthy heiress comes to light, the schemes of her malicious stepmother and the impostor heiress are exposed. Lin Kexin rises as the true heiress and leader of the corporation, ultimately finding happiness with Gu Juncen.

name: Güneşin Doğduğu Yer
summary: The story revolves around the life of Kenan, the son of the Kozan family—one of Çukurova's long-established families—and how his life changes after he meets the love of his life. The story begins in Germany and continues in the world of Adana, woven with strong family ties.

name: Frust
summary: Vedran is a frustrated yet ambitious young writer, constantly struggling for attention and recognition. When he accidentally kills a drug dealer who has been terrorizing his neighborhood, he is hailed as a vigilante justice-seeker and becomes an overnight local celebrity - even though his true identity remains hidden. Realizing that it takes only one person to spark a revolution, he makes a choice that changes his life forever...

name: No More Pretense: Mr. Huo's Daily Desire for Reconciliation
summary: Bai Luo An and CEO Huo Ling end their five-year marriage, with Bai Luo An leaving a letter behind. The story follows their complicated past and the misunderstandings that shaped their relationship. As they move forward separately, both face challenges, personal growth, and the ups and downs of love, loyalty, and emotional connection.

name: The Repair Shop: Beyond the Barn
summary: The Repair Shop experts visit some of the people who have been reunited with cherished mementos.

name: Truth Under The Wheel
summary: Li Xing Chen, a former criminal investigator now working as a traffic police officer, takes on a mysterious hit-and-run case on a rainy night. Entrepreneur Gao Yu Hai is killed in the crash, but the scene has already been tampered with by someone posing as a traffic officer, erasing crucial evidence. A special task force is formed, with Li Xing Chen leading the investigation. The driver, Shen Xi, appears to have no connection to the victim, but as the investigation deepens, Li Xing Chen uncovers layer after layer of lies. Just as the case is about to be ruled a traffic accident, Xiao Ze is fou

name: 9/11: Days That Shocked the World
summary: Rescue workers, survivors and witnesses relive the traumatic events of the September 11 terror attacks. Some tell their story for the first time, of how a regular morning turned into a nightmare.

name: Love Express
summary: Yun Qingqing's life falls apart in an instant. Hoping to find a decent place to quietly end it all, she is instead tricked into becoming the acting manager of a guesthouse. Before she can make sense of her new life, she finds herself chased by debt collectors and caught in the sights of Shen Feng, the owner of a local tea plantation. To her surprise, Shen Feng turns out to be the online boyfriend she ghosted years ago. Amid the chaos and unexpected encounters of everyday life, Yun Qingqing gradually heals and rediscovers the courage to love—and to let herself be loved.

name: Into the Carpathian Wild
summary: European wildlife is threatened like never before, but in the Carpathian Mountains it has found its last great refuge. Home to Europe's most extensive primeval forests and the continent's largest populations of bears, wolves and lynx, the Carpathians are a stronghold of biodiversity. Follow the lives of this remarkable wildlife over the course of a year to reveal how each species is connected to the wider ecosystem. Together, they sustain a landscape that protects biodiversity, stores carbon and safeguards life-giving water, making the Carpathians one of Europe's most vital natural treasures.

name: Boy, with Caution
summary: Jang Gi U is a 32-year-old temporary high school teacher. Four years ago, he became the subject of an inappropriate rumor involving a student. As a result, he never took the teacher certification examination and has instead spent the years moving from one contract teaching position to another. Raised in a single-mother household, he grew up constantly hearing that he had to be someone with "no flaws in the eyes of others." He lives as a person who appears flawless, but his life feels dull and unremarkable. At least, that is what everyone says.

name: The Mechanical Dragon City
summary: Two thousand years ago, the Mohist school split into two factions: Chu Mo and Qin Mo. Qin Chen, the leader of Qin Mo, instigated a great war to seize the treasure, the Heavenly Mirror. After their defeat, Chu Mo hid in the world and spent a hundred years building the Mechanical Dragon City to protect the treasure. Two thousand years later, Shen Tuo, a descendant of Chu Mo, ventures into the perilous Mechanical Dragon City with his friends to save his cursed daughter, Shen Ning, and find his missing girlfriend Jiang Mingyue. Along the way, he uncovers Qin Mo's puppets and traitors, ultimately c

name: Подслушано в Выборге
summary: Rybinsk is out, Vyborg is in, and instead of a visionary journalist, we have an ordinary postman. Modest 30-year-old Vitalik Tyunin lives with his mother and spends his days delivering mail across the city. Everything changes when he becomes an unwelcome witness to a crime. This absurd twist of fate sets off a chain of events that will keep Vyborg wide awake—a city where Zoya and Bayan, having arrived from Rybinsk on personal business, suddenly find themselves caught in the middle.

name: Невесомая жизнь
summary: What does a modern cartoon character look like? On the search for a universal formula for creating the perfect cartoon character.

name: Prelude of the White Snake
summary: Bai Suzhen has cultivated for five hundred years and is poised to become an immortal, yet an unfinished love tribulation robs her of an important memory. Commanded by the gods, she goes down to the mortal world to seek out Xu Xian and repay his kindness. Along with Xiaoqing, she steps into the human world and crosses paths with Xu Xian, a demon hunter haunted by his family's massacre, and Fahai, a disciple of Jinshan. Together, the four embark on a journey bound by fate.

name: Colisión
summary: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.

name: Merry Berry Love
summary: A love story takes place on an Charo Island in Japan between South Korean Lee Yoo-Bin and Japanese Karin Shirahama. Lee Yoo-Bin failed big as a space planner in South Korea, while Karin Shirahama is a berry farmer, who suffers from an unknown illness.

name: Habilidad física 100: México
summary: Taqueros, cops and CrossFit champs haul massive weights, battle in hand-to-hand combat and conquer relentless physical trials for a juicy cash prize.

name: Bo! in the USA
summary: Leigh Francis reprises his role of Avid Merrion and along with Barunka O'Shaughnessy, as his wife and sister Sacha, opens a hotel in L.A. full of celebrities, including past favourites Craig David and George Michael.

name: The Prize Wall
summary: Three players take on increasingly hard rounds of trivia to compete to win amazing prizes from Brat TV Studios' The Prize Wall.
previous_episode: Mason Wong, Alexander Wong, and Harrison Wong

name: Love is Blind: Nederland
summary: Nicolette van Dam and Bas Smit host this social experiment where Dutch singles date and get engaged sight unseen to discover whether love truly is blind.

name: Your Majesty, Are We in Love Yet?
summary: Chu Yunshu and Emperor Xiao Jingheng seem like a model couple, all courtesy and no passion. A cute system warns her: boost their happiness score or face the Cold Palace! She awkwardly woos him, unaware he's already smitten. Together, they defy the Empress Dowager, dodge assassins, and confess their love—earning their happily ever after a perfect score!

name: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
summary: College student Kurumi Fukuga finally makes her long-awaited debut in FX (foreign exchange margin trading). Her reason? To recoup the 20 million yen her late mother lost in FX. "I'll easily get 20 million yen back!" she vows, but the world she plunges into is one where heaven or hell can be turned upside down in an instant. Unrealized losses, stop-loss orders, a heart that won't stop beating... Yet she still wants to buy, sell, and make money! With the addition of Yasuko and other eccentric FX warriors, the market heats up even more! A cute yet slightly (!!) dangerous money game where they flu

name: No.9 Hunter
summary: Since time immemorial, the Sky Rift has unleashed demonic chaos upon the mortal world. Shangguan Ziyan, a young demoness, and Yuanchu, a Taoist priest, are brought together by fate. As the two No.9 Hunters, they set out on a journey to mend the heavens. Ziyan is afflicted with the Stone Curse, which constantly reverses her yin and yang, shifting her between male and female. Yuanchu, meanwhile, is bound by a cruel fate: whom he loves shall perish. Through all their encounters with humans and demons alike, they come to realize that only their love can serve as the thread to patch the sky and sav

name: Abyssal Sentience
summary: In 1965, a drilling accident in the Arihundi Gobi Desert led to the mysterious disappearance of prospector Chu Hanwen. Twenty years later, the Lenghu Oilfield received a mysterious signal from the abyss, reviving a long-forgotten case. Beneath the Gobi Desert lies an unknown life form called Hundi, capable of parasitizing humans, causing mutations, and establishing an underground network sharing consciousness. Chu Nanfei, Liang Yihan, Zhou Fanghua, and others venture into the perilous Gobi abyss, confronting both infected mutants and the ambitious "Natural Science Society" while facing familia

name: Fragments of Truth
summary: Orphaned at a young age, Han Ning loses his sister in a bizarre kidnapping case. Determined to seek justice, he becomes a detective, using his natural profiling talent to catch criminals. When a strange murder takes place, it triggers a chain of subsequent homicides, and every single case is somehow tied to the unsolved disappearance of Han Ning's sister seven years ago...

name: Rutger en de buitenlanders
summary: Rutger Castricum investigates the story behind a word that is increasingly central to the social debate. At a time when 'the foreigner' is often designated as the cause of problems in the Netherlands, he speaks to twelve people who came here for various reasons. From refugees and migrant workers to people who have lived here for years and newcomers who are still looking for their place. In candid conversations, Rutger asks critical questions, searches for the man behind the label and shows that reality is often more nuanced than the debate suggests.

name: Big Day with Peter Schrager
summary: Big Day with Peter Schrager will originate from New York City and cover the biggest stories from across the sports world each day, blending reporting, interviews, unique perspectives and authentic conversations with the athletes, coaches, executives and personalities driving the day's biggest headlines. While fans can expect Schrager's trademark NFL insight and relationships, Big Day is built to celebrate the full sports landscape and the moments everyone will be talking about.

name: Sandi's Ireland: A Literary Journey
summary: Sandi Toksvig treads in the footsteps of Ireland's literary greats, to find out how an island so modest in size and population has produced one of the world's greatest literary cultures.

name: Run from Me if You Can
summary: Hui Won, an ER nurse, transfuses her own blood to save Tae Yeong, a mob boss who arrives with a gunshot wound — only to discover his deadly secret: hemophilia. On the day of her wedding, her fiancé's betrayal leaves her with nothing. Tae Yeong hands her a contract: be his fake wife for one year. With 3 billion won and her father's medical bills on the line, Hui Won is locked away in his mansion. She pushes back against his cold obsession and control, but slowly uncovers the loneliness and warmth hidden beneath his ruthless exterior — and the more she tries to escape, the deeper she falls.

name: Live From The Lycett Arms
summary: Joe Lycett presents comedy, celebrity chat and chaos from his own pub, open for only one hour a week on a Friday night, with a guest manager on hand to keep things ticking over as well as guests from the world of comedy, star-studded punters and other regulars.

name: Strawberry Shortcake's Bake Shop
summary: Strawberry's cozy neighborhood bakery is officially open, and her Berry Besties are always popping by. Sometimes they're lending a helping hand, sometimes they're hungry customers and sometimes they're just swinging by for a snack and some fun together. Whether she's whipping up desserts in her homey kitchen and bake shop, hosting friends in her snug upstairs apartment or throwing a sunshiney garden party out front, Strawberry brings the sweet warmth of a baked treat into every moment … and she's always ready for whatever friend stops by next.

name: The Cheetah Girls
summary: Four teens face the challenges of growing up as they sing and dance their way toward an elusive record deal as a girl group.

name: The Cut
summary: Rags-to-riches style icon Tommy Hilfiger hosts The Cut, the search for America's next top fashion designer. 16 style-savvy contestants compete for the opportunity to design their own collection under the Tommy Hilfiger label. The contestants must complete a series of tasks that showcase their design and business skills to prove they have what it takes to make the cut in the fashion world.
previous_episode: The Newest Designer for Tommy Hilfiger Is ...

name: Single In Marriage
summary: The world of housewife Fan Juan collapses when her husband suggests a ridiculous trade: an affair for the family's interests. Pressured by reality, she submits in humiliation, but gets only emotional cruelty and double deceit. Just when she loses all hope, two unexpected allies emerge, and together the three set out for sweet revenge. In the end, from the wreckage of her life, Fan Juan rebuilds her career and dignity, and finds a heartfelt love ten years overdue.

name: Jagamae Sangeetham
summary: A young Carnatic prodigy carries the weight of his grandfather's name and his family's survival. As financial pressure mounts and a long-buried family conflict resurfaces through his uncle Thyagaraju, Balu is pushed to question everything he's been trained to honor. An unexpected creative partnership forces him to see his tradition, and his family, in a new light.

name: Sweet Deceit
summary: Sweet Deceit challenges teams of three competitors to search for deceptive, hyper-realistic sweets hiding in plain sight in real-world locations. Actor Josh Peck, who hilariously commands the on-screen hijinks as he leads contestants through four rounds as they try to identify masterfully disguised sweets created by world-class cake artists. Escalating in difficulty round by round, the teams work together to determine what is cake and prove it with their teeth by biting into their best guess, all in pursuit of a total prize up to $12,000.

name: La maison des bois
summary: Realistic chronicle of everyday life during the Great War. A ranger collects in his family several Parisian children refugees because of the conflict. All share the life of the country village, the school, the news from the front.

name: Basta
summary: Marco van Basten evolves from a quintessentially Dutch boy with a big soccer dream into a global phenomenon. We follow his journey from the youth fields to Ajax under the guidance of Johan Cruijff, and then on to his glory days at AC Milan. One of the absolute highlights is his wonder goal at the European Championship. But success comes at a price. How far will Van Basten go to fulfill his childhood dream?

name: Limited Time Offer
summary: Limited Time Offer is an arched competition show where 10 pop-culture food junkies compete every week to create iconic brands, with the winning product available to the public the day after the episode airs.

name: Профессиональ­ный сосед
summary: One mistake in the documents for the apartment turns the life of the Malyutin family upside down - thanks to her, the apartment raider Baev appears in their house, who gets the right to use a share in real estate and begins to survive the owners of the only housing. Strictly within the law, but far beyond the bounds of humanity. Now Malyutin has to find out whether it is possible to defeat a professional neighbor on his own territory and which will be stronger: Baev's legal savvy or a family with nowhere else to go.

name: Nine to Five - Das Amt
summary: In the Berlin-Tiergarten-Mitte-West citizens' office, bureaucratic chaos collides with career ambitions: The new boss, Ronja, causes unrest with her attempts at optimization, while Conny keeps the place running smoothly. Amidst bureaucracy, office squabbles, and personal entanglements, everyday life at the office escalates in a wonderfully absurd way.

name: Mammoth
summary: Mammoth follows Coach Tony Mammoth, a larger-than-life high school gym teacher whose life is put on ice in 1983, when he's buried in a freak ski avalanche. Forty years later, he thaws out to a world that has completely changed... but he's convinced it really didn't need to. Still clinging to life in the '80s - complete with his Burt Reynolds moustache and treasured Trans-AM -- Mammoth returns to the job he loves, only to discover that today's rules, relationships, and realities bear little resemblance to the world he once knew.

name: Imperio de cristal
summary: Imperio de cristal centers on Sofía Vidal, whose life changes completely after attending a party at the mansion of the wealthy Lombardos—owners of a crystal factory—thereby unleashing dark secrets, family ambition, and the intrigues of Livia, the matriarch.

name: Wunderschön!

One day, a detective who had handled the investigation in Nakahara's past case visits him and tells him that Nakahara's ex-wife has been murdered on the street. The culprit is quickly arrested, but there are many inexplicable points in his testimony. Nakahara retraces his ex-

name: A Suitable Match
summary: To escape an unwanted family arrangement, a sharp-witted career woman enters a contract marriage with a high-powered executive—unaware that her new "husband" has secretly orchestrated the entire match to win her heart.

name: There Is Also a Hole in the Student Organization!
summary: Ume Mizunoe, a first-year student at the prestigious Fujinari Academy, excels in Japanese literature but struggles so badly in science that his chances of advancing are at risk. Hoping to boost his academic record, he joins the student council—only to find himself surrounded by a cast of quirky characters: a charismatic yet secretly shy president, a kind but intimidating treasurer, an adorably cheeky boy, and a tiny, stray-cat-like secretary. Thrown into a whirlwind of chaotic daily life, Ume's school days are about to get a lot more unpredictable—and a lot more lively!
previous_episode: A Day in Satomi's Life / Cleanup Duty and Boobs / Get Well Soon! / Ume's Playboy Allegations / Tan's Scheme / Cold Alone, Warm Together

name: Undercover Lover
summary: 14 seemingly single men and women arrive at a stunning villa, but 5 are secretly in relationships. From a second villa, their partners watch as they try to keep their romance hidden. When sparks fly from the start, jealousy and distrust quickly create tension.

name: I Hunt Wraiths in Mortal Realm
As Promised
summary: He Xiaoyuan, an ordinary palace maid, has been trapped in a cycle of rebirth for thirty-three lifetimes. In every life, she does everything she can to win the heart of Crown Prince Zhao Junyao, only for him to fall for the courtesan Mu Tingting and for her life to end in a palace coup. In her thirty-fourth life, Seventh Prince Zhao Baiqing reveals that their fates are bound together. The cycle can only be broken if he ascends the throne and He Xiaoyuan wins the Crown Prince's true love. To achieve their shared goal, the two form an alliance, with Zhao Baiqing personally coaching He Xiaoyuan on

name: A Secret in Prague
summary: The series follows Mikoy, an ordinary guy who falls for a mafia boss' daughter, forcing him to choose between protecting his own family or betraying the woman he loves.

name: Potje Rijden: Kirgizië
summary: Sean and Stefan go head-to-head in a race across the harsh and unforgiving landscapes of Kyrgyzstan. The race kicks off, and both teams discover the cultural differences between themselves and the locals of Kyrgyzstan.

name: Frank's Veiling: Influencers Onder De Hamer
summary: Frank van der Slot welcomes influencers to his reverse auction. He offers hilarious and merciless challenges where participants don't spend money, but can actually earn it. Who bids the least, gets to do it, and takes the prize?

name: Just Too Bored
summary: A web-drama depicting office romance that's full of mystery, secrets, and interns trying to navigate through work life.

name: Las tres caras de Eva
summary: A quiet woman suffers mysterious blackouts caused by two hidden alter-egos—a thrill-seeking rebel and a composed mediator. As her fractured mind threatens her marriage, a psychiatrist attempts to uncover her underlying trauma and fuse her personalities into one.

name: Allegedly with Ellison Barber
summary: Hosted weekly by journalist Ellison Barber, this gripping podcast digs into the most captivating and talked about true crime cases.

name: Godslayer
summary: On the monster-ravaged continent of Yuanyang, Lu Yuanqing, a young man, awakens the power of the Turbid Dragon after his sister is chosen as a Holy Maiden and turned into a porcelain statue. Determined to save her, he makes himself the most perilous cargo of all and joins forces with the Redtail Armed Escort Agency on a deadly journey across the monster wastes. But the deeper he ventures, the darker the truth becomes: behind Heaven's Blessing lies a brutal system of servitude, upheld by the Heavenwrights and the gods they serve. His quest to save his sister sets him on a path to slay gods, rew

name: Stand Up for Love
summary: Jiang Lai donated her kidney for the man she loved, only to be betrayed by him and framed as being mentally unstable in a deadly plot to silence her. After narrowly surviving, she takes on a new face and a new identity as Zhao Ke. Joining forces with the mysterious Zhao Mai, she sets her revenge plan in motion, turning the tables on those who wronged her. Amid a tangled web of love, hatred, and hidden secrets, Jiang Lai uncovers the truth buried in the past and finally claims the justice she deserves.

name: Farm Busily in the Cold Palace
summary: Modern office worker Lu Yunluo wakes up to find herself transported into the body of an abandoned consort banished to the cold palace, where she crosses paths with the newly crowned Emperor Ji Wujue. Hoping to live a quiet, carefree life, she uses her modern knowledge of medicine and farming to make a fortune and gradually earns the favor of the imperial court. Along the way, she unexpectedly finds love.

name: Filter
summary: Matty is an introverted boy who, despite his indecisive and hesitant nature, has managed to come out. He is surrounded by family and friends who support him. But when he falls in love with Radek, a boy his own age,he is harshly confronted with the reality of his first emotional confusions, mistakes, and failures. Suddenly, he must face unexpected problems and a lack of understanding from those around him. Will he manage to find a fragile inner balance amid the storm of a complicated adolescence?

name: Знахарь
summary: A young promising doctor, a happy husband and a darling of fortune, Razin loses everything in an instant. He is accused of murder, which he did not commit, and goes to jail. Even there, he remains true to his profession.

name: High School Boy
summary: Daemun Boys' High School is notorious for bringing together troubled students from across the country. Small and physically vulnerable, Hong Il-tak becomes a constant target of bullying within the all-boys school's rigid social hierarchy. Determined to change his situation, he deliberately approaches Lee Hyun-woo, one of the most influential and popular students on campus. As misunderstandings and ambiguous encounters draw them closer, tension and attraction quietly begin to build. But as their feelings intensify, so do the jealousy, rumors, and pressure surrounding them.

name: Dom de Iludir
summary: Amid the glamour and privilege of Rio de Janeiro's elite, art collector Lúcia Rossetti and her daughter, Maíra Rossetti, are caught in a complex and turbulent relationship. When their lives intersect with Irina, a web of secrets, tensions and mysteries begins to unfold.

name: Wisdom of the Crowd
summary: John Bishop hosts as players take on the audience to win up to £30,000. The science says the audience should win. But will anyone manage to steal it by beating the wisdom of the crowd?

name: Die Putzfrau
summary: While working as a temporary cleaner, Teri witnesses a murder. To save her own life, she offers to clean up the crime scene for the hotel manager. This lays the foundation for a dangerous pact: Teri needs money for expensive but vital therapy for her daughter Luca. So from then on, she cleans up crime scenes for the wealthy Vincent. With each job, the former medical student finds herself in a deeper moral conflict. The state criminal investigation department quickly picks up her trail.

name: Africa: Earth's Wild Home
summary: Africa: Earth's Wild Home captures four years of unprecedented wildlife encounters across nearly 30 countries, revealing Africa's breathtaking landscapes alongside the frontline conservationists fighting to preserve the continent's wild future.

name: Thunder Chaser
summary: As drug trafficking spreads unchecked, narcotics squad captain Bai Hua leads young police officers, including Zhuang Yan and Li Xiao, into perilous missions. They work undercover and pit their wits against drug dealers. Step by step, they unravel the trafficking network, ultimately arrest the kingpin, tear out the corrupt protective umbrella behind him, and keep the border safe.

name: The Masked Lover
summary: Warlord Lu Zhentian controls Fancheng. His adjutant, He Jingchen, plots to seize the Lu family's hidden treasure, hoping to strengthen the army and protect the people. Su Yutang, an orphan from an opera troupe, goes undercover to seek revenge. After uncovering He Jingchen's plan, she turns it to her own advantage, throwing the situation into turmoil. When they discover that Lu Zhentian plans to trade the treasure for opium and harm the people, Su Yutang and He Jingchen see through each other's facades and join forces. Together, they lay a trap, seize the treasure, and ultimately set off on a n

name: Doctor at Sea
summary: Doctors Duncan Waring and Dick Stuart-Clark leave St. Swithin's behind and take to the high seas as ship's physicians aboard a Mediterranean cruise ship, where their new surroundings bring a fresh assortment of medical mishaps, troublesome passengers and comic adventures.
previous_episode: But It's So Much Nicer to Come Home

name: Doctor at Large
summary: Doctor at Large is a British television comedy series based on a set of books by Richard Gordon about the misadventures of a group of newly qualified doctors. The series follows directly from its predecessor Doctor in the House , and was produced by London Weekend Television in 1971.

name: Urban Horror
summary: Do you often feel inexplicably disturbed in this cold, unconcerned city? Those things we are used to but not specifically noticed are not caused by supernatural or spiritual phenomena but the daily, under-the-surface crises sparked by the fear, ignorance and indifference around us. This is a series without ghosts, monsters, supernatural or sci-fi components.

name: Fără urmă
summary: In a Transylvanian village, Barbu appears to lead a simple life with Mara and their son, Codrin. Yet, beneath this quiet surface lies an identity he spent years trying to bury. When he intervenes in a robbery, his face appears on television, and the people he fled from track him down. Forced to defend his family and return to a world he thought he had left behind, Barbu discovers that the past never truly disappears.

name: Geordie Coppers
summary: New series following Newcastle's neighbourhood police teams and their partners as they tackle crime, disorder and the many unexpected challenges of keeping one of Britain's liveliest cities safe.

name: Paul, la série
summary: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…

name: Glory Days
summary: Glory Days follows a tight-knit group of four high school friends—Walker, Dave, Dominic, and Trigg—as they navigate their early careers and struggle to maintain their friendships into adulthood.

name: From Far Away
summary: A captivating cast of characters embarks on a rich adventure and destiny, weaving a love story that will bring you to tears. Furthermore, the science fiction elements remain compelling even in today's world.

name: Family Full House
summary: Hosted by Indian cricket icon Rohit Sharma, two families go head-to-head in a high-stakes, laughter-filled gameshow featuring relatable trivia, nostalgic household challenges, and playful family rivalries.

name: Ντέρτι
summary: Stella returns to 1987 Patras to face her mother Xenia, a legendary nightclub singer who abandoned her at age five. Their reunion dredges up buried secrets, forcing both women to reckon with absence and the slow path toward forgiveness.

name: Dusty Bluffs
summary: When the editor of the "Dusty Bluffs Gazette" skips town, lifelong paperboys MP and Jer refuse to give up the only job they've ever wanted. With overconfidence and zero qualifications, the boys take the reins of a newspaper they've never read.

name: Garo: Higashi no Kairo
summary: A Japanese live-action tokusatsu television drama set in the Ryūga-verse continuity. Taking place after the events of "Heir to Steel Armor", the story centers on the collapse of the Eastern Region following a catastrophic desertification event caused by the Horror Garzas, and the defense of the region by the Golden Knight Ryuga Dougai.

name: Revenge From A Wife
summary: Chen Shou He, a craftsman who weaves with grass, incurs the wrath of Consort Chen over a piece of "Twinroot Grass" and is brutally tortured to death. His wife, Su Wan Niang, eagerly awaits his return, only to receive his corpse stuffed with withered grass. Devastated by grief, she assumes the identity of Su Cao, a female physician, and infiltrates the imperial city. Using a herbal medicine stall as her cover, she quietly builds an intelligence network and carefully plots her way closer to the emperor, one step at a time. She has only one goal: to avenge her murdered husband.

name: She Lies in Wait
summary: She Lies in Wait seamlessly blends the past and present day, as we're introduced to seven teenagers, Topaz, Aurora, Callum, Benners, Jojo, Coralie and Brett, who go camping in Brinken Wood, part of the New Forest in July 2002. Only six teenagers emerge from the trip as 15-year-old Aurora mysteriously vanishes with no trace, instigating an exhaustive police investigation with public appeals by her family. Flipping deftly between the timelines, the surviving teenagers, including Aurora's sister Topaz, are now in their early 40s and successful in their careers. But what secrets do they harbour? T

name: Jack Dee's Help Me Tiny Big Brain
summary: Each episode sees three junior geniuses (the Tiny Big Brains) paired with three different comics who try their best not to scupper the Tiny Big Brains' chances of victory!

name: Naked and Afraid: Aadimanav
summary: Discover how six survivalist dropped in the Filipino wilderness naked face harsh terrain, scarce resources, and constant exposure. Survival depends on endurance, resilience, adaptability, and smart decisions.

name: Bébés Lemmings
summary: For the Baby Lemmings , the world is a playground—and there's nothing better than sharing this philosophy of life with anyone in the Canadian forest who needs it. When you look at life the Lemming way, you can overcome any challenge—and have fun doing it!

name: Best and Bester
summary: Best and Bester is an animated buddy comedy following a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

name: Love Island VIPS
summary: A group of singles is once again going in search of love, and given the VIPS format, we will see some familiar faces returning.

name: Locatie Onbekend
summary: In Location Unknown , we travel to the most inaccessible places in the world. Which team will be the first to reach the finish line within 48 hours?

name: Good Luck Guys: Overleven zonder filter
summary: In this program, an unexpected group of heroes embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Surviving on a deserted beach on the other side of the world. They all have some form of fame, but once on the beach that no longer matters and they have to rely on themselves. Completely outside their comfort zone, the personalities normally accustomed to luxury compete in duos.

name: Great Ghost Tales
summary: This live television anthology series presents weekly, standalone adaptations of classic supernatural and gothic horror stories by authors like Edgar Allan Poe and W. W. Jacobs. Introduced by an off-screen narrator, each episode plunges everyday characters into unsettling encounters with the paranormal, featuring ominous doppelgängers, cursed artifacts, and psychological dread. Performed entirely in real-time, the show relies on atmospheric suspense and stagecraft to explore fate, guilt, and terror.
previous_episode: Who's the Fairest One of All?

name: Dark Machine: the Animation
summary: "Find Senki," those were the final words of Kairi's grandfather and now his mission. DARK MACHINE, a new and captivating eSport game, transformed Japan's economy. The most powerful player controls it with the title Senki. Now, on the seventh Senki, Kairi plays to finally meet them and ultimately take claim. Will he be able to hold his own, though?

name: Magic Knight Rayearth
summary: Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu, girls from separate schools, find themselves linked together as they fall through the floor during a field trip to the Tokyo Tower. They land in a place called Cephiro, where their will controls what happens. They meet with Guru Clef and find out that they were summoned to save Princess Emeraude who has been imprisoned by High Priest Zagato. They learn magic and acquire weapons on their quest to save Cephiro from the evils of Zagato.

name: Romelia War Chronicle
summary: After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King m

name: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
summary: Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!
previous_episode: So What's Wrong with Wanting to Move Up in the World for My People's Sake?

name: Hunting Gary Glitter
summary: A string of dogged journalists chases fugitive pop star Gary Glitter across the globe — from Cuba to Cambodia to Vietnam — determined to expose the child sexual abuse he concealed behind decades of chart-topping fame. This documentary follows their pursuit alongside the survivors who speak out, charting Glitter's 1997 conviction, through to his years on the run, and eventual incarceration.

name: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
summary: Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points! With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer!
previous_episode: That's opium! Nobody's going to argue with you, and I'm sure you feel like you've gotten stronger! But that's not steroids... You're not actually the slightest bit stronger!

name: The Vermilion Mask
summary: The mask brings calamity. The mask revels in slaughter. The mask has a will of its own... Pelle, a traveling mask merchant, possesses the ability to craft mysterious masks that give its wearers unique powers. In a city shrouded in an eerie atmosphere, he encounters Sonah, a mysterious young girl. As revelations unfold and inner conflicts arise, a young boy takes his first steps forward! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mask battle fantasy!

name: Catedrales
summary: Catedrales is told across two timelines as the Sardá family confronts the devastating truth behind a thirty-year-old murder. In 1986, Ana, the youngest daughter of the devoutly religious family, is found dismembered and burned in a vacant lot. The case is closed without a suspect, and the family accepts their grief in silence — all except Lía, who walks away from everything. In 2018, Lía returns to Santiago to be with her dying father, whose last wish is to learn what happened to Ana. Moving between past and present, the series unravels a history steeped in religious extremism, forbidden love,

name: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
summary: Mitsutaka Oji is a 40-year-old, handsome office worker that is admired by his colleagues. Of course, he has a secret he is trying to hide from everyone: he loves cute things. But with his nephew going to his apartment, Mitsutaka's secret is now in danger!
previous_episode: Chief Oji and the Class Reunion

name: Vertex Force
summary: Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family, however, harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira, on the other hand, has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events begin to occur around the world.

name: #I'm Looking For Zombie
summary: Set in a world where 90 percent of humans on Earth have contracted and died from a deadly, virulent disease, only to then rise again as zombies who attack people. 13 years after that "Red Day" of societal and civilizational collapse, the surviving humans live outside the big cities, still hoping to retake them someday. An entirely new generation of people who know nothing of the pre-Red Day world is now coming into its own. The story begins when Aki and her close friends, Haru and Natsuki, set out to find Aki's missing father.

name: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
summary: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor's son to make a bet with her about their future!
previous_episode: I Was No Longer an Evil Heiress

name: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
summary: The Good Witch of the Lake's four-year crush ended in heartbreak with a single request from the object of her affections. Wanting to increase what little time she has with Royal Knight Harij, Rose sends him on a wild-goose chase for the ingredients for a love potion but gets more than she bargained for when the grumbling knight starts visiting her every day to feed her.

name: The World's Strongest Witch
summary: When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, "Internet." This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means...

name: EN-O'CLOCK
summary: A variety show around the K-Pop group ENHYPEN where they complete games, obstacle courses and much more.

name: Love in the Moonlight: Redrawn
summary: The five main cast members—Park Bo Gum, Kim Yoo Jung, Jin Young, Chae Soo Bin, and Kwak Dong Yeon—reunite for a two-day, one-night trip to Hongcheon, where they spend time together, reminisce about the drama and their memories from 10 years ago, and show how their friendships have changed—or stayed the same—over the years.

name: Εξ Αδιαιρέτου
summary: Efi, a free spirited fashion designer, and Alexandros, a strict and conservative technocrat, unexpectedly find themselves forced to live together after jointly inheriting the same house. Bound by strict legal conditions, the two complete opposites constantly clash over their incompatible lifestyles. Their ongoing battle over who will have the upper hand turns life under the same roof into constant chaos, as each resorts to increasingly inventive ways to drive the other out of the house.

name: Pac-Man: Snack Breaks
summary: PAC-MAN is hungry for a new adventure and some fresh flavors! He's leaving his familiar home of PAC-VILLAGE for the bright and bustling NEW PAC-CITY ! But what adventures are being cooked up? What a-MAZE-ing challenges will PAC-MAN roll through? Find out in PAC-MAN: Snack Breaks , where snack-sized moments turn into feasts of fun and life is not just a 1-player game. Join PAC-MAN along with a colorful cast of characters. Some of whom will help PAC-MAN conquer his day-to-day quests, while others will serve up chaos on a whole new level.

name: La Pola
summary: New Granada, early 19th century. In this era, there are only two choices: one is either a Royalist or a Patriot. A fierce power struggle is underway, bringing with it injustice, countless tears, executions, war itself. Against this backdrop, extraordinary stories unfold, for people live each day literally as if it were their last. This is the setting for the story of La Pola , an untamed spirit, a visionary driven by ideals and a burning desire to fight for freedom, a woman ahead of her time in an era where rampant chauvinism denies women any voice or say. In an age when love is still eternal

name: Grindl
summary: Driven by an agency manager who sends her to a new temporary assignment every week, an eccentric and highly literal-minded domestic worker blunders her way into bizarre high-stakes situations—ranging from murder mysteries to undercover police ops—accidentally solving the chaos through pure blind luck before moving on to her next job.

name: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring
summary: It's the modern world, where humans, yokai, and various other races coexist. Satoru, who works as the apartment manager, ends up angering his secret crush, Mifuyu, a snow woman who lives in the same building. Eager to make amends, he uses a mysterious ring that is said to help in communicating with yokai. However, he finds himself hotly pursued by Mifuyu, who has suddenly become extremely forward.

name: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
summary: RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.
previous_episode: Makoto Takatsuki Helps With Her Revenge

name: Tank Chair
summary: In a dystopian city ruled by violent gangs, a devoted young girl accepts the world's most dangerous assassination contracts to intentionally expose her comatose, wheelchair-bound brother to extreme killing intent—the only catalyst capable of temporarily awakening his unstoppable instincts as a legendary hitman.

name: Squamish Medium
summary: Psychic medium Danielle Searancke uses a connection to Spirit to help people live big and meaningful lives. Disconnected from her Indigenous culture, Danielle is on a journey of reconnection: to self, family, culture, and the land itself.

name: Breitscheidplatz 19/12
summary: About a week before Christmas 2016, a truck plowed into the popular holiday market at Breitscheidplatz, a crowded public square. Twelve people died and many were injured in Germany's deadliest terror attack in decades.

name: Project XY
summary: Using a 'Search for the Leading Actor' format, the show will cast the main and supporting CPs for our company's debut BL drama. It creates a complete business loop across talent-building, drama incubation, fan economy, and merchandise, serving as the launchpad for Chinese-language BL content on the global stage. Six men arrive at a seaside house as complete strangers, each searching for the partner who matches him best.

name: Η Ελίζα και... οι Άλλοι
summary: Eliza Stamatiou lives with her mother, Margarita, and her younger brother, Giorgos, somewhere in Brahami. Their financial situation is very good and everyone at home has relative freedom of movement. Eliza works for a large insurance company, but her "secret" desire is to work in cinema, regardless of her specialty. In the boredom of everyday life and a rather indifferent life, Eliza juxtaposes her imagination, which has been fueled by endless hours in movie theaters or in front of the video. Her generally unsuccessful attempts to transfer elements and situations from movies and their correspo

name: Εμείς κι Εμείς
summary: A heartwarming Greek sitcom centered on the daily lives, romantic misadventures, and enduring bond of a close-knit group of thirty-something friends and neighbors living in an apartment building in Athens.

name: Double Shuffle
summary: Fan Chiang Jui Chen, heir to a powerful family, becomes ruthless amid deadly power struggles. His only weakness is his love for his seventh uncle, Fan Wei Hsia. Their bond ends in tragedy when Jui Chen dies saving Wei Hsi, who is later murdered seeking revenge. Fate sends Wei Hsi back to his youth with memories of their past life. Determined to change their destiny, he protects Jui Chen, only to findhim colder than before. When an accident restores Jui Chen's memories, they must confront old wounds and decide whether love can overcome fate.

name: Котляревський
summary: The series revolves around the fast-paced, dramatic, and humorous everyday life of the staff working at a fictional restaurant named Kotliarevskyi.

name: Building Buffalo
summary: Building Buffalo tells the story of the laborers, tradespeople, architects and contractors who built the Bills' state-of-the-art stadium, featuring Bills legends Thurman Thomas, Andre Reed and Steve Tasker alongside current players Damar Hamlin, Dawson Knox, DJ Moore and others.

name: A Course Called Ireland
summary: This isn't just a show about golf — it's a celebration of life going gloriously off course. In this series, Bill Murray and good friend and author, Tom Coyne play their way across some of the island's most legendary golf courses. But somewhere between the first tee and the final pint, the journey veers off course to meet the people who give it its soul, and why Bill loves his Irish heritage so much. Each episode follows Murray and friends across some of the island's most breathtaking fairways, with every episode featuring a different golf course and guest. The series offers an intimate portrai

name: Mr. Gu, Happy Trial Marriage
summary: Shen Zhiyi, a bride-to-be, finds out she is unexpectedly pregnant due to a bizarre medical mix-up. When she subsequently discovers her fiancé's infidelity, she calls off the wedding immediately and decides to raise the child alone as a single mother. Two years later, Gu Chenzhou—the cold, powerful president of the prominent Gu Group—presents her with a DNA test proving he is the biological father of her child. To give their son a complete family, Gu Chenzhou proposes a "trial marriage" contract with strict terms, promising a temporary arrangement with no romantic obligations. Despite his initi

name: Психологическая импровизация
summary: Psychological Improvisation is a show in which viewers ask personal questions to psychologist Maya Zozzatti right from the audience and receive a quick and clear analysis of their situations. Love, money, family, complexes and fears – in each episode, we explore what worries us, hinders our understanding of ourselves, and prevents us from building relationships with others.

name: Tyson
summary: In this surprisingly emotional documentary, heavyweight champ Mike Tyson analyzes the controversies surrounding his career and turbulent private life.

name: Shaun the Sheep: Brain Breaks
summary: Shaun the Sheep is here to get you up and moving as you take on fun games and challenges. Featuring all your Mossy Bottom Farm friends!

name: Saman: La verità nascosta
summary: Saman, la verità nascosta (Saman, The Hidden Truth) is a three-part docuseries that reconstructs the tragic story of Saman Abbas, the 18-year-old Pakistani girl killed in Novellara in 2021. Blending investigative journalism with cinematic storytelling, the series explores the clash between the young woman's desire for freedom and the rigid dictates of her family. It traces her rebellion, her tragic disappearance, and the complex investigation that culminated in the international judicial process.

name: The Mafia Nanny
summary: The Mafia Nanny centers on Davina who serves as an elite nanny to high-net-worth families. Her job should be straightforward: protect the charge, obey the client, and avoid becoming emotionally attached. But when Davina receives her first mission in the form of young Mikey Angelini, his imposing – and alluring – father threatens to drag her back into the world of organized crime she had tried to leave behind.

name: Hard Feelings
summary: Hard Feelings follows Claire Ambrose, New York City's most sought-after dating consultant, who teaches straight men communication skills and emotional intelligence while repeatedly choosing to date men who possess neither.
