Together with senior attending physician He Yu-hua, the ER team faces relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles within the hospital. Miracles of the ER delves into the complex dynamics between doctors and patients, patients and their famil

name: Община
summary: Konstantin Rogachev, a gruff and embittered investigator, is called to the scene of the tragedy on the last day before his vacation. Together with Alina Samarina, an investigator specializing in subversive organizations who has arrived from the regional capital, they begin to unravel a tangled web with roots stretching back thirty years.

name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
summary: A new group of dynamic young mothers in Orange County collide in a community where beliefs are not just their religion; they are their identity. While some defend their way of life, fighting against modernity, others embrace change, becoming a platform to disrupt the status quo. Scandals and secrets will be revealed, facades will crumble, and families and friendships will change forever on both sides of the battlefield as this group of strong, game-changing influencers comes together to build their answer to #MomTok.

name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
summary: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

name: Aileen Wuornos: Damsel of Death
summary: Aileen Wuornos: Damsel of Death re-examines the crimes and life of one of America's most notorious female killers, drawing on FBI case files and testimony from Brian Jarvis, the lead detective who investigated Wuornos and questioned her following her arrest. Beginning with the murder of Richard Mallory in Florida in November 1989, the documentary traces a series of killings that left seven men dead over the following 11 months. As bodies were discovered along Florida's highways, all shot multiple times, investigators began searching for the person responsible.

name: Convictions Gone Bad with Will Mellor
summary: Will Mellor fronts this gripping true crime series, delving into five of the most shocking miscarriages of justice in legal history. Will unpacks how the system got it so disastrously wrong and reveals the crucial new evidence that finally set the wrongfully convicted, free. We hear from the falsely accused in their own words, providing an insight into what it's like to be arrested, tried and convicted of the most horrendous of crimes; and the subsequent battle to clear their name.

name: Baddies Gone Wild: Cancun
summary: The ladies are back and going even wilder! This season, they're taking their energy straight to Cancun for nonstop turn-ups, unforgettable nights, and plenty of unexpected moments along the way. With no telling what can happen when the girls hit the streets, beaches, and nightlife of Mexico, Cancun is about to experience Baddies Gone Wild like never before.

name: Food Samouraï
summary: The six-episode show sees Mory, accompanied by pastry chef and friend Theó Segretin and guests such as Omar Sy, immerse himself in Japanese culture and gastronomy to unlock how to prepare the perfect bento. Alongside Lupin star Sy are other guests including multi-Michelin-starred chef Pierre Gagnaire, writer Chihiro Masui.

name: Lola ylösalaisin
summary: Set in a tight-knit coastal community, the story follows a group of teenage girls navigating a world shaped by strict social hierarchies and traditional power dynamics. In this town, wealth and influence are concentrated within a few dominant families, creating a rigid system of control and compliance that directly impacts the lives of the youth.

name: The UnBelievable: Encounters with Dan Aykroyd
summary: What happens when an ordinary day takes a truly extraordinary turn? The UnBelievable: Encounters with Dan Aykroyd dives into history's strangest brushes with the unexplained—from alleged alien abductions and cryptid sightings to haunted houses, ghostly visitors, and demonic possessions. Whether you call them impossible, paranormal, or just plain weird, these are the encounters that left witnesses rattled, investigators scratching their heads, and skeptics wondering if there might be more out there than we can explain.

name: Happy Jack
summary: Happy Jack centers on Jack, a bit of a lifelong ne'er-do-well. He's got two great daughters, although his Dad deserves more credit for how they turned out. Kate runs Jack's company and keeps him on the rails while Sam is a wild child who is more like her Dad. When Sam comes home to introduce everyone to her new boyfriend, Jack's shocked to learn Paul, a former investment banker turned van life guru, is the same age as he is. Shocked at first, Jack soon realizes he's got a choice to make. Will he keep looking out for number one, or embrace this last chance to be a real part of his daughters' li

name: The Howard Stern Show
summary: Legendary innovator, broadcaster, and "King of All Media" Howard Stern brings his signature, long-running SiriusXM show to HBO Max.

name: La Señora
summary: La Señora is a fictionalized series that follows Catalina Rojas, a haughty, upper-middle-class woman who becomes the prime suspect in the attempted murder of several members of her own family, and the investigator on the case looking for justice.

name: Stacks of Cash
summary: Stacks of Cash is an edge-of-your-seat game show hosted by Emmy Award-nominated actor Mike O'Malley, where six contestants face off in a quiz-driven battle with towering stakes. Players answer questions to earn uniquely shaped blocks, then stack their way toward a gold line. One wrong move can send everything crashing down .

name: Cow Squad
summary: Animated series based on Chick-fil-A's new mascots, Sarge, Daisy and Carrots.

name: Bob's Game Night - Blood on the Clocktower
summary: Bob the Drag Queen hosts a deadly social deduction game in Ravenswood Bluff, where players must battle to expose evil secrets and shocking betrayal.

name: Mafia: Behind the Bloodshed
summary: Mafia: Behind the Bloodshed reveals the real-world operations, structures, and history of major global organized crime groups.

name: Deadly Destinations
summary: Deadly Destinations chronicles the stories of unsuspecting travelers whose lives are tragically cut short, and gradually reveals how their final stop holds critical clues needed to catch their killer.

name: Zarah: Wilde Jahre
summary: A lesbian journalist fights the patriarchy in 1970s Hamburg.

name: 24 Hour Millionaire
summary: 24 Hour Millionaire is an epic series that assembles the most skilled game players and puts them to the ultimate test: 24 nonstop hours of social strategy and physical competitions where one player is guaranteed to walk away with a $1 million prize.

name: Made in the USA
summary: Made in the U.S.A. will track contestants' challenges to produce their ideas into full-scale products. One contestant will be eliminated each week; the last remaining inventor gets a contract with HSN.

name: Pop Pap Polters
summary: The remote control seems to have moved, and snacks have mysteriously disappeared? It might actually be the work of a mischievous ghost... This is a slightly whimsical and amusing story about three little ghost brothers, Pop, Pup, and Porta, who live inside the walls of a certain house.

name: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
summary: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

name: His Wild Rose Strikes Again
summary: On the day she is abandoned, Lu Chayao sets fire to her grandmother's courtyard. Amid the flames, she encounters the bloodied heir Lu Shiye. He takes her home, plotting to use this troubled beauty to overturn the situation between their two families. Yet, the more defiant she gets, the more he falls for her. From then on, the cunning and calculating Shiye lays the traps, while the shrewd and eccentric Chayao sets them in motion—teaming up to crush their enemies and save each other. This drama is adapted from the Fanqie Novel "Young Master, the Down-and-Out Girl You Brought Home Has Lost It Aga

name: My National Husband
summary: Qiao An Hao and Lu Jin Nian enter a fake marriage because of Xu Jia Mu's car accident, concealing their true feelings. Later, they join the same film crew and experience misunderstandings, mutual protection, and revelations about the past

name: Political Lupin
summary: Set in the fictional country of Nipponia, the protagonist of this story is Kisaragi Yayoi, who sets her sights on "political money," whose use is often unclear. While outsmarting an elite politician who manages the ruling party's finances, she brilliantly seizes all of this shady political money.

name: LOST10
summary: The story is set in Hokkaido. Triggered by the Shikabadake Incident, a mountain accident that occurs during a guided climbing tour, this human suspense drama unfolds as the motives, senses of justice, evil, and complex emotions of the various people involved intertwine.

name: Pitch Invasion: How the USA Changed Soccer
summary: Star-spangled soccer, from Best to Beckham. How the USA gave a declining, hooligan-ridden sport a family friendly makeover. It didn't just grow the game, it changed it forever.

name: A Cloud Loves Me
summary: The story begins on Gu Yueji's 27th birthday, which turns into a disaster when her first love betrays her, dumps her, and leaves her burdened with debt. Right at her lowest point, a birthday cake deliveryman named Ren Jiangye arrives. Desperate for a fresh start, Yueji enters into a living arrangement and contract with him.

name: Thornbird
summary: Ten years after her father—the infamous serial killer Gabriel Thorn—was caught, 17-year-old Ryan Shipley is back in her childhood hometown of Starling, Tennessee, trying to lay low. No one can know who she really is. No one can know the truth about her past. All Ryan wants is a chance to live as a normal teenager, maybe even fall in love.

name: Pablo & Luisão
summary: The adventures of Pablo and Luisão . The production will bring to the small screen the hilarious stories of the artist's father and his best friend in a frustrated attempt to open their own businesses, the love-hate relationship between the two with their family and the holes they got into.

name: Alemão: Os Dois Lados do Complexo
summary: 2010: Just as the Brazilian government launch a military-assisted siege on one of Rio de Janeiro's most notorious and criminally-controlled favelas, the identities of four undercover policemen operating in the slum are accidentally leaked. As violence mounts, the favela's ruthless boss, orders his men to hunt them down.

name: Meu nome é Preta
summary: An intimate portrait of Preta's life, told through the artist's own perspective and exclusive archival material. The series explores the many sides of her personality, career, and experiences that shaped her remarkable journey.

name: Bionic Trace
summary: In 2035, Song Yang, a top student specializing in AI, is falsely accused of murdering his girlfriend and her daughter. While on the run, he teams up with Ada, an android who has developed self-awareness. Together, they solve a series of mysterious cases and uncover the dark secrets of Cedar Group. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and Song Yang clears his name. Ada sacrifices herself to protect him, and humans and androids enter a new era of coexistence.

name: Εκμέκ Παγωτό
summary: After many years of living in Africa, a family returns to Greece and tries to make a fresh start and stand on their own feet again. The grandmother prepares the evening meal, and her cooking becomes the reason for the whole family to gather. During the appetizer, all the issues troubling them come to the surface. In the first course, secrets are revealed and unbelievable stories unfold. But when the dessert arrives - ekmek ice cream - nothing seems quite so serious anymore.

name: Ο Επισκέπτης της Ομίχλης
summary: A professor of the high school in Ioannina, who many years ago had been forced to flee to Germany because he was unfairly accused of killing a student, returns after many years, determined to restore his name and discover the real culprit. In his homeland everyone is confronted with suspicion, and his presence is of crucial importance to the small society where he lives. But as his research progresses, he discovers that there are many more hidden secrets.

name: Big Money in the Morning
summary: A fast-paced, comprehensive look at the major issues driving the market, designed to help viewers navigate the complex financial forces shaping their future before the trading day begins.

name: Tarcísio & Glória
summary: An opportunistic, corrupt businessman takes in a hyper-logical alien scientist studying human biology, creating chaos as she attempts to comprehend human ethics, culture, and romance through his shady world.

name: Nicolle Wallace Presents: 92NY on MS NOW
summary: MS NOW is launching a collaboration with The 92nd Street Y, New York to bring the cultural and community center's signature conversations to the network's weekend lineup in a new monthly series, Nicolle Wallace Presents: 92NY on MS NOW .
previous_episode: Rachel Maddow & Hollywood Power Broker Ari Emanuel

name: Caçador de Marajás
summary: A charismatic politician launches his career by portraying himself as a crusading reformer determined to tear down high-earning, corrupt state officials. However, his rise to the nation's highest office quickly unravels as severe economic collapse, rampant inflation, and personal financial scandals trigger his dramatic political downfall.

name: Herança em Jogo
summary: Thirteen strangers compete for a fortune left behind by the Deceased. To win the money, they work together on missions guided by the Executor. At the end of each mission, only one person receives the sum and decides whether or not to share it with the others.

name: Fast & Furious
summary: Fast & Furious is a live-action television series based on the hit movie franchise.

name: Mayday
summary: When the alarm sounds and everyone else seeks shelter, they cast off. We get a unique, raw glimpse into life aboard the rescue vessels—filmed by the crew themselves. These boats operate along the entire Norwegian coast to save lives and protect property.

name: Sam and Colby
summary: Join Sam and Colby as they explore and document the creepiest haunted sites. Maintaining their infectious humor in even the darkest of situations, paranormal investigation has never been more fun.

name: The Man and the Challenge
summary: A scientist tests problems of human survival. Unusual semi-documentary series with the accent of space training.

Hug Each Other at the End of the Fireworks
summary: Lin Ting has been abandoned by the Lin family for many years. name: The Man Called X
summary: Adventures of Ken Thurston, US Intelligence Bureau Agent - Code Name "X".

name: Vicky e a Musa
summary: When Euterpe, the Greek goddess of music, unexpectedly arrives in a vibrant Brazilian neighborhood, she summons a grieving young teenager named Vicky, using the transformative power of art and music to heal her community.

name: Die Düsteren
summary: On a North Sea island, sinister doppelgängers threaten the inhabitants. As Soma tries to discover who she really is, her past becomes the key to the mystery.

name: KERORO☆
summary: The Hinata household is your typical, everyday Japanese household, it consists of: Aki, the mother who is a manga editor, Natsumi, the older sister that is perfect at school, but bossy at home, Fuyuki, the little brother that is in the occult club at school, and Sgt. Keroro, the frog-like alien that was sent here as part of an invasion force to take over Pokopen (Earth). As the Sgt.'s comrades appear, the only defense against the invasion of Earth are the Hinata household and other friends.
previous_episode: Is It a Cavity? No, It's the Caries War / Aki Becomes a Middle Schooler

name: Rota 66: A Polícia que Mata
summary: While thoroughly investigating the murder of two young men from São Paulo, reporter Caco Barcellos uncovers a group of ROTA hitmen operating with the apparent approval of the military justice system.

name: Além da Ilha
summary: The series takes place in a luxury resort on a desert island that inaugurates in Brazil the coveted mystery tourism, already known and explored in other parts of the world.

name: Os Parças - A Série
summary: The Buddies are back and on a difficult mission: Toinho, Pilôra, and Romeu need to free Ray Van, who was mistakenly kidnapped by a dangerous gang.

name: Second Plate
summary: Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on t

name: Hide & Seek
summary: Freelance journalist Tsukura becomes caught up in a bombing and loses his beloved girlfriend, Sana. He is then branded by the state as the terrorist who masterminded the attack and becomes a wanted fugitive! Tsukura flees to South Korea, where he spends his days in despair. Then, incredibly, he receives a phone call from Sana...!? Is Sana still alive? Or is she actually someone else? As Tsukura flees from the authorities while pursuing the truth about his mysterious girlfriend, a desperate game of escape and pursuit unfolds. Every character has a hidden side, and after one betrayal after anoth

name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
summary: The re-opening of a mysterious 1985 cold case murder in Louisiana unearths a haunting history of bloodshed and long-buried trauma. What begins as an investigation into a 1985 murder turns into a haunting exploration of a community's dark history of violence and bloodshed. Set in the rural bayou outside New Orleans, Louisiana, a harsh landscape steeped in supernatural lore and traditions, the story starts with the disappearance of Dorothy Lou Thompson - the owner of a pet cemetery that had been built on land long rumored to be cursed. Dorothy's body eventually turns up wrapped in chains in the

name: Dekiai Kareshi no Tsukurikata: Se kara Honmei ni Naru Onna no Ko no Hanashi
summary: Sakura, heartbroken after a physical encounter with her senior coworker Keisuke turns into cold rejection, finds herself unable to let him go. In her despair, she meets Zakuchan, a blunt "fairy of love" disguised as a doll who harshly scolds her choices. Guided by Zakuchan's strict romance lessons, Sakura sets out to transform her unrequited crush into becoming Keisuke's true girlfriend.

name: Hadakanboutachi
summary: Sabasaki Ryo is a shoemaker and salesperson who innocently approaches any woman who catches his interest. It makes no difference to him whether the woman has a boyfriend or a spouse, and although those around him deride him as a "player" and a "jerk," he does not care in the slightest. While enjoying a convenient, "almost-lovers" relationship with Tsutsui Momo, a dentist ten years his senior, Sabasaki also takes an interest in Momo's best friend, Hotta Kyoko, a mother of three. Driven by his desires, he finds himself wavering back and forth between the two women.

name: Doubt: 15-nen Me no Fukushu
summary: Fifteen years after surviving the serial killer "Komori," clinical psychologist Ando Kaede uses her hyper-acute hearing alongside her detective brother to hunt down their family's murderer. When the long-dormant case suddenly resurfaces, the siblings are drawn into a web of secrets and lies in pursuit of the truth.

name: Mikon Sagi
summary: Sayaka and Shinji appear to be a deeply loving married couple whose main struggle is their inability to conceive despite fertility treatments. Unbeknownst to Sayaka, who remains desperate to have a child with him, her seemingly perfect and supportive husband is keeping a major secret: two other women are involved in his life.

name: The Martians and Us
summary: Series about the history of British science fiction.
previous_episode: The End of the World as We Know It

name: Deadly Tag
summary: Chase, be chased, and survive. A deadly game of tag begins.

name: Love on Hire
summary: Thitinan will take any job—being a fake girlfriend and breaking up a relationship, or, special just for Miss Chat, becoming a bedroom coach.

name: The Blossoming of Zhang Mei Li
summary: Because of a misunderstanding, Zhang Meili is sent to a wrong school, the Huaxia Global Universal Extravagant High School. This wouldn't actually be a problem if the school wasn't known for housing stuck-up young men. Thus, she meets many beautiful "younglings" at her new school, though, they are all mean. For Zhang it is now: take a deep breath and get to it!

name: That Winter Solstice
summary: On the day of the winter solstice, Nan Zhaoning and Jing Shuo were married. However, on the very first day of their marriage, Jing Shuo revealed that he planned to undergo assisted suicide in a year due to his chronic pain and disability. If he was once her light, she would now have to become his light, breathing love and a will to live into him.

name: A visszavágó – Kapj el, ha tudsz!
summary: This pan-European reality chase show is based on the 'Catch Us If You Can' format and is a spin-off of the earlier series 'Most Wanted – A hajsza'. In this version, celebrity pairs are the ones pursuing Balázs and his team.

name: Just Eating a Meal Together
summary: Trapped in unfulfilling marriages, cooking instructor Taki and home-cooked meal lover Rei bond over shared dishes, struggling to control their deepening attraction within the strict boundary of only eating together.

name: Bennie
summary: Bennie, a headstrong boy with Down syndrome, turns 18. Now that he is finally an adult, he wants a real job, happiness in love, and to live on his own. Just like everyone else. His fight for independence turns his delightfully dysfunctional family completely upside down. With his disarming humor, Bennie fights against all prejudices and inspires his parents, sister, and brother to choose themselves and each other again, too.

name: Recipe of the Year
summary: The ABC is bringing Australians together around the kitchen table with Recipe of the Year , a heart-warming cooking competition hosted by beloved cook Adam Liaw and acclaimed actor and food lover Pia Miranda. Set on a picturesque country farm, the seven-part series sees home cooks compete for the ultimate title: Australia's Recipe of the Year. From family recipes shaped by culture and passed down through generations to ingeniously simple weeknight winners that will put a smile on everyone's face, Recipe of the Year celebrates the stories and flavours that make up Australia today. name: The State of Man
summary: In the new three-part documentary series The State of Man , award-winning journalist Marc Fennell investigates the powerful online movement influencing how a generation of boys and young men see themselves and navigate the world.

name: Bureau Groningen
summary: Ewout Genemans spends six months shadowing police officers in Groningen. He joins six police pairs who are on standby day and night to intervene whenever necessary. Ewout empathizes with the officers in all kinds of intense situations and, in doing so, gets to know the person behind the uniform.

name: Only Fools and Horses: The Lost Archive
summary: Sir David Jason, along with the cast and crew of the beloved comedy show reunite to watch and relive previously unseen archive from Only Fools and Horses.

name: Rule 101
summary: A wealthy professor consumed by sex addiction. A group of students drawn into a forbidden ethical abyss. When a dangerous game of temptation and taboo takes an unexpected turn — a student mysteriously disappears, and everyone believes their secrets will be buried forever. But the arrival of a new face becomes the first domino to fall. The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

name: Locker Diaries: Camp Rock
summary: Glimpse the drama unfolding across Camp Rock.

name: Judge Hacker
summary: Order! Order! Judge Hacker is a brand-new comedy entertainment format in which children and grown-ups finally get justice for the everyday ‘crimes' that normally go unpunished. Not content with his role on Blue Peter, the cheeky canine gets his own show, crammed with gags, games and celebrity guests. Hacker T Dog, performed by Phil Fletcher, presides over cases alongside lawyers Lorna Rose Treen and Toussaint Douglass, delivering his verdicts and suitably fitting punishments.

name: Hyperlight - Battle of the Guardians
summary: Hyperlight - Battle of the Guardians is a brand-new animated adventure that takes viewers into the Network, a parallel digital world hidden within the hyper-connected city of New Avalon. When teenager Chrissie develops extraordinary new powers, she and Bella are drawn into a battle against hackers, viruses and a sinister entity threatening the city.

name: Animal Allsorts
summary: Animal Allsorts is a brand-new animated series. Using stunning imagery from the award-winning books by renowned artist Owen Davey, the series taps into the love that young children have for collecting and sorting things, especially animals. Whether you are passionate about penguins, crazy about crocs or mad about monkeys there's so much to sort in the world of animals.

name: The Mask
summary: The Story of Walter and Peter Guilfoyle, brothers and attorneys working out of New York.

name: Het Roer Om
summary: Het Roer Om is a popular Dutch reality series following couples and families who leave their familiar lives in the Netherlands behind to build a new life abroad.

name: Kono Ai wa Machigai desu ka ~ Furin no Shokuzai
summary: Entering her second year of marriage, housewife Matsumoto Naho realizes her relationship with her husband, Shogo, has become sexless. As Naho's attempts to reignite their intimacy fail, Shogo is tempted into an affair by a coworker while Naho seeks comfort in her ex-boyfriend's kindness. Their crossing of lines entangles four people in a secret web, turning the couple's quiet routine into an unpredictable psychological battle.

name: Rezoned
summary: With imagination, tenacity, and a few bucks, people have transformed the most unlikely public places into personal palaces. reZONED turns the typical house tour on its ear. Meet gutsy visionaries who found beauty in dilapidated commercial spaces, rezoning them into imaginative, amazing, one-of-a-kind homes.

name: Umayuru Full Gate!
summary: Class is in session again as new Uma Musume students enter Tracen Academy.

name: Permission to Cheat
summary: To preserve her sexless five-year marriage and combat intense emotional loneliness, Kae, a frustrated homemaker carrying the burden of solo childcare, agrees to her husband Hiroki's surprising proposal to seek physical and intimacy fulfillment through an "approved affair." However, as Kae engages with former partners, dating apps, and professional services with Hiroki's consent, she realizes that casual physical satisfaction cannot replace her true desire: to be emotionally cherished and genuinely loved. Ultimately, her search for intimacy forces her to confront her deepest desires and reasses

name: Christopher Lee's Ghost Stories for Christmas
summary: Christopher Lee reads the disturbing Victorian ghost stories of writer MR James.

name: Baby Animals Down Under
summary: Baby Animals Down Under takes you on a spectacular trek around Australia to meet a wide variety of delightful youngsters that hop, climb, fly and swim through its wilds. In Forests, go piggybacking with Koala joeys and enjoy the rare sight of a Tree Kangaroo joey popping its head out of the pouch. On the Waterways, see baby Saltwater crocodiles emerge from their eggs, and go for a paddle with fluffy baby Black Swans. In the Outback, bound around with Red Kangaroo joeys and Emu chicks. name: Model Citizens
summary: A team of fashion models travels to different towns across the country to take on demanding physical labor, renovating community centers, cleaning coastlines, and building shelters to give back to local neighborhoods.

name: The Fitbit Killer
summary: British woman Caroline Crouch is murdered in Athens during an apparent robbery. Her husband Babis survives, but as leads go cold, troubling questions emerge.

name: Hell Barrister
summary: Yau Yum Yum is a lawyer with more enemies than friends. One day, she is attacked and met a deceased rich man on her deathbed. His intention is to send Yau back to the world of the living to be his lawyer. He needs Yau to manage his assets. Yau gets possessed by spirits and travels between the two "worlds". She witnesses how ugly and ridiculous inheritance disputes can get. It makes her wonder the true meaning of inheritance, and whether it is a blessing or a curse.

name: Cause of Death
summary: Rookie forensic pathologist Ching Tsz Yan finally earns her transfer to work under her benefactor Lam Sam after much effort. Lam Sam is widely recognized within the forensics department as the toughest and most hard-core pathologist - sharp-tongued, arrogant, and dismissive of newcomers. He constantly berates Tsz Yan. Meanwhile, detective Ko Chun, nicknamed the "Unluckiest Cop in the Force", is accused of killing a suspect during a pursuit. Lam Sam entrusts the critical autopsy to Tsz Yan, who lives up to expectations and discovers a hidden layer in the case. Ko Chun, too, starts to see her in

name: Kylmään kadonneet
summary: Kylmään kadonneet is set in the early winter of Lapland, following the investigation of the disappearance of an Irish seasonal worker behind the scenes of a luxury resort.

name: Hopley Hall
summary: At Hopley Hall , the heating rarely works, the history is questionable and the gift shop sells mostly tea towels. The Grade A listed masterpiece, located in a fictional town on the Coast of County Antrim, is held together by damp, optimism, and a deep-seated resentment for the tourist attraction down the road. summary: Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna demonstrates the recipes that she loves to cook.

Everything changes when his former classmate, Kiryukha, unexpectedly reappears in his life. summary: At the behest of the Queen, Earl Ciel Phantomhive hosts a lavish dinner party attended by several of the finest members of polite society—as well as struggling author, Arthur. But as the party reaches its high, a terrible murder takes place and none other than the Earl himself is suspected of the crime. Hidden among the innocent players are the traitors, striking to murder each night. In this high-stakes battlefield of trust, deception, and strategy - Trust is Uncool, Mosam Ikkada New Rule.

name: Sam Lovegrove: Race Mechanic
summary: Sam Lovegrove prepares cars and bikes for Britain's iconic motorsport events.

name: Matt Baker: Our Barn in the Dales
summary: Matt Baker returns to the family farm for an ambitious new chapter: transforming the old barn beside Matt's parents' farmhouse into a new home.

name: The Search for Leah Croucher: A Parent's Nightmare
summary: An intimate documentary drawing on rare access to 19-year-old Leah Croucher's family to tell the story behind one of Britain's most high-profile missing person cases.

name: Nashville 99
summary: Featuring Claude Atkins as Metro Nashville police lieutenant and Jerry Reed as his sidekick, this show features many country music personalities and is shot on location at various downtown Nashville sites as well as other locations (including Opryland). This show runs in the same vein as "CHIPs", "Hawaii Five-O", and other police/crime shows, only this one seems to center around the music community within Nashville. Nashville country artists of 1977 feature prominently in each one of these episodes.

name: El crimen de Pazos
summary: In the quiet village of Pazos, Aniceto and his wife Irene appear to be the perfect couple until one night, when she suffers a brutal attack during an apparent robbery. As she fights for her life in the hospital, Elías, a sergeant in the Civil Guard who is convinced that Aniceto is the perpetrator, faces a system he perceives as unwilling to heed his warnings or protect the victim. With Aniceto free and Irene's life hanging by a thread, will the truth come to light before it's too late?

name: Men v. Food
summary: Each week, former NFL pros and friends Ryan Fitzpatrick and Vince Wilfork will touch down in a new NFL city in search of unforgettable flavors, hidden gems and larger-than-life food challenges. After 17 seasons, nine teams and a career built on fierce competition, longtime NFL quarterback and football analyst Ryan Fitzpatrick is taking his competitive streak to a new arena. For two-time Super Bowl champion and All-Pro defensive powerhouse Vince Wilfork, tackling massive meals is second nature to him, helping fuel a dominant career in football. Bringing their competitive edge to the plate, thes

name: Harmonia
summary: Harmonia is set in an AI-controlled, high-end luxury resort and wellness facility, where technology meets escapism and every guest's desire can be fulfilled. It reflects things we all aspire to, but also fear. It's a modern-day Frankenstein story of a scientist who would be God, and their extraordinary creation, where it becomes increasingly unclear whether the AI is the monster, or whether the humans are.

name: Zodiac
summary: A live-action spy thriller.

name: Aquel
summary: The origins, career and music of Spanish singer Raphael inspire this intimate biopic series about his remarkable journey to 60 years of global success.

name: The Wolves of Real Estate: The Alexander Brothers
summary: The Wolves of Real Estate tells the story of three brothers who were recently convicted of preying on women for more than a decade, masquerading as party boys while allegedly drugging and raping women. These claims only came to light when dozens of women came forward, leading to one of the biggest sex trafficking trials of the decade. Delving into the family and brothers' early years, and with access to never-before-seen footage and exclusive interviews, the series exposes a twisted and disturbing tale.

name: Palacio
summary: On November 6, 1985, an M-19 guerrilla commando forcibly entered the Palace of Justice and took more than 300 people hostage, including Supreme Court justices. On November 7, the Colombian Army retook the Palace. Inspired by real and publicly known events, the series recounts what happened during the siege and retaking of the Palace of Justice, which resulted in the deaths and disappearances of at least 94 people, including justices, guerrilla members, civilians and members of the military. It also follows the victims' families in their pursuit of justice for more than 20 years.

name: How to Ruin Diwali: Meet the Parents
summary: A hidden engagement forces a proud Zulu family and an Indian medical dynasty under one roof as secrets and colliding customs threaten to derail Diwali.

name: Tierra de Amor y Coraje
summary: The Coraje and Barrios ranches have been neighbors and rivals for years, but a dispute over access to the river hides a much deeper conflict. The lives of the Coraje brothers—Juan, Jerónimo, and Lalo—change after the death of their parents and the return of Clara Barrios to Arizona to carry on her family's legacy. Meanwhile, her father seeks to take over the Coraje land after discovering its vast mineral wealth. When Juan and Clara meet, a powerful attraction sparks between them, while Jerónimo is also drawn to her and Lalo begins developing feelings for Clara. What begins as a feud between ne

name: Ana, mi-ai fost scrisa in ADN!
summary: Ana, a young woman abandoned at birth, takes a DNA test and discovers her mother's identity. This revelation unravels buried family secrets, forcing her to face deception, betrayal, and shifting loyalties in a world of power and emotion.

name: Hun Nan Zi Kong
summary: After three years in a distant arranged marriage, forensic doctor Mu Siwan prepares to divorce Bo Yan. An accident reveals the capable woman behind her quiet facade, and his indifference begins to crack.

name: Surviving Alaska: Women of the Wild
summary: Across the vast wilderness of Alaska, four unique women share one goal: to thrive in the harsh and unpredictable conditions of the frozen winter landscape. Ryne Olson trains reindeer for backcountry travel. Jody Potts-Joseph carries on the traditions of her Indigenous ancestors. Sarah Poynter subsists on a remote off-grid homestead. Kaycee Powell relies on dog power to stake her claim in the wild.

name: Doula: A True Crime
summary: A young woman seeks help from dozens of doulas for a traumatic pregnancy, until something feels off. As her labour escalates, the story takes a turn no one saw coming.

name: Lao Gong Qing He Wo Lian Ai Ba

As for Leng Jing—no matter how bad her reputation is, he trusts her unconditionally. Archrival? Hardly. He's the childhood friend who's secretly loved her for years. So she takes his an

name: Eternal Boys
summary: One day, Sanada Kentaro, who has become unemployed, applies for a full-time position at Manpuku Entertainment and becomes a member of the new idol project "Eternal Boys." Eternal Boys is an "old man idol project" where all the members are in their late 30s or early 40s. Sanada aims to become an idol, overcoming the barriers of age and physical strength alongside these men who have experienced both success and failure.

name: A Pretty Sister-in-Law Falls from the Sky, the Sisters-in-Law Chase After Her to Dote On Her
summary: Ming Yi works at a nightclub and is desperately trying to save up for her gravely ill mother's surgery. After a chance encounter with Liang Yuchen, the head of a large group, she asks him only to pay for the treatment. Due to a misunderstanding, he mistakes her for a gold-digger and fires her. Ming Yi soon learns she's pregnant. Accustomed to supporting her mother and younger brothers alone, she plans to hide the truth and raise the child alone. However, Yuchen learns everything and proposes marriage. Ming Yi agrees only on two conditions: that their relationship remain a secret, and that they

name: Blondie
summary: A well-meaning but notoriously bumbling father routinely gets into chaotic misadventures while balancing the demands of his short-tempered boss, his penchant for massive late-night sandwiches, and the daily slapstick hazards of suburban family life, all while his sharp, level-headed wife consistently keeps the household running smoothly and saved from total collapse.

summary: Every day, hundreds of inspectors watch over our safety and health. Twelve of them allow themselves to be followed during inspections at markets, at sea, in large-scale kitchens, playgrounds, amusement parks, and forests, in search of infringements and violations.

name: Gaspard et Lisa
summary: Gaspard and Lisa are best friends who get involved in many adventures and everyday situations in life. Sometimes they often cause troubles that make other people upset with them and when that happens they say "Uh oh! Catastrophe!", but when they fix the problem, they say, "Yes, triumph!".

name: Secret Agent Challenge
summary: Two junior spies work together to solve the riddles that will guide them through unique places and lead them to prizes.

name: Музыка судьбы. Жизнь и кино Исаака Шварца
summary: Isaac Schwartz is a composer whose melodies are more widely known to the general public than the identity of their creator. Yet Schwartz's music is closely tied to his life story. Time and again, when faced with pressure from circumstances — be it exile, war, creative challenges, or a cultural revolution — the composer found unconventional solutions and turned difficulties to his advantage. This series is a retrospective of Isaac Schwartz's life and work. It covers all stages of the composer's career, from his early works in theatre and cinema to his life's work — the concert "Yellow Stars". V

name: She Is My Kryptonite
summary: Dawson executive Guan Jiahe reunites with her former lover, Zhongsheng CEO Chen Che, during a business negotiation. Seven years ago, the 25-year-old Guan met the 19-year-old lonely Chen, and they fell deeply in love. When her family faced trouble, she was worried of being a burden to him, who had a bright future ahead. She left without a word, leaving only 500,000 behind, and he has resented her ever since. Now, he seeks revenge at every turn. Amid misunderstandings from others, the truths of the past come to light. Overcoming past hurts and their age gap, they mend their relationship and stay

name: The Fake Alchemist
summary: In the city-state of Orichalconia, a world where alchemy and magic are deeply rooted in the lives of the people, the reincarnated Paracelsus ekes out a living as an alchemist while hiding his "cheat skills." However, his life changes dramatically one day after he enters into a contract with a shaman slave-girl, Nora, and later meets Coco, an elf who has lost all four limbs and five senses. To save Coco, what began as a rescue attempt in a small workshop gradually escalates into a battle involving alchemy and sorcery, space and even the gods themselves.

name: The Boy Who Stole Billions?
summary: The series delves into one of the biggest frauds in U.S. history with unprecedented access and exclusive firsthand accounts from Sam Bankman-Fried himself from prison.

name: Swipe Right on the Devil
summary: When 24-year-old Sydney Loofe disappears after a Tinder date, what begins as a missing-person case quickly spirals into a haunting mystery. As investigators race to uncover her whereabouts, they are drawn into an astounding world of manipulation, witchcraft, mind control and black magic. Each new lead uncovers disturbing revelations, exposing behavior that shocks even seasoned FBI agents. With every answer raising new questions, Sydney's story becomes a cautionary tale about trust, vulnerability and the hidden dangers that can lurk behind seemingly ordinary encounters, culminating in a chillin

name: Με Αγάπη Άννα
summary: Hosted by legendary Greek singer Anna Vissi, Με Αγάπη Άννα was a weekly musical variety show. Combining live musical performances, celebrity interviews, comedy sketches and entertainment segments, the show offered audiences a different side of the popular singer. The program featured appearances by various Greek artists, humorous sketches with actor Pavlos Haikalis, a karaoke competition with Michalis Tsousopoulos and a comedy segment titled Taxi , featuring Markos Seferlis in one of his earliest television appearances. Anna Vissi also performed throughout the show, bringing her distinctive mu

name: The Cold Truth behind the Sweet Trap
summary: Duan Bo Han and Xiang Si Yi come from a blended family. To take revenge on Xiang Si Yi's mother, he deliberately approaches her, showing endless care and affection. Over five years, Xiang Si Yi falls completely in love with her older stepbrother, only to accidentally discover at a gathering with his friends that she was merely a pawn in his revenge. Heartbroken, she plans to leave for London to study abroad… but Duan Bo Han refuses to let her go — in those five years, he too has fallen in love with his younger stepsister.

name: Pimp
summary: In Pimp , when a married couple loses their spark, they get it back in the most shocking and controversial way – by running a sex work operation out of their upstanding Midwest community.

name: No Opportunity Wasted
summary: No Opportunity Wasted is a Canadian reality-adventure television series that follows ordinary Canadians as they face their fears, pursue lifelong dreams, and take on personal challenges within 72 hours, proving that it's never too late to seize an opportunity and change your life.

name: The Mighty Jungle
summary: The show captures the hopes, fears, frustrations, joys, and silliness of children. It explores how preschoolers play and overcome both physical and emotional obstacles through its animal characters.

name: Falling Beyond the Rules
summary: Xi Xubai is a meticulous professor who has always lived by strict rules, keeping his emotions firmly under control. Fang Zhixia, a bold and free-spirited novelist, is everything he isn't. When their paths cross again, a writing project becomes the perfect excuse to get closer, stirring feelings that have remained unspoken for ten years. For a man who has spent his life maintaining order, falling in love means breaking every rule he's ever followed. And Fang Zhixia might just be the one person worth losing control for.

name: Çiçekçi Kız
summary: The story revolves around two completely opposite people whose paths unexpectedly cross in a small boutique flower cafe.

name: Office Gossip
summary: Sitcom set in the office of a toy company, where Jo and Simon are PAs to incompetent and demanding bosses respectively.

name: Høst
summary: Gorm is s farmer and owner of the Feldumgaard estate. As he turns 65, he appoints the youngest of his three children, his daughter Astrid, to inherit and manage the farm. Shock waves run through the family and especially upset is the eldest son Erik. All are now forced to confront the past, each other, and the future. Together as well as independently.

name: Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos
summary: In Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos a rebellious teenage Avatar bucks thousands of years of tradition by choosing to learn the four elements through globetrotting adventures, staying one step ahead of his angry teacher, rowdy pirates, and chaotic spirits - all while helping the world in his own unique ways.

name: Happy Anding
summary: Asura, a struggling comedy trio made up of Tae-gu, Nam-il, and Jun-seo, who have spent ten years together without recognition. They endured a shabby reality of scant stage income and part-time wages, but after a broadcaster's one-sided taping cancellation, leader Tae-gu declares Asura's breakup. Before them, their feelings jagged and confused, appears a "mysterious suspicious woman" with her face wrapped in a black scarf!

name: 1 Euro House
summary: Renowned interior designers Shaynna Blaze and Darren Palmer take on the ultimate renovation challenge in 1 Euro House , as they transform a dilapidated one-euro property in the Italian village of Castronovo into a spectacular dream home. In this series the duo passionately reinvent key spaces, infusing each one with unique character through clever styling and structural vision. No detail will be overlooked as they transform every corner of the home, teaming up with local Italian artisans to incorporate handcrafted designs and custom furniture to root the home in its stunning surroundings. Much

name: First Love Again
summary: Zhou Xiangxiang, a spirited and aspirational girl, and Gu Han, an aloof basketball prodigy, are childhood friends who reunite after years apart due to a misunderstanding. As their rivalry intensifies, they gradually transform each other while witnessing one another bravely chasing their dreams — a heartwarming love story that evolves from bickering rivals into a textbook romance.

name: The Chemistry
summary: Chemistry between characters is that special feeling that emerges when two people are together, making even the most ordinary moments feel extraordinary.

name: Lamp of Tied Bones
summary: Born with a yin fate, Sang Wanning mistakes her savior, Shen Yuchen, for his elder brother, Shen Yuji, and happily prepares to marry him, unaware that he died in battle long ago. By a twist of fate, she weds Shen Yuchen instead, whose memories of saving her have been erased. Now, he sees her only as the blood sacrifice needed to break the Shen family's century-old curse and resurrect his dead brother.

name: Celebrity Scares
summary: An unscripted, immersive horror-interview series that pairs genre legends and celebrities with premier haunted attractions for terrifying, raw conversations while navigating jump scares.

name: Rise of the Mystic Outcast
summary: The story follows young Long Fei, falsely condemned as a sinister being. After being buried alive for a decade, he bursts from his coffin and uses the Jiuli Ghost Disk to turn his fate around, becoming a new-generation Ghost Master and revealing the stunning secret of Tiangong Tower. Ten years of patience, one moment of triumph, a thrilling tale rich in cultural depth and hot-blooded revenge.

name: Artemis Fowl: The Animated Series
summary: The action-adventure fantasy series " Artemis Fowl " follows 13-year-old genius Artemis Fowl as he uncovers an underground world of armed and dangerous — and surprisingly high-tech — fairies as he launches a plan to capture one and steal its magic to heal his dying mom and save his family.

name: The Paranormal Borderline
summary: This exploitative series dealt with people who had crossed the paranormal borderline into the world of the supernatural.

name: All The Little Houses
summary: All the Little Houses is set in the wealthy enclave of Longview, Texas, where Charleigh Anderson has clawed her way from outcast to undisputed queen bee. But when a seemingly perfect, prairie-kissed family arrives in town — complete with a trad-wife mother, woodworking father, and wholesome daughter — Charleigh finds her carefully constructed world under threat. As two formidable women go head-to-head, their battle for the soul of Longview exposes the secrets, resentments, and desires lurking beneath its picture-perfect surface.

name: See you again
summary: Hu Guang Lai murdered the people that harassed his sister. Because of that event, he was sentenced to life imprisonment. Life was bleak in prison, and he felt abandoned by his community. After securing early release on good behaviour, how will his new life unfold?

name: Hot Wheels: Monster Trucks Island
summary: The trucks end up in a big mud pit and struggle to get out. Backfires sounding like farts, spinning wheels spraying each other with mud—it's a hilarious mess. Only by working together can they free themselves and move a little further along.

name: The Stars Look Down
summary: Set between 1910 and 1930 in the fictional coal-mining community of Sleescale in North East England, the serial traces the social, political, and personal conflicts surrounding the working class, mine owners, and local politics across two decades.

name: Mayas : la guerre des rois divins
summary: A look at the "Game of Thrones" of the Maya, explaining how this brilliant civilisation collapsed after two centuries of ruthless power struggles.

name: Witch Detectives
summary: Maya, Max, or Millie, three young witches, still in high school, embark on becoming private detectives!

name: The Great Food Con
summary: Craig Reucassel reveals how ultra-processed foods are now linked to a range of harmful health effects and asks - do we really know what we're eating anymore?

name: Spaceship Earth
summary: In Spaceship Earth , when a mission to avert an imminent global cataclysm goes awry, a small band of teenagers from Earth's past and future must join forces to confront a threat as vast and mysterious as time itself.

name: The Vicki Gunvalson Show
summary: Talk show hosted by Vicki Gunvalson.

name: Big Bargain Holiday Showdown
summary: Olympic gold medalist figure skater, TV personality and sports broadcaster Tara Lipinski will challenge Christmas fanatics to create Yuletide magic on a dime in HGTV's new competition series Big Bargain Holiday Showdown , in each of the festive six episodes, two teams of friends, family and neighbors will battle to prove who has the most holiday spirit without blowing their shoestring budget. With the help of DIY experts, Ashley Dixon and Clinton Tharp, the teams will have just 48 hours and $500 each to transform one room in their home into a stunning winter-themed wonderland using ingenious d

name: Merrick & Treves
summary: Set inside Queen Victoria's top secret Royal Temporal Constabulary, Merrick & Treves follows a team of unlikely heroes as they voyage back and forth through time in an effort to stop Jack the Ripper.

name: A Day in the life with Kuromi
summary: Join us for this brand new, spookycute series that will follow Kuromi into mischievous mystery, kooky conspiracy, and wacky weirdness with her two besties! It's her season now!

name: Nick Cannon @ Night
summary: Nick Cannon @ Night uses pop culture, current events, and personal stories to explore love, dating, relationships, health, and modern intimacy as they unfold in everyday life. Audience questions and real-life dilemmas drive the conversation, while doctors and professionals anchor each discussion with informed perspectives and practical advice.

name: MP3
summary: A satirical music video countdown show featuring three new absurd music videos every episode. Music and compositions by Zach Reino & Jess McKenna.

name: Church Wives
summary: Set inside a prominent megachurch, Church Wives follows two ambitious women who go to war for status and power when a coveted leadership role opens up. Polite competition escalates fast, turning committee meetings, fundraisers, and Bible studies into battlegrounds for manipulation and shifting alliances. As devotion gives way to ego, the congregation is caught in the fallout, and victory starts to matter more than faith itself.

name: Prawo Bestii
summary: Panic returns to Poland as a convicted child murderer nears release, reigniting moral conflict between the case's lead investigator and its psychiatrist.

name: Запретная Япония
summary: A captivating travel show about journeys to mysterious Asia. This time, hosts Lorenzo Bagnati and Roman Kagramanov will explore popular and lesser-known Japanese regions, exploring the culture and discovering little-known local traditions.

name: Megastorm
summary: Extreme weather events examined from the inside out, including Hurricane Helene, the December Tennessee tornado outbreak and the vicious Black Summer of Australian wildfires, charting how and why they happen and the devastation left behind using first-hand survivor and witness accounts and adrenaline-fuelled footage captured on the ground.

name: Anantasaya
summary: Four young masters… one prophecy. And a journey of the heart where they choose their own path.

name: Предпринималити

name: Peccato

After tearing up the engagement, she meets Huo Jin — and in order to resist the Shen family's coercion, they form an alliance that gradually turns into love. When Shen Wang Chuan uses her mother to force her to break things off, Huo Jin sees through her façade and insists on pulling her into an even deeper game of power and intrigue.

name: Disney+ Hulu Throwbacks Podcast
summary: Welcome to the Disney+ Hulu Throwbacks podcast , a nostalgic deep dive into the iconic movies and shows that defined a generation. In each episode, hosts Sherry Cola and Cierra Ramirez are joined by special guests who were on the sets where the magic first happened. They answer burning questions, play games, and finally spill the behind-the-scenes stories.

name: Assassins
summary: In Assassins , a group of players compete in a ruthless game of cunning strategy and wit inspired by the massive global phenomenon played in real life around the world. From the moment they arrive, each player is assigned a target — one person they must eliminate before the season is out. But in this game, every hunter is also the hunted, and no one is ever safe. With shifting alliances and deception, only the most calculating player will survive to win it all.

name: Everybody Hates
summary: Pulling back the curtain on the origin stories that made the most polarizing and provocative athletes in sports history.

name: Desires
summary: A woman, pregnant and fed up with her husband's possessive love and controlling behavior, runs away. When he finally finds her five years later, shocking truths come to light and their love is tested once more.

summary: Xu Zhiyou suffers hardship from her lover and others, but she comes to her senses and cuts off her misplaced affections. Facing life's difficulties head-on, she bravely makes a living. She enters the workplace, upholding her principles and remaining independent and self-reliant, facing difficulties and exclusion with composure and openness. Fortunately, she finds a loving partner in Huo Yuzhou, and they treat each other with sincerity and mutual devotion. name: Less Than a Stranger - Dear and Annoying You
summary: The day her first crush became her "older brother," Kiyoka's faint feelings of love as a child were quietly contained. With a nameless love in her heart, Kiyoka continued to gaze upon her "older brother," Fuuto. However, Fuuto had other plans. While celebrating his engagement, an incident suddenly occurs that shakes the house. The threads of fate that intertwine the two, who can no longer become strangers, will eventually tear them apart.

name: Dai Wa Shan Hun, Gu Zong Bie Tai Ai Wo
summary: A single mother, Lin Qianqian, plans to enter into a marriage of convenience with a local man so she can register her son's household. Gu Yan, the head of a powerful group, also goes to the civil affairs bureau to arrange a marriage of convenience in order to fulfill an elder's dying wish. The two unexpectedly meet there. Mistaking Gu Yan for the man she was supposed to marry, Lin Qianqian impulsively marries him. Unbeknownst to them, the two had crossed paths six years earlier, and Lele, Lin Qianqian's son, is actually their child. After the wedding, Gu Yan quietly protects the mother and son

When she wakes up at the moment of the proposal, she chooses revenge—bringing the two together and leading them toward ruin. But as she grows closer to the man she once turned away, her feelings begin to change. Caught between revenge and love, can Ye Rin reclaim everything and find true love?

name: Silent Summer of Love
summary: After four years, Xiao Heng is finally released from prison, and Xia Shisheng comes to pick him up. She is determined to see him, as she senses that she has something to do with his imprisonment, and also wants to confirm if he was the one who kept sending her flowers back then. However, he is avoidant as he feels no longer worthy of her...

name: Victoria
summary: Victoria is an erotic thriller that follows Maxine Tao, a brilliant con artist who finds herself in a dark web of power, luxury and the crosshairs of a seductive killer who knows her secrets. Maxine is thrust into the seductive, high-stakes world of venture capital after a chance encounter grants her the grift of a lifetime.

name: Miss Qiao's Top White Moonlight
summary: When Qiao Xing Ye was 8 years old, she was abandoned by her adoptive parents and was eventually picked up by Qiao Rong Chuan and brought up in the Qiao family. When Qiao Xing Ye was betrayed by her fiancé and hurt by her family, the man who raised Qiao Xing Ye came to Hong Kong to stand up for her, which shocked the entire upper-class society.

name: Invisible
summary: After a desperate call from her brother, missing for thirty years, Emma Le Roux returns to South Africa to find him. With bodyguard Dekker at her side, her search crosses paths with Colonel Phatudi's investigation into a deadly conspiracy.

name: Signals
summary: Mysterious and dangerous cyberattacks shake the foundations of Icelandic society. A journalist and a police officer, bound by a fragile new romance, must each uncover the perpetrators in their own way while protecting their relationship.

name: Bella from Barneys
summary: Bella from Barneys follows Bella Baldwin, an outer-borough outsider with an eye for style, who lands a job in the stock room of the newly revived Barneys New York. When she talks her way into becoming a personal shopper to the store's most notorious socialite client, she's pulled into a cutthroat world of fashion and family secrets, and into the orbit of the heir fighting to save the family business.

name: Mommy Guard
summary: A feel-good family story centered on a mother-and-son relationship, second chances, and the unsung heroes of security guards.

name: Echo of a Letter
summary: Smooth and tactful, Chen Wan can handle anything other than his feelings for Zhao Shengge. A business venture brings them together as partners, and Zhao Shengge unexpectedly begins making the first moves, gradually closing the distance Chen Wan has so carefully maintained. Will a secret love that never dared for hope finally bloom?

name: La Ley de Alicia
summary: Alicia watches her life come undone when her husband, Aurelio, is found guilty and imprisoned for corruption, after videos surface implicating him in a sex scandal. With her family under public scrutiny, she decides to return to the legal profession after 20 years and rebuild her career to move forward. As she tries to reclaim her professional standing and support her teenage children in this new reality, Alicia begins to question what she wants out of life. A reunion with a past love and changes in her relationship with Aurelio will force her to make a decision: return to the life she once kn

name: Keselyű
summary: A famous, sharp-tongued radio host sees his life shatter when a serial killer begins targeting his friends and family. Before each murder, the killer calls into his live broadcast to recite classic Hungarian poetry, forcing him to decode the poetic ciphers on air to save the next victim.

name: Besties' Coming Fortune
summary: Modern-day best friends Tian Yuyuan and Lin Shutiao unexpectedly find themselves transported into a novel about household power struggles. They become sisters-in-law destined to be framed in a flower boat scandal on their wedding night and die together as sacrificial characters. The two team up to thwart the eldest sister-in-law and the adopted daughter, Shen Wanwan, as they expose one scheme and trap after another, making money along the way to survive. Shen Cheng, the cold and aloof heir, is afflicted with a deadly poison and needs the heroine's blood to stay alive, while Shen He, the unruly

name: Kevin McCloud's Classic Car Road Trips

name: Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths
summary: From vampires and werewolves to demons and Frankenstein, Monsters: The Truth Behind the Myths unpacks the origin story of our most legendary monsters —and tracks their staying power across the centuries. It's a historical journey to the mindsets that made them and how folklore and superstition has intersected with science and popular culture right up until today.

name: Шатун
summary: The events of the series "Shatun" begin to develop in a country house where old school friends gathered - a doctor, a wealthy housewife, a successful entrepreneur, an investigator, an actor and a drunkard. It seems that there is nothing in common between them, however, despite the divergence of life paths, the main characters love to get together and share their experience.

name: Wij Alexander
summary: In 1909, a certain patient claims to be Prince Alexander and knows a lot about life at court. There are many hints from other quarters that this could very well be the "forgotten" crown prince and he has a mystery box, with information that could shake the entire royal family to its foundations.

name: Tirolerblut
summary: Tirolerblut tells the story of three generations of an Innsbruck police family living under one roof and their very different approaches to the crimes they have to solve.

name: Infinito Amor
summary: Ariel agrees to serve a prison sentence for a crime he did not commit in exchange for a promise that his seriously ill mother will be taken care of. His conviction costs him not only his freedom but also Cristina, the love of his life. Fifteen years later, upon his release, he discovers that everything was carefully orchestrated and sets out to clear his name, seek justice, and reunite with the woman he never stopped loving. But regaining his freedom is only the beginning. Ariel must find his mother and uncover who stole fifteen years of his life. Along the way, he faces betrayal, enemies dete

name: Vares 2.0
summary: Private detective Jussi Vares investigates surprising disappearances related to the Turku underworld. Based on the bestselling books by Reijo Mäki.

name: Guarded
summary: Former police officer Jess O'Brien agrees to work as an undercover bodyguard to protect self-centered billionaire, Mason Flynn. But Mason's need for a secret bodyguard isn't unfounded; Jess and Mason will find that there are more threats around him than initially thought. In the strange world of wealth and privilege, there are many potential enemies, making Jess's work harder and the stakes higher as she starts to fall in love with the billionaire she must protect.

name: Demons' Crest
summary: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

name: The Quest
summary: The series stars Perry King, Noah Beery Jr., Karen Austin, and Ray Vitte as potential heirs to the throne of a fictional European monarchy that, were its king to die without issue, would revert to rule by France

name: Quirky
summary: Showcases Quirky, a unique product development company that lets its online community submit ideas for new inventions.

name: Sexual Lessons
summary: After a harsh breakup, Seong-ho seeks skinship lessons to understand what went wrong—only to find his tutor is a man. What begins as a lesson in touch soon turns into something deeper, blurring the lines between teacher and student, friendship and something more.

name: Unskilled Adult
summary: After years of successfully mucking around for a living, Hamish Blake has realised when it comes to practical skills, he doesn't have many. To remedy this, Hamish starts a business helping real people with jobs they really need done, for real money and putting himself firmly on the hook. Each week, Hamish recruits two equally underqualified personalities to join him in tackling a challenge none of them are remotely prepared for. From welding a trailer or catering a wedding to drywalling a salami shed and sewing costumes for a community theatre, Hamish and his team will jump in at the deep end

name: Hotel Blöff

In the reality series, 10 pairs of celebrities move into a luxury hotel, where they compete against one another for a grand prize of 20 million HUFs. Success depends on who can bluff without being noticed and forge strategic alliances.

name: Feng Le！Lao Ban Yi Wei Wo Zhen Xiang Zhui Ta
Dear Song
summary: To seek justice for her father, Yu Song takes a job as an assistant in the Song household. Her sincerity wins Song Cheng over, and she teams up with Jing, a driver, to gather evidence and expose the Song family's crimes. But she refuses to let hatred consume her. She breaks free from what has held her back and realizes that real victory means taking control of her own life. In the end, she embraces life with newfound freedom and hope.

name: Der Restauranttester
summary: In each episode, the protagonist - a successful chef - visits a restaurant that is struggling. His mission is to save the establishment. To do this, he evaluates its kitchen, service, and management, subsequently confronting the owners with his analysis, which is often delivered in blunt, hard-hitting terms. Depending on the specific situation, he either proposes strategies or works collaboratively with the owners to refine the existing concept—or replace it entirely. The typical timeframe is one week; while this often spans seven days, it may conclude as early as the fifth day, or, in cases r

name: Comedian vindt werk
summary: Flemish comedians take on the challenge of performing a 'difficult job.' After three days on the job, tired and having gained new perspective, they put on a performance for their temporary colleagues.

name: Dreamland
summary: Ever since his mother died in a fire, Terrence has drifted through life in a fog of apathy, terrified by any flame. The same nightmare haunts him every night, until he finally confronts his phobia. By overcoming his fear, Terrence becomes a Voyager, able to command fire and cross into Dreamland, the mysterious dimension where humanity's dreams and nightmares come to life.

name: In Lilac Bloom, The Path to a Veterinarian
summary: Satori is a socially withdrawn girl who enters a veterinary school in Hokkaido. In this coming of age story she strives to become a veterinarian while having to deal with the reality of life and death.

name: Restraint by Day, Indulgence by Night
summary: Si Yimian unexpectedly finds herself inside a tragic romance novel as its long-suffering heroine, trapped by a biased family and a sham engagement. Determined not to repeat the original story, she takes matters into her own hands. She approaches He Sichen, the seemingly unapproachable eldest son of the He family, and uses their connection to gain access to a key family project. At Yu'an Group, their professional dealings become a charged game of strategy and attraction. While fending off her scheming adoptive older sister and her family's indifference, Yimian steadily takes control of her own

name: Kissing the Wolf
summary: An Yifeng, heir to the powerful Lei Group, saves Situ Chun, the cherished daughter of a police family, from a deadly pursuit. It's love at first sight for him, and when they meet again and she tends to his wounds, their attraction only grows. Before they even know each other's names, he asks if he can pursue her. But once their identities come to light, their budding romance comes to an abrupt halt. He tries to push her away, warning her that he's a bad man she should avoid, yet she doesn't hesitate to shield him when a gun is aimed his way. Caught between two opposing worlds, he risks everyth

summary: Just like every Filipino worker, Boi faces daily struggles as a delivery rider but must endure them to provide for his loved ones. On the other hand, Boi also takes the role of one of the modern heroes today, delivering convenience and service to customers. Through his noble job, Boi learns a thing or two from the people he meets on the road. Because of his loving personality, positive outlook, and warmth to everyone around him, Boi unexpectedly changes their lives, too. And despite the struggles caused by the enemies he didn't make, Boi continues fighting for his goals with one big wish in hi

name: Zhizhi's Delayed Marriage, My New Boss Turned Out To Be My Ex-Husband
summary: Song Zhi once had a marriage that ended almost as quickly as it began. She and Chi Yuchuan rushed into marriage, divorced just as fast, and she believed that once they separated, they would simply go their separate ways and become strangers again. Four years later, that plan falls apart when Chi Yuchuan suddenly appears in front of her desk—as her new boss. Still carrying years of anger and hurt, he finally explodes and accuses Song Zhi of abandoning both her husband and daughter. But beneath all the resentment are wounds neither of them ever truly dealt with.

summary: Bad Girls Club: Unfinished Business is a two-episode unscripted special event hosted by Bad Girls Club icon Tanisha Thomas. The special event reunites six unforgettable personalities from Season 7 of the iconic Bad Girls Club franchise, Fandango's most-watched season: Angie Castillo, Judi Jackson, Priscilla Mennella, Shelly Hickman, Stasi Townsend, and Tiara Hodge. Nearly a decade after the original series last aired, the Bad Girls are back, to finish what they started.

name: The Heart Is in Care and the Time Is Worth It
summary: Xu An Ran lost her memory in a car accident and was rescued by the chairman of Gu Group and arranged to marry Gu Jin Cheng. On the eve of the wedding, the two had a relationship by accident. They canceled the wedding and missed their meeting. Later, Xu An Ran became a designer in Gu Jin Cheng's company. He mistakenly thought she came for love.

name: Bløff
summary: In a fairytale castle, ten contestants compete against each other in a game that isn't about how smart you are, but about how smart people think you are.

name: Only Joking
summary: Presented by Bradley Walsh, Only Joking is a game show in which two families compete to tell jokes in each round.

name: You Must Be Joking
summary: You Must Be Joking is a comedy panel game show presented by Bradley Walsh.

name: Slumbering With Wolves
summary: Focusing on the growth of young people in the new era and the pursuit of the rule of law and justice, the story follows criminal psychology expert Gu Yan and his partner Shen Yu as they stay true to their original ideals and justice, work together to solve perplexing cases, and uncover the truth. Blending suspenseful mind games with reflections on human nature, it focuses on real-world issues such as moral limits and self-protection. It keeps pace with the times, with a fresh narrative approach and tight pacing.

name: Rally
summary: In Rally , at a hyper-competitive elite tennis academy, ambitious young players discover that the loneliest sport in the world demands sacrificing the very connections that might be the only thing that makes winning worth it.

name: Unwavering Marriage
summary: Fu Qingshao, for the sake of a political marriage, demanded that his wife not fall in love with him, only that they maintain a respectful relationship. Meng Yu, the youngest daughter of the Meng family, had just been found by her family and forced to break up with her ex-boyfriend. She was still in tears when she went on her blind date, perfectly matching Fu Qingshao's standards. After they registered their marriage, Fu Qingshao went to Europe to expand his market. The estranged couple reunited two years later, fulfilling only necessary marital obligations and keeping to themselves. Everyone a

name: Politically Incorrect
summary: Bill Maher and a chaotic panel of four politicians, actors, and public figures sit down to break the rules of polite conversation, tackling the week's biggest headlines with unfiltered humor and clashing opinions.
