name: Pursuit
summary: Pusuit explores the psychological and physical stakes of the hunter and the hunted, where each standalone episode centers on an individual or group desperately being pursued.

name: The Queen and I
summary: A junior officer serving aboard a once-popular but now aging and run-down cruise ship, the Amsterdam Queen , discovers that the new owners intend to sell the vessel for scrap. In a desperate attempt to save their ship, he and the rest of the crew embroil themselves in a number of "get rich quick" schemes.

name: Universe of Love
summary: Upcountry guy Natee moves to Bangkok where he stays at the home of tidy introvert Pruek. Pruek has to adjust to living with cheerful Natee. Pruek develops a fondness for Natee, though he dares not admit it. At university, Natee makes friends with Earth and June and the three join a club run by odd art professor Niti. When Pruek's close friend Sun first comes to visit at the house, he develops an instant affection for Natee. He begins pursuing him, much to Pruek's discomfort. Furthermore, whenever Sun and Earth meet, there's tension.

name: Walk to Kwangya
summary: Han So Ran, who doesn't have a single friend in the real world, her only true friend is 'ke-Soran' who lives in Kwangya. One day, she accidentally encounters her ex-boyfriend who broke up with her by ghosting her four years ago, and he was living in the so-called "Analog Mode" as he does not use a smartphone or SNS. The secret that So Ran and ke-So Ran who lives in both Kwangya and the real world that cannot be told to Do Kwang starts to be dug up.

name: Retrosexual: The '80s
summary: This five-hour mini-series is all about what was sexy during the "Me Decade" of the 1980s. People love nostalgia. They also love sex. Retrosexual: The '80s takes these two cornerstones of culture and finally puts them together. Whether it's film, TV, music, fashion, sports, politics or advertising, they pull back the curtain and sneak a peak at all the titillating, fun-filled and steamy moments that made the decade hotter than exercise video spandex. As they look back at an era before ubiquitous thongs and Internet porn, they note that what is commonplace today was often groundbreaking and sca

name: One of a Kind Romance
summary: One of a Kind Romance follows the story of an ordinary job-seeker whose everyday life is suddenly disrupted by a celebrated actor and a rising idol, leading to a romance brimming with personal desires.

name: Точка опори
summary: Точка опори is structured as a candid conversation with prominent Ukrainians—including actors, directors, volunteers, military personnel, athletes, and scholars. The show's primary objective is to use the stories of these significant figures to illustrate how Ukrainians are navigating the realities of a full-scale war, and how they discover inner transformation and the strength to continue living, working, and inspiring others.

name: Le Charles
summary: Le Charles follows a tense murder investigation aboard the French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle as it heads toward a high-intensity conflict zone.

name: Robin Hood
summary: The 1953 BBC live television mini-series Robin Hood follows the outlaw Robin Hood (played by Patrick Troughton) and his Merry Men as they fight against the Sheriff of Nottingham and navigate encounters with King Edward in 1950s-adapted medieval England.

name: Ryan
summary: An ex-cop turned private investigator named Michael Ryan navigates the gritty underworld of Melbourne, Australia, using his grit, smarts, and network of street informants to solve complex cases of murder, extortion, and crime.
previous_episode: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Altar

name: The Apology
summary: The Apology follows Evelyn and Caleb Amspoker whose son was murdered 18 years ago in a cold case that gripped the nation. When a stranger suddenly appears and confesses, justice finally seems possible — until they learn the killer may get off with a reduced sentence. Faced with that unbearable truth, Evelyn and Caleb decide to take matters into their own hands.

name: La Terre et le Sang
summary: Anto, a Parisian police officer of Corsican origin, returns to his family's vineyard in Corsica to break a multi-generational cycle of family vendettas, only to be ambushed, fall into a 10-year coma, and awaken to find his teenage son consumed by the very same desire for revenge.

name: Plateau of Fear
summary: A British journalist investigates mysterious attacks on a nuclear power station in the Andes mountains of South America, suspecting a giant beast is responsible.

name: Conversations With a Mobster
summary: This is a series in which old mafia friends in the witness program reminisce about the old days: we actually see recreations of famous mob hits.

name: The Rotters' Club
summary: The Rotters' Club is a story about a group of Birmingham teenagers and their families set against a backdrop of the class conflict, racial tension, strike action - not to mention Blue Nun, prog-rock and black forest gateau - which was the social and political landscape of Seventies Britain. Much more than just a rites of passage tale, The Rotters' Club is a blend of the personal and the political, a coming-of-age drama that takes in everything from industrial disputes to the delights and confusion of first love.

name: Riptide
summary: Following the tragic death of his wife, an American man sails solo from San Francisco to Australia, where he decides to stay and operate a coastal charter boat business, frequently getting entangled in local crimes, rescues, and maritime adventures.

name: Killer Clues: Forensics
summary: Killer Clues: Forensics is a true crime series where the smallest piece of evidence cracks the most baffling cases. Each episode follows a single murder investigation and the forensic breakthrough, from DNA and genetic genealogy to digital footprints, cell records, and trace evidence, that turns an unsolvable case into an airtight conviction. The series shows how science speaks for victims who can no longer speak for themselves, proving that no matter how careful the killer, the evidence always remembers.

name: Fleiri Pabbahelgar
summary: Karen, a single mother of three for dreadful five years now, has become an experienced Tinder user and a dating expert. She is seeking for the ever so perfect love but might end up with the nuclear family she is surprisingly not ready for.

name: Never Ending Story
summary: Never Ending Story follows Doyun, a bestselling romance novelist struggling with writer's block for a sequel to his hit book Never Ending Story , who begins working out at a gym and forms a close relationship with a personal trainer named Hyunwoo.

summary: The saga of the Knight Sabers continues in MegaTokyo, 2034. After taking a brief hiatus, the group of mercenary women in advanced hard suits is forced to reunite. A mysterious cybernetic faction known as the "Illegal Army" has initiated a string of high-tech robberies and murders, stealing advanced artificial intelligence components. The Knight Sabers must put aside their differences to combat the rogue Boomers and stop a virus threat threatening the city.

name: Therapy
summary: Jung Woogyo, who has lived a long period without sex, enrolls in a four-week confidential sexual therapy program. To his surprise, his therapist is the composed, highly professional—and strikingly fit—Park Heesu. From the awakening of hidden sensitivities to increasingly intense sessions of deep physical connection, Heesu guides Woogyo through unexplored realms of sensation. name: Escaping Idi Amin

name: Francesca Next Door

Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

name: Wo De Xing Dong Qi Yue
First Dates Greece
summary: Will our chemistry work? And no matter how much times change, we can all agree that a tête-à-tête romantic dinner will always be the most beautiful FIRST DATE.

name: Thirty-Six Stratagems: Slay
summary: When the Strait Command Tower is hit, Yan Zizhou, also known as Night Blade, is assigned to investigate, only for his sister Xiaoxiao to suddenly plunge from a building. Using the Thirty-Six Stratagems, he joins forces with his second brother Zong Xiaoquan, and Li Li, Xiaoxiao's separated twin sister, to help local police reveal, through Li Luo, the case of their parents' murder eighteen years earlier and bring He Huan and her sibling, Kang Qingtian, and the other chief culprits to justice.

name: Boogies Diner
summary: A kind of "Beverly Hills 90210" and "Saved by the Bell" hybrid with some "Facts of Life" thrown in the syndicated series centers on a diner/store and the seven teens who work there. The cast includes Jason (Jimmy Marsden) "resident hunk" with a Boy Scout's code of honor: Cynthia (Robin Stapler) a perky waitress; Cheryl-Ann (Joy Tanner), who's described as having unlimited credit but a limited personality; Zoya (Monika Schnarre), who's 6-foot-1 and beautiful; Tymp (Richard Chevolleau), the store's deejay and mix master; Kirby (Zack Ward), the strange chef; and Gerald (Jim J. Bullock), the hyste

name: Blood & Sweat
summary: Two detectives - Watanabe and Pääkkönen - from Japan and Finland unite to solve serial murders spanning both countries, bridged by their common dedication to justice.

name: Rising Turbulence
summary: Six major cases involving organized crime erupt in succession. Interest groups at home and abroad move along the trail, quietly jockeying for position. Undercover officer Tang Jinze infiltrates the gang world. As investigative threads slowly converge, the hidden links behind the cases surface one by one.

name: Overseas Security Guard
summary: Set against the Belt and Road backdrop, this drama focuses on a real-world story of overseas private security. Wei Tian, a man with top-level protective skills, loses his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack. He assumes a hidden identity in Antilocaris and forms a private security squad called "The Silent Ones" to protect Chinese compatriots living abroad.

name: History's Mystery Files
summary: History has spent decades investigating the mysteries that challenge what we know about the past, and what we think is possible. History's Mystery Files revisits the most unforgettable cases, from sacred discoveries and bizarre weapons to unsolved disappearances and high strangeness. Hosted by Jorge Garcia, each episode follows the clues, the evidence and the questions that refuse to go away.

name: The Sandy Duncan Show
summary: A young, upbeat woman moves to UCLA to work as a secretary for an advertising firm while renting a room from an eccentric couple. Her high-spirited personality and well-meaning nature frequently lead her into amusing, chaotic situations both at her desk and with her landlords' quirky family.

name: Gift
summary: Depicts the story of professional baseball coach Jung Min Yong, who gains extraordinary abilities after an unexpected accident and takes on the role of head coach for the last-place amateur Deokcheon High School baseball team, leading to a passionate, intense, and tear-jerking season. He gains the power to rate the level and ability of baseball players and scouts Tae Hun as a first-team pitcher, after seeing in him the potential to become a great player. The story unfolds as the players express their dissatisfaction with the newly appointed coach.

name: Kollaps - Profeten i Bærum
summary: On a farm in Bærum, former multi-millionaire Christian Sønstebø leads a community that shares his conviction about preparing for the collapse of society. He himself is guided by a calling from God and has grand plans for himself and those closest to him.

name: Zero Hour
summary: In Zero Hour , when mysterious ovals appear in the sky, the world changes forever. In the minutes that follow, a wife fights to keep her ailing husband alive, a doomsday prepper races to get his family to safety, teenage runaways are caught in the middle of a bank robbery, and a brilliant young presidential aide scrambles to make sense of it all. What begins as a pulse-pounding survival story slowly unravels into a sweeping mystery, as the truth about who these visitors are, and why they have come, upends everything humanity thought it knew about first contact.

name: Open House Outrageous
summary: Interior designer Megan Batoon and comedian Tim Chantarangsu taking exciting tours of unusual vacation homes and distinctive stays in destinations.

name: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
summary: The new Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea series follows brilliant ocean scientist Lee Crane, who is pulled into a classified government program after a catastrophic Arctic expedition claims the life of her twin sister. At the center of the program is the USS Seaview, a retro-futuristic submarine found entombed in the ice, marked with symbols from a history that shouldn't exist, and it powers up only when Lee steps aboard. Thrust into command of a pressure-cooker crew and an uneasy alliance with government power brokers, Lee leads Seaview on daring undersea missions to contain mysterious forces

name: Desafío Champions Sendokai
summary: Four unpopular Earth kids find mystic bracelets that transport them to another dimension, where they must master the ancient art of Sendokai and win a cosmic tournament to save Earth from the Zorn Empire.

name: In vitro
summary: Set in a fertility clinic called Ginestia in Barcelona, the story follows Blanca, a 37-year-old embryologist, and her colleagues as they navigate the emotional, ethical, and scientific dilemmas of modern assisted reproduction.

name: Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion
summary: Fixer Upper: Chip Bought a Mansion take viewers inside every step of the transformation as Chip and Jo navigate unexpected setbacks, budget challenges and the unique opportunities that come with renovating a property of this scale. In the premiere, the couple hosts a pre-renovation open house to gather feedback from realtors and the community as they develop a plan for the massive project ahead. To help shape her vision, Jo leans on her designer friends for guidance and a fresh perspective. Then, as work gets underway; Chip searches for creative ways to offset costs, including selling salvaged

name: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal
summary: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal examines allegations of misconduct, abuse of power, favoritism and competition rigging that have shaken the pageant world. Former contestants and insiders, including Taylor Hale (Miss Michigan 2021/Miss USA contestant) Noelia Voigt (Miss USA 2023) and Brittany Mason (Miss Indiana 2008/Miss USA contestant) share their experiences as concerns around contestant safety, financial pressures, ownership disputes and leadership turmoil come into focus. The nation's best-loved TV stars are invited to unwind and open up about what made them who they are today, with never-heard-before behind-the-scenes stories and moments that shaped them.

name: New Wave
summary: This series tells the fascinating story of New Wave music and the decade from 1977 to 1987 that brought alternative culture into the mainstream. The four-part series will take us on a journey through the rise of New Wave from its rebellious origins to its influential impact on music, fashion, and pop culture. New Wave defined a generation and reshaped the musical landscape in part by embracing women, the queer community and new technology while in the process creating a legacy that is still influencing us today.

name: Ai, I Love You
summary: Phuwasol had to fly back to Thailand, seeing his father take his life because of financial problem. All of property were seized and sold by bank. He and mother need to move to relative house at province. At here, meeting Chattawan, the naughty girl who seem to dislike his arrogant. He is always teased by her, to face with any supernatural incident at here.

name: Retribution
summary: A rich family that is believed to be cursed because of the mysterious death of all the men in the family leaving only the women alive. This is the story about how sweet and innocent love flourishes in the middle of harsh tribulations, and how far scarier than a mystical curse is the curse caused by love, greed, anger, and delusion in the human heart.

name: The Scammer Games
summary: A group of eight scammers must come together to defraud the mafia gang. They were hired by a mysterious figure known as "The Admin." With the promise of a large prize money, their tasks revolve around scamming several illegitimate businesses including underground lottery, illegal gambling and call center gang. In order pull off the biggest heist for a mysterious entity as they unknowingly discover the dark truths behind this whole operation.

name: Chaar Yaar
summary: Chaar Yaar is a story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

name: Коллекционер
summary: In each episode, five star contestants find themselves in a mysterious castle, where they must complete eight challenges. The tasks test logic, courage, erudition, ingenuity, and physical fitness.

name: Next Gen ATL
summary: Next Gen Atlanta follows a new generation of rising personalities making their mark. Some have famous ties, while others are building their reputations from the ground up, but all have big dreams and plenty to prove as they juggle careers, friendships and family dynamics.

name: Griff Across the Alps
summary: Griff Rhys Jones takes on one of the world's most celebrated mountain ranges by train as he explores from Slovenia to France, uncovering how the Alps have shaped Europe's history, wars, trade, and communities. From Hannibal's famous elephant crossing in 218 BC, to Napoleon's Alpine campaigns, pilgrim trails, medieval traders, and WWII Escape Routes, The Alps have played a pivotal role in some of humanities greatest historical moments and influenced the spread and survival of culture for centuries. Starting with the Alp's eastern end at the stunning Lake Bled and ending on the Mediterranean bea

name: Killing the Writer

However, during a celebration on a secluded island, he unexpectedly travels through time and discovers that he is destined to be stabbed to death with a steak knife at midnight. Everyone at the villa seems to be hiding something: Xiaotao, his longtime friend who demands writing credit for the novel; Sophie, his obsessive girlfriend; An'an, his troubled ex-girlfriend; and Mr. Dai, a copyright representative. With each of them under suspicion, Li

name: Lawyer Sheng's Rules Before Divorce
summary: Sheng Yan thought she could keep her feelings for Jiang Mo a secret forever, but he is the one who speaks up first. Even after they marry, she spends their days together wondering how much she truly means to him, convinced she is the one who has more to lose. Then she begins to see cracks in her seemingly unshakable husband's composure: he loses his cool when something happens to her, lies awake over a single thing she says, and tears up when she asks for a divorce. Sheng Yan may have fallen first, but Jiang Mo is the first to admit just how much this marriage means to him.

name: Night Port Love Letter
summary: Eight years of a perfect relationship, their shared work, and their future plans are shattered in an instant when Lin Wenjun discovers she's been unfaithful. Her ex-lover, convinced she's worthless after 30, takes away her most important career project. But a chance encounter with a young, daring photographer changes everything. Can a mature woman trust a fleeting feeling when intrigue swirls around her and her ex is trying to destroy her reputation?

name: King of Ashes
summary: King of Ashes is centered on Roman Carruthers, who returns home to his family's crematory business in Virginia after his father is left comatose in a suspicious hit-and-run, only to discover his brother's criminal debts have put the entire family in danger—and he'll do whatever it takes to protect them.

name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
summary: In the heart of Texas Hill Country is the picture‑perfect town of Boerne where wealth, beauty, faith and family reign supreme. Centered on a tight-knit circle of glamorous women, this series follows their lives as they raise families, run ranches and farms and manage sparkling social calendars in a town rooted in rodeos and tradition. Behind the polished smiles and Sunday sermons, however, there are intimate relationships and forbidden romances that test loyalties and marriages, jeopardizing the town's pristine image and proving that perfection is far more complicated than anyone could imagine

name: Milestones of the Solar System
summary: The solar system we know may seem eternal. Yet long before our Sun and planets began their elegant dance, billions of years of chaos and wreckage reigned supreme. From planets, asteroids, and moons forged from stardust, to volcanoes unleashing fiery destruction on Mars, and a cataclysmic collision that turned early Earth molten and gave birth to our Moon, this series explores the defining milestones of our Solar System. summary: Editorially Speaking follows journalists at a fictional publication called "Editorial Magazine" as they navigate careers, relationships, and the fashion media industry.

name: Sessions
summary: With the support of his wife, Dan Carver, a 40-something lawyer dealing with identity crisis, turns for help to psychoanalyst, Dr. Bookman.

name: Tamed
summary: Haunted by childhood trauma, Cheng Yu'an has shut himself off from the world. One rainy night, he takes in Lin Qi and they begin living together under a "master and pet" contract. But the gentle Lin Qi keeps breaking the rules, prompting Cheng Yu an to make exceptions, even going so far as to defy his family for him. As Lin Qi searches for the truth behind his father's death, Cheng Yu'an's buried secrets begin to surface. From offering him shelter to being unable to let him go, who will surrender his heart first in this game of taming? A cold-hearted lawyer and a gentle artist in a steamy roma

name: Dur Yolcu
summary: Following the death of his terminally ill wife, an Ottoman commander is forced to take his young daughter to the frontlines of the Battle of Gallipoli, where they face the horrors of war alongside a fearless Turkish female sniper locked in a deadly duel with Australia's most ruthless hunter.

name: Son Çıkış
summary: In the story that begins in a suburb of Istanbul, the events between Kenan Cesur, who shouldered the burden of a momentary mistake, and Zeynep proceed with an adventure full of ambition, passion and regret. Imam Yusuf and Teacher Nilüfer, on the other hand, become a beacon of hope for the young people whose dreams are gradually disappearing in the dark road they enter by saying "Nothing can happen for once".

name: Репортаж-2035
summary: 2035. An investigative journalist informs the FSB and the GRU that he has discovered an AI assistant developed for criminals. After hacking the program, the heroes gain access to the archives of the world's major terrorist attacks. They are forced to implant neurochips in themselves in order to penetrate the darknet metaverse and stop the evil.

name: Cyclone Tracy
summary: On Christmas Day, 1974, the eye of Cyclone Tracy ripped through Darwin, leaving the city in ruins. Over 100 people were killed, 20 000 were left homeless, and 80 percent of the city's buildings were destroyed. It was the worst natural disaster in Australian history. This highly acclaimed, three part mini-series depicts the events of that terrifying Christmas, celebrating the spirit and courage of the people who survived the devastation. Caught in the excitement of a hot Australian Christmas, many locals failed to heed early warnings and were left helpless in the face of the cyclone's fury. But

name: Catfish Murders
summary: Across ten gripping episodes, Catfish Murders reveals the extreme lengths people will go to exploit trust and the deadly consequences when their lies spill into the real world.

name: Battle of the Streaming Stars
summary: Terry Crews hosts as 12 streaming stars split into teams and battle through challenges inspired by iconic TV moments for the Golden Roku Remote.

name: LOL: Last One Laughing US
summary: Contestants must try to crack each other up using every trick in the book while desperately trying to keep a straight face themselves; whoever holds out the longest without laughing wins.

name: SuperKitties: Su-Purr Adventures
summary: An adorable and action-packed series that will showcase the feline cast's superhero skills and kitty kindness that they use to work together as a team to make their town of Kittydale a great place to live.

name: Assenheim
summary: Assenheim features an intimate, one-on-one dinner interview with notable public figures. While the premise involves him meeting and sharing a meal with a different guest each week, the title on the screen is strictly his last name.

name: Сладкий мир
summary: An informative travel show in which renowned pastry chef Renat Agzamov embarks on a "sweet" expedition. From India and Egypt to Italy, each country is explored through the lens of its desserts and traditions.

name: Estranei
summary: In Correggio, a small town in Emilia-Romagna, home to one of the largest Sikh communities in Italy, the disappearance of two young lovers shatters the town's equilibrium. The case is investigated by Laura, a "carabiniera" who has returned home to care for her ailing father, working alongside Bisan, a cousin of the missing young man who has just returned after years spent in the French Foreign Legion.

name: Crime and Punishment in America
summary: Crime and Punishment in America is a four-part series that tells the story of criminal justice in America from the colonial era to today, and explores how for more than 250 years, Americans have wrestled with the problem of crime, the purpose of punishment and the meaning of justice.

name: First Footprints
summary: Over 50,000 years of Australia's ancient past is brought to life through the world's oldest oral stories, new archaeological discoveries, stunning art, cinematic CGI and never before seen archival film.
previous_episode: The Biggest Estate: 9,000 Years Ago to 1788

name: House of Sweet Dreams
summary: Xie Huaiyu and Lan Qianning grew up together, but one day Huaiyu suddenly disappeared from her life. Years later, he returns just before Qianning's engagement. For her, he's still the closest person she has ever known, and for him, she's the love he's forbidden himself to feel for years. But what will happen when hiding his feelings becomes impossible?

name: La masacre de Flores
summary: The story of Matías Bagnato, the sole survivor of the Flores Massacre, one of the most shocking criminal cases in Argentine history.

name: The Narco Hack
summary: Once considered impenetrable, the encrypted messaging service Sky ECC became a safe haven for organized crime. When French and European investigators manage to infiltrate the system, they intercept more than a billion messages, exposing drug trafficking, money laundering and planned murders. Featuring testimonies from investigators and criminals, this documentary series explores one of the most extraordinary police operations against international organized crime.

name: Snapped: Killer Moms
summary: Mothers will do absolutely anything for their children. High-emotion and high-stakes stories where a mother's unconditional love twists into bloodshed, as matriarchs stop at nothing to protect or avenge their kids.

name: The Great White
summary: The Great White tells the story of a brilliant but disgraced barrister Alan Armstrong who is slapped with a twelve-month supervision order for professional misconduct, and finds himself working out of a struggling law office above a panel beater's shop in Sydney's eastern suburbs.

name: Charmed by a Southern Monster
summary: The story follows Maeve, a brilliant corporate fixer sent to convince and seduce Hunter, a rumored murderer, into selling his family's estate. But when she discovers that the town's most feared man may actually be its most misunderstood, and the only person who can protect her from her dangerous ex-boyfriend, Maeve becomes entangled in Hunter's world.

name: You Alone Know Me
summary: Dumped for money by childhood sweetheart Gu Zheng, adopted daughter Lin Hua takes best friend Xie Bao'er's advice and enters a contract marriage with Bao'er's father, Xie Zhouhan. He quietly protects her. She learns her mother once cared for him in his youth, and he has loved Lin Hua for years. She lets go of her past and opens her heart. They tear up their contract and choose a lifetime of love.

name: Angels of Death: Origins
summary: An animated anthology prequel series to "Angels of Death", set in the grimdark universe of Warhammer 40,000. The mini-series delves into the backstories and hidden origins of the key characters and the crew of the Blood Angels' Strike Cruiser, the Sword of Baal, exploring their duties, sacrifices, and inner struggles before the main events.

name: The Black Tapes
summary: In The Black Tapes , Dr. Richard Strand, a brilliant psychiatrist with a mysterious past, teams with the obsessed, relentless scientist Alex Regan to debunk paranormal cases of hauntings, possessions, disappearances, and sinister legends – the infamous black tapes. But as Strand and Regan unravel the secrets of these events, they uncover a hidden occult world behind our own and must unravel a centuries-old apocalyptic conspiracy.

name: Vow of Autumn
summary: Deceived by a married jerk, lawyer Wen Wanqing gets drunk and accidentally kisses her best friend's younger brother, surgeon Pei Yiqiu—who has secretly loved her for years. As misunderstandings give way to romance, she breaks free from her toxic relationship, while he offers the tenderness she's always deserved. A two-way journey that began in their youth finally comes full circle, bringing them both a chance to heal.

name: Rise of the Underdog
summary: Ma Dawei's previous life ends in prison and family ruin, but he suddenly returns to the turning point of his fate. He resolutely avoids the pitfalls, grasps the opportunities of the age, and rises with momentum. Against one scheme after another, Ma Dawei cuts off old entanglements, protects his loved ones with all his strength, sails through the ups and downs of business, and sets off toward a brilliant new future that belongs to him.

name: The Hidden Shadows
summary: After finding her twin sister Ta's body, Nin assumes her identity to uncover the truth behind her death and seek revenge. She targets powerful minister Napha and her family, causing scandals that destroy careers and relationships.

name: Fiery Eyes
summary: Nicholas and Amara have a son named Itsara, and are expecting twin girls named Ornchuma and Inthira. As Amara is nearing her due date, they are visited by aunt Helen. She reminds Nicholas that the birth of a female child into their family will bring upon a horrible fate, as their family is cursed. Helen tries to kill the twins the night they are born, but fails. When the twins turn six, Inthira, the younger twin is angered to the point of becoming Medusa. She kills one of the servants in the house. Nicholas takes Inthira to Greece, in attempts to find a cure for the curse. Left behind are Amar

name: Silver Screen Paradise
summary: Orawan was a very popular actress in the past, but she was framed to cheat on Is, her partner on and off screen. Their wedding ceremony was cancelled and the scandal ruined her career. Years later, her daughter Nussara joined the entertainment industry to find out the truth about the scandal, while also searching for her celebrity father who refused to admit her as a child. Rungrawee, an actress who was Orawan's rival and is now married to Is, had a daughter named Pimdao who will become Nussara's rival in the industry and also in winning the love of Krit, a movie director.

name: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
summary: Rise of the Rockstar Chef charts the rise of three of Britain's most influential culinary figures, Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal, whose drive, creativity and uncompromising pursuit of excellence helped transform modern British cuisine and placed it firmly on the global stage. This series is set against the backdrop of the ‘Cool Britannia' era of radical social and cultural change. name: The Substitute
summary: Depicts the story of a high-achieving, low-income student who takes the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) for another person to avoid blackmail. Children are placed on an exam stage where they risk falling behind in life if they do not complete the CSAT safely. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas. Kang Geon Tae, the miracle of a "special

name: Love Bound
summary: Cracks waiting for the day they finally shatter. Three paths of love, each marked by labels. A love that began like a ray of light… but was broken by wounds from the past. A pure love ready to protect and heal a broken heart. A love that feels like a shackle, surrendering one's heart completely to the power of true love.

name: America's Funniest People
summary: From savage jokes and wild stunts to outrageous pranks, questionable decisions, and unforgettable viral moments, each episode showcases the kind of social content you can't believe someone actually posted. With her fearless humor and unapologetic perspective, Ms. Pat brings her signature comedic style to the competition as three hilarious content creators go head-to-head for a cash prize.

With her cleverness, kindness, and daring fighting spirit, she has grown into an excellent foreign trade merchandiser and business manager. But Jian Ai is not satisfied with the identity leap that has been achieved. After several setbacks, she established her own foreign trade company. Her relationship with Lin Hengzhi also became stronger and more equal.

name: Ye Se Qing Chan Shi
summary: After an enemy destroys her wedding, Zhou Tang targets the woman's powerful father, Huo Yanci, as part of a revenge plan, but their calculated relationship begins turning into something real.

name: Chi Ye Wen Rou
summary: At eighteen, Xu Xing's mother tragically died. Forced by her father to dig out her heart to save his stepdaughter, she fled to a mountain village in search of her grandmother. She met 26-year-old tattoo artist Wen Xun, who became protective and took care of her. After the college entrance exam, she planned to confess her love to Wen Xun. But he was caught in a mudslide and disappeared. Xu Xing switched to studying geology to find him. Four years later, they met again, and after some evasive action, Wen Xun finally confessed that he had missed her every day.

name: Gong Ni Lan Qing Kong
summary: What is it like to work in the same airline with a husband who is secretly married? The two met and got married under the arrangement of their families. After marriage, Lin Kong Yu joined Qin Si Yan's airline. As they got along, they gradually understood each other and fell in love.

name: Love Is Highly
summary: Her childhood sweetheart, Lu Jing Ran, is obsessed with the game of saving Cinderella. Shen Jin Yi decides to break up the engagement and find another man. After much deliberation, she musters up the courage to find Lu Jing Ran's eldest brother, Lu Hui Shi, the current head of the Lu Group.

name: Heart Flutter
summary: A mismatched blood type tears open the facade of Wen Xi's life, revealing she is not the legitimate daughter of the Wen Family. Weighing family interests, she marries Shang Chen, the heir to a prominent family in the capital. This marriage, which began as a contract, was initially icy cold. The lawyer Wen Xi and the powerful Shang Chen lived under the same roof, their lives running parallel like lines. name: Nest Of Hearts
summary: Business-school lecturer Chao Ning and IT executive Yi Linxun meet through a practical blind date, both carrying scars from previous relationships and neither particularly interested in falling in love again. They agree to a six-month trial marriage with an unusual bet: whoever asks for a divorce first loses. What begins as a deliberately emotionless arrangement changes through everyday companionship, especially when Yi Linxun quietly supports Chao Ning through a career crisis and both begin lowering the defenses they built after their past relationships. Just as they finally admit their feeli

summary: Polina, 40, suffers from anterograde amnesia, which means she has to face the reality every day that her daughter, Taya, is missing. But the mother refuses to believe the worst and, despite her illness, conducts her own investigation, piecing together the events of what happened with the help of a diary. Polina increasingly suspects that Taya's disappearance was no accident and that her loved ones are hiding the truth from her.

name: Игра в прятки
summary: Investigator Andrei Skuratov is investigating a series of mysterious deaths: the victims die from their own phobias, and an equally eerie smile is frozen on their faces. The only lead is the drug "Guru" found in their blood. When the trail leads to his own wife, a practicing psychologist, Andrei breaks every rule of his profession to get to the bottom of the truth. But the deeper he digs, the more he realizes that someone is orchestrating this game, knowing all his weaknesses inside and out.

name: Murder in Belfast: Sisters Seeking Justice
summary: Murder in Belfast: Sisters Seeking Justice tells the story of the working-class women who challenged the might of the IRA. With evidence destroyed and an IRA cover up underway, the five sisters of Robert and his fiancée fought a very public campaign to bring his killers to justice and to discover the truth.

name: Love Beyond Palace Walls
summary: Modern-day heiress sisters Lin Zhaohua and Lin Yumian are transported into a period romance drama. Lin Zhaohua, the decisive and formidable CEO of a powerful conglomerate, becomes the long-lost biological daughter of the Chancellor's Mansion, who was separated from them for sixteen years. Her younger sister, Lin Yumian, who has suffered from chronic illness and paralysis for years, becomes the pampered adopted daughter who has enjoyed eighteen years of privilege—and finally gains the healthy body she has always wished for. After returning to the Chancellor's Mansion, Lin Zhaohua uses her intel

summary: Young violinist Su Ge lives alone with her grandfather, a master potter. One day, she accidentally meets the brilliant pianist Meng Xinyan and captivates him with her musical talent. Thus begins their daily routine, full of playful banter and sweet confrontation. Su Ge boldly pursues her feelings: although she's still inexperienced, her passion and fearlessness know no bounds. Her flirtations repeatedly throw Meng Seungyan off balance, and he, with helpless seriousness, asks her to stop teasing him. Will they be able to overcome the age difference and preserve their love?

name: La Intrusa
summary: What would happen if a woman could exchange her life with that of another woman who is her exact double? That's what Estrella de Rossi, a wealthy and capricious woman bored with her marriage and family, does. One day, she meets Virginia, a humble and kind young woman who is her spitting image. Estrella proposes a deal: she will pay her a large sum of money if she agrees to impersonate her for a year. Virginia, pressured by circumstances, accepts the deal and moves into Estrella's mansion. name: Andrew Tate: Toxic Empire
summary: Andrew Tate promises wealth and brotherhood. Followers and alleged victims offer a rare look behind his powerful online empire.

name: Jiu Ming! Wo You Ren Cuo Lao Gong Le
summary: Jing Yi is a manhua artist suffering from selective face blindness. By a freak accident, she mistakes Tan Shuyang, the president of the Tan Shi Group, for her arranged marriage fiancé, and they quickly marry. With her kindness and warmth, she heals his childhood traumas, helping him escape his emotional wilderness. He, in turn, leaves his "marks"—a special perfume, a wedding ring, and kiss marks—on himself to become the only recognizable image in her world. And only when all the confusion is revealed does their true love begin.

name: Untamable Wildness
summary: To save her mother, impoverished student Cheng Xin assumes the identity of a powerful family's widowed daughter-in-law. Suspicious heir Chong Yu challenges her deception, sparking a dangerous attraction.

name: Wei Ni Zhong Qing
summary: Having escaped her tyrannical father and an arranged marriage, Shen Jia Bao vows never to deal with the rich—for her, it's a world of lies and cynicism. In a remote province, she meets a humble cook from a diner whose sincerity slowly melts her heart. They are forced to share a roof, unaware that they are both fleeing their pasts. Only her "poor" lover is actually the heir to a vast fortune, hiding from his family. Now he must choose: continue playing the role of a penniless romantic or risk everything and admit that he is one of the people she hates most in the world.

name: Love Makes Us Brave
summary: To escape her gambling-addicted mother, supermodel Shen Yan targets surgeon and Tang heir Tang Shiqing as a protector, unaware he has already fallen for her and is willingly playing along.

name: You Zen Me Le ，Wo De Da Xiao Jie：Xian Ai Wei Zhi
summary: Reborn eight years in the past, Shen Zhili vows to undo the hurt she caused future husband Jiang Xianzhou. He mistrusts her sudden devotion, while old rivalries threaten her attempt to win him back.

name: E Lie Wen Rou
summary: Childhood sweethearts Cheng Zanshu and Li Xianqing split to protect his family's reputation. Two years later she returns as a journalist assigned to interview him, and their bitter reunion reignites old love.

name: Jiao Cang Jing Zhi
summary: After secretly loving Zhou Yuli for years, Sang Nian unexpectedly marries him. Their polite marriage begins to change as they share highs and lows and decide to start a family

name: Ye Gang Fei Chen
summary: After years of hiding her strength, Chen Mo returns to Gangcheng to reclaim her mother's inheritance and draws heir Zhou Jingxu into her plan, only for their calculated alliance to turn unexpectedly personal.

name: Jie Hun Zheng Shi Jia De，Su Xiao Jie Ke Yi Lian Ai Le
summary: Su Ye discovers her marriage certificate is fake and her partner secretly married the Jiang family's adopted daughter; while plotting revenge, she gains an unexpected ally and new love in powerful Shen Yanyu.

name: Zhi Zhi Yu Hun
summary: Medical PhD Su Zhi marries carefree heir Lu Yu to escape Fu Jingzhou's control. What begins as a protective marriage of convenience changes as trust and genuine affection grow between them.

name: (Don't) Worry with Katy Tur & Jacob Soboroff
summary: (Don't) Worry with Katy Tur & Jacob Soboroff explores pressing political and social questions regarding the future of American democracy and current events.
previous_episode: How worried should we be about the future of American democracy?

name: Das Vergessen - Spurlos im Moor
summary: A police officer's life is thrown off course by a devastating blow of fate. While attempting to solve the mysterious disappearance of her 17-year-old niece, Amelie, Pia Kraus receives a shattering diagnosis: she is suffering from an early-onset form of Alzheimer's disease.

name: Shadows of the Ten Ninja
summary: Fourteen years after the Battle of Sekigahara, imprisoned warrior Sanada Yukimura joins forces with the exceptionally skilled ninja Sasuke Sarutobi and nine other warriors to escape confinement and protect the Toyotomi family from Ieyasu Tokugawa's ambition. As the Sanada Ten Braves head toward the Siege of Osaka, they face betrayals, rivalries, and dangerous schemes while forging unbreakable bonds and challenging the powerful Tokugawa regime.

name: Sam Bai Mai Thao
summary: The story follows a warm and loving family - albeit with a strict father. There is nothing more in life that he loves more than to freeze the moments with his daughters and keep them where he wants them. Perhaps due to his possessive and interfering parental ways, his three daughters are anything but under his firm control.

name: My Secret Zone
summary: The path to love is often entwined with dark, hidden secrets. Nantawan is heartbroken when tragedy strikes, and he cannot save Chalalai's family. As time passes, he becomes successful…his love for Chalalai grows stronger. Chalalai has also grown into a beautiful woman, and Nantawan's love for her has transformed from brotherly to romantic. Fate brings Fakhram into their lives, and he tries to win over Chalalai. However, Nantawan's love for Chalalai is unwavering, and he must find the courage to confess his feelings to her. name: Love in a Cage
summary: Soiinthanin is a beautiful, smart, well-educated girl, who is the daughter of Saengfah, who owns the "Yupharet" house. But because her mother is only a mistress, and she is an illegitimate child, she spends her life in their house being oppressed and not experiencing the same privileges her half-sister Soifah gets. The miserable and painful life of her mother is not lost on her as she too finds herself facing the same fate when she falls for Soifah's fiance Phas, a man who has to marry her half-sister in order to maintain his noble family's honour.

name: Cornette Side of the Ring
summary: Legendary wrestling manager and historian Jim Cornette pulls back the curtain on outrageous, infamous, and unforgettable moments in pro wrestling, offering his unfiltered perspective and opinions in a companion series to Dark Side of the Ring.
previous_episode: Hogan on Late Night / The Black Scorpion

name: Long-Term Relationship
summary: After ending a long-term relationship, Dojin suddenly breaks up with Jihun without warning. Surrounded by memories of their life together, Jihun spends the next year trying to move on. Eventually, loneliness leads him to download a dating app. What begins as casual conversations with a stranger gradually becomes a source of comfort. Encouraged by their growing connection, Jihun finally agrees to meet in person. But when he opens the door, the person standing there is none other than Dojin.

name: La Caída de El Mayo
summary: On July 25, 2024, Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada García, co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel and one of the most wanted individuals sought by authorities for decades, landed at a small airport in New Mexico aboard a private plane alongside Joaquín Guzmán López, son of El Chapo, where he was taken into U.S. custody. Was it a kidnapping, a betrayal, or a covert operation?

summary: For years, the girls have held down the title of "bad", while the fellas have stood on the sideline -- but now, it's the guys turn to lay claim to the crown.

name: The Birds

With a killer on the loose and personal threats mounting, she fights to protect her daughter against a terrifying new menace: vicious, deadly bird attacks inexplicably tied to the crime.

name: Love Spice
summary: A historical drama that celebrates the charm of traditional Thai cuisine—rich in culture, artistry, and identity—woven into the lives and fates of its characters during the reign of King Rama V.

name: Родственные души
summary: Borya lives with his mother, who doesn't want to let him go. After learning that he owns his father's old house, Borya decides to sell the family estate in order to start an independent life. Only after an unfortunate incident did he suddenly start seeing the ghosts of the former owners of the house — his ancestors from different eras: the actress Raisa from the early 20th century, the merchant Fadey from the time of Peter I, a hussar, the Komsomol member Nadya, and a bandit from the 1990s. But suddenly, Egor's long‑time neighbor, Maxim, who has nowhere to live, returns to the apartment, and then Sasha's younger sister, the student Dasha, shows up. On the same day, Anechka, the daughter of her mother's friend, moves into the apartment; she's planning to find a wealthy groom in Moscow, and Sasha's ex‑husband, the assertive Anton, also moves in. With help from guest stars like Home Town's Ben & Erin Napier, and Scott McGillivray and Sarah Keenleyside, they surprise local changemakers with life-changing home renovations, culminating in an emotional grand re-opening that puts this underdog town back on the map.

name: Drop
summary: The story of a 15-year-old junior high school student. Hiroshi transfers from a private school to a public one in order to emulate the delinquents in his manga books. On his first day, he's challenged by the school's most notorious delinquent, Iguchi Tatsuya, and ends up beaten and caught by a detective. He finally gains recognition by winning a one-on-one fight against a student from another school and joins the ranks of delinquents, leading a life of fighting against other schools.
previous_episode: 最終決着！！ 大乱闘の果てに

name: Deepmate
summary: An unintended cohabitation between two women— from that moment on, every emotional boundary begins to blur.

name: Seoul Trip
summary: On the first day of my trip to Seoul, I chased down a man I mistook for a pickpocket, only to end up spending the night with him. To my horror, I later found my wallet tucked safely in my bag—and discovered he was actually waiting for an "outcall service." The moment I'm forced to pay my debt with my body instead of cash, a disastrous misunderstanding spirals into a dangerous Seoul affair.

name: We Go High
summary: We Go High is Netflix Korea's K-pop girl group audition project, set at an arts high school, where students major in their dreams. True to its title, the series promises to capture the pure passion of arts school students striving to reach new heights and bring their talents to a bigger stage. Representing top arts high schools across Korea, these talented students will face off against formidable rivals while building the kind of chemistry it takes to become a group. The project is expected to broaden K-pop's global fandom and bring together a girl group chosen through the eyes of the world.

name: Cue the Laughs
summary: Adam Ray hosts as our favorite sitcom moments happen in real life; family chaos, workplace antics and holiday disasters deliver the laughter. Adam joins the action in Adam Guest Stars and picks his favorite clips in Adam's A-List.

Upon meeting again, Su Tang and Lu Huaisheng accidentally spent the night together, Su Tang became pregnant, they married, and began their journey from a marriage of convenience to true love. Under Lu Huaisheng's powerful and profound protection, the resilient and courageous Su Tang, like a delicate flower, continually grew and transformed!

name: Ming Zhong Zhu Ding Dui Ni
summary: By a strange coincidence, Yan Cheng and Ling Yan's long-standing rivalry ends at the Civil Affairs Bureau. Finding understanding in marriage will be extremely difficult. Or maybe not so difficult… Perhaps, after just a few dozen comical situations and moments of intimacy, the eternal rivals will turn into eternal lovers?

name: Rising With the Wind
summary: Not a trace of her former luxury remains: her father is dead, the company is destroyed, and the traitor is at large. The only chance to reclaim the family legacy is to trust a cynical investor and start from scratch. Will the pampered heiress prove to the world that she was written off prematurely, or will cold calculation destroy her last hope?

name: Contract to the Heart
summary: Ruan Ting Xia, adopted daughter of the Zhou family, witnesses her fiancé Zhou Yan Chen's engagement to someone else. Heartbroken, she gets drunk and hastily marries Song Ji Lin, a rising star in the business world. Initially, it was a marriage of convenience, and Song Ji Lin spoiled her with incomparable tenderness.

name: Darling, I'm Getting Married
summary: Wen Yi Ning and Gu Xi Zhou have been together for 5 years. When she was about to propose to Gu Xi Zhou, she heard that he only treated her as a toy and that he really liked someone else. The heartbroken Wen Yi Ning chose to accept Pei Yu Zhi's proposal and left Gu Xi Zhou.

name: She Was Never a Good Girl
summary: Orphaned young, Na Dan Bi is raised under the iron rule of her strict uncle, who molds her life to his desires. Outwardly obedient but fiercely independent inside, she spends a night with Moon Seo Won at her cousin's wedding, hoping his influence can free her from her uncle's control. But when he unexpectedly falls for her, they are both drawn into a perilous web of love, power, and secrets.

name: The Lily of the Valley Law: Growing Closer the More We Love
summary: Rong Zhi Yan, a wealthy architect heiress, agrees to a marriage of convenience and on her wedding day learns that her fiancé and the father of her child is Yi Chen Ze, whom she abandoned seven years earlier. He is the illegitimate eldest son of the He family, who returned to the family through this union. He promises revenge, but his feelings for Rong Zhi Yan remain. She resists this feigned revenge, hesitates, but her heart is no longer deceived.

name: Secretary Qiu's Marriage
summary: Smart, humorous and tenacious, 25-year-old Qiu Yu is adept at working and is the right-hand secretary of CEO Ji Xiang Dong. Faced with the constant challenges of old love and family interference, Ji Xiang Dong's feelings beneath his cold exterior gradually emerge. Secretary Qiu bravely chooses her own happiness in the whirlpool of work and love.

name: Deeply Pampered Marriage: Accidentally Provoking A Billionaire Husband
summary: An Zhisu was framed for murder and imprisoned in a mental hospital for five years. During those five years, An Zhisu played the role of a well-behaved girl. After her release, she married Ye Lancheng, the president of the Shengshi Consortium. The two went from strangers to acquaintances, and eventually fell in love, with Ye Lancheng always protecting her. Ultimately, with Ye Lancheng's help, An Zhisu cleared her name and reclaimed everything

name: Kill My Sins
summary: "Gu Chenzhou, you always bleed for me. In this life, will you shed tears for me?" She thought that as her bodyguard, he was willing to die for her, but unwilling to love her. Little did she know, he was feeding a tiger with his own body, calculating everything, except for his own heart. On the two sides of a sharp blade, they saw threads of love piercing through the gaps between black and white.

name: Tomorrow Love Letter
summary: Quan Wei was born with a mysterious condition that causes her to age in reverse, growing younger as the years pass. At thirty-five, she meets nineteen-year-old Gu Yao, but their attraction frightens her because their lives are moving in opposite directions. Eight years later, they meet again when both appear twenty-seven, only for fate to repeatedly separate and reunite them. Eventually Quan Wei becomes a nineteen-year-old girl while Gu Yao reaches thirty, forcing her to reveal the extraordinary truth she has been hiding and leaving them to decide whether their love can survive time itself.

name: Kaleb Off The Farm
summary: Clarkson's Farm breakout star Kaleb Cooper is going solo in a brand-new series—swapping Chipping Norton for the Australian outback. Kaleb Off The Farm follows the farming contractor on his first-ever solo trip abroad, and his first time on a plane, as he heads Down Under with dreams of striking it rich in Australian farming. But first he'll need to conquer wheat fields the size of small countries, round up wild cattle on horseback, and learn the hard way that crocodiles aren't just oversized farm dogs.

name: Chao Qi Xing De Tongxing
summary: The disgraced Xunjia is shown the door, and her birth parents, having already received money for her, also refuse to take her in. Just when she feels there's nowhere left to return to, the silent Li Feng extends his hand and utters a few words: "I'll give you a home."

name: Shan Hun Hou Wo Zai Fu Jia Hun Shui Mo Yu
summary: Su Ziyue, the second young lady of the Su family, suffers long-term rumors and cold treatment due to her scheming cousin. After making a bet with her grandfather to regain her father's shares, she has no choice but to find someone for a flash marriage. She casually pulls Qin Muchen, a man involved in a car accident with her, thinking she married a poor nobody. Surprisingly, her husband turns out to be the behind-the-scenes boss of the top conglomerate Xingyao Group! After marriage, Muchen fiercely protects her, dealing with her scumbag ex-boyfriend, punishing her cousin, and helping her secure

name: Obsessed with Her
summary: On the eve of her wedding, supermodel Rong Mei spends one night with a rugged mechanic. A public scandal follows. Then she learns the 'mechanic' is far more powerful than he appeared.

name: Utterly Submit
summary: Jiang Wan Zhi and Ximen Li Chen, the prince of a scientific research family, were having an underground love affair. They dated for three months in college and then broke up for three years. Jiang Wan Zhi was forced to marry the playboy of the Fu family. She drove her fiancé and lover to the hotel on a rainy night, but she didn't expect that the noble man sitting in the luxury car that was hit by the car accident was actually her ex-boyfriend who had been dumped.

name: Mr. Bo, Madame Sold You for Money
summary: Shen Ci Yu, a good-for-nothing daughter, was lying down at home and was kicked out by her parents, who asked her to be self-reliant. Shen Ci Yu learned that her best friend's uncle was recruiting a wife with a high salary, so she immediately went for an interview and finally got a marriage certificate under the temptation of a high salary. She thought she could live a carefree life, but she didn't expect that the curtain of a secret love would slowly be unveiled.

name: Yue Ye Yue Shu
summary: In a cooling marriage, Shi Yue meets her husband's friend Qin Zhao, who is drawn to the bold woman beneath her dutiful-wife facade. Their growing connection unsettles the stable life she wanted.

name: Ban Shu Lao Gong
summary: Wen Ying and Jiang Chen Ye married through a family alliance agreement. What began as a mechanical, routine way of getting along gradually shifted into a sweet, irresistible pull of affection. The icy, aloof husband is slowly melted by his soft and adorable wife, leading to a mutually devoted, healing romance.

name: Reborn in Your Embrace
summary: In her previous life, Shi Xing followed her family's arrangement and got engaged to He Sheng, only to suffer his betrayal and cruelty, ending in mutual destruction with Qi Chen Yan. After being reborn, Shi Xing bravely pursues Qi Chen Yan, and the two begin a sweet romance. The story unfolds around their emotional journey, gradually revealing the truth of their past lives, and ultimately, the two attain a happy ending together.

name: My Bankruptcy Romance
summary: After their parents passed away and the company went bankrupt, Tu Yuan was shamelessly dumped by her brother at the home of his business rival, Xie Yinhe. In order to stay, Tu Yuan pulled out all the stops, pretending to be poor, pitiful, and delicate. Who would've thought she was actually the lamb to the slaughter! Brother, when are you making your big comeback? Your precious little sister is about to be eaten alive! Wait, never mind! Don't bother picking me up, Xie Yinhe must take responsibility this time! Your arch-enemy is now your brother-in-law!

name: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List
summary: Alan Carr's Great Big Bucket List pairs Alan Carr with his comic friends, including Jack Dee, Tom Allen and Joanne McNally and more, sending them on a mission to road-test the world's most popular bucket list activities. Across the series, our comics try as many experiences as possible - from the classic to the absurd - and debate whether each one deserves to stay on the Bucket List or never be spoken of again.

name: Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure
summary: Before Hawkins, there was Marion.

name: The Long March of the Family
Faces Reborn
summary: In the bustling heart of H City, a giant billboard featuring top actor Zhao Xiao towers above the streets. Beneath it, a woman named A Lan stares at his face with burning hatred. Despite the warm summer evening, she keeps herself completely covered, hiding an identity no one would recognize: Zhao Xiao's ex-wife. Her face, covered in stitches, scars, and bruises, is a devastating reminder of the sacrifices she once made for love. Determined to reclaim her life, A Lan turns to plastic surgeon Fang Qi, willing to spend everything she has on a new face—one that will become her ultimate weapon of r

name: Gordon
summary: Inspired by true events, this thriller follows the transformation of Aníbal Gordon, a common criminal who, without ever giving up crime, became a ruthless agent amid the political violence of 1970s Argentina.

name: Melania, The Series
summary: The series, titled Melania, The Series , offers new insight into the behind-the-scenes life of the first lady. The Series reveals never-before-told stories, offering unprecedented insight into Melania Trump's life, including the extraordinary days immediately following the 47th Presidential Inauguration,

name: Estado de Graça
summary: Estado de Graça is a comedy and political/social satire program on RTP1 that takes a humorous look at current events through sketches and impersonations performed by prominent figures in Portuguese comedy.

name: Los archivos secretos del NO-DO
summary: The documentary series Los archivos secretos del NO-DO (The Secret Archives of NO-DO) examines over 6,000 reels of previously unseen film—shot by the Francoist newsreel service NO-DO but never broadcast—with the goal of uncovering which stories were hidden, why they were censored, and what the "B-side" of the dictatorship and the Transition period was really like.

name: Нахальная Катя
summary: The project is built on improvisation, awkward humor, and satirical provocations. In each short episode, Morgunova plays a hyper-serious, stern interviewer who deadpans highly uncomfortable, absurd, or blunt questions to her celebrity guests. The guests are put on the spot, creating a comedic dynamic where they often look like scolded school children trying to figure out whether to laugh or defend themselves.

name: Αχ Ελένη!
summary: Eleni, a sweet and helpful woman, suddenly finds herself alone. As she navigates the comically challenging beginning of her new life, she awkwardly learns how to live as an independent woman!

name: My Boss I Love You
summary: When a strict, perfectionist company president/boss who never yields crosses paths with a charming new secretary who completely disrupts her routine and her heart, a high-tension workplace relationship slowly transforms into unexpected romance.

name: Too Good To Be True
summary: How much luxury do you get for a shot? In Too Good To Be True, Mark and Filemon go on the hunt for the most bizarre bargains. From a Rolls-Royce for €9,000 and a weekend getaway for €29 to an estate in Moldova and a massage for a few euros: everything is bought, booked and tested. Because behind every spectacular offer is the same question: is it a hidden gem or just... Too Good To Be True?

name: Calling All Villains
summary: After years of failed careers and searching for his place in the universe, Mr. Puzzles receives an unexpected opportunity when the galaxy's most notorious villain, The Big Bad, announces a competition to find his successor. Joining forces with a ragtag group of villains, Puzzles must prove he has what it takes to rise through the ranks of villainy. Has Puzzles finally found his purpose, or just another spectacular way to fail?

name: Yuusanchi! from Yuuhachi
summary: A short, stocky, mysterious creature called "The Big Bee," a silent fish hanging in a convenience store named "Pisu-chan," and a clumsy, unreliable raccoon dog weave together a laid-back, surreal everyday life alongside humans in this unpredictable and addictive slice-of-life comedy short anime

summary: Dawid Andres is hitting the road again! After the United States, Indonesia, Kenya, Vietnam, and Australia, this time he'll be working as a truck driver in one of the most colourful and diverse countries in the world - India. The new series is a journey through a land of contrasts, where heavy traffic, crowded cities, picturesque landscapes, and exotic culture will be part of everyday life. Dawid will face the realities of local transportation as he navigates roads full of surprises - from winding mountain roads to crowded urban areas.

In the subsequent stages of the expedition, he shows the day-to-day reality of a truck driver's work, route planning, and the challenges of driving conditions. The route takes him through various climate zones and landscapes - from the ocean coast, through mountain passes, to harsh, desert terrain. The new series takes viewers on a journey through a country of contrasts: skyscrapers and ports, palm plantations, winding mountain roads and jungle trails, monsoon downpours and scorching heat. summary: Twenty years after the murder of the Mexican regional music icon, the production reconstructs the hours that shaped his story and revisits the questions that, two decades later, remain unanswered.

name: Seven Little Australians
summary: Based on Ethel Turner's classic children's novel, this award-winning miniseries is about a family of seven children set in 1890s Australia.

summary: Lomnuea used to believe in love. Then his cousin Pong's marriage proposal is rejected by his long-time girlfriend Green, who leaves him for a wealthier man, and ultimately takes his own life, leaving Lomnuea with a deep resentment. Seung Hyeok, now the club manager, confronts I Hyeon, who works in lowly conditions, leading to a series of hostile interactions rooted in past grievances. When I Hyeon's father is diagnosed with cancer, he reluctantly re-engages with Seung Hyeok under a work and debt agreement. name: Tarifsiz Lezzetler
summary: A Turkish culinary and gastronomy television series on TRT Türk directed by Mir Murad Bedirhan, featuring rotating master chefs every ten episodes as they prepare traditional Anatolian and international dishes.

But the road to that glory is a deadly game, where every step demands a trade of dignity… and life. Than, a struggling musician drowning in debt, is forced into the seductive yet cruel world of bar hosts, where beauty and desire are weapons. There, he clashes with Ray, the club's reigning star: a man obsessed with uncovering the dark secret behind The Legacy and the lover he lost to it. When the truth behind the Masked Deer is finally revealed, Than and Ray realize that The Legac

summary: A girl from Sichuan, Zhang Zhi'an, moves to South Korea to study abroad and stumbles into an elite chaebol academy — landing in Class F, the lowest tier of the social ladder. Here, everyone lives by a strict code of power drawn along lines of birth and family background, and the whole class is steeped in outright malice. But an airhead is the natural antidote to a schemer: armed with her uniquely Chinese brand of relaxed, unbothered obliviousness, Zhang Zhi'an doesn't just fail to sense the hostility around her — she's far too busy wanting to study to care. name: Культ личности
summary: A series of exclusive star‑studded investigations. This is the channel's first project that examines stars not through their creative output or scandals, but through the mechanics of money, control, and PR.

name: Konuşan Fotoğraflar
summary: An award-winning Turkish cultural and visual arts television program exploring the stories behind photographs and visual memory using innovative 2.5D freeze-frame techniques.

name: Maria i ashimi
summary: Maria is an ugly but hard working girl who falls in love with her charming and handsome boss.

name: Love Me to Hurt Me
summary: Song is a glamorous jewellery mogul; she has everything but peace. Haunted by the woman who broke her heart, she seizes the change for revenge when her former lover, Oh, unexpectedly becomes her mother's private nurse. Bound by a contract and trapped under one roof, Oh endures Song's cold cruelty while hiding the painful truth behind their separation. As old wounds reopen, resentment gradually gives way to longing. When the secrets finally surface, however, Song realises she has been punishing the woman who sacrificed everything for her. Is there a second chance for love, or is it already too

name: Inside the Music
summary: In a brand new series, Inside the Music dives into five of the world's most beloved symphonies and their creation. With their specific tone and cadence to create moving art, each symphony will be performed by the orchestra and decoded by principal conductor Edward Gardner, creative director Paavo Järvi and guest conductor Karina Canellakis. Featuring interviews from members of the string, brass, percussion and woodwind section, the group dissect what makes these pieces so special and showstopping, instrument by instrument, as well as looking into the lives of the maestros that made them.

name: Nightswimming
summary: The series creates a multi layered narrative, twisting and turning with every revelation as Matthew returns to his home in Portugal where he was convicted of the brutal murder of his family years earlier. Weaving between past and present, Nightswimming picks apart the events that led up to the devastating night when Matthew's wife, Beth, and two teenage sons, Alex and Simon, were brutally attacked in their beachfront home, while Matthew was performing his nightly ritual, swimming in the ocean. In the present, Matthew mounts his own investigation into the crime that tore his life apart, confron

name: Complicit
summary: Following an unexpected death, Jen Molloy finds herself trapped by a lie that threatens to unravel her life, forcing her to make impossible choices to protect the people she loves.

name: Sheng Shi Lan Shan Chu
summary: Sheng Shi and Gu Lan Shan have harbored a secret love for many years, but one wants to stay with the other while the other wants to escape.

name: Shu Dong Lianren
summary: Gu Yu, a wealthy, second-generation factory heir ("chang er dai") who once lived comfortably at the top of the social ladder. However, a sudden and devastating family crisis strips him of his privilege, forcing him to pick up the pieces of his life from rock bottom. On the other side of the screen is Xu Yan, an emotionally guarded online web novelist who keeps herself isolated from society and locks her inner feelings away from the real world.

name: Xin Xu Shi Ge
summary: Despite her independence, Zhou Ying Tang continues to go on blind dates at her aunt's insistence. On one of these dates, she accidentally meets her classmate Zong Che, a forensic scientist with severe mysophobia. They got married that same day.

name: Ji Zhang Da Ren, Qing Wu Pian Li Xin Dong Hang Xian
summary: When Nebula Airlines' ace female pilot Lu Ling was frustrated in her career and in her life, she happened to meet the new president Cen Yi Lou. She found that Cen Yi Lou was like her ideal man and fell in love with him. Later, she became his co-pilot and fought side by side in the flight mission, and their relationship warmed up.

name: Zhang Xin Kui Ai

It is not until Zuo Xiao Luo, Huo Zhi An's childhood friend, returns from abroad that Zhuang Qian Xi becomes completely disheartened. To avoid alarming their families, both sides continue to maintain a superficial relationship. During this time, Zhuang Qian Xi meets Huo Yu Cheng, Huo Zhi An's elder cousin and the chairman of the Huo Group. She gradually realizes that this restrained and gentle man may be the one who truly saved her. Wheth

After their divorce, she became the only "antidote" for Hong Kong tycoon Huo Yanting. Huo Yanting signed a contract with her to help her divorce and escape his family. Within this mutually beneficial relationship, she capitalized on the situation, confronting her scumbag husband live on social media, breaking free from the shackles of her family and becoming a revered independent woman. name: Yi Jian Ni Jiu Xiao
summary: Unemployed liberal arts student Shen Lehuan repeatedly faces setbacks in her job search. Desperate, she takes a job as a live-in nanny to care for Song Yuqing, who has become withdrawn and irritable after being framed and disabled in a car accident. Initially, Song Yuqing is indifferent, resistant, and emotionally unstable, but Shen Lehuan always accompanies him with gentleness and patience, gradually melting his closed heart with her delicate touch and sincerity. name: Possession, my dear
summary: Tutor Min Jiangxi wins over Qin Zhan's rebellious nephew and clashes with the feared businessman himself. As rivals target her, Qin Zhan protects her and their hostility gradually turns into love.

name: Take Away Love with a Knife
summary: Zhu Pu Yu was framed by her stepmother and stepsister, losing everything she had. She was driven out of her home by her biological father and lived a life of wandering for years. Returning, she vowed to make them pay and take everything back. The moment she saw her stepsister holding her fiancé, Wen Jing Si, she knew her chance for revenge had arrived.

name: I'm Waiting for You to See Me
summary: A girl has to ask for help from her adoptive brother's powerful and scary friend multiple times. When she goes to him again, this time for her adoptive father, he asks that she give herself to him in exchange.

name: Soft Fury
summary: The Wen family of Hong Kong fell overnight, and Wen Yu was imprisoned by Shen Ji Bai. For the sake of the Beigang docks, Shen Ji Bai used Wen Yu's twin sister, Wen Ruan, as a substitute, making her pretend to be his loving wife. Wen Ruan, wanting to escape Shen Ji Bai's clutches, turned her attention to Pei Yan, the Hong Kong heir, while Pei Yan also became curious about this woman with a mysterious identity.

name: Summer Rose
summary: Bai Qing Me is a free-spirited photographer. Zhou Sheng An is an emotionless CEO. She longs for freedom and is afraid of love. His manners are pristine, and he always follows the rules. She lays down the rules for an open but equitable marriage. He agrees. They are engaged. What could go wrong?

name: Tralala
summary: Tralala and her Dad live an idyllic life in a world where cloud-sheep sing, hills talk, and ordinary events unfurl into imaginative adventures with friends from everywhere - even under the sofa!

name: That's Jokes
summary: Animated comedy sketch show with silly jokes and hilarious characters including guinea pigs in wigs, accident-prone newsreaders, a very posh Pomeranian, and many, many more!

name: Ikke kødd med Joe
summary: When Joe moved to Norway, he was scammed by a telephone salesperson. This marked the beginning of a two-year battle to get his money back and a hunt for a company that has managed to avoid punishment for 20 years, despite countless reports and complaints.

name: The Other Elliot Sister
summary: Persuasion was the final novel completed by author Jane Austen – published six months after her death. The story focuses on Anne Elliot, whose family moves to Bath to reduce their debt by renting their estate to an admiral and his wife. The Other Elliot Sister will build on the approach established by The Other Bennet Sister , placing Elizabeth Elliot, a character confined to the margins, at the heart of her own story.

name: Menekşe
summary: Two young people, madly in love when they are just eighteen, dream of overcoming all obstacles to build a new life together. However, the love between Menekşe, who is poor and has no family, and Murat, the heir to the deeply rooted Sancar family, turns into a great test due to their families' opposition. Torn apart in the shadow of separation, silence, and misunderstandings, the two lovers meet again years later while the wounds of the past are still bleeding.
