name: Leonor, Marquesa de Alorna
summary: Confined to a convent since the age of eight, Leonor dreams of freedom. She knows the outside world only through books, yet even these are forbidden. Her imagination and curiosity become her survival tools. She finds love, but her father opposes the union. Once free, she secures the new Queen's blessing for her relationship and dreams of travelling across Europe with her husband. The Queen, however, entrusts her with a mission: to unite the Portuguese and Austrian royal houses. In Vienna, she discovers a world of masquerade balls and forbidden pleasures. Torn between love and royal duty, she f

name: Stars and Vows: Anele & Buzza
summary: Follow media darling Anele Mdoda and her royal fiance Buzza James from pre-wedding celebrations and tense family moments to their long-awaited "I do."

name: Wśród nocnej ciszy
summary: The series follows the brutal murder of a pregnant woman, her husband, and her young brother on a dark country road. It exposes the subsequent cover-up, the wall of silence kept by dozens of local witnesses who were bound by a blood oath, and the grueling investigation to bring the killers to justice.

name: The Ghost Family
summary: The life of Thanwa, a young orphan, changes completely after he finds a red envelope and decides to open it. This simple gesture ends up creating an unexpected connection to the spirit of Jin, a young CEO, leading him to be part of an unconventional family made entirely of ghosts. Between supernatural situations, spooky moments and bonds starting to emerge, Thanwa finds herself wrapped in this family's secrets and will be on a mission to solve a mysterious murder that hides much more than meets the eye.

name: Livatino - Il giudice e i suoi assassini
summary: In the Agrigento area during the 1980s, magistrate Rosario Livatino wages a battle against the power of the Mafia, striking at its interests and assets. In the background, a new generation of criminals seeks redemption through violence. These two paths are destined to cross tragically on September 21, 1990.

name: Skye's Pup Squad
summary: In Skye's Pup Squad , Skye and her best friends embark on an all-girl-pup road trip traveling along the trails of Rescue Ridge. When one of the Ridge's animals is in trouble, Skye makes sure the Pup Squad is "rescue ready!" Whether it's a baby goat climbing too high or a catnapping kitty floating down the raging rapids in a runaway canoe, Skye's Pup Squad will gear up, team up and bring that bestie home. It's heroic, high-flying action meets care, cuddles and cuteness, with plenty of real animal facts and campfire sing-alongs along the way.

name: Hamza: Birds of Prey
summary: Wildlife cameraman Hamza Yassin shares his love of majestic birds of prey. From the UK to Africa, he encounters beautiful, endangered raptors and those fighting to protect them.

name: The Awakened
summary: A man awakens from suspended animation with memories of 1955 and reunites with his grandson, while a boxer begins recovering mysterious memories connected to secrets beneath the sea.

She knows that the one responsible for her long imprisonment was the lawyer, Diego Mendoza; she hates him and swears to take revenge on him for this injustice. Silvana, a violent predator, hits her in the head with a fire extinguisher, which temporarily blinds her. A strange woman called Endrina visits Diego and asks him to repair his injustice. Diego is about to get married with the famous model Vicky Cárdenas. But destiny is going to play its cards and the sudden encounter between Paula and Diego turns into a love story. name: Emperatriz
summary: Emperatriz Jurado is a woman filled with hatred and pain who seeks revenge on Anselmo Lander, the man who deceived her and took her daughter when she was born. With the help of Leonidas León, who also harbors a hatred for Anselmo, Emperatriz devises a plan to destroy both Anselmo and his wife, Alma Rosa Corona. However, Emperatriz's quest for vengeance also shatters the lives of the couple's daughters, leaving them orphaned and separated. The eldest of these girls is, in fact, Emperatriz's own daughter. Camila will grow up to be a beautiful woman and an ambitious reporter. Heartbroken and abandoned by her first love, Camila gives birth to a daughter and becomes a successful professional. Upon discovering this secret, she decides to go to Caracas in search of her father, Israel Santamaría. Pastora Lara Portillo, Raúl's mother and the wife of the powerful Israel Santamaría, will not allow this girl to claim what she believes rightfully belongs to her.

Trapos íntimos

Isabel Cordero is a beautiful, willful interior designer working as an art teacher. Their mission is to disguise, distract, deceive, and hide Shaq in plain sight across Dallas, Texas, for a shot at the grand prize.

name: Salish's 12 Games of Christmas

name: Voltea pa' que te enamores
summary: Dileidy María López earns a living selling newspapers on an avenue in Caracas. She dreams of becoming an engineer and being Luis Fernando García's girlfriend. The problem is, she's only exchanged a few glances with him, and he's from a different social class.

name: Clive Myrie's American Adventure
summary: Clive grew up fascinated by American culture and has served stints as the BBC News correspondent in both LA and Washington DC. Like millions of African Americans, Clive traces his ancestry back to West Africa. But while his family's story unfolded in Jamaica, he has always wondered about that parallel experience of those who arrived in America and were swept up in the Great Migration—the 50-year odyssey that saw six million African Americans leave the South and head North and West. name: SOR

Piotr Hajduk, a brilliant doctor with a complicated past, begins working at the ER managed by Kaśka, his former love interest. Standing between them is Andrzej, a gruff head of department with a sharp tongue. Will the hospital's most merciless floor give a second chance to someone who doesn't deserve it?

name: Por todo lo alto
summary: At the Caribbean San Miguel Arcángel Airport, three beautiful and risky women: Anabela, Morana, and Dulce María, strive to manage their own lives and try to make their way in the aeronautical world which is dominated by men.

name: Dr. G y las mujeres
summary: Gabriel Andrade Nino is a psychiatrist whose skills are mediocre at best. But the doctor believes that his attractive physique will help him to become a famous psychiatrist who can cater to the needs of tormented beautiful women. But what happens when Dr. Gabriel discovers that he has the ability to hear the private thoughts of these women?

name: 90 Day: Florida
summary: Loren built her life in Florida with Alexei and their three children, while Darcey and Stacey headed south as their children grew older and went off to college. Jovi and Yara followed as Yara searched for a place to truly call home, while Jasmine traded the cold of Michigan for a lifestyle closer to her Panamanian roots and Cortney was already living in Florida with her parents when she met Phillip. Santiago is marked by hatred and revenge. Tania, after a strong experience, is transformed into a woman with a message of peace, and will seek at all costs to cleanse those negative and dark feelings present in Santiago's life.

name: The American Heiress

Cora thinks she is in love with Teddy, an American artist, but when she falls off her horse in a hunting accident and wakes up in Lulworth Castle, the seat of the 12th Duke of Wareham, all her certainties are challenged. name: La mujer perfecta

Some of them, to achieve this, will try everything: surgeries, exercises, diets, botox. Others, however, will not even want to achieve it. But above all, it is a story about the different forms of love, the rule of vanity, social exclusion, ambition, fame and its delusions, the cult of the ego and the family as a strength.

Embedded with instructors and students in the field, the series captures the physical demands, mental fatigue and moral clarity forged under extreme conditions. For the first time ever, viewers will witness the intense deliberations that decide each candidate's fate. For many, it is the culmination of a lifelong dream and years of dedication towards a legacy, one that honors the bravery of the American men and women who serve our country.

name: Xiangqin Duixiang Shi Chilai De Xindong

name: Wen Rou Shi Kong

name: Nian Ta: Ta Dian Ji Ta Hen Jiu Le

name: Sweet Marriage

name: Better Late Then First Sight

Burdened by the painful shadow of being an illegitimate child, Zhong Yi has long struggled to escape the wounds brought by her family. Each wants to outsmart the other, but with each passing day, the lines between hostility and attraction blur.

Their marriage seemed like the perfect match until the past intervenes: his first love, the one he was once willing to do anything for, returns to town.

name: Toda una dama

From that moment on, their exciting life together under one roof began.

Her plans are thwarted by an unexpected ally: Third Master Yun, a man of impeccable reputation known as a "living Buddha." Chu Ci and Mu Qing decide to intervene, but Mu Yi's parents add fuel to the fire by unexpectedly revealing Mu Yi's true identity. What will become of the young woman?

One afternoon, a pickpocket on a motorcycle will snatch her purse, but it is not a pickpocket, but Fernando Paz-Soldán, Aníbal's brother. Fernando will fall in love with Ana Paula instantly.

What begins as an innocent fascination gradually turns into an obsession. Sneaky and determined, she manages to interfere in the couple's affairs, until she takes control of their lives.

Body language can be staged. Lines can be memorized. But how do you act out tangled breaths and a heartbeat spiraling out of control?

name: Yes, No, Or Maybe?
summary: Kunieda Kei is the up-and-coming Prince Charming of the evening news. Inside, he's the opposite: brash, hot-tempered, and prickly as can be. For years, Kei has successfully juggled his private and professional personas, until a chance meeting with a stop motion animator threatens to bring it all crashing down. But is that really as frightening as the possibility that someone might love and accept both sides of who he is?

name: Рокировка
summary: Investigative Committee Captain Ekaterina Bulatova teams up with an undercover con artist to solve complex cases. Together, they must track down a thief who stole a secret formula and expose a group of fraudulent IT specialists.

name: Aquaman
summary: Jump into the life of twenty-something Naru as he navigates through the confusing world of modern dating. He's faced with familiar moments we've all been through, such as "Should I add that smiley face at the end of the text?" or "Why haven't they responded to my text?" But the added challenge for Naru? He's never dated, doesn't use a cellphone, and most importantly, someone's out there to sabotage his dating life!

name: She's Fine
summary: Fresh off a messy divorce, Heidi sets out to secure a lively second act for herself and her kids. But when she stumbles into coordinating her father's retirement community sexcapades, Heidi is forced into an unlikely alliance with his girlfriend's perpetually single son.

name: Manukai
summary: Man Yu is a young football prodigy whose skills are judged as not good enough to pursue a professional career. Determined to prove himself, he travels to Japan, where he develops feelings for Kaito, the team's cold-hearted captain. Amid language barriers and cultural differences, Man Yu must navigate his growing feelings for Kaito alongside a close friend who secretly harbors romantic feelings for him.

name: Wallis Simpson
summary: The untold story of what happened to the Duchess of Windsor after Edward VIII's death.

name: Murder Next Door
summary: Learn about some of the most unsuspecting murderers in the country and their horrific crimes, giving chilling insights into when some people become a deadly threat to their neighbours.

The case soon becomes an obsession linked to her own past—a past marked by the death of her sister when they were both young. Her search for answers leads her to uncover the secrets hidden in Ura, a fictional town where some of the inhabitants are determined to prevent the truth from coming to light.

name: Holiday Bakeshop

Guided by one of the killers himself, the female-led team hunts for undiscovered victims and seeks atonement for their department's past mistakes.

Amanda is on the verge of marrying the man she believes to be the love of her life, Arsenio Cuevas; however, she is unaware that Arsenio has a mistress: her own cousin, Ana Belén Sabater. Amanda's life changes drastically when she meets Iván Moros, a handsome young man to whom she feels an immediate, powerful attraction, one that soon blossoms into a deep, enduring love.

name: She Can See
summary: Lin Jianwei, an ordinary girl, suddenly acquires superpowers and learns that the strange creatures of the Classic of Mountains and Seas have never vanished. They live hidden in the modern city. Pulled into one eerie case after another, she encounters divine beasts that are misunderstood and pursued. She transforms from someone swept up in events into a connector between humans and beasts. Confronted with greed and forbidden secrets, she decides to uncover the ancient truth.

name: Space King
summary: The Star Defenders, comically inept Holy warriors, search across the galaxy for artifacts that could lead to the return of their divine leader - Space King.

name: Link Click: The Daily Life in Lightime

name: Barkoni: The Guide to Humanity
summary: An Israeli satirical comedy series starring the viral red alien puppet Barkoni.

name: Elma

name: Rescue 911

name: Niña mimada

name: A calzón quitao

Through their experiences, the novela presents emotional conflicts, intense relationships, and harsh realities, highlighting the struggle for dignity, love, and a better life amid adversity.

Participants must complete various physical challenges to earn a spot on the yacht; however, staying on board is never guaranteed, as strategic maneuvering, manipulation, and betrayal can land them back on the shore at any moment. The format originated in the Netherlands, and filming takes place in Greece.

name: A nemzet hülyéje
summary: Based on the BBC's *Nation's Dumbest* format. Each day, players face a variety of challenges: they must prove themselves through logic puzzles, written and oral exams, presentations, tests of skill, and a quiz. The twist is simple: those who perform well are saved and leave the game, while those who make a mistake remain in it.

name: Í Versta Falli
summary: Katrín is striving to flourish in her life after a colorful childhood, but a mysterious boss, missing mothers, and perhaps a minor alcohol problem cause her to lose herself in a whirlwind of trouble and chaos.

name: Amici
summary: Everyone has grieved the loss of someone who is still alive. AMICI is about that first time. Miguel lost his father and locked himself in his room. His mother and sister don't know what to do with him anymore. Until, one summer in Cascais filled with beaches, parties, and sleepless nights, Felipe appears. Miguel laughs again, goes out again, and falls in love without realizing it. When Felipe disappears, Miguel discovers that the first heartbreak hurts like a funeral. And it's with his mother and sister, the two who remain, that he learns what he couldn't learn from his father: how to say good

name: Arroz con leche
summary: The story of Wenceslao, an older man who has lost his wife Manuela and who has three daughters, Belén, Amanda and Teresa, who lead totally unhappy lives.

name: Food. Curated.
summary: From hidden dumpling shops to boundary-pushing artisan bites, the James Beard Award–winning series spotlights chefs and small food brands shaping the New York City area's food future. Heartwarming and trendsetting, each story reveals the passion behind small businesses that make the region one of the world's greatest food destinations.

name: The Heist
summary: In a game set in the "Most Wanted" universe, players must steal gold bars from a heavily guarded vault.

name: Initial D: Extra Stage
summary: An Initial D side story OAV which follows the lives of Mako and Sayuki, the "Impact Blue" SilEighty team from Usui and their troubles with racers and romance.

name: A tégla
summary: In this adventure and strategy reality show, contestants work together to complete challenges and increase the prize pool, while one of them is secretly playing against the team. Based on the belgian format 'De Mol'.

name: Un esposo para Estela
summary: Estela needs a husband to claim her mother's inheritance and save her indebted ranch. Adriano recognizes her from a recent encounter where his family's necklace went missing. He vies to prove her innocence while recovering the jewel.

name: Mambo y canela
summary: Canela is a cheerful young woman, although she was in an orphanage and lived a hard life. She works as a product demonstrator and during one of these events she meets Rodrigo, a photographer and son of a powerful businessman. Rodrigo has separated from his family after refusing to be in charge of the family business to dedicate himself to photography. There is an immediate spark between them. However, things get complicated for the lovers when Canela is accused of killing Rodrigo's father.

name: ¿Vieja yo?
summary: Margot Batalla, a 50-year-old frustrated actress who seems like an old lady to everyone and is always referred to as "that old lady." One day, excited about an acting role offered in the "Happy Caiman", she had to dress up as an alligator. The owner of the store, Don Pipo, meets Margot, and just by knowing her acting aspirations, he hires her to carry out a role as general manager of the store.

name: Mujer secreta
summary: Eugenia is a beautiful woman trapped in an abusive marriage who struggles to find herself, love, and happiness.

name: El Árbol de Gabriel
summary: Gabriel León is a famous TV host, owner of his own production company and husband of one of the most beautiful women in the country, model Angie Sorelli; But all his happiness is overshadowed when he learns that he suffers from kidney failure and since he has no children or siblings, his only option is dialysis. However Gabriel finds another option in a secret from his past; since in his youth, due to financial needs, he was a semen donor.

name: La vida entera
summary: Julieta Torres is a social communication student who is in the final stage of his university career and to graduate must carry out a thesis on a journalist and decides to do it about Salvador Duque. Salvador Duque is a journalist, intelligent and handsome, who is always pending to seek the truth, the lie. The time they spend together makes them fall in love, their love will be impossible because life will put challenges and obstacles to their love.

name: Carita pintada
summary: Naive, beautiful Aurora Pabuena finds love and happiness with Diego Caceres until Rodrigo Caceres, his malicious twin brother, takes Diego's identity, confusing and hurting her feelings. In the midst of betrayal and disillusion, Aurora escapes to the city and begins a new life as a model and unknowingly becomes the star of her natural mother's fashion line: Carita.

name: ¡Qué buena se puso Lola!
summary: Dolores Santos Estrella is a simple and devoted nurse working in a modest clinic. Jorge Avellaneda is the best surgeon cosmetic main center of the country. Both have lifestyles very different tastes and opinions. However, fate will unite in marriage shortly after they met. Motivated by his perfectionist spirit, want to make it an ideal beauty and unable to convince her to operate, lied and tricked into surgery leads up into an almost perfect woman, as if he were Dr. Frankenstein. She betrayed and transfigured now fight to reclaim their dreams making Jorge, now hopelessly in love with her, not

name: La Dama de Rosa
summary: Gabriela is a young woman whose greatest dream is to become an actress; however, she must abandon her aspirations to help her family, who are facing severe financial hardship. Consequently, she takes a job at a car wash owned by Tito Clemente. This successful businessman has built a vast economic empire alongside his wife - a marriage defined by frustration, a lack of children, and a bond held together solely by money. Gabriela and Tito first meet during the opening of the business, but a clumsy mistake by the young woman leads to her immediate dismissal. In her attempt to keep the job, an att

name: Soñar no cuesta nada
summary: Emilia goes from being a poor immigrant to a millionaire heir. This transformation is a perverse plan that traps her in a web of lies and deception. What starts out as a dream turns into a nightmare that changes your life.

name: Omerta
summary: The series follows the life of the prominent and influential Van Loo family. Behind the perfect image and luxurious lifestyle lies a hidden web of secrets that has to be protected at all costs.

name: Возвращенец
summary: After suffering a concussion in a combat zone, Major Konstantin Andreev is transferred to St. Petersburg and joins the elite criminal investigation department. His partner becomes Artem Belov — at first glance, a seemingly frivolous young man, the son of a general, who has everything in life figured out. But over time, it becomes clear that they are united by their concern for their work and for people's lives. Together, they face a series of cases that reveal a carefully constructed system of "shadow justice," where the concepts of law and justice are blurred.

name: Por estas calles
summary: A world where money is more important than life, where law and order are at stake. A place where honest people must fight to uphold their dreams, love, and truth in order to create a better world for younger generations.

name: Cristal
summary: A poor maid becomes pregnant and is fired; with no money for herself and the child, she leaves her in an orphanage. Years later she has become very rich and successful, but she has never forgotten the child she abandoned years before.

name: Pecado de Amor
summary: During her adolescence, Consuelo Sánchez becomes pregnant by her boyfriend, Adolfo Álamo, who is married to a wealthy, alcoholic woman named Marisela; the couple also has three children: Junior, Andreína, and Rosalía.

name: La Traicionera
summary: Twenty years after her mother's suicide, Renata Medina begins her revenge plan against Eduardo, the man who caused her family great sadness and pain. To lead him to his destruction, she will claim justice using her beauty and wit as her only weapons. However, the young woman does not consider an obstacle that can ruin her plan: she will meet Esteban, the love of her life, the son of that man she hates so much.

name: Dulce ilusión
summary: Dulce María possesses a vast fortune and a great deal of land, yet she wears only rags and spends her days performing various chores under the command of Zarina, whom she serves at every turn. Juan Francisco Corona has been drawn to Dulce María since childhood; this feeling has never wavered, and the romance between them is clear. Together, they set out to fight so that Dulce María may reclaim the fortune that is currently illegally in the hands of Zarina and her two daughters. To achieve this goal, Dulce María relies on some great friends, including imaginary ones such as Homero the lizard, P

name: Rubí rebelde
summary: When she was selling newspapers, a young man of good social position named Víctor Alfonso almost ran over Rubí, who fell in love with him and he, moved by her situation, employed her in his own house. Doña Leonor, who deeply hates Lucrecia for ruining her son's life, ends up declaring Rubí the universal heiress of her immense fortune. From this moment on, Rubí will be the object of Lucrecia's anger and her son.

name: The Team: Michigan Football
summary: Featuring never-before-seen footage and firsthand accounts from Michigan greats including Fox NFL lead analyst and seven-time Super Bowl champion Tom Brady, legendary coach Jim Harbaugh, Pro Football Hall of Famer and 'Fox NFL Kickoff' analyst Charles Woodson, famed quarterback J.J. McCarthy, three-time national championship-winning head coach and ‘Fox Big Noon Kickoff' analyst Urban Meyer, NFL stars Blake Corum and Brian Griese and other renowned sports figures, The Team: Michigan Football takes viewers inside Michigan's historic 1997 and 2023 national championship seasons to examine the trad

name: Classic Movies: Iconic Scenes
summary: Ian Nathan examines some of the most memorable scenes in the history of cinema.

name: Clangold
summary: Clangold explores the spectacular 2017 theft of the 100-kilogram "Big Maple Leaf" gold coin from Berlin's Bode Museum. Through the perspectives of investigators, the four-part documentary follows the investigation into the Remmo clan, the subsequent trial, and the challenges faced by authorities in prosecuting organized crime in Germany.

name: Ultraman Arc
summary: A being of light hailing from a faraway galaxy unites with Yuma, the protagonist who owns tremendous "power of imagination," and they form the gigantic new Ultra Hero: Ultraman Arc.

name: A Walk in Your Shoes
summary: Noggin's " A Walk in Your Shoes " helps kids learn about cultural, religious, and geographical differences by watching two real people from different backgrounds switch places for a few days.

name: Viola, Who Was inside You
summary: Minato enters university struggling to fit in, uncomfortable around other people and unable to find a place where he truly belongs. However, he catches the attention of Haru, the head of the drama club, who casts him as Viola, the lead role in the stage production of Twelfth Night. Though confused about playing a heroine in women's clothing despite being male, Minato gradually finds himself drawn to Haru through their rehearsals together. But his insecurities, anxieties about gender, and the presence of Haru's former lover, Kaede, stand in the way, causing Minato to suppress his true feelings.

name: Mi ex me tiene ganas
summary: Three friends live in a cosmopolitan city: Pilar, Miranda and Soledad. For Pilar, having her ex suddenly show up saying he loves her is completely unbelievable, given that he left her, pregnant, in the middle of a freeway. The possibility of rekindling that flame doesn't even cross her mind. Miranda is a model who accidentally runs into her ex husband. Now married to a multimillionaire, she misses her ex's unbridled passion, so temptation is very strong. And Soledad, a divorcée burdened with endless household chores, casually meets her ex lover, now a model - a gorgeous model promising to brea

name: Hunkkaar: The Roar
summary: When 17-year-old Meenu Rawat accuses Baapji, a revered and politically connected spiritual leader, of sexually assaulting her, her complaint sets off a national storm. Backed by a determined police officer, ACP Jasleen Singh Soin, a lawyer and a journalist, Meenu takes on a powerful man's influence, a hostile media trial and a divided public in a fight for justice that plays out from the police station to the courtroom.

name: Trópico
summary: Set in the beautiful beaches and the capital of the Dominican Republic, this melodrama revolves around the young, provincial Angelica Santos who works in the local tobacco hacienda "La Guzmana". Angelica leaves her home to get away from her unscrupulous aunt, and goes to Santo Domingo. Then she joins a beauty pageant sponsored by Guillermo Guzman and there she meets and falls in love with Antonio Guzman. Their love is quickly torn apart by Antonio's brother and Angelica's aunt, who conspire against them.

name: Secreto de amor
summary: Maria Clara and Carlos Raul are in love and preparing to get married. But everything changes when he looses his job, postpones the wedding, moves to Miami and there becomes involved with a wealthy heiress.

name: Ser bonita no basta
summary: Coral, Topacio, and Esmeralda Torres are three sisters who grew up without knowing each other and live separate paths, very different from each other. For these three women, beauty is everything, however, the different experiences they will live will lead them to face a great truth and reconsider the role of the physique in their lives. Love will be a real challenge in their lives and will lead them to rediscover themselves.

name: Amor Comprado
summary: A wealthy playboy must rush to find a bride and marry before his 30th birthday—or risk losing his massive inheritance—while dealing with a manipulative grandmother and unexpected, genuine love.

name: Te tengo en salsa
summary: Adriana Palacios Guillén is a woman facing severe financial hardship. When her younger sister, Patricia, becomes pregnant by an unknown man and decides to put her newborn daughter up for adoption, Adriana chooses to adopt her niece—whom she names Tatiana—despite her own difficult circumstances.

name: The Jigsaw Puzzle Murder
summary: A dismembered human torso is discovered in a Manchester woodland. With no DNA match, witnesses, murder weapon or obvious suspect, detectives open a murder investigation with almost nothing. And then more body parts appear across an unsettled city.

name: Az igazság mániákusai
summary: This two-part documentary series explores Hungary's most notorious and high-profile criminal cases following the fall of communism through the regular dinner gatherings of a unique group of friends - including retired detective Ernő Tóth and his former colleagues.

name: Olvidarte Jamás
summary: A woman lost her youth and innocence to a wealthy family and has been waiting 20 years for the perfect opportunity to get even. When Luisa Dominguez (Sonya Smith) was a teen peasant working on the ranch owned by Don Gregorio Montero, she was seduced by the owner's son, Gonzalo Montero (Sebastián Ligarde), and became pregnant. But she lost the baby at the hands of Gonzalo's angry wife, Gladis, who violently beat Luisa in a jealous rage. Years later, Luisa has grown into a beautiful, rich and confident woman who has changed her identity to Victoria Salinas. With her adopted daughter, Carolina, V

name: Code Zero
summary: Code Zero introduces Police Sergeant Laura Collier who is pragmatic, funny and no-nonsense, the kind of officer you'd want to turn up if you dialled 999. Laura is assigned fresh-faced new recruit Cal to take under her wing on his first day – a day which quickly takes a dark turn as they're ensnared in a meticulously crafted bank heist. As Laura and her team are pulled into a fast-paced cat-and-mouse investigation, the consequences of the heist begin to impact her life in ways she never could have imagined.

name: The Young Team
summary: 15-year-old Azzy Williams and his pals roam the streets of Airdrie on a Friday night, bottles of Buckfast in hand and techno playing from tinny speakers. Azzy is ready. Ready to smoke, pop pills, drink wine and fight. He longs to become fully initiated into local gang the Young Team Posse (YTP). But when Azzy, determined to prove himself, makes a bold move, a brutal gang conflict ensues with Azzy very firmly at its heart. The Young Team will follow Azzy on his journey from boyhood to manhood as he and his mates become postcode warriors in a toxic cycle that threatens to consume them. An unflin

name: Charmer
summary: Charmer follows an ambitious group of thirty-something Londoners whose lives are turned upside down by Ryan, a seducer-for-hire employed to test the fidelity of his wealthy clients' partners. As a wedding day draws closer, an assignment becomes personal, threatening the professional distance that has always underpinned Ryan's work. As deception gives way to desire, Ryan risks breaking the one rule that has always defined him: never fall in love. Charmer is an exploration of trust, desire and the pursuit of authentic love.

name: El Castillo
summary: Two inspectors from Spain's UCRIF unit investigate a network of roadside clubs and brothels where women from around the world are sexually exploited. As they follow the trail, they uncover the criminal networks operating behind Spain's sex trade.

name: Segunda temporada
summary: In 2024 Barcelona, former literary sensation Paula grapples with unstable gigs and creative drought while navigating a landscape of fading stars and relentless pressure to remain relevant.

name: Traveling Through Time To Become An Immortal Emperor, The System Arrives 80000 Years Late
summary: Zhao Yingxiong has lived for eighty thousand years in the way legends usually begin: without prompts, daily rewards, or a convenient system, through protracted cultivation, wars, the fall of sects, and endless attempts to break through the level of an immortal emperor. When the long-awaited systemic voice finally appears in his mind, it comes not to a weak newcomer, but to a man who has already endured too much to enjoy training assignments.

name: Her Willing Subject
summary: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

name: Dang Ai Di Da Shi
summary: Ni Wu takes her daughter to the hospital, only to discover that the attending doctor is her ex-boyfriend Pei Huai Yu, from whom she broke up seven years ago. Pei Huai Yu does not recognize her and is unaware that she secretly gave birth to his daughter. This unexpected reunion brings back painful memories for Ni Wu, while fate continues to intertwine their lives. Pei Huai Yu's heart recognizes her before his mind does.

name: Mark of a Murderer
summary: A gripping Australian true crime series revealing the truth about two men convicted of murder - Andrew Mallard and Simon Rochford. Former journalist, now MP Colleen Egan exposes police failures, gross miscarriages of justice and unmasks a suspected serial killer.

name: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
summary: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle opens up the hidden rooms, sealed archives and private spaces, to uncover the untold stories behind the buildings and the people who lived in them. Across four episodes, Lucy unlocks the secrets of Britain's majestic Blenheim Palace (birthplace of Winston Churchill); the glittering Versailles Palace in France - and one of its most infamous residents, Queen Marie Antoinette; the fairytale castle Neuschwanstein in Germany; and Venice's intriguing Doge's Palace. While these spectacular palaces host millions of visitors every year, Lucy Worsley's Keys To The Castl

name: The Hills Are Alive: A Year at Kylemore Abbey
summary: Kylemore Abbey, a lakeside Gothic castle, set amidst the beautiful landscape in Connemara, was once the family home of a wealthy Victorian MP, but, for the last hundred years, has been a Benedictine Abbey. Now, facing rising bills and falling vocations, the nuns embrace tourism, commerce and ecology, alongside their religious life, in their efforts to secure the future of Kylemore and their community.

name: Κάρμα
summary: True crimes that shocked Cyprus. A moment of insanity and an uncontrollable outburst of rage are enough to push man beyond his limits and turn him into a ruthless beast, proceeding to the most horrific act ... a crime of passion / hate / vendetta stained with the deep red color of blood.

name: Hec
summary: A church burns down in a small village, and with it the belief that people truly know their neighbours. The return of criminal investigator Alena reopens old guilt and stirs up new suspicions.

name: Asiye
summary: Asiye , a story that blends the boundless power of motherhood, compassion, and impossible love in an ancient tale.

name: Oro
summary: In French Polynesia, after a shipwreck, nine environmental activists find themselves trapped on an island as fascinating as it is unsettling. Between unexplained phenomena, ancestral beliefs, and wounds from the past, the group's cohesion threatens to shatter.

name: Secrets of the Ancient Wonders
summary: Combining the latest archaeological research with state-of-the-art scanning technology, Secrets of the Ancient Wonders transforms detailed survey data into spectacular 3D models, brought to life on a vast Volume Wall. Archaeologist Dr. Alice Roberts, alongside leading specialists, explores these remarkable structures as never seen before, uncovering new insights into their construction and the civilizations that created them.

name: Who's In The Band?
summary: Who's In The Band? will put a twist on the traditional talent show as five contestants sing the same song at once, each inside a brightly colored soundproof tube, while judges at their own mixing desks isolate vocals and eliminate hopefuls in real time, and will culminate in a live finale that sees one girl band and one boy band go head-to-head.

name: 10η εντολή
summary: Stories of ordinary people that at a crucial point of their lives cross the limits in a shocking way.

name: Κόκκινος Κύκλος
summary: A series of episodes based on real crimes that shocked the public opinion. But these stories have been altered so as the people involved not to be recognized. The heroes are sometimes the perpetrators and sometimes the victims.

summary: Have you ever thought what your life would be like if within you lived an alter ego who made you consider yourself the splitting image of perfection; i.e.: "An Argentinean"? Well our Valentino did. Valentino is a confident and fascinating man with a special allure and pizzazz for making women fall on his feet thanks to his alter ego "The Argentinean", an imaginary friend that appered while he was a boy whene his mother confess to him that his father is a grand Argentinean who is the owner of "La Pampa". It is "The Argentine" who will be the one maintaining the distance between Valentino and Ma

summary: A young woman from the countryside moves to the city to seek justice against the woman who swindled her parents and had them killed when she was a baby.

She lives with her mother Matilde and her two sisters Niurka and Patty. One day Rebeca crashes her delivery truck into the car of Eduardo Montalbán, a rich and dashing playboy. Since the accident a romance develops between them. However, Eduardo's girlfriend, Princesa Izaguirre pushes for a marriage and is determined to eliminate the competition. Rebeca encounters Sergio Montalbán, unaware that he is Eduardo's father. Now father and son will become rivals for t

name: La pasion de Teresa
summary: Teresa is a young novice in a Miami convent who prepares to take her religious vows. When she learns that her father has been murdered, she abandons the convent to seek revenge. Her plans become complicated due to interference from her stepmother, Sabrina, and a temporary blindness. Amid these trials, she falls in love with Guillermo, while dealing with the deceit of his twin brother, Alberto, who schemes to use her fortune.

name: Die Tuning Profis
summary: Timo, Charly, Bolle, and Jörni—tuners who gained fame on the VOX automotive show "auto mobil"—set out to fix the botched modifications that German hobbyist mechanics have inflicted upon their beloved vehicles. In this docuseries, dull and often battered cars are transformed into exciting, one-of-a-kind machines. For "Die Tuning Profis" (The Tuning Pros), failure is not an option; they always know exactly what needs to be done.

name: Amores de fin de siglo
summary: Amores de fin de siglo , follows the lives, conflicts, and complex relationships of various couples at different stages of commitment, famously using the tagline "The telenovela that begins where the others end"

name: La Goajirita
summary: Analía leaves behind her indigenous roots and customs to be close to Ángel, her husband, navigating a complex web of romance and drama.

name: Susuz Yaz
summary: In the 1970s, in the village of Çarlak in Adana, Osman and his older brother Hasan work the land to make ends meet, but Osman's deep love for Bahar upsets the balance between the two brothers.

name: From Gaming to Murder: The Killing of Breck Bednar
summary: Told by Breck Bednar's family and friends, this powerful series reveals how the innocent world of an online gaming group became the stalking ground of a predator. Lewis Daynes created a fantasy life of a tech millionaire in order to isolate and groom 14-year-old Breck. Despite Breck's parents' desperate efforts to protect him, Daynes lured Breck to his murder with the most cynical of lies.

name: Fokus
summary: 17-year-old Tove Nyberg is the star athlete at Fokus, an elite figure skating club in Espoo, with her sights set on securing Finland's sole Olympic spot. Weeks before the most critical competition season, Tove's longtime private coach, Jaana, suffers a sudden medical emergency under murky circumstances and goes on extended sick leave.Tove teams up with a new coach, Miina—a former European gold medalist and Jaana's ex-star pupil—just as Jaana's talented former skater Karla returns to the competitive ice. name: Fleet Street
summary: Fleet Street begins in 1901. Queen Victoria is dead, and all the newspapers are racing to capture a nation at the end of an era. The death of a florist with ties to the Royal Household gives Kitty and Samuel their first lead. A missing son, an anonymous message and a violent death draw them into an investigation reaching far beyond the newsroom. With the Queen's funeral approaching, powerful people have good reason to keep the truth out of print. The story could make Kitty's career and restore Samuel's or put them both in danger. Blending mystery, political intrigue, romance and a touch of wit

name: Acorralada
summary: Trapped, also known in Spanish as Acorralada , is a 2007 telenovela produced by Venevision. While a woman lives a fabulous life of wealth and comfort, she hides the dark secret that she stole everything she has from her best friend years ago. Octavia Irazabel owns a successful perfume factory, lives in a beautiful mansion, and is able to get whatever she wants. name: He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part

summary: Hosted by NFL mvp Cam Newton, 4th & 1 presents: 'Quarterback Club' takes you inside football's most exclusive fraternity. Every Wednesday, Newton sits with Hall of Famers, current superstars, and rising phenoms for raw, unfiltered conversations about mental warfare, sideline chaos, and the realities of life under center. No filters. No media spin. Just the truth from the generals of the gridiron.

name: The Joker's Wild
summary: On The Joker's Wild , two contestants compete by taking spins on the High Roller slot machine, using their luck and knowledge to win big. The contestants answer questions based on categories that come up in their spins, and Jokers are wild, increasing the points up for grabs. After three rounds, the contestant with the most points wins the game. That winner moves on to the new Joker's Jackpot bonus round where they'll face tempting deals with the Devil as they try to take home up to $50,000.

name: GialappaShow
summary: The Gialappa's Band and Mago Forest are back with a fresh show, featuring sharp-witted jokes, special guests, and ironic commentary on the best (and worst) of television and social media.

name: Swing Me to Your Heart
summary: Switched at birth, Qiao Xing Ye returns to her biological family but is never treated like she belongs. She is schemed against by her adopted sister and almost loses her life. No one in her family seems to trust or love her. Her family and fiancée's mistreatment only increase when her adopted sister, Liang Yu Tong, is diagnosed with cancer. Whilst planning for her wedding, Xing Ye is abandoned as her fiancé is really in love with her adopted sister. After three whole years of disappointment, Xing Ye grows tired of the cold indifference, her scumbag fiancé and the life she had come home to. Pre

name: An Lian Shi Ke Xing Xing Tang
summary: Tan Xu Ze is the pride of heaven, while Shu Mian secretly admires him but never dares to hope. One night in college, after getting drunk, Shu Mian blurted out that she wanted to pursue him. From then on, Tan Xu Ze walked her back to her dorm, sat through classes with her, brought her breakfast—teasing openly and tempting subtly, showering her with indulgence and affection. When the little girl shyly asked if she could chase after him, Tan Xu Ze pulled her into a fierce kiss: "What do you think?"

name: Zhi Jing Dong Feng Xue
summary: Lin Zhi Yun experienced a difficult childhood and complicated family relationships. She lives alone, works as a translator, and her life seems bleak and joyless. On New Year's Eve, she borrowed a lighter from a well-known, successful lawyer, Yuan Zhi Feng. He not only lit fireworks but also illuminated her life. Yuan Zhi Feng surrounded her with attention and care, becoming her true salvation, just as he had been seven years ago. Thanks to him, she learned the power and tenderness of true love.

name: Xue Luo Shi Feng Ni
summary: After university, Wen Jiu and Zhou Yanchuan went their separate ways: she became a lawyer, he a successful entrepreneur. A chance encounter at a high school reunion revealed that their feelings hadn't cooled. But what should they do when the reason for their breakup still looms large?

name: Ci Wei De Yong Bao
summary: On what should be the happiest night of their lives, a newlywed couple transforms a simple bar outing into a high-stakes game of wits and charm. He's a confident, free-spirited doctor who never loses, while she's a shrewd and ambitious business powerhouse who refuses to settle for second place. What begins as a marriage of convenience and strategy soon transforms into an emotional battleground where pride meets passion. As hidden pasts resurface and carefully constructed facades begin to crack, their constant rivalry gives way to unexpected tenderness. Amidst laughter, heartbreak, and betrayal

name: Qu You Ni De Di Fang
summary: After a divorce with the CEO of Lin Corp, Ruan Rong leaves with a fortune in her hands and offers handsome pay to whoever she deems fit to father her child. Her assistant introduces her to a male model who seems perfect in every aspect—except that he is her ex-husband's friend, the powerful and ruthless CEO, Mu Jin Chen! Rumor has it that he rarely involves himself with women, so why did he agree to the offer? Meanwhile, her ex-husband unexpectedly proposes remarriage. Who is she going to choose?

With her signature northeastern sincerity and determination, she overcomes all obstacles. Xiaohui not only heals the protagonist's soul, crushed by his family's expectations, but also wins the affection of his entire family. Ultimately, this bold and free-spirited woman proves that if you live authentically and are yourself, you can win over even the most influential family.

When Tom's Recon Team comes across plans for the upcoming Tet Offensive, it unleashes a chain of events that pulls the young warrior out of the jungles and into the shadows of Cold War espionage.

Now nine years after his release from prison, his innocence long forgotten, he's an ex-con who takes nothing for granted. With his wife Olivia pregnant and the two of them closing on a house in his hometown, things are looking up. Until the day Matt gets a shocking, inexplicable video call from Olivia's phone. And in an instant, the unraveling begins.

summary: Haruto Hatsushima, a genius forensic pathologist and former neurosurgeon, works at Tokyo's National Forensic Autopsy Center, solving mysterious deaths caused by rare, undetectable diseases. Hailed as "a genius chosen by God," he treats each case as a "Quiz from God," uncovering hidden truths behind society's darkest tragedies. Yet Haruto harbors secrets of his own: a mysterious illness slowly consuming him and a hidden truth buried in his past.

summary: Fabryka Zirok is a Ukrainian music talent reality show and the 2026 streaming revival of the Star Academy format on Sweet.tv. The brand has spawned international versions, merchandise, world-record-breaking live events and unforgettable TV moments. The new series will build on that legacy with ambitious films and a renewed sense of scale for a new generation of viewers - while introducing a fresh cast led by Gordon Ramsay.

name: Yakiniku no Onna: Ayamonji Akana
summary: Ayamonji Akana, a 31-year-old who works at a yakiniku restaurant because of her love for the meat, is easily smitten and has a habit of comparing men to different cuts of meat. She has always found solace in yakiniku after heartbreaks. However, her happy life takes a turn when she discovers her live-in boyfriend is cheating on her. Then, a man named Shirasaki Rei appears before her, offering unsolicited, blunt advice on love.

name: Style Wars
summary: It features 72 of Korea's "Top Fashionistas" in a battle to become the country's "next fashion icon." Featuring fashion lovers from all walks of life, including hobbyists, college students, pensioners influencers, amateurs and professionals, the upcoming survival show will see some of Korea's best-dressed compete against each other in a series of high-stakes challenges.

name: Last Siren
summary: Emergency medical personnel belonging to the Yokohama City Fire Department are dispatched every day to save lives, confronting and overcoming the harsh realities of Japanese society.

name: Night Tales Club
summary: Yamada Takayuki stars as Hojo Zenichi, a wealthy entrepreneur obsessed with unexplained phenomena. Viewing the supernatural as "glitches" in a hidden conspiracy, he establishes the Night Tales Club and offers a 20-million-yen reward for stories and evidence of paranormal encounters.

name: Chef of Antarctica
summary: Let's raid the Antarctic base's storage shed and serve warm meals to the thousands of researchers living in isolation, separated from their families, in Antarctic stations across more than 30 countries, driven by a sense of mission!

name: Heart in Danger
summary: After his father is accused of treason and mysteriously dies, Pie becomes an intern at the company of Tharn, the man demanding that he repays his father's debt. His boss takes him into his home, giving him the perfect opportunity to investigate the truth.

name: Porucznik Kabura
summary: In the year 2050, Ryszard Kabura—a small-time plumber and gambling addict running from his creditors—enlists in a galactic military mission and accidentally becomes Earth's only hope against an alien invasion.

name: Love Destiny from Hell
summary: Meth, an ordinary young archaeologist, finds himself entangled in a strange situation when his beloved younger brother is threatened by a mysterious man with silver hair and cold, deathly eyes. Preparing to face a murderer, Meth discovers instead that he's confronting a reaper. As he interferes with Grim's work, Meth becomes trapped in a twisted, unbreakable bond with the ruthless reaper, leading them both into an inescapable, eternal cycle.

summary: Series investigating the disappearance of a 15-year-old girl living in Spain's Costa del Sol, and the family divisions and unanswered questions that have surrounded her case ever since. summary: Deep Water Secrets sets out to explore the unexplained and the never-before-seen, detailing encounters with history's strangest aquatic mysteries, from creatures to natural anomalies to lost cities and monuments, and much more. Similar to the beloved sci-fi novel Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas, the series will explore both fiction and fact, delving into present-day mysteries, as well as stories and myths from the past, and in some instances, how they intersect. While some cases will be debunked, others will never be completely understood.

name: Love above the Clouds
summary: Spy Rin is tasked with infiltrating a cybersecurity company to uncover evidence against a suspected-cybercriminal, CEO Seer. As she grows close to her mark, she begins to see the situation is more complex than imagined, and she may be facing a life-altering choice between duty and her heart.

name: Reversed Lovers
summary: Han Seok Jin, a renowned tarot reader, is left betrayed after his fiancée disappears with 10 billion won. He then forces his way into Seung Bin's home, insisting they live together. Contestants will tackle an epic, zany, visually jaw-dropping course packed with inventive obstacles, physical challenges and laugh-out-loud jeopardy. Bringing together the UK's most passionate crazy golfers - from top class professionals to keen amateurs - who are fearless everyday thrill-seekers, the series delivers skill, scale and Ant & Dec's trademark comedy mischief in equal measure.
